title: Intrinsic polarization superjunctions in III-nitride heterostructures for efficient power electronics
abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    III-nitride semiconductors combine a wide bandgap with low sheet resistance and, thus, can be used for efficient power electronics. Their lateral architecture also enables monolithic integration on cost-effective silicon. However, electric-field crowding, as well as surface and buffer trapping, limit the breakdown voltage, degrade dynamic performance and reduce reliability. Here we report intrinsic polarization superjunctions in III-nitride heterostructures for efficient power electronics. We use the spontaneous and piezoelectric polarization fields to induce matched mobile electrons in a two-dimensional electron gas and mobile holes in a two-dimensional hole gas, forming an intrinsically charge-balanced superjunction without intentional doping. With an ohmic contact to the two-dimensional hole gas, both carrier types can be dynamically depleted during switching, which preserves drift-region charge neutrality, producing a nearly uniform electric field and increasing the breakdown voltage under operating conditions. We use the approach to create gallium-nitride-on-silicon polarization superjunction Schottky barrier diodes with a breakdown voltage exceeding 3.9 kV and a specific ON resistance as low as 4.7 mΩ cm
                    2
                    , as well as polarization superjunction transistors with a breakdown voltage exceeding 3.4 kV. The devices exhibit a near-ideal dynamic ON-resistance degradation of less than 15% up to 3 kV, as well as repeatable, temperature-stable and avalanche-like breakdown.
title_zh: III族氮化物异质结构中的本征极化超结用于高效电力电子器件
abstract_zh:
摘要

                  
                    III族氮化物半导体兼具宽禁带和低薄层电阻的特点，因而可用于高效电力电子器件。其横向架构还能实现高性价比硅衬底上的单片集成。然而，电场集中以及表面和缓冲层陷阱效应限制了击穿电压，劣化了动态性能并降低了可靠性。本文报道了用于高效电力电子器件的III族氮化物异质结构本征极化超结。我们利用自发极化和压电极化场在二维电子气中感应出匹配的可动电子，并在二维空穴气中感应出可动空穴，从而在无需有意掺杂的情况下形成本征电荷平衡的超结。借助与二维空穴气的欧姆接触，两类载流子在开关过程中均可被动态耗尽，从而保持漂移区电荷中性，产生近乎均匀的电场，并提高工作条件下的击穿电压。我们利用该方法制备了硅上氮化镓极化超结肖特基势垒二极管，其击穿电压超过3.9 kV，比导通电阻低至4.7 mΩ cm2，并制备了击穿电压超过3.4 kV的极化超结晶体管。该器件在3 kV以内表现出低于15%的近理想动态导通电阻退化，并具有可重复、温度稳定且类似雪崩的击穿特性。

title: Scalable Hierarchical Structuring Enables Robust Non-Wetting Condensation and Anti-Frosting on Stainless Steel
abstract: Abstract Scalable fabrication of surface morphologies with sufficiently high energy barriers remains a key limitation in achieving stable non-wetting condensation on stainless steel, as its chemical resilience makes controlled surface structuring challenging. Here, we leverage the intrinsic microstructural features of additively manufactured 316L stainless steel to generate dense microneedle arrays, further decorated with nanostructures to enhance wetting resistance and enable sustained coalescence-induced droplet jumping. The engineered surface maintains stable droplet removal under pure vapor conditions, achieving a 2.5–3.7 X enhancement in heat transfer coefficient compared to filmwise condensation, across a subcooling range of 4.1 to 11.3 K. Notably, strong resistance to wetting transitions is observed across a wide range of supersaturation conditions during a continuous 20 h test. In addition, frosting is significantly delayed by suppressing ice nucleation and propagation, retaining approximately 60% frost-free area after 180 min at –10 °C and 50% frost-free area after 100 min at –13 °C whereas the untreated surface is fully covered by frost within the first 10 to 30 min. This work establishes a scalable strategy for stabilizing non-wetting condensation on stainless steel, enabling improved thermal performance and expanding the application space of additively manufactured metals.
title_zh: 可扩展分级结构实现不锈钢表面稳健的不润湿冷凝与防结霜
abstract_zh: 摘要 在不锈钢上实现稳定的非润湿冷凝，其关键限制之一仍是如何可规模化地制备具有足够高能垒的表面形貌，因为不锈钢的化学稳定性使可控的表面结构化具有挑战性。在此，我们利用增材制造316L不锈钢固有的微观结构特征生成密集的微针阵列，并进一步以纳米结构修饰，以增强抗润湿性并实现持续的聚并诱导液滴弹跳。该工程表面在纯蒸气条件下保持稳定的液滴脱除，在4.1至11.3 K的过冷度范围内，与膜状冷凝相比传热系数提升2.5–3.7倍。值得注意的是，在连续20小时测试中，在很宽的过饱和度范围内均观察到对润湿转变的强抵抗能力。此外，通过抑制冰成核与扩展，结霜被显著延迟，在–10 °C下180分钟后仍保持约60%的无霜面积，在–13 °C下100分钟后保持50%的无霜面积，而未处理表面在最初的10至30分钟内即被霜完全覆盖。这项工作确立了一种使不锈钢上非润湿冷凝稳定化的可扩展策略，可提升热性能并拓展增材制造金属的应用空间。

title: Dual-Oxide-Modified Electrospun Carbon Nanofibers Enabling Hierarchically Porous Composite Electrodes for Regulated Zinc Deposition in Zinc–Manganese Flow Batteries
abstract: Abstract Zinc-based flow batteries (ZBFBs) are promising candidates for large-scale energy storage. However, their practical application is limited by uneven interfacial electric fields and uncontrolled dendrite growth during zinc deposition. Herein, we report a hierarchical zincophilic composite electrode combining a conventional carbon felt with an electrospun carbon nanofiber scaffold modified by ZnO and SiO2. This multiscale porous structure improves both electrolyte transport and charge distribution. Specifically, the macroporous carbon felt facilitates electrolyte flow, while the nanofiber network increases the electrochemically active surface area to homogenize the local electric field. Furthermore, the dual oxides act as regulated zinc nucleation sites and mechanical plasticizing components, lowering the nucleation overpotential and relieving localized stress during repeated plating and stripping. Consequently, the electrode promotes uniform and highly reversible zinc deposition under high areal loading. The resulting ZBFBs achieve highly stable performance for over 50,000 cycles at 60 mA cm–2, demonstrating exceptional durability under practical, high-current-density operations.
title_zh: 双氧化物修饰的静电纺丝碳纳米纤维实现分级多孔复合电极用于锌锰液流电池中锌沉积的调控
abstract_zh: 摘要 锌基液流电池（ZBFBs）是大规模储能的有力候选技术。然而，其实际应用受到锌沉积过程中不均匀的界面电场和不可控的枝晶生长的限制。本文报道了一种分级亲锌复合电极，它将传统碳毡与经ZnO和SiO2修饰的静电纺丝碳纳米纤维骨架相结合。这种多尺度多孔结构同时改善了电解液输运和电荷分布。具体而言，大孔碳毡促进电解液流动，而纳米纤维网络增大电化学活性表面积以均匀化局部电场。此外，双氧化物作为调控的锌成核位点和力学增塑组分，降低了成核过电位，并缓解了反复沉积/剥离过程中的局部应力。因此，该电极在高面载量下促进了均匀且高度可逆的锌沉积。所得ZBFBs在60 mA cm–2下循环超过50,000次仍保持高度稳定的性能，展示了在实际高电流密度运行下卓越的耐久性。

title: Nanodiamonds in Filtration and Adsorption Systems: Structure-Property Relationships, Immobilization Strategies, and Emerging Applications
abstract: Abstract Nanodiamonds (NDs) combine the exceptional hardness, chemical durability, and thermal stability of bulk diamond with a high surface-to-volume ratio and widely tunable surface chemistry. These properties enable broad control over surface charge, polarity, hydration, and interfacial interactions, making NDs attractive for adsorption and water-treatment applications. Nevertheless, their practical potential in these fields remains substantially underdeveloped relative to the depth of accumulated physicochemical knowledge. This review critically examines known and filtration-relevant interactions between ND surfaces and dissolved species, and evaluates how these interactions could be exploited in adsorption and filtration technologies. We compare the two technologically relevant ND classes—detonation nanodiamonds (DNDs) and high-pressure high-temperature (HPHT) NDs—and analyze the consequences of surface termination, defect structure, nitrogen content, and colloidal state for zeta potential, hydration, and interfacial reactivity in aqueous environments. A particular focus is placed on hydrogenated NDs, which exhibit an unusual combination of strongly positive electrokinetic response, pronounced interfacial water structuring, and surface electronic effects associated with charge transfer and particle structure that distinguish them from oxidized NDs and other carbon nanomaterials. We systematically review documented interactions between ND surfaces and relevant pollutant classes: multivalent metal ions, charged organic molecules, PFAS, and biomolecules, drawing on literature from water treatment, biomedicine, and chromatography to establish the breadth of ND interfacial chemistry. A central argument of this review is that the functional unit in ND-based filtration is the accessible ND surface: immobilization strategies that preserve surface exposure-electrostatic deposition, covalent grafting, and thermally assisted stabilization on inorganic supports-are critically distinguished from embedded composite approaches where ND surfaces are mostly buried and rendered passive. We identify the translation of these immobilization strategies to polymer membrane supports as the principal unresolved engineering challenge, and outline the role of ND structural heterogeneity, long-term surface stability, and scalable deaggregation as key scientific priorities for realizing the full potential of NDs in next-generation filtration systems.
title_zh: 纳米金刚石在过滤与吸附体系中的应用于：结构-性能关系、固定化策略及新兴应用
abstract_zh: 摘要 纳米金刚石（NDs）兼具块体金刚石卓越的硬度、化学耐久性和热稳定性，以及高比表面积和广泛可调的表面化学。这些性质使其能够对表面电荷、极性、水合及界面相互作用实现广泛调控，使NDs在吸附和水处理应用中颇具吸引力。尽管如此，相对于已积累的物理化学知识的深度，其在这些领域的实际潜力仍未得到充分开发。本综述批判性地考察了ND表面与溶解物种之间已知的、与过滤相关的相互作用，并评估了如何在吸附和过滤技术中利用这些相互作用。我们比较了两类具有技术相关性的ND——爆轰纳米金刚石（DNDs）和高温高压（HPHT）NDs——并分析了表面终端、缺陷结构、氮含量和胶体状态对水相环境中Zeta电位、水合及界面反应性的影响。特别关注了氢化NDs，它们表现出强正电动力学响应、显著界面水结构化以及与电荷转移和颗粒结构相关的表面电子效应的独特组合，这使其区别于氧化NDs和其他碳纳米材料。我们系统综述了ND表面与相关污染物类别（多价金属离子、带电有机分子、PFAS和生物分子）之间已记录的相互作用，并借鉴文

title: Guiding Orthorhombic Phase Evolution in Ultrathin (<4 nm) Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 on Germanium
abstract: Abstract The integration of scalable, high-performance Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 (HZO) ferroelectric materials with high-mobility channels such as germanium is critical for next-generation logic and memory devices. However, maintaining robust ferroelectricity in films thinner than 5 nm remains a major challenge. In this study, we systematically investigate 3.7-nm HZO films incorporated into a titanium nitride/HZO/Ge capacitor structure. We demonstrate that a conventional single-step post-metallization annealing (PMA) process is insufficient for inducing strong ferroelectricity in ultrathin HZO films. To address this limitation, we formulate a synergistic strategy combining interface engineering with ZrO2-termination and a two-step annealing sequence comprising post-deposition annealing (PDA) followed by PMA. This approach stabilizes the ferroelectric orthorhombic o(020)/o(002) phase and produces robust remanent polarization and improved polarization–voltage loop (P–V loop) squareness, as reflected by an enhanced polarization ratio and (dP/dV)max. Consequently, polarization switching becomes more complete and the P–V loop becomes more rectangular. Comprehensive structural, spectroscopic, theoretical, and electrical analyses further confirm the effectiveness of this strategy. This study provides mechanistic insights into the integration of ultrathin ferroelectric HZO with Ge-based electronic platforms.
title_zh: 引导超薄（<4 nm）Hf0.5Zr0.5O2在锗上的正交相演变
abstract_zh: 摘要 将可规模化、高性能的Hf0.5Zr0.5O2（HZO）铁电材料与锗等高迁移率沟道集成，对下一代逻辑和存储器件至关重要。然而，在厚度小于5 nm的薄膜中保持稳健的铁电性仍是一项重大挑战。在本研究中，我们系统研究了集成于氮化钛/HZO/Ge电容器结构中的3.7 nm HZO薄膜。我们证明，常规的单步金属化后退火（PMA）工艺不足以在超薄HZO薄膜中诱导强铁电性。为解决这一局限，我们制定了一种协同策略，将ZrO2终端的界面工程与先沉积后退火（PDA）再PMA的两步退火序列相结合。该方法稳定了铁电正交o(020)/o(002)相，产生了稳健的剩余极化和改善的极化—电压回线（P–V回线）方形度，体现在增强的极化比和(dP/dV)max上。因此，极化翻转更加完全，P–V回线更加矩形。全面的结构、光谱、理论和电学分析进一步证实了该策略的有效性。本研究为超薄铁电HZO与锗基电子平台的集成提供了机理认识。

title: Structurally Engineered Polyimide Microsphere/Nanofibrous Gradient Aerogels with Enhanced Dust-Holding Capacity for High-Temperature Air Filtration
abstract: Abstract With the increasing emission of particulate matter (PM) from industrial and transportation activities, the demand for filtration materials exhibiting high thermal and chemical stability is growing. Nanofiber materials have attracted significant attention owing to their small fiber diameter, high porosity, and large specific surface area, which enhance their initial filtration efficiency. However, their densely packed architectures and uniform pore distributions lead to rapid surface cake formation, increasing airflow resistance and limiting dust-holding capacity. In contrast, three-dimensional gradient aerogel structures incorporate multiscale pore channels that facilitate depth filtration. Such architectures provide greater dust storage capacity and delay pore blockage, thereby significantly improving overall filtration performance. Here, gradient nanofiber aerogels (MGPAs) with a microsphere structure were successfully fabricated based on a single-component polyimide system. Utilizing single-component materials enhances recyclability and ensures uniform thermal expansion under temperature fluctuations, which is crucial for high-temperature filtration applications. The prepared material exhibits a dual-layer gradient nanofiber aerogel structure, comprising coarse fibers (≈730 nm) and medium fibers (≈300 nm). Furthermore, a composite functional layer composed of microspheres (≈3.34 μm) and ultrafine fibers (≈60 nm) was deposited onto the medium-fiber layer surface. Benefiting from this hierarchical structure, the MGPAs exhibit a PM0.3 filtration efficiency of 99.996%, with an initial pressure drop as low as 45.08 Pa, and a dust-holding capacity of 127 g/m2. Even at 300 °C, it maintains a filtration efficiency of 99.91%. This demonstrates their excellent thermal stability. The developed MGPAs offer significant potential for high-temperature exhaust gas filtration applications.
title_zh: 结构工程化聚酰亚胺微球/纳米纤维梯度气凝胶增强容尘量用于高温空气过滤
abstract_zh: 摘要 随着工业和交通运输活动中颗粒物（PM）排放的日益增加，对具有高热稳定性和化学稳定性的过滤材料的需求不断增长。纳米纤维材料因其纤维直径小、孔隙率高和比表面积大而备受关注，这些特性提高了其初始过滤效率。然而，其密实堆积的结构和均匀的孔径分布导致表面快速形成滤饼，增大了气流阻力并限制了容尘量。相比之下，三维梯度气凝胶结构包含多尺度孔道，有利于深层过滤。此类结构提供了更大的粉尘储存容量并延缓孔隙堵塞，从而显著提升整体过滤性能。本文基于单组分聚酰亚胺体系成功制备了具有微球结构的梯度纳米纤维气凝胶（MGPAs）。采用单组分材料增强了可回收性，并确保在温度波动下热膨胀均匀，这对高温过滤应用至关重要。所制备的材料呈现双层梯度纳米纤维气凝胶结构，由粗纤维（≈730 nm）和中纤维（≈300 nm）组成。此外，由微球（≈3.34 μm）和超细纤维（≈60 nm）组成的复合功能层沉积于中纤维层表面。得益于这种分级结构，MGPAs对PM0.3的过滤效率达到99.99

title: Dual-State Emissive Imidazole-Based Photoswitches by Design and Their Use for Data Encryption
abstract: Abstract Herein, we report the rational design, synthesis, and photophysical characterization of a new family of N-substituted 2,4,5-arylimidazole derivatives that integrate excited-state intramolecular proton transfer (ESIPT) and intramolecular charge transfer (ICT) to achieve reversible photochromism. Solvatochromic studies revealed pronounced shifts in emission (392–457 nm) and large Stokes shifts (4252–7776 cm–1), indicating significant excited-state charge separation driven by the N,N-diethylamino donor group. Lippert–Mataga and time-resolved photoluminescence (TRPL) analysis confirmed the dominant ICT character, particularly for N-aryl derivatives (Δμ = 9.26–9.73 D), which exhibited larger dipole moment changes than N-alkyl derivatives (Δμ = 8.17–8.34 D). Upon UV irradiation (395 nm), reversible E/Z keto photoisomerization was observed both in solution and in the solid state, confirmed by UV-vis, photoluminescence, and infrared spectroscopy. Single crystal X-ray diffraction showed that N-alkyl chain length enhances torsional angles, directly influencing the photoswitching behavior and dual-state emissive properties with quantum yields of Φ = 25% in toluene and Φ = 77% in the solid state for IM-N-Bu. Thermal treatment (80 °C) enabled full reversibility in toluene and poly(methyl methacrylate) (PMMA) films over multiple cycles, which were applied to data encryption, demonstrating their potential in photonic and information security technologies.
title_zh: 双态发射的咪唑类光开关的设计及其在数据加密中的应用
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文报道了一系列新型N-取代2,4,5-芳基咪唑衍生物的合理设计、合成及光物理表征，该系列衍生物整合了激发态分子内质子转移（ESIPT）与分子内电荷转移（ICT），以实现可逆光致变色。溶剂化变色研究表明，其发射峰发生显著红移（392–457 nm），并具有大的Stokes位移（4252–7776 cm–1），表明N,N-二乙氨基供体基团驱动的显著激发态电荷分离。Lippert–Mataga分析和时间分辨光致发光（TRPL）分析证实了其以ICT特性为主导，尤其是N-芳基衍生物（Δμ = 9.26–9.73 D），其偶极矩变化大于N-烷基衍生物（Δμ = 8.17–8.34 D）。在紫外光照射（395 nm）下，无论在溶液中还是固态中均观察到可逆的E/Z酮式光异构化，并通过紫外-可见、光致发光和红外光谱予以证实。单晶X射线衍射表明，N-烷基链长度增大了扭转角，直接影响了光开关行为和双态发射性能，其中IM-N-Bu在甲苯中的量子产率为Φ = 25%，在固态中为Φ = 77%。热处理（80 °C）使其在甲苯和聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯（PMMA）薄膜中经多个循环后仍能完全可逆，该材料被应用于数据加密，展示了其在光子学与信息安全技术中的潜力。

title: Tuning Interparticle Interactions in Graphene Oxide Dispersions for Enhanced Shear-Induced Alignment
abstract: Abstract The macroscopic behavior of colloidal materials is governed by interactions between their microscopic building blocks. In anisotropic colloidal systems, subtle variations in interparticle forces can lead to dramatic changes in phase behavior, flow response, and alignment under shear. Here, we systematically investigate how ionic strength controls the structural state, rheology, and alignment dynamics of aqueous graphene oxide (GO) dispersions, and how these effects translate into the performance of wet-spun fibers. By varying the NaCl concentration, we tune the GO system across three regimes: a jammed repulsive glass state at low salt, an aggregation-dominated state at high salt, and a relaxed soft glassy state that allows for structural rearrangement. In this intermediate regime (∼1–5 mM NaCl), the dispersions exhibit the lowest yield stress and the fastest domain reorientation under shear, as observed via shear polarized optical microscopy (shear-POM) and rheo-small-angle X-ray scattering (rheo-SAXS). When processed into fibers via wet spinning, dispersions from this regime yield markedly higher alignment, tensile strength, and electrical conductivity than those from either the jammed or the aggregated state. These findings establish a multiscale structure−rheology−alignment−property relationship in GO dispersions, in which shear-induced alignment is determined by the balance of interparticle interactions and the resulting structural state.
title_zh: 调控氧化石墨烯分散体中的颗粒间相互作用以增强剪切诱导取向
abstract_zh: 摘要 胶体材料的宏观行为由其微观结构单元之间的相互作用所支配。在各向异性胶体体系中，颗粒间作用力的微小变化可导致相行为、流动响应以及剪切下取向的剧烈改变。本文系统研究了离子强度如何控制水性氧化石墨烯（GO）分散液的结构状态、流变学和取向动力学，以及这些效应如何转化为湿法纺丝纤维的性能。通过改变NaCl浓度，我们将GO体系调节至三种状态：低盐下的阻塞排斥玻璃态、高盐下的聚集主导状态，以及允许结构重排的松弛软玻璃态。在这一中间状态（约1–5 mM NaCl）下，分散液表现出最低的屈服应力和最快的剪切下畴重新取向，这通过剪切偏光显微镜（shear-POM）和流变-小角X射线散射（rheo-SAXS）观察到。当通过湿法纺丝加工成纤维时，来自该状态的分散液相比阻塞态或聚集态均获得了显著更高的取向度、拉伸强度和电导率。这些发现建立了GO分散液中跨尺度的结构−流变−取向−性能关系，其中剪切诱导取向由颗粒间相互作用的平衡及由此产生的结构状态所决定。

title: Biomimetic Diatom Surface-Enhanced Raman Scattering Microcavity Array with Multiscale Structure Synergy Enhancement
abstract: Abstract Diatoms are a type of organism with a natural three-dimensional porous sieve chamber structure. Their sieve plates exhibit multi-level porous features and can control the distribution of light fields through micronano structures, generating resonance coupling and local field enhancement effects. Although surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) substrates have achieved ultra-high sensitivity detection, they often encounter problems such as poor signal uniformity and uncontrollable molecular distribution. Inspired by the above-mentioned structural characteristics of diatoms, this paper mimics their three-dimensional porous sieve chamber structure to construct a biomimetic three-dimensional microcavity array SERS substrate. By combining the vertical microcavity structure and array design at the micronano scale, multi-scale collaborative enhancement is achieved. This substrate features a large-area high-order array structure, regular three-dimensional microcavities, and the scalability of functional modification. Through systematic regulation of the microcavity height, both experimental and simulation results reveal a significant cavity height-controlled SERS enhancement behavior, which is attributed to the effective coupling between the microcavity optical resonance and local surface plasmon hotspots. Additionally, the designed microcavity structure induces active enrichment of molecules during the drying of droplets, effectively suppressing the coffee ring effect. The minimum detectable concentration of rhodamine can reach 10–12 M, with good uniformity and repeatability. This biomimetic three-dimensional SERS substrate achieves a unified high sensitivity and uniformity through the collaborative effects at the nano, micro, and macro scales, providing a universal strategy for the structural design of high-performance SERS substrates.
title_zh: 具有多尺度结构协同增强的仿生硅藻表面增强拉曼散射微腔阵列
abstract_zh: 摘要 硅藻是一类具有天然三维多孔筛室结构的生物体。其筛板展现出多级多孔特征，可通过微纳结构控制光场分布，产生共振耦合和局域场增强效应。尽管表面增强拉曼散射（SERS）基底已实现超高灵敏度检测，但常面临信号均匀性差和分子分布不可控等问题。受上述硅藻结构特征的启发，本文模仿其三维多孔筛室结构，构建了仿生三维微腔阵列SERS基底。通过在微纳尺度上结合垂直微腔结构与阵列设计，实现了多尺度协同增强。该基底具有大面积高阶阵列结构、规则的三维微腔以及功能化修饰的可扩展性。通过对微腔高度的系统性调控，实验与模拟结果均揭示了显著的腔高控制的SERS增强行为，这归因于微腔光学共振与局域表面等离激元热点之间的有效耦合。此外，所设计的微腔结构在液滴干燥过程中诱导分子的主动富集，有效抑制了咖啡环效应。罗丹明的最低可检测浓度可达10–12 M，且具有良好的均匀性和重复

title: Novel Multi-Pyridyl-Functionalized Spirobifluorenes as Precursor Additives for Improving Efficient and Stable Perovskite Solar Cells
abstract: Abstract Significant advancement of additive engineering has primarily focused on the improved perovskite film quality by the regulation of crystallization rates or defect passivation, thereby enabling highly efficient and stable solar cells; however, current research on the incorporation of functional additives into perovskite precursor solutions to simultaneously gain crystallization improvement and reduced defects in the perovskite film remains a significant challenge. Herein, two novel multi-pyridyl-functionalized spirobifluorene additives (designated as SBF-3-py and SBF-4-py) achieved by a facile Suzuki cross-coupling reaction are first incorporated into the perovskite precursor for producing high-quality perovskite films. SBF-3-py or SBF-4-py with spirobifluorene and multiple pyridyl groups can form multi-site interactions with perovskite components, thereby improving the perovskite film crystallization, simultaneously passivating VI and PbI defects, modulating energy level alignment, and promoting carrier mobility. Consequently, the inverted perovskite solar cells (PSCs) with SBF-3-py or SBF-4-py treatment acquire a remarkably high power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 20.65 or 20.98% with low hysteresis, distinctly surpassing the control PSC (PCE = 18.67%), along with markedly improved stability. This work pioneers a new class of small organic additives for the simultaneous realization of crystallization improvement and defect reduction of the perovskite film in highly efficient and stable devices.
title_zh: 新型多吡啶基功能化螺芴作为提升钙钛矿太阳能电池效率与稳定性的前驱体添加剂
abstract_zh: 摘要 添加剂工程的重大进展主要集中于通过调控结晶速率或缺陷钝化来改善钙钛矿薄膜质量，从而实现高效稳定的太阳能电池；然而，目前关于在钙钛矿前驱体溶液中引入功能添加剂以同时实现结晶改善和钙钛矿薄膜缺陷减少的研究仍面临重大挑战。本文通过简便的Suzuki交叉偶联反应获得了两种新型多吡啶基功能化螺二芴添加剂（分别命名为SBF-3-py和SBF-4-py），并首次将其引入钙钛矿前驱体中以制备高质量钙钛矿薄膜。具有螺二芴结构和多个吡啶基团的SBF-3-py或SBF-4-py可与钙钛矿组分形成多位点相互作用，从而改善钙钛矿薄膜结晶，同时钝化VI和PbI缺陷，调节能级排列并促进载流子迁移。因此，经SBF-3-py或SBF-4-py处理的倒置钙钛矿太阳能电池（PSC）获得了20.65%或20.98%的显著高功率转换效率（PCE），且滞后低，明显优于对照PSC（PCE = 18.67%），同时稳定性显著提高。本工作开创了一类新型小分子有机添加剂，可在高效稳定器件中同时实现钙钛矿薄膜的结晶改善和缺陷减少。

title: Photo-Programmable Synergistic Responses of Phenothiazine-Diarylethene Hybrids: From Molecular Engineering to Electrochromism and Information Encryption
abstract: Abstract A series of phenothiazine-modified diarylethene derivatives (1z–6z) were designed via molecular engineering to achieve multi-stimuli responsive photochromic materials. By precisely modulating donor linkage and conjugated bridge length, the absorption wavelengths of closed-ring isomers were effectively tuned, enabling broad color variation from yellow to deep purple. Notably, 3z and 4z, featuring a single benzene bridge, exhibit superior multi-stimuli responsive performance. Beyond retaining intrinsic reversible photochromism and fluorescence switching, they display a distinctive “photo−oxidation” synergistic mechanism. UV-induced closed-ring isomers reconstruct the electron delocalization pathway of oxidized products through a strong D−π−A architecture, inducing a precise red shift to the mid-visible region and enabling high-contrast color transitions (red/purple to blue) independent of stimulus sequence. Electrochemical investigations further reveal that modulation of the oxidation potential via a photoinduced conformational gating effect serves as the fundamental basis for this synergistic behavior. Leveraging their solid-state responsiveness, gel-based electrochromic devices were fabricated, and a multi-component dynamic information encryption system was constructed, demonstrating multilevel anti-counterfeiting and information concealment. This work presents tunable, multi-responsive photochromic materials and a referable molecular engineering strategy for designing photo−electro−chemical synergistic triad systems.
title_zh: 吩噻嗪-二芳基乙烯杂化物的光可编程协同响应：从分子工程到电致变色与信息加密
abstract_zh: 摘要 通过分子工程设计了一系列吩噻嗪修饰的二芳基乙烯衍生物（1z–6z），以实现多刺激响应光致变色材料。通过精确调控供体连接方式和共轭桥长度，有效调节了闭环异构体的吸收波长，实现了从黄色到深紫色的宽泛颜色变化。值得注意的是，具有单苯桥结构的3z和4z表现出优异的多刺激响应性能。除了保留固有的可逆光致变色和荧光开关特性外，它们还展现出独特的“光−氧化”协同机制。紫外光诱导的闭环异构体通过强D−π−A结构重构氧化产物的电子离域路径，诱导精确红移至中可见光区域，并实现不依赖于刺激顺序的高对比度颜色转变（红/紫色变为蓝色）。电化学研究进一步揭示，通过光致构象门控效应调控氧化电位是这种协同行为的基本基础。利用其固态响应特性，制备了凝胶基电致变色器件，并构建了多组分动态信息加密系统，展示了多级防伪和信息隐藏功能。本工作提出了可调谐的多响应光致变色材料，并为设计光−电−化学协同三元体系提供了可借鉴的分子工程策略。

title: Sodium-Ion Storage of Antimony Sulfide Enabled by Dual-Carbon Confinement
abstract: Abstract Antimony trisulfide (Sb2S3) as an anode material for sodium-ion batteries shows a theoretical specific capacity of 954 mAh g−1, but its poor intrinsic electrical conductivity, severe volume expansion, formation/shuttling of polysulfide during sodiation/desodiation processes, and low initial Coulombic efficiency severely hinder its practical application. In this work, reduced graphene oxide (rGO) sheets are coated first on antimony trisulfide nanorods that are further embedded in a pitch pyrolytic carbon matrix to yield ternary composites (Sb2S3@rGO@C). The rGO sheets can increase ion transport pathways and ameliorate the reaction kinetics of Sb2S3. The pitch-derived pyrolytic carbon matrix not only reduces the specific surface area of the composite and enhances the initial Coulombic efficiency, but also suppresses the volume variation of Sb2S3. The C−S chemical bonds formed within the composites can inhibit polysulfide shuttling and further improve the sodiation/desodiation cycling stability. The as-prepared Sb2S3@rGO@C anode exhibits a high initial Coulombic efficiency of 82.2%, excellent cycling stability (delivering a specific capacity of 375.1 mAh g−1 even after 800 cycles at 1.0 C), and outstanding rate capability (maintaining a specific capacity of 495.5 mAh g−1 at a high current density of 2.0 C).
title_zh: 双碳限域实现硫化锑的钠离子存储
abstract_zh: 摘要 三硫化二锑（Sb2S3）作为钠离子电池负极材料具有954 mAh g−1的理论比容量，但其本征电导率差、体积膨胀严重、钠化/脱钠过程中多硫化物的形成与穿梭以及较低的初始库仑效率严重阻碍了其实际应用。本工作中，首先在三硫化二锑纳米棒上包覆还原氧化石墨烯（rGO）片，再将其嵌入沥青热解碳基质中，得到三元复合材料（Sb2S3@rGO@C）。rGO片可增加离子传输路径并改善Sb2S3的反应动力学。沥青衍生热解碳基质不仅降低了复合材料的比表面积并提高了初始库仑效率，还抑制了Sb2S3的体积变化。复合材料内部形成的C−S化学键可抑制多硫化物穿梭，进一步提高钠化/脱钠循环稳定性。所制备的Sb2S3@rGO@C负极表现出82.2%的高初始库仑效率、优异的循环稳定性（在1.0 C下循环800次后仍可提供375.1 mAh g−1的比容量）以及出色的倍率性能（在2.0 C的高电流密度下保持495.5 mAh g−1的比容量）。

title: Ester Bond-Anchored TMP Moieties for Durable and Rechargeable Anti-biofouling PVDF Membranes
abstract: Abstract Global water scarcity and pollution have elevated membrane separation to an indispensable technology for sustainable water purification. Poly(vinylidene fluoride) (PVDF), prized for its exceptional chemical and mechanical stability, faces a long-standing performance trade-off, as its inherent hydrophobicity causes severe biofouling, while chlorine regeneration for biofilm removal degrades surface-grafted antibacterial functional layers. Herein, we report a high-performance chlorine-rechargeable N-halamine antibacterial membrane (denoted as PPVDF-O-TP-Cl, a PEG-blended PVDF grafted with chlorinated TMP moieties) fabricated via an integrated “passive defense-active attack” strategy, featuring covalent surface anchoring of sterically hindered 2,2,6,6-tetramethylpiperidine (TMP-OH) onto PVDF backbones through ester linkages. The membrane achieved robust broad-spectrum antibacterial efficacy, delivering a 6.1-log reduction against Gram-negative E. coli and a 5.5-log reduction against Gram-positive S. aureus within 30 min, a flux recovery ratio exceeding 90.0%, and retained over 99% antibacterial activity after 10 chlorination-regeneration cycles. Notably, TMP’s bulky methyl groups sterically shield vulnerable ester bonds from hydrolytic and oxidative degradation, while PEG hydration layers and N-halamine moieties synergistically mitigate the interfacial kinetic imbalance plaguing traditional membranes. This work provides a versatile strategy for designing durable rechargeable anti-biofouling membranes, with future investigations warranted into their long-term performance in complex real wastewater matrices and scalable fabrication.
title_zh: 酯键锚定TMP基元实现耐用可充电抗生物污染PVDF膜
abstract_zh: 摘要 全球水资源短缺与污染问题已使膜分离技术成为可持续水净化不可或缺的技术。聚偏氟乙烯（PVDF）因其卓越的化学与机械稳定性而备受推崇，但长期面临性能上的权衡困境：其固有的疏水性导致严重的生物污损，而用于清除生物膜的氯再生处理又会降解表面接枝的抗菌功能层。本文报道了一种高性能可充氯型N-卤胺抗菌膜（记为PPVDF-O-TP-Cl，即接枝了氯化TMP结构单元的PEG共混PVDF），采用“被动防御—主动攻击”一体化策略制备，通过酯键将空间位阻型2,2,6,6-四甲基哌啶（TMP-OH）共价锚定在PVDF主链上。该膜展现出强效的广谱抗菌性能，在30分钟内对革兰氏阴性大肠杆菌实现6.1个对数级的杀灭、对革兰氏阳性金黄色葡萄球菌实现5.5个对数级的杀灭，通量恢复率超过90.0%，且经过10次氯化-再生循环后仍保持99%以上的抗菌活性。值得注意的是，TMP的庞大甲基基团通过空间位阻保护易受水解和氧化降解的酯键，而PEG水化层与N-卤胺结构单元协同缓解了困扰传统膜材料的界面动力学失衡问题。本工作为设计耐久型可再充电抗生物污损膜提供了一种通用策略，其长期性能有待进一步研究。

title: Zwitterionic PEGylation of Nanodrugs for Reduced Immunogenicity and Improved Drug Delivery Efficacy
abstract: Abstract PEGylated liposomes are widely used as drug delivery carriers due to their prolonged circulation and enhanced accumulation at pathological sites. However, repeated administration can trigger the accelerated blood clearance (ABC) phenomenon, reducing delivery efficacy. Herein, we report a zwitterionic PEGylation strategy by grafting glutamic acid-lysine (EK) peptides onto PEGylated phospholipid derivatives to assemble liposome (Lip)-based drug delivery systems. Small-angle neutron scattering analysis confirmed that EK modification significantly enhanced Lip hydration, leading to a 40-fold reduction in protein adsorption compared to conventional PEGylation, which therefore reduced immune cell uptake, anti-PEG antibody production, and nonspecific hepatic accumulation of EK-Lip. Furthermore, even in the presence of preexisting APAs, EK-Lip could mitigate the ABC effect and exhibit a twofold increase in the area under the curve of the pharmacokinetic profile after multiple injections compared to Lip. When loaded with doxorubicin, the zwitterionic EK-Lip demonstrated lower immunogenicity and superior antitumor efficacy compared to conventional formulations. This work provides a facile strategy to assemble zwitterionic liposomes with modified surface chemistry, offering a promising solution to the ABC effect in PEGylated liposomes.
title_zh: 纳米药物的两性离子PEG化以降低免疫原性并提高药物递送效率
abstract_zh: 摘要 PEG化脂质体因其长循环时间和在病理部位的增强蓄积而被广泛用作药物递送载体。然而，反复给药可能引发加速血液清除（ABC）现象，降低递送效率。本文报道了一种两性离子PEG化策略，通过将谷氨酸-赖氨酸（EK）肽接枝到PEG化磷脂衍生物上，构建基于脂质体（Lip）的药物递送系统。小角中子散射分析证实，EK修饰显著增强了脂质体的水合作用，与常规PEG化相比蛋白质吸附减少了40倍，从而降低了免疫细胞摄取、抗PEG抗体产生以及EK-Lip的非特异性肝脏蓄积。此外，即使存在预先形成的APA，EK-Lip也能缓解ABC效应，多次注射后其药代动力学曲线下面积较Lip提高两倍。负载阿霉素后，两性离子型EK-Lip表现出比常规制剂更低的免疫原性和更优的抗肿瘤疗效。本工作提供了一种简便的两性离子脂质体组装策略，通过修饰表面化学性质，为解决PEG化脂质体的ABC效应提供了有前景的方案。

title: Autonomous Self-Turning and Obstacle-Surmounting Soft Robots Enabled by Liquid Crystal Elastomer Material Intelligence
abstract: Abstract This study reports the development of a chiral helical soft robot inspired by natural climbing tendrils, fabricated through a low-cost and parameter-tunable approach. Owing to the deep coupling between the intrinsic structure of the material and the thermal field, the system converts ambient thermal energy into kinetic energy without the need for external power sources, thereby exhibiting a unique thermally induced untwisting behavior that generates pronounced initial kinetic energy resulting in a maximum rolling velocity within the upper range of those reported for autonomous robots. The helical LCE strip demonstrates path selection behaviors governed by deformation and energy feedback, enabling remarkable adaptability, self-turning, obstacle avoidance, and obstacle-crossing capabilities in complex environments. Owing to the specific design, an asymmetrical shape can be induced post-fabrication, enabling adaptive control of the self-motion trajectory. The underlying mechanism arises from thermally driven untwisting and energy redistribution; whereby elastic potential energy is stored within the helical architecture during rolling or upon obstacle contact and subsequently released under specific conditions. This work highlights the potential of soft robots for autonomous locomotion, environmental interaction, and the realization of physical intelligence, while offering new strategies for the design of low-power and multifunctional soft robotic systems.
title_zh: 液晶弹性体材料智能驱动的自主转向越障软体机器人
abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究报道了一种受天然攀援卷须启发、通过低成本且参数可调的方法制备的手性螺旋软体机器人。由于材料内在结构与热场之间的深度耦合，该系统无需外部电源即可将环境热能转化为动能，从而表现出独特的热致解旋行为，产生显著的初始动能，使其最大滚动速度位于已报道的自主机器人速度范围的上段。螺旋LCE条带展现出由形变与能量反馈支配的路径选择行为，使其在复杂环境中具备卓越的适应性、自主转向、避障和越障能力。得益于特定设计，可在制备后诱导非对称形状，实现自运动轨迹的自适应控制。其潜在机制源于热驱动解旋与能量再分布：弹性势能在滚动过程中或接触障碍物时储存于螺旋结构中，并在特定条件下释放。本工作凸显了软体机器人在自主运动、环境交互以及实现物理智能方面的潜力，同时为低功耗、多功能软体机器人系统的设计提供了新策略。

title: Highly ordered, ultra-dense intermetallic nanocrystals extend heavy-duty fuel cell projected lifetime beyond 240,000 h
abstract: Oxygen reduction catalysts are critical for advancing the durability and efficiency of proton-exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFCs). Now a block-copolymer micelle confinement strategy is shown to enable the decoupled synthesis of highly ordered, ultra-dense Pt-based intermetallic nanocrystals, yielding PEMFC catalysts with high activity and long projected lifetimes.
title_zh: 高度有序、超密度金属间化合物纳米晶体将重型燃料电池预计寿命延长至24万小时以上
abstract_zh: 氧还原催化剂对于提升质子交换膜燃料电池（PEMFC）的耐久性和效率至关重要。如今，嵌段共聚物胶束限域策略被证明能够实现高有序、超致密Pt基金属间化合物纳米晶体的解耦合成，从而获得具有高活性和长预期寿命的PEMFC催化剂。

title: Ketene-driven Mizoroki–Heck cross-coupling
abstract: Mizoroki–Heck reactivity has mostly been confined to the coupling of aryl (pseudo)halides with olefins. Now, the exploitation of ketenes generated in situ has unlocked direct access to α,β-unsaturated carbonyl compounds and divinyl ketones via a Heck-type pathway.
title_zh: 烯酮驱动的Mizoroki–Heck交叉偶联
abstract_zh: Mizoroki–Heck反应活性长期以来主要局限于芳基（拟）卤化物与烯烃的偶联。如今，对原位生成烯酮的利用开启了通过Heck型路径直接合成α,β-不饱和羰基化合物和二乙烯基酮的大门。

title: From environmental sensing to societal listening
abstract: Environmental sensing now captures environmental change with unprecedented precision, yet these signals often fail to enter public awareness or guide collective response. Bridging measurement with cultural meaning, sensory experience and institutional action can transform sensing systems into foundations for societal listening.
title_zh: 从环境感知到社会聆听
abstract_zh: 环境感知如今能以前所未有的精度捕捉环境变化，然而这些信号往往难以进入公众意识或引导集体响应。将测量与文化意义、感官体验和制度行动相结合，可将感知系统转化为社会聆听的基础。

title: Skin-Like Coating Stabilizes the In Situ Forming Lithium Anode for High-Energy-Density Batteries
abstract: Abstract In situ forming lithium metal batteries (IFLMBs) offer higher energy density and improved safety. However, lithiophobic Cu current collectors trigger nonuniform Li nucleation and dendrite growth, causing rapid Li inventory depletion and poor cycling stability. Herein, inspired by the selective transport regulation and barrier protection functions of the skin, a skin-like hydrolyzed collagen (HC) layer derived from biomass is constructed on Cu to stabilize IFLMBs. The ultrathin HC layer tightly covers the Cu surface as a biomolecular “skin”, physically isolating deposited Li from the electrolyte and suppressing parasitic corrosion. Meanwhile, HC also serves as a durable lithiophilic nucleation scaffold. The abundant amide groups can act as lithiophilic active sites, redistributing Li+ flux and guiding uniform lithium nucleation. Accordingly, HC-coated Cu (HCCu) exhibits an increased Li+ transference number (0.71) and a reduced Li nucleation overpotential (13 mV). At a deposition capacity of 3 mAh cm−2, HCCu enables compact Li deposition with a thickness of 16.2 μm, which approaches the theoretical value of 15 μm. Consequently, Li||HCCu cells deliver a high average coulombic efficiency (CE) of 99.2% over 400 cycles. Moreover, a 6.4 Ah HCCu||LRMO pouch cell achieves a high energy density of 578.5 Wh kg−1, providing a viable pathway toward scalable, energy-dense IFLMBs.
title_zh: 类皮肤涂层稳定原位形成的锂负极用于高能量密度电池
abstract_zh: 摘要 原位生成锂金属电池（IFLMBs）具有更高的能量密度和更好的安全性。然而，疏锂的Cu集流体会导致不均匀的Li成核和枝晶生长，造成Li库存快速耗尽和循环稳定性差。本文受皮肤的选择性转运调控和屏障保护功能的启发，在Cu上构建了源自生物质的类皮肤水解胶原蛋白（HC）层以稳定IFLMBs。超薄的HC层作为生物分子“皮肤”紧密覆盖在Cu表面，将沉积的Li与电解质物理隔离，抑制寄生腐蚀。同时，HC还可作为持久的亲锂成核骨架。其丰富的酰胺基团可作为亲锂活性位点，重新分布Li+通量并引导锂均匀成核。因此，HC包覆的Cu（HCCu）表现出更高的Li+迁移数（0.71）和更低的Li成核过电位（13 mV）。在3 mAh cm−2的沉积容量下，HCCu实现了厚度为16.2 μm的致密Li沉积，接近15 μm的理论值。因此，Li||HCCu电池在400次循环中实现了99.2%的高平均库仑效率（CE）。此外，6.4 Ah的HCCu||LRMO软包电池实现了578.5 Wh kg−1的高能量密度，为可规模化、高能量密度的IFLMBs提供了一条可行途径。

title: Enabling Stable Chemical Looping CO2-Splitting with Strontium Ferrate-Spaced Structurally Reversible Strontium-Doped Iron Oxygen Carriers
abstract: Abstract Chemical looping CO2-splitting has emerged as a promising carbon utilization technique for integration with large-scale centralized emission sources. Unlike chemical looping combustion, CO2-splitting is predominantly conducted using iron-based oxygen carriers (OCs) due to thermodynamic constraints. However, the phase transformation of iron/iron oxide often leads to severe sintering within a few cycles. To mitigate this issue, we incorporated alkaline earth metals (magnesium, calcium, and strontium) into iron oxide OCs. Among these, the strontium-incorporated iron oxygen carrier, prepared with molecular-level mixing, demonstrated superior dispersion and anti-sintering properties. It evolved into a mixture of strontium ferrate and strontium-doped iron oxide. The strontium ferrate particles became stable spacers that separated the strontium-doped iron oxide particles from severe sintering, allowing for reversible transitions between wustite (FeO) and magnetite (Fe3O4). Consequently, the Sr-modified OC sustained stable performance over 100 cycles of chemical looping CO2-splitting coupled with ethane cracking at 700 °C. In contrast, magnesium- and calcium-incorporated samples formed large single-phase oxide materials that were either inactive toward CO2-splitting or exhibited slow kinetics due to inhibited ion diffusion through the crystal lattice.
title_zh: 铁酸锶间隔的结构可逆锶掺杂铁基载氧体实现稳定化学链CO2分解
abstract_zh: 摘要 化学链CO2分解作为一种有前景的碳利用技术，可与大规模集中排放源集成。与化学链燃烧不同，由于热力学限制，CO2分解主要采用铁基载氧体（OCs）。然而，铁/铁氧化物的相变往往在几个循环内导致严重烧结。为缓解这一问题，我们将碱土金属（镁、钙和锶）引入铁氧化物载氧体中。其中，通过分子级混合制备的掺锶铁基载氧体表现出优异的分散性和抗烧结性能。它演变为铁酸锶与掺锶铁氧化物的混合物。铁酸锶颗粒成为稳定的间隔体，将掺锶铁氧化物颗粒隔开以避免严重烧结，从而实现方铁矿（FeO）与磁铁矿（Fe3O4）之间的可逆转变。因此，Sr改性载氧体在700 °C下化学链CO2分解与乙烷裂解耦合的100次循环中保持了稳定性能。相比之下，掺镁和掺钙的样品形成了大尺寸单相氧化物材料，或对CO2分解无活性，或因晶格中离子扩散受抑制而表现出缓慢的动力学。

title: Briefing Chat: How Dolly Parton left her mark on science
abstract: Nature reporters discuss the country-music icon's advocacy for vaccines and public health — plus, promising trial results for an mRNA cancer therapy.
title_zh: 简报聊天:Dolly Parton如何在科学界留下印记
abstract_zh: 《自然》记者探讨这位乡村音乐偶像对疫苗和公共卫生的倡导——此外，还有mRNA癌症疗法令人鼓舞的试验结果。

title: Hard-Sphere Mixture Thermodynamics Are Necessary to Capture Mixed Cation Effects in CO2–to–CO Electroreduction
abstract: Abstract The rate of the electrochemical reduction of CO2 (CO2RR) is sensitive to the identity of the alkali metal cation, with many mechanistic studies examining their interfacial effect in single cation electrolytes. However, cation effects in mixed cation electrolytes remain underexplored, despite their relevance in zero-gap, anion exchange membrane electrolyzers or in their deliberate use as bulk electrolytes. We herein explore the impact of size-sensitive, competitive interfacial assembly of cations in mixed cation systems and predict their resultant influence on the rate of CO2RR. The rate of Au-catalyzed CO2RR to CO was examined in Cs:X bicarbonate mixtures, where X is either Li or Na, with Cs mole fractions ranging from 1.0 to 0.0. Electrolysis experiments reveal that CO production rates increase with diminishing returns with increasing Cs mole fraction and applied potential, implying preferential accumulation of Cs cations over the cocation at the interface. Continuum scale modeling with finite-size effects demonstrates that Cs outcompetes Li and Na at the interface under polarization. This effect qualitatively agrees with experiment using the Boublík–Mansoori–Carnahan–Starling–Leland (BMCSL) model, which captures hard-sphere mixture thermodynamics. This work demonstrates the utility of mixed cation electrolytes as a platform to reduce the usage of Cs in CO2RR devices, as well as establishing the necessity of BMCSL to capture CO2RR effects in mixed cationic interfaces.
title_zh: 硬球混合物热力学对于捕捉CO2–to–CO电还原中的混合阳离子效应必不可少
abstract_zh: 摘要 CO2电化学还原（CO2RR）的速率对碱金属阳离子的种类敏感，许多机理研究考察了它们在单一阳离子电解质中的界面效应。然而，混合阳离子电解质中的阳离子效应仍待深入探索，尽管其在零间距阴离子交换膜电解槽中具有相关性，或被有意用作本体电解质。本文探讨了混合阳离子体系中尺寸敏感的竞争性界面阳离子组装的影响，并预测其对CO2RR速率的影响。在Cs:X碳酸氢盐混合体系中考察了Au催化CO2RR生成CO的速率，其中X为Li或Na，Cs摩尔分数范围为1.0至0.0。电解实验表明，CO生成速率随Cs摩尔分数和施加电位的增加而增加但收益递减，暗示Cs阳离子在界面上优先于共阳离子积累。考虑有限尺寸效应的连续尺度模型表明，在极化条件下Cs在界面上胜过Li和Na。该效应与采用Boublík–Mansoori–Carnahan–Starling–Leland（BMCSL）模型的实验定性一致，该模型可刻画硬球混合物热力学。这项工作展示了混合阳离子电解质作为减少CO2RR装置中Cs用量的平台的价值，并确立了采用BMCSL描述混合阳离子界面CO2RR效应的必要性。

title: Ultrafast Proton-Coupled Electron Transfer Reactions at Unit Quantum Yield
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Proton-coupled electron transfer (PCET) reactions mediate essential biological energy-conversion processes, yet dynamical experiments that distinguish concerted electron/proton motion from sequential electron-transfer/proton-transfer pathways are unprecedented on ultrafast time scales. Here we report a tightly coupled donor–spacer–acceptor assembly, NDI-Sp-PhOH/BI, that enables direct interrogation of light-triggered and ultrafast PCET dynamics. Photoexcitation of the naphthalene diimide chromophore drives charge separation forming NDI radical anion and benzimidazolium phenoxy radical (PhO•/BIH+) products with a 440 fs time constant, followed by thermal charge recombination on a 5 ps time scale. Transient visible/near-infrared and mid-infrared spectroscopies independently track electron and proton motion and reveal coincident formation and decay of the charge-separated PCET products, excluding detectable phenol radical cation or phenoxide intermediates expected for sequential electron transfer-proton transfer (ET-PT) pathways. Surface-hopping quasiclassical trajectory simulations demonstrate rapid proton relocation coupled to evolution from locally excited to charge-transfer states, congruent with a concerted mechanism. These combined spectroscopic and computational results establish NDI-Sp-PhOH/BI as an archetype for ultrafast, concerted PCET occurring with unit quantum yield; further, because this platform provides distinct electronic and vibrational spectroscopic handles in its ground, electronically excited, and charge-separated states, it provides new opportunities to characterize mechanistic crossover in biomimetic PCET systems.
title_zh: 单位量子产率下的超快质子耦合电子转移反应
abstract_zh: 摘要 质子耦合电子转移（PCET）反应介导着重要的生物能量转换过程，然而在超快时间尺度上区分协同电子/质子运动与 sequential 电子转移/质子转移路径的动态实验尚无先例。本文报道了一种紧密耦合的给体–间隔–受体组装体NDI-Sp-PhOH/BI，可实现对光触发超快PCET动力学的直接探究。萘二酰亚胺发色团的光激发驱动电荷分离，以440 fs时间常数生成NDI自由基阴离子和苯并咪唑鎓苯氧自由基（PhO•/BIH+）产物，随后在5 ps时间尺度上发生热电荷复合。瞬态可见/近红外和中红外光谱分别追踪电子和质子运动，揭示电荷分离PCET产物的同步生成与衰减，排除了sequential电子转移-质子转移（ET-PT）路径所预期的可检测苯酚自由基阳离子或苯酚盐中间体。表面跳跃准经典轨迹模拟表明质子快速重定位与从局域激发态到电荷转移态的演化相耦合，与协同机理相符。这些光谱与计算相结合的结果确立了NDI-Sp-PhOH/BI作为以单位量子产率发生超快协同PCET的原型；此外，由于该平台在基态、电子激发态和电荷分离态中提供了独特的电子和振动光谱探针，它为

title: Oxygen Vacancy Engineering and Pre-accommodated Distortion Stabilization Enabling Superior Rate and Cycling Performance in P2-Type Mn-Rich Cathodes
abstract: Abstract P2-type layered oxides have been considered as an ideal cathode material for sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) due to their high capacity and facile synthesis, yet their practical application is severely hampered by Jahn–Teller distortion, manganese dissolution, and poor intrinsic ionic conductivity. While conventional cation doping strategies can partially mitigate these issues, the complex mechanisms and multi-component interactions pose challenges for rational material design. Here, we propose an oxygen vacancy engineering strategy, introducing controllable oxygen vacancies into Na0.67Ni0.15Fe0.2Mn0.65O2 (NFM) by regulating the calcination atmosphere. The introduced oxygen vacancies effectively modulate the local electronic structure of manganese, lower its average valence state, and induce the formation of an orthorhombic P'2 phase. Attributed to the pre-accommodating lattice distortion of the P'2 phase, the structural stability and reversibility of NFM are significantly enhanced. Concurrently, the increased cationic disorder improves both electronic and ionic conductivity. Benefiting from these synergistic effects, the modified NFM cathode delivers outstanding rate and cyclability performance, maintaining a considerable capacity of 127.3 mAh g–1 at 5 C and a high capacity retention of 90.8% even after 500 cycles. This work not only creates an effective vacancy engineering approach to simultaneously enhance the rate capability and cycling stability of Mn-rich cathodes but also provides guidance for designing high-performance electrode materials for SIBs via anion framework regulation.
title_zh: 氧空位工程与预容纳畸变稳定化使P2型富锰正极实现优异倍率与循环性能
abstract_zh: 摘要 P2型层状氧化物因其高容量和易于合成被认为是钠离子电池（SIBs）的理想正极材料，但其实际应用受到Jahn–Teller畸变、锰溶解和本征离子导电性差的严重阻碍。虽然传统的阳离子掺杂策略可以部分缓解这些问题，但其复杂机理和多组分相互作用给材料的合理设计带来挑战。本文提出一种氧空位工程策略，通过调节煅烧气氛在Na0.67Ni0.15Fe0.2Mn0.65O2（NFM）中引入可控氧空位。引入的氧空位有效调控了锰的局域电子结构，降低了其平均价态，并诱导正交P'2相的形成。归因于P'2相的预适应晶格畸变，NFM的结构稳定性和可逆性显著增强。同时，阳离子无序度的提高改善了电子和离子导电性。得益于这些协同效应，改性NFM正极展现出优异的倍率和循环性能，在5 C下保持127.3 mAh g–1的可观容量，即使在500次循环后容量保持率仍高达90.8%。这项工作不仅创造了一种同时提升富锰正极倍率性能和循环稳定性的有效空位工程方法，也为通过阴离

title: Direct Photopatterning on Polysulfide Polymers for Engineered Surfaces and Anti-Counterfeiting Technology
abstract: Abstract Laser modification of polymer surfaces is critical in many contexts, including self-cleaning materials, microelectronics, and biomedical research. Despite their utility, accessing these modified polymers requires expensive or complex materials and multistep fabrication, masking, and washing processes. Here, we present a simple and direct laser writing method for creating diverse, stable, and highly complex patterns on a polysulfide polymer made by inverse vulcanization. The key innovation is the spatial engineering and patterning of the polymer surface by precise control of the laser irradiation time. The polymer’s vitrimer-like S–S bond network preserves complex surface patterns with high fidelity and long-term stability. Motifs such as lines, dots, channels, grids, teardrops, checkerboards, and fish scales were reliably and repeatedly created, highlighting the material’s robust and versatile patterning capabilities. Hierarchical patterns could also be achieved by combining nanoscale hot-press templating with laser modification. This patterning versatility allows modulation of hydrophobicity, templated self-assembly of gold particles, and precise micrometer-scale optical structures, including diffraction elements and dynamic optical barcodes, with potential for anti-counterfeiting applications.
title_zh: 在多硫化物聚合物上进行直接光图案化以构建工程表面与防伪技术
abstract_zh: 摘要 激光改性聚合物表面在许多领域至关重要，包括自清洁材料、微电子学和生物医学研究。尽管这类改性聚合物用途广泛，但要获得它们需要昂贵或复杂的材料以及多步制备、掩膜和清洗过程。在此，我们提出一种简单直接的激光写入方法，可在通过逆向硫化制备的聚硫聚合物表面创建多样化、稳定且高度复杂的图案。关键创新在于通过精确控制激光辐照时间实现聚合物表面的空间工程与图案化。该聚合物类玻璃体（vitrimer）的 S–S 键网络能够以高保真度和长期稳定性保存复杂的表面图案。线条、点阵、沟道、网格、液滴形、棋盘格和鱼鳞形等图案均可可靠且重复地制备，凸显了该材料稳健而多样的图案化能力。通过将纳米级热压模板与激光改性相结合，还可实现分级结构图案。这种图案化多样性可调控疏水性、实现金颗粒的模板化自组装，并构建精确的微米级光学结构，包括衍射元件和动态光学条形码，在防伪领域具有应用潜力。

title: Manganese Single-Atom-Engineered TiO2 Enables High-Performance Pt Catalysts for Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cells
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract The instability of carbon supports in platinum (Pt)-based catalysts under high potentials severely hinders the long-term performance of the corresponding proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFCs). Developing robust oxide supports that can simultaneously stabilize Pt nanoparticles and regulate their intrinsic catalytic properties remains an important challenge. In this work, we report a single-atom engineering strategy to strengthen metal–support interactions and construct a Mn single-atom-modified TiO2-supported Pt catalyst (Pt/Mn1–TiO2) to significantly improve the performance of PEMFCs. The atomically dispersed Mn sites induce pronounced interfacial charge transfer, leading to an optimized electronic structure and a downshifted d-band center of Pt, thereby modulating the adsorption of oxygenated intermediates and enhancing intrinsic oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) activity. Meanwhile, the strengthened interfacial anchoring can effectively suppress Pt oxidation, migration, and agglomeration, resulting in a superior structural stability. As a result, Pt–Mn1/TiO2 exhibits a high half-wave potential of 0.937 V (vs RHE) and significantly enhanced mass/specific activities in acidic media. In a practical H2–O2 fuel cell, it delivers a peak power density of 2.37 W cm–2, outperforming commercial Pt/C, while maintaining minimal performance degradation during long-term operation. This work provides a general strategy for achieving synergistic enhancement of activity and durability in oxide-supported Pt catalysts via single-atom interfacial engineering.
title_zh: 锰单原子工程化TiO2助力高性能质子交换膜燃料电池Pt催化剂
abstract_zh: 摘要 铂（Pt）基催化剂中碳载体在高电位下的不稳定性严重阻碍了相应质子交换膜燃料电池（PEMFC）的长期性能。开发既能稳定 Pt 纳米颗粒又能调控其本征催化性能的稳健氧化物载体仍是一项重要挑战。在本工作中，我们报道了一种单原子工程策略，用以增强金属-载体相互作用，并构建了 Mn 单原子修饰的 TiO2 负载 Pt 催化剂（Pt/Mn1–TiO2），从而显著提升 PEMFC 的性能。原子级分散的 Mn 位点诱导显著的界面电荷转移，优化了 Pt 的电子结构并使其 d 带中心下移，从而调控含氧中间体的吸附并增强本征氧还原反应（ORR）活性。同时，增强的界面锚定作用可有效抑制 Pt 的氧化、迁移和团聚，带来优异的结构稳定性。因此，Pt–Mn1/TiO2 在酸性介质中表现出 0.937 V（vs RHE）的高半波电位以及显著提升的质量/比活性。在实际 H2–O2 燃料电池中，其峰值功率密度达 2.37 W cm–2，优于商用 Pt/C，且长期运行中性能衰减极小。本工作为通过单原子界面工程实现氧化物负载 Pt 催化剂活性与耐久性协同提升提供了一种通用策略。

title: Synthesis of Carborane-Modified Sugars and Nucleosides via Pd(II)-Catalyzed B–H Bond Activation
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Carborane-modified sugars and nucleosides are promising boron-delivery agents for boron neutron capture therapy (BNCT). Accordingly, a series of carborane-based sugars and nucleosides have been successfully prepared. Nevertheless, current research on such compounds is mainly focused on carbon-site modification of carboranes, yet methods for directly forming B-sugars/nucleosides without a protecting group are scarce. Herein, we establish an unprecedented and highly efficient protocol for the stereoselective synthesis of carborane-modified sugars and nucleosides via Pd(II)-catalyzed selective B–H bond activation of carboranes and subsequent addition to unsaturated sugars and nucleosides. The transformation selectively occurs at the C2 site of the sugar ring, exclusively affording products with the carboranyl moiety in an equatorial conformation. Remarkably, this protocol avoids preprotection of hydroxyl groups on glycal and unsaturated nucleoside substrates and exhibits broad substrate compatibility as well as excellent synthetic scalability. Mechanistic control experiments further demonstrate that hydroxyl groups and nitrogenous bases can act as weak coordinating groups to interact with the Pd catalytic center, which are indispensable for facilitating this catalytic transformation.
title_zh: 通过Pd(II)催化的B–H键活化合成碳硼烷修饰的糖类与核苷
abstract_zh: 摘要 碳硼烷修饰的糖和核苷是硼中子俘获治疗（BNCT）中有前景的硼递送剂。为此，一系列基于碳硼烷的糖和核苷已被成功制备。然而，目前对此类化合物的研究主要集中于碳硼烷碳位点的修饰，而无需保护基直接构建 B-糖/核苷的方法十分稀缺。在此，我们建立了一种前所未有的高效方案，通过 Pd(II) 催化的碳硼烷 B–H 键选择性活化及随后对不饱和糖和核苷的加成，实现碳硼烷修饰糖和核苷的立体选择性合成。该转化选择性地发生在糖环的 C2 位点，专一性地生成碳硼烷基处于赤道构象的产物。值得注意的是，该方案避免了糖烯和 不饱和核苷底物上羟基的预保护，具有广泛的底物兼容性和出色的合成可扩展性。机理控制实验进一步表明，羟基和含氮碱基可作为弱配位基团与 Pd 催化中心相互作用，这对促进该催化转化不可或缺。

title: Spontaneously Piezo- and Pyroelectric Polyacrylonitrile Brushes Prepared via Surface-Initiated Polymerization
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Surface-initiated polymerizations generate thin films (“brushes”) consisting of polymer chains that are anchored with one chain end to a solid surface. As they are conducted from initiator-modified solid substrates, these polymerizations allow for unidirectional chain growth and enforce a stretched chain conformation. Using acrylonitrile as an example of a monomer with a dipolar side-chain functional group, this study finds that surface-initiated polymerization not only impacts the alignment and conformation of the polymer main chain but can also influence the orientation of side-chain functional groups. Surface-initiated polymerization of acrylonitrile is found to result in polyacrylonitrile (PAN) brushes that display spontaneous pyro- and piezoelectric behavior. As these properties are not observed in spin-cast PAN films, this indicates that surface-initiated growth of PAN enforces an overall parallel orientation of the dipolar nitrile side-chain functional groups. This is supported by polarized FTIR spectroscopy and NEXAFS experiments, which suggest an overall nonisotropic orientation of nitrile groups in the PAN brush, whereas the nitrile groups in the spin-cast PAN film are more isotropically oriented. Pyro- and piezoelectric polymers are attractive for use in sensors, actuators, and energy-harvesting devices but typically require electrical poling, mechanical stretching, or electrospinning to promote the alignment of molecular dipoles and enhance piezo- and pyroelectric properties. The ability to prepare thin polymer films that display spontaneous pyro- and piezoelectric behavior is significant as it renders these postprocessing steps unnecessary.
title_zh: 通过表面引发聚合制备自发压电与热电聚丙烯腈刷
abstract_zh: 摘要 表面引发聚合可生成由聚合物链构成的薄膜（“刷”），其中聚合物链的一端锚定在固体表面上。由于聚合在引发剂修饰的固体基材上进行，可实现单向链增长并迫使链采取伸展构象。以丙烯腈这一具有偶极侧链官能团的单体为例，本研究发现表面引发聚合不仅影响聚合物主链的取向与构象，还可影响侧链官能团的取向。研究发现，丙烯腈的表面引发聚合可得到表现出自发热电和压电行为的聚丙烯腈（PAN）刷。由于旋涂 PAN 膜中未观察到这些性质，这表明 PAN 的表面引发生长迫使偶极氰基侧链官能团整体呈平行取向。偏振 FTIR 光谱和 NEXAFS 实验证实了这一点，结果显示 PAN 刷中的氰基整体呈各向异性取向，而旋涂 PAN 膜中的氰基取向更为各向同性。热电和压电聚合物在传感器、执行器和能量收集器件中具有吸引力，但通常需要电晕极化、机械拉伸或静电纺丝来促进分子偶极排列并增强压电和热电性能。制备具有自发热电和压

title: Helical Unwinding Governs Divergent Kinetics in the Reductive Defluorination of Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Reductive defluorination offers an important strategy for mitigating the environmental and health risks posed by per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS). However, the degradation rates of PFAS vary widely and cannot be explained by differences in C–F bond strength alone. Here, we use quantum chemical calculations to identify the ability of the perfluorocarbon backbone to unwind from its intrinsic helical conformation as an overlooked source of variation in PFAS reduction kinetics. Using the hydrated electron as the reference reductant, we combine the Marcus and Savéant models to show how helical unwinding shifts the kinetic preference between the stepwise and concerted reductive defluorination pathways, thereby rationalizing the structure-dependent degradation rates reported experimentally. Specifically, longer perfluorocarbon backbones tend to delocalize an excess electron through helical unwinding and form the radical intermediate required for the stepwise pathway. By contrast, the carboxylate headgroup constrains this unwinding, thereby favoring the conventional concerted pathway in which reactivity is governed by C–F bond strength. Nanoscale confinement can provide additional van der Waals stabilization, weakening the conformational constraint imposed by the carboxylate headgroup and lowering the activation free energy for the stepwise pathway. Together, these findings point to molecular conformation as a potential contributor to PFAS reduction kinetics alongside C–F bond strength and raise the prospect of accelerating degradation through microenvironment engineering.
title_zh: 螺旋解旋主导全氟和多氟烷基物质还原脱氟反应的差异化动力学
abstract_zh: 摘要 还原脱氟是降低全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）环境与健康风险的重要策略。然而，PFAS 的降解速率差异很大，仅凭 C–F 键强度的差异无法解释。在此，我们利用量子化学计算发现，全氟碳主链从其固有螺旋构象解旋的能力是 PFAS 还原动力学差异的一个被忽视的来源。以水合电子为参考还原剂，我们结合 Marcus 和 Savéant 模型，展示了解旋如何在分步与协同还原脱氟路径之间改变动力学偏好，从而合理解释了实验报道的依赖于结构的降解速率。具体而言，较长的全氟碳主链倾向于通过解旋离域过剩电子，形成分步路径所需的自由基中间体。相比之下，羧酸根头基限制了解旋，从而有利于由 C–F 键强度主导的传统协同路径。纳米尺度限域可提供额外的范德华稳定作用，削弱羧酸根头基带来的构象限制，降低分步路径的活化自由能。总之，这些发现表明分子构象是除 C–F 键强度外影响 PFAS 还原动力学的潜在因素，并提出了通过微环境工程加速降解的前景

title: Molecular Approaches to the Mechanism of CO2 Reduction to Methanol by Cobalt Phthalocyanine
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract The electrochemical reduction of CO2 has received significant scientific interest over the past two decades as a key step in the synthesis of CO2 into combustible fuels. Cobalt phthalocyanine (CoPc) adsorbed on carbon nanotubes has risen as a rare electrocatalyst that reduces CO2 beyond two electrons, specifically to methanol. Recent efforts have improved the efficiency of this process and established that methanol production proceeds by reduction of a free CO intermediate, however, many aspects of the catalytic pathway remain unclear, which may underpin persistent issues of stability and selectivity. Here we employ electrochemistry, spectroelectrochemistry, X-ray adsorption spectroscopy (XAS), synthesis of catalytic intermediates, and density functional theory (DFT) calculations to understand the catalytic mechanism and identify distinguishing molecular features. We find that CoPc undergoes three sequential reductions between 0 and −2.5 vs NHE; the first reduction occurring at the Co center, and the second two reductions populating the Pc ring. XAS and theory show the Pc ligand to be noninnocent, interacting with the electronic structure of the Co center and causing Co to adopt a Co(II) state as the complex undergoes the second and third reductions. Consistent with previous studies, [CoPc]2– is found to be active for CO2 reduction, however, we find that the catalyst must be reduced further to [CoPc]3– to bind CO at the Co site. Carbonylation of [CoPc]3– under aprotic conditions leads to fast decomposition, forming [Co(CO)4]−. However, we show that [CoPc]3–, if ring protonated by weak acid to form [CoPc-H]2–, reacts with CO to generate a formyl without decomposition, the first step in methanol synthesis. DFT calculations of the mechanism indicate that the reaction of [CoPc-H]2– with CO to generate the formyl in solution proceeds by an intermolecular proton transfer between the Pc ring of [CoPc-H]2– and the Co–CO of [Co-COPc-H]2–. Overall, this study points to the importance of the Pc ligand in determining the catalytic behavior of CoPc and provides the first examples of several isolated reduced CoPc complexes and catalytic intermediates that we hope will guide future work.
title_zh: 钴酞菁催化CO2还原为甲醇机理的分子层面研究

title: Enantioselective Decarboxylative Synthesis of Chiral α-Silylamines and α-Germylamines
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Metalloids bridge the properties of metals and nonmetals, creating unique opportunities in drug discovery. However, the potential of silicon- and germanium-containing scaffolds in organic synthesis and medicinal chemistry remain underexplored, largely owing to the lack of general stereocontrolled synthetic methods, particularly for value-added chiral α-silylamines and α-germylamines. Here, we report a robust nickel-catalyzed enantioselective decarboxylative cross-coupling of amino acid or peptide-derived redox-active esters with silylzinc and germylzinc reagents. The method exhibits a broad substrate scope and delivers excellent performance under mild conditions. Its efficacy is further demonstrated through the late-stage diversification of complex bioactive peptides, and both enantiomers can be accessed with high stereochemical fidelity. Mechanistic investigations delineate the origin of stereocontrol, while preliminary biological evaluations show promising activities, with Ge substitution in several cases surpassing Si and certain clinically marketed boron-containing drugs. Collectively, this work establishes an efficient and enantioselective route to chiral α-silylamines and α-germylamines, underscoring their potential to expand peptide chemical space and to enable the development of peptide-based therapeutics and diagnostics.
title_zh: 手性α-硅胺与α-锗胺的对映选择性脱羧合成
abstract_zh: 摘要 类金属连接了金属与非金属的性质，为药物发现创造了独特的机遇。然而，含硅和含锗骨架在有机合成与药物化学中的潜力仍未被充分开发，这主要归因于缺乏通用的立体控制合成方法，尤其是针对高附加值的的手性α-硅胺和α-锗胺。本文报道了一种稳健的镍催化对映选择性脱羧交叉偶联反应，将氨基酸或多肽衍生的氧化还原活性酯与有机硅锌和有机锗锌试剂偶联。该方法底物范围广泛，并在温和条件下表现出优异性能。通过复杂生物活性多肽的后期多样化进一步证明了其有效性，并且两个对映体均能以高立体化学保真度获得。机理研究阐明了立体控制的起源，而初步生物评估显示出令人鼓舞的活性，在若干实例中Ge取代优于Si以及某些已上市临床含硼药物。总体而言，本工作建立了一条高效、对映选择性的手性α-硅胺和α-锗胺合成路线，凸显了它们在拓展多肽化学空间以及推动基于多肽的治疗和诊断试剂发展方面的潜力。

title: Million-Turnover Photocatalysis Enabled by Far-Red-Light-Responsive Gold Nanoclusters
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract In recent years, numerous photocatalytic systems have been developed to promote a wide range of organic transformations mediated by singlet oxygen. However, conventional blue-light photosensitizers encounter significant challenges in large-scale synthesis, primarily due to the limited penetration depth of high-energy photons. Herein, we report an atomically precise Au27 nanocluster featuring a novel superatomic core built from an icosahedral Au13 and a tetrahedral Au4, allowing for highly efficient singlet oxygen generation under far-red-light irradiation. While its overall structure closely resembles that of Au25 nanoclusters with a single icosahedral Au13 core, the incorporation of a tetrahedral Au4 building unit through ligand engineering markedly enhances intersystem crossing efficiency and aligns transition energies for effective O2 sensitization, affording an internal quantum yield of 0.37% at 740 nm. Compared with previous light-driven systems, our ten-gram-scale, cluster-based photochemical process reduces catalyst loading by four orders of magnitude (10,000-fold), requiring only 13 nmol of photocatalyst, and achieves turnover numbers greater than one million. This study establishes a new paradigm in photocatalyst design, demonstrating how atomic-level structural control can enable far-red-light-driven organic transformations with substantially enhanced catalytic performance.
title_zh: 远红光响应金纳米团簇实现百万转化数光催化
abstract_zh: 摘要 近年来，人们已开发出众多光催化体系，以促进由单线态氧介导的广泛有机转化。然而，传统的蓝光光敏剂在规模化合成中面临重大挑战，这主要由于高能光子有限的穿透深度。本文报道了一种原子精确的Au27纳米团簇，其具有由二十面体Au13和四面体Au4构建的新型超原子核心，可在远红光照射下高效产生单线态氧。尽管其整体结构与具有单一二十面体Au13核心的Au25纳米团簇十分相似，但通过配体工程引入四面体Au4构建单元显著提高了系间窜越效率，并使跃迁能量与有效的O2敏化相匹配，在740 nm处获得0.37%的内量子产率。与以往光驱动体系相比，我们十克规模的基于团簇的光化学过程将催化剂用量降低了四个数量级（10,000倍），仅需13 nmol光催化剂，并实现了超过一百万的转化数。本研究确立了光催化剂设计的新范式，展示了原子级结构控制如何实现远红光驱动的有机转化，并显著提升催化性能。

title: Hexacoordinate Actinide(IV) Compounds: Benchmark Complexes for Magnetism and Electronic Structure Analysis
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Two series of actinide tetrachloride complexes with the monodentate carboxylic amide ligands phthalimidine (H-phthal) and 2-pyridone (HPyO) of the general formula [AnIVCl4(L)2] (An = U, Np, Pu) were synthesized and characterized in the solid state and in solution. SC-XRD analysis revealed an octahedral coordination environment with trans orientation of either H-phthal or HPyO in all cases, with and without THF molecules hydrogen-bonded to the NH group of the ligands. In the case of [NpCl4(H-phthal)2], the absence of THF leads to a significant distortion of the coordination geometry around the metal, including the shortest Np–Cl bonds observed so far (2.4394(8) Å). A quantum chemical bonding analysis (QTAIM) showed that the main bonding interaction is found between the actinide and chloride ligands, with the amides rather loosely bound. Despite their unusually low coordination number, the complexes were found to be stable, even in coordinating solvents. This allowed for an in-depth analysis of their 1H and 13C NMR spectroscopy. Due to their pseudoD4h symmetry in the first coordination sphere, these complexes are excellent model systems to analyze their electronic structure and magnetic properties. We applied SQUID magnetometry to extract magnetic properties (μeff) and crystal field parameters ( Bqk, Wybourne) in combination with quantum chemical calculations, which allows for the comprehensive description of the electronic ground state from an experimental and theoretical point of view.
title_zh: 六配位锕系元素(IV)化合物：磁性与电子结构分析的基准配合物
abstract_zh: 摘要 合成了两个系列的锕系四氯化物配合物，采用单齿羧酰胺配体邻苯二甲酰亚胺酮（H-phthal）和2-吡啶酮（HPyO），通式为[AnIVCl4(L)2]（An = U、Np、Pu），并在固态和溶液中进行了表征。SC-XRD分析表明，在所有情况下均呈现八面体配位环境，H-phthal或HPyO呈反式取向，无论配体的NH基团是否通过氢键结合THF分子。在[NpCl4(H-phthal)2]的情况下，THF的缺失导致金属周围配位几何的显著畸变，其中包括迄今为止观察到的最短Np–Cl键（2.4394(8) Å）。量子化学键分析（QTAIM）表明，主要成键相互作用存在于锕系元素与氯配体之间，而酰胺的结合较为松散。尽管配位数异常低，这些配合物被发现即使在配位溶剂中也保持稳定。这使其¹H和¹³C NMR波谱得以深入分析。由于其第一配位球层具有伪D4h对称性，这些配合物是分析其电子结构和磁性质的优秀模型体系。我们结合SQUID磁测量与量子化学计算提取了磁性质（μeff）和晶体场参数（Bqk, Wybourne），从而从实验和理论角度对电子基态进行了全面描述。

title: Sequential Topotactic Transformations Traverse Metastable Phases in Complex Aluminophosphate Frameworks with Tunable Pore Architectures
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Crystalline porous frameworks are irreplaceable platforms for catalysis, separation, new energy, sensing, and biomedicine, yet the majority exist as inaccessible metastable structures across an extensive structural landscape. Here we introduce a sequential topotactic transformation (STT) strategy, in which a simple steaming treatment induces a cascade of structurally correlated topotactic transformations, systematically uncovering a family of hidden metastable frameworks. Using this STT approach, the small-pore aluminophosphate molecular sieve (AlPO MS) DNL-17 undergoes sequential crystalline–state transitions to yield three previously unknown MSs (DNL-18, DNL-19, and DNL-20). Structural characterization and DFT calculations reveal that these transformations preserve partial ABC-6 stacking motif through selective bond cleavage and framework-fragment sliding. This strategy not only accesses diverse metastable states but also enables pore-size modulation from small-pore to ultramicroporous regimes, leading to efficient propane/propylene and water/carbon dioxide separations. It broadens the structural diversity of MSs and provides a strategy for tailoring pore architectures toward application-specific performance.
title_zh: 序列拓扑转化 traversing 亚稳态相：具有可调孔道结构的复杂磷酸铝骨架
abstract_zh: 摘要 晶态多孔框架在催化、分离、新能源、传感和生物医学领域是不可替代的平台，然而在广阔的结构版图中，大多数以难以获得的亚稳态结构存在。本文提出了一种顺序拓扑转变（STT）策略，其中简单的蒸汽处理可诱导一系列结构相关的拓扑转变，系统性地揭示出一族隐藏的亚稳态框架。采用该STT方法，小孔磷酸铝分子筛（AlPO MS）DNL-17经历顺序晶态转变，生成三种此前未知的MS（DNL-18、DNL-19和DNL-20）。结构表征与DFT计算表明，这些转变通过选择性断键和骨架片段滑动保留了部分ABC-6堆积基元。该策略不仅可获得多样的亚稳态，还实现了从小孔到超微孔区域的孔径调控，从而实现高效的丙烷/丙烯和水/二氧化碳分离。它拓展了MS的结构多样性，并提供了一种针对特定应用性能定制孔结构的策略。

title: Enantioselective Organocatalytic Construction of N -Bridged Tricyclic Normorphan Skeleton: Application to the Total Synthesis of (+)-Peduncularine
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract The normorphan framework is a compact, sp3-rich N-bridged scaffold found in biologically active natural products and increasingly valued as a three-dimensional platform for medicinal chemistry. Despite its synthetic and biological relevance, direct catalytic asymmetric access to functionalized normorphan-related architectures remains limited. Here, we describe an enantioselective organocatalytic method for constructing an N-bridged tricyclic scaffold bearing a normorphan skeleton using a bifunctional cinchona alkaloid-derived squaramide catalyst. The reaction between 3-hydroxy-2-pyridones and α,β-unsaturated aldehydes results in the formation of a [4 + 2] cycloaddition adduct as an intermediate, which subsequently undergoes skeletal rearrangement. Mechanistic studies and DFT calculations are consistent with a bifunctional hydrogen-bond donor/base activation mode in which the catalyst organizes the initial cycloaddition step and facilitates the rearrangement process. This methodology provides access to a series of bridged normorphan skeletons that exhibit excellent enantio- and diastereoselectivities (up to 99% ee and dr >20:1). The protocol is scalable to gram quantities and was successfully applied to the asymmetric total synthesis of (+)-peduncularine and the preparation of related analogues, demonstrating the synthetic utility of the enantioenriched tricyclic platform.
title_zh: N-桥连三环降吗喃骨架的对映选择性有机催化构建：在(+)-Peduncularine全合成中的应用
abstract_zh: 摘要 诺吗啡喃（normorphan）骨架是一种紧凑的、富sp3的氮桥骨架，存在于具有生物活性的天然产物中，并日益被视为药物化学的三维平台。尽管具有合成和生物学相关性，功能化诺吗啡喃相关骨架的直接催化不对称合成途径仍然有限。本文描述了一种对映选择性有机催化方法，采用双功能金鸡纳生物碱衍生方酰胺催化剂，构建含诺吗啡喃骨架的氮桥三环骨架。3-羟基-2-吡啶酮与α,β-不饱和醛之间的反应首先生成[4 + 2]环加成加合物中间体，随后发生骨架重排。机理研究与DFT计算与双功能氢键供体/碱活化模式一致，其中催化剂组织初始环加成步骤并促进重排过程。该方法学提供了一系列桥连诺吗啡喃骨架的合成途径，表现出优异的对映选择性和非对映选择性（高达99% ee，dr >20:1）。该方案可放大至克级规模，并成功应用于(+)-peduncularine的不对称全合成及相关类似物的制备，展示了富对映体三环平台的合成实用性。

title: Carrier–Lattice Coupling Drives Oxidative Degradation in Mixed Tin–Lead Halide Perovskites: Machine Learning Combined with Nonadiabatic Molecular Dynamics
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Mixed Sn–Pb halide perovskites exhibit excellent optoelectronic properties but suffer rapid degradation due to the facile oxidation of Sn2+ to Sn4+. Here, we establish a multiscale framework to uncover how cation ordering, surface defect chemistry, hole localization, and carrier dynamics collectively drive the initiation of Sn oxidation in FAPb0.5Sn0.5I3 (FA = formamidinium). Graph neural network screening identifies layered Sn/Pb enrichment as a recurring low-energy motif, which naturally yields an Sn-rich, Sn–I-terminated surface. Static calculations reveal contrasting effects of the two surface defects: the Sn vacancy (VSn) creates an oxidation-prone local environment that stabilizes Sn-centered hole localization and lattice distortion, whereas atop iodine (Iatop) promotes hole delocalization, reinforces the surface Sn–I framework, and suppresses the formation of Sn(IV)-like oxidation precursors. Nonadiabatic molecular dynamics further reveal a hundred-picosecond window, defined by ultrafast hole extraction toward the surface and much slower nonradiative recombination, in which accumulated photogenerated holes can drive oxidation-related lattice reorganization. Ab initio molecular dynamics simulations with two excess holes show that the pristine surface remains relatively robust, whereas VSn strongly stabilizes localized holes and triggers pronounced local distortion together with SnI4-like extrusion and defect growth. These findings reveal that Sn oxidation is governed by carrier–lattice coupling through its control over the kinetic accessibility of Sn-centered hole localization, and they identify the suppression of VSn defects and the stabilization of I-rich surface terminations as key design principles for stable Sn–Pb perovskites.
title_zh: 载流子–晶格耦合驱动锡铅混合卤化物钙钛矿的氧化降解：机器学习结合非绝热分子动力学
