title: LATS1/2 inactivation drives a distinct venous endothelial cell response that contributes to fibrotic remodeling of the lung
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Endothelial dysfunction is recognized to contribute to chronic tissue remodeling in the lung, yet endothelial-derived mechanisms driving these processes remain largely undefined. Here, we show that endothelial inactivation of the LATS1 and LATS2 kinases, key suppressors of the transcriptional regulators YAP and TAZ, elicits distinct responses depending on endothelial identity within different pulmonary vascular beds. Our data indicate that LATS1/2 inactivation in general capillary endothelial cells induces a reactive capillary injury-like state, whereas a separate endothelial population located within veins adopts a distinct profibrotic state. We show that expansion of this reactive venous endothelial cell population, which is marked by EBF1 and ACKR1 expression, is associated with fibroblast activation, macrophage accumulation, and epithelial remodeling, collectively generating a microenvironment characteristic of fibrotic lung disease. We further demonstrate that pharmacologic inhibition of YAP/TAZ-TEAD signaling prevents stromal and immune remodeling and fibrotic lesion formation following endothelial LATS1/2 inactivation. These findings identify LATS1/2-mediated restraint of YAP/TAZ as essential for lung endothelial homeostasis and highlight a distinct venous cell response as a direct contributor to fibrotic lung remodeling.
title_zh: LATS1/2失活驱动一种独特的静脉内皮细胞反应，促进肺纤维化重塑
abstract_zh: 内皮功能障碍被认为是导致肺部慢性组织重塑的因素之一，但驱动这些过程的内皮源性机制在很大程度上仍未明确。在此，我们发现内皮细胞中LATS1和LATS2激酶（转录调节因子YAP和TAZ的关键抑制因子）的失活，会根据不同肺血管床中内皮细胞的身份引发不同的反应。我们的数据表明，一般毛细血管内皮细胞中LATS1/2的失活会诱导反应性毛细血管损伤样状态，而位于静脉中的另一群内皮细胞则采取一种独特的促纤维化状态。我们证明，这种以EBF1和ACKR1表达为标志的反应性静脉内皮细胞群的扩增，与成纤维细胞活化、巨噬细胞积累和上皮重塑相关，共同形成纤维化肺疾病特征的微环境。我们进一步证明，药物抑制YAP/TAZ-TEAD信号传导可防止内皮LATS1/2失活后的基质和免疫重塑以及纤维化病灶形成。这些发现表明LATS1/2对YAP/TAZ的抑制对肺内皮稳态至关重要，并强调一种独特的静脉细胞反应是纤维化肺重塑的直接促成因素。

title: Structural insights into fosfomycin efflux by a streptococcal ABC transporter
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
Gram-positive bacteria encode a broad array of ABC transporters that mediate substrate translocation across the cell membrane, with some contributing to their survival under environmental stresses such as antimicrobial exposure. While several of these transporters have been shown to exhibit multidrug efflux activity, the functional roles of many others remain unknown. Here, using an efflux pump screen in the opportunistic human pathogen
                    Streptococcus pneumoniae
                    , we identified a previously uncharacterized type IV ABC transporter (FoeAB) that confers resistance to the antibiotic fosfomycin. We show that purified FoeAB mediates fosfomycin transport in a liposome-reconstituted system and provide evidence that it functions as a multidrug efflux pump with substrate preferences distinct from those of known efflux pumps. Furthermore, we present cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) structures of FoeAB in inward- and outward-facing states, which reveal conformational changes associated with nucleotide binding and identify residues important for substrate transport. Collectively, these findings expand the known repertoire of antibiotic-exporting ABC transporters in Gram-positive bacteria and provide structural insight into the underlying transport mechanism.
title_zh: 链球菌ABC转运蛋白介导磷霉素外排的结构机制解析
abstract_zh: 革兰氏阳性细菌编码多种介导底物跨细胞膜易位的ABC转运蛋白，其中一些有助于它们在抗微生物药物暴露等环境胁迫下的存活。虽然其中一些转运蛋白已被证明具有多药外排活性，但许多其他转运蛋白的功能仍然未知。在此，通过在机会性人类病原体肺炎链球菌中进行外排泵筛选，我们鉴定了一种此前未表征的IV型ABC转运蛋白（FoeAB），其赋予对抗生素磷霉素的抗性。我们表明，纯化的FoeAB在脂质体重构系统中介导磷霉素转运，并提供证据表明它作为一种多药外排泵发挥功能，其底物偏好性与已知外排泵不同。此外，我们呈现了FoeAB在内向和外向状态下的冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）结构，揭示了与核苷酸结合相关的构象变化，并鉴定了对底物转运重要的残基。总之，这些发现扩展了已知的革兰氏阳性细菌中输出抗生素的ABC转运蛋白库，并为潜在的转运机制提供了结构性见解。

title: Personality pairing improves human–AI collaboration
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Here we examine how AI agent “personalities” interact with human personalities to shape human–AI collaboration and performance. In a large-scale, preregistered randomized experiment, we paired 1,258 participants with AI agents prompted to exhibit varying levels of the Big Five personality traits. These human–AI teams produced 7,266 display ads for a real think tank, which we evaluated using 1,168 independent human raters, and a field experiment on X that generated nearly 5 million impressions. We found that human and AI personalities individually shaped ad quality and teamwork and that human–AI personality pairings directly influenced ad quality. For example, extraverted humans paired with conscientious AI produced the lowest quality ads, followed by conscientious humans paired with agreeable AI and neurotic humans paired with conscientious AI. In the field experiment, ad quality significantly influenced ad performance, measured by click-through rates and cost-per-click. Together, these results demonstrate that personality pairing can improve human–AI collaboration and performance. They also motivate future research on the complex implications of AI personalization for human–AI collaboration, teamwork, and performance.
title_zh: 个性匹配提升人机协作效果
abstract_zh: 在此，我们研究AI智能体“个性”如何与人类个性相互作用，从而塑造人机协作和绩效。在一项大规模的预注册随机实验中，我们将1258名参与者与被提示表现出大五人格特质不同程度变化的AI智能体配对。这些人机团队为一家真实智库制作了7266条展示广告，我们使用1168名独立人类评估者对其进行评估，并在X上进行了产生近500万次展示的现场实验。我们发现，人类和AI的个性分别影响广告质量和团队合作，而人机个性配对直接影响广告质量。例如，外向型人类与尽责型AI配对产生的广告质量最低，其次是尽责型人类与随和型AI配对，以及神经质人类与尽责型AI配对。在现场实验中，广告质量显著影响广告表现，以点击率和每次点击成本衡量。总之，这些结果表明，个性配对可以改善人机协作和绩效。它们还推动了对AI个性化在人机协作、团队合作和绩效方面复杂影响的未来研究。

title: PLASTID ENVELOPE ION CHANNELS (PEC1/2) link Ca2+ and jasmonic acid signaling in plant cells
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
Plants constantly encounter adverse environmental interactions. One organelle is particularly specialized in stress signaling and phytohormone synthesis: the plastid. Calcium (Ca
                    2+
                    ), a key second messenger, is known to intersect with cellular phytohormone signaling networks. While cytosolic Ca
                    2+
                    dynamics have been studied extensively, the physiological relevance of stromal Ca
                    2+
                    transients and the identity of channels mediating rapid Ca
                    2+
                    flux into plastids remain largely unexplored. In this study, we provide evidence for PLASTID ENVELOPE ION CHANNELS (PECs) as long-sought mediators of fast-activating cation channel-like currents. We show that
                    PEC
                    expression is jasmonic acid (JA)-induced to augment stromal Ca
                    2+
                    transients under stress. Loss of PECs results in decreased JA priming and failure to elicit full defense responses after wounding. In turn,
                    PEC1
                    overexpression improves
                    Botrytis cinerea
                    tolerance. Our findings link stromal Ca
                    2+
                    signaling with JA-dependent stress responses and position PECs as modulators of plant defense.
title_zh: PLASTID ENVELOPE ION CHANNELS (PEC1/2) 连接植物细胞中的Ca2+与茉莉酸信号传导
abstract_zh: 植物不断遭遇不利的环境相互作用。有一种细胞器尤其专门负责胁迫信号传导和植物激素合成：质体。钙（Ca2+）是关键的第二信使，已知它与细胞植物激素信号网络交叉。虽然细胞质Ca2+动力学已被广泛研究，但基质Ca2+瞬变的生理相关性以及介导Ca2+快速流入质体的通道身份在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本研究中，我们提供证据表明质体外膜离子通道是长期寻找的快速激活阳离子通道样电流的介导者。我们表明PEC表达受茉莉酸（JA）诱导，以在胁迫下增强基质Ca2+瞬变。PEC的缺失导致JA引发效应减弱，以及在损伤后无法激发完整的防御反应。相应地，PEC1过表达提高了对灰葡萄孢菌的耐受性。我们的发现将基质Ca2+信号传导与JA依赖的胁迫反应联系起来，并将PEC定位为植物防御的调节因子。

title: scProtoTransformer: Scalable reference mapping across molecules, cells, and donors
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: The rapid accumulation of single-cell data has made it possible to comprehensively characterize biological systems at molecular, cellular, and donor levels. However, scalable reference mapping across different resolutions remains a major challenge in current research. Here, we propose scProtoTransformer, a prototype-based Transformer architecture designed to achieve scalable reference mapping across molecular, cell, and donor levels. scProtoTransformer introduces a knowledge-guided prototype tokenizer that projects gene expression into biologically interpretable pathway prototypes, effectively reducing numerical batch effects while preserving biological semantic patterns. Furthermore, by leveraging knowledge distilled from the foundation model and a dynamic supervised fine-tuning strategy, scProtoTransformer achieves robust biological representations with reduced pretraining requirements. Benchmark experiments across molecular, cell, and donor-level reference mapping demonstrate that scProtoTransformer delivers competitive or even superior performance compared with state-of-the-art approaches while providing interpretability through biological prototypes. Together, these results establish scProtoTransformer as a unified framework for scalable reference mapping, laying the foundation for systematic understanding from genes to individuals.
title_zh: scProtoTransformer：跨分子、细胞和供体的可扩展参照映射
abstract_zh: 单细胞数据的快速积累使得在分子、细胞和供体层面全面表征生物系统成为可能。然而，跨不同分辨率进行可扩展的参考图谱映射仍然是当前研究中的重大挑战。在此，我们提出scProtoTransformer，这是一种基于原型的Transformer架构，旨在实现跨分子、细胞和供体层面的可扩展参考图谱映射。scProtoTransformer引入了一种知识引导的原型分词器（prototype tokenizer），将基因表达投射到具有生物学可解释性的通路原型中，在保留生物学语义模式的同时有效降低数值批次效应。此外，通过利用从基础模型中蒸馏的知识以及动态监督微调策略，scProtoTransformer以更低的预训练需求获得了稳健的生物学表征。在分子、细胞和供体层面参考图谱映射的基准实验表明，scProtoTransformer与最先进的方法相比具有竞争力甚至更优的性能，同时通过生物学原型提供了可解释性。总之，这些结果确立了scProtoTransformer作为可扩展参考图谱映射的统一框架，为从基因到个体的系统性理解奠定了基础。

title: Adipose-cartilage communication via EV-Mito–mtDNA signaling promotes osteoarthritis progression
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Obesity is a major risk factor for osteoarthritis (OA), yet the mechanisms linking excess adiposity to joint degeneration remain incompletely understood. Here, we identify adipocyte-derived extracellular vesicles enriched in mitochondrial components (EV-Mito) as pathogenic mediators that transfer mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) to chondrocytes. The internalized mtDNA activates the cyclic GMP-AMP synthase-stimulator of interferon genes (cGAS-STING) cytosolic DNA-sensing pathway, inducing inflammatory signaling, metabolic dysfunction, senescence, and cartilage degeneration in murine and human models. Genetic and pharmacological inhibition of cGAS-STING signaling attenuates cartilage damage, pain behaviors, and gait abnormalities. Population-level and interventional data further show that body fat percentage, rather than body mass index, is more closely associated with OA risk and severity. In an exercise cohort, high-intensity interval training selectively reduced adiposity and was associated with lower mtDNA abundance in synovial EV fractions enriched for adipose-associated EV markers, reduced synovial 2′,3′-cyclic GMP-AMP levels, and superior improvement in OA symptoms. These findings define a conserved EV-Mito–mtDNA–cGAS-STING axis linking adipose tissue to joint pathology and highlight fat-targeted interventions as mechanistically informed strategies for preventing and treating obesity-associated OA.
title_zh: 脂肪组织与软骨通过EV-Mito–mtDNA信号通讯促进骨关节炎进展
abstract_zh: 肥胖是骨关节炎（OA）的重要危险因素，但将过多脂肪与关节退变联系起来的机制尚未完全阐明。在此，我们发现富含线粒体成分的脂肪细胞来源细胞外囊泡（EV-Mito）是致病介质，可将线粒体DNA（mtDNA）递送至软骨细胞。内化的mtDNA激活环GMP-AMP合酶-干扰素基因刺激蛋白（cGAS-STING）胞质DNA传感通路，在小鼠和人体模型中诱导炎症信号传导、代谢功能障碍、细胞衰老和软骨退变。cGAS-STING信号的遗传和药理学抑制可减轻软骨损伤、疼痛行为和步态异常。人群水平和干预性数据进一步表明，体脂百分比（而非体重指数）与OA风险和严重程度更为密切相关。在一个运动队列中，高强度间歇训练选择性地降低了脂肪量，并与富含脂肪相关EV标志物的滑膜EV组分中mtDNA丰度降低、滑膜2′,3′-环GMP-AMP水平下降以及OA症状的更优改善相关。这些发现定义了一条将脂肪组织与关节病理联系起来的保守的EV-Mito–mtDNA–cGAS-STING轴，并强调针对脂肪的干预是预防和治疗肥胖相关OA的具有机制依据的策略。

title: A spatially resolved implantable microdevice for multiplexed in situ screening of engineered cellular therapies in solid tumors
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
The clinical translation of cellular immunotherapies for solid tumors remains limited by the lack of adequate tools to evaluate therapeutic function within the native tumor microenvironment. Here, we demonstrate a miniaturized implantable microdevice (IMD) capable of spatially resolving and multiplexing the delivery and screening of multiple T cell therapies directly within live tumors. This customizable IMD is comprised of discrete fibrin-filled reservoirs that can be independently loaded with distinct immune cell formulations, which enables spatially confined release and region-specific immune-tumor interactions within the same tumor mass. Using this platform in glioblastoma xenografts, we simultaneously delivered EGFR-targeting CAR-T cells and control T cells and analyzed adjacent tissues via IHC-based quantitative image analysis and multiplexed immunofluorescence. The perireservoir region adjacent to CAR-T cell reservoirs exhibited dense CD8
                    +
                    infiltration, cleaved caspase-3-mediated apoptosis, and suppressed Ki67 expression, in contrast to minimal activity in control regions. We believe our IMD platform facilitates the parallel in vivo evaluation of multiple immune cell therapies, providing a translational tool to accelerate the development of successful personalized adoptive cell therapies.
title_zh: 一种空间分辨的可植入微器件，用于实体瘤中工程化细胞治疗的多重原位筛选
abstract_zh: 针对实体肿瘤的细胞免疫疗法的临床转化仍受限于缺乏能够在原生肿瘤微环境中评估治疗功能的合适工具。在此，我们展示了一种小型化可植入微装置（IMD），能够在活体肿瘤内直接对多种T细胞疗法的递送和筛选进行空间解析和多重化。这种可定制的IMD由若干离散的纤维蛋白填充储库组成，各储库可独立加载不同的免疫细胞制剂，从而在同一肿瘤块内实现空间局限的释放和区域特异性的免疫-肿瘤相互作用。在胶质母细胞瘤异种移植瘤中使用该平台，我们同时递送了靶向EGFR的CAR-T细胞和对照T细胞，并通过基于IHC的定量图像分析和多重免疫荧光分析邻近组织。与对照区域的极低活性相比，CAR-T细胞储库邻近的储库周围区域表现出密集的CD8+浸润、cleaved caspase-3介导的细胞凋亡以及Ki67表达的抑制。我们相信，我们的IMD平台有助于多种免疫细胞疗法的平行体内评估，为加速成功的个性化过继细胞疗法的开发提供转化工具。

title: Adaptable weaving origami
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: As intelligence continues to deepen in engineering fields, adaptable shape-morphing structures face increasing demands for multifunctionality and reconfigurability. Origami has been widely explored in deployable structures, mechanical computing, metamaterials, and metamorphic robots. However, conventional origami designs typically rely on single-layer folding topologies, which impose intrinsic trade-offs among foldability, mobility, and reconfigurability and thus limit their generality. Here, we show that weaving-inspired origami can overcome these constraints by introducing interlaced strip architectures into origami design. This strategy enables the simultaneous realization of developability, flat-foldability, and rigid foldability, while supporting coupled extension, twisting, and bending deformations. Based on this framework, we establish a library of origami units with diverse polygonal configurations that exhibit rich and programmable morphing behaviors. Demonstrations including mechanical encryption, adaptable apertures, and an origami gripper illustrate the versatility of the proposed approach. These results show that weaving provides a promising pathway for constructing general-purpose origami structures suitable for interdisciplinary engineering applications.
title_zh: 可适配编织折纸结构
abstract_zh: 随着工程领域智能化的不断深入，可适配的形状变形结构对多功能性和可重构性的需求日益增加。折纸结构已在可展开结构、机械计算、超材料和变形机器人中得到广泛探索。然而，传统的折纸设计通常依赖单层折叠拓扑，这在可折叠性、可动性和可重构性之间造成了内在的权衡，从而限制了其通用性。在此，我们表明受编织启发的折纸可以通过在折纸设计中引入交织条带架构来克服这些限制。该策略能够同时实现可展开性、平折性和刚性可折叠性，同时支持耦合的伸展、扭转和弯曲变形。基于这一框架，我们建立了一个具有多样多边形构型的折纸单元库，展现出丰富且可编程的变形行为。包括机械加密、可适配光圈和折纸夹持器在内的演示说明了所提方法的通用性。这些结果表明，编织为构建适用于跨学科工程应用的通用折纸结构提供了一条有前景的途径。

title: Locomotion optimizes sensory representations through a computational principle shared by rodents and primates
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Behavior modulates the activity of sensory systems in multiple ways: from gain changes in individual neurons to changing interactions in neural populations. These effects are not universal; while movement has a strong influence on sensory coding in rodents, its impact on primates is less prominent. The diversity of effects that locomotion exerts on sensory neurons, as well as disparities between species, raises questions about the existence of universal principles that may underlie sensation during behavior. We propose that sensory systems are internally modulated to match systematic changes in stimulus statistics caused by locomotion, to facilitate an accurate and efficient sensory code. We find that model neurons, adapted to stimuli recorded during movement in natural environments, predict and reproduce a broad spectrum of experimental observations in rodents and primates. This simple principle of maintaining coding efficiency across behavioral states reconciles the diversity of ways in which locomotion modulates visual coding in different animal species.
title_zh: 运动通过啮齿类和灵长类共享的计算原理优化感觉表征
abstract_zh: 行为以多种方式调节感觉系统的活动：从单个神经元的增益变化到神经元群间相互作用的改变。这些效应并非普遍存在；虽然运动对啮齿动物的感觉编码有强烈影响，但其对灵长类动物的影响不太显著。运动对感觉神经元施加的效应的多样性以及物种之间的差异，引发了关于行为过程中感觉背后是否存在普遍原理的疑问。我们提出，感觉系统受到内部调节，以匹配由运动引起的刺激统计特性的系统性变化，从而促进准确而高效的感觉编码。我们发现，适应于在自然环境中运动期间记录的刺激的模型神经元，能够预测并重现啮齿动物和灵长类动物中广泛的实验观察结果。这种在不同行为状态下维持编码效率的简单原理，调和了运动在不同动物物种中调节视觉编码方式的多样性。

title: SHARPIN restrains IL-33 release by stromal cells to control ILC2 inflammation
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Loss of SHARPIN, a component of the linear ubiquitin chain assembly complex (LUBAC), causes systemic inflammation including the accumulation of eosinophils across multiple tissues in mice. However, the mechanisms by which SHARPIN regulates type 2 inflammation remain unclear. Here, we found that SHARPIN deficiency resulted in increased numbers of type 2 innate lymphoid cells (ILC2s) in the lung and other tissues via a cell-extrinsic mechanism. SHARPIN loss enhanced interleukin-33 (IL-33) production by lung stromal cells in vivo and in vitro, thereby promoting ILC2 proliferation. Mechanistically, SHARPIN directly bound IL-33 through its Pleckstrin homology-linker region and restrained IL-33 release independently of its ubiquitination. Combined deficiency of SHARPIN and IL-33 completely reversed ILC2 increase and lung inflammation, but not stromal cell death. Our study reveals a non-canonical, ubiquitin-independent function of SHARPIN as a gatekeeper of IL-33-driven type 2 inflammation.
title_zh: SHARPIN限制基质细胞释放IL-33以调控ILC2炎症
abstract_zh: SHARPIN是线性泛素链组装复合物（LUBAC）的一个组分，其缺失会导致系统性炎症，包括小鼠多种组织中嗜酸性粒细胞的积累。然而，SHARPIN调节2型炎症的机制仍不清楚。在此，我们发现SHARPIN缺失通过细胞外在机制导致肺和其他组织中2型固有淋巴细胞（ILC2）数量增加。SHARPIN缺失在体内和体外均增强肺基质细胞产生白细胞介素-33（IL-33），从而促进ILC2增殖。在机制上，SHARPIN通过其Pleckstrin同源连接区直接结合IL-33，并以不依赖于其泛素化功能的方式抑制IL-33的释放。SHARPIN与IL-33联合缺失可完全逆转ILC2增加和肺部炎症，但不能逆转基质细胞死亡。我们的研究揭示了SHARPIN作为IL-33驱动的2型炎症守门者的非经典、非泛素依赖功能。

title: Neuron-derived SPP1 instructs microglia to limit degeneration
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Neurons actively shape immune responses that maintain central nervous system integrity. We identify SPP1 (secreted phosphoprotein 1) as a neuron-derived signal that reprograms microglia into a neuroprotective, homeostatic state after injury and during neurodegeneration. In mouse models of glaucoma and optic nerve damage, neuronal SPP1 enhances microglial autophagy, debris clearance, and anti-inflammatory activity, preserving neuronal survival and visual function. SPP1 is elevated in neurons of human and primate glaucomatous retinas, where SPP1
                    +
                    cells show increased resilience. In Alzheimer’s disease brain, neuronal SPP1 correlates with neuronal survival, while microglia around Aβ plaques display defective autophagy. In human iPSC co-cultures, SPP1 enhances microglial Aβ clearance and prevents neurodegeneration. Thus, SPP1 defines a protective neuron–microglia axis in glaucoma and possibly other neurodegenerative diseases.

abstract_zh: 神经元主动塑造维持中枢神经系统完整性的免疫反应。我们发现SPP1（分泌性磷蛋白1）是一种神经元来源的信号，可在损伤后及神经退行性变过程中将小胶质细胞重编程为神经保护性、稳态状态。在青光眼和视神经损伤小鼠模型中，神经元SPP1增强小胶质细胞自噬、碎片清除及抗炎活性，从而保护神经元存活和视功能。SPP1在人类和灵长类青光眼视网膜神经元中表达升高，其中SPP1+细胞表现出更强的耐受性。在阿尔茨海默病患者大脑中，神经元SPP1与神经元存活相关，而Aβ斑块周围的小胶质细胞表现出自噬缺陷。在人类iPSC共培养体系中，SPP1增强小胶质细胞对Aβ的清除并防止神经退行性变。因此，SPP1界定了青光眼乃至其他神经退行性疾病中一条保护性的神经元–小胶质细胞轴。

title: Engineering Dirac points with hybrid photonic synthetic dimensions in a cavity
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Synthetic dimensions provide a powerful route for engineering topological matter beyond the constraints of real-space geometry, with enhanced tunability and measurement accessibility. Here, we implement two independent and extended synthetic dimensions based on photonic frequency and orbital angular momentum (OAM) in a zero-dimensional cavity system. With polarization serving as a pseudo-spin, we realize an anisotropic Dirac Hamiltonian with fully controllable coupling strengths, enabling unprecedented engineering of Dirac points, including their creation, motion, and merging, as well as a Lifshitz transition from type-I to type-II Dirac cones. Using angle- and time-resolved spectroscopic techniques, we experimentally reconstruct the full two-dimensional band structure, identify Dirac points, and measure the associated Berry phase. Our platform provides a versatile setting for exploring Dirac physics and topological phenomena and establishes a scalable pathway toward higher-dimensional quantum simulation.

abstract_zh: 合成维度为在实空间几何限制之外工程化拓扑物态提供了一条强大途径，具有增强的可调性和测量可达性。在此，我们在一个零维腔系统中基于光子频率和轨道角动量（OAM）实现了两个独立且扩展的合成维度。以偏振作为赝自旋，我们实现了耦合强度完全可控的各向异性Dirac哈密顿量，从而实现对Dirac点的前所未有的工程调控，包括其产生、移动与合并，以及从I型到II型Dirac锥的Lifshitz转变。利用角度分辨和时间分辨光谱技术，我们在实验上重构了完整的二维能带结构，确定了Dirac点，并测量了相应的Berry相位。我们的平台为探索Dirac物理和拓扑现象提供了多功能环境，并为高维量子模拟建立了可扩展的途径。

title: Non-Hermitian trapping of Dirac exciton-polariton condensates in a perovskite metasurface
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Massless Dirac particles avoid trapping because of their exceptional tunneling properties manifested in the so-called Klein paradox. This conclusion stems from the conservative treatment, but so far, it has not been extended to a non-Hermitian framework. Recently, driven-dissipative bosonic condensation of exciton-polaritons featuring Dirac dispersion was demonstrated in metasurface waveguides—a platform rich in non-Hermitian effects. Here, we report an experimental observation of spatial binding and energy quantization of Dirac polaritons in a halide perovskite metasurface. A combination of spatially profiled nonresonant optical excitation and exciton-polariton interaction forms an effective non-Hermitian complex potential responsible for the observed effect. In the case of tightly focused pump spots spanning from 9 to 17 micrometers, several bound states simultaneously achieve macroscopic occupation, constituting a multimode bosonic condensation of exciton-polaritons. Our theoretical analysis based on the driven-dissipative extension of the Dirac equation reveals a non-Hermitian confinement mechanism that bypasses the Klein paradox. Unlike previous observations limited to massive Dirac gaps, the non-Hermitian trap confines particles even in a gapless spectrum on both sides of the Dirac point.
title_zh: 钙钛矿超表面中Dirac激子-极化子凝聚体的非厄米捕获
abstract_zh: 无质量Dirac粒子因其以所谓Klein悖论为表现的非凡隧穿特性而无法被俘获。这一结论源于保守（厄米）处理，但迄今为止尚未被推广到非厄米框架。最近，在超表面波导中实现了具有Dirac色散的激子-极化子的驱动-耗散玻色凝聚——一个富含非厄米效应的平台。在此，我们报道在卤化物钙钛矿超表面中对Dirac极化子空间束缚和能量量子化的实验观察。空间分布的非共振光学激发与激子-极化子相互作用相结合，形成了导致所观察效应的有效非厄米复势。在泵浦光斑从9到17微米紧聚焦的情况下，多个束缚态同时实现宏观占据，构成激子-极化子的多模玻色凝聚。我们基于Dirac方程的驱动-耗散扩展的理论分析揭示了一种绕过Klein悖论的非厄米束缚机制。与以往局限于有质量Dirac能隙的观察不同，该非厄米势阱即使在Dirac点两侧无隙谱中也能束缚粒子。

title: Neural network–augmented Pfaffian wave-functions for scalable simulations of interacting fermions
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Developing accurate numerical methods for strongly interacting fermions is crucial for improving our understanding of various quantum many-body phenomena, especially unconventional superconductivity. Recently, neural quantum states have emerged as a promising approach for studying correlated fermions, highlighted by the hidden fermion and backflow methods, which use neural networks to model corrections to fermionic quasiparticle orbitals. In this work, we expand these ideas to the space of Pfaffians, a wave-function that naturally expresses superconducting pairings, and propose the hidden fermion Pfaffian state (HFPS), which flexibly represents both unpaired and superconducting phases and scales to large systems with favorable asymptotic complexity. In our numerical experiments, HFPS provides state-of-the-art variational accuracy in different regimes of both the attractive and repulsive Hubbard models. We show that the HFPS is able to capture general phases with and without pairing, and therefore may be a useful tool for modeling phases with unconventional superconductivity.

title: Surface chemistry governs sex-dependent responses to PEG and zwitterionic siRNA nanocarriers in primary macrophages
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Nanoparticle carriers are widely used for nucleic acid delivery, with poly(ethylene glycol) (PEG)–conjugated nanoparticles emerging as a frontrunner in the field. Growing concerns surrounding PEG immunogenicity have generated interest in zwitterionic polymers as alternative biocompatible surface grafts. At present, there exists a paucity of data regarding zwitterion-conjugated nanoparticle performance in primary immune cells and across biological sexes. Here, we synthesized pH-responsive PEG- and zwitterion-grafted cationic nanoparticles, including PEG methyl ether methacrylate (PEGMMA), carboxybetaine methacrylate (CBMA), sulfobetaine methacrylate (SBMA), and polymeric SBMA, and assessed their cytotoxicity and small interfering RNA (siRNA) delivery in primary male and female murine macrophages. All formulations enabled intracellular siRNA uptake and suppressed tumor necrosis factor–α expression. Sex-dependent effects varied by nanoparticle formulation and biological end point. Zwitterionic nanoparticles exhibited sex-specific effects in cytotoxicity and gene knockdown despite similar uptake, whereas PEGMMA showed higher uptake in females but comparable knockdown across sexes. These findings demonstrate that uptake alone does not predict functional efficacy and highlight the importance of sex-informed evaluation when developing nanomedicines.

title: “Smelltronics”—From Gas to Smell Sensing
source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    This review discusses recent trends in smell and odor‐sensing studies, including materials, devices, and interfaces. Since the invention of chemical sensors, particularly over the past few decades, gas sensor materials and devices for small molecules have been extensively investigated. Recently, the social value of odor information has been strongly reaffirmed across diverse research fields, triggered by the rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML). Compared with conventional gas sensing, the requirements for sensing materials and devices for extracting odor information are fundamentally different. In the fields of health diagnosis, food inspection, and environmental monitoring, target molecules that express odor information are frequently composed of molecules with relatively large molecular weights. Because the structural isomers of such relatively large molecules essentially exhibit variations in odor information, their discrimination of such structural isomers is an important issue for smell/odor sensing. Various sensors that operate based on different principles, including electrical, gravimetric, and optical sensors, were discussed in terms of their characteristics. In addition, we describe the sensing materials and interfaces for smell/odor sensing–
                    smelltronics
                    . Finally, we discuss the current challenges and perspectives of smelltronics.
title_zh: “气味电子学”——从气体到气味传感
abstract_zh:
摘要

本文综述了气味与嗅觉传感研究的最新趋势，包括材料、器件与界面。自化学传感器问世以来，尤其在过去几十年中，针对小分子的气体传感器材料与器件已被广泛研究。近来，受人工智能（AI）与机器学习（ML）快速发展的推动，气味信息的社会价值在多个研究领域得到了重新高度重视。与常规气体传感相比，用于提取气味信息的传感材料与器件在需求上存在根本性差异。在健康诊断、食品检验和环境监测领域，表达气味信息的目标分子常常由分子量相对较大的分子组成。由于这类较大分子的结构异构体本质上表现出气味信息的差异，对这些结构异构体的区分是气味/嗅觉传感的重要课题。本文讨论了基于不同原理工作的各类传感器，包括电学、质量敏感和光学传感器，并分析了其特性。此外，我们描述了用于气味/嗅觉传感的传感材料与界面——气味电子学（smelltronics）。最后，我们讨论了气味电子学当前面临的挑战与前景。

title: Moiré‐Induced Symmetry Breaking of Charge Order in van der Waals Heterostructures
source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    Layered materials that stack different lattice symmetries are rare in nature. Misfit layered chalcogenides, which combine square and hexagonal lattices of rocksalt monochalcogenides and transition‐metal dichalcogenides, provide a platform to explore how incommensurability and explicit symmetry breaking impact collective electronic phases. Here we use low‐temperature scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy to probe the misfit compounds (MS)
                    1+δ
                    TaS
                    2
                    with M = Pb, Sn and track how the misfit interface reshapes the electronic ground state of the embedded 1H‐TaS
                    2
                    monolayers. High‐resolution STM imaging and Fourier analysis reveal that the charge‐density wave (CDW) is incommensurate and exhibits spatially inhomogeneous, short‐range correlations. Strikingly, the CDW exhibits a pronounced and anisotropic response to the uniaxial moiré potential imposed by the misfit layer: its coherence lengths and ordering wavevectors become inequivalent, demonstrating a strong nonlinear coupling between the intrinsic CDW instability and the symmetry‐breaking moiré field. First‐principles‐informed multiscale modeling suggests that this reorganization arises from the combined effect of interlayer charge transfer and the spatially anisotropic energy landscape introduced by the misfit interface. In contrast, superconductivity is comparatively insensitive to the moiré, revealing a uniform, single full‐gap consistent with s‐wave pairing. Our results establish heterosymmetry stacking as a route to engineer correlated states in van der Waals materials.
title_zh: 范德华异质结构中莫尔诱导的电荷有序对称性破缺
abstract_zh:
摘要

将不同晶格对称性堆叠在一起的层状材料在自然界中十分罕见。失配层状硫族化合物将岩盐型单硫族化物的四方晶格与过渡金属二硫族化物的六方晶格相结合，为探索非共度性与显式对称性破缺如何影响集体电子相提供了平台。本文利用低温扫描隧道显微镜/谱学研究失配化合物 (MS)1+δTaS2（M = Pb、Sn），并追踪失配界面如何重塑嵌入的 1H-TaS2 单层的电子基态。高分辨率 STM 成像与傅里叶分析表明，电荷密度波（CDW）是非共度的，并呈现空间不均匀的短程关联。引人注目的是，CDW 对失配层施加的单轴莫尔势表现出显著且各向异性的响应：其相干长度和有序波矢变得不等价，表明本征 CDW 不稳定性与破缺对称的莫尔场之间存在强非线性耦合。基于第一性原理的多尺度建模表明，这种重组源于层间电荷转移与失配界面引入的空间各向异性能量景观的共同作用。相比之下，超导性对莫尔相对不敏感，呈现出均匀的单一全能隙，与 s 波配对一致。

title: Direct Observation of Propagating Spin Waves in a Spin Hall Nano‐Oscillator
source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Constriction‐based spin Hall nano‐oscillators (SHNOs) show great promise for application as highly tunable microwave sources with straightforward scalability toward large coupled networks. However, details of the magnetization dynamics within SHNOs have thus far not been addressed experimentally, due to the minute time and length scales involved. In this work, we present direct imaging of the magnetization dynamics within a single CoFeB‐based SHNO using time‐resolved scanning transmission x‐ray microscopy (TR‐STXM). Our measurements reveal that the magnon amplitude is strongest at the two constriction edges, with a pronounced asymmetry favoring one edge, and that the emitted spin waves (SWs) exhibit strongly anisotropic propagation. Micromagnetic simulations suggest that grain boundaries and the Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya interaction (DMI) play a key role in both effects. Furthermore, the magnetodynamics changed during measurement, indicating that the CoFeB/MgO interface may be more susceptible to x‐ray‐induced modifications than previously recognized, challenging its presumed radiation hardness.
title_zh: 自旋霍尔纳米振荡器中传播自旋波的直接观测
abstract_zh:
摘要

基于收缩结构的自旋霍尔纳米振荡器（SHNO）作为高度可调谐的微波源具有巨大应用前景，并易于向大规模耦合网络扩展。然而，由于涉及的时间和长度尺度极小，SHNO 内部磁化动力学的细节迄今尚未在实验上得到研究。本工作中，我们利用时间分辨扫描透射 X 射线显微镜（TR-STXM）对单个基于 CoFeB 的 SHNO 内部的磁化动力学进行了直接成像。测量结果表明，磁振子幅度在收缩结构的两侧边缘最强，且呈现明显偏向一侧的不对称性；同时，发射的自旋波（SW）表现出强烈的各向异性传播。微磁学模拟表明，晶界和 Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya 相互作用（DMI）在这两种效应中都起关键作用。此外，磁化动力学在测量过程中发生了变化，表明 CoFeB/MgO 界面可能比以往认为的更易受 X 射线诱导的改性影响，这对其 presumed 的抗辐射硬度提出了挑战。

title_zh: 生长在GaAs(001)上的晶体FeCo薄膜中合金化调控的界面自旋轨道相互作用与磁阻尼
abstract_zh:
摘要

非中心对称铁磁体中本征自旋-轨道场的发现因其在基础研究和技术应用上的价值而引起了广泛关注。然而，这类材料一经合成，其自旋-轨道场强度便难以调控，因为它主要是体性质。本文中，我们证明了生长在 GaAs(001) 上的单晶 Fe1−xCox 薄膜中的界面自旋-轨道相互作用（SOI）可以通过合金化连续调控。利用自旋轨道铁磁共振，我们发现 Landé g 因子、Gilbert 阻尼 α 和界面自旋-轨道场对 Co 浓度表现出共同的非单调依赖关系。在 x ≈ 0.2 附近出现显著极小值，实现超低阻尼 α ≈ 0.0015。此外，我们观察到 α 与 (g − 2)2 之间的线性标度关系，表明界面 SOI 也可能对磁弛豫有贡献。这些结果表明，合金化是调控单晶铁磁体/半导体异质结构中界面 SOI 与阻尼的有效手段。

title: Evolving an Aptameric Nose for Synthetic Cannabinoids Through Modular Reprogramming of Specificity
source: Wiley: Angewandte Chemie International Edition: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Discerning subtle structural differences among highly similar small molecules remains a major challenge for synthetic receptors. Natural olfactory systems solve this problem using cross‐reactive receptor families that combine a conserved docking core with hypervariable specificity domains. Despite the modular nature of nucleic acid aptamers, the variable supporting domains have largely been viewed as inert scaffolds, whereas the conserved regions have been the main focus of functional studies. Here, we demonstrate that these supporting domains actively govern fine‐structural selectivity, thereby decoupling specificity from core binding affinity and enabling modular reprogramming of recognition. Guided by this insight, we emulated natural receptor evolution by screening a structure‐biased library with randomized peripheral domains, thus building a family of structurally homologous, cross‐reactive aptamers against synthetic cannabinoids. When assembled into a machine‐learning‐guided sensor array, termed an “aptameric nose”, this repertoire produces distinct yet correlative response patterns for closely related analogs. The array robustly discriminates these compounds and adaptively identifies emerging new variants. Through modular reprogramming, we engineer artificial receptor families that keep pace with continuously diversifying chemical threats, offering a powerful analytical tool for forensic, clinical, and environmental monitoring.
title_zh: 通过特异性模块化重编程进化出用于合成大麻素的适体鼻
abstract_zh:
摘要

辨识高度相似的小分子之间的细微结构差异仍是合成受体面临的重大挑战。天然嗅觉系统通过交叉反应性受体家族解决了这一问题，这些受体将保守的对接核心与高变异性特异结构域相结合。尽管核酸适配体具有模块化特性，其可变支撑结构域大多被视为惰性支架，而保守区一直是功能研究的主要焦点。本文中，我们证明这些支撑结构域能够主动调控精细结构选择性，从而将特异性与核心结合亲和力解耦，并实现对识别功能的模块化重编程。基于这一认识，我们通过筛选一个外围结构域随机化的结构偏好文库，模拟天然受体的进化过程，构建了一个针对合成大麻素的 structurally 同源、交叉反应性适配体家族。当组装成由机器学习引导的传感器阵列（称为“适配体鼻”）时，该库对密切相关的类似物产生既不同又相关的响应模式。该阵列能够稳健地区分这些化合物，并自适应地识别新出现的变体。通过模块化重编程，我们构建了能够跟上持续多样化化学威胁的人工受体家族，为法医、临床和环境监测提供了强大的分析工具。

source: Wiley: Angewandte Chemie International Edition: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    Overcoming the long‐standing trade‐off between efficiency and radiative rate in metal‐free phosphorescence remains a central challenge in molecular photophysics and is pivotal for the next‐generation optoelectronic technologies. Here, we demonstrate that tuning the strength of anion–π
                    +

                    5

                    −

                    +

title: Six-fold reduction in ocean heat content estimate uncertainty since 1960
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Ocean heat content (OHC) dominates Earth’s energy imbalance, but its uncertainty has not been fully understood. Here, we construct a Large-Ensemble to comprehensively quantify the OHC uncertainty from global to regional scales since 1955, and consider eight groups of error sources based on the community’s efforts. The global upper 2000 m OHC estimated uncertainty (defined as 5–95% quartile error range) has reduced six-fold since 1955 from ~111 ZJ (1955–1965) to ~19 ZJ (2014–2023), mainly due to reduced mapping/sampling uncertainty. This indicates a robust upper 2000 m OHC increase since 1955 of 449 [385, 519] ZJ. Quality-Control (QC) has become a primary error source recently, due to the difficulties detecting outliers in eddy-rich regions. Trend uncertainty sources differ from annual OHC: for 2005–2023, the upper 2000m trend is 10.9 [9.2, 11.4] ZJ yr−1 (0.68 [0.57, 0.71] Wm−2), with uncertainties from spatial gaps, mapping, QC, and climatology choice. The ocean warming rate increase from 2005–2023 is small but robust: 0.34 [0.19, 0.46] Wm−2 dec−1. These comprehensive uncertainty estimates guide future improvements in the global ocean observing system.
title_zh: 自1960年以来海洋热含量估计的不确定性降低至六分之一
abstract_zh: 海洋热含量（OHC）主导着地球能量不平衡，但其不确定性尚未得到充分理解。在此，我们构建了一个大样本集合（Large-Ensemble），以全面量化自 1955 年以来从全球到区域尺度的 OHC 不确定性，并基于学界的相关工作考虑了八组误差来源。全球 2000 m 以上 OHC 的估算不确定性（定义为 5–95% 分位数误差范围）自 1955 年以来降低了六倍，从约 111 ZJ（1955–1965 年）降至约 19 ZJ（2014–2023 年），这主要归因于填图/采样不确定性的降低。这表明自 1955 年以来 2000 m 以上 OHC 稳健地增加了 449 [385, 519] ZJ。近年来，质量控制（QC）已成为主要的误差来源，这是因为在涡旋丰富区域难以检测异常值。趋势不确定性的来源不同于逐年 OHC：对于 2005–2023 年，2000 m 以上的趋势为 10.9 [9.2, 11.4] ZJ yr^−1（0.68 [0.57, 0.71] W m^−2），其不确定性来自空间间隙、填图、QC 和气候态选择。2005–2023 年海洋变暖速率的增加虽小但稳健：0.34 [0.19, 0.46] W m^−2 dec^−1。这些全面的不确定性估计为全球海洋观测系统的未来改进提供了指导。

title: Widespread genomic islands are hotspots of genome variations and mosaicism in giant viruses
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Giant viruses in the phylum Nucleocytoviricota possess exceptionally large and mosaic genomes, yet the mechanisms underlying their remarkable plasticity remain poorly understood. Genomic islands are dynamic genomic regions that are major drivers of diversification and adaptation in bacteria. However, their contribution to giant virus evolution remains largely unexplored. Here, we characterize the genomic island landscape of giant viruses using 369 high-quality genomes spanning cultured isolates and long-read metagenome-assembled genomes. We identify 307 genomic islands across >50% of the genomes, demonstrating that these regions are pervasive across Nucleocytoviricota. These genomic islands are frequently associated with genomic hypervariability and enriched in genes involved in host interaction, particularly surface adhesion proteins, suggesting roles in host adaptation during the virus-host arms race. Comparative analyses further reveal these islands as hotspots of genome diversification, exhibiting frequent gain/loss and rearrangement even among highly similar genomes. Notably, many genomic islands are enriched in bacterial homologs, and several exhibit striking synteny with genomic regions recovered from co-occurring bacterial genomes, supporting large-scale genetic exchange between bacteria and giant viruses. Together, these findings identify genomic islands as pervasive and dynamic drivers of giant virus genome evolution, providing a framework for genome plasticity, mosaicism, and adaptive potential of giant viruses.
title_zh: 广泛存在的基因组岛是巨型病毒基因组变异与镶嵌性的热点
abstract_zh: 核质巨病毒门（Nucleocytoviricota）的巨型病毒拥有异常庞大且嵌合的基因组，然而其显著可塑性的潜在机制仍知之甚少。基因组岛是动态的基因组区域，是细菌多样化与适应的主要驱动力。然而，它们对巨型病毒演化的贡献在很大程度上尚未被探索。在此，我们利用涵盖培养分离株和长读长宏基因组组装基因组的 369 个高质量基因组，刻画了巨型病毒的基因组岛景观。我们在超过 50% 的基因组中鉴定出 307 个基因组岛，表明这些区域在核质巨病毒门中普遍存在。这些基因组岛经常与基因组超变异性相关联，并富集于参与宿主相互作用的基因，尤其是表面黏附蛋白，暗示其在病毒-宿主军备竞赛中的宿主适应作用。比较分析进一步揭示这些岛屿是基因组多样化的热点，即使在高度相似的基因组之间也表现出频繁的获得/丢失和重排。值得注意的是，许多基因组岛富集细菌同源基因，且其中若干与共现细菌基因组中回收的基因组区域表现出显著的同线性，支持细菌与巨型病毒之间存在大规模遗传交换。总之，这些发现确定了基因组岛是巨型病毒基因组演化的普遍且动态的驱动力，为巨型病毒的基因组可塑性、嵌合性及适应潜力提供了框架。

title: Dynamic Electron Redistribution on Rooted-Type High-Entropy Perovskite-Supported Ir Catalysts for Durable Proton-Exchange-Membrane Water Electrolysis
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Addressing the inherent trade-off between low iridium loading and operational durability is of paramount importance for advancing proton-exchange-membrane water electrolysis (PEMWE) technology toward green hydrogen production, yet it remains a formidable challenge. Here, we develop a multilevel stabilization strategy to dynamically stabilize Ir under industrial current densities. This approach combines strong physical anchoring, achieved by constructing a rooted-type embedded architecture on a high-entropy perovskite support (Ir/HESIO), with dynamic electronic state regulation of the active supported layer via in situ electron redistribution. In situ spectroscopic characterization and theoretical simulations jointly verify that the synergy between structural confinement and in situ electronic regulation effectively suppresses the migration, overoxidation, and subsequent dissolution of Ir active species. Owing to these attributes, the developed Ir/HESIO exhibits a low cell voltage of 1.71 and 1.80 V to achieve industrial current densities of 2 and 3 A cm–2, meeting the DOE 2026 target (1.80 V @ 3A cm–2) and outperforming most reported catalysts. Moreover, it demonstrates outstanding operational stability, maintaining stable operation over 3800 h at 2 A cm–2 with just 2.2% potential decay and over 3200 h at 3 A cm–2 with just 4.7% potential decay. This work not only presents a highly promising electrocatalyst for water electrolysis but also establishes a dynamic electronic structure regulation strategy that is broadly applicable for stabilizing other heterogeneous catalysts.
title_zh: 基于植根型高熵钙钛矿负载Ir催化剂的动态电子再分布用于耐久性质子交换膜电解水
abstract_zh: 摘要 解决低铱载量与运行耐久性之间的固有权衡，对于推动质子交换膜水电解（PEMWE）技术迈向绿氢生产至关重要，然而这仍然是一项艰巨的挑战。在此，我们开发了一种多级稳定化策略，以在工业电流密度下动态稳定 Ir。该策略结合了通过在高熵钙钛矿载体（Ir/HESIO）上构建扎根型嵌入结构所实现的强物理锚定，以及通过原位电子再分配对活性负载层进行的动态电子态调控。原位光谱表征和理论模拟共同验证了结构限域与原位电子调控之间的协同作用有效抑制了 Ir 活性物种的迁移、过度氧化及随后的溶解。得益于这些特性，所开发的 Ir/HESIO 在实现 2 和 3 A cm^−2 的工业电流密度时表现出 1.71 和 1.80 V 的低槽压，达到美国能源部（DOE）2026 年目标（1.80 V @ 3 A cm^−2），并优于大多数已报道的催化剂。此外，它还展现出卓越的运行稳定性，在 2 A cm^−2 下稳定运行超过 3800 h，电位衰减仅 2.2%；在 3 A cm^−2 下稳定运行超过 3200 h，电位衰减仅 4.7%。这项工作不仅提供了一种极具前景的电解水催化剂，还建立了一种广泛适用于稳定其他非均相催……

title: Efficient CO-to-Acetate Conversion Electrocatalyst Screened by Pressurization-Compatible Operando Raman Spectroscopy
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract The conversion of CO to acetate represents a selective and efficient pathway among CO2/CO-to-C2+ electroreduction routes, with recent advancements being partly attributed to pressurized electrolyzer designs. Pressurization establishes bulk CO enrichment that enhances mass transport, yet methodologies for designing catalyst surfaces to efficiently accommodate and electroreduce dense *CO intermediates remain underdeveloped. We systematically investigate *CO adsorption coverage and affinity across copper surfaces with varying structural features, correlating these properties with CO-to-acetate performance. Notably, operando Raman spectroscopy conducted in a custom flow reactor replicating pressurized environments reveals pressure-dependent *CO adsorption and conversion dynamics on distinct Cu surfaces. We discover that Cu twin boundaries optimally support both pressurization-enhanced CO adsorption and subsequent conversion steps, achieving Faradaic efficiencies of 91% for total C2+ products and 82% for acetate at 10 atm CO pressure, surpassing all reported monometallic Cu catalysts. We contributed a practical tool for the operando characterization of pressurized gas-fed electrocatalytic processes.
title_zh: 通过加压兼容的工况拉曼光谱筛选高效CO转化为乙酸盐的电催化剂
abstract_zh: 摘要 将 CO 转化为乙酸酯是 CO2/CO 到 C2+ 电还原路线中一条选择性且高效的途径，近期的进展部分归功于加压电解槽设计。加压建立了体相 CO 富集以增强传质，然而设计催化剂表面以高效容纳并电还原高密度 *CO 中间体的方法仍然不成熟。我们系统研究了具有不同结构特征的铜表面的 *CO 吸附覆盖度和亲和力，并将这些性质与 CO 到乙酸酯的性能相关联。值得注意的是，在复现加压环境的定制流通式反应器中进行的工况拉曼光谱揭示了不同 Cu 表面上依赖压力的 *CO 吸附与转化动力学。我们发现 Cu 孪晶界能够最优地同时支持加压增强的 CO 吸附及随后的转化步骤，在 10 atm CO 压力下，总 C2+ 产物的法拉第效率达到 91%，乙酸酯达到 82%，超越了所有已报道的单金属 Cu 催化剂。我们为加压气相进料电催化过程的工况表征贡献了一种实用工具。

title: Interfacial Hydrogen-Bond Chain Engineering via Surface-Immobilized Ammonium Cations for Accelerated Alkaline Hydrogen Evolution
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Engineering the electrode–electrolyte interface has emerged as a critical strategy to overcome sluggish kinetics of alkaline hydrogen evolution reaction (HER). However, the dynamic and complex nature of the double electric layer makes mechanistic understanding at the molecular level and rational interfacial regulation highly challenging. Herein, we demonstrate that molecular modification of Ni-doped MoS2 catalyst with a zwitterionic molecule (z-Ni-MoS2) markedly enhances alkaline HER kinetics. In-situ Raman spectroscopy combined with ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) simulations reveals that the quaternary ammonium cation reconstructs interfacial water into linear hydrogen-bond chains via electrostatic repulsion of potassium ions from the z-Ni-MoS2 surface. This distinctive interfacial microenvironment enables water molecules within hydrogen-bond chains to directly relay protons to sulfur sites via a Grotthuss-associated mechanism. In contrast to the conventional diffusion-dominated, non-Grotthuss-associated mechanism, this mechanism lowers the water-dissociation barrier and promotes interfacial proton transport, thereby accelerating alkaline HER kinetics. To evaluate device-level applicability, z-Ni-MoS2 was incorporated into an anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer (AEM-WE). The system delivers outstanding performance of 5.21 A cm–2 at 1.8 V and 9.57 A cm–2 at 2 V, 80 °C, surpassing the United States Department of Energy (DOE) 2026 target (3 A cm–2 at 1.8 V). This work provides molecular-level insight for interfacial water restructuring as a design principle for high-performance alkaline HER catalysts.
title_zh: 通过表面固定化铵阳离子实现界面氢键链工程以加速碱性析氢
abstract_zh: 摘要 工程化电极–电解质界面已成为克服碱性析氢反应（HER）动力学缓慢的关键策略。然而，双电层的动态和复杂特性使得分子层面的机理认识和合理的界面调控极具挑战性。本文中，我们证明用两性离子分子对Ni掺杂MoS2催化剂进行分子修饰（z-Ni-MoS2）可显著增强碱性HER动力学。原位拉曼光谱结合从头算分子动力学（AIMD）模拟表明，季铵阳离子通过将钾离子从z-Ni-MoS2表面静电排斥，将界面水重构为线性氢键链。这种独特的界面微环境使氢键链内的水分子能够通过Grotthuss关联机制将质子直接传递至硫位点。与传统的扩散主导、非Grotthuss关联机制不同，该机制降低了水解离势垒并促进界面质子传输，从而加速碱性HER动力学。为评估器件级应用性，将z-Ni-MoS2集成到阴离子交换膜水电解槽（AEM-WE）中。该系统在80 °C、1.8 V下输出5.21 A cm–2，2 V下输出9.57 A cm–2的优异性能，超过美国能源部（DOE）2026年目标（1.8 V下3 A cm–2）。这项工作为界面水重构作为设计原…提供了分子层面的洞察

title: Ammonia Diverts Ozonolysis from C═C Scission to Nitrogen Incorporation via Competitive Adsorption and Nucleophilic Trapping
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract The reaction of ozone with unsaturated organic compounds is a fundamental process in chemistry, central to both synthetic transformations and environmental molecular cycling. Here, we reveal a mechanistic branching in the Criegee ozonolysis of squalene, a model poly unsaturated triterpene, induced by gaseous ammonia, a ubiquitous nucleophile. Our experimental findings reveal that NH3 suppresses the ozone uptake by a factor of ∼3, an inhibition traced to competitive adsorption. DFT calculations and kinetic modeling indicate that NH3·H2O complexes outcompete O3 for reactive C═C sites, suggesting a site-blocking suppression mechanism. Real-time ultrahigh-resolution mass spectrometry identifies nearly 40 unique nitrogen-containing organic compounds (NOCs) formed exclusively in the presence of NH3. Gibbs free energy profiles support a thermodynamically feasible mechanism wherein NH3 acts as a nucleophile, intercepting reactive carbonyl oxide intermediates (Criegee intermediates) and downstream carbonyl species. This work elucidates a direct pathway for nitrogen incorporation into unsaturated lipid oxidation matrices, demonstrating how a simple nucleophile can fundamentally rewire a classic organic reaction mechanism simultaneously controlling and steering product distribution toward complex, heteroatom-enriched architectures. These findings provide molecular-scale understanding of nucleophile participation in multiphase ozonolysis, with implications for synthetic and complex organic chemistry.
title_zh: 氨通过竞争性吸附和亲核捕获使臭氧化反应从C═C断裂转向氮掺入
abstract_zh: 摘要 臭氧与不饱和有机化合物的反应是化学中的一个基础过程，对合成转化和环境分子循环均至关重要。在此，我们揭示了由普遍存在的亲核试剂——气态氨诱导的角鲨烯（一种模型多不饱和三萜）Criegee臭氧化反应中的机理分支。我们的实验结果表明，NH3将臭氧摄取抑制约3倍，这一抑制作用源于竞争性吸附。DFT计算和动力学建模表明，NH3·H2O复合物在与O3竞争反应性C═C位点时占优，提示一种位点阻断抑制机制。实时超高分辨率质谱鉴定出仅在NH3存在下形成的近40种独特的含氮有机化合物（NOCs）。吉布斯自由能谱支持一种热力学可行的机理，其中NH3作为亲核试剂，拦截反应性羰基氧化物中间体（Criegee中间体）及下游羰基物种。这项工作阐明了氮掺入不饱和脂质氧化基质的直接途径，展示了简单亲核试剂如何从根本上重塑经典有机反应机理，同时控制并将产物分布引导至复杂的富杂原子结构。这些发现为多相臭氧化中亲核试剂参与的分子尺度理解提供了依据，对合成及复杂有机化学具有重要意义。

title: Low-Temperature Thermal Depolymerization of Polymethacrylates
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract The chemical recycling of poly(methyl methacrylate) (PMMA) typically requires energy-intensive pyrolysis (>450 °C) or specialized photochemical setups restricted by light penetration depth. Herein, we report a purely thermal, low-temperature strategy that drives the efficient depolymerization of native, unaltered PMMA at 170 °C using commercially accessible peroxides. By maintaining a low steady-state radical concentration, oligomer formation can be fully eliminated, resulting in >95% of regenerated monomer under judiciously optimized conditions. Mechanistic studies and vapor-trapping experiments implicate a dual-activation pathway, where alkoxy radicals work alongside highly reactive chlorine radicals that undergo efficient hydrogen atom transfer with the polymer backbone, resulting in chain scission and subsequent depropagation to monomer. The full omission of chlorinated solvents could also be achieved, albeit at slightly higher temperatures. Notably, the real-world utility of this system is demonstrated by the direct depolymerization of commercial Plexiglas, despite the presence of comonomers, pigments, and additives.
title_zh: 聚甲基丙烯酸酯的低温热解聚
abstract_zh: 摘要 聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯（PMMA）的化学回收通常需要高能耗的热解（>450 °C）或受光穿透深度限制的专用光化学装置。本文中，我们报道了一种纯热、低温策略，使用商业易得的过氧化物在170 °C下驱动天然未改性PMMA的高效解聚。通过维持低稳态自由基浓度，可完全消除低聚物的生成，在精心优化的条件下再生单体收率超过95%。机理研究和蒸气捕获实验表明存在双活化路径，其中烷氧自由基与高活性氯自由基协同作用，后者与聚合物主链发生高效的氢原子转移，导致链断裂并随后解聚为单体。也可以完全不使用氯化溶剂，但温度略高。值得注意的是，通过直接解聚商用Plexiglas（尽管其中存在共聚单体、颜料和添加剂）验证了该体系的实际应用价值。

title: An Inhalable Hybrid Nitric Oxide Nanogenerator for Lung Adenocarcinoma Treatment via Bioorthogonal-Activated Gas-Immunotherapy
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Nitric oxide (NO) holds promise for circumventing resistance to platinum-based chemotherapy by reprogramming the tumor microenvironment (TME) in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD). However, their further application is greatly hindered by uncontrolled release kinetics and off-target toxicity. Herein, an inhalable NO nanogenerator (10m@FOMs-Cu) that reprograms the TME via specific NO release is developed by encapsulating a biorthogonal-activated NO-cisplatin prodrug into TME-responsive hybrid micelles, allowing for sustained and effective LUAD treatment. The prodrug integrates a Pt-based catalyst with a caged active NO donor within one molecule and is further encapsulated in a disulfide-cross-linked organosilica shell, enabling redox-triggered self-catalytic NO release while minimizing off-target injury to normal tissues. It is verified that nebulized 10m@FOMs-Cu could achieve efficient mucus-extracellular matrix dual barrier penetration to reach the TME, thereby ensuring sustained NO release to potentiate Pt(II)-mediated nuclear damage and Cu(II)/Cu(I)-mediated cuproptosis. This sensitization process reprograms the TME by inducing metabolism-DNA stress feedback, triggering a systemic and durable immune response that confers efficient tumor suppression in orthotopic and rechallenged LUAD. It demonstrates that 10m@FOMs-Cu could serve as a potent and safe nebulized nanomedicine for LUAD therapy and provides insights into designing gas-based nanotherapeutics.
title_zh: 一种可吸入的混合型一氧化氮纳米发生器通过生物正交激活的气体-免疫疗法治疗肺腺癌
abstract_zh: 摘要 一氧化氮（NO）通过重编程肺腺癌（LUAD）肿瘤微环境（TME），有望克服铂类化疗的耐药性。然而，其不可控的释放动力学和脱靶毒性极大阻碍了进一步应用。本文通过将生物正交激活的NO-顺铂前药封装于TME响应型混合胶束中，开发了一种可吸入NO纳米发生器（10m@FOMs-Cu），通过特异性NO释放重编程TME，实现持续有效的LUAD治疗。该前药将Pt基催化剂与笼状活性NO供体整合于一个分子中，并进一步封装在二硫键交联的有机硅壳中，实现氧化还原触发自催化NO释放，同时最大限度地减少对正常组织的脱靶损伤。经验证，雾化10m@FOMs-Cu可实现黏液-细胞外基质双重屏障的高效穿透以到达TME，从而确保持续的NO释放，增强Pt(II)介导的核损伤和Cu(II)/Cu(I)介导的铜死亡。该敏化过程通过诱导代谢-DNA应激反馈重编程TME，触发全身且持久的免疫应答，在原位和再攻击LUAD中实现有效肿瘤抑制。这表明10m@FOMs-Cu可作为强效且安全的雾化纳米药物用于LUAD治疗，并为气体纳米治疗剂的设计提供了见解。

title: Buried-Interface Kinetic Regulation of Crystallization Enables Efficient Near-Infrared Tin Perovskite LEDs
abstract: Abstract Near-infrared tin perovskite light-emitting diodes (PeLEDs) constitute a class of lead-free optoelectronic devices, but their performance suffers from rapid crystallization over a defective hole transport layer underneath the perovskite film. Here, we report a buried-interface kinetic regulation strategy for Cs-rich tin iodide perovskites. The buried interlayer regulated the initial growth of the perovskite film. This regulation delayed the emergence of emissive domains and promoted compact film growth without substantially perturbing the Sn-I framework. Spectroscopic and theoretical analyses reveal interfacial interactions with Sn-related sites, which help suppress defect formation and nonradiative losses. The optimized PeLEDs exhibited near-infrared electroluminescence centered at 945 nm and achieved a peak external quantum efficiency of 8.04%. This work highlights buried-interface kinetic regulation as an effective route toward efficient lead-free near-infrared tin perovskite LEDs.
title_zh: 埋藏界面结晶动力学调控实现高效近红外锡钙钛矿LED
abstract_zh: 摘要 近红外锡钙钛矿发光二极管是一类无铅光电器件，但其性能受限于钙钛矿薄膜下方缺陷空穴传输层上的快速结晶。在此，我们报道了一种针对富Cs碘化锡钙钛矿的埋底界面动力学调控策略。埋底中间层调控了钙钛矿薄膜的初始生长。该调控延迟了发光畴的出现，并在不显著扰动Sn-I骨架的情况下促进致密薄膜的生长。光谱和理论分析揭示了与Sn相关位点的界面相互作用，有助于抑制缺陷形成和非辐射损失。优化的PeLED表现出以945 nm为中心的近红外电致发光，峰值外量子效率达到8.04%。这项工作凸显了埋底界面动力学调控作为实现高效无铅近红外锡钙钛矿LED的有效途径。

title: Sustained algal-bacterial interactions promote accumulation of recalcitrant particulate carbon with accelerated radiocarbon aging signatures
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Algal-bacterial interactions regulate the production and fate of marine particulate organic carbon (POC), yet their capacity to generate long-lived carbon sinks remains unclear. Using a two-year, nutrient-self-sustaining co-culture of Synechococcus and its mutualistic microbiota, we demonstrate that sustained algal-bacterial interactions promote the progressive accumulation of recalcitrant POC. Continuous release of algal-derived organic substrates, coupled with repeated microbial enzymatic reworking, produced inert organic particles, with ~26% resisting remineralization and forming a stable recalcitrant particulate carbon pool. Radiocarbon (Δ14C) analyses revealed an apparent age offset exceeding 400 years for POC formed within only two-year experiment. This “aged” signature likely results from algal assimilation of fossil-fuel-14C-depleted atmospheric CO2 followed by accumulation in generated recalcitrant POC. By demonstrating that apparent radiocarbon age can become decoupled from actual residence time, these results provide insights into the interpretation of “old” marine POC and highlight the important roles of algal-bacterial interactions in ocean particulate carbon sequestration.
title_zh: 持续的藻菌相互作用促进难降解颗粒碳的积累并伴随加速的放射性碳老化特征
abstract_zh: 藻菌相互作用调控海洋颗粒有机碳（POC）的产生与归宿，但其生成长效碳汇的能力仍不明确。利用聚胞藻及其共生微生物群落的两年营养自维持共培养体系，我们证明持续的藻菌相互作用促进难降解POC的渐进累积。藻源有机底物的持续释放，加之微生物酶的反复改造，生成了惰性有机颗粒，其中约26%抵抗再矿化并形成稳定的难降解颗粒碳库。放射性碳（Δ14C）分析显示，仅在两年的实验中形成的POC表现出超过400年的表观年龄偏移。这种“老化”特征很可能源于藻类同化化石燃料导致的14C亏损大气CO2，随后累积于生成的难降解POC中。通过证明表观放射性碳年龄可与实际滞留时间解耦，这些结果为解读“古老”海洋POC提供了见解，并凸显了藻菌相互作用在海洋颗粒碳封存中的重要作用。

title: The Biosynthesis of a Fungal Flavonoid, Chlorflavonin, Precisely Controlled by Two Types of Equilibrium States
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Flavonoids are polyphenolic natural products predominantly isolated from plants and exhibit a diverse array of biological activities. Because they serve as important pharmaceuticals and nutraceuticals, there is a strong demand for their sustainable supply. Chlorflavonin is a rare fungal flavonoid with potent antitubercular activity. While its biosynthetic enzymes are expected to be valuable tools for application in fungal production of flavonoids, the biosynthetic pathway remains unknown. Here, we elucidate the complete biosynthetic pathway for chlorflavonin through detailed functional analysis of each biosynthetic enzyme. Previously, stepwise and straightforward introduction of 3-, 7-, and 8-methoxy; 2′-hydroxy; and 3′-chloro functionalities have been proposed. In contrast to this proposal, we uncovered an intricate biosynthetic route involving a dynamic interconversion between the 6- and 8-methoxy forms of flavonoid skeletons mediated by the chalcone isomerase CfvF and the flavin-dependent oxygenase CfvI. CfvF interconverted the 6- and 8-methoxyflavanones, likely via a chalcone intermediate. CfvI oxidized the chemically inert 2,3-double bond of flavanone, giving the hemiacetal product. Although these enzymes generate products existing in equilibrium states, respective downstream enzymes catalyze selective conversion of one specific species, facilitating smooth progression to the final product. We also solved the crystal structure of CfvK, the dehydratase that selectively converts the 8-methoxy form of the CfvI product. Through analyzing the structure complexed with its substrate and product and site-directed mutagenesis, key residues determining the substrate selectivity were identified. Our comprehensive analysis established a rational framework for preparing 46 flavonoids, including unnatural ones, setting the stage for fungal production of structurally diverse flavonoids.
title_zh: 由两类平衡态精确控制的真菌黄酮类化合物Chlorflavonin的生物合成

title: Topographic decoupling of tree-mortality disturbances drives contrasting soil carbon fates via divergent microbial strategies
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Climate change is exacerbating tree mortality worldwide, threatening the stability of forest soil organic carbon (SOC) stocks. However, how SOC responds to tree mortality amid co-occurring disturbances remains mechanistically unresolved. Here, we demonstrate that topography spatially decouples the canopy-opening and detrital-legacy effects of tree mortality and transforms these co-occurring disturbances into distinct selective pressures on soil microbial communities, thereby driving SOC toward contrasting fates through divergent microbial strategies for carbon and energy acquisition. On ridges, canopy-opening effects co-select for exo-enzyme and aerobic-respiration traits, alongside SOC loss associated with reduced heavy-fraction organic carbon. In valleys, detrital-legacy effects promote light-fraction-associated SOC gain while co-enriching endo-enzyme and anaerobic-respiration traits, potentially strengthening SOC retention. By integrating amplicon sequencing with genome-informed functional traits, our study provides genomic evidence for the microbial mechanisms underlying divergent SOC responses to tree mortality and highlights the potential of genome-based microbial traits for predicting ecosystem-scale biogeochemical processes.
title_zh: 树木死亡扰动的地形解耦通过 divergent 微生物策略驱动截然不同的土壤碳命运
abstract_zh: 气候变化正在加剧全球范围内的树木死亡，威胁森林土壤有机碳（SOC）储量的稳定性。然而，在多种干扰共现的情况下，SOC 如何响应树木死亡在机制上仍不清楚。在此，我们证明地形在空间上使树木死亡的冠层开敞效应与碎屑遗留效应解耦，并将这些共现干扰转化为对土壤微生物群落的截然不同的选择压力，从而通过不同的碳和能量获取微生物策略驱动 SOC 走向相反的命运。在山脊上，冠层开敞效应共选择胞外酶和有氧呼吸性状，同时伴随着与重组分有机碳减少相关的 SOC 损失。在山谷中，碎屑遗留效应促进与轻组分相关的 SOC 增加并共富集胞内酶和厌氧呼吸性状，从而可能增强 SOC 的保留。通过将扩增子测序与基于基因组的功能性状相结合，我们的研究为树木死亡引起 SOC 分歧响应的微生物机制提供了基因组学证据，并突显了基于基因组的微生物性状在预测生态系统尺度生物地球化学过程中的潜力。

title: Hydrophobicity strategy drives contact-electro-catalysis on natural silicate minerals
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Contact-electro-catalysis (CEC) at catalyst-water interfaces shows promise for wastewater purification, metal recovery, and H2O2 production, but catalyst design has mainly emphasized electron-withdrawing ability while overlooking interfacial water transfer. Here, we develop a hydrophobicity engineering strategy for natural silicate minerals to optimize catalyst-water contact by balancing the water approach and removal. As a representative non-fluorinated system, alkyl-modified minerals with moderate hydrophobicity (water contact angle of 125–148°) achieve a H2O2 yield of 350.0 μmol·L–1·h–1 under ultrasonication, outperforming fluorinated minerals. Mechanistic analysis indicates that this enhancement arises from improved interfacial contact efficiency rather than stronger electron-withdrawing ability alone. This strategy also remains effective under weak-force conditions, enabling self-powered CEC in a natural river. The modified minerals selectively enriched microorganisms associated with oxidative stress resistance and oxidized organic carbon utilization, including Novosphingobium sp. Together, these findings identify hydrophobicity regulation as an effective contact-optimization strategy for CEC.
title_zh: 疏水策略驱动天然硅酸盐矿物上的接触电催化
abstract_zh: 催化剂-水界面的接触电催化（CEC）在废水净化、金属回收和 H2O2 生产方面显示出前景，但催化剂设计主要强调吸电子能力，而忽视了界面水的传递。在此，我们开发了一种针对天然硅酸盐矿物的疏水性工程策略，通过平衡水的接近与去除来优化催化剂与水的接触。作为代表性的非氟化体系，具有适度疏水性（水接触角为 125–148°）的烷基修饰矿物在超声条件下实现了 350.0 μmol·L–1·h–1 的 H2O2 产量，优于氟化矿物。机理分析表明，这种增强源于界面接触效率的改善，而不仅仅是更强的吸电子能力。该策略在弱力条件下仍然有效，可在天然河流中实现自供电 CEC。修饰后的矿物选择性地富集了与氧化应激抗性和氧化态有机碳利用相关的微生物，包括 Novosphingobium sp.。总之，这些发现表明疏水性调节是一种有效的 CEC 接触优化策略。

title: Integrative analysis of the embryonic origin of adult neural stem cells in forebrain subventricular zones
abstract: In the mammalian brain, adult neural stem cells (NSCs) located in ventricular-subventricular zone (V-SVZ) of lateral ventricles and dentate gyrus continuously generate new neurons and glia throughout life. The adult NSCs in V-SVZ are derived from ventricular radial glial cells (RGCs) which become quiescent during embryonic development. However, the origin and establishment of this adult NSC pool remain elusive, primarily due to the challenge of tracing the lineage from embryonic RGCs to their quiescent adult successors. Here, by leveraging Vcam1—a marker continuously expressed from embryonic RGCs to adult NSCs—we unravel the dynamic process and regulatory mechanism underlying the fate bifurcation that gives rise to quiescent seed cells. We demonstrate that Vcam1+ embryonic RGCs directly contribute to the adult NSC pool. A subpopulation of quiescent Vcam1+ RGCs emerges early and is maintained throughout development, while a parallel population of proliferative Vcam1+ progenitors actively replenishes this quiescent reservoir. Through the combinatory analysis of single-cell multi-omics and clonal lineage tracing of Vcam1+ cells, we identified the TGF-β/Smad3 pathway as a critical regulator of quiescence. Our work thus provides a mechanistic dissection of how the foundational adult NSC pool is established through precisely regulated fate decisions during embryogenesis, offering new insights into the principles of lifelong neurogenesis.
title_zh: 前脑室管膜下区成体神经干细胞胚胎起源的整合分析
abstract_zh: 在哺乳动物大脑中，位于侧脑室脑室-室管膜下区（V-SVZ）和齿状回的成体神经干细胞（NSC）在一生中持续产生新的神经元和胶质细胞。V-SVZ 中的成体 NSC 源自脑室放射状胶质细胞（RGC），后者在胚胎发育过程中进入静息状态。然而，这一成体 NSC 库的起源与建立仍不清楚，主要原因是难以追踪从胚胎 RGC 到其静息成体后代的谱系。在此，我们利用 Vcam1——一种从胚胎 RGC 到成体 NSC 持续表达的标记物——揭示了产生静息种子细胞的命运分歧的动态过程和调控机制。我们证明 Vcam1+ 胚胎 RGC 直接贡献于成体 NSC 库。一部分静息的 Vcam1+ RGC 早期出现并在整个发育过程中得以维持，而一群平行的增殖性 Vcam1+ 祖细胞则主动补充这一静息储备库。通过对 Vcam1+ 细胞的单细胞多组学和克隆谱系追踪的综合分析，我们鉴定出 TGF-β/Smad3 通路是静息状态的关键调控因子。因此，我们的工作从机制上剖析了成体 NSC 基础库如何通过胚胎发育过程中精确调控的命运决定而建立，为终生神经发生的原理提供了新见解。

title: The rise of renewable energy: How it shapes dependency, diversity, and geopolitical risk in the European Union
abstract: As the European Union advances its shift toward cleaner energy to address climate challenges, a pressing question emerges: can this shift also strengthen energy security in an increasingly volatile global landscape? This study investigates the impact of renewable energy on energy security risks across 27 EU countries over the period 2010 to 2022. It measures energy security through three key dimensions—energy dependency risk, energy diversity risk, and geopolitical risk. The findings reveal that renewable energy significantly mitigates energy diversity risk and geopolitical risk across the EU. However, its impact on energy dependency risk is statistically insignificant in the overall sample. Notably, further non-linear analyses show that in countries with higher levels of renewable energy deployment, renewables significantly reduce dependency risk on foreign energy sources. This highlights the importance of reaching a critical threshold of renewable integration to unlock broader energy security benefits.
title_zh: 可再生能源的兴起：它如何塑造欧盟的依赖性、多样性与地缘政治风险
abstract_zh: 随着欧盟推进向清洁能源转型以应对气候挑战，一个紧迫的问题浮现：在这一日益动荡的全球格局中，这一转型是否也能增强能源安全？本研究考察了2010年至2022年间可再生能源对27个欧盟能源安全风险的影响，并通过三个关键维度——能源依赖风险、能源多样性风险和地缘政治风险——来衡量能源安全。研究结果表明，可再生能源显著降低了整个欧盟的能源多样性风险和地缘政治风险。然而，其对能源依赖风险的影响在总样本中不具有统计显著性。值得注意的是，进一步的非线性分析表明，在可再生能源部署水平较高的国家，可再生能源显著降低了对国外能源的依赖风险。这凸显了达到可再生能源整合临界阈值以释放更广泛能源安全效益的重要性。

title: Modelling nonlinear heat pump part-load efficiency for optimal investment planning
abstract: Heat pumps are a key technology for decarbonising the heating sector and achieving net-zero targets. In practice, however, their performance characteristics are inherently nonlinear, depending on factors such as minimum load constraints and part-load efficiency, particularly for inverter-driven systems. While advanced optimisation methods exist for operational scheduling (e.g., in model predictive control), investment planning models typically neglect part-load behaviour due to the computational challenges associated with solving nonlinear mixed-integer problems. Instead, simplified linear approximations are commonly employed. This work addresses this gap by presenting an integrated optimisation framework for heat pump investment planning that explicitly accounts for nonlinear part-load efficiency. The framework targets heat supply facilities at the building or building-complex level, modelled as a single-node energy hub that may comprise multiple heat pumps and additional generation technologies. To manage the resulting computational complexity, we develop both a relaxed piecewise-linear formulation and a novel second-order cone relaxation. The proposed approaches are evaluated using a real-world case study. Incorporating part-load efficiency into investment planning leads to structurally different capacity decisions compared to conventional formulations that neglect such effects. The resulting system design reduces electricity consumption by 4.5% and annual costs by 2.9%, confirmed in an ex-post validation on the full, unaggregated time horizon. Furthermore, computational performance analysis shows a 10.3-fold speed-up for the piecewise-linear relaxation and a 4.3-fold speed-up for the conic relaxation, measured in deterministic work units, paving the way for their application to larger energy hub and multi-technology investment problems. Overall, the proposed methods facilitate more accurate and computationally tractable investment decisions, thereby supporting informed decision-making in the transition towards clean and affordable heat.

title: Multiparametric optimization based decision making approach in energy systems planning under uncertainty
abstract: Energy infrastructure planning confronts a fundamental temporal asymmetry in which capacity decisions must be committed before uncertainty materializes and yet must remain robust across all future operational scenarios. Traditional approaches either adopt worst-case hedging or ignore operational uncertainty. We address this through a Robust Optimization framework integrating data-driven uncertainty quantification with multiparametric programming, enabling design strategies as explicit functions of realized uncertainty without iterative re-optimization. We quantify forecasting errors via probabilistic deep learning technique to inform uncertainty bounds. Rather than worst-case designs, we model it as bilevel problem solved multiparametrically, deriving "wait-and-see" operations as piecewise affine functions of "here-and-now" decisions and uncertainty realizations.Applied to a multi-source, multi-sink energy system (wind, nuclear, natural gas, battery, electricity and hydrogen demands) under joint supply-demand uncertainty, the framework reveals a strategic shift in technology prioritization as uncertainty quantiles increase, optimal designs preferentially allocate capacity to expensive-but-reliable dispatchables even though economical renewables remain available. The complete parametric solution enables upfront cost-robustness trade-off exploration, providing a tractable and generalizable tool for risk-aware capacity expansion, supporting strategic investment decisions in uncertain and rapidly evolving energy landscape.
title_zh: 不确定条件下能源系统规划中基于多参数优化的决策方法
abstract_zh: 能源基础设施规划面临一个根本性的时间不对称问题：容量决策必须在不确定性显现之前做出承诺，但又必须在所有未来运行场景中保持稳健。传统方法要么采用最坏情形对冲，要么忽略运行不确定性。我们通过一个鲁棒优化框架来解决这一问题，该框架将数据驱动的不确定性量化与多参数规划相集成，使设计策略成为已实现不确定性的显式函数，而无需迭代重新优化。我们通过概率深度学习技术量化预测误差，以为不确定性边界提供信息。我们不采用最坏情形设计，而是将其建模为通过多参数方法求解的双层问题，将“等待观望”运行导出为“此时此地”决策和不确定性实现的分段仿射函数。应用于一个多源多汇能源系统（风能、核能、天然气、电池、电力和氢能需求）在供需联合不确定性下的情况，该框架揭示了随着不确定性分位数的增加，技术优先级发生战略性转变：即使仍可获得经济的可再生能源，最优设计仍优先将容量分配给昂贵但可靠的可调度电源。完整的参数化解支持预先的成本-稳健性权衡探索，为风险感知的容量扩展提供了一个可行且可推广的工具，以支持在不确定且快速演变的能源格局中的战略投资决策。

title: Pulse-based state-of-charge and state-of-health estimation of randomly retired lithium-ion batteries for second-life applications
abstract: Retired lithium-ion batteries are an important resource for second-life energy storage, but their practical reuse requires rapid and efficient state assessment under unknown usage histories. To address this problem, we develop a pulse-based framework for joint state-of-health (SOH) and state-of-charge (SOC) estimation of randomly retired lithium-ion battery cells. A set of voltage-response features is extracted from short bipolar pulse tests and used as diagnostic descriptors. Based on these features, two machine learning models, extremely randomized trees (ExtraTrees) and a tabular prior-data fitted network (TabPFN), are employed for battery state estimation and evaluated using data from 270 retired cells that cover three chemistry types and four capacity classes. The results show that TabPFN clearly outperforms ExtraTrees and achieves mean absolute errors ranging from 0.0076 to 0.0306 for SOH estimation and below 0.01 for SOC estimation across all cell groups. To reduce the testing burden, a subset of SOC-dependent pulse tests is removed, and the missing feature points are reconstructed using interpolation methods. The reduced-test results show that near-baseline estimation accuracy can be retained even after removing 40%–70% of SOC-dependent pulse tests, depending on the target state and accuracy requirements. These results demonstrate a practical route toward faster, lower-cost, and scalable state assessment for second-life battery applications.
title_zh: 面向梯次利用的随机退役锂离子电池基于脉冲的荷电状态与健康状态估计
abstract_zh: 退役锂离子电池是二次寿命储能的重要资源，但其实际再利用需要在未知使用历史条件下进行快速高效的状态评估。为解决这一问题，我们开发了一种基于脉冲的框架，用于对随机退役的锂离子电池单体进行健康状态（SOH）和荷电状态（SOC）的联合估计。从短双极性脉冲测试中提取一组电压响应特征，并将其用作诊断描述符。基于这些特征，采用两种机器学习模型——极端随机树（ExtraTrees）和表格先验数据拟合网络（TabPFN）——进行电池状态估计，并使用涵盖三种化学体系和四个容量类别的270个退役单体的数据进行评估。结果表明，TabPFN明显优于ExtraTrees，在所有单体组中，SOH估计的平均绝对误差范围为0.0076至0.0306，SOC估计的平均绝对误差低于0.01。为减轻测试负担，我们移除了部分依赖SOC的脉冲测试，并使用插值方法重构缺失的特征点。缩减测试后的结果表明，根据目标状态和精度要求的不同，即使移除40%–70%的依赖SOC的脉冲测试，仍可保持接近基线的估计精度。这些结果为二次寿命电池应用提供了一条通往更快、更低成本和可扩展状态评估的实用途径。

title: Health and nutrition returns to clean cooking fuel access across the rural-urban divide
abstract: Access to clean cooking fuels is central to advancing health, equity, and environmental sustainability worldwide. However, despite sustained policy efforts, a substantial share of households, especially in developing countries, still rely on polluting fuels, with adverse effects on health, environmental quality, and economic well-being. This paper draws on a panel dataset of 102 developing countries spanning 2000–2022 to assess the relationship between access to clean cooking fuels and human well-being. Using fixed-effects and instrumental-variable estimators, we address potential endogeneity concerns. We further explore heterogeneity across rural and urban settings and show that improvements in access are associated with larger gains in health and nutrition outcomes in urban areas. Focusing on sub-Saharan Africa, we conduct scenario-based simulations to quantify the potential benefits of expanding access to clean cooking fuels. Increasing rural access from 10% to 25% is estimated to prevent around 84,000 infant deaths and reduce child stunting by approximately 1.68 million cases. In urban areas, achieving universal access from a baseline of 35% coverage could avert up to 377,000 infant deaths and generate more than 11 million disability-adjusted life years saved, reflecting a substantial reduction in disease burden linked to household air pollution. These results point to the need to accelerate progress toward universal access to clean cooking fuels through targeted, context-specific policies. While rural populations remain underserved and require continued attention, the magnitude of potential gains in urban areas underscores the case for a balanced strategy in clean energy policy design.
title_zh: 跨越城乡差距的清洁烹饪燃料可及性对健康与营养的回报

title: A dynamic electrochemical impedance spectroscopy extraction method for PEM water electrolyzers considering time resolution
abstract: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) is an efficient in-operando characterization tool for analyzing the internal processes of proton exchange membrane water electrolyzers (PEMWE). However, conventional EIS requires the system to operate under steady-state conditions, which limits its applicability in real-world systems. Dynamic EIS (DEIS) provides a potential approach to capture the variation of internal physical states caused by changes in operating conditions over time. However, existing impedance calculation methods, such as fast Fourier transform and wavelet transform-based approaches, are limited in their ability to analyse nonstationary signals across the entire frequency range. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a hybrid method that combines the advantages of several existing time–frequency and instantaneous feature extraction techniques to accurately obtain DEIS under dynamic conditions. This study segments the perturbation signals based on operating variations and applies adaptive processing to ensure accurate impedance extraction. Simulation and experimental verification under different input power profiles to a PEMWE are conducted in this work. The results demonstrate that the proposed hybrid method achieves a DEIS accuracy exceeding 96%, verifying its effectiveness for PEMWE applications and potential for other electrochemical devices.
title_zh: 考虑时间分辨率的PEM水电解槽动态电化学阻抗谱提取方法

title: Multiscale fractal-LLM synergy for secure synchrophasor data authentication in smart grids
abstract: Synchrophasor Data (SD), which captures the states and dynamics of transmission and distribution power networks, is recorded by dispersed Phasor Measurement Units (PMUs) that are connected through advanced communication infrastructures in cyber-physical systems. While the source information of SD is critical for PMU-based applications, it remains susceptible to data integrity attacks. Reliable SD source authentication must be performed efficiently before any SD analytics to ensure application integrity. Existing machine learning authentication methods are focused on sparse SD across vast regions and fail to represent realistic network conditions. This study presents a data-driven SD source authentication of dense PMUs at intra-state locations without requiring detailed power network topology, parameters, or costly upgrades to PMU hardware and data infrastructure. It offers a practical data-driven approach through multiscale fractal - Large Language Models (LLMs) synergy for secure SD authentication. Specifically, Multiscale Vector Visibility Height Correlation Analysis (MVVHCA) is developed to extract long-term fractal correlations from SD with multiple attributes simultaneously and pinpoint scales exhibiting peak multifractality. Then, high-fidelity synthetic SD is reconstructed through Adaptive Multifractal Interpolation (AMFI). These synthetic SD are further processed by LLMs to achieve robust, real-time source authentication. Validation on extensive real-world SD from multiple intra-state locations confirms superior accuracy and computational efficiency, which establishes a scalable solution for secure operation of renewable-dominated smart grids.

title: Market power and distributed solar integration in microgrids under limited regulation
abstract: Decentralized electricity systems increasingly emerge where centralized grids fail to provide reliable supply. In such settings, privately operated neighborhood microgrids, often based on diesel generators, exhibit significant market power, limited regulatory oversight, and high environmental externalities. In parallel, households increasingly deploy off-grid solar photovoltaic (PV) systems to gain control over electricity supply. However, these systems suffer from curtailed excess generation during peak solar hours and unreliable access at other times. While prior studies have optimized microgrids in low-reliability grid contexts from a techno-economic perspective, they largely neglect the market power exerted by monopolistic private generators. This paper addresses this gap by developing a bi-level game-theoretic model that enables household-generated electricity to be fed into the microgrid while explicitly accounting for the market power of a neighborhood diesel generator company (DGC). The regulator sets price and feed-in-tariff caps to maximize household economic surplus (HES), while the DGC acts as a profit-maximizing agent controlling access and supply. The model is illustrated using high-resolution empirical data from Lebanon. Results show that: (i) price and feed-in-tariff caps substantially increase HES and consistently induce significant household PV feed-in to the microgrid; (ii) higher DGC budgets or greater PV-owner penetration lead to pronounced gains in HES; and (iii) the renewable energy share reaches 60% under base conditions and approaches 100% at sufficiently high budgets or PV-owner penetration levels, compared to 0% under the status quo.
