ABSTRACT
                  Topochemical reactions in molecular crystals are often accompanied by severe lattice strain, frequently leading to crystal fracture and loss of crystallinity. Here we report an unusual case in which heat‐driven topochemical azide–alkyne cycloaddition (TAAC) polymerization in a non‐centrosymmetric molecular crystal induces macroscopic cracking that is followed by autonomous self‐healing. Single‐crystal x‐ray diffraction reveals a regiospecific single‐crystal‐to‐single‐crystal transformation to a helical polymer, despite large‐amplitude molecular motion and anisotropic lattice deformation (a +19.9%, b −2.9%, c −13.3%). Face‐indexing and morphology analysis correlate the crystallographic axes with macroscopic crystal dimensions, rationalizing the observed breadth expansion, length contraction, and cleavage along a weakly bound crystallographic plane. Mechanistically, crack formation originates from reaction‐induced bimorphic lattice strain, while self‐healing is driven by electrostatic attraction between oppositely charged fracture surfaces in the polar crystal, followed by continued intradomain polymerization that eliminates the bimorphic interface. Autonomous healing occurs upon completion of the topochemical polymerization in the crystalline material.
title_zh: 拓扑化学聚合驱动的分子晶体开裂与自愈合
abstract_zh:
摘要

分子晶体中的拓扑化学反应往往伴随严重的晶格应变， frequently 导致晶体破裂和结晶性丧失。在此我们报道一个不寻常的案例：非中心对称分子晶体中的热驱动拓扑叠氮-炔环加成（TAAC）聚合引起宏观开裂，随后发生自主自愈合。单晶 X 射线衍射揭示了区域专一的单晶到单晶转变生成螺旋聚合物，尽管存在大幅分子运动和各向异性晶格变形（a +19.9%，b −2.9%，c −13.3%）。晶面索引和形貌分析将晶体学轴与宏观晶体尺寸相关联，合理解释了观察到的宽度膨胀、长度收缩以及沿弱结合晶面的解理。从机理上讲，裂纹的形成源于反应诱导的双态晶格应变，而自愈合则由极性晶体中带相反电荷断裂面之间的静电吸引驱动，随后域内持续聚合消除了双态界面。自主愈合在晶体材料中拓扑化学聚合完成时发生。

title: Harnessing Sacrificial Mechanical Bonds for Toughening Elastomers
source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Sacrificial bonds serve as key energy‐dissipating motifs, governing the toughness of elastomers. Herein, we propose a robust and versatile strategy to toughen elastomers by precisely tuning the mechanochemical reactivity of sacrificial mechanical bonds through the systematic modification of stopper structures in rotaxane crosslinkers. By varying the size and number of stoppers, the quantitative relationship between the mechanochemical response of sacrificial bonds at the molecular level and the macroscopic mechanical performance of elastomers is elucidated. This is a breakthrough that expands the practical potential of elastomers and establishes a conceptual framework for the rational design of sacrificial bonds and mechanochemicallyinspired polymer systems.
title_zh: 利用牺牲性机械键增韧弹性体
abstract_zh:
摘要

牺牲键作为关键的能量耗散基元，决定着弹性体的韧性。在此，我们提出了一种坚固且通用的策略，通过系统修饰轮烷交联剂中封端基团的结构来精确调节牺牲机械键的力化学反应性，从而增韧弹性体。通过改变封端基团的大小和数量，阐明了分子水平上牺牲键的力化学响应与弹性体宏观力学性能之间的定量关系。这是一项突破性进展，拓展了弹性体的实际应用潜力，并为牺牲键及力化学启发聚合物体系的合理设计建立了概念框架。

title: Colored Sandwich-Structured Metafabrics for Passive Radiative Cooling
abstract: Abstract Developing passive radiative cooling (PRC) fabrics that combine high solar reflectance with desirable coloration, particularly purple, remains challenging due to the spectral trade-off between solar reflection and visible light absorption. Here, a “colored–white–colored” sandwich-structured metafabric is designed to balance aesthetic appearance and cooling performance. The fabric consists of spectrally selective purple skin layers and a highly reflective scattering core. The skin layers, composed of polyurethane (TPU) fibers and purple metal–organic framework ZIF-67, enable selective visible light absorption and enhanced mid-infrared emission, while the TPU/ZnO nanofiber core enhances broadband solar reflection through strong scattering. By spatially decoupling coloration and reflection, the fabric achieves a high solar reflectance of 90.6% and a mid-infrared emissivity of 94.6%. Outdoor tests show a maximum sub-ambient cooling of about 5.2 oC during daytime. Simulated and real-skin evaluations confirm superior personal cooling performance compared with commercial dyed cotton fabrics. The fabric also exhibits good moisture permeability and hydrophobicity, with a water vapor transmission rate of ~24.01 mg·cm–2·h–1 and a water contact angle of ~120o, which facilitates sweat evaporation and heat dissipation. This work provides a practical strategy for designing colored passive radiative cooling fabrics with aesthetic appeal, high visibility, and efficient thermal management.
title_zh: 用于被动辐射制冷的彩色三明治结构超构织物
abstract_zh: 摘要 开发兼具高太阳反射率和理想色彩（尤其是紫色）的被动辐射冷却（PRC）织物，由于太阳反射与可见光吸收之间的光谱权衡，仍然具有挑战性。本文设计了一种“彩色–白色–彩色”三明治结构超织物，以平衡美观外观与冷却性能。该织物由光谱选择性的紫色表层和高效反射散射内芯组成。表层由聚氨酯（TPU）纤维和紫色金属有机骨架ZIF-67构成，可实现选择性可见光吸收和增强的中红外发射，而TPU/ZnO纳米纤维内芯通过强散射增强宽带太阳反射。通过在空间上解耦着色与反射，该织物实现了90.6%的高太阳反射率和94.6%的中红外发射率。户外测试表明，白天最高可实现约5.2 oC的亚环境温度冷却。模拟和真实皮肤评估证实，其个人冷却性能优于商用染色棉织物。该织物还表现出良好的透湿性和疏水性，水蒸气透过率约为~24.01 mg·cm–2·h–1，水接触角约为~120o，有助于汗液蒸发和散热。本工作为设计兼具美学吸引力、高可见性和高效热管理的彩色被动辐射冷却织物提供了一种实用策略。

title: Bio-inspired Micropit Photothermal Evaporator by 3D Printing for Efficient Water-Electricity Co-generation
abstract: Abstract Solar-driven interfacial evaporation provides a sustainable approach for water purification and energy harvesting, but integrated evaporators still face challenges in rapid fabrication, efficient solar-energy utilization, and stable hydrovoltaic output. Herein, a beetle-inspired CTPH evaporator with biomimetic micropit arrays was rapidly fabricated by digital light processing (DLP) 3D printing within 38 min. Incident light can undergo multiple internal reflections within the concave micropits. The three-dimensional architecture also enlarges the exposed geometric evaporation area. MWCNTs–COOH act as photothermal centers and introduce negatively charged interfaces favorable for hydrovoltaic electricity generation. Under 1 sun irradiation, the optimized CTPH evaporator achieved an evaporation rate of 2.09 kg m–2 h–1 and a solar-to-vapor conversion efficiency of 95.4%. In brine, it delivered a stable open-circuit voltage of 0.37 V and a steady-state current of 13.26 μA; after scaling the array to 4 × 4, the current increased to 61.45 μA. The evaporator also showed effective purification performance toward seawater, heavy-metal wastewater, dye wastewater, and acidic/alkaline solutions, demonstrating its feasibility for integrated solar water purification and hydrovoltaic electricity generation.
title_zh: 仿生微坑光热蒸发器的3D打印实现高效水-电联产
abstract_zh: 摘要 太阳能驱动的界面蒸发为水净化和能量收集提供了一种可持续途径，但集成蒸发器在快速制备、高效太阳能利用和稳定水伏输出方面仍面临挑战。本文通过数字光处理（DLP）3D打印在38分钟内快速制备了一种具有仿生微凹坑阵列的甲虫启发CTPH蒸发器。入射光可在凹形微凹坑内发生多次内反射。三维结构还增大了暴露的几何蒸发面积。MWCNTs–COOH作为光热中心，并引入有利于水伏发电的带负电界面。在1个标准太阳照射下，优化后的CTPH蒸发器实现了2.09 kg m–2 h–1的蒸发速率和95.4%的太阳能-蒸汽转换效率。在盐水中，其输出0.37 V的稳定开路电压和13.26 μA的稳态电流；将阵列扩展至4 × 4后，电流增至61.45 μA。该蒸发器对海水、重金属废水、染料废水以及酸/碱溶液也表现出有效的净化性能，展示了其用于集成太阳能水净化与水伏发电的可行性。

title: Multiple Passivation on High-Quality Perovskite Crystals Based on Low-Cost Polyfunctional Food Additive for High-Performance Perovskite Solar Cells in Ambient Air
abstract: Abstract The two-step deposition of FAPbI3 perovskite films in ambient air faces multiple challenges, such as incomplete PbI2-to-perovskite conversion and moisture-induced degradation, leading to residual PbI2, grain boundary defects, and unstable phase formation. To solve these issues, a low-cost polyfunctional food-grade food additive, sodium cyclamate (SC), was introduced into the PbI2 precursor for the air-processed device fabrication process. The multiple cooperative interactions between SC and perovskite precursors effectively inhibit the unfavorable defect generation and greatly improve moisture tolerance. The sulfonic acid group (–SO3–) in SC coordinates with Pb2+ vacancies, while the amino group (–NH–) passivates I– vacancies via hydrogen bonding. Additionally, SC facilitates the crystallization kinetics of perovskite films via forming a porous PbI2 intermediate, which promotes the complete FAI penetration and stabilizes the α-phase against δ-phase transition. The perovskite films with enlarged grain size, reduced trap density, and improved phase purity were achieved in ambient air. Consequently, the champion device achieves an improved power conversion efficiency (PCE) with a high open-circuit voltage (Voc) in ambient air. The unencapsulated devices with SC exhibit superior long-term stability compared with the control devices under ambient conditions.
title_zh: 基于低成本多功能食品添加剂的高质量钙钛矿晶体多重钝化用于空气中高性能钙钛矿太阳能电池
abstract_zh: 摘要 FAPbI3钙钛矿薄膜在环境空气中的两步沉积面临多重挑战，如PbI2向钙钛矿转化不完全和湿气诱导降解，导致残余PbI2、晶界缺陷和不稳定的相形成。为解决这些问题，在空气处理的器件制备过程中，向PbI2前驱体中引入了一种低成本多功能的食品级食品添加剂——环己基氨基磺酸钠（SC）。SC与钙钛矿前驱体之间的多重协同相互作用有效抑制了不利缺陷的产生，并极大提高了耐湿性。SC中的磺酸基团（–SO3–）与Pb2+空位配位，而氨基（–NH–）通过氢键钝化I–空位。此外，SC通过形成多孔PbI2中间体促进钙钛矿薄膜的结晶动力学，促进FAI完全渗透并稳定α相以抵御δ相转变。在环境空气中获得了晶粒尺寸增大、陷阱密度降低和相纯度提高的钙钛矿薄膜。因此，冠军器件在环境空气中实现了更高的功率转换效率（PCE）和较高的开路电压（Voc）。在环境条件下，添加SC的未封装器件相比对照器件表现出更优异的长期稳定性。

title: Solvent Polarity-Directed Morphological Transformation of Zinc Porphyrin Assemblies for Enhanced Photodynamic Therapy of Glioblastoma
abstract: Abstract Glioblastoma is one of the most aggressive brain cancers with poor prognosis. Photodynamic therapy (PDT) is an efficient and noninvasive strategy for glioblastoma treatment. Porphyrins represent common photosensitizers for PDT but suffer from poor water solubility and low reactive oxygen species (ROS) yield. Herein, we report a porphyrin photosensitizer with enhanced ROS via a cascade fabrication involving the self-assembly of zinc meso-tetra(4-pyridyl)porphyrin (ZnTPyP) into tetragonal nanorods (NRs), followed by a polarity-driven morphological transition into hexagonal nanowires (NWs). Spectroscopic monitoring revealed a continuous disassembly-reassembly mechanism for this morphological transition, with a critical transition observed at 40% (v/v) ethanol. Different from the monoaxial Zn–N coordination and symmetric π-stacked structure of tetragonal NRs, the hexagonal NWs adopt a dual axial coordination and J-aggregated conjugated packing to form open hexagonal channels. This structural reorganization of NWs was accompanied by a significant absorption redshift, enhanced light harvesting, and a 1.9-fold increase in ROS generation. Upon 635 nm irradiation, the NWs exhibited a superior photodynamic effect (79.9%) compared to that of tetragonal NRs (44.5%). Apolipoprotein E (ApoE)-modified NWs traversed the blood-brain barrier and efficiently inhibited glioma growth in an orthotopic glioma model via enhanced PDT. Collectively, the solvent polarity modulation offers a powerful and general strategy to engineer supramolecular assembly architectures, paving the way for advanced photoactive nanotheranostics against brain diseases.
title_zh: 溶剂极性诱导锌卟啉组装体形貌转变增强胶质母细胞瘤光动力治疗

title: Detection of Time-Dependent Uptake of Microplastics by Joint Utilization of Hepatic Organoids and a 3D-Printed Carrier
abstract: Abstract Microplastics (MPs, 5 μm particles show negligible internalization, 3D HOs exhibited significant accumulation of intact micron-scale MPs via tissue-layer penetration and paracellular retention, with PP uptake peaking at ∼40% within 48 h and ∼18% retained long-term. This triggered dose- and time-dependent hepatotoxicity (40–4000 ng/mL), marked by CD36 upregulation from 8 h, mitochondrial impairment, and elevated LDH and AST levels. Notably, NR fluorescence intensity was governed by polymer chemistry rather than surface roughness, enabling material-specific detection. This work provides novel label-free techniques within 3D in vitro models to explore the depot and effective concentration of micron-scale MPs, advancing understanding of MP-induced cellular damage upon uptake and deposition.
title_zh: 肝脏类器官与3D打印载体联合用于检测微塑料的时间依赖性摄取
abstract_zh: 摘要 微塑料（MPs，5 μm的颗粒几乎不发生内化，而3D HOs通过组织层渗透和细胞旁滞留表现出完整微米级MPs的显著积累，其中PP摄取在48小时内达到约~40%的峰值，并长期滞留约~18%。这引发了剂量和时间依赖性肝毒性（40–4000 ng/mL），表现为8小时起CD36上调、线粒体损伤以及LDH和AST水平升高。值得注意的是，NR荧光强度由聚合物化学而非表面粗糙度决定，可实现材料特异性检测。本工作在3D体外模型中提供了新颖的无标记技术，用于探究微米级MPs的储库和有效浓度，增进对MPs在摄取和沉积后诱导细胞损伤的理解。

title: Chemo-Mechanical Interphase Stabilization of Silicon-Based Anodes for High-Energy All-Solid-State Batteries
abstract: Abstract Silicon anodes show great potential for high-energy-density all-solid-state lithium batteries, but their substantial volume changes during cycling result in the loss of solid-solid contact, while parasitic interfacial reactions generate significant interfacial resistance. Herein, we present a chemo-mechanical stabilization strategy using a high-capacity, carbon-free silicon suboxide (SiOx) anode. The in situ formation of a Li2O/LixSiOy-rich matrix maintains continuous ion-transport pathways by stabilizing interfacial contact and mitigates parasitic reactions with sulfide electrolytes. As a result, the SiOx anode operates at current densities up to 5.0 mA cm−2 and delivers an areal capacity of 2.3 mA h cm−2. Furthermore, full cells achieve 70.3% capacity retention after 400 cycles at 1.0 mA cm−2, with a reversible areal capacity of 1.6 mA h cm−2. Moreover, a molten-salt-enabled surface coating was employed, which improved the electronic conductivity of SiOx by two orders of magnitude. This work offers a new avenue toward high-energy ASSLBs based on SiOx anodes.
title_zh: 高能量全固态电池硅基负极的化学-机械界面稳定化
abstract_zh: 摘要 硅负极在高能量密度全固态锂电池中显示出巨大潜力，但其在循环过程中的大幅体积变化导致固-固接触丧失，同时寄生界面反应产生显著的界面电阻。本文提出了一种采用高容量、无碳的氧化亚硅（SiOx）负极的化学-机械稳定化策略。原位形成的富Li2O/LixSiOy基体通过稳定界面接触维持连续的离子传输通道，并减轻与硫化物电解质的寄生反应。因此，SiOx负极可在高达5.0 mA cm−2的电流密度下工作，并提供2.3 mA h cm−2的面容量。此外，全电池在1.0 mA cm−2下循环400次后容量保持率为70.3%，可逆面容量为1.6 mA h cm−2。此外，还采用了熔盐表面包覆，将SiOx的电子电导率提高了两个数量级。本工作为基于SiOx负极的高能量ASSLBs开辟了新途径。

title: Cerium-Rutin Coordination Polymer Nanoparticles for Scavenging ROS and Inhibiting Amyloid-β Fibrillation in Alzheimer's Disease
abstract: Abstract The abnormal accumulation of amyloid-beta (Aβ) triggers cellular dysfunction and tissue damage through processes including reactive oxygen species (ROS) and neuroinflammation, ultimately leading to the manifestation of AD symptoms. However, existing studies have revealed that the isolated clearance of amyloid-beta (Aβ), reactive oxygen species (ROS), or neuroinflammation confers no significant benefit on cognitive and memory function in AD patients. Thus, given the complex pathogenic mechanisms underlying AD, multitarget synergistic therapy represents a promising therapeutic strategy. Herein, we reported coordination polymer nanoparticles, Ce-Ru@Trf NPs, composed of cerium (Ce), rutin (Ru), and transferrin (Trf), which efficiently scavenge various ROS and anti-neuroinflammation and inhibit Aβ fibrillization. Owing to Trf modification, its accumulation in brain tissues increased significantly. The Ce-Ru@Trf NPs also dampened neuroinflammation by redirecting microglia toward the M2 phenotype and curtailing proinflammatory factor release. In an AD APP/PS1 model, it significantly achieved a neuroprotective effect and improved cognitive function. The findings suggest that biocompatible coordination polymers composed of metals and natural products may offer a viable therapeutic strategy for Alzheimer’s disease.
title_zh: 铈-芦丁配位聚合物纳米粒子清除ROS并抑制阿尔茨海默病中淀粉样-β纤维化
abstract_zh: 摘要 淀粉样蛋白-β (Aβ) 的异常积累通过活性氧 (ROS) 和神经炎症等过程引发细胞功能障碍和组织损伤，最终导致 AD 症状的表现。然而，现有研究表明，单独清除淀粉样蛋白-β (Aβ)、活性氧 (ROS) 或神经炎症对 AD 患者的认知和记忆功能没有显著益处。因此，鉴于 AD 复杂的致病机制，多靶点协同治疗是一种有前景的治疗策略。本文报道了由铈 (Ce)、芦丁 (Ru) 和转铁蛋白 (Trf) 组成的配位聚合物纳米粒子 Ce-Ru@Trf NPs，其能够高效清除各种 ROS、抗神经炎症并抑制 Aβ 纤维化。由于 Trf 修饰，其在脑组织中的积累显著增加。Ce-Ru@Trf NPs 还通过将小胶质细胞重定向至 M2 表型并减少促炎因子释放来抑制神经炎症。在 AD APP/PS1 模型中，它显著实现了神经保护作用并改善了认知功能。研究结果表明，由金属和天然产物组成的生物相容性配位聚合物可能为阿尔茨海默病提供一种可行的治疗策略。

title: Modification of Dielectric Elastomer with Ionic Units: A New Approach to Lowering Driving Electric Fields
abstract: Abstract Dielectric elastomers (DEs) have emerged as promising artificial muscles, capable of replicating or even surpassing natural muscle performance. However, their widespread application is severely hindered by the requirement for high driving electric fields. To address this issue, recent research has focused on incorporating ionic units into DEs to enhance polarization. Notably, the effect of ionic units in boosting the dielectric constant far exceeds that of conventional polar groups or high-permittivity fillers, thus enabling successful operation of dielectric elastomer actuators (DEAs) at significantly lower electric fields. This review provides a comprehensive overview of ion modification strategies for DEs. We systematically compare the material design principles between ion-modified DEs and conventional ionic polymers (e.g., those in ionic polymer-metal composites), and elucidate how different ionic components influence the dielectric, mechanical, and actuation properties of DEs. Finally, we highlight the state-of-the-art applications of ion-modified DEs in soft robots and wearable electronics, and discuss the challenges and potential solutions for advancing these materials toward practical low-field actuation.
title_zh: 离子单元修饰介电弹性体：一种降低驱动电场的新方法
abstract_zh: 摘要 介电弹性体 (DEs) 已成为有前景的人工肌肉，能够复制甚至超越天然肌肉的性能。然而，其广泛应用因需要高驱动电场而受到严重阻碍。为解决这一问题，近期研究集中于将离子单元引入 DEs 以增强极化。值得注意的是，离子单元在提升介电常数方面的效果远超传统极性基团或高介电常数填料，从而使介电弹性体致动器 (DEAs) 能够在显著更低的电场下成功运行。本综述全面概述了 DEs 的离子改性策略。我们系统比较了离子改性 DEs 与传统离子聚合物（如离子聚合物-金属复合材料中的聚合物）的材料设计原理，并阐明了不同离子组分如何影响 DEs 的介电、机械和致动性能。最后，我们重点介绍了离子改性 DEs 在软体机器人和可穿戴电子器件中的最新应用，并讨论了推动这些材料走向实用化低场驱动的挑战与潜在解决方案。

title: Eco-Friendly AgInGaS/ZnSe Core/Shell Quantum Dots for Solar-Driven Hydrogen Evolution
abstract: Abstract Heavy-metal-free colloidal quantum dots (QDs) are promising sensitizers for photoelectrochemical (PEC) H2 evolution, but their photoresponse and operational stability remain limited. Here, AgInGaS (AIGS)/ZnSe core/shell QDs with two AIGS core compositions were synthesized and evaluated as sensitizers for PEC H2 evolution. Variation of the In/Ga ratio produced composition-dependent absorption and photoluminescence spectra, while ZnSe growth broadened the visible-light absorption response and increased the average PL decay lifetimes. Under the same two-cycle ZnS post-treatment, the AIGS/ZnSe-QD-sensitized photoanodes exhibited substantially higher photocurrent densities and improved photocurrent retention than the corresponding AIGS-core-QD-sensitized photoanodes. The best-performing AIGS/ZnSe #2 photoanode reached a photocurrent density of 4.1 mA cm–2 at 0.9 V versus RHE under AM 1.5G illumination and produced a cumulative H2 amount of 63.4 μmol cm–2 over 2 h, corresponding to a Faradaic efficiency of 70.9%. It retained approximately 50% of its initial photocurrent after 2 h of continuous illumination. These results demonstrate that AIGS core-composition control and ZnSe shell growth can improve the PEC response of heavy-metal-free QD sensitizers, although operational stability remains an important target for further improvement.
title_zh: 生态友好型AgInGaS/ZnSe核/壳量子点用于太阳能驱动产氢
abstract_zh: 摘要 无重金属胶体量子点 (QDs) 是光电化学 (PEC) 析氢的有前景的敏化剂，但其光响应和工作稳定性仍然有限。本文合成并评估了两种 AIGS 核组分 的 AgInGaS (AIGS)/ZnSe 核/壳 QDs，作为 PEC 析氢的敏化剂。In/Ga 比例的变化产生了组分依赖的吸收和光致发光光谱，而 ZnSe 的生长拓宽了可见光吸收响应并增加了平均 PL 衰减寿命。在相同的两循环 ZnS 后处理下，AIGS/ZnSe-QD 敏化光电阳极相比相应的 AIGS 核 QD 敏化光电阳极表现出显著更高的光电流密度和改善的光电流保持率。性能最佳的 AIGS/ZnSe #2 光电阳极在 AM 1.5G 光照下、0.9 V (相对于 RHE) 条件下达到 4.1 mA cm–2 的光电流密度，并在 2 h 内产生 63.4 μmol cm–2 的累计 H2 量，对应的法拉第效率为 70.9%。在连续光照 2 h 后，其仍保持约 50% 的初始光电流。这些结果表明，AIGS 核组分控制和 ZnSe 壳层生长可以改善无重金属 QD 敏化剂的 PEC 响应，尽管工作稳定性仍是需要进一步改进的重要目标。

title: Urban design interventions reduce fear of crime in public spaces in gender-sensitive ways
abstract:
Abstract
                  Fear of crime in public spaces is a major policy problem worldwide. Environmental Crime Prevention proposes that modifying the built environment can reduce the fear of crime, but key questions remain: are these interventions equally effective across genders, and what intensity maximizes safety perceptions while optimizing costs? Here we evaluated three interventions: ‘Eyes on the Street’ (adding windows to blind walls), neutral stimuli (removing graffiti by repainting walls) and ‘Nature-Based Solutions’ (integrating tidy vegetation into urban infrastructure) in the context of ‘Broken Windows’ disorder. Interventions were applied at varying intensities across four types of public spaces. Using a randomized experiment in Chile with photo simulations and an adapted Positive and Negative Affective Schedule, we collected 18,150 perception ratings from 2,028 respondents. The results show that perceived safety improvements are positive but nonlinear, indicating diminishing returns beyond a certain intervention intensity. Critically, responses were highly gender specific: interventions were more effective for men, suggesting that environmental changes alone do not fully address women’s perceived insecurity.
title_zh: 城市设计干预以性别敏感方式减少公共空间中的犯罪恐惧
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  公共空间中的犯罪恐惧是全球性的重大政策问题。环境犯罪预防理论提出，改造建成环境可以减少犯罪恐惧，但关键问题仍然存在：这些干预措施对不同性别是否同样有效，以及在优化成本的同时何种强度能最大化安全感？我们在“破窗”失序背景下评估了三种干预措施：“街道之眼”（在盲墙上增加窗户）、中性刺激（通过重新粉刷墙壁去除涂鸦）和“自然基解决方案”（将整洁的植被整合到城市基础设施中）。干预措施以不同强度应用于四种类型的公共空间。我们通过在智利进行的一项使用照片模拟和改进版正负性情绪量表的随机实验，从 2,028 名受访者中收集了 18,150 项感知评分。结果表明，感知安全的改善是正向的但非线性的，表明超过一定干预强度后收益递减。至关重要的是，响应具有高度的性别特异性：干预措施对男性更有效，这表明仅靠环境改变无法完全解决女性的不安全感。

title: Desolvated cations promote CO2 electroreduction through partial covalent interactions
abstract: The mechanism of cation enhancement in electrocatalytic CO2 reduction has been widely debated but spectroscopic evidence under operating conditions is lacking. Now operando X-ray and surface-enhanced infrared spectroscopy are combined with theory to reveal that desolvated Cs+ cations enable CO2 activation at substantially reduced overpotentials through partial covalent interactions.
title_zh: 去溶剂化阳离子通过部分共价相互作用促进CO2电还原
abstract_zh: 电催化 CO2 还原中阳离子增强的机制一直存在广泛争议，但缺乏操作条件下的光谱证据。如今，原位 X 射线与表面增强红外光谱与理论相结合，揭示了去溶剂化的 Cs+ 阳离子通过部分共价相互作用在大幅降低的过电位下实现 CO2 活化。

title: Functional Carbon Nanotube Contacts for Silicon Photovoltaics: From Transparent Conductive Films to Selective and Passivating Interfaces
abstract: Abstract Carbon nanotube/silicon (CNT/Si) heterojunction solar cells have emerged as a promising low-temperature photovoltaic platform, combining the strong light-harvesting capability of Si with the transparency, processability, and mechanical compliance of CNT-based contacts. Recent advances have pushed laboratory-scale efficiencies to about 23% and extended device operation to centimeter-scale areas. These advances reflect a functional evolution of CNT contacts from transparent conductive films in early front-junction devices to chemically and structurally engineered contacts and further to selective/passivating interfaces integrated with architectures that decouple optical management from CNT transport constraints. This review examines how CNT composition, doping, morphology, Si absorber design, interfacial passivation, and optical management collectively regulate carrier extraction, recombination, photon utilization, and mechanical form factor. It then discusses the key barriers to practical implementation, including CNT film uniformity, area scaling, contact stability, and mechanical reliability. By linking device-performance advances with the remaining materials and engineering challenges, this review provides a materials and interface perspective on the requirements for scalable and reliable CNT/Si photovoltaics.
title_zh: 硅光伏的功能性碳纳米管接触：从透明导电薄膜到选择性与钝化界面
abstract_zh: 摘要 碳纳米管/硅 (CNT/Si) 异质结太阳能电池已成为一种有前景的低温光伏平台，兼具 Si 的强光捕获能力与 CNT 基接触的透明性、可加工性和机械柔顺性。近期进展已将实验室规模的效率提升至约 23%，并将器件工作扩展到厘米级面积。这些进展反映了 CNT 接触的功能演进：从早期前结器件中的透明导电薄膜，到化学和结构工程化接触，再到与将光学管理与 CNT 输运限制解耦的架构相结合的选择性/钝化界面。本综述考察了 CNT 组成、掺杂、形貌、Si 吸收层设计、界面钝化和光学管理如何共同调控载流子提取、复合、光子利用和机械形态因子。随后讨论了实际应用的关键障碍，包括 CNT 薄膜均匀性、面积放大、接触稳定性和机械可靠性。通过将器件性能进展与剩余的材料和工程挑战相联系，本综述从材料和界面视角为可扩展、可靠的 CNT/Si 光伏提供了要求参考。

title: Catalytic Regulation of Cluster-Mediated Growth Enables Scalable Synthesis of Shape-Controlled Single-Crystalline Silver Nanocrystals
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Precisely controlling shape and crystallinity is central to defining structure-dependent properties in colloidal nanocrystals (NCs), which is particularly important yet challenging for silver (Ag) NCs. Here, we report catalytic regulation that facilitates cluster-mediated growth pathways to enable the scalable synthesis of single-crystalline Ag-NCs with programmable shapes. A copper (Cu)-assisted, one-pot heating-up process produces highly uniform Ag-NCs with tunable diameters (5–11 nm) and morphologies ranging from truncated-octahedral (“mecon”) to spherical geometries, while maintaining gram-scale batch output, air tolerance, and compatibility with continuous flow synthesis. Spectroscopic and mass spectrometric analyses reveal a stepwise growth pathway involving discrete Ag cluster intermediates, whose formation and interconversion are accelerated by trace Cu species acting as catalysts. Density functional theory calculations further show that Cu modulates surface and stacking-fault energetics, promoting single-crystalline growth with well-defined facets. By introducing a quantitative shape descriptor, we establish predictive relationships linking NC morphology to plasmonic response, supported by discrete dipole approximation simulations. These results define a general synthetic principle in which catalytic species and dynamic ligand environments cooperatively govern cluster-phase evolution, enabling precise and scalable control of NC structure and function.
title_zh: 团簇介导生长的催化调控实现形貌可控单晶银纳米晶的可扩展合成
abstract_zh: 摘要 精确控制形貌和结晶度是决定胶体纳米晶（NCs）结构相关性能的核心，这对银（Ag）纳米晶尤为重要且极具挑战。本文报道了一种催化调控策略，该策略促进团簇介导的生长路径，实现了具有可编程形貌的单晶Ag纳米晶的可规模化合成。铜（Cu）辅助的一锅加热法可制备高度均匀的Ag纳米晶，其直径可调（5–11 nm），形貌涵盖截角八面体（“mecon”）至球形，同时保持克级批次产量、空气耐受性以及与连续流合成的兼容性。光谱和质谱分析揭示了涉及离散Ag团簇中间体的分步生长路径，微量Cu物种作为催化剂可加速这些中间体的形成和相互转化。密度泛函理论计算进一步表明，Cu可调节表面能和层错能，促进具有明确晶面的单晶生长。通过引入定量形貌描述符，我们建立了纳米晶形貌与等离激元响应之间的预测关系，并得到离散偶极近似模拟的支持。这些结果确立了一般性合成原理：催化物种与动态配体环境协同调控团簇相演化，从而实现对纳米晶结构与功能的精确、可规模化控制。

title: Light-Triggered Decoding of Hydrophobic Interactions in Living Systems
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract The hydrophobic effect is central to biological organization, underlying membrane assembly, molecular recognition, and protein folding. Despite its importance, spatiotemporal control of hydrophobicity is challenging because it emerges from collective solvation free-energy effects around hydrocarbon frameworks whose C(sp3)–H bonds are chemically inert. Here we show that hydrophobic interactions can be encoded and decoded on demand under physiological conditions using water-soluble functional groups and visible light. Aliphatic carbon frameworks are encoded in charged radical precursors, significantly reducing the free-energy penalty of aqueous solvation. Light-triggered single-electron decarboxylation converts these precursors into nonpolar hydrocarbon products, restoring hydrophobic interactions. This transition drives emergent behaviors including membrane self-assembly, lipid-mediated signaling, and targeted protein degradation in living cells.
title_zh: 活体系统中疏水相互作用的光触发解码
abstract_zh: 摘要 疏水效应是生物组织的核心，支撑着膜组装、分子识别和蛋白质折叠。尽管其重要性显著，但由于疏水效应源于C(sp3)–H键化学惰性的烃骨架周围的集体溶剂化自由能效应，对其时空控制极具挑战。本文表明，利用水溶性官能团和可见光，可在生理条件下按需编码和解码疏水相互作用。脂肪族碳骨架被编码于带电自由基前体中，显著降低了水溶剂化的自由能损失。光触发的单电子脱羧反应将这些前体转化为非极性烃类产物，恢复疏水相互作用。这一转变驱动了包括膜自组装、脂质介导的信号传导以及活细胞中靶向蛋白质降解等涌现行为。

title: Compositional Effects on Proton and Oxygen Ion Transport in BaCo x Fe0.8– x Zr0.1Y0.1O3−δ (BCFZY)

title: An On-Demand Functionalizable Neural Electrode Interface for Precise Interrogation and Biofunctional Regulation
abstract: Abstract Neural electrodes capable of precise interrogation and biofunctional regulation—encompassing both long-term electrophysiological signal recording and tunable control of neuronal or pathological cell behavior via surface biofunctionalization—hold significant promise for advancing the diagnosis and treatment of neurological disorders. A critical challenge lies in mitigating the immune-mediated foreign body response, which often leads to glial scar formation that encapsulates implants like “cement,” severely compromising functionality. To address this, we develop a benzyloxycarbonyl (Cbz)-substituted poly(ornithine-alt-glycine) (OGCbz) interface, which inherently resists biofouling and immunogenic rejection without degrading electrical performance. Notably, substituting the Cbz group with various functional moieties not only maintains these excellent antifouling and biocompatibility properties but also imparts corresponding functionalities. As a proof-of-concept, replacing Cbz with the peptide sequence IKVAV and the antibody cetuximab successfully endows the interface with neuron-affinity and tumor cell proliferation inhibition, while retaining its inherent antifouling and anti-foreign-body reaction properties. During a six-month in vivo implantation period, the IKVAV-functionalized electrodes exhibit a significantly enhanced operational lifetime with improved electrophysiological signal fidelity. This work presents a reliable and versatile interfacial strategy for developing durable and multifunctional neural interfaces.
title_zh: 用于精确调控和生物功能调节的按需功能化神经电极界面
abstract_zh: 摘要 能够实现精确探测和生物功能调控的神经电极——既包括长期电生理信号记录，也包括通过表面生物功能化对神经元或病理细胞行为的可调控制——在推进神经系统疾病的诊断和治疗方面具有重大前景。一个关键挑战在于缓解免疫介导的异物反应，该反应常导致胶质瘢痕形成，像“水泥”一样包裹植入物，严重损害其功能。为此，我们开发了一种苄氧羰基（Cbz）取代的聚（鸟氨酸-交替-甘氨酸）（OGCbz）界面，其本身可抵御生物污染和免疫排斥，同时不降低电学性能。值得注意的是，用各种功能基团替换Cbz基团不仅保持了这些优异的抗污染和生物相容性，还赋予了相应的功能。作为概念验证，将Cbz替换为多肽序列IKVAV和抗体西妥昔单抗，成功赋予界面神经元亲和性和肿瘤细胞增殖抑制能力，同时保留其固有的抗污染和抗异物反应特性。在六个月的体内植入期间，IKVAV功能化电极表现出显著延长的工作寿命和改善的电生理信号保真度。这项工作为开发耐用且多功能的神经界面提供了一种可靠且通用的界面策略。

title: Mixed Monoammonium/Diammonium Ligands for High-Efficiency Sky-Blue Quasi-2D Perovskite Light-Emitting Diodes
abstract: Abstract Quasi-two-dimensional (quasi-2D) metal halide perovskites have demonstrated great potential in light-emitting displays. Monoammonium cation ligands are widely employed for preparing quasi-2D perovskites. Herein, a mixed-ligand strategy combining monoammonium ligand 4-methoxyphenethylammonium hydrobromide with diammonium ligand 3,6-dioxa-1,8-octanediammonium hydrobromide (DADOBr2) is proposed for preparing blue-emissive quasi-2D perovskites. The diammonium ligand of DADOBr2 not only serves as a linker of adjacent inorganic layers to enhance the rigidity of the quasi-2D perovskite structure, but also favors passivating the uncoordinated Pb2+ ions with its oxygen atoms, therefore reducing the energy loss caused by exciton–phonon coupling and trap-assisted nonradiative recombination. It is also found that the mixed-ligand strategy leads to random crystal orientation of quasi-2D perovskites, resulting in restricted carrier transport and increased radiative recombination rate. The mixed-ligand strategy significantly enhances the photoluminescence quantum yield of the blue quasi-2D perovskite film and boosts the external quantum efficiency of the blue device to 14.2%.
title_zh: 用于高效天蓝光准二维钙钛矿发光二极管的混合单铵/二铵配体
abstract_zh: 摘要 准二维（quasi-2D）金属卤化物钙钛矿在发光显示领域展现出巨大潜力。单铵阳离子配体被广泛用于制备准二维钙钛矿。本文提出了一种混合配体策略，将单铵配体4-甲氧基苯乙基溴化铵与双铵配体3,6-二氧杂-1,8-辛二胺溴化氢盐（DADOBr2）相结合，用于制备蓝光发射准二维钙钛矿。DADOBr2的双铵配体不仅作为相邻无机层的连接体以增强准二维钙钛矿结构的刚性，还通过其氧原子有利于钝化未配位的Pb2+离子，从而减少激子–声子耦合和陷阱辅助非辐射复合造成的能量损失。研究还发现，混合配体策略导致准二维钙钛矿的随机晶体取向，限制了载流子传输并提高了辐射复合速率。混合配体策略显著提高了蓝色准二维钙钛矿薄膜的光致发光量子产率，并将蓝光器件的外量子效率提升至14.2%。

title: Mechanistic Insights into Photo-Induced Bond Dissociation of a 2-(4-Nitrophenyl)-1H-indole-3-ylmethyl (NPIM) Derivative: A Case Study on Quantum Spin-Manipulation for Uncaging
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Photolabile protecting groups (PPGs) are indispensable tools for spatiotemporally controlled release of reactive functional groups. Recently, we proposed a quantum spin-manipulation (QSM-1) strategy that employs triplet ground-state cations to render ion-pair recombination spin-forbidden, thereby enhancing the uncaging quantum yield. In this study, the photodissociation mechanism of a 2-(4-nitrophenyl)-1H-indole-3-ylmethyl (NPIM) photocage bearing a benzoate leaving group was investigated to evaluate the effectiveness of a triplet excited-state-mediated QSM pathway (QSM-2). Spectroscopic analyses revealed that the excited state of NPIM possesses a relatively small singlet–triplet energy gap (ΔEST = 5.3 kcal mol–1), enabling efficient intersystem crossing (ISC) from the intramolecular charge-transfer singlet excited state to the triplet excited state. Oxygen-quenching experiments demonstrated that photodissociation proceeds predominantly from the triplet excited state. Time-resolved absorption spectroscopy identified the singlet excited state (τ = 1.6 ns), triplet excited state (τ = 2.3 μs), and NPIM radical intermediate (τ = 1.5 ms). In situ infrared analysis directly detected benzoic acid, an oxidized NPIM product, and CO2 generated from the benzoyl radical, supporting a homolytic bond-cleavage mechanism. Ultrafast time-resolved infrared spectroscopy of the NPIM chromophore revealed formation of a twisted intramolecular charge-transfer state that promotes ISC by reducing ΔEST. Density functional theory calculations further indicate that C–O bond homolysis from the triplet excited state is energetically feasible and is driven by relief of excited-state antiaromaticity. These results establish that uncaging of NPIM derivatives proceeds through triplet-state homolysis and demonstrate the validity of the QSM-2 strategy for designing efficient photochemical release systems.
title_zh: 2-(4-硝基苯基)-1H-吲哚-3-基甲基 (NPIM) 衍生物光诱导键解离的机理研究：量子自旋操控解笼释放的案例研究

title: Polymer Brush-Assisted Fabrication of Layered Metal Oxide Heterostructures for Future Electronic Device Applications
abstract: Abstract For the future advancement of electronic devices, the sustainable use of materials and a reduction of the energy consumed are factors which need to be considered, as well as performance and size. This has motivated the need to explore alternative processes in integrated circuit manufacture. In this study, we present a novel and cost-effective polymer brush infiltration technique for fabricating layer-by-layer dielectric-semiconductor-dielectric nanofilms. A polymer brush template was employed to facilitate the uniform infiltration of aluminium oxide (Al2O3) and indium oxide (In2O3) precursors, and subsequent UV/ozone treatment to achieve the formation of oxide film layers. The structural integrity, composition, and surface morphology of the layers were characterized using atomic force microscopy (AFM), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), and transmission electron microscopy (TEM). Electrical measurements confirmed the insulating behaviour of the complete Al2O3/In2O3/Al2O3 gate stack, whereas capacitance-voltage (CV) characteristics revealed charge trapping behaviour associated with the In2O3-containing structure. This work demonstrates a scalable and straightforward fabrication strategy for Al2O3/In2O3/Al2O3 multilayer oxide heterostructures. Structural and MOS capacitor characterization establish the quality of the fabricated multilayer stack and its charge trapping behaviour, providing a promising materials platform for future oxide electronic devices.
title_zh: 聚合物刷辅助制备层状金属氧化物异质结构用于未来电子器件应用
abstract_zh: 摘要 对于电子器件的未来发展，除了性能和尺寸之外，材料的可持续利用以及能耗的降低也是需要考虑的因素。这促使人们探索集成电路制造中的替代工艺。在本研究中，我们提出了一种新颖且低成本的聚合物刷渗透技术，用于逐层制备介电体-半导体-介电体纳米薄膜。采用聚合物刷模板促进氧化铝（Al2O3）和氧化铟（In2O3）前驱体的均匀渗透，并随后通过UV/臭氧处理实现氧化物薄膜层的形成。利用原子力显微镜（AFM）、扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、X射线光电子能谱（XPS）和透射电子显微镜（TEM）对各层的结构完整性、组成和表面形貌进行了表征。电学测量证实了完整的Al2O3/In2O3/Al2O3栅极叠层的绝缘行为，而电容-电压（CV）特性则揭示了与含In2O3结构相关的电荷俘获行为。这项工作展示了一种可扩展且简便的Al2O3/In2O3/Al2O3多层氧化物异质结构的制备策略。结构和MOS电容器的表征确立了所制备多层叠层的质量及其电荷俘获行为，为未来的氧化物电子器件提供了一个有前景的材料平台。

title: A Minimal Hemin-Albumin Nanozyme with Peroxidase-like Activity Enabling Tyrosine-Crosslinked Hydrogel Formation
abstract: Abstract Heme enzymes catalyze key oxidative reactions, yet their use in biotechnology is often limited by high production costs, low stability, and intricate operational conditions. Hemin, the catalytic iron-porphyrin cofactor of heme enzymes, has been explored as an alternative. However, its practical use is limited by its aggregation and deactivation in aqueous media. Here, we report a minimal biomimetic nanozyme based on the stabilization of hemin with bovine serum albumin (BSA) to enable aqueous catalysis and hydrogel formation under mild aqueous conditions. Through alkaline-mediated synthesis, hemin was stabilized with BSA, allowing the generation of a Hemin@BSA noncovalent hybrid with peroxidase- and catalase-like activity, outperforming free hemin or BSA complexed with hemin prepared under physiological conditions. Beyond standard peroxidase assays, Hemin@BSA catalyzed the oxidative C–C coupling of N-acetyl-tyrosine (NAT), yielding dityrosine as the main product. This enzymatic-like property was successfully applied at the macromolecular level, enabling the crosslinking of hyaluronic acid-tyramine (HA-TyrA) conjugates, yielding the formation of hydrogel networks with mechanical properties comparable to HRP-mediated crosslinked hydrogels. The cytotoxicity of hemin and Hemin@BSA was evaluated in both U87 glioblastoma and normal human astrocytes (NHA) cells, while cellular uptake and reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation were investigated in U87 cells, demonstrating efficient cellular uptake of Hemin@BSA and higher ROS levels induced by free hemin compared with Hemin@BSA. Overall, simple heme-protein complexes lie as the interface between molecular catalysts and functional biomaterials. They provide a low-cost and robust alternative to natural peroxidases, making them promising tools for creating redox-based hydrogels towards biomedical applications.
title_zh: 具有类过氧化物酶活性的最小血红素-白蛋白纳米酶实现酪氨酸交联水凝胶的形成
abstract_zh: 摘要 血红素酶催化关键的氧化反应，但其生物技术应用常受到生产成本高、稳定性低以及操作条件复杂的限制。氯化血红素（hemin）作为血红素酶的催化性铁-卟啉辅因子，已被作为替代品加以探索。然而，其在水性介质中的聚集和失活限制了其实际应用。在此，我们报道了一种基于牛血清白蛋白（BSA）稳定氯化血红素的最简仿生纳米酶，以在温和的水性条件下实现水性催化和水凝胶形成。通过碱介导的合成，氯化血红素被BSA稳定，从而生成具有类过氧化物酶和类过氧化氢酶活性的Hemin@BSA非共价杂化物，其性能优于游离氯化血红素或在生理条件下制备的BSA-氯化血红素复合物。除标准过氧化物酶测定外，Hemin@BSA还催化了N-乙酰酪氨酸（NAT）的氧化C–C偶联，主要产物为双酪氨酸。这种类酶特性被成功应用于大分子水平，实现了透明质酸-酪胺（HA-TyrA）偶联物的交联，形成机械性能可与HRP介导交联水凝胶相媲美的水凝胶网络。在U87胶质母细胞瘤和正常人星形胶质细胞（NHA）中评估了氯化血红素和Hemin@BSA的细胞毒性，同时在U87细胞中研究了细胞摄取和活性氧（ROS）的产生，结果表明Hemin@BSA被细胞高效摄取，且游离氯化血红素诱导的ROS水平高于Hemin@BSA

title: Polyaspartamide-Mediated Messenger RNA Delivery Enables Efficient Ex Vivo Engineering of Chimeric Antigen Receptor Natural Killer Cells via Enhanced Cellular Internalization
abstract: Abstract Engineered natural killer (NK) cells expressing chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) represent a promising alternative to CAR T-cell therapy due to their allogeneic potential. However, current CAR NK cell production relies on lentiviral or retroviral transduction to achieve stable CAR expression, requiring complex, multistep, and time-consuming manufacturing processes that limit scalability and timely clinical application. Here, we report a nonviral strategy for rapid ex vivo generation of CAR NK cells using amphiphilic polyaspartamide-based polyplexes for CAR messenger RNA (mRNA) delivery. Polyaspartamide derivatives incorporating diethylenetriamine (DET) and cyclohexylethylamine (CHE) (PAsp[DET/CHE]) enabled efficient mRNA complexation, enhanced cellular uptake, and robust CAR expression in NK cell lines. Mechanistically, increasing the N/P ratio of polyplexes, defined as the molar ratio of DET amino groups to mRNA phosphate group, enhanced cellular internalization, leading to improved transfection efficiency. NK cells engineered with CAR–NKG2D mRNA exhibited potent and selective cytotoxicity against various cancer cell lines, accompanied by elevated expression of cytotoxic mediators and cytokines, while sparing normal fibroblasts. Importantly, systemic administration of engineered NK cells significantly suppressed tumor growth in a subcutaneous colon cancer model. Collectively, this study established a simple, scalable, and safe platform for CAR NK cell manufacturing and provides mechanistic insights into polymer-mediated mRNA delivery in NK cells, offering a promising alternative to conventional viral approaches for cancer immunotherapy.
title_zh: 聚天冬酰胺介导的信使核糖核酸递送通过增强细胞内化实现嵌合抗原受体自然杀伤细胞的高效离体工程化
abstract_zh: 摘要 表达嵌合抗原受体（CAR）的工程化自然杀伤（NK）细胞因其同种异体潜力而成为CAR T细胞疗法的有前景的替代方案。然而，目前的CAR NK细胞生产依赖慢病毒或逆转录病毒转导以实现稳定的CAR表达，需要复杂、多步骤且耗时的制造工艺，限制了可扩展性和及时的临床应用。在此，我们报道了一种非病毒策略，利用两亲性聚天冬酰胺基聚复合物递送CAR信使RNA（mRNA），实现CAR NK细胞的快速体外生成。掺入二乙烯三胺（DET）和环己基乙胺（CHE）的聚天冬酰胺衍生物（PAsp[DET/CHE]）实现了高效的mRNA复合、增强的细胞摄取以及NK细胞系中稳健的CAR表达。在机制上，提高聚复合物的N/P比（定义为DET氨基与mRNA磷酸基团的摩尔比）可增强细胞内化，从而提高转染效率。经CAR–NKG2D mRNA工程化的NK细胞对多种癌细胞系表现出有效且选择性的细胞毒性，并伴随细胞毒性介质和细胞因子表达升高，同时不损伤正常成纤维细胞。重要的是，全身给予工程化NK细胞在皮下结肠癌模型中显著抑制了肿瘤生长。总之，本研究建立了一个简单、可扩展且安全的CAR NK细胞制造平台，并提供了聚合物介导NK细胞mRNA递送的机制见解，提供了一个有前景

title: Programmable Twisted Microchannels in Polymer Fibers via Rotational Thermal Drawing for Enhanced Micromixing
abstract: Abstract Micromixers are essential components of microfluidic systems, enabling rapid and homogeneous mixing at microliter and submicroliter scales. Although three-dimensional (3D) microchannel geometries can significantly enhance mixing performance, their broader adoption has been limited by fabrication challenges that restrict geometric control, scalability, and system integration. Here, we report an in-fiber twisted micromixer, termed the Fiber-μMixer, fabricated by rotational thermal drawing (rTDP). By introducing controlled rotation and revolution during drawing, this method enables scalable fabrication of microchannels with centered and off-centered geometries, feature sizes down to 100 μm, and twist pitches as small as 4 mm. The resulting twisted and helical channel architectures enhance microscale mixing through the combined effects of swirl-induced advection and Dean-vortex-driven secondary flows. Numerical simulations and experiments demonstrate strong mixing performance across a range of Reynolds numbers, with mixing efficiencies exceeding 75% and negligible pressure penalty in the intermediate regime (1 ≤ Re ≤ 30), where conventional passive micromixers typically underperform. This in-fiber micromixing platform provides a practical and scalable route toward compact, flexible, and multifunctional microfluidic systems, opening opportunities for lab-in-fiber technologies and advanced microscale fluid handling.
title_zh: 通过旋转热拉伸在聚合物纤维中构建可编程扭曲微通道以增强微混合
abstract_zh: 摘要 微混合器是微流控系统的关键组件，能够在微升和亚微升尺度上实现快速且均匀的混合。尽管三维（3D）微通道几何结构可以显著提高混合性能，但其更广泛的应用受到制造挑战的限制，这些挑战限制了几何控制、可扩展性和系统集成。在此，我们报道了一种由旋转热拉伸（rTDP）制备的纤维内扭转微混合器，称为Fiber-μMixer。通过在拉伸过程中引入受控的旋转和公转，该方法能够可扩展地制备具有居中和偏心几何形状的微通道，特征尺寸可小至100 μm，扭转螺距可小至4 mm。由此产生的扭转和螺旋通道结构通过旋流诱导的对流和Dean涡驱动的二次流的联合效应增强了微尺度混合。数值模拟和实验表明，在一系列雷诺数范围内均具有较强的混合性能，在中等流态（1 ≤ Re ≤ 30）下混合效率超过75%且压力损失可忽略不计，而传统被动微混合器在该流态下通常表现不佳。这种纤维内微混合平台为紧凑、柔性且多功能的微流控系统提供了一条实用且可扩展的途径，为纤维实验室技术和先进的微尺度流体操控开辟了机遇。

title: Enrichment Performance Assessment of Extracellular Vesicles Using Different Functionalized Magnetic Materials and Application in Urinary Proteomics of Prostate Cancer
abstract: Abstract Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are lipid bilayer nanovesicles that mediate intercellular communication and hold significant potential for clinical applications. Although material-based isolation strategies offer promising alternatives to conventional methods, their relative performances have not been systematically evaluated. In this study, we conducted a comparative assessment of magnetic nanomaterials with distinct surface functionalities, including metal oxides (TiO2), metal–organic frameworks (UiO-66), biopolymeric materials (chitosan), and lipid probes (DSPE-PEG, DOPE-PEG, and CLS-PEG). A comprehensive evaluation across multiple dimensions including capture capacity, capture rate, sample volume, and product purity reveals that the bifunctional magnetic nanomaterial Fe3O4@UiO-66@DSPE material exhibits superior EV capture performance. This material enables the efficient and stable enrichment of high-purity EVs by synergizing Zr4+-phosphate coordination with lipid bilayer anchoring, and preserves EV biological integrity and activity. Meanwhile, this method could be highly compatible with proteomics, and over 1000 proteins are identified by proteomic analysis of urinary EVs, while 34 proteins are upregulated and 25 proteins are downregulated in prostate cancer patients relative to healthy donors. Notably, the differentially expressed proteins, such as AGT, ITIH4, and PGLYRP2, are associated with disease progression. Overall, this work highlights the superior performance of the Fe3O4@UiO-66@DSPE material for efficient and selective EV isolation. It provides a powerful tool for clinical liquid biopsy and proteomic biomarker discovery, enabling early diagnosis, prognostic evaluation, and precision therapy.
title_zh: 使用不同功能化磁性材料评估细胞外囊泡的富集性能及其在前列腺癌尿液蛋白质组学中的应用

title: A Dual-Mode Fluorescent and Colorimetric Biosensor Based on AuNPs@RCA Nanogel-Integrated Multipedal DNA Walker for Ultrasensitive miRNA Detection
abstract: Abstract The development of highly sensitive and reliable biosensors is essential for the early diagnosis and therapeutic monitoring of cancer. Herein, we report a dual-mode fluorescence–colorimetric biosensing platform for the ultrasensitive detection of miRNA-21, integrating AuNP-supported dual-stage rolling circle amplification (RCA) with an RCA-generated multipedal binding-and-cleavage mechanism. The sensing hierarchy is initiated by target-dependent activation of the primary RCA on the gold nanoparticle (AuNP) surface, producing long DNA strands with multiple repeated recognition domains that function as numerous walker “legs” and form a DNA-rich nanogel matrix. Through these repeated domains, the RCA-generated multipedal walker repeatedly and multivalently binds fluorophore-labeled hairpin substrates on the AuNP surface, thereby facilitating APE1-mediated substrate cleavage and fluorescence recovery. The APE1-generated cleavage fragments subsequently initiate the secondary RCA following the addition of the T2 template. The two successive RCA reactions ultimately produce an Au@RCA DNA nanogel containing abundant G-quadruplex/hemin DNAzymes that catalyze a visually detectable color change. By integrating the multipedal walker-mediated multivalent binding-and-cleavage process with dual-stage RCA, the platform enables dual-mode fluorescence–colorimetric detection with efficient signal amplification and low background, achieving limits of detection of 9.854 and 790 fM for the fluorescence and colorimetric modes, respectively. Furthermore, the two complementary outputs provide independent signal readouts for cross-validation. The biosensor demonstrated excellent specificity and distinguished the endogenous responses of MCF-7, HeLa, and HEK293T cell lysates. These results support the potential of the platform for ultrasensitive tumor-associated biomarker detection, while the cell-lysate experiments represent a preliminary proof-of-concept evaluation in complex biological matrices.

title: Flexible Aerogels for Thermal Management: Energy-Regulation Pathways, Performance Trade-Offs, and Design Strategies
abstract: Abstract Flexible aerogels, with highly porous architectures and tunable thermal, spectral, and electrical properties, have emerged as promising platforms for multifunctional thermal management. The functions, including thermal insulation, radiative cooling, photothermal and electrothermal heating, and thermal buffering, are enabled by energy regulation pathways for heat transfer suppression, solar rejection and radiative dissipation, energy conversion, and heat storage and release. More importantly, the distinctive advantage of flexible aerogels lies in their ability to preserve the structural basis that sustains these pathways under mechanical loading. This review presents an energy-flow-centered framework that connects functional properties, stable energy-regulation pathways, design strategies, and application-level functions. We first introduce the measurable thermal, spectral, electrical, and storage properties of aerogels and then examine the mechanical stability of their corresponding pathways. Then, design principles, trade-offs, and construction strategies of flexible aerogels are discussed in terms of preserving functional structures under deformation. Recent advances are critically compared, with emphasis on functional–mechanical coupling, performance retention, and application-specific trade-offs. Finally, we highlight key challenges and future directions, emphasizing the need to balance mechanical adaptability, durability, and multifunctional efficacy in next-generation flexible aerogels.
title_zh: 用于热管理的柔性气凝胶：能量调节途径、性能权衡与设计策略
abstract_zh: 摘要 柔性气凝胶具有高度多孔的结构以及可调控的热学、光谱和电学性能，已成为多功能热管理的理想平台。其功能包括隔热、辐射制冷、光热与电热加热以及热缓冲，这些功能由抑制传热、太阳反射与辐射耗散、能量转换以及热量存储与释放等能量调控途径实现。更重要的是，柔性气凝胶的独特优势在于其能够在机械载荷下保持维持这些途径的结构基础。本综述提出了一个以能量流为中心的框架，将功能特性、稳定的能量调控途径、设计策略与应用层功能联系起来。我们首先介绍气凝胶的可测量的热学、光谱、电学和存储特性，然后考察其相应途径的机械稳定性。接着，从变形下保持功能结构的角度，讨论了柔性气凝胶的设计原则、权衡与构筑策略。我们还对最新进展进行了批判性比较，重点讨论功能–机械耦合、性能保持以及特定应用的权衡。最后，我们强调了关键挑战与未来方向，着重指出下一代柔性气凝胶需要在机械适应性、耐久性与多功能效能之间取得平衡。

title: Material and Design Strategies of Soft Microelectrode Arrays for Implantable Cardiac Interfaces
abstract: Abstract Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) remain one of the leading causes of mortality worldwide. However, conventional diagnostic and therapeutic technologies are often bulky, limited in functionality, and lack the mechanical softness required for continuous high-fidelity monitoring and treatment of patients with life-threatening cardiac conditions. In recent years, advances in materials science, device engineering, and system integration have led to the development of mechanically compliant microelectrode arrays (MEAs) capable of monitoring and modulating cardiac electrical, optical, and mechanical activities in vivo. These MEAs serve as promising bioelectronic platforms for conformal interfacing with the heart, monitoring cardiac physiology, and treating CVDs. This Review summarizes recent advances in soft implantable cardiac MEAs. We begin by introducing the fundamental principles of cardiac electrophysiology, followed by a detailed discussion of material candidates used in soft cardiac microelectrodes. We then review state-of-the-art cardiac MEAs for electrophysiological mapping and electrotherapy. Transparent and bioresorbable cardiac MEAs are elaborated. We further discuss multimodal devices that integrate electrical, optical, and mechanical functionalities for studying cardiac electrophysiology, optophysiology, and mechanophysiology. Finally, we highlight future directions that will advance soft cardiac MEAs toward next-generation cardiovascular diagnosis, monitoring, and therapy.
title_zh: 植入式心脏接口软微电极阵列的材料与设计策略
abstract_zh: 摘要 心血管疾病（CVDs）仍然是全球主要的死亡原因之一。然而，常规的诊断和治疗技术往往体积庞大、功能有限，并且缺乏对患有危及生命的心脏疾病患者进行连续高保真监测与治疗所需的机械柔软性。近年来，材料科学、器件工程与系统集成领域的进展推动了力学柔顺型微电极阵列（MEAs）的发展，其能够在体内监测并调控心脏的电学、光学与机械活动。这些MEAs作为有前景的生物电子平台，可与心脏实现共形接口，用于监测心脏生理并治疗CVDs。本综述总结了软性可植入心脏MEAs的最新进展。我们首先介绍心脏电生理学的基本原理，随后详细讨论用于软性心脏微电极的候选材料。然后，我们评述了用于电生理标测与电治疗的最先进心脏MEAs，并详细阐述了透明与生物可吸收心脏MEAs。我们进一步讨论了集成电学、光学与机械功能的多模态器件，用于研究心脏电生理学、光生理学与力生理学。最后，我们展望了推动软性心脏MEAs迈向下一代心血管诊断、监测与治疗的未来方向。

title: Flexible Cellulose Nanofibril-Based Surface-Enhanced Raman Scattering Substrate via Silver–Ammonia-Mediated In SituPhotoreduction for Pesticide Residue Detection and Full-Spectrum Thiram Quantification
abstract: Abstract Uniform and reproducible Ag nanostructures are essential for flexible cellulose-based surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) substrates. Herein, a flexible SERS substrate was fabricated by in situ photoreduction of a silver–ammonia precursor on TEMPO-oxidized cellulose nanofibril (TOCNF) films without external reducing agents or surfactants during Ag photoreduction. Compared with an AgNO3 precursor control, the silver–ammonia system reached its optimal SERS response within a shorter irradiation time (25 vs 70 min) and produced more homogeneous AgNP assemblies. The optimized substrate enabled detection of thiram and thiabendazole with limits of detection of 1.39 × 10–8 and 1.16 × 10–7 M, respectively while characteristic signals remained distinguishable on tomato surfaces at 0.48 and 1.61 ng/cm2. To improve thiram quantification over a broad concentration range, full-spectrum PLS, linear SVR, and RFR models were evaluated. RFR provided the best predictive performance (Rp2 = 0.9859, RMSEP = 0.1839, and RPD = 8.50) and yielded recoveries of 108.28% and 103.37% for tomato samples spiked at 96 and 9.6 ng/cm2, respectively. These results demonstrate precursor-dependent photochemical growth of SERS-active Ag nanostructures on flexible TOCNF films and the utility of full-spectrum nonlinear regression for thiram quantification.
title_zh: 基于银氨介导原位光还原的柔性纤维素纳米纤丝表面增强拉曼散射基底用于农药残留检测及福美双全光谱定量分析
abstract_zh: 摘要 均匀且可重现的Ag纳米结构对于柔性纤维素基表面增强拉曼散射（SERS）基底至关重要。本文中，在不使用外部还原剂或表面活性剂的情况下，通过TEMPO氧化纤维素纳米纤丝（TOCNF）薄膜上银氨前驱体的原位光还原制备了柔性SERS基底。与AgNO3前驱体对照相比，银氨体系在更短的光照时间内（25 vs 70 min）即达到最佳SERS响应，并产生更均匀的AgNP组装体。优化后的基底可检测福美双和噻菌灵，检出限分别为1.39 × 10–8和1.16 × 10–7 M，同时在番茄表面上0.48和1.61 ng/cm2浓度下特征信号仍可区分。为了在宽浓度范围内改进福美双的定量分析，评估了全光谱PLS、线性SVR和RFR模型。RFR提供了最佳预测性能（Rp2 = 0.9859，RMSEP = 0.1839，RPD = 8.50），对加标96和9.6 ng/cm2的番茄样品的回收率分别为108.28%和103.37%。这些结果展示了柔性TOCNF薄膜上依赖于前驱体的SERS活性Ag纳米结构光化学生长，以及全光谱非线性回归在福美双定量中的实用性。

title: Sucrose-Assisted Interface Engineering of Boron Nitride for BT-Based High-Frequency Electronic Packaging Substrates with Low Dielectric Loss and Enhanced Thermal Conductivity
abstract: Abstract The rapid evolution of high-frequency communication, heterogeneous integration, and high-power-density packaging technologies has imposed increasingly stringent requirements for low-loss signal transmission and efficient heat dissipation on polymer-based packaging substrates. Herein, a BN interfacial engineering strategy combining sucrose-assisted mechanochemical activation with silane coupling was developed, and the resulting functionalized BN (f-BN) and SiO2 were incorporated as hybrid fillers into glass fiber fabric-reinforced bismaleimide-triazine (BT) resin composites. The results reveal that sucrose-assisted ball milling generated a hydroxyl-rich active layer on the BN surface, enabling the subsequent grafting of phenylamino silane and thereby improving the dispersion and interfacial bonding of f-BN within the composites. With the partial replacement of SiO2 by thermally conductive f-BN, the f-BN45 composite achieved an extremely low dielectric loss (Df) of 0.003 at 10 GHz and a through-plane thermal conductivity of 1.53 W m–1 K–1, which was 86.9% higher than that of the composite filled only with SiO2. In addition to its low Df and enhanced heat-conduction capability, f-BN45 also exhibited improved dimensional stability of the composites, as reflected by an X-axis CTE of 7.2 ppm/°C, while maintaining stable dielectric performance over a wide temperature range. Practical power device heat-dissipation evaluation and finite element simulations further confirmed the advantage of f-BN45 in chip thermal management. This work highlights sucrose-assisted surface activation combined with silane coupling as an effective route to tailoring the BN/resin interface, offering a feasible paradigm for high-performance BT-based composites in high-frequency electronic packaging and thermal management applications.
title_zh: 蔗糖辅助氮化硼界面工程用于低介电损耗和增强导热性的BT基高频电子封装基板
abstract_zh: 摘要 高频通信、异构集成和高功率密度封装技术的快速演进，对聚合物基封装基板的低损耗信号传输和高效散热提出了日益严格的要求。本文开发了一种结合蔗糖辅助机械化学活化与硅烷偶联的BN界面工程策略，并将所得功能化BN（f-BN）与SiO2作为混合填料引入玻璃纤维布增强双马来酰亚胺-三嗪（BT）树脂复合材料中。结果表明，蔗糖辅助球磨在BN表面生成了富含羟基的活性层，实现了苯氨基 silane 的后续接枝，从而改善了f-BN在复合材料中的分散与界面结合。通过用导热f-BN部分取代SiO2，f-BN45复合材料在10 GHz下实现了0.003的极低介电损耗（Df）以及1.53 W m–1 K–1的面外导热系数，比仅填充SiO2的复合材料高86.9%。除了低Df和增强的导热能力外，f-BN45还改善了复合材料的尺寸稳定性，其X轴CTE为7.2 ppm/°C，同时在宽温度范围内保持稳定的介电性能。实际功率器件散热评估和有限元模拟进一步证实了f-BN45在芯片热管理方面的优势。这项工作凸显了蔗糖辅助表面活化……

title: Strong Enhancement of Hydrogen Ion Conductivity in Y-Doped BaZrO3 Films on Al2O3 with the Assistance of Templated Epitaxy
abstract: Abstract Hydrogen ion conductors are a key component of solid-state ionics, including artificial intelligence devices, sensors, catalysts, and fuel cells. The interest has been focused on BaZr1–xYxO3 (BZYO, typically x = 0.2) among solid-state hydrogen ion conductors, but high conductivity is only observed in the grain-boundary-free BZYO epitaxial films deposited on impractical cubic substrates. Here, by virtue of a templated epitaxy, we significantly enhance hydrogen ion conductivity of BZYO films by one order of magnitude when we grow the films on industrially practical (0001)Al2O3 with the MgO template layer. X-ray diffraction and transmission electron microscopy reveal that the epitaxy-driven excellent crystallinity of BZYO films allows the suppression of hydrogen-blocking grain boundaries, enabling the facile movement of hydrogen ions. The discovery of fast hydrogen ion conduction in BZYO epitaxial films on Al2O3 will attract great attention for designing inorganic hydrogen ion conductors based on the structure–property relationship and promote economic benefits in hydrogen economy.
title_zh: 借助模板外延生长在Al2O3上强增强Y掺杂BaZrO3薄膜的氢离子电导率
abstract_zh: 摘要 氢离子导体是固态离子学的关键组成部分，应用包括人工智能器件、传感器、催化剂和燃料电池。在固态氢离子导体中，人们的关注点集中于BaZr1–xYxO3（BZYO，通常x = 0.2），但高电导率仅在沉积于不实用的立方基板上的无晶界BZYO外延薄膜中观察到。本文中，借助模板外延，当我们在工业实用的(0001)Al2O3上以MgO模板层生长BZYO薄膜时，其氢离子电导率显著提升了一个数量级。X射线衍射和透射电子显微镜表明，外延驱动的优异BZYO薄膜结晶质量可抑制阻挡氢离子的晶界，使氢离子得以顺畅移动。在Al2O3上BZYO外延薄膜中快速氢离子传导的发现，将引起基于结构–性能关系设计无机氢离子导体的极大关注，并促进氢经济的经济效益。

title: Waste-to-Wealth Engineering of Sugarcane Bagasse−Derived Carbon/Porous PDMS Composites for Efficient Triboelectric Energy Harvesting
abstract: Abstract Sustainable material design for high-performance triboelectric nanogenerators (TENGs) is crucial for advancing self-powered systems. In this study, agro-waste sugarcane bagasse (SCB) is transformed into a functional carbonaceous filler via a simple hydrothermal process and integrated with porous polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) to engineer an efficient hybrid triboelectric interface. The strategy offers an economically viable and environmentally benign fabrication route with potential for scale-up, highlighting a practical waste-to-wealth approach for value-added energy materials. The incorporation of alkali-treated sugarcane bagasse-derived carbon significantly enhanced the dielectric characteristics of the porous PDMS, increasing the dielectric constant from 5.2 to 7.7 and modifying the surface morphology and heterogeneous carbon−PDMS interfacial environment. The enhanced dielectric response, together with the modified surface and interfacial characteristics, contributes to the improved triboelectric performance of the composite. The optimized device delivers an output of 121.6 V, 8.8 μA, and 42.8 nC, along with a peak power density of 804 mW m−2, significantly outperforming pristine PDMS. Alkali activation further modifies the carbon structure and accessible pore characteristics, providing additional enhancement of the composite dielectric and triboelectric response. Beyond energy harvesting, the optimized device demonstrates the capability to operate as a self-powered impact sensor capable of detecting external vibrations in mechanical systems, highlighting its potential in energy conversion and sensing. This work presents a facile and sustainable pathway for developing high-performance biomass-derived triboelectric materials.
title_zh: 甘蔗渣衍生碳/多孔PDMS复合材料的变废为宝工程用于高效摩擦电能量收集
abstract_zh: 摘要 面向高性能摩擦电纳米发电机（TENGs）的可持续材料设计对于推进自供能系统至关重要。在本研究中，农业废弃物甘蔗渣（SCB）通过简单的水热工艺转化为功能性碳质填料，并与多孔聚二甲基硅氧烷（PDMS）集成，构筑出高效的混合摩擦电界面。该策略提供了一条经济可行且环境友好的制造路线，并具有规模化潜力，凸显了面向高附加值能源材料的变废为宝的实用途径。掺入碱处理的甘蔗渣衍生碳显著增强了多孔PDMS的介电特性，介电常数从5.2提高到7.7，并改变了表面形貌以及碳–PDMS非均相界面环境。增强的介电响应连同改性的表面与界面特性，共同促成了复合材料摩擦电性能的提升。优化后的器件输出为121.6 V、8.8 μA和42.8 nC，峰值功率密度为804 mW m−2，显著优于纯PDMS。碱活化进一步改变了碳结构和可及孔特性，为复合材料的介电与摩擦电响应提供了额外增强。除能量收集外，优化后的器件还展示了作为自供能冲击传感器的能力，可检测机械系统中的外部振动，凸显了其潜……

title: MXene-Coupled Sulfurization Strategy for MnCo2O4/MnCo2S4 Heterojunctions for Enhanced Overall Water Splitting
abstract: Abstract Developing low-cost and durable electrocatalysts with engineered heterogeneous interfaces to accelerate reaction kinetics remains a critical yet challenging path for advancing efficient water electrolysis. In this study, we present a facile two-step hydrothermal strategy for the fabrication of MnCo2O4/MnCo2S4 nanoarrays integrated with MXene nanosheets. Comprehensive experimental characterizations reveal that the incorporation of MXene significantly enhances the electronic conductivity and interfacial charge-transfer capability of the hybrid architecture, thereby facilitating water dissociation kinetics and boosting intrinsic electrocatalytic activity. Benefiting from the synergistic coupling among MnCo2O4, MnCo2S4, and MXene, the optimized MnCo2O4/MnCo2S4@MXene exhibits outstanding bifunctional electrocatalytic performance in 1.0 M KOH. The catalyst requires ultralow overpotentials of only 155.2 mV for HER and 216.6 mV for OER to achieve 10 mA cm–2. Remarkably, an overpotential of 288.4 mV is needed to deliver 50 mA cm–2 for the OER process. When the MnCo2O4/MnCo2S4@MXene heterostructure is employed as the cathode and anode as a noble metal-free overall water-splitting system, the assembled electrolyzer delivers a low cell voltage of 1.56 V at 10 mA cm–2, closely comparable to that of the benchmark RuO2//Pt/C device (1.53 V). In addition, the electrolyzer demonstrates excellent operational durability over 100 h of continuous electrolysis. The DFT results demonstrate that charge transfer from MCO/MCS to MXene modulates the electronic structure of the heterostructure, leading to enhanced electronic conductivity and accelerated charge-transport kinetics. These findings highlight the significant potential of interfacial MXene-engineered spinel/sulfide heterostructures as efficient and economically viable electrocatalysts for sustainable hydrogen production.
title_zh: MXene耦合硫化策略构建MnCo2O4/MnCo2S4异质结以增强全解水性能
abstract_zh: 摘要 开发低成本、耐用且具有工程化异质界面的电催化剂以加速反应动力学,仍然是推进高效电解水的一条关键而富有挑战性的路径。在本研究中,我们提出了一种简便的两步水热策略,用于制备与MXene纳米片集成的MnCo2O4/MnCo2S4纳米阵列。综合实验表征表明,MXene的引入显著增强了该复合结构的电子电导率和界面电荷转移能力,从而促进水解离动力学并提升本征电催化活性。得益于MnCo2O4、MnCo2S4与MXene之间的协同耦合,优化后的MnCo2O4/MnCo2S4@MXene在1.0 M KOH中表现出优异的双功能电催化性能。该催化剂在HER和OER中分别仅需155.2 mV和216.6 mV的超低过电位即可达到10 mA cm–2。值得注意的是,OER过程达到50 mA cm–2仅需288.4 mV的过电位。当MnCo2O4/MnCo2S4@MXene异质结构作为阴极和阳极构建无贵金属的全解水体系时,所组装的电解槽在10 mA cm–2下仅需1.56 V的低槽压,与基准RuO2//Pt/C器件(1.53 V)相当。此外,该电解槽在100 h连续电解中表现出优异的运行耐久性。DFT结果表明,电荷从MCO/MCS向MXene转移调控了异质结构的电子结构

title: Temperature-Regulated Growth of Thickness-Modulated Bi2O2Se Lateral Homojunctions for Self-Powered Broadband Photodetection
abstract: Abstract Two-dimensional lateral homojunctions can introduce built-in electric fields without dissimilar-material interfaces, but their direct construction remains challenging. Here, we report a temperature-regulated vapor-phase growth strategy for constructing thickness-modulated Bi2O2Se lateral homojunctions. By combining low-temperature lateral growth with rapid heating-induced local thickening, laterally continuous thin–thick regions are formed within individual Bi2O2Se flakes. The thickness-dependent band structure is expected to induce a band offset at the lateral interface, thereby generating a built-in electric field for carrier separation and zero-bias photodetection. The resulting self-powered photodetector exhibits a broadband response from 350 to 1050 nm, with a responsivity of 0.41 A/W, a detectivity of 2.48 × 1011 Jones, response/recovery times of 9.4/5.6 ms, and good linear power dependence. Moreover, single-pixel imaging demonstrates its potential for spatial optical sensing and self-powered imaging. This work provides a simple temperature-regulated route for engineering Bi2O2Se lateral homojunctions and highlights their promise for low-power broadband optoelectronics.
title_zh: 厚度调制Bi2O2Se横向同质结的温度调控生长用于自供电宽带光电探测
abstract_zh: 摘要 二维横向同质结可在不引入异质材料界面的情况下引入内置电场,但其直接构筑仍具挑战性。在此,我们报道了一种温度调控的气相生长策略,用于构筑厚度调制的Bi2O2Se横向同质结。通过将低温横向生长与快速升温诱导的局部增厚相结合,在单个Bi2O2Se薄片中形成了横向连续的薄-厚区域。厚度依赖的能带结构有望在横向界面处诱导能带偏移,从而产生用于载流子分离和零偏压光电探测的内置电场。所得的自供电光电探测器表现出350至1050 nm的宽波段响应,响应度为0.41 A/W,探测度为2.48 × 1011 Jones,响应/恢复时间为9.4/5.6 ms,并具有良好的线性功率依赖性。此外,单像素成像展示了其在空间光探测和自供电成像方面的潜力。这项工作提供了一种简单的温度调控途径来设计Bi2O2Se横向同质结,并凸显了其在低功耗宽波段光电子学中的前景。

title: Na–C Dynamic Interface-Induced Ion Tunneling for Ultrafast Sodium-Ion Transport in Mesoporous Carbon
abstract: Abstract Developing high-performance anode materials is critical for advancing sodium-ion batteries (SIBs), wherein slow ion transport kinetics remains a major bottleneck. Although surface/bulk engineering can reduce Na+ diffusion barriers, current strategies lack clear structure-kinetic correlations. Herein, we fabricate mesoscopic carbon spheres (MCS) via a scalable nano-emulsion co-assembly strategy to construct dynamic active interfaces for efficient Na+ transport. The mesoporous structure enhances Na+ accessibility, induces electron cloud rearrangement, and forms dynamic Na–C coordination channels, leading to a nearly four-order-of-magnitude enhancement in Na+ diffusion compared to non-porous carbon. MCS delivers a high reversible capacity of 336.6 mAh g–1 at 0.1 A g–1 and retains 110.4 mAh g–1 after 1000 cycles at 7.5 A g–1. Multiscale simulations (DFT/MD) reveal that precursor Na+ triggers electron cloud rearrangement at interfaces, forming Na–C channels with covalent characteristics. This reduces the diffusion barrier, enabling an ultrafast "interface-induced ion tunneling" migration. This work provides atomic-level insights into interfacial ion regulation and a scalable strategy for high-rate SIB anodes.
title_zh: Na–C动态界面诱导离子隧穿实现介孔碳中超快钠离子传输
abstract_zh: 摘要 开发高性能负极材料对推进钠离子电池至关重要,其中缓慢的离子传输动力学仍是主要瓶颈。尽管表面/体相工程可降低Na+扩散势垒,但现有策略缺乏明确的结构-动力学关联。本文中,我们通过可规模化的纳米乳液共组装策略制备了介观碳球,以构建动态活性界面实现高效的Na+传输。介孔结构增强了Na+的可及性,诱导电子云重排,并形成动态的Na–C配位通道,使Na+扩散相比无孔碳提升了近四个数量级。MCS在0.1 A g–1下展现出336.6 mAh g–1的高可逆容量,并在7.5 A g–1下循环1000次后仍保持110.4 mAh g–1。多尺度模拟揭示了前驱体Na+在界面处触发电子云重排,形成具有共价特征的Na–C通道。这降低了扩散势垒,实现了超快的"界面诱导离子隧穿"迁移。这项工作为界面离子调控提供了原子层面的洞察,并为高倍率SIB负极提供了可规模化策略。

title: Flexible Transparent Electrodes via a Grid-Patterned Structure of Epitaxially Synthesized Ag-Au Core-Shell Nanowire Networks
abstract: Abstract This study describes the synthesis of silver-gold core-shell nanowires and their integration into transparent heaters with well-defined grid patterns. By employing a controlled epitaxial growth strategy, we achieved uniform formation of gold shells on silver nanowires, which prevents structural degradation of the silver core and imparts exceptional chemical stability. This approach enables the fabrication of transparent heaters that combine high electrical conductivity, excellent optical transmittance, and outstanding durability. The fabricated heaters have a low sheet resistance of 14.2 Ω/sq and an optical transmittance exceeding 85% at 550 nm, while maintaining stable and robust performance under corrosive conditions, such as exposure to hydrogen peroxide and nitric acid. The heaters achieve uniform and stable Joule heating performance, effectively removing frost within 15 s and clearing fog within 7 s, making them suitable for automotive windshields, camera sensors, and outdoor electronic displays. This research establishes a platform for high-performance, durable, and transparent heating devices and highlights the significant potential of silver-gold core-shell nanowires for next-generation optoelectronic and thermal management applications.
title_zh: 通过外延合成Ag-Au核壳纳米线网络的网格图案化结构制备柔性透明电极
abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究描述了银-金核壳纳米线的合成及其在具有规整网格图案的透明加热器中的集成。通过采用可控外延生长策略,我们实现了金壳在银纳米线上的均匀形成,从而防止银核的结构退化并赋予其卓越的化学稳定性。该方法使透明加热器的制备能够兼具高电导率、优异的光透过率和出色的耐久性。所制备的加热器具有14.2 Ω/sq的低方块电阻和550 nm处超过85%的光透过率,同时在腐蚀性条件下(如暴露于过氧化氢和硝酸)保持稳定而 robust的性能。该加热器实现了均匀且稳定的焦耳加热性能,可在15 s内有效除霜、7 s内除雾,使其适用于汽车挡风玻璃、相机传感器和户外电子显示器。本研究为高性能、耐用且透明的加热器件建立了一个平台,并凸显了银-金核壳纳米线在下一代光电子和热管理应用中的巨大潜力。

title: Triptycene Branched Poly(Isatin-Biphenylene) Electrolytes for Bipolar Membrane Water Electrolyzers
abstract: Abstract Bipolar membrane water electrolysis (BPMWE) performance depends on the properties of two ion exchange layers and their interfacial compatibility. Herein, linear anion and cation exchange ionomers (PIB-QA and PIB-BS) are synthesized based on the same poly(biphenyl-isatin) backbone, and a linear BPM (PIB-L) with a nano-SnO2 catalytic interlayer is prepared via ultrasonic spray coating. A rigid triptycene moiety is introduced to prepare branched ionomers (PIB-QA-5% and PIB-BS-5%) and the corresponding BPM (PIB-Trip5%). The branching structure increases fractional free volume and ion-transport channel connectivity while providing high water uptake, low swelling, and dimensional stability, facilitating water dissociation, and interfacial stability. At 60 °C, PIB-Trip5% achieves 0.7 A cm−2 at 2.00 V and 2.29 V at 1.0 A cm−2 in pure-water electrolysis, and 1.5 A cm−2 at 2.00 V in an asymmetric acid-base electrolyzer. The electrolyzer operates at 0.5 A cm−2 for 200 h with a voltage decay rate of 0.87 mV h−1.
title_zh: 三蝶烯支化聚(靛红-联亚苯)电解质用于双极膜水电解器
abstract_zh: 摘要 双极膜水电解的性能取决于两层离子交换层的性质及其界面相容性。本文基于相同的聚(联苯-靛红)骨架合成了线性阴离子和阳离子交换离聚物(PIB-QA和PIB-BS),并通过超声喷涂制备了具有纳米SnO2催化中间层的线性双极膜。引入刚性三蝶烯结构单元以制备支化离聚物(PIB-QA-5%和PIB-BS-5%)及相应的双极膜。支化结构增加了自由体积分数和离子传输通道的连通性,同时提供高吸水率、低溶胀和尺寸稳定性,促进水解离和界面稳定性。在60 °C下,PIB-Trip5%在纯水电解中于2.00 V下达到0.7 A cm−2,于1.0 A cm−2下为2.29 V,并在非对称酸碱电解槽中于2.00 V下达到1.5 A cm−2。该电解槽在0.5 A cm−2下运行200 h,电压衰减率为0.87 mV h−1。

title: 2,2,6,6-Tetramethylpiperidine-1-oxyl (TEMPO)-Oxidized Cellulose Nanofibril-Reinforced Hydrogels for High-Output, Mechanically Robust Triboelectric Nanogenerators
abstract: Abstract With the rapid advancement of wearable sensors and the Internet of Things (IoT), self-powered systems have become essential for sustainable, low-maintenance electronics. Triboelectric nanogenerators (TENGs) are promising candidates; however, achieving high electrical output together with mechanical robustness remains challenging. Herein, we report an ultra-tough, stretchable TENG based on a conductive hydrogel reinforced with 2,2,6,6-tetramethylpiperidine-1-oxyl (TEMPO)-oxidized cellulose nanofibrils (TOCNFs). The design delivers a dual benefit: abundant carboxyl groups on TOCNFs enhance triboelectric charge transfer and boost electrical output, while TOCNFs form a robust triple cross-linked network that imparts durability. The resulting TENG achieves an open-circuit voltage of 69.4 V, a short-circuit current of 2.8 μA, a power density of 12.15 μW/cm2, a tensile strength of 3.05 MPa at 908% elongation, and a compressive strength of 4.10 MPa at 80% strain, outperforming most reported hydrogel-based TENGs. For sensing, it exhibits a sensitivity of 0.36 V·kPa–1, fast response and recovery times (298/270 ms), and stable operation over 5000 cycles. Additionally, the device powers microelectronics, enables wireless Morse-code communication, and supports self-powered health monitoring. This work resolves the common trade-off between performance and durability in TENG design and provides a versatile platform for self-powered wearable electronics and IoT applications.
title_zh: 2,2,6,6-四甲基哌啶-1-氧自由基(TEMPO)氧化纤维素纳米纤丝增强水凝胶用于高输出、机械稳健的摩擦纳米发电机
abstract_zh: 摘要 随着可穿戴传感器和物联网的快速发展,自供电系统已成为可持续、低维护电子产品的必需品。摩擦纳米发电机是极具前景的候选者;然而,同时实现高电输出与机械鲁棒性仍具挑战性。在此,我们报道了一种基于2,2,6,6-四甲基哌啶-1-氧自由基氧化纤维素纳米纤维增强导电水凝胶的超韧、可拉伸TENG。该设计带来双重益处:TOCNF上丰富的羧基增强了摩擦电荷转移并提升了电输出,同时TOCNF形成了坚固的三重交联网络,赋予其耐久性。所得TENG实现了69.4 V的开路电压、2.8 μA的短路电流、12.15 μW/cm2的功率密度、908%伸长率下3.05 MPa的拉伸强度以及80%应变下4.10 MPa的压缩强度,优于大多数已报道的基于水凝胶的TENG。在传感方面,其灵敏度为0.36 V·kPa–1,响应/恢复时间快速(298/270 ms),并在5000次循环中稳定运行。此外,该器件可为微电子设备供电,实现无线摩尔斯电码通信,并支持自供电健康监测。这项工作解决了TENG设计中性能与耐久性之间的常见权衡问题,为自供电可穿戴电子和物联网应用提供了一个多功能平台。

title: A General Photoredox Platform for the Hydroarylation of Olefins
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Alkene hydroarylation provides a direct strategy for merging aryl groups with alkene-derived C(sp3)-rich fragments, yet general methods that employ abundant aryl bromides across diverse alkene classes remain elusive. Herein, we report XAT-Heck, a radical hydroarylation platform that couples aryl bromides with alkenes under mild photoredox conditions through halogen-atom transfer (XAT)-enabled aryl radical generation. The method accommodates terminal, internal, and gem-disubstituted alkenes, as well as a broad range of heteroaryl and aryl bromides. Chemical-space mapping further supports the broad coverage of commercially available olefin and aryl bromide space. The versatility of this platform is showcased through deuterium incorporation, medium-ring formation, late-stage functionalization, and proteolysis-targeting chimera (PROTAC) library construction.
title_zh: 用于烯烃氢芳基化的通用光氧化还原平台
abstract_zh: 摘要 烯烃氢芳基化反应提供了一种将芳基与富含C(sp3)的烯烃衍生片段相结合的直接策略，然而采用丰富的芳基溴化物并适用于多种烯烃类型的通用方法仍然难以实现。本文报道了XAT-Heck，这是一种自由基氢芳基化平台，可在温和的光氧化还原条件下通过卤原子转移（XAT）实现的芳基自由基生成，将芳基溴化物与烯烃偶联。该方法适用于末端烯烃、内烯烃和偕二取代烯烃，以及范围广泛的杂芳基和芳基溴化物。化学空间映射进一步支持了对市售烯烃和芳基溴化物空间的广泛覆盖。该平台的多功能性通过氘掺入、中环形成、后期官能团化以及蛋白降解靶向嵌合体（PROTAC）文库构建得以展示。

title: Unlocking Triple Interfacial Synergy in All-Inorganic Carbon-Based CsPbI2Br Perovskite Solar Cells via Molecular Interface Engineering
abstract: Abstract All-inorganic CsPbI2Br perovskite solar cells suffer from efficiency and stability losses caused by defect-mediated recombination, unfavorable interfacial energetics, and environmental degradation in carbon-based architectures. Here, we report a molecular interface engineering strategy using N-methyl-4-bromobenzylammonium chloride (4-Br-NMBACl) that enables a triple interfacial synergy addressing these limitations simultaneously. The molecular post-treatment effectively passivates undercoordinated Pb2+ defects and halide vacancies through the coordination interactions of –NH– groups and the defect-compensating effect of Cl- ions, respectively, while simultaneously optimizing interfacial energy-level alignment and enhancing moisture resistance. These synergistic effects suppress non-radiative recombination, improve charge extraction, and enhance environmental resistance. As a result, the devices deliver a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 14.22%, compared with 12.17% for control devices, together with significantly improved operational and ambient stability. This work demonstrates a simple and effective molecular strategy for simultaneously regulating defect chemistry, interfacial energetics, and moisture resistance in all-inorganic perovskite solar cells.
title_zh: 通过分子界面工程解锁全无机碳基CsPbI2Br钙钛矿太阳能电池的三重界面协同效应
abstract_zh: 摘要 全无机CsPbI2Br钙钛矿太阳能电池在碳基结构中因缺陷介导的复合、不利的界面能级排列以及环境退化而导致效率和稳定性损失。在此，我们报道了一种采用N-甲基-4-溴苄基氯化铵（4-Br-NMBACl）的分子界面工程策略，该策略实现了同时解决这些限制的三重界面协同效应。该分子后处理通过–NH–基团的配位作用和Cl-离子的缺陷补偿效应，分别有效钝化了配位不足的Pb2+缺陷和卤素空位，同时优化了界面能级排列并增强了抗湿性。这些协同效应抑制了非辐射复合，改善了电荷提取，并增强了环境耐受性。因此，器件的功率转换效率（PCE）达到14.22%，而对照器件为12.17%，同时运行稳定性和环境稳定性显著提高。这项工作展示了一种简单而有效的分子策略，可同时调控全无机钙钛矿太阳能电池中的缺陷化学、界面能级和抗湿性。

title: A Ruthenium Dihydride-Catalyzed Hydrogenation of Thioureas: A Mild and Practical Approach from CS2 to Methanethiol
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Catalytic hydrogenation of thioureas, which are readily formed from CS2 and amines, can provide alternative, mild approaches to the hydrogenation of the CS2 pollutant to high-value methanethiol, an important raw material for the synthesis of methionine. We report herein a highly active Ru-dihydride [(triphos)Ru(PPh3)H2], which features an exchangeable PPh3 ligand that has a relatively low dissociation energy barrier, thereby efficiently catalyzing the hydrogenation of thioureas without any additives. Other reducible organosulfur compounds such as thiocarbamates, thioamides, or thioesters, even unsaturated sulfur-containing polymer resins, have also been successfully achieved. The wide utility indicates that this is a universal platform that can produce thiols under neutral and mild reaction conditions without generating waste, which will drive this ruthenium dihydride to have a broader applicability and accessibility.
title_zh: 钌二氢化物催化硫脲的氢化反应：一种由CS2温和实用制备甲硫醇的方法
abstract_zh: 摘要 硫脲可由CS2和胺轻松形成，其催化氢化可为将CS2污染物加氢转化为高价值甲硫醇（蛋氨酸合成的重要原料）提供替代性的温和方法。本文报道了一种高活性的Ru-二氢化物[(triphos)Ru(PPh3)H2]，其具有一个解离能垒相对较低的可交换PPh3配体，从而无需任何添加剂即可高效催化硫脲的氢化反应。其他可还原的有机硫化合物，如硫代氨基甲酸酯、硫代酰胺或硫酯，甚至含硫的不饱和聚合物树脂，也均已成功实现转化。这种广泛的适用性表明这是一个通用平台，可在中性温和的反应条件下生产硫醇且不产生废物，这将推动这种钌二氢化物获得更广泛的应用性和可获得性。
