title: An atomic-scale digital twin of dislocation systems
abstract: Dislocations, the primary carriers of plasticity, govern the mechanical properties of crystalline materials ranging from metals to semiconductors. The atomic-scale behavior of a dislocation is controlled by multi‑dimensional fields encompassing structure, stress, energy, and chemical environment, which govern its intrinsic mobility and interactions with other defects. However, simultaneously capturing such multi‑dimensional information remains a long‑standing challenge, since the atomic‑resolution images primarily reveal structural features like atomic positions, while other critical fields remain hidden. Here, we introduce AtomDiT, a machine learning-based framework that creates a digital twin of dislocations directly from a high‑resolution micrograph. AtomDiT uses atomistic simulations to learn the relationships between local atomic environment and multi‑dimensional fields, and transfers this knowledge to experimental images. Derived from a single image, it identifies dislocation types and core positions, constructing the surrounding mechanical and chemical fields. AtomDiT is applicable across various crystal structures, dislocation types, chemical complexities, and deformation states. Using the digital twin, we reveal how stress and elemental distribution regulate dislocation‑interface interactions, offering mechanistic insights into plasticity in chemically and structurally complex systems. Based on atomic structures derived from experimental measurements, the digital twin directly serves as a data foundation for mesoscale and continuum‑level plasticity models, bridging atomic‑scale defect dynamics with higher‑scale material behavior.
title_zh: 位错系统的原子级数字孪生
abstract_zh: 对可能出现“负闰秒”的担忧正在加速废除闰秒调整的计划。位错作为塑性的主要载体，决定着从金属到半导体等各类晶体材料的力学性能。位错的原子尺度行为受结构、应力、能量和化学环境等多维场控制，这些场决定了位错的固有迁移率及其与其他缺陷的相互作用。然而，同时获取这种多维信息长期以来仍是一项挑战，因为原子分辨率图像主要揭示原子位置等结构特征，而其他关键场仍然隐藏不见。本文中，我们介绍了AtomDiT，这是一种基于机器学习的框架，可直接从高分辨率显微图像构建位错的数字孪生。AtomDiT利用原子模拟学习局部原子环境与多维场之间的关系，并将这一知识迁移到实验图像中。它可从单幅图像中识别位错类型和核心位置，并构建周围的力学和化学场。AtomDiT适用于各种晶体结构、位错类型、化学复杂性和变形状态。利用该数字孪生，我们揭示了应力和元素分布如何调控位错-界面相互作用，为化学和结构复杂体系中的塑性提供了机理认识。基于实验测量得到的原子结构，该数字孪生可直接作为介观尺度和连续介质水平塑性模型的数据基础，架起了

title: Palladium nanoparticles supported on a Ni-Based MOF for low-temperature acetylene semi-hydrogenation: breaking the activity-selectivity trade-off
abstract: The semi-hydrogenation of acetylene in excess ethylene is of great importance in the petrochemical industry. Conventional catalysts typically rely on Pd sites that simultaneously activate H2 and C2H2, often resulting in a trade-off effect between activity and selectivity. In this work, Pd nanoparticles are stabilized by a Ni-based metal-organic framework (Ni-MOF) to afford a Pd/Ni-MOF composite. The Ni-MOF not only selectively concentrates and activates acetylene, but also modulates the electronic structure of Pd, suppressing its inherent acetylene activation ability and enabling it to preferentially activate hydrogen. This design establishes separated activation sites for hydrogen and acetylene, thereby achieving high ethylene selectivity while maintaining excellent catalytic activity even at low temperatures. This Pd/Ni-MOF achieves > 99.6% acetylene conversion with 92% ethylene selectivity at 80°C, surpassing most Pd-based catalysts. This synergistic mechanism effectively suppresses over-hydrogenation while preserving high activity, offering a promising strategy for rational design of heterogeneous catalysts for selective hydrogenation.
title_zh: 负载于Ni基MOF上的钯纳米粒子用于低温乙炔半加氢：打破活性-选择性权衡
abstract_zh: 过量乙烯中乙炔的半加氢在石油化学工业中具有重要意义。传统催化剂通常依赖同时活化H2和C2H2的Pd位点，往往导致活性与选择性之间的权衡效应。在本工作中，通过Ni基金属有机框架（Ni-MOF）稳定Pd纳米颗粒，构建了Pd/Ni-MOF复合材料。Ni-MOF不仅能选择性富集并活化乙炔，还能调控Pd的电子结构，抑制其固有的乙炔活化能力，使其优先活化氢气。这一设计建立了氢气和乙炔的分离活化位点，从而即使在低温下也能在保持优异催化活性的同时实现较高的乙烯选择性。该Pd/Ni-MOF在80°C下实现了>99.6%的乙炔转化率和92%的乙烯选择性，超越了大多数Pd基催化剂。这种协同机制在保持高活性的同时有效抑制了过度加氢，为选择性加氢多相催化剂的合理设计提供了一种有前景的策略。

title: Cross-scale integratable catalytic stirrer for aqueous-phase organic synthesis
abstract: Although aqueous-phase reactions are an environmentally friendly approach to organic synthesis, their effectiveness is limited by the inefficiency of coupling immiscible mass transfer with surface reactions. Here, we present a cross-scale, integratable catalytic stirrer that reduces this limitation by employing a synthesis strategy that intensifies the process. We demonstrate the stirrer’s effectiveness by using the hydrogenation of nitrobenzene in an aqueous phase as a model system. Production rates increase significantly under extremely mild conditions—by 26.7 and 9.7 times in water using hydrazine hydrate and H2 as hydrogen donors, respectively, compared to traditional hydrogenation in organic solvents using a powder catalyst. This strategy can be extended to synthesize a wide spectrum of amines (78 examples, 12 of which are drug intermediates), alkanes (9 examples) and alcohols (8 examples). We anticipate that our design strategy will facilitate the development of advanced systems that integrate catalysts and devices for significant yet challenging aqueous-phase transformations in multiphasic systems.
title_zh: 面向水相有机合成的跨尺度可集成催化搅拌器
abstract_zh: 尽管水相反应是一种环境友好的有机合成方法，但其效果受限于不互溶传质与表面反应之间耦合的低效性。在此，我们提出一种跨尺度、可集成的催化搅拌器，通过强化过程的合成策略来降低这一限制。我们以水相中硝基苯的加氢为模型体系，验证了该搅拌器的有效性。在极其温和的条件下，分别以水合肼和H2为氢源时，在水中的生产速率相比使用粉体催化剂在有机溶剂中的传统加氢分别提高了26.7倍和9.7倍。该策略可推广用于合成多种胺类（78例，其中12例为药物中间体）、烷烃（9例）和醇类（8例）。我们预期这一设计策略将促进催化剂与器件集成的高级系统的发展，以实现多相体系中重要而具有挑战性的水相转化。

title: Self-sufficient hydrogen transfer integrates plastic upcycling with biomass valorization
abstract: Waste plastics and biomass represent abundant renewable carbon resources, yet both remain underutilized due to inefficient recycling and valorization strategies. Here, we present a stoichiometrically self-sufficient hydrogen-transfer platform that directly integrates the valorization of oxygenated plastics with the reductive upgrading of biomass derivatives without external hydrogen or reductants. A bifunctional RuPd catalyst supported on rutile mediates selective hydrogen transfer from plastics, such as polyethylene terephthalate (PET), polylactic acid (PLA), and polyoxymethylene (POM), to biomass-derived substrates such as levulinic acid (LA) and guaiacol. Under mild aqueous conditions, the system delivers γ-valerolactone (86%) and terephthalic acid (95%) with high selectivity, a diverse substrate scope, and robust compatibility with real waste streams. Life cycle assessment across multiple functional units demonstrates consistent environmental benefits over conventional routes, including 21–41% lower greenhouse-gas emissions together with reduced resource scarcity and ecosystem-quality impacts. This self-sufficient hydrogen-transfer strategy establishes a modular synthesis platform that unifies plastic upcycling, hydrogen generation, and biomass valorization within a single catalytic system, providing a blueprint for advanced synthetic refineries powered by the complementary reactivity of waste-derived feedstocks.
title_zh: 自给自足的氢转移将塑料升级回收与生物质高值化利用相结合
abstract_zh: 废塑料和生物质是丰富的可再生碳资源，但由于低效的回收和资源化策略，两者的利用率仍然不足。在此，我们提出一种化学计量自给自足的氢转移平台，无需外部氢气或还原剂，直接将含氧塑料的资源化与生物质衍生物的还原升级相结合。负载于金红石上的双功能RuPd催化剂介导从塑料（如聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯（PET）、聚乳酸（PLA）和聚甲醛（POM））向生物质衍生底物（如乙酰丙酸（LA）和愈创木酚）的选择性氢转移。在温和的水相条件下，该体系以高选择性生成γ-戊内酯（86%）和对苯二甲酸（95%），具有广泛的底物适用范围，并对真实废物流具有稳健的兼容性。基于多个功能单位的生命周期评估表明，该路线相较传统路线具有一致的环境效益，包括温室气体排放降低21–41%，同时减少资源稀缺和生态系统质量影响。这种自给自足的氢转移策略建立了一个模块化合成平台，在单一催化体系中统一了塑料升级回收、制氢和生物质资源化，为以废料衍生原料互补反应性驱动的高级合成精炼厂提供了蓝图。

title: Late eocene uplift and erosion of eastern tibet initiated long-term cenozoic global cooling
abstract: Global cooling beginning ∼50 million years ago is commonly attributed to atmospheric CO2 drawdown driven by silicate weathering during uplift of the Tibetan Plateau and Himalaya. Yet direct, well-dated evidence connecting surface rise to cooling remains scarce. New paleoelevation and paleoenvironment data from the Mangkang Basin, Eastern Tibet, constrained by radiometrically anchored magnetostratigraphy and cyclostratigraphy, show rapid uplift from 3.3 ± 0.9 km to 4.3 ± 0.9 km with ∼5°C regional cooling between 35.7 and 35.2 Ma. Thus, Eastern Tibet attained near-modern elevations prior to the Eocene–Oligocene transition (EOT, 33.9 Ma), and long before major Himalayan uplift. This uplift is temporally correlated with increased orographic rainfall, initiation of Asia’s major rivers, enhanced sediment flux to marginal seas, and rising oceanic 87Sr/86Sr ratios. We suggest that late Eocene uplift and erosion of Eastern Tibet—not the later Miocene Himalaya uplift or plateau-wide rise—may have played an important role in driving the long-term CO2 decline and global cooling that ultimately culminated in the EOT.
title_zh: 始新世晚期青藏高原东部的隆升与侵蚀启动了新生代长期全球变冷
abstract_zh: 约5000万年前开始的全球降温通常归因于青藏高原和喜马拉雅隆升期间硅酸盐风化驱动的大气CO2消耗。然而，将地表抬升与降温直接联系起来的、有确切定年的直接证据仍然稀少。来自藏东芒康盆地的新古海拔和古环境数据（受放射性年代锚定的磁性地层学和旋回地层学约束）表明，在35.7至35.2 Ma之间，该区从3.3±0.9 km快速抬升至4.3±0.9 km，伴随约5°C的区域降温。因此，藏东在始新世-渐新世转折（EOT，33.9 Ma）之前、且远在喜马拉雅大规模隆升之前就达到了接近现代的海拔高度。此次抬升在时间上与地形雨增加、亚洲主要河流的起源、向边缘海沉积通量的增强以及海洋87Sr/86Sr比值的上升相关。我们认为，晚始新世藏东的抬升和侵蚀——而非稍晚的中新世喜马拉雅隆升或全高原范围的抬升——可能在驱动长期CO2下降和最终导致EOT的全球降温中发挥了重要作用。

title: Bright Red Self-Trapped Exciton Emission with Highly Linear Polarization in Bi-Doped Wide Bandgap In-Plane Anisotropic GaPS4
abstract: Abstract Self-trapped exciton (STE) emission from halides with high photoluminescence quantum yields (PLQYs) has been explored extensively in recent years. In contrast, studies on STE emission in thiophosphates are very limited, and the corresponding PLQY is rather low. Herein, we report an unexpected bright red STE emission with highly linear polarization in Bi-doped wide bandgap in-plane anisotropic van der Waals GaPS4 (Bi:GaPS4). The photoluminescence (PL) spectrum of Bi:GaPS4 exhibits two ultra-broadbands with a full width at half-maximum (FWHM) of 143/147 nm and a large Stokes shift of 1.54/1.81 eV. Although pristine GaPS4 is nonluminescent, Bi:GaPS4 displays a bright red emission with a PLQY of up to 14.1%. The excitation-power- and temperature-dependent PL reveals a typical excitonic recombination rather than defect-related emission, accompanied by a strong electron−phonon interaction, implying that this unexpected red emission can be assigned rationally to STEs. Notably, benefiting from the synergistic contributions of low-symmetry crystal structure and robust in-plane anisotropic electron−phonon interaction, Bi:GaPS4 demonstrates pronounced angle-resolved polarized Raman spectroscopy (ARPRS) and highly linear polarized emission. The degree of polarization (DOP) reaches as high as 0.54. This work offers an effective doping strategy to enhance the STE emission in GaPS4-based thiophosphates and highlights their potential applications in linear polarization-sensitive photonics and optoelectronics.
title_zh: Bi掺杂宽带隙面内各向异性GaPS4中具有高度线偏振的亮红色自陷激子发射
abstract_zh: 摘要 近年来，具有高光致发光量子产率（PLQYs）的卤化物自陷激子（STE）发光得到了广泛研究。相比之下，关于硫代磷酸盐中STE发光的研究非常有限，且相应的PLQY相当低。本文报道了Bi掺杂宽带隙面内各向异性范德华GaPS4（Bi:GaPS4）中一种出乎意料的明亮红色STE发光，并具有高度线偏振特性。Bi:GaPS4的光致发光（PL）光谱表现出两个超宽发射带，半峰全宽（FWHM）为143/147 nm，并具有1.54/1.81 eV的大斯托克斯位移。尽管本征GaPS4不发光，Bi:GaPS4却表现出明亮的红光发射，PLQY高达14.1%。激发功率和温度依赖的PL揭示了典型的激子复合而非缺陷相关发射，并伴随强烈的电子-声子相互作用，表明这种意外的红光发射可合理地归属于STE。值得注意的是，得益于低对称性晶体结构与稳健的面内各向异性电子-声子相互作用的协同贡献，Bi:GaPS4展现出显著的角度分辨偏振拉曼光谱（ARPRS）和高度线偏振发射，偏振度（DOP）高达0.54。这项工作提供了一种有效的掺杂策略来增强GaPS4基硫代磷酸盐的STE发光，并突显了其在线偏振敏感光子学和光电子学中的潜在应用。

title: Why are rich people so pessimistic? What the numbers say
abstract: Optimism about the future can seem in short supply nowadays, but people’s age, where they live and their expectations have a lot to do with it.
title_zh: 为什么富人如此悲观？数据怎么说
abstract_zh: 如今，对未来的乐观情绪似乎很稀缺，但人们的年龄、居住地点以及期望对此有很大影响。

title: Decoupling CO2 Availability from Bulk Solubility via Biohybrid Reaction–Diffusion Nanoconfinement
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Although contemporary CO2 reduction research is largely dominated by the search for novel active sites, the performance of even the most sophisticated catalysts remains fundamentally constrained by the sluggish mass transport of dissolved CO2. Here, we demonstrate that engineering the local chemical microenvironment is as critical as tuning intrinsic catalytic activity. Inspired by the functional orchestration of cyanobacterial carboxysomes, we report a biomimetic interface that integrates carbonic anhydrase within copper phosphate nanoflowers to establish a reaction–diffusion nanoreactor. Hyperspectral micro-FTIR imaging reveals a spatially localized and quantitatively enhanced CO2-associated signal at the biohybrid interface, consistent with the formation of an interfacial CO2 reservoir sustained by enzymatic bicarbonate dehydration. This interfacial CO2 enrichment directly translates into enhanced carbon utilization, manifested by higher conversion rates and improved selectivity toward carbon-derived reduction products relative to the enzyme-free control. Real-time online electrochemical mass spectrometry confirms a shift in selectivity toward carbon-derived products under conditions where conventional electrodes are transport-limited. This work establishes that shifting the focus from material-bound kinetics to interface-driven carbon management is also a strategy for advancing electrosynthesis.
title_zh: 通过生物杂化反应–扩散纳米限域将CO2可利用性与整体溶解度解耦
abstract_zh: 摘要 尽管当代CO2还原研究主要集中于寻找新型活性位点，但即使是最先进的催化剂，其性能仍从根本上受到溶解CO2缓慢传质的制约。本文证明，调控局部化学微环境与调节本征催化活性同等重要。受蓝细菌羧酶体功能协同作用的启发，我们报道了一种仿生界面，将碳酸酐酶整合到磷酸铜纳米花中，构建了反应-扩散纳米反应器。高光谱显微FTIR成像显示，在生物杂化界面处存在空间局域化且定量增强的CO2相关信号，这与酶促碳酸氢盐脱水所维持的界面CO2储库的形成相一致。这种界面CO2富集直接转化为更高的碳利用率，表现为相对于无酶对照组更高的转化速率和对碳基还原产物更好的选择性。实时在线电化学质谱证实，在传统电极受传质限制的条件下，选择性向碳基产物转移。这项工作确立了将关注点从材料束缚的动力学转向界面驱动的碳管理，同样是推进电合成的有效策略。

title: Nickel-Electrocatalyzed Anodic Enantioselective Acyloxylation and Cathodic Deacyloxylation of C–O Bonds
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Asymmetric catalysis is indispensable for the synthesis of chiral molecules, yet it is typically constrained by thermodynamic and kinetic barriers. Achieving stereoselective bond formation and cleavage within a single, catalytic platform would dramatically expand the power and versatility of asymmetric catalysis. We present an enantioselective nickel-electrocatalytic system that utilizes a spin–center shift (SCS) mechanism to enable selective C–O linkage transformations. A variety of commercially available carboxylic acids and 2-acylimidazoles can be directly coupled through anodic oxidative cross-dehydrogenative acyloxylation with excellent enantiomeric excess (up to 99% ee), and the resulting esters can be cleaved to release the carboxylic acids and 2-acylimidazoles via cathodic reduction (up to 92% yield). Mechanistic exploration revealed that the ferrocene mediator promotes the oxidative coupling process while suppressing the reductive cleavage pathway. This asymmetric electrocatalytic strategy enables flexible C–O transformations, facilitating a highly stereoselective and efficient acyloxylation–deacyloxylation process.
title_zh: 镍电催化阳极对映选择性酰氧基化与阴极脱酰氧基化C–O键
abstract_zh: 摘要 不对称催化对于手性分子的合成不可或缺，但通常受到热力学和动力学壁垒的限制。在单一催化平台上实现立体选择性的成键与断键将极大地拓展不对称催化的能力与通用性。我们提出了一种对映选择性的镍电催化体系，利用自旋-中心转移（SCS）机制实现选择性C–O键转化。多种市售羧酸和2-酰基咪唑可通过阳极氧化交叉脱氢酰氧基化直接偶联，获得优异的对映体过量（高达99% ee），所得酯可通过阴极还原裂解以释放羧酸和2-酰基咪唑（产率高达92%）。机理研究表明，二茂铁介体促进氧化偶联过程，同时抑制还原裂解路径。这种不对称电催化策略实现了灵活的C–O键转化，促进了高立体选择性和高效的酰氧基化-脱酰氧基化过程。

title: Highly Charged Porphyrin Molecular Wires
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Successive oxidations, or reductions, of an extended molecular π-system can give rise to significant changes in the electronic structure compared to the neutral or singly charged counterparts. In this work, we investigated highly reduced states of butadiyne-linked porphyrin oligomers with up to nine porphyrin units and one negative charge per porphyrin. CW-EPR and 1H Mims ENDOR spectroscopy were used to probe the proton hyperfine interactions in these polyanions. Both techniques show a continuous narrowing of the spectra with simultaneously increasing charge and oligomer length corresponding to a decrease in the magnitudes of the largest hyperfine interactions. This is consistent with density functional theory calculations that support delocalization of spin density over the entire lengths of the molecules with high degrees of spin polarization and nonuniform spin density distributions. These spin distributions can also be described by a Hubbard model with antiferromagnetic spin coupling between electrons on adjacent sites. Finding systems with coherent wave functions that span the entire length of π-conjugated molecules, up to a length of more than 10 nm, will help identifying suitable candidates capable of coherent electron tunneling through molecular junctions.
title_zh: 高电荷卟啉分子线
abstract_zh: 摘要 扩展分子π体系的连续氧化或还原可使其电子结构相比中性或单电荷对应体发生显著变化。在本工作中，我们研究了丁二炔连接的卟啉寡聚物的高度还原态，其中包含多达九个卟啉单元，每个卟啉带有一个负电荷。利用CW-EPR和1H Mims ENDOR光谱探测了这些多阴离子中的质子超精细相互作用。两种技术均表明，随着电荷数和寡聚物长度同时增加，谱图持续变窄，对应于最大超精细相互作用幅值的减小。这与密度泛函理论计算结果一致，计算支持自旋密度在整个分子长度上的离域，并具有高度的自旋极化和非均匀的自旋密度分布。这些自旋分布也可用Hubbard模型描述，其中相邻位点上的电子之间存在反铁磁自旋耦合。寻找相干波函数可覆盖π共轭分子整个长度（长度可超过10 nm）的体系，将有助于识别能够通过分子结实现相干电子隧穿的合适候选材料。

title: Topological Control of Carbon Nanohoops for Boosted Long-Range Coherent Transport
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Molecular topology offers a powerful yet underexplored strategy for controlling charge transport in molecular electronics. Here, we construct double-loop single-molecule junctions based on conjoined carbon bisnanohoops containing more than 15 phenylene units. Intrinsic curvature asymmetry between the two loops directs Au−π binding and enables controlled formation of distinct single-loop and double-loop transport configurations. The double-loop topology results in higher conductance and a substantially reduced attenuation factor compared with size-matched linear and single-loop analogues, allowing coherent tunneling to be sustained over transport lengths of up to ten phenylene units. Density functional theory calculations attribute this behavior to enhanced orbital coupling across phenylene units and improved electrode coupling arising from the double-loop connectivity. These results establish molecular topology as an effective design parameter for engineering long-range charge transport in π-conjugated systems.
title_zh: 碳纳米环的拓扑调控助力增强长程相干传输
abstract_zh: 摘要 分子拓扑为调控分子电子学中的电荷输运提供了一种强大但尚未充分探索的策略。在此，我们基于含有超过15个亚苯基单元的联体碳双纳米环构建了双环单分子结。两个环之间固有的曲率不对称性引导Au−π结合，并实现了不同单环和双环输运构型的可控形成。与尺寸匹配的线性及单环类似物相比，双环拓扑具有更高的电导和显著降低的衰减因子，使相干隧穿能够在长达十个亚苯基单元的输运长度上得以维持。密度泛函理论计算将这一行为归因于双环连接带来的跨亚苯基单元增强的轨道耦合以及改善的电极耦合。这些结果确立了分子拓扑作为设计π共轭体系中长程电荷输运的有效设计参数。

title: Correction to “Bioinspired Amine-Guided Polyphenol Coatings for Selective Bacterial Disruption and Osseointegration on Orthopedic Implants”

title: Computing Nucleation Rates from Confined Equilibria: The Critical Cluster Equivalence Principle
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Nucleation is a fundamental step in the formation of new materials, with nucleation rates governing phase-transition pathways and outcomes that influence material properties across chemistry, physics, and biology. Nevertheless, extracting nucleation rates remains challenging: experiments are limited by the microscopic length scales involved, while molecular simulations are hindered by the rare-event nature of nucleation and the large system sizes required to sample low-supersaturation regimes typical of experiments and industrial processing. Here, we build on the established thermodynamic correspondence between stable clusters in small, closed systems and critical clusters in open systems and develop a multicomponent extension, the Critical Cluster Equivalence Principle, that transforms this correspondence into a practical workflow for calculating nucleation rates. We employ this equivalence to determine solvent-mediated NaCl crystal nucleation driving forces and rates over a wide range of supersaturations (SNaCl ∈ [1.5, 4]) and further validate the framework by benchmarking against curvature-corrected homogeneous nucleation rates for argon vapor condensation. This has been achieved using a small number of brute-force, finite-size simulations in which cluster-size statistics and monomer-exchange dynamics in the steady-state map directly onto critical clusters in macroscopic systems. By combining this multicomponent correspondence with the computational approach developed here, the current investigation has obtained nucleation rates in excellent agreement with experiments and enhanced sampling simulations. This approach provides a unified and generalizable tool for predicting nucleation rates with minimal computational effort, enabling routine application across a wide range of material systems.
title_zh: 由受限平衡计算成核速率：临界团簇等价原理
abstract_zh: 摘要 成核是新物质形成过程中的基本步骤，成核速率决定相变路径与结果，进而影响化学、物理学和生物学领域的材料性质。然而，提取成核速率仍然充满挑战：实验受限于所涉及的微观长度尺度，而分子模拟则受限于成核的稀少事件特性，以及在实验和工业加工中典型的低过饱和条件下采样所需的大体系尺寸。在此，我们基于小尺寸封闭体系中稳定团簇与开放体系中临界团簇之间已确立的热力学对应关系，发展了其多组分扩展，即临界团簇等效原理（Critical Cluster Equivalence Principle），将该对应关系转化为计算成核速率的实用工作流程。我们利用这一等效原理，在宽广的过饱和度范围（SNaCl ∈ [1.5, 4]）内确定了溶剂介导的NaCl晶体成核驱动力和速率，并通过与氩蒸气冷凝的曲率校正均相成核速率进行基准比较，进一步验证了该框架。这些成果是通过少量暴力（brute-force）有限尺寸模拟获得的，其中稳态下的团簇尺寸统计和单体交换动力学可直接映射到宏观体系中的临界团簇。通过将这一多组分对应关系与此处发展的计算方法相结合，本研究获得的成核速率与实验结果高度吻合

title: Anisotropic Defect-Induced Orbital Reordering Enables Coherent Charge Redistribution and Selective Photocatalytic CO2 Reduction in Metal–Organic Frameworks
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Photocatalytic CO2 reduction in metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) is often limited by inefficient charge separation and poorly defined active sites, while the role of crystallographic defect heterogeneity remains unclear. Taking MIL-125-NH2 as a prototypical system, we demonstrate that inequivalent oxygen vacancies dictate photocatalytic behavior through defect-site-dependent orbital reconstruction. By combining time-dependent density functional theory with nonadiabatic molecular dynamics, we show that axial and equatorial vacancies of TiO6 cage induce distinct Ti 3d electronic configurations, leading to markedly different carrier dynamics. Axial vacancies trigger cooperative t2g–eg orbital reordering, suppress coherent electron–hole overlap, accelerate decoherence, and prolong carrier lifetime, whereas equatorial vacancies exhibit the opposite behavior. This electronic disparity directly translates into catalytic outcomes: axial vacancies enable efficient CO2 activation via synergistic σ-type and π-type interactions, stabilizing bent intermediates and selectively driving HCOOH formation with overpotentials of less than 0.05 eV, while equatorial vacancies remain largely inactive. These findings identify defect-site anisotropy as a decisive descriptor and establish orbital-level defect engineering as a general strategy for designing high-performance photocatalysts.
title_zh: 各向异性缺陷诱导的轨道重排实现相干电荷重新分布及金属–有机框架中的选择性光催化CO2还原
abstract_zh: 摘要 金属有机骨架（MOFs）中的光催化CO2还原往往受限于低效的电荷分离和定义不明确的活性位点，而晶体学缺陷非均质性的作用仍不清楚。以MIL-125-NH2为典型体系，我们证明了不等价氧空位通过依赖缺陷位点的轨道重构决定光催化行为。通过将含时密度泛函理论与非绝热分子动力学相结合，我们表明TiO6笼的轴向和赤道空位诱导出截然不同的Ti 3d电子组态，导致明显不同的载流子动力学。轴向空位引发协同的t2g–eg轨道重排，抑制相干的电子–空穴重叠，加速退相干并延长载流子寿命，而赤道空位则表现出相反的行为。这种电子结构差异直接转化为催化结果：轴向空位通过σ型和π型协同相互作用实现高效的CO2活化，稳定弯曲中间体并以低于0.05 eV的过电位选择性驱动HCOOH生成，而赤道空位基本无活性。这些发现将缺陷位点各向异性确定为决定性描述符，并确立了轨道级缺陷工程作为设计高性能光催化剂的通用策略。

title: Nickel-Catalyzed Regio-Controllable α- or β-Hydroalkylation of α,β-Unsaturated Amides
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Novel transition-metal-catalyzed approaches to modulate chemo- and regioselectivity provide opportunities to tailor C–C bond formations from a common substrate, thereby diversifying accessible products and expanding chemists’ synthetic repertoire. Herein, a Ni-catalyzed chemo- and regioselective cross-electrophile coupling reaction of unsaturated amides with unactivated alkyl bromides has been developed. Most notably, the reactivity can be controlled to alkylate the unsaturated amide at the α- or β-carbon with excellent regioselectivity. The selectivity is attributed to subtle differences in the bidentate nitrogen-based ligand architectures and the additive (CaCl2). Mechanistic and DFT studies support two different reaction pathways. The reactivity patterns developed herein are distinct from previous reports and have potential applications in the synthesis of pharmaceuticals.
title_zh: 镍催化区域可控的α,β-不饱和酰胺α-或β-羟烷基化
abstract_zh: 摘要 新型过渡金属催化方法可用于调控化学选择性和区域选择性，为从同一底物定制C–C键形成提供了机会，从而丰富可获得的产物并拓展化学家的合成手段。本文发展了一种Ni催化的不饱和酰胺与非活化烷基溴的化学和区域选择性交叉亲电偶联反应。最值得注意的是，可以通过调控反应性，以优异的区域选择性在α-或β-碳上对不饱和酰胺进行烷基化。该选择性源于双齿氮配体结构以及添加剂（CaCl2）的细微差异。机理和DFT研究支持两种不同的反应路径。本文发展的反应性模式有别于以往报道，在药物合成中具有潜在应用价值。

title: n-Type Conjugated Polymers: Molecular Design, Material Properties, and Device Applications
abstract: Abstract Both n-type and p-type conjugated polymers play vital roles in the advancement and commercialization of polymer electronics. Through the tremendous efforts of scientists and engineers in this field over the past decade, n-type polymer semiconductors have experienced remarkable progress in nearly every aspect. However, most of the reported high-performance polymer semiconductors still exhibit p-type characteristics. The performance gap between p-type and n-type polymer semiconductors has become the Achilles’ heel of polymer electronics, hindering the development of emerging applications such as logic circuits. Therefore, a timely and comprehensive overview of recent advances in the molecular design, material properties, and device applications of n-type conjugated polymers is essential to facilitate the development of high-performance n-type polymer materials. This review offers a comprehensive overview of recent advancements in n-type conjugated polymers, focusing on their fundamental optoelectronic properties, strategic molecular design, and emerging device applications. It starts by introducing the basic principles and historical background and highlighting both the importance and the challenge of developing effective n-type conjugated polymers. Subsequently, it systematically establishes structure–property relationships by first outlining key characteristics, including energy level, charge transport property, morphology, and mechanical property, and then correlates them with crucial molecular design strategies. This review also outlines the important applications and provides an overview of the critical progress in emerging optoelectrical devices, including organic solar cells and organic field-effect transistors. Finally, the challenges and promising research directions for n-type conjugated polymers are presented, which provide valuable guidance for the design of high-performance n-type polymer semiconductors and the exploration of more advanced applications in the future.
title_zh: n型共轭聚合物：分子设计、材料性能与器件应用
abstract_zh: 摘要 n型和p型共轭聚合物在聚合物电子学的发展和商业化进程中均发挥着重要作用。得益于该领域科学家和工程师在过去十年中的巨大努力，n型聚合物半导体几乎在各个方面都取得了显著进展。然而，大多数已报道的高性能聚合物半导体仍表现出p型特性。p型与n型聚合物半导体之间的性能差距已成为聚合物电子学的阿喀琉斯之踵，阻碍了逻辑电路等新兴应用的发展。因此，及时而全面地综述n型共轭聚合物在分子设计、材料性质和器件应用方面的最新进展，对于促进高性能n型聚合物材料的发展至关重要。本综述全面概述了n型共轭聚合物的最新进展，重点关注其基本光电性质、战略性分子设计以及新兴器件应用。本文首先介绍基本原理和历史背景，并强调开发高效n型共轭聚合物的重要性与挑战。随后，通过首先概述能级、电荷传输性质、形貌和力学性质等关键特性，并将其与关键的分子设计策略相关联，系统地建立了结构–性质关系。本综述还概述了重要应用

title: Sonochemical Surface Grafting Using Diazonium Salts
abstract: Abstract Surface modification via the attachment of organic molecules with specific end functionalities has attracted significant attention, driven by applications in chemical sensors and biosensors, electrocatalysis, and molecular electronics. Among the available approaches, electrochemical reduction of diazonium salts to form surface-bound organic thin films is one of the most widely used methods for chemically modifying metals, carbon materials, and semiconductors. Here, we report a nonelectrochemical approach to diazonium-derived thin-film formation, in which surfaces are immersed in a dilute diazonium solution (1 mM) containing traces of water and dimethyl sulfoxide and exposed to probe ultrasonication (400 W, 24 kHz). Ultrasonication induces cavitation, generating a transient reducing environment, primarily via hydrogen radicals formed upon bubble collapse, which enables diazonium reduction at the surface. Prior to reduction, interfacial electrostatics regulate the local concentration of the cationic diazonium precursor near the surface by promoting or hindering its pre-accumulation at the surface. For semiconducting Si–H, this electrostatic effect can be controlled by the doping type, with p-type and n-type Si producing opposite surface potentials and therefore different degrees of diazonium accumulation. Thus, sonication supplies the hydrogen radicals required for reduction, whereas substrate electrostatics determine precursor pre-concentration and thereby influence the extent of grafting. This method enables grafting of organic thin films across diverse substrates and establishes interfacial electrostatics as a promising control parameter for surface reactions involving charged species.
title_zh: 利用重氮盐的声化学表面接枝
abstract_zh: 摘要 通过连接具有特定末端官能团的有机分子进行表面修饰因其在化学传感器与生物传感器、电催化以及分子电子学等领域的应用而备受关注。在现有的方法中，电化学还原重氮盐以形成表面键合有机薄膜是化学修饰金属、碳材料和半导体最广泛使用的方法之一。在此，我们报道了一种非电化学的重氮盐衍生薄膜形成方法：将表面浸入含有痕量水和二甲基亚砜的稀重氮盐溶液（1 mM）中，并进行探头超声（400 W，24 kHz）。超声诱导空化，主要通过气泡塌缩时形成的氢自由基产生瞬态还原环境，从而实现表面上的重氮盐还原。在还原之前，界面静电通过促进或阻碍阳离子型重氮盐前体在表面的预富集，调节其在表面附近的局部浓度。对于半导体Si–H，这种静电效应可通过掺杂类型加以调控，p型和n型Si产生相反的表面电势，从而导致不同程度的重氮盐富集。因此，超声提供还原所需的氢自由基，而基底静电决定前体的预富集，进而影响接枝程度。该方法可在多种基底上实现有机薄膜的接枝

title: IFN-γ-driven iNOS induction in macrophages mediates CAR T cell resistance in B cell lymphoma
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapies have revolutionized B cell malignancy treatment, but many patients with large B cell lymphoma (LBCL) experience primary resistance or relapse. To uncover resistance mechanisms, here we examine pre-infusion tumor biopsies and observe that increased immunoregulatory macrophages correlate with poor clinical responses. In murine models, CAR T cell-produced interferon-gamma (IFN-γ) upregulates inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS, NOS2) in immunoregulatory macrophages, impairing CAR T cell function. Proteomic profiling reveals that iNOS-expressing macrophages promote apoptosis and cell cycle arrest while downregulating protein synthesis machinery in CAR T cells. Metabolically, CAR T cells exhibit reduced glycolytic intermediates and altered tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle activity. Pharmacological inhibition of iNOS enhances CAR T cell treatment efficacy in vivo. Elevated levels of iNOS+CD14+ monocytes in leukaphereses are associated with non-durable responses to CAR T cells. Targeting iNOS in immunoregulatory macrophages, potentially by modulating CAR T-produced IFN-γ, could improve LBCL outcomes.
title_zh: 巨噬细胞中IFN-γ驱动的iNOS诱导介导B细胞淋巴瘤中CAR T细胞的耐药性
abstract_zh: 嵌合抗原受体（CAR）T细胞疗法已经彻底改变了B细胞恶性肿瘤的治疗，但许多大B细胞淋巴瘤（LBCL）患者会出现原发性耐药或复发。为了揭示耐药机制，我们在此研究了输注前的肿瘤活检样本，观察到免疫调节性巨噬细胞的增加与不良临床反应相关。在小鼠模型中，CAR T细胞产生的干扰素-γ（IFN-γ）上调免疫调节性巨噬细胞中诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS，NOS2）的表达，从而损害CAR T细胞功能。蛋白质组学分析显示，表达iNOS的巨噬细胞促进CAR T细胞的凋亡和细胞周期阻滞，同时下调蛋白质合成机器。在代谢方面，CAR T细胞表现出糖酵解中间产物减少和三羧酸（TCA）循环活性改变。药物抑制iNOS可在体内增强CAR T细胞治疗的疗效。白细胞分离术样本中iNOS+CD14+单核细胞水平升高与对CAR T细胞的非持久性反应相关。靶向免疫调节性巨噬细胞中的iNOS（可能通过调节CAR T细胞产生的IFN-γ），可改善LBCL的预后。

title: α-KG conformationally stabilizes nuclear GLUD1-SNAIL complex to fuel trans-endothelial migration in metastasis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Trans-endothelial migration (TEM) is a critical rate-limiting barrier in tumor metastasis, yet its mechanistic basis remains poorly defined. Here we show that α-ketoglutarate (α-KG) and its metabolic enzyme glutamate dehydrogenase 1 (GLUD1) constitute a pivotal regulatory axis governing this process. Mechanistically, GLUD1 translocates to the nucleus, where α-KG binds to its non-catalytic site (K147) to induce a conformational change that stabilizes the GLUD1-SNAIL interaction, promoting assembly of a nuclear ternary complex. Notably, this complex is preferentially enriched in tumors, and specific blockade of K147 disrupts this assembly and abrogates metastatic effects. Our findings reveal a non-canonical role for GLUD1 and α-KG in transcriptional regulation and propose a therapeutic paradigm that selectively interferes with metabolite-dependent complex formation rather than enzymatic activity, offering a precise strategy to target TEM-driven metastatic cells.
title_zh: α-KG在构象上稳定核内GLUD1-SNAIL复合物以促进转移中的跨内皮迁移
abstract_zh: 跨内皮迁移（TEM）是肿瘤转移中一个关键的限制性速率屏障，但其机制基础仍不明确。我们在此表明，α-酮戊二酸（α-KG）及其代谢酶谷氨酸脱氢酶1（GLUD1）构成了调控这一过程的关键调节轴。在机制上，GLUD1易位至细胞核，α-KG结合其非催化位点（K147）引起构象变化，从而稳定GLUD1-SNAIL相互作用，促进核内三元复合物的组装。值得注意的是，该复合物在肿瘤中优先富集，特异性阻断K147可破坏该组装并消除转移效应。我们的发现揭示了GLUD1和α-KG在转录调控中的非经典作用，并提出了一种治疗范式，即选择性干扰依赖代谢物的复合物形成而非酶活性，为靶向TEM驱动的转移性细胞提供了精确策略。

title: Skull morphology of the extinct Tasmanian tiger suggests unique biting style
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The recently extinct thylacine (Tasmanian tiger) was the largest modern marsupial predator. It is considered a classic example of evolutionary convergence due to striking similarities with placental canids (e.g., foxes and wolves), particularly in the skull, despite ~160 million years of evolutionary separation. However, we here present geometric and linear morphometric evidence that the thylacine’s cranial form arises from a mosaic of traits not represented among canids or other living mammalian carnivores. Thylacines had disproportionately large heads, tall and gracile snouts with a flared canine region, and conspicuously large infraorbital foramina. Many of these traits suggest adaptations to fast, high-impact snapping behaviour in prey capture, as proposed for several living and extinct predatorial vertebrates with similar trait combinations. The thylacine’s cranial function may therefore not be inferable from observation of living mammals. However, genomic progress presents new opportunities for future insights into the evolution and development of thylacine cranial adaptation.
title_zh: 已灭绝的塔斯马尼亚虎颅骨形态提示其独特的咬合方式
abstract_zh: 最近灭绝的袋狼（塔斯马尼亚虎）是现代最大的有袋类捕食者。由于与胎盘类犬科动物（如狐狸和狼）惊人地相似，尤其是在颅骨方面，尽管存在约1.6亿年的演化分离，它被认为是演化趋同的经典例子。然而，我们在此提供的几何和线性形态学计量证据表明，袋狼的颅骨形态源于一组在有胎盘类犬科动物或其他现存哺乳类食肉动物中均不存在的镶嵌性状。袋狼的头部比例异常大，吻部高而纤细且犬齿区外扩，眶下孔明显较大。其中许多性状提示其对猎物捕获中快速、高冲击力的撕咬行为的适应，这与具有类似性状组合的若干现存和已灭绝的捕食性脊椎动物所提出的假说一致。因此，袋狼的颅骨功能可能无法通过观察现存哺乳动物来推断。然而，基因组学的进展为未来深入理解袋狼颅骨适应性演化与发育提供了新的机遇。

title: ERα Micromap (µMap) proximity labeling reveals fulvestrant mechanisms
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Estrogen Receptor alpha (ERα) is the primary driver in ER+ breast cancer and can be targeted using small molecules such as fulvestrant, a selective estrogen receptor degrader (SERD). Despite being approved over two decades ago and used regularly in post-menopausal women, its precise anti-tumor mechanism remains unclear, with several reports showing efficacy without the requirement for ERα degradation. To investigate the molecular basis of fulvestrant’s action, we employed split intein-based µMap photo-proximity labeling to profile ERα-associated interactions. Our findings reveal that fulvestrant displaces oncogenic interactions induced by estradiol and promotes ERα translocation to promyelocytic leukemia (PML) nuclear bodies, leading to altered transcriptional signatures and senescence. Overall, this study offers insights into SERD mechanism of action and establishes a framework for evaluating additional ERα modulators and degraders.
title_zh: ERα微图谱（µMap）邻近标记揭示氟维司群的作用机制
abstract_zh: 雌激素受体α（ERα）是ER+乳腺癌的主要驱动因子，可被小分子如氟维司群（一种选择性雌激素受体降解剂，SERD）靶向。尽管氟维司群早在二十多年前就已获批并常规用于绝经后女性，但其确切的抗肿瘤机制仍不清楚，多项报道显示其疗效并不依赖于ERα的降解。为研究氟维司群作用的分子基础，我们采用基于分裂内含肽的µMap光邻近标记技术来分析ERα相关的相互作用。我们的发现表明，氟维司群置换了雌二醇诱导的致瘤性相互作用，并促进ERα易位至早幼粒细胞白血病（PML）核体，导致转录特征改变和细胞衰老。总体而言，本研究为SERD的作用机制提供了见解，并为评估其他ERα调节剂和降解剂建立了框架。

title: Land-use optimization for food security, bioenergy and forest conservation in Indonesia
abstract: Balancing food and energy security is a key priority for Indonesia, but the associated land conversion could induce deforestation. This study examines how best to optimize energy security (biodiesel blend ratios of 50%) and food security (rice cropping) given land constraints and current policy.
title_zh: 面向粮食安全、生物能源与森林保护的印度尼西亚土地利用优化
abstract_zh: 平衡粮食安全与能源安全是印度尼西亚的一项重要优先事项，但相关的土地转换可能引发毁林。本研究探讨了在土地限制和当前政策条件下，如何最佳地优化能源安全（50%的生物柴油掺混比例）和粮食安全（水稻种植）。

title: Chlor-alkali electrolysis for battery grade lithium hydroxide production as a pathway towards low-carbon lithium refining
abstract: Lithium hydroxide (LiOH) is a critical precursor for nickel rich lithium-ion battery cathodes, with demand projected to grow rapidly over the next decade. Conventional LiOH production relies on multi-step chemical refining, which is energy intensive, reagent intensive and generates substantial byproduct streams. In this work, we evaluate LiCl based chlor-alkali electrolysis as a process intensified route for LiOH production and compare it with chemical routes and other electrochemical routes including bipolar membrane electrodialysis and electro-electrodialysis across energy use, CO 2 footprint and chemical waste generation. Our analysis shows that lithium chlor-alkali electrolysis for LiOH production is most compelling when LiCl is available at sufficient purity and when chlorine and hydrogen products can be valorized or internally recycled. Additionally, LiCl electrolysis also face Li specific ion transport limitations including bi-layer cation exchange membrane swelling, hydroxide crossover, electro-osmotic water drag and LiOH solubility limit, which constrain reaching higher current densities and higher faradaic efficiencies. We discuss strategies to improve these performance metrics and compare electrochemical LiOH production from spodumene, brine and battery leachate as Li sources. Further, we show that Flash Joule Heating technology could be coupled with chlor-alkali electrolysis to create a closed loop spodumene to LiOH process and discuss why the overall climate benefit of electrochemical routes strongly depend on electricity-grid carbon intensity. Overall, we posit that lithium chlor-alkali electrolysis represents a promising pathway for LiOH production, but its practical implementation will depend on advances in membrane design, process integration and electricity grid decarbonization.

title: Spectrally Partitioned All-Optical Memristors for Highly Linear Neuromorphic Vision Systems
abstract: All-optical control of synaptic weights offers a promising route toward low-power and massively parallel neuromorphic hardware. However, existing optoelectronic memristors often require electrical assistance or exhibit nonlinear and asymmetric conductance updates, limiting their energy efficiency and scalability. Herein, we report a spectrally partitioned all-optical memristor based on a PbS/PEDOT:PSS/VOx heterostructure, in which near-infrared and visible light are coupled to opposite defect-state filling and depletion pathways. Near-infrared illumination selectively excites PbS quantum dots and drives gradual electron transfer into oxygen-vacancy-related defect states in VOx through the PEDOT:PSS-regulated interface, producing continuous conductance potentiation. By contrast, visible illumination activates VOx and promotes interfacial hole-assisted recombination, leading to reversible depletion of defect-state electrons and conductance depression. This wavelength-selective carrier-transfer process enables highly linear and symmetric all-optical weight updates, achieving a linearity of 0.9994 and an effective 8-bit conductance resolution. The electrical energy consumption per optically induced synaptic event is calculated to be as low as 0.63 fJ under an ultralow probing bias. By integrating the devices into a 32 × 32 all-optically programmed array, we further demonstrate hardware-based BloodMNIST microscopic blood-cell image classification with an accuracy of 96.5% and strong noise robustness. These results provide a viable strategy for developing high-linearity, low-power, and spectrally programmable neuromorphic hardware. Highlights:1 A spectrally partitioned PbS/PEDOT:PSS/VOx all-optical memristor enables wavelength-selective potentiation and depression through regulated interfacial carrier dynamics.2 Highly linear bidirectional weight updates with a linearity of 0.9994, 8-bit conductance resolution, and an electrical energy consumption of 0.63 fJ per event are achieved.3 A 32 × 32 memristor array enables hardware-based BloodMNIST inference with 96.5% accuracy and strong noise robustness.
title_zh: 光谱分区的全光忆阻器用于高度线性的神经形态视觉系统
abstract_zh: 突触权重的全光调控为实现低功耗和大规模并行的神经形态硬件提供了一条有前景的途径。然而，现有的光电忆阻器通常需要电学辅助，或表现出非线性和非对称的电导更新，限制了其能效和可扩展性。本文报道了一种基于PbS/PEDOT:PSS/VOx异质结的分谱全光忆阻器，其中近红外光和可见光分别耦合到相反的缺陷态填充与耗尽路径。近红外照射选择性地激发PbS量子点，并通过PEDOT:PSS调控的界面驱动电子逐步转移到VOx中氧空位相关的缺陷态，产生持续的电导增强。相比之下，可见光照射激活VOx并促进界面空穴辅助复合，导致缺陷态电子的可逆耗尽和电导抑制。这种波长选择性的载流子转移过程实现了高度线性和对称的全光权重更新，线性度达到0.9994，有效电导分辨率为8位。在超低探测偏压下，计算得出每个光诱导突触事件的电学能耗低至0.63 fJ。通过将器件集成到32 × 32的全光编程阵列中，我们进一步演示了基于硬件的BloodMNIST显微血细胞图像分类，准确率达96.5%，并具有强噪声鲁棒性。这些结果为开发高线性度、低功耗

abstract: Beyond enabling new optical behaviours, metamaterials influence our thinking of wave–matter interactions in science and engineering.

title: Well-defined chiral binuclear copper catalysis in accessing trifluoromethyl amino acid derivatives
abstract: We report the first well-defined binuclear copper catalyst for asymmetric radical difunctionalization of alkenes, enabled by a crescent-shaped ligand that preorganizes a rigid cavity. Unlike spontaneous self-assembly, this architecture ensures uniform azide coordination and exceptional stereocontrol, thereby providing a general platform for the synthesis of chiral α-quaternary trifluoromethylated amino acids and peptides.
title_zh: 结构明确的chi手性双核铜催化用于获取三氟甲基氨基酸衍生物
abstract_zh: 我们报道了首个结构明确的双核铜催化剂，可用于烯烃的不对称自由基双官能化反应，其关键在于一种新月形配体能够预组织形成刚性空腔。与自发自组装不同，这种结构确保了叠氮配位的均一性和卓越的立体控制，从而为合成手性α-季碳三氟甲基化氨基酸和多肽提供了通用平台。

title: Insertion-dominated anion redox in high-capacity amorphous sulfide cathodes for solid-state batteries
abstract: Conventional cathode active materials (CAMs) often face structural and interfacial challenges when integrated into all-solid-state batteries. A sulfide-based CAM design strategy that combines interfacial compatibility, structural disorder, and anion regulation enables reversible insertion-dominated multi-electron redox chemistry, delivering high specific energy, rapid kinetics, and durable cycling performance.
title_zh: 固态电池高容量非晶硫化物正极中的插入主导型阴离子氧化还原
abstract_zh: 传统正极活性材料（CAMs）在全固态电池中集成时常面临结构和界面方面的挑战。一种将界面相容性、结构无序与阴离子调控相结合的硫化物基正极活性材料设计策略，可实现以嵌入为主导的可逆多电子氧化还原化学，从而提供高比能量、快速动力学以及持久的循环性能。

title: Tuning moiré twist angles enhances tensile plasticity in bulk van der Waals crystals
abstract: Moiré twisting breaks the inherent symmetry of crystal structures, providing a promising method for tuning emergent quantum phenomena and physical properties in layered materials. Here we demonstrate that moiré twisting can also be harnessed to effectively enhance the tensile plasticity of bulk layered van der Waals crystals. We show that interlayer moiré twisting, spanning a broad range of twist angles commensurate with the crystal's translational symmetry, can be controllably introduced through simple off-axis compression in ternary bulk layered van der Waals crystals. It facilitates efficient stress relaxation under mechanical loading with a further increase in the moiré twist angles and enables a substantial increase by up to 360% in room-temperature macroscopic tensile ductility, reaching 30% tensile strain along the a-b plane. Moreover, moiré twisting occurs only between layers and, thus, negligibly affects the in-plane electronic properties. By establishing tunable moiré twisting as an effective mechanism for plastic deformation, this work provides a broadly applicable strategy for enhancing tensile ductility in bulk layered materials.
title_zh: 调节莫尔扭转角提升块体范德华晶体的拉伸塑性
abstract_zh: 莫尔扭转打破了晶体结构的固有对称性，为调控层状材料中的新兴量子现象和物理性质提供了一种有前景的方法。在此，我们展示了莫尔扭转还可被有效利用来显著增强块体层状范德华晶体的拉伸塑性。我们证明，在三元块体层状范德华晶体中，通过简单的离轴压缩可以可控地引入层间莫尔扭转，其扭转角范围广泛且与晶体的平移对称性相匹配。这种扭转在机械载荷下促进了高效应力弛豫，并使莫尔扭转角进一步增大，从而使室温宏观拉伸延展性大幅提升高达360%，沿a-b平面达到30%的拉伸应变。此外，莫尔扭转仅发生在层间，因此对面内电子性质影响甚微。本研究确立了可调莫尔扭转作为一种有效的塑性变形机制，为提升块体层状材料的拉伸延展性提供了一种广泛适用的策略。

title: Unassisted bipolar photoelectrochemical synthesis of H2O2
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Photoelectrochemical bipolar systems enable bias-free H2O2 synthesis by integrating light harvesting, water oxidation and oxygen reduction. However, poor selectivity due to competing 4e- pathways, slow charge transfer, and inferior stability severely limit their practical application. Herein, we present a bias-free photoelectrochemical bipolar system for H2O2 production, which integrates a Zn-TiO2/BVO/WO3 photoanode for the 2e- water oxidation reaction and a Ru:CuO/Nb-CBO photocathode for the 2e- oxygen reduction reaction. The photoanode suppresses *OOH intermediates to favor H2O2 formation, achieving a Faradaic efficiency (FE) of 90.2% at 0.6 VRHE. The photocathode stabilizes *OOH intermediates and delivers an FE of 91.9% under the same conditions while maintaining performance for over 50 h. Practical testing under natural sunlight with 36 cm2 electrodes achieves an FE of 163.37% and a yield of 11.44 mmol L−1. In situ generated H2O2 achieves over 99% bacterial inactivation within 60 min. This work provides an adaptive platform for solar-driven H2O2 synthesis and energy conversion.
title_zh: 无辅助双极光电化学合成H2O2
abstract_zh: 光电化学双极系统通过整合光捕获、水氧化和氧还原反应，实现无偏压的H2O2合成。然而，竞争性4e-路径导致的选择性差、电荷转移缓慢以及稳定性不足严重限制了其实际应用。本文提出了一种用于H2O2生产的无偏压光电化学双极系统，该系统集成了用于2e-水氧化反应的Zn-TiO2/BVO/WO3光阳极和用于2e-氧还原反应的Ru:CuO/Nb-CBO光阴极。光阳极抑制*OOH中间体以促进H2O2生成，在0.6 VRHE下实现了90.2%的法拉第效率（FE）。光阴极稳定*OOH中间体，在相同条件下实现91.9%的FE，并保持性能超过50 h。在自然阳光下使用36 cm2电极进行的实际测试实现了163.37%的FE和11.44 mmol L−1的产率。原位生成的H2O2在60 min内实现了超过99%的细菌灭活。这项工作为太阳能驱动的H2O2合成和能量转换提供了一个适应性平台。

title: Predicting ionic conductivity of sulfide glass solid-state electrolytes using max-flow methodology
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Disordered materials such as glasses are promising candidates as solid-state electrolytes for batteries, but they tend to exhibit low ionic conductivity and current methods for investigating and predicting the ionic conductivity of electrolyte materials are inefficient. Here, we propose a framework that summarizes the topological properties of the electrolyte material’s atomic structure with a weighted graph based on periodic boundary conditions. We then compute a variation of the max-flow algorithm, a commonly used model in continuum models of transportation and liquid flow, on this summary and show that it is compatible with the simulated periodic atomic structures. Using molecular dynamics simulations of various glassy solid-state electrolyte families including both mobile lithium and sodium ions, we validate the approach by showing a positive correlation between the area-normalized maximum flow predicted from the static glass structures and the ionic conductivity as obtained from the simulations, especially in the case of high-conductivity sulfide glass electrolytes. We envision that the developed methodology, which only relies on static atomic structure, will accelerate the discovery of highly conductive sulfide glassy electrolytes for high-performance all-solid-state batteries.
title_zh: 利用最大流方法预测硫化物玻璃固态电解质的离子电导率
abstract_zh: 玻璃等无序材料是很有前景的电池固态电解质候选材料，但它们往往表现出较低的离子电导率，而当前用于研究和预测电解质材料离子电导率的方法效率低下。在此，我们提出了一个框架，基于周期性边界条件用加权图来概括电解质材料原子结构的拓扑性质。然后，我们在该概要上计算一种最大流算法的变体（这是输运和液体流动连续模型中常用的模型），并证明其与模拟的周期性原子结构兼容。通过对包括可移动锂离子和钠离子在内的多种玻璃态固态电解质体系进行分子动力学模拟，我们验证了该方法：由静态玻璃结构预测的面积归一化最大流与模拟得到的离子电导率呈正相关，尤其是在高电导率硫化物玻璃电解质的情况下。我们预计，这种仅依赖静态原子结构的方法将加速用于高性能全固态电池的高电导率硫化物玻璃电解质的发现。

title: Listeria promotes systemic infection by targeting the host deubiquitinase CYLD
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Listeria monocytogenes (Lm) is an intracellular pathogen that can cause life-threatening systemic infections. Internalin C (InlC) is a secreted factor required for full Lm virulence in systemic models of infection by mechanisms that remain unclear. Here, we show that InlC binds to CYLD, a host deubiquitinase and regulator of innate immunity. Structurally, we reveal the LRR domain of InlC binds the CAP-Gly2 domain of CYLD, independently of InlC’s binding site for other host target proteins. Lm strains harboring amino acid substitutions in InlC that selectively disrupt binding to CYLD were examined. We demonstrate that after Lm accesses the host cytosol, InlC recruits CYLD to ubiquitin-positive bacteria. Recruitment of CYLD was dependent on the host E3 ligase RNF213, a major initiator of ubiquitin-mediated defenses. Furthermore, InlC-CYLD binding contributed to Lm virulence in mice. Together, these findings reveal how a secreted bacterial factor promotes the recruitment of a host deubiquitinase to cytosolic bacteria in response to ubiquitin-mediated defenses.
title_zh: 李斯特菌通过靶向宿主去泛素化酶CYLD促进系统性感染
abstract_zh: 单核细胞增生李斯特菌（Lm）是一种胞内病原体，可引起危及生命的系统性感染。内化素C（InlC）是一种分泌因子，在系统性感染模型中对Lm的完全毒力至关重要，但其机制尚不清楚。在此，我们发现InlC与CYLD结合，后者是宿主的一种去泛素化酶和先天免疫调节因子。在结构上，我们揭示了InlC的LRR结构域结合CYLD的CAP-Gly2结构域，且独立于InlC与其他宿主靶蛋白的结合位点。我们研究了InlC中选择性破坏CYLD结合的氨基酸替换的Lm菌株。我们证明，在Lm进入宿主细胞质后，InlC将CYLD招募到泛素阳性的细菌上。CYLD的招募依赖于宿主E3连接酶RNF213，即泛素介导防御的主要启动因子。此外，InlC-CYLD结合有助于Lm在小鼠中的毒力。总之，这些发现揭示了细菌分泌因子如何响应泛素介导的防御而促进宿主去泛素化酶向胞质菌的招募。

title: Single-cell profiling identifies obesity-disrupted brain glucose sensing
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Neuronal nutrient sensing in the hypothalamus and brainstem is thought to regulate energy and glucose homeostasis, yet how these brain regions respond to elevated adiposity or blood glucose remains unclear. We performed single-nucleus RNA-sequencing on 75,787 cells from the arcuate nucleus, ventromedial hypothalamus, and dorsal vagal complex of control diet- and high-fat diet (HFD)-fed male mice following intravenous glucose or saline infusion. HFD broadly altered gene expression across cell types, including Th/Slc6a3, Agrp, Ghrh, and Trh/Cxcl12 neurons. In control diet-fed mice, hyperglycemia triggered transcriptional responses conserved across brain regions in astrocytes and oligodendrocytes, and a response in Ghrh neurons, consistent with reduced neuronal activity. The transcriptional responses to hyperglycemia were largely absent or reversed after HFD. Genes enriched in both mouse and human GHRH neurons were located in loci genetically linked to human glycemic traits. These findings point to the brain’s intrinsic capacity to sense hyperglycemia and suggest that this detection system is profoundly impaired in obesity.
title_zh: 单细胞图谱鉴定肥胖所致的大脑葡萄糖感知异常
abstract_zh: 人们认为下丘脑和脑干的神经元营养感知可调节能量和葡萄糖稳态，但这些脑区如何响应脂肪增多或血糖升高仍不清楚。我们对静脉输注葡萄糖或生理盐水的对照饮食和高脂饮食（HFD）喂养的雄性小鼠的弓状核、腹内侧下丘脑和背侧迷走神经复合体的75,787个细胞进行了单核RNA测序。HFD广泛改变了各类细胞的基因表达，包括Th/Slc6a3、Agrp、Ghrh和Trh/Cxcl12神经元。在对照饮食喂养的小鼠中，高血糖触发了各脑区星形胶质细胞和少突胶质细胞中保守的转录响应，以及Ghrh神经元中的响应，这与神经元活动降低一致。高血糖的转录响应在HFD后大部分消失或被逆转。在小鼠和人类GHRH神经元中富集的基因位于与人类血糖性状遗传连锁的基因座上。这些发现表明大脑具有感知高血糖的内在能力，并提示该检测系统在肥胖状态下受到严重损害。

title: A lipid transfer-dependent feedback loop activates ATG9A compartments in autophagy initiation
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Autophagy degrades cellular material by sequestering it within autophagosomes, which form de novo from precursors called phagophores. Phagophore assembly and expansion require ATG9A-positive seed compartments, the lipid transfer protein ATG2A, and the class III phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate kinase complex I (PI3KC3-C1). PI3KC3-C1 synthesizes phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate (PI3P), a key lipid that drives downstream processes for phagophore expansion, including ATG8 lipidation. We find that ATG9A compartments contain only traces of phosphatidylinositol (PI), likely insufficient for efficient PI3P production or recruitment of PI3P-binding effectors. Nevertheless, ATG2A is recruited to these compartments and mediates lipid transfer, including PI, into them. Remarkably, even without detectable PI3P, ATG9A compartments are direct substrates for ATG8 lipidation, and ATG8 proteins themselves enhance ATG2A-mediated lipid transfer. In cells, ATG2A is essential for the appearance of PI3P on ATG9A compartments. Our findings support a model in which a lipid transfer-driven feedback loop activates ATG9A compartments for phagophore expansion.
title_zh: 脂质转移依赖性反馈环路在自噬启动中激活ATG9A隔室
abstract_zh: 自噬通过将细胞物质隔离在自噬体内来降解它们，自噬体由称为吞噬泡的前体从头形成。吞噬泡的组装和扩张需要ATG9A阳性的种子区室、脂质转移蛋白ATG2A以及III类磷脂酰肌醇3-磷酸激酶复合物I（PI3KC3-C1）。PI3KC3-C1合成磷脂酰肌醇3-磷酸（PI3P），这是驱动吞噬泡扩张下游过程（包括ATG8脂化）的关键脂质。我们发现ATG9A区室仅含有微量的磷脂酰肌醇（PI），可能不足以有效产生PI3P或招募PI3P结合效应蛋白。然而，ATG2A被招募到这些区室并介导脂质（包括PI）向其中转移。值得注意的是，即使在无可检测PI3P的情况下，ATG9A区室也是ATG8脂化的直接底物，且ATG8蛋白本身增强了ATG2A介导的脂质转移。在细胞中，ATG2A对ATG9A区室上PI3P的出现至关重要。我们的发现支持这样一个模型：脂质转移驱动的反馈回路激活ATG9A区室以进行吞噬泡扩张。

title: The default mode network exhibits circuit-specific selective vulnerability despite widespread amyloid burden in an animal model of Alzheimer’s disease
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: In Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) the default mode network (DMN) exhibits selective vulnerability to functional decline and amyloid beta (Aβ) plaques in early AD. DMN vulnerability may simply be the result of Aβ accumulation. Alternately, Aβ may unmask an intrinsic susceptibility of DMN circuits. Should DMN vulnerability persist amidst global Aβ deposition, this would support the latter hypothesis. We tested this using long-term, multi-region recordings of single units in mice characterized by widespread Aβ (APP/PS1). We tracked a neuronal population within the retrosplenial cortex (a DMN region) and two monosynaptically connected target populations, one within (anterior cingulate) and the other outside the DMN (primary visual cortex). We also recorded in hippocampus and examined interactions between the in-DMN and out-DMN circuits. Our data revealed progressive dysfunction restricted to the in-DMN circuit. In contrast, communication originating within but targeting an out-DMN population was unaffected by disease. Dysfunction was pronounced in sleep.
title_zh: 在阿尔茨海默病动物模型中，默认模式网络尽管淀粉样蛋白广泛沉积仍表现出回路特异的选择性脆弱性
abstract_zh: 在阿尔茨海默病（AD）中，默认模式网络（DMN）在早期AD中表现出对功能衰退和β淀粉样蛋白（Aβ）斑块的选择性易损性。DMN的易损性可能仅仅是Aβ积累的结果。或者，Aβ可能揭示了DMN环路的内在易感性。如果DMN的易损性在全局Aβ沉积中持续存在，则支持后一种假说。我们利用具有广泛Aβ沉积的小鼠（APP/PS1）进行长期、多区域单细胞记录来检验这一点。我们追踪了压后皮层（DMN区域）内的一个神经元群体以及两个单突触连接的靶群体，一个在DMN内（前扣带皮层），另一个在DMN外（初级视觉皮层）。我们还记录了海马，并考察了DMN内和DMN外环路之间的相互作用。我们的数据揭示了仅限于DMN内环路的进行性功能障碍。相比之下，起源于DMN内但靶向DMN外群体的通信不受疾病影响。功能障碍在睡眠中尤为明显。

title: OsIDD7 integrates signaling networks for arbuscular mycorrhizal symbiosis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Arbuscular mycorrhizal (AM) symbiosis is a widespread mutualism between plant roots and Glomeromycotina fungi that enables nutrient exchange through arbuscules. Although many transcriptional regulators of AM symbiosis have been identified, the role of the INDETERMINATE DOMAIN (IDD) proteins remain unknown. We show that rice IDD7 expression is strongly induced in arbuscule-containing cells, and its loss markedly reduces fungal colonization and disrupts arbuscule development. IDD7 is required for induction of genes associated with fatty acid biosynthesis, nutrient transport, and symbiotic signaling during AM symbiosis. IDD7 interacts with the transcription factors SLENDER RICE 1 (SLR1) and PHOSPHATE STARVATION RESPONSE 2 (PHR2) through its conserved TQDFLG domain. Electrophoretic mobility shift assays show that IDD7 binds multiple promoter motifs. Together with SLR1 and PHR2, IDD7 synergistically activates the promoters of PHOSPHATE TRANSPORTER 11 (PT11) and the AM-associated transcription factors PHR2, REQUIRED FOR ARBUSCULAR MYCORRHIZATION 1 (RAM1), WRINKLED 5a (WRI5a), and CYCLOPS. Moreover, IDD7 is required for PHR2 expression in arbuscule-containing cells. Here, we show that IDD7 is a central transcriptional regulator in arbuscule-containing cells.
title_zh: OsIDD7整合丛枝菌根共生的信号网络
abstract_zh: 丛枝菌根（AM）共生是植物根系与球囊菌亚门（Glomeromycotina）真菌之间广泛存在的互利共生关系，通过丛枝实现养分交换。尽管已鉴定出许多AM共生的转录调控因子，但INDETERMINATE DOMAIN（IDD）蛋白的作用仍不清楚。我们发现水稻IDD7在含丛枝的细胞中强烈诱导表达，其缺失显著降低真菌定殖并破坏丛枝发育。IDD7是AM共生过程中脂肪酸生物合成、养分运输和共生信号相关基因诱导所必需的。IDD7通过其保守的TQDFLG结构域与转录因子SLENDER RICE 1（SLR1）和PHOSPHATE STARVATION RESPONSE 2（PHR2）相互作用。电泳迁移率变动实验表明IDD7可结合多种启动子基序。IDD7与SLR1和PHR2协同激活PHOSPHATE TRANSPORTER 11（PT11）以及AM相关转录因子PHR2、REQUIRED FOR ARBUSCULAR MYCORRHIZATION 1（RAM1）、WRINKLED 5a（WRI5a）和CYCLOPS的启动子。此外，IDD7是含丛枝细胞中PHR2表达所必需的。我们的研究表明，IDD7是含丛枝细胞中的核心转录调控因子。

title: Mutation-agnostic base editing of the progerin farnesylation site rescues Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome phenotypes in neuromuscular organoids
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Hutchinson Gilford progeria syndrome (HGPS) is a fatal premature aging disorder caused by pathogenic farnesylated lamin A variants that disrupt nuclear architecture and DNA repair. Current therapies, including farnesyltransferase inhibitors, provide only modest survival benefits and lack molecular specificity, while mutation-specific genome-editing strategies cannot address atypical laminopathies. Here, we develop Farnesylation Amino acid Targeted Editing (FATE), a mutation-agnostic base-editing platform that selectively disrupts the LMNA farnesylation motif without affecting other farnesylated proteins. Using isogenic human pluripotent stem cell derived neuromuscular organoids (NMOs), we reveal muscle-specific progerin accumulation that sequesters 53BP1 and abolishes DNA damage foci formation. FATE eliminates perinuclear progerin, restores 53BP1 mobility, reconstitutes DNA repair foci, and normalizes heterochromatin architecture. Importantly, transient delivery of FATE mRNA conjugated with lipid nanoparticles to HGPS NMOs achieves efficient base editing and phenotypic rescue. These findings establish FATE as a mutation-independent therapeutic strategy targeting a fundamental pathogenic mechanism in HGPS and provide a proof-of-concept for RNA-based in situ genome editing in progeroid disease.
title_zh: 对早老蛋白法尼基化位点进行突变无关的碱基编辑可挽救神经肌肉类器官中的Hutchinson-Gilford早衰综合征表型
abstract_zh: Hutchinson Gilford早衰综合征（HGPS）是一种致命的早衰性疾病，由致病性法尼基化lamin A变异体引起，这些变异体破坏核结构和DNA修复。现有疗法（包括法尼基转移酶抑制剂）仅能提供有限的生存获益且缺乏分子特异性，而突变特异的基因组编辑策略无法解决非典型核纤层蛋白病。在此，我们开发了法尼基化氨基酸靶向编辑（Farnesylation Amino acid Targeted Editing，FATE），这是一种突变不可知（mutation-agnostic）的碱基编辑平台，可选择性破坏LMNA法尼基化基序而不影响其他法尼基化蛋白。利用同基因人类多能干细胞来源的神经肌肉类器官（NMOs），我们揭示了肌肉特异性早老蛋白（progerin）的积累，其隔离53BP1并消除DNA损伤灶的形成。FATE可清除核周早老蛋白，恢复53BP1的移动性，重建DNA修复灶，并使异染色质结构正常化。重要的是，将脂质纳米颗粒偶联的FATE mRNA瞬时递送至HGPS NMOs可实现高效的碱基编辑和表型挽救。这些发现确立了FATE作为一种不依赖突变的治疗策略，针对HGPS的基本致病机制，并为早衰样疾病中基于RNA的原位基因组编辑提供了概念验证。

title: Chromosome-level Streptochaeta genome elucidates the ancestral karyotype and allopolyploid origin of grasses
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Grasses (Poaceae) are the most economically important group of plants. Reconstructing the ancestral grass genome and studying the evolutionary factors shaping major grass lineages are crucial for understanding the evolution of cereals, including rice, wheat and maize. Here, we report a chromosome-level genome assembly of Streptochaeta spicata, which represents the lineage without typical spikelets and the sister to the rest of Poaceae, and perform comparative genomic analyses across major grass lineages. We confirm the occurrence of the ρ-whole-genome duplication (ρ-WGD) in Streptochaeta, suggesting a shared allotetraploidization event for all extant grasses. Reconstruction of the ancestral grass karyotype (AGK) reveals a chromosome number of ante-ρ (x = 8) and post-ρ (x = 12), followed by chromosome number reduction by fusion events accompanying the diversification within major subfamilies. Biased subgenome fractionation and dominance are observed and inherited across Streptochaeta and major grass lineages. Comparative expression analyses of key floral genes in S. spicata indicate that the spikelet equivalent of this early-diverging lineage might represent a modified ancestral state of grass spikelet. Given its critical phylogenetic position, the Streptochaeta genome sheds light on the early karyotypic evolution of grasses, and the origin and key morphological innovation with respect to WGDs.
title_zh: 染色体水平的Streptochaeta基因组揭示了禾草植物的祖先核型及其异源多倍体起源
abstract_zh: 禾本科（Poaceae）草本是经济上最重要的植物类群。重建草本祖先基因组并研究塑造主要草本谱系的演化因素，对于理解包括水稻、小麦和玉米在内的谷类作物的演化至关重要。在此，我们报道了Streptochaeta spicata的染色体级别基因组组装，该物种代表缺乏典型小穗的谱系，是其余禾本科植物的姐妹群，并在主要草本谱系间进行了比较基因组学分析。我们证实了ρ全基因组加倍（ρ-WGD）在Streptochaeta中发生，表明所有现存草本植物共享一次异源四倍化事件。草本祖先核型（AGK）重建显示ρ前染色体数目为x = 8，ρ后为x = 12，随后在主要亚科内部多样化过程中伴随融合事件发生染色体数目减少。在Streptochaeta和主要草本谱系中观察到并可遗传有偏的亚基因组分化和显性。对S. spicata关键花发育基因的比较表达分析表明，这一早期分化谱系的小穗等同物可能代表草类小穗的修饰祖先状态。鉴于其关键的系统发育位置，Streptochaeta基因组为草类的早期核型演化以及与WGD相关的起源和关键形态创新提供了启示。

title: Subicular spatial codes arise from predictive mapping
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The successor representation has emerged as a powerful model for understanding mammalian navigation and memory; explaining the spatial coding properties of hippocampal place cells and entorhinal grid cells. However, the diverse spatial responses of subicular neurons, the primary output of the hippocampus, have eluded a unified account. Here, we demonstrate that incorporating rodent behavioural biases into the successor representation successfully reproduces the heterogeneous activity patterns of subicular neurons. This framework accounts for the emergence of boundary and corner cells—neuronal types absent in upstream hippocampal regions. We provide evidence that subicular firing patterns are more accurately described by the successor representation than a purely spatial or boundary vector cell model of subiculum. Our work reveals a temporal hierarchy in hippocampal-subicular processing, with subiculum encoding predictive representations over longer time horizons than CA1, capturing extended behavioural patterns and environmental affordances.
title_zh: 下托空间编码源于预测性映射
abstract_zh: 后继表征（successor representation）已成为理解哺乳动物导航和记忆的强大模型，可解释海马位置细胞和内嗅皮层网格细胞的空间编码特性。然而，下托（海马的主要输出结构）神经元多样化的空间反应一直缺乏统一的解释。在此，我们证明将啮齿动物的行为偏好纳入后继表征可以成功再现下托神经元的异质性活动模式。该框架解释了边界细胞和角细胞（上游海马区域中缺失的神经元类型）的产生。我们提供证据表明，与纯粹的空间模型或下托的边界向量细胞模型相比，下托的放电模式能被后继表征更准确地描述。我们的工作揭示了海马-下托处理中的时间层级，下托比CA1在更长的时间尺度上编码预测性表征，捕捉扩展的行为模式和环境可供性。

title: Clinical attribute-based risk matrix for prognostication in immunotherapy-treated non-small cell lung cancer
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Biomarkers used to guide immunotherapy in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) are invasive, variably available, and insufficient to capture clinical and regional heterogeneity, leaving many patients inadequately stratified for prognosis. We develop a clinical attribute–based framework that leverages routinely collected variables to estimate survival risk, even when baseline data are incomplete. We analyze 17 051 patients with NSCLC treated with immunotherapy, assembled from published cohorts and tertiary centers across multiple regions, and evaluate seventeen common clinical attributes using a two-stage survival modeling strategy with external validation in Western and East Asian populations. Clinical attributes exhibit context-dependent prognostic effects across variable-defined strata and survival endpoints, with performance status and disease stage emerging as the most consistent determinants of survival risk prediction, alongside region-specific modifiers. Here we show that this “start-anywhere” clinical risk matrix provides robust, population-aware prognostic stratification and complements biomarkers for assessing immunotherapy outcomes in patients with NSCLC.
title_zh: 基于临床属性的风险矩阵用于免疫治疗非小细胞肺癌的预后评估
abstract_zh: 用于指导非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）免疫治疗的生物标志物具有侵入性、可得性不一且不足以捕捉临床和区域异质性，导致许多患者的预后分层不充分。我们开发了一个基于临床属性的框架，利用常规收集的变量来估计生存风险，即使在基线数据不完整的情况下也可行。我们分析了接受免疫治疗的17 051例NSCLC患者，数据来自已发表队列和多个地区的三级医疗中心，并采用两阶段生存建模策略评估了17个常见临床属性，在西方和东亚人群中进行了外部验证。临床属性在变量定义的分层和生存终点间表现出依赖于情境的预后效应，其中体能状态和疾病分期是生存风险预测最一致的决定因素，同时还存在区域特异性调节因子。我们的研究表明，这种“任意起点”的临床风险矩阵可提供稳健的、人群感知的预后分层，并作为生物标志物的补充用于评估NSCLC患者的免疫治疗结局。

title: Perirenal fat β₃-adrenergic signaling alleviates renal fibrosis via regulating Bcat2/BCAA-TNFα pathway in diabetic kidney disease
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Tubulointerstitial fibrosis predicts irreversible kidney function loss in diabetic kidney disease (DKD), but adipose-derived signals that shape fibrogenesis are poorly defined. Here, we show that perirenal fat (PRF), an adipose depot contiguous with the kidney, is enriched for β3-adrenergic receptor (ADRB3) and that ADRB3 expression is reduced in human DKD and male mouse DKD models. In db/db and streptozotocin/high-fat diet mice, increased PRF mass associates with albuminuria and serum creatinine, whereas PRF removal attenuates tubular lipid accumulation, mitochondrial injury and fibrosis. Brown adipocyte-lineage ADRB3 deletion enlarges PRF and increases adipocyte TNFα release by suppressing Bcat2-dependent branched-chain amino-acid catabolism through CREB1/METTL3-mediated m6A regulation. ADRB3 activation or PRF-restricted ADRB3 restoration reduces PRF inflammation and renal fibrosis, while iBAT-restricted restoration does not reproduce this renal protection. These findings identify a PRF ADRB3-Bcat2/BCAA-TNFα pathway that contributes to diabetic renal fibrosis.
title_zh: 肾周脂肪β₃-肾上腺素能信号通过调控糖尿病肾病中的Bcat2/BCAA-TNFα通路缓解肾纤维化
abstract_zh: 肾小管间质纤维化预示糖尿病肾病（DKD）中不可逆的肾功能丧失，但塑造纤维化的脂肪衍生信号仍不明确。在此，我们发现肾周脂肪（PRF）——与肾脏相邻的脂肪库——富含β3肾上腺素能受体（ADRB3），且ADRB3表达在人类DKD和雄性小鼠DKD模型中降低。在db/db和链脲佐菌素/高脂饮食小鼠中，PRF质量增加与蛋白尿和血肌酐相关，而去除PRF可减轻小管脂质积累、线粒体损伤和纤维化。棕色脂肪细胞谱系ADRB3缺失通过CREB1/METTL3介导的m6A调控抑制依赖Bcat2的支链氨基酸分解代谢，从而增大PRF并增加脂肪细胞TNFα的释放。ADRB3激活或PRF限制性ADRB3恢复可减少PRF炎症和肾纤维化，而iBAT限制性恢复则不能重现这种肾脏保护作用。这些发现确定了一条促进糖尿病肾纤维化的PRF ADRB3-Bcat2/BCAA-TNFα通路。

title: RBP-Driven RNA sorting and local translation establish the molecular identities of individual sensory axons
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Neurons extend long axons that traverse distinct microenvironments, yet how these subcellular compartments acquire and maintain specialized identities remains unclear. Here, we use spatial translatomics to define the local translatomes of somatosensory dorsal root ganglion (DRG) neurons. Translating Ribosome Affinity Purification and RNA sequencing (TRAP-seq) reveal thousands of mRNAs preferentially translated within central axons, peripheral axons, or DRG somata, establishing compartment-specific translational programs. Many of these transcripts encode ion channels and neurotransmitter receptors that may confer distinct electrophysiological and regenerative properties to each axon. Integration of the TRAP-seq data with published RNA-seq identify locally translated components that change following neuropathic injury and could thereby adjust neuronal activity. We identify RNA regulons coordinated by RNA-binding proteins (RBPs) SFPQ and SRSF10, which preferentially bind and traffic mRNAs to peripheral or central axons, respectively. These findings indicate that RBP-guided RNA sorting and local translation enable the establishment and dynamic local modulation of somatosensory function.
title_zh: RBP驱动的RNA分选与局部翻译确立了单个感觉轴突的分子身份
abstract_zh: 神经元延伸出穿越不同微环境的长轴突，但这些亚细胞区室如何获得并维持特化的身份仍不清楚。在此，我们利用空间翻译组学定义了躯体感觉背根神经节（DRG）神经元的局部翻译组。翻译核糖体亲和纯化与RNA测序（TRAP-seq）揭示了数千种在中枢轴突、外周轴突或DRG胞体中被优先翻译的mRNA，确立了区室特异性的翻译程序。这些转录本中有许多编码离子通道和神经递质受体，可能赋予每条轴突不同的电生理和再生特性。将TRAP-seq数据与已发表的RNA-seq整合，我们鉴定了神经病理性损伤后发生变化的局部翻译组分，从而可能调节神经元活动。我们鉴定了由RNA结合蛋白（RBP）SFPQ和SRSF10协调的RNA调节子，它们分别优先结合并将mRNA运输至外周轴突或中枢轴突。这些发现表明，RBP引导的RNA分选和局部翻译能够建立躯体感觉功能并对其进行动态的局部调节。

title: Temporal lag in post-mining regrowth amplifies carbon loss in tropical forests during the period 2000–2023
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Mining-induced deforestation is an under-recognized source of tropical forest carbon loss, and the extent to which post-mining regrowth offsets this loss remains unclear. Here, we reconstruct mining-related deforestation and subsequent forest regrowth across the tropics from 2000 to 2023 using high-resolution satellite observations. We estimate that mining causes ~4537 km2 of deforestation, whereas post-mining regrowth covers ~300 km2, equivalent to 6.6% of the deforested area. Forest regrowth also exhibits a pronounced temporal lag, with ~40% occurring more than five years after deforestation and ~16% occurring at least a decade later. Mining-related deforestation results in ~47.5 Tg C of carbon loss, while regrowth contributes ~3.8 Tg C of carbon gain, offsetting 8% of losses. These findings indicate that post-mining forest regrowth provides a limited carbon offset, highlighting the need to improve both the extent and timeliness of forest recovery in mining-affected tropical forests.
title_zh: 采后植被再生的时间滞后放大了2000–2023年期间热带森林的碳损失
abstract_zh: 采矿引起的森林砍伐是一个未被充分认识的热带森林碳损失来源，而采矿后森林再生在多大程度上抵消这一损失仍不清楚。在此，我们利用高分辨率卫星观测重建了2000年至2023年热带地区与采矿相关的森林砍伐及随后森林再生的状况。我们估计采矿造成约4537 km2的森林砍伐，而采矿后的再生面积约为300 km2，相当于被砍伐面积的6.6%。森林再生还表现出明显的时间滞后，约40%发生在森林砍伐五年多之后，约16%至少在十年后才发生。与采矿相关的森林砍伐导致约47.5 Tg C的碳损失，而森林再生贡献了约3.8 Tg C的碳增益，抵消了8%的损失。这些发现表明，采矿后森林再生提供的碳抵消有限，凸显了在受采矿影响的热带森林中提高森林恢复的规模和及时性的必要性。

title: The global distribution of macroalgal carbon burial in coastal sediments
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Macroalgae play a pivotal role in the global ocean carbon cycle, yet the spatial distribution of their coastal carbon burial, a long-term sink relevant to national inventories, remains poorly resolved. Here, we present a high-resolution (5-arcminute, ~9.2 km at the equator) global assessment of the Macroalgal Carbon Burial Index (MCBI), a measure of how favorable coastal environments are for burying macroalgal carbon. Synthesizing the most comprehensive dataset of sediment accumulation rates (n = 1617), we identify the depositional environment as a critical constraint on burial, acting independently of macroalgal productivity.
