abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Singlet fission (SF), the spin‐conserving conversion of one photoexcited singlet exciton into two triplet excitons has emerged as a versatile exciton‐management strategy for optoelectronics and quantum technologies. While initially explored to overcome the efficiency limit of single‐junction photovoltaics, SF is now recognized as a broader platform for engineering correlated excited states. Efficient triplet generation and spin‐correlated pairs create opportunities in photovoltaics, photodetection, photocatalysis, photon up‐conversion, quantum light sources, spin–photon interfaces, and bioimaging. This Review summarizes the fundamental mechanisms, energetic requirements, and molecular design principles governing SF, together with the influence of supramolecular organization and external stimuli on its dynamics. Particular emphasis is placed on the multiscale relationships among molecular energetics, excited‐state character, molecular packing, triplet‐pair separation, triplet transport, and interfacial energy or charge transfer, which ultimately determine device performance. We further discuss recent advances in SF‐enabled optoelectronic and quantum applications. Despite rapid progress, major challenges remain in establishing a unified mechanistic framework, understanding SF in polymeric and disordered systems, and expanding the library of stable, high‐performance SF materials. Finally, we highlight future opportunities in machine‐learning‐assisted materials discovery, excited‐state engineering, and the integration of SF into next‐generation functional optoelectronic devices.
title_zh: 单线态裂解作为下一代光电材料的激子管理平台
abstract_zh:
摘要
单线态裂分（SF）是将一个光激发单线态激子自旋守恒地转换为两个三线态激子的过程，已成为光电子学和量子技术中一种多功能的激子管理策略。虽然SF最初被探索用于突破单结光伏的效率极限，但如今它被视为工程化相关激发态的更广泛平台。高效的三线态生成和自旋相关对在光伏、光电探测、光催化、光子上转换、量子光源、自旋-光子界面和生物成像等领域创造了机遇。本综述总结了支配SF的基本机制、能量要求和分子设计原理，以及超分子组织和外部刺激对其动力学的影响。特别强调了分子能量学、激发态特性、分子堆积、三线态对分离、三线态传输和界面能量或电荷转移之间的多尺度关系，这些最终决定了器件性能。我们进一步讨论了SFenabled的光电子和量子应用的最新进展。尽管进展迅速，在建立统一的机制框架、理解聚合物和无序体系中的SF以及扩充稳定高性能SF材料库方面仍存在重大挑战。最后，我们重点展望了机器学习辅助材料发现、激发态工程以及将SF集成到下一代功能器件中的未来机遇

title: Bioprinting of Biomimetic Periosteum‐Bone Integrated Scaffolds
source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Bone is composed of periosteum, cortical bone, and cancellous bone. The development of tissue engineering scaffolds mimicking these three parts of bone tissue and enabling synergistic functional performance remains a significant challenge. Herein, a biomimetic periosteum‐bone integrated scaffold was successfully fabricated by assembling the outer engineered periosteum with the inner Haversian bone module, achieving structural and functional biomimicry of natural bone tissue. The engineered periosteum constructed with periosteal cells (PCs) with zinc silicate nanorods (ZS) spontaneously recapitulated the diverse bioactivities of natural periosteum, thus facilitating the synergistic osteogenesis when co‐cultured with bone marrow related cells in vitro. Coarse‑grained molecular dynamics simulations revealed that surface curvature of ZS affected membrane bending‐energy landscape and particle reorientation during endocytosis, thereby regulating PCs’ function via altered intracellular ion accumulation kinetics. Notably, in a segmental bone defect, the engineered periosteum and Haversian‐bone module exhibited the superior synergistic effect on integrative bone regeneration in vivo. More importantly, the engineered periosteum was found to functionally replace natural periosteum with the mechanism of ZS activating a specific fibrogenic sub‐cluster with potent chondrogenesis and neurovascular communication. This biomimetic periosteum‐bone integrated scaffold offers a fresh perspective for the design of full structure and function‐mimicking bone tissue engineering materials.

title: A Voltage‐Stabilizing MXene Additive Electrolyte Mitigates Interference From External Force on the Charge‐Discharge Process for Multifunctional Hybrid Structural Supercapacitors
source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  In structural energy storage devices (SESDs) that simultaneously store electrochemical energy and bear mechanical loading, the external force will normally affect the electrochemical performance of SESDs. One example is that, under cyclic bending stress, voltage ripples emerge in charge‐discharge curves, which cause voltage instability. In this study, we demonstrate that these voltage ripples originate from spatially heterogeneous electric field distribution within the mechanically deformed region. By using polarized electric fields formed through hydrogen bonding networks in MXene additive electrolyte, we can effectively homogenize the distribution of the electric field, thereby attenuating voltage ripples and smoothing the voltage curves. Moreover, the uniform electric field distribution promotes uniform Zn deposition and extends the device lifespan. As a result, the fabricated Zn‐ion‐based structural hybrid supercapacitor (CSHS) with MXene additive electrolyte exhibits a capacity retention of 93.6% after 10 000 three‐point bending cycles at a strain of 0.5%, much higher than that of CSHS without the addition of MXene (80.4%). The investigation into the suppression of voltage ripples of SESDs paves a viable way to design high‐performance structural power sources capable of exhibiting stable voltage under mechanical loading.
title_zh: 电压稳定MXene添加剂电解液减轻外力对多功能混合结构超级电容器充放电过程的干扰

title: Unconventional Biexciton Dynamics in Superradiant Perovskite Quantum Dots Driven by Many‐Body Correlations
source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    Excitons and biexcitons emission traits, for example, quantum yield, lifetime, and coherence, govern device performance metrics including brightness, optical gain thresholds, and the efficiency of single‐ and entangled‐photon generation. Biexcitons are conventionally understood to radiatively decay more rapidly than excitons. This view stems largely from studies in strongly confined quantum dots (QDs), where inter‐exciton correlations are often neglected. In contrast, weakly confined systems such as large CsPbBr
                    3
                    QDs exhibit significant Coulomb correlations, necessitating a revised framework for biexciton radiative dynamics, one that has remained incomplete due to limited experimental insights. Here, we combine single‐particle photoluminescence (PL) spectroscopy with effective‐mass variational quantum Monte Carlo (VQMC) simulations to directly probe the biexciton geometry, exciton–phonon interactions, and radiative decay in CsPbBr
                    3
                    QDs across a range of sizes and temperatures. We reveal that the biexciton‐to‐exciton radiative decay lifetime ratio is strongly modulated by inter‐exciton correlations, with a striking inversion of the expected decay lifetime hierarchy in the weak‐confinement regime. Specifically, at cryogenic temperatures, biexcitons exhibit anomalously longer radiative lifetime (148 ± 30 ps) than excitons (106 ± 16 ps), challenging conventional models. These findings uncover a correlation‐driven regime of multiexciton physics and suggest new routes for tailoring light–matter interactions for classical and quantum photonic applications.

title: DNA‐Based Loop‐Amplifier Fluorescence Signaling Networks Enable Rapid Quantitative Pathogen Detection of Periprosthetic Microbial Bone Infection
source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Periprosthetic microbial bone infection (PMBI) is a serious pathological condition that may lead to terrible consequences without timely therapeutic intervention. However, the clinical management of PMBI is challenged by the difficulties in the efficient and accurate identification of microbial pathogens. For this purpose, we report a DNA‐based loop‐amplifier fluorescence signaling network (DLFSN) for the efficient and accurate detection of pathogenic microbes in the context of PMBI. The DLFSN system comprises an Amplifier Unit A and a Quantifier Unit B. Specifically, Amplifier Unit A transforms pathogenic microbial genetic materials into fluorescent DNA molecules through an entropy‐driven automated reaction loop, leading to efficient and precise amplification of pathogen‐specific genomic input signals. Subsequently, Quantifier Unit B converts the quenched fluorescent intermediate products into an activated state, thus allowing the precise identification of the genetic signature of pathogenic microorganisms in a quantitative manner. DLFSN demonstrated high diagnostic accuracy comparable to gold standard PMBI diagnostic technologies, including tissue section staining and qPCR, while the actual assay time was much lower at only around 30 min for real‐life patients. The DLFSN system provides a promising precision diagnostic tool for early PMBI diagnosis, holding promise to improve orthopedic outcomes in the clinic.
title_zh: 基于DNA的环路放大荧光信号网络实现假体周围微生物骨感染的快速定量病原体检测
abstract_zh:
摘要
假体周围微生物骨感染(PMBI)是一种严重的病理状态,若不及时治疗干预可能导致可怕的后果。然而,PMBI的临床管理面临着高效准确鉴定病原微生物的困难。为此,我们报道了一种基于DNA的环路放大荧光信号网络(DLFSN),用于在PMBI背景下高效准确地检测病原微生物。DLFSN系统由放大器单元A和定量器单元B组成。具体而言,放大器单元A通过熵驱动的自动化反应回路将病原微生物遗传物质转化为荧光DNA分子,从而实现对病原体特异性基因组输入信号的高效精确放大。随后,定量器单元B将淬灭的荧光中间产物转化为激活状态,从而能够以定量方式精确识别病原微生物的遗传特征。DLFSN表现出与金标准PMBI诊断技术(包括组织切片染色和qPCR)相当的高诊断准确性,而对真实患者的实际检测时间要低得多,仅约30分钟。DLFSN系统为PMBI的早期诊断提供了一种有前景的精准诊断工具,有望改善临床骨科治疗效果。

title: Toward Ultrahigh‐Rate Li–Cl2 Batteries via an Electron Pump Strategy
source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    Rechargeable lithium–chlorine (Li–Cl
                    2
                    ) batteries hold great promise due to their high energy density, yet their performance is limited by sluggish electron‑ion transport at the solid–solid interface between the electrode and insulating LiCl. Here, we construct a MoSe
                    2
                    /TiN heterostructure featuring a built‑in electric field‑driven electron pump, which simultaneously enhances electronic coupling and achieve rapid activation of LiCl. This design enables rapid extraction of electrons from LiCl during charging, efficiently promotes LiCl dissociation and significantly reduces interfacial diffusion resistance by transforming the reaction interface from localized points into a homogeneous plane through strong electronic coupling. The resulting Li–Cl
                    2
                    battery achieves an ultralow polarization of 0.18 V and outstanding rate performance up to 50 A g
                    −1
                    . Moreover, a cylindrical cell configuration demonstrates stable cycling over 35 cycles with a capacity retention of 70 mAh. This work offers both a high‑performance cathode and fundamental insight into interfacial charge‑mass transfer regulation in multi‑phase battery systems.
title_zh: 基于电子泵策略实现超高倍率Li–Cl2电池

title: In Situ Photothermalized Allomelanin Bulk Hydrogels Enable Efficient Solar Water Desalination
source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    Hydrogel‐based interfacial solar evaporation shows great promise for desalination. However, conventional hydrogels rely on exogenous photothermal agents, which may compromise water transport and complicate heat transfer within the hydrogel under conditions of high loading, insufficient dispersion, or poor interfacial compatibility. To address those critical issues, we have presented a facile and modular strategy for constructing robust allomelanin bulk hydrogels, where photothermal precursors (1,8‐dihydroxynaphthalene) act as crosslinkers to directly couple with hydrophilic polymers (oxidized polysaccharides) for hydrogel gelation, while serving simultaneously as functional monomers that undergo spontaneous reactions to in situ form photothermal agents during the curing process. This strategy avoids the introduction of exogenous photothermal agents while achieving seamless integration of the in situ‐generated photothermal agents with the hydrogel network, thereby remarkably boosting the performances of water transport, water activation, and thermal management. The resulting allomelanin bulk hydrogel interestingly achieved an impressive evaporation rate of 4.26 kg·m
                    −2
                    ·h
                    −1
                    under 1 sun irradiation. Moreover, techno‐economic analysis estimated a competitive clean water production cost of $1.66 per ton for the hydrogel, rivalling reverse osmosis. This work pioneers a novel pathway for designing highly efficient hydrogel‐based desalination devices, presenting a sustainable solution to water scarcity challenges.

title: A Textile‐Based, Battery‐Free, Electrochromic Platform for Visual Epidermal Sweat Biosensing
source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    Noninvasive wearable sweat sensors are promising for personalized health management, yet their widespread adoption is hindered by complex multi‐component architectures, reliance on rigid batteries, and a lack of intuitive visual feedback. Herein, we propose a sweat‐powered metabolism‐to‐visual transduction mechanism that utilizes sweat as both an energy source and a detection target. A fabric‐based sweat electricity harvester is fabricated, which harnesses sweat energy to yield a stable power output, enabling battery‐free sensing operation. Coupled enzymatic sensing electrode–electrochromic display system translates sweat glucose concentration into directly perceptible color change. To overcome the subjective errors inherent in traditional colorimetry, a neural network‐based smartphone application is employed to provide precise quantitative visual readouts, achieving highly accurate estimation of sweat glucose (R
                    2
                     = 0.997) comparable to commercial assay kits in on‐body evaluation on human subjects. title_zh: 用于表皮汗液生物传感的纺织基、无电池、电致变色可视化平台
abstract_zh:

无创可穿戴汗液传感器在个性化健康管理方面前景广阔,但其广泛采用受到复杂多组件架构、对刚性电池的依赖以及缺乏直观视觉反馈的阻碍。在此,我们提出了一种汗液驱动的代谢-视觉转导机制,利用汗液同时作为能源和检测目标。我们制备了一种基于织物的汗液发电采集器,利用汗液能量产生稳定的功率输出,实现无电池的传感操作。耦合的酶传感电极-电致变色显示系统将汗液葡萄糖浓度转化为可直接感知的颜色变化。为克服传统比色法固有的主观误差,采用基于神经网络的智能手机应用程序提供精确的定量视觉读数,实现了对汗液葡萄糖的高精度估计(R2 = 0.997),在人体佩戴评估中可与商业检测试剂盒相媲美。通过成功地将可穿戴传感器与刚性电源解耦,同时将自供电电致变色显示器与AI辅助数字读数相融合,这一轻量化纺织平台为用户友好且智能的代谢监测建立了一种按需策略。

title: Detailed modelling of alpha transport due to ELM control fields in ITER: implications for PFCs and diagnostic design
abstract: This paper presents simulations of alpha-particle transport in ITER driven by static 3D magnetic field perturbations in the high-performance baseline scenario, specifically resonant magnetic perturbations arising from edge-localized mode (ELM) control coils, combined with toroidal field ripple and effects from ferromagnetic materials. We employ the Lorentz-Orbit Code for Use in Stellarators and Tokamaks (LOCUST), which tracks fast-ion orbits under the Lorentz force and Monte Carlo collisions with the bulk plasma, taking into account the detailed geometry of ITER plasma-facing components. LOCUST uses GPU cards to enable the high-resolution modelling required to accurately resolve power fluxes across surfaces with complex morphologies, including unprotected cooling pipes beneath the dome divertor, and the generation of reliable synthetic diagnostics for the ITER Fast Ion Loss Detector (FILD) to support its design. The simulations include a range of ELM control coil current profiles with toroidal mode number n = 3. The results indicate that the total alpha-particle energy lost has a negligible impact on plasma performance, remaining below 1% of the alpha energy produced in D–T reactions. Furthermore, the power flux density on the divertor structures and the first wall remains well below design limits and is comparable to thermal and radiative loads. The simulated alpha flux on the FILD scintillator plate is well above the noise threshold and can be significantly higher than conservative estimates.
title_zh: ITER中ELM控制场引起的alpha粒子输运的详细建模：对PFC和诊断设计的影响
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了ITER中由静态三维磁场扰动驱动的α粒子输运模拟，研究的是高性能基线运行情景，特别是由边缘局域模（ELM）控制线圈产生的共振磁扰动，并结合环向场纹波及铁磁材料效应。我们采用用于仿星器和托卡马克的洛伦兹轨道代码（LOCUST），该代码在洛伦兹力和与体等离子体的蒙特卡罗碰撞下跟踪快离子轨道，同时考虑ITER面向等离子体部件的详细几何结构。LOCUST使用GPU卡来实现高分辨率建模，从而准确分辨具有复杂形态的表面上的功率通量，包括偏滤器穹顶下方无保护的冷却管道，并为ITER快离子损失探测器（FILD）的合成诊断提供可靠结果以支持其设计。模拟包括了环向模数n = 3的一系列ELM控制线圈电流分布。结果表明，损失的总α粒子能量对等离子体性能的影响可以忽略，保持在D–T反应产生的α能量的1%以下。此外，偏滤器结构和第一壁上的功率通量密度远低于设计限值，与热负荷和辐射负荷相当。FILD闪烁体板上的模拟α通量远高于噪声阈值，并且可能显著高于保守估计值。

title: Modeling temperature profiles in the pedestal of NSTX with reduced models
abstract: This paper describes new modeling capabilities for predicting H-mode pedestal profiles in spherical tokamaks. Temperature profiles for NSTX discharges 132543 (narrow pedestal) and 132588 (wide pedestal, lithiated) are modeled by coupling the astra transport solver with neoclassical transport and gyrokinetic-based reduced models for electron temperature gradient (ETG) and kinetic ballooning mode (KBM) instabilities. An empirically normalized quasilinear proxy for ion-scale transport is constructed from linear gene calculations. Its single global coefficient is calibrated to the ELM-free discharge 132588 and retained for 132543, providing a cross-discharge test of transferability. Time-evolving the temperatures yields good profile recovery, confirming the structural consistency inherited from the linear calculations. Systematic analysis of the transport mechanisms reveals that neoclassical transport is substantial across the entire pedestal region for the ion channel. ETG turbulence is large in the plasma edge and low density gradient region, contributing substantially to the electron channel. However, KBM/MHD-like modes also drive significant transport in both the ion and electron thermal channels, making them essential for accurate pedestal modeling. Further refinements, including explicit shear suppression and a refined model for ETG transport, produce quantitative but not qualitative improvements. This proof-of-principle study provides a promising first step toward an empirically constrained predictive framework.
title_zh: 利用简化模型建模NSTX台基区的温度分布
abstract_zh: 本文描述了用于预测球形托卡马克H模台基分布的新建模能力。NSTX放电132543（窄台基）和132588（宽台基、锂化）的温度分布通过将astra输运求解器与新经典输运以及基于回旋动理学的电子温度梯度（ETG）和动能气球模（KBM）不稳定性简化模型相耦合进行建模。基于线性gene计算构建了一个经验归一化的离子尺度输运准线性代理模型。其单一全局系数通过无ELM放电132588进行标定，并保留用于132543，从而提供了跨放电的可迁移性检验。对温度进行时间演化得到了良好的分布恢复，证实了继承自线性计算的结构一致性。对输运机制的系统分析表明，对于离子通道，新经典输运在整个台基区域都很显著。ETG湍流在等离子体边缘和低密度梯度区域很大，对电子通道贡献显著。然而，KBM/类MHD模在离子和电子热通道中均驱动显著输运，因此对于精确的台基建模至关重要。进一步的改进，包括显式的剪切抑制和改进的ETG输运模型，带来了定量而非定性的改善。这一原理验证研究为经验约束的预测框架迈出了有希望的第一步。

title: Modeling of divertor heat flux limits and lithium vapor shielding in NSTX-U using UEDGE code
abstract: Managing extreme heat and particle fluxes to divertor targets remains a critical challenge for high-power spherical tokamaks such as NSTX-U. In this work, UEDGE simulations coupled self-consistently with a two-dimensional wall transport solver (Wall-Li) are used to investigate two closely related issues important for NSTX-U operation: (1) plasma-surface interactions of graphite plasma-facing components (PFCs) under increasing input power for standard and snowflake (SF) divertors and (2) lithium PFC vapor shielding and its dependence on upstream plasma conditions for a standard lower single null divertor with a 5 mm layer of lithium on the graphite tiles. Simulations with graphite target PFCs show a monotonic increase in surface temperature with increasing heat flux incident on the target plates. For a broad range of operating conditions, surface temperatures exceed the graphite sublimation temperature , when graphite starts massively sublimating) once peak heat fluxes exceed 7 MW m . This occurs despite enhanced carbon radiation (up to 2.5 MW for a 10 MW input-power case), indicating that carbon radiation alone is insufficient to dissipate NSTX-U divertor heat loads with graphite PFCs. A SF-minus divertor configuration is analyzed to assess divertor heat handling on the secondary strike point (SP#2) under conditions where both magnetic field-line incidence and cross-field transport are uncertain. A poloidally non-uniform transport model is employed to approximate the enhanced cross-field transport associated with churning-mode (CM) plasma convection in the SF zone. Simulation results indicate that the heat flux to SP#2 is dominated by enhanced CM transport rather than parallel conduction, leading to increased deposited heat flux with increasing CM strength and incidence angle. Lithium vapor shielding is investigated using a self-consistent model in which lithium sourcing depends on local plasma and surface conditions. The model demonstrates that lithium vapor shielding provides passive thermal cooling, maintaining surface temperatures below C even as the core power increases. However, lithium accumulation upstream increases once surface temperatures exceed C. Increasing the core density augments the drag force on impurity ions due to the parallel plasma flow in the scrape-off layer, confining lithium closer to the target and thereby extending the operational window for effective vapor shielding. Overall, these results highlight the necessity of (1) thick lithium layers to prevent strike-point depletion, (2) active cooling mechanisms (such as fast-flowing liquid lithium) to suppress excessive surface temperatures and evaporation, as lithium operation is constrained by surface temperature, and/or (3) deuterium gas puffing near the divertor to further increase SOL flow and density, leading to higher frictional drag on lithium impurities.
title_zh: 使用UEDGE代码建模NSTX-U偏滤器热通量极限与锂蒸气屏蔽

title: Overview of the European breeding blanket programme for HELIAS 5-B: dual coolant lead–lithium design, integration and tools
abstract: As part of EUROfusion’s mission to bring stellarators to technological maturity, the stellarator power plant studies (SPPS) work package prospective R&D (WPPRD) began in 2021 to develop a HELIAS-class power plant. Building on DEMO tokamak experience, European teams are designing a dual coolant lead–lithium (DCLL) breeding blanket (BB) for HELIAS. This concept uses liquid PbLi as breeder/coolant and decoupled helium cooling for the first wall (FW). Two key adaptations address HELIAS’s complex geometry: a detached FW using capillary porous system (CPS) technology, and a quasi-toroidal segmentation (QTS) with PbLi flow aligned to magnetic field lines. QTS reduces magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) pressure drop by up to two orders of magnitude, potentially eliminating electrical insulation needs. Remote handling (RH) is rethought for 3D stellarators, where traditional vertical-port extraction is impractical. Alternatives include enlarged fixed coils, movable coils for temporary large ports, and detachable vessel periods. The detached FW strategy shifts maintenance from large BB segments to smaller, easily replaceable FW panels, extending BB lifetime. CPS designs with Li in tungsten matrices were analysed thermally, hydraulically, and neutronically, showing potential to lower displacement-per-atom (dpa) damage while maintaining tritium breeding. Be-based moderators behind the FW CPS matrix improved tritium breeding ratio (TBR) while reducing back-structure damage. To accelerate design and analysis, HeliasGeom and SHANE tools were developed to rapidly generate realistic 3D parametric geometries for CAD, neutronic, and thermal-hydraulic coupling. Preliminary 3D studies addressed TBR optimization, shielding, MHD in non-uniform fields (via GridapMHD), and multi-scale thermal–mechanical assessments. These innovations collectively advance stellarator blanket technology, integration, and maintainability toward viable power plant concepts.
title_zh: HELIAS 5-B欧洲增殖包层计划概述：双冷却剂铅锂设计、集成与工具

title: Characteristics of core beta-induced Alfvén eigenmodes with shear flow in EAST NBI heating plasmas
abstract: The basic features and relationship with zonal flows of multiple branches of beta-induced Alfvén eigenmodes (BAEs) are investigated in the EAST tokamak. Those branches of BAEs, excited by tangentially injected neutral beam injection, are located in the central region ( ), with frequencies in the range of 50 70 kHz and low toroidal mode numbers . The excitation of BAEs is clearly characterized by three typical features: an increase in the shear locally, accompanied by simultaneous rises in both central rotation velocity and electron temperature. Radial profiles of the mode phase angle from electron cyclotron emission (ECE) diagnostics vary significantly with . Global gyrokinetic simulations of core BAEs are performed in both linear and nonlinear regimes. In the linear regime, the unstable BAE branches are consistent with experiment on toroidal mode number, real frequency and the mode structure phase angle. The radial variation of BAE phase angle is primarily caused by bulk plasma kinetic effects rather than the energetic particle (EP) non-perturbative drive. In the nonlinear regime, single- BAE without zonal fields saturates at a large amplitude that triggers the non-adiabatic frequency chirping on a fast timescale of sub-millisecond, while the self-organized zonal flow beat-driven by BAE greatly reduces BAE saturation amplitude below the chirping threshold, which is in consistency with experimental observation. Moreover, it is confirmed that the criterion of zonal flow regulation on dissipative-type instability (such as AEs) becomes rather than traditional for reactive-type instability. In general,the self-organized zonal flow can improve plasma confinement through regulating both BAEs and drift-wave turbulence.
title_zh: EAST中性束注入加热等离子体中存在剪切流时芯部beta感应Alfvén本征模的特性

title: Progress of LHCD experiment at 4.6 GHz towards long-pulse and high-power operation on EAST
abstract: Recent achievements of lower hybrid current drive (LHCD) experiment at 4.6 GHz towards long-pulse and high-power operation on EAST tokamak are reported. The duration of long-pulse plasmas has been extended to 1056 s with 1.1 MW LH power in I-mode and 1066 s with 0.92 MW in H-mode. The operational domains in plasma current and line-averaged density for fully non-inductive discharges with LH alone and with the combined LH and electron cyclotron (EC) waves are presented. The dependence of LHCD efficiency on plasma density in both L- and H-mode discharges characterized by residual loop voltage Vloop = 0 is quantified. It is found that the LHCD efficiency is improved significantly by EC heating due to the increase of electron temperature. The dominant issues in long-pulse and high-power operation are summarized and discussed, including the power coupling imbalance, the hot spot and arc events in front of the antenna, and the deteriorated plasma heating effect with high LH power. Finally, prospects with a new 4 MW LHCD system at 4.6 GHz which is under development are given.
title_zh: EAST上4.6 GHz低杂波电流驱动实验在长脉冲和高功率运行方面的进展
abstract_zh: 报道了EAST托卡马克上4.6 GHz低杂波电流驱动（LHCD）实验在长脉冲和高功率运行方面的最新进展。长脉冲等离子体的持续时间已延长至I模下1.1 MW LH功率的1056 s和H模下0.92 MW的1066 s。给出了仅用LH以及LH与电子回旋（EC）波联合实现全非感应放电的等离子体电流和线平均密度的运行域。量化了以剩余环电压Vloop = 0为特征的L模和H模放电中LHCD效率对等离子体密度的依赖关系。发现由于电子温度的提高，EC加热显著改善了LHCD效率。总结并讨论了长脉冲和高功率运行中的主要问题，包括功率耦合不平衡、天线前方的热点和电弧事件，以及高LH功率下等离子体加热效果的恶化。最后，展望了正在研发中的4.6 GHz新型4 MW LHCD系统的前景。

title: A Fully Distributed Market Clearing Framework for Peer-to-Peer Energy Trading in Heterogeneous Virtual Power Plants
abstract: Virtual Power Plants (VPPs) are proposed to aggregate numerous small-scale prosumers to handle their barriers in participating in Peer-to-Peer (P2P) markets due to capacity requirements. However, market clearing in P2P energy markets with multiple VPPs is challenging because of VPP heterogeneity, communication resource constraints, and the coupling between intra- and inter-VPP markets. This paper constructs a market clearing framework for this scenery. The fully distributed P2P energy market is designed for inter-VPP market with high communication costs and the intra-VPP market with insufficient communication resources to release the communication burden, while other intra-VPP market apply the distributed framework. Under such a setting, through the reconstruction of the fully - distributed P2P energy market clearing problem based on distributed estimation, the P2P energy market clearing problem for multiple heterogeneous virtual power plants is constructed. A market clearing algorithm is developed based on the consensus ADMM and parallel ADMM to maximize the utilization of communication resources and improving communication efficiency. Furthermore, based on marginal cost pricing, the electricity prices in the heterogeneous intra-VPP markets and inter-VPP market are discussed. Finally, the convergence and scalability of the proposed algorithm and the effectiveness of the electricity price analysis are verified on the IEEE 37-bus and IEEE 123-bus test feeders.
title_zh: 异构虚拟电厂中点对点能源交易的全分布式市场出清框架
abstract_zh: 虚拟电厂（VPP）被提出用于聚合众多小规模产消者，以解决其因容量要求而参与对等（P2P）市场的障碍。然而，由于VPP的异构性、通信资源限制以及VPP内部市场与VPP之间市场的耦合，包含多个VPP的P2P能源市场出清面临挑战。本文针对该场景构建了一个市场出清框架。对于通信成本高的VPP间市场和通信资源不足以减轻通信负担的VPP内部市场，设计了全分布式P2P能源市场，而其他VPP内部市场则采用分布式框架。在此设置下，通过基于分布式估计重构全分布式P2P能源市场出清问题，构建了多个异构虚拟电厂的P2P能源市场出清问题。基于一致性ADMM和并行ADMM开发了市场出清算法，以最大化通信资源利用率并提高通信效率。此外，基于边际成本定价，讨论了异构VPP内部市场和VPP间市场的电价。最后，在IEEE 37节点和IEEE 123节点测试馈线上验证了所提算法的收敛性和可扩展性以及电价分析的有效性。

title: Region-Driven Two-Layer Refined Scheduling for Multi-Stack-Integrated Alkaline Electrolyzer in Wind-Hydrogen System
abstract: To mitigate the stability impacts of renewable intermittency on power systems, on-site accommodation via Power-to-Hydrogen (P2H) stands out as a promising solution. As the most mature P2H technology, balance-of-plant (BOP)-shared multi-stack integrated alkaline water electrolyzer (MSI-AWE) systems offer both high flexibility and cost advantages. However, accommodating highly fluctuating wind power requires scheduling MSI-AWE system at minute-level intervals, posing significant computational burdens for real-time energy management. To address this, this paper first introduces the concept of operational regions to efficiently characterize the time-varying power boundaries of MSI-AWE systems, along with a pruning-based algorithm to accelerate region computation. Further, a minute-level model predictive control (MPC)-based wind-hydrogen operational framework is proposed, which decouples the refined scheduling problem into region-embedded upper-layer power allocation and lower-layer electrolyte/cooling flow regulation. Case studies demonstrate that the two-layer framework extends full wind power utilization duration by 8.7%, improves state regulation accuracy by 4.6%, and reduces average computation time by 50.2% compared to traditional single-layer approaches, validating its effectiveness in enhancing renewable energy accommodation and facilitating smart grid integration.
title_zh: 风-氢系统中多堆集成碱性电解槽的区域驱动两层精细化调度
abstract_zh: 为了缓解可再生能源间歇性对电力系统稳定性的影响，通过电转氢（P2H）实现就地消纳成为一种有前景的解决方案。作为最成熟的P2H技术，共享辅助系统（BOP）的多堆集成碱性水电解（MSI-AWE）系统兼具高灵活性和成本优势。然而，消纳高度波动的风电需要以分钟级间隔对MSI-AWE系统进行调度，给实时能量管理带来巨大的计算负担。为此，本文首先引入运行域的概念，以高效表征MSI-AWE系统的时变功率边界，并提出一种基于剪枝的算法加速区域计算。其次，提出了一种基于分钟级模型预测控制（MPC）的风-氢运行框架，将精细化调度问题解耦为嵌入运行域的上层功率分配和下层电解液/冷却流量调节。案例研究表明，与传统单层方法相比，该两层框架将风电全额消纳时长延长了8.7%，状态调节精度提高了4.6%，平均计算时间减少了50.2%，验证了其在提升可再生能源消纳和促进智能电网并网方面的有效性。

title: A dv / dt Output Filter for Mitigating Motor Terminal Overvoltage in SiC-Based Motor Drive Systems
abstract: The Silicon carbide (SiC) MOSFET, as a prominent wide bandgap device, is extensively used in motor drive systems due to its high-speed switching characteristic. However, higher dv/dt will cause overvoltage at the motor terminals, accelerate the aging of windings and bearings, seriously threaten the insulation of motor windings, and shorten the service life of the motor. To address the critical challenge, this paper proposes a novel third-order LCRL dv/dt filter topology, which introduces parallel inductance to improve the flexibility of cable matching and shunts damping resistors to reduce damping loss, thereby significantly reducing the volume and cost of the heat sink. A parameter design method suitable for high-order filters and a multi-dimensional design optimization strategy based on the optimal loss model are proposed to simultaneously find the best solution to minimize motor terminal overvoltage and total system loss, providing theoretical guidance for the application of high-order dv/dt filters. A series of experimental results demonstrate that the motor terminal overvoltage, damping loss, and volume of the proposed filter are reduced by 81.5%, 43.7%, and 33.3%, respectively, compared with the conventional LCR filter, which improves motor reliability in high-speed switching applications without compromising system efficiency.
title_zh: 用于抑制SiC基电机驱动系统中电机端子过电压的dv/dt输出滤波器
abstract_zh: 碳化硅（SiC）MOSFET作为一种突出的宽禁带器件，凭借其高速开关特性被广泛应用于电机驱动系统。然而，较高的dv/dt会在电机端子处产生过电压，加速绕组和轴承的老化，严重威胁电机绕组绝缘，缩短电机的使用寿命。针对这一关键挑战，本文提出了一种新颖的三阶LCRL dv/dt滤波器拓扑，通过引入并联电感提高电缆匹配的灵活性，并对阻尼电阻进行分流以降低阻尼损耗，从而显著减小散热器的体积和成本。提出了适用于高阶滤波器的参数设计方法和基于最优损耗模型的多维设计优化策略，以同时找到最小化电机端子过电压和系统总损耗的最佳方案，为高阶dv/dt滤波器的应用提供理论指导。一系列实验结果表明，与传统的LCR滤波器相比，所提滤波器的电机端子过电压、阻尼损耗和体积分别降低了81.5%、43.7%和33.3%，在不牺牲系统效率的情况下提高了电机在高速开关应用中的可靠性。

title: Analysis and Elimination of Current Measurement Scaling Error for High-Frequency Voltage Injection-Based Sensorless Control
abstract: Current measurement scaling error (CMSE) is a common problem in permanent magnet synchronous machine (PMSM) drive systems. It can be categorized into current measurement scaling difference error (CMSDE) and current measurement scaling average error (CMSAE). This research aims to analyze and eliminate the effects of the CMSE on rotating high-frequency voltage injection (HFVI)-based sensorless control. Firstly, a detailed analysis of the CMSE-induced position estimation error is presented, revealing the relationship between the position estimation error and the CMSE. It indicates that the CMSE introduces both a DC offset and a 2nd harmonic into the position estimation. Secondly, an effective sequential elimination strategy is proposed to address the CMSDE as its first step, and then the CMSAE as the second step. A moving average filter (MAF) is designed to extract the error signal, followed by a sliding mode controller (SMC) to eliminate the CMSDE and CMSAE. Finally, the theoretical analysis and the elimination methods of the CMSE have been validated by the experimental results.
title_zh: 基于高频电压注入的无传感器控制电流测量标度误差的分析与消除
abstract_zh: 电流测量标度误差（CMSE）是永磁同步电机（PMSM）驱动系统中的常见问题，可分为电流测量标度差异误差（CMSDE）和电流测量标度平均误差（CMSAE）。本研究旨在分析和消除CMSE对基于旋转高频电压注入（HFVI）的无传感器控制的影响。首先，详细分析了CMSE引起的位置估计误差，揭示了位置估计误差与CMSE之间的关系，表明CMSE在位置估计中引入了直流偏置和二次谐波。其次，提出了一种有效的顺序消除策略，第一步处理CMSDE，第二步处理CMSAE。设计了滑动平均滤波器（MAF）以提取误差信号，随后通过滑模控制器（SMC）消除CMSDE和CMSAE。最后，通过实验结果验证了理论分析和CMSE的消除方法。

title: Fine-Grained Optimal Allocation of Wind Farm Decoupled Models for CPU-GPU Parallel EMT Simulation
abstract: Parallel. simulation based on CPU-GPU heterogeneous hardware, owing to its high speed-up ratio, has emerged as an effective approach for accelerating electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulation of wind farms. However, most existing studies rely mainly on hardware multi-threading capabilities, with limited quantitative analysis of model–hardware adaptability, resulting in insufficient exploitation of the complementary advantages of CPUs and GPUs. To this end, this paper proposes a fine-grained optimal allocation method (FGOAM) that formulates the hardware assignment of each subsystem in wind farms as a constrained optimization problem for maximal simulation efficiency. Firstly, a bottom-up quantification method is developed to accurately assess the computational resources and solution time of decoupled models by decomposing the computation process into sequential and parallelizable steps. Secondly, a FGOAM for decoupled wind farm models is proposed, for the first time, by formulating an integer nonlinear programming (INLP) problem for step-level computation allocation. Finally, to further improve solution efficiency of FGOAM, an enhanced FGOAM (E-FGOAM) is derived via integer variable reduction without sacrificing allocation optimality. The accuracy of the proposed quantification method and the improvement on simulation efficiency after optimal allocation are validated. Simulation results demonstrate that the simulation speed is increased by two orders of magnitude for a wind farm consisting of 400 turbines.
title_zh: 风电场解耦模型的细粒度优化分配用于CPU-GPU并行EMT仿真
abstract_zh: 基于CPU-GPU异构硬件的并行仿真因其高加速比，已成为加速风电场电磁暂态（EMT）仿真的有效途径。然而，现有研究大多主要依赖硬件多线程能力，对模型-硬件适应性的定量分析有限，导致CPU与GPU互补优势未被充分挖掘。为此，本文提出了一种细粒度最优分配方法（FGOAM），将风电场中各子系统的硬件分配问题表述为以仿真效率最大化为目标的约束优化问题。首先，开发了一种自底向上的量化方法，通过将计算过程分解为串行和可并行步骤，准确评估解耦模型的计算资源和求解时间。其次，首次针对解耦风电场模型提出了FGOAM，将步级计算分配表述为整数非线性规划（INLP）问题。最后，为进一步提高FGOAM的求解效率，在不牺牲分配最优性的前提下，通过整数变量缩减推导出增强型FGOAM（E-FGOAM）。验证了所提量化方法的准确性以及最优分配后仿真效率的提升。仿真结果表明，对于由400台风机构成的风电场，仿真速度提高了两个数量级。

title: Droop-Based Hierarchical Control for Power-Sharing and Voltage Balancing in Bipolar DC Microgrids
abstract: Bipolar DC microgrids, which consist of three lines and three voltage buses, are increasingly being explored in modern power systems as they can provide higher reliability and flexibility compared to unipolar systems. One of the main assignments of bipolar DC microgrids is the efficient operation through power-sharing between converters. However, compared to unipolar systems, there are more considerations to operate bipolar systems such as power coupling across three buses, unbalanced load, and voltage imbalance. To settle the above considerations, this article presents droop-based hierarchical control in bipolar DC microgrid, consisting of primary and secondary control levels. The primary level performs power-sharing through droop control, which is designed based on the equivalent droop circuit model of bipolar DC microgrid and analysis of power coupling and load imbalance conditions. The second level is implemented through low-bandwidth communication and performs voltage restoration and balancing bipolar bus voltages or SoC of energy storage systems in the bipolar DC microgrid. Stability analysis of the entire control system including primary and second control levels is conducted. Finally, the operation and effectiveness of the proposed hierarchical control are validated via lab-scale DC microgrid experiments.
title_zh: 双极性直流微电网中基于下垂控制的功率分配与电压均衡分层控制
abstract_zh: 双极性直流微电网由三根线和三个电压母线组成，与单极性系统相比可提供更高的可靠性和灵活性，因而在现代电力系统中日益受到关注。双极性直流微电网的主要任务之一是通过变换器间的功率分配实现高效运行。然而，与单极性系统相比，双极性系统的运行需要考虑更多因素，如三条母线间的功率耦合、不平衡负载和电压不平衡。为解决上述问题，本文提出了双极性直流微电网中基于下垂控制的分层控制，包括一次和二次控制层。一次控制层通过下垂控制实现功率分配，该控制基于双极性直流微电网的等效下垂电路模型以及功率耦合和负载不平衡条件的分析进行设计。二次控制层通过低带宽通信实现电压恢复以及双极性直流微电网中双极性母线电压或储能系统SoC的均衡。对包含一次和二次控制层的整个控制系统进行了稳定性分析。最后，通过实验室规模的直流微电网实验验证了所提分层控制的运行和有效性。

title: Parallelizable Complex Neural Dynamics Models for PMSM Temperature Estimation With Hardware Acceleration
abstract: Accurate and efficient thermal dynamics models of permanent magnet synchronous motors are vital to efficient thermal management strategies. Physics-informed methods combine model-based and data-driven methods, offering greater flexibility than model-based methods and superior explainability compared to data-driven methods. Nonetheless, there are still challenges in balancing real-time performance, estimation accuracy, and explainability. This paper presents a hardware-efficient complex neural dynamics model achieved through the linear decoupling, diagonalization, and reparameterization of the state-space model, introducing a novel paradigm for the physics-informed method that offers high explainability and accuracy in electric motor temperature estimation tasks. We validate this physics-informed method on an NVIDIA A800 GPU using the JAX machine learning framework, the parallel prefix-sum algorithm, and the Compute Unified Device Architecture (CUDA) platform. We demonstrate its superior estimation performance and parallelizable hardware acceleration capabilities through experimental evaluation on a real electric motor.
title_zh: 可并行化复数神经动力学模型用于PMSM温度估计及硬件加速
abstract_zh: 永磁同步电机精确高效的热动力学模型对于高效的热管理策略至关重要。物理信息方法融合了基于模型的方法与数据驱动方法，相比基于模型的方法具有更强的灵活性，相比数据驱动的方法具有更优的可解释性。然而，在实时性、估计精度与可解释性之间取得平衡仍存在挑战。本文通过对状态空间模型进行线性解耦、对角化和重参数化，提出了一种硬件高效的新型复杂神经动力学模型，为物理信息方法引入了一种新范式，在电机温度估计任务中兼具高可解释性与高精度。我们在NVIDIA A800 GPU上，利用JAX机器学习框架、并行前缀和算法以及计算统一设备架构（CUDA）平台对该物理信息方法进行了验证。通过对实际电机的实验评估，我们展示了其卓越的估计性能与可并行的硬件加速能力。

title: PLL-Free Approach: Reactive Power-Based Synchronization in Grid-Following Inverters
abstract: The rapid growth in inverter-based resource penetration is leading to the widespread integration of grid-following and grid-forming inverters within ac grids. Despite their distinct operational characteristics, these two inverter modes share fundamental similarities, motivating joint investigations into their attributes. Building on the identified symmetry between these devices, this paper proposes a novel phase-locked loop-free grid-following control strategy inspired by the grid-forming control architecture. The proposed approach simplifies the grid-following inverter control structure while retaining its inherent capabilities and enabling the intuitive configuration of synchronous inertia and damping. Analytical, experimental, and simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.
title_zh: 无锁相环方法：并网逆变器中基于无功功率的同步
abstract_zh: 基于逆变器资源渗透率的快速增长，正导致跟网型和构网型逆变器在交流电网中的广泛应用。尽管这两种逆变器模式具有不同的运行特性，但它们在基本原理上具有相似性，这促成了对其属性的联合研究。基于所识别的这些装置之间的对称性，本文提出了一种受构网型控制架构启发的无锁相环跟网型控制新策略。所提出的方法简化了跟网型逆变器的控制结构，同时保留了其固有能力，并能够直观地配置同步惯量和阻尼。解析、实验和仿真结果验证了所提策略的有效性。

title: An End-to-End Learning Model With Quantization Technology for Dynamic Prediction-Decision Joint-Making in Active Distribution Networks
abstract: Efficient load management and system stability in active distribution networks (ADNs) depend heavily on accurate forecasting of photovoltaic (PV) generation, load demand, and reliable dynamic decision-making. This paper proposes a novel end-to-end joint learning model for dynamic prediction-decision joint-making in active distribution networks. The model integrates a prediction module, leveraging attentional-quantization long short-term memory (AQLSTM) networks to forecast photovoltaic generation, active power load, and reactive power load, with a control decision module based on Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3). The forecasting outputs are fed into the decision-making module, enabling dynamic adjustments to network parameters. A feedback mechanism is introduced which incorporates decision losses into the prediction module to enhance forecasting accuracy, thereby creating a tightly coupled, end-to-end joint optimization framework. In addition, a sensitivity-aware mixed-precision quantization technology is adopted to reduce computational overhead and facilitate efficient deployment. Experimental results on IEEE 33-bus and 123-bus distribution networks demonstrate that the proposed model outperforms other methods in terms of forecasting accuracy and dynamic control effectiveness, resulting in substantial improvements in the operational efficiency and stability of ADNs.
title_zh: 采用量化技术的端到端学习模型用于主动配电网动态预测-决策联合制定
abstract_zh: 有源配电网（ADN）中高效的负荷管理与系统稳定性在很大程度上依赖于光伏（PV）出力预测、负荷需求预测以及可靠的动态决策。本文提出了一种用于有源配电网动态预测—决策联合制定的新型端到端联合学习模型。该模型集成了预测模块与控制决策模块：预测模块利用注意力量化长短期记忆（AQLSTM）网络预测光伏出力、有功负荷和无功负荷；决策模块基于双延迟深度确定性策略梯度（TD3）。预测输出被馈入决策模块，以实现对网络参数的动态调整。引入了一种反馈机制，将决策损失纳入预测模块以提高预测精度，从而构建了一个紧耦合的端到端联合优化框架。此外，采用了一种敏感性感知的混合精度量化技术，以降低计算开销并实现高效部署。在IEEE 33母线和123母线配电网上的实验结果表明，所提模型在预测精度和动态控制效果方面优于其他方法，显著提升了ADN的运行效率与稳定性。

title: Situationally Aware Rolling Horizon Multi-Tier Load Restoration Considering Behind-the-Meter DER
abstract: Restoration in power distribution systems (PDSs) is well studied, however, most existing research focuses on network partition and microgrid formation, where load transfer is limited to adjacent feeders. This focus is not practical, as when adjacent feeders lack sufficient capacity, utilities may request support from more distant feeders in practice. Such a hierarchical restoration is complex, especially when involving changing system conditions due to cold load pickup and delayed reconnection of behind-the-meter DERs. To fill this research gap, a situationally aware multi-tier load restoration framework is proposed. Specifically, models are proposed to describe the multi-tier load restoration, including the multi-tier load transfer and substation transformer and feeder protection models. By introducing binary actional switching variables and load block transfer variables, the models effectively captures the dynamics of switches and multi-tier transfer process. To integrate situational awareness of evolving system conditions, the problem is formulated as a mixed-integer linear program (MILP) and then embedded within a rolling horizon optimization. Particularly, a set of safeguarded constraints are developed based on segment-level restoration reward bounds to mitigate the myopia of traditional rolling horizon optimization. The proposed safeguarded rolling strategy guarantees that each time step is lower bounded by a $(1-\varepsilon)$ -fraction of its optimal restoration potential, thereby balancing short-term switching decisions with long-term restoration goals. Finally, cases studies on the modified IEEE 123-node test feeder validate the proposed multi-tier restoration framework.
title_zh: 考虑表后DER的情境感知滚动时域多级负荷恢复
abstract_zh: 配电系统（PDS）的恢复问题已被广泛研究，然而，现有研究大多集中于网络分区与微电网构建，其中负荷转供仅限于相邻馈线。这一关注点并不切合实际，因为当相邻馈线容量不足时，实际中电力公司可能会向更远的馈线寻求支持。这种分层恢复十分复杂，尤其是当涉及由冷负荷投入和表后DER延迟并网引起的系统条件变化时。为填补这一研究空白，提出了一种情境感知的多层级负荷恢复框架。具体而言，建立了描述多层级负荷恢复的模型，包括多层级负荷转供以及变电站变压器与馈线保护模型。通过引入二元动作切换变量和负荷块转供变量，该模型有效刻画了开关动作与多层级转供过程的动态特性。为了纳入对系统条件演变的情境感知，该问题被表述为混合整数线性规划（MILP），并嵌入滚动时域优化之中。特别地，基于分段级恢复收益界开发了一组保护性约束，以缓解传统滚动时域优化的短视性。所提出的保护性滚动策略保证每个时间步均以其最优恢复潜力的 $(1-\varepsilon)$ 比例为下界，从而在短期开关决策与长期恢复目标之间取得平衡。最后，算例

title: Additional AC Copper Losses in the Field Winding of Converter-Fed Synchronous Machines for Pumped Storage Hydropower Plants
abstract: Converter-fed synchronous machines for variable speed pumped storage hydropower plants are becoming increasingly important as the share of fluctuating renewable energy increases. The inverter connected to the stator terminals causes additional harmonic currents in the stator winding, which induce additional harmonic currents in the field winding. Due to the eddy current effects and the typical form-wound coil design, these additional harmonic currents in the field winding can lead to significant additional losses, even with relatively small amplitudes. The aim of this paper is to calculate these additional losses. Therefore, numerical calculations are used to determine the resistance factor for a frequency band from $\text{0}\,\text{Hz}$ to $\text{15}\,\text{kHz}$ while also considering saturation. In addition, two measurements are carried out on a research hydro generator at different inverter switching frequencies. Using the measured currents and determined resistance factors, the additional losses due to the switching frequency are calculated and validated using a temperature measurement in the field winding. The results of this work are important for the future design and cooling of large converter-fed synchronous machines with form-wound field coils, as the additional AC losses in the field winding are usually neglected.
title_zh: 抽水蓄能电站变频器供电同步电机励磁绕组中的附加交流铜耗
abstract_zh: 随着波动性可再生能源占比的不断提高，用于变速抽水蓄能电站的变流器馈电同步电机正变得越来越重要。连接到定子端子的逆变器会在定子绕组中引起附加谐波电流，并在励磁绕组中感应出附加谐波电流。由于涡流效应以及典型的成形绕组线圈设计，励磁绕组中的这些附加谐波电流即使幅值相对较小，也可能导致显著的附加损耗。本文旨在计算这些附加损耗。为此，采用数值计算方法在 $\text{0}\,\text{Hz}$ 至 $\text{15}\,\text{kHz}$ 的频带范围内确定电阻因子，并同时考虑饱和效应。此外，在一台研究用水轮发电机上针对不同的逆变器开关频率进行了两次测量。利用实测电流和所确定的电阻因子，计算了由开关频率引起的附加损耗，并通过励磁绕组的温度测量进行了验证。由于励磁绕组中的附加交流损耗通常被忽视，本工作的结果对于未来采用成形绕组励磁线圈的大型变流器馈电同步电机的设计与冷却具有重要意义。

title: Static Voltage Stability and DGs Integration Capacity Quantification Method With Extended Power Flow for ADNs With Grid-Forming and Grid-Following DGs
abstract: Power flow calculation and static voltage stability (SVS) analysis of active distribution networks (ADNs) are facing convergence and applicability issues caused by extreme conditions and control strategies of grid-forming (GFM) and grid-following (GFL) distributed generations (DGs). To solve these challenges, an SVS and DG integration capacity quantification method based on extended holomorphic embedding power flow (EHEPF) is proposed which includes four aspects: 1) an EHEPF algorithm is developed that accommodates both convergence and converter’s internal primary and secondary control characteristics of DGs; 2) the unsolvable mathematical expression of EHEPF is derived using Padé approximant to clearly distinguish between no solution and lower-branch (inoperable) solution; 3) the voltage sensitivity and SVS indexes of EHEPF combining different control strategies of DGs are formulated to analyze the weak bus and SVS of ADNs; 4) the DGs integration capacity is quantified by balancing SVS and network loss under voltage distribution calculated in EHEPF. Case studies are carried out on 12 bus, IEEE 33 and IEEE 123 bus systems. Numerous test results are analyzed to verify the applicability, convergence and effectiveness of proposed EHEPF for SVS and DGs integration capacity quantification in ADNs.
title_zh: 考虑构网型和跟网型DG的主动配电网扩展潮流静态电压稳定与DG接纳容量量化方法
abstract_zh: 有源配电网（ADN）的潮流计算与静态电压稳定（SVS）分析正面临由极端条件以及构网型（GFM）和跟网型（GFL）分布式电源（DG）控制策略所引发的收敛性与适用性问题。为解决这些挑战，提出了一种基于扩展全纯嵌入潮流（EHEPF）的SVS与DG并网容量量化方法，包括四个方面：1）开发了兼顾收敛性与变流器内部一次和二次控制特性的DG的EHEPF算法；2）利用Padé逼近推导了EHEPF的不可解数学表达，以明确区分无解与下分支（不可运行）解；3）构建了结合DG不同控制策略的EHEPF电压灵敏度与SVS指标，用于分析ADN的弱母线与SVS；4）通过在EHEPF计算的电压分布下平衡SVS与网损来量化DG并网容量。在12母线、IEEE 33和IEEE 123母线系统上进行了算例研究。通过分析大量测试结果，验证了所提EHEPF方法在ADN的SVS与DG并网容量量化中的适用性、收敛性与有效性。

title: A Direct Harmonic Current Suppression Technique for Dual Three-Phase PMSM System
abstract: Due to the small equivalent impedance in harmonic loop, the harmonic currents in dual three-phase permanent-magnet synchronous machine system are relatively large, which would lead to the serious distortion of phase currents and extra system loss. Hence, the suppression of harmonic currents is indispensable. To further improve the suppression performance, the simplified technique is proposed. In the proposed technique, two variable virtual voltage vectors, which are dynamically determined by the reference voltages, are designed and applied in modulation process, under both the fundamental-related sub-plane and the harmonic-related sub-planes. The novelty of the proposed technique is that the modulation implementation is greatly simplified while the harmonic currents are effectively suppressed, compared with the previous methods. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed technique is validated through the experimental test.
title_zh: 双三相PMSM系统的直接谐波电流抑制技术
abstract_zh: 由于谐波回路中等效阻抗较小，双三相永磁同步电机系统中的谐波电流相对较大，会导致相电流严重畸变和额外的系统损耗。因此，谐波电流的抑制不可或缺。为进一步提升抑制性能，提出了一种简化技术。在所提技术中，设计了两个由参考电压动态确定的可变虚拟电压矢量，并在基波相关子平面和谐波相关子平面下的调制过程中均加以应用。所提技术的新颖之处在于，与以往方法相比，在有效抑制谐波电流的同时，大幅简化了调制的实现。最后，通过实验测试验证了所提技术的有效性。

title: Low Carbon Scheduling of Integrated Energy System Based on Large Language Model-Embedded Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: The complex multi-energy coupling characteristics inherent to integrated energy system (IES) present unprecedented challenges for the implementation of low-carbon scheduling. Existing optimization methods often exhibit limitations in system scalability, algorithm adaptivity, and carbon reduction efficacy for complex IES. This paper proposes a Large Language Model (LLM)-Embedded Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (LEMARL) to address the aforementioned issues. The proposed method integrates the global perception capability of LLMs with the dynamic optimization capability of MARL. Specifically, the LLM-Embedded module generates high-quality reward functions and policy frameworks from a global perspective, while the MARL module leverages these LLM-generated strategies for distributed interactive iterations—greatly enhancing computation efficiency and scalability. Simulation results demonstrate that LEMARL reduces carbon emissions by 7.76% and simultaneously decreases operating costs by 4.49% in a small-scale IES. Furthermore, LEMARL also exhibits superior applicability and scalability in large-scale IES of the IEEE 141-bus power grid integrated with 51-node thermal system.
title_zh: 基于嵌入大语言模型的多智能体强化学习的综合能源系统低碳调度
abstract_zh: 综合能源系统（IES）固有的复杂多能耦合特性给低碳调度的实施带来了前所未有的挑战。现有优化方法在系统可扩展性、算法自适应性以及复杂IES的碳减排效果方面往往存在局限。本文提出一种大语言模型嵌入式多智能体强化学习方法（LEMARL）以解决上述问题。所提方法将LLM的全局感知能力与MARL的动态优化能力相结合。具体而言，LLM嵌入式模块从全局视角生成高质量的奖励函数和策略框架，而MARL模块利用这些LLM生成的策略进行分布式交互迭代，从而大幅提升计算效率和可扩展性。仿真结果表明，在小规模IES中，LEMARL将碳排放降低7.76%，同时将运行成本降低4.49%。此外，在集成51节点热系统的IEEE 141节点电网的大规模IES中，LEMARL也表现出优越的适用性和可扩展性。

title: Probabilistic Disaggregation of Behind-the-Meter PV Systems Using Conformal Prediction
abstract: Disaggregating solar photovoltaics (PV) profiles from smart electricity meter data has attracted attention, as Distribution System Operators (DSOs) need street-level PV generation profiles to improve grid operations and planning. Given the importance of reliability in operational decisions, probabilistic results are preferred to avoid overlooking potential violations. This paper proposes a probabilistic disaggregation framework based on Conformal Prediction (CP), a cutting-edge uncertainty quantification methodology. This framework trains a deterministic regressor to estimate normalized PV generation profiles and proposes an efficient capacity estimation algorithm to help compute the full PV generation profiles. To obtain probabilistic results, the framework applied CP with different variants, such as Mondrian Binning (MB) and Conformal Predictive System (CPS), to enhance the reliability of prediction intervals. To address the arbitrary bin count in CP with MB, the paper proposes a novel CP variant, namely: Adaptive Mondrian Binning (AMB). Its performance, along with other CP methods, is evaluated and benchmarked against quantile regression methods on two actual datasets from the region of Amsterdam, the Netherlands, and Sydney, Australia. Results show that using LightGBM as the deterministic regressor, AMB outperforms quantile regression and other CP variants. The generalizability of the proposed framework is analysed for both probabilistic outputs and key sub-processes, such as deterministic disaggregation and capacity estimation.
title_zh: 基于共形预测的表后光伏系统概率分解
abstract_zh: 从智能电表数据中分解太阳能光伏（PV）出力曲线受到广泛关注，因为配电系统运营商（DSO）需要街道级PV发电曲线以改进电网运行与规划。鉴于可靠性在运行决策中的重要性，概率性结果更受青睐，以避免忽视潜在越限。本文提出一种基于保形预测（CP）的概率分解框架，CP是一种前沿的不确定性量化方法。该框架训练一个确定性回归器来估计归一化的PV发电曲线，并提出一种高效的容量估计算法以辅助计算完整的PV发电曲线。为获得概率性结果，该框架采用不同变体的CP方法，如Mondrian分箱（MB）和保形预测系统（CPS），以提升预测区间的可靠性。针对CP结合MB中箱数任意选取的问题，本文提出一种新颖的CP变体，即自适应Mondrian分箱（AMB）。基于荷兰阿姆斯特丹地区和澳大利亚悉尼的两个实际数据集，对该方法及其他CP方法的性能进行了评估，并与分位数回归方法进行了基准对比。结果表明，以LightGBM作为确定性回归器时，AMB优于分位数回归和其他CP变体。本文还从概率输出以及确定性分解和容量估计等关键子过程两方面分析了所提框架的泛化能力。

title: Multi-Time Scale Distributed Stochastic Economic Dispatch for Flexible Traction Power Supply System
abstract: Flexible traction power supply system (FTPSS), integrated with renewable energy, energy storage, and power flow controllers (PFC), offers great potential for safe and economical railway operation. However, the uncertainty in traction load and photovoltaic (PV) output poses significant challenges to cost-effective dispatch. Therefore, a multi-time scale distributed stochastic economic dispatch method for FTPSS is proposed. The prediction module uses LSTM to produce point forecasts, while KDE models the forecast errors to construct predictive intervals and generate scenarios for PV output and traction load. A stochastic programming model is then formulated, where uncertainties in traction load and PV are represented by chance constraints and scenarios. In the first stage, the day-ahead forecast is used to solve the stochastic optimization model to minimize daily operational cost. In the second stage, the scheduler uses the day-ahead plan as a soft reference and re-optimizes at each rolling step with updated probabilistic forecasts, implementing only the first control move to maintain real-time responsiveness and economic efficiency. The optimization model is solved using an ADMM-based distributed algorithm, which accounts for limited inter-subsystem communication and reduces computational complexity. A case study based on a real electrified railway demonstrates that the proposed method improves economic performance by reducing operating costs by approximately 9% under uncertainty.
title_zh: 面向柔性牵引供电系统的多时间尺度分布式随机经济调度
abstract_zh: 柔性牵引供电系统（FTPSS）集成了可再生能源、储能和潮流控制器（PFC），为铁路的安全经济运行提供了巨大潜力。然而，牵引负荷和光伏（PV）出力的不确定性给经济调度带来了重大挑战。为此，提出一种适用于FTPSS的多时间尺度分布式随机经济调度方法。预测模块利用LSTM生成点预测，同时采用KDE对预测误差建模以构建预测区间并为PV出力和牵引负荷生成场景。随后建立随机规划模型，其中牵引负荷和PV的不确定性由机会约束和场景表示。第一阶段，利用日前预测求解随机优化模型以最小化日运行成本。第二阶段，调度器将日前计划作为软参考，在每个滚动步利用更新的概率预测进行再优化，仅执行首个控制动作，以保持实时响应能力和经济性。优化模型采用基于ADMM的分布式算法求解，该算法考虑了子系统间有限的通信能力并降低了计算复杂度。基于某实际电气化铁路的案例研究表明，所提方法在不确定性环境下将运行成本降低约9%，提升了经济性能。

title: Dynamic Behavior Modeling of Price-Responsive Flexible Loads: A Deep Learning-Parameterized Inverse Optimization Approach
abstract: Accurately modeling the behavior of price-responsive flexible loads (PRFLs) is increasingly critical for enhancing power system flexibility. While existing inverse optimization methods can achieve flexible load modeling using only external price-response data, the surrogate model with time-invariant parameters severely limits its ability to capture dynamic behaviors induced by user demands, weather conditions, etc. In contrast to mainstream static modeling formulations, this paper proposes a Deep Learning-parameterized Inverse Optimization (DL-IO) method that enables dynamic surrogate modeling of PRFLs. Specifically, a dynamic virtual energy storage (DVES) model is formulated as the surrogate model, with its parameters represented by multi-task deep learning to exhibit time-varying properties. Then, the DVES model is integrated into the DL-IO framework, enabling the approximation of response behaviors for thermostatically controlled loads (TCLs) and electric vehicles (EVs) based solely on price-response data and public information. To solve the resulting bi-level DL-IO problem, it is reformulated as an empirical risk minimization task, which consists of a deep learning-based parameter estimation layer and an optimization-based response estimation layer. An analytical end-to-end gradient is then derived and backpropagated through both layers to achieve behavior learning. Numerical tests indicate that the proposed modeling method outperforms existing inverse optimization and data-driven regression approaches.
title_zh: 价格响应型柔性负荷的动态行为建模：一种深度学习参数化逆优化方法
abstract_zh: 准确建模价格响应型柔性负荷（PRFL）的行为对于提升电力系统灵活性日益关键。现有逆优化方法虽可仅利用外部价格响应数据实现柔性负荷建模，但含时不变参数的代理模型严重限制了其捕捉由用户需求、天气条件等因素引起的动态行为的能力。与主流静态建模方法不同，本文提出一种深度学习参数化逆优化（DL-IO）方法，实现PRFL的动态代理建模。具体而言，构建动态虚拟储能（DVES）模型作为代理模型，其参数由多任务深度学习表示以呈现时变特性。随后，将DVES模型集成到DL-IO框架中，仅基于价格响应数据和公开信息即可逼近温控负荷（TCL）和电动汽车（EV）的响应行为。为求解由此产生的双层DL-IO问题，将其重构为经验风险最小化任务，包括基于深度学习的参数估计层和基于优化的响应估计层。进而推导出解析的端到端梯度并在两层之间反向传播，实现行为学习。数值测试表明，所提建模方法优于现有逆优化和数据驱动回归方法。

title: A Cross-Line Successive Fault Detection of Distribution Network Based on Zero-Sequence Capacitance Variation
abstract: In non-effectively grounded system, the rise in phase voltage during single-phase grounding (SPG) fault poses a significant threat to the system’s insulation integrity. The increasing cabling rate in distribution network has led to a rising proportion of cross-line double successive single-phase grounding (SSPG) faults triggered by initial fault. To address the challenges of weak characteristic and difficult detection of such successive fault, this paper proposes a SSPG detection method based on zero-sequence capacitance variation. First, the dynamic zero-sequence equivalent network during successive faults is simplified, and derive the zero-sequence current (ZSC) expressions for each feeder under both overdamped and underdamped conditions. Subsequently, the singular value decomposition-total least squares extended Prony algorithm is employed to fit the zero-sequence voltage (ZSV) and ZSC, enabling the calculation of zero-sequence capacitance for both initial and successive faults in the complex frequency domain. A detection criterion is then constructed using the variation of capacitance. Finally, digital simulations and recorded field data validate the correctness and feasibility of the theoretical analysis.
title_zh: 基于零序电容变化的配电网跨线相继故障检测
abstract_zh: 在小电流接地系统中，单相接地（SPG）故障引起的相电压升高对系统绝缘完整性构成严重威胁。配电网电缆化率的提高导致由初始故障引发的跨线路双重连续单相接地（SSPG）故障比例不断上升。针对此类连续故障特征微弱、检测困难的问题，本文提出一种基于零序电容变化的SSPG检测方法。首先，简化连续故障期间的动态零序等效网络，推导过阻尼和欠阻尼条件下各馈线的零序电流（ZSC）表达式。随后，采用奇异值分解-总体最小二乘扩展Prony算法拟合零序电压（ZSV）和ZSC，从而在复频域中计算初始故障和连续故障的零序电容。进而利用电容的变化构建检测判据。最后，数字仿真和现场录波数据验证了理论分析的正确性和可行性。

title: Spatial-Constrained Structure Optimization of the Mover for Minimizing Power Consumption in Maglev Planar Motors
abstract: This paper presents a novel spatial-structure optimization method for the coils of moving-coil magnetically levitated planar motors (MLPMs) to address the coupled challenges of power consumption and spatial constraints. The proposed framework systematically determines the optimal coil geometry and arrangement to minimize power consumption under a required force output and a strictly confined mover volume. A harmonic-based electromagnetic force model is employed to guide a compact coil layout by defining the number, length, and spacing of coils. These parameters are subsequently incorporated into a power-minimization model to determine the coil and beam widths. A final trade-off optimization is performed to balance high-order harmonic suppression and manufacturing tolerance, resulting in a comprehensive design strategy. Experimental results validate the superiority of the proposed method: under identical motor dimensions and magnetic pole pitch, the optimized design achieves more than a 40% increase in thrust-to-weight ratio (TWR) while reducing thrust fluctuation to below 15%. Furthermore, at a constant levitation height, the proposed design reduces power consumption by 10% to 25% compared with conventional systems. These findings demonstrate significant improvements in system stability and force efficiency, offering a generalized and practical design guideline for high-performance moving-coil MLPM.
title_zh: 面向磁悬浮平面电机功耗最小化的动子空间约束结构优化
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种针对动圈式磁悬浮平面电机（MLPMs）线圈的新型空间结构优化方法，以解决功耗与空间约束相互耦合的挑战。所提出的框架可在满足所需力输出且动子体积严格受限的条件下，系统性地确定最优的线圈几何形状与排布，以实现功耗最小化。采用基于谐波的电磁力模型，通过定义线圈的数目、长度和间距来指导紧凑的线圈布局。随后将这些参数纳入功耗最小化模型，以确定线圈宽度和梁宽。最终进行折衷优化，以平衡高次谐波抑制与制造公差，从而形成一套完整的设计策略。实验结果验证了所提方法的优越性：在电机尺寸和磁极距相同的情况下，优化设计使推重比（TWR）提升超过40%，同时将推力波动降至15%以下。此外，在恒定悬浮高度下，与传统系统相比，所提设计将功耗降低了10%至25%。这些结果表明系统稳定性和力效率得到显著改善，为高性能动圈式MLPM提供了一套通用且实用的设计准则。

title: Impact of Shielding Configurations With Magnetic-Electrically Conductive Alloy on Multi-Physical Fields in the End Region of Air-Cooled Synchronous Condenser
abstract: In large-capacity air-cooled synchronous condensers (ACSCs) operating under deep leading-phase conditions, significant end leakage flux induces substantial losses and heating in the stator end components. Effective electromagnetic shielding is therefore a critical design consideration and a novel shielding configuration utilizing magnetic-electrical conductive alloys is proposed in this article. Using a 300 MVar ACSC as a case study, the three-dimensional transient electromagnetic field model of the end region is first established. The effects of four configurations (copper shield+magnetic shield, Fe-16<inline-formula><tex-math notation="LaTeX">$\%$</tex-math></inline-formula>Cu alloy shield+magnetic shield, single Fe-20<inline-formula><tex-math notation="LaTeX">$\%$</tex-math></inline-formula>Cu alloy shield, and single magnetic shield) on the leakage flux density and losses in end components are analyzed. Subsequently, a global ventilation network and a fluid-thermal coupling model for the end region are developed for each configuration. The results from network and aforementioned losses serve as boundary conditions for the fluid-thermal coupling model. The flow fields and the temperature distributions under different configurations are then determined. The findings demonstrate that each shielding configuration exhibits specific advantages and limitations. Experimental validation based on traditional scheme confirms the accuracy of the model and methodology. The simulation results elucidate the significant potential of the Fe-Cu alloy. The single Fe-20<inline-formula><tex-math notation="LaTeX">$\%$</tex-math></inline-formula>Cu configuration reduces the hot-spot temperature of shield, and significantly lowers weight and cost while effectively protecting the end iron core.
title_zh: 磁电导磁导电合金屏蔽结构对空冷同步调相机端部多物理场的影响
abstract_zh: 在大容量空冷同步调相机（ACSCs）深度进相运行条件下，显著的端部漏磁会在定子端部部件中引起 substantial 损耗和发热。因此，有效的电磁屏蔽是一个关键的设计考量，本文提出了一种利用磁电导电合金的新型屏蔽结构。以一台300 MVar的ACSC为例，首先建立了端部区域的三维瞬态电磁场模型。分析了四种结构（铜屏蔽+磁屏蔽、Fe-16%Cu合金屏蔽+磁屏蔽、单一Fe-20%Cu合金屏蔽以及单一磁屏蔽）对端部部件漏磁通密度和损耗的影响。随后，针对每种结构建立了全局通风网络和端部区域的流体-热耦合模型。网络结果和上述损耗作为流体-热耦合模型的边界条件，进而确定了不同结构下的流场和温度分布。研究结果表明，每种屏蔽结构各有其优势与局限。基于传统方案的实验验证证实了模型和方法的准确性。仿真结果阐明了Fe-Cu合金的巨大潜力。单一Fe-20%

title: Stage-Wise Analytical Modeling of the Stray Magnetic Field in Surface-Mounted Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors Under Mixed Eccentricity
abstract: Conventional subdomain methods face challenges in calculating the stray magnetic field of surface-mounted permanent magnet synchronous motors (SPMSMs) under eccentric conditions due to their inability to handle complex boundaries, leading to low computational efficiency. To address these issues, this paper proposes a cell-based Schwarz-Christoffel (SC) mapping method and a stage-wise calculation strategy to improve computational efficiency while maintaining accuracy. First, an analytical model (AM) integrating equivalent surface current, conformal transformation method is established. Based on magnetic field superposition, the load air-gap magnetic field is derived. Second, a stage-wise subdomain-based computational strategy is employed to decouple the magnetic field calculations for the air-gap region and the outer air region. The stray magnetic field is analytically modeled using SC mapping and separation of variables. Finally, the proposed method is validated through experiments on an 8-pole 18-slot interior-rotor SPMSM with mixed eccentricity. Results show that the TM achieves a computational error of only 3.49% and that the computational speed is 136 times faster than that of the finite element method (FEM).
title_zh: 混合偏心下表贴式永磁同步电机杂散磁场的分段解析建模
abstract_zh: 传统子域方法在计算偏心条件下表贴式永磁同步电机（SPMSMs）的杂散磁场时，由于无法处理复杂边界而面临挑战，导致计算效率低下。为解决这些问题，本文提出了一种基于单元的Schwarz-Christoffel（SC）映射方法和分段计算策略，在保持精度的同时提高计算效率。首先，建立了结合等效面电流与保角变换法的解析模型（AM）。基于磁场叠加，推导了负载气隙磁场。其次，采用基于分段子域的计算策略，将气隙区域和外部空气区域的磁场计算解耦。利用SC映射和分离变量法对杂散磁场进行了解析建模。最后，在一台具有混合偏心的8极18槽内转子SPMSM上通过实验验证了所提方法。结果表明，该方法（TM）的计算误差仅为3.49%，计算速度比有限元法（FEM）快136倍。

title: Sensorless Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors Using Model Predictive Algorithm Based Back-EMF Observer
abstract: Back-electromotive force (back-EMF) based sensorless control is widely applied in permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) drives. For high-gain back-EMF observers, the control law often leads to an inherent trade-off between steady-state accuracy and dynamic response. To address this issue, a model predictive control (MPC)-based observer designed in discrete-time domain is proposed in this article. In the studied observer, the optimal control action selected from a predetermined set is adopted to eliminate the current estimation error. Then, the estimated back-EMFs can be extracted from the applied control actions. By leveraging traversing optimization, the proposed method improves the current error and observation accuracy while maintaining fast response and robustness. Experimental results conducted on a 1-kW PMSM platform verify the effectiveness of the proposed observer.
title_zh: 基于模型预测算法反电动势观测器的永磁同步电机无传感器控制
abstract_zh: 基于反电动势（back-EMF）的无传感器控制广泛应用于永磁同步电机（PMSM）驱动系统。对于高增益反电动势观测器，其控制律往往导致稳态精度与动态响应之间固有的折衷。针对这一问题，本文提出了一种在离散时间域中设计的基于模型预测控制（MPC）的观测器。在所研究的观测器中，采用从预定集合中选取的最优控制动作来消除电流估计误差，随后可从所施加的控制动作中提取估计的反电动势。借助遍历优化，所提方法在保持快速响应和鲁棒性的同时，提高了电流误差和观测精度。在1-kW PMSM平台上进行的实验结果验证了所提观测器的有效性。

title: Dynamic Current Control Strategy of Grid-Connected Voltage Source Converters Feeding Constant Power Loads for Transient Stability Enhancement
abstract: The negative impedance characteristic of constant power loads (CPLs) can destabilize grid-connected voltage source converters (VSCs) by introducing positive feedback loops. To this end, this paper proposes a dynamic current control strategy for grid-connected VSCs with CPLs to enhance system transient synchronous stability (TSS). Firstly, a nonlinear phase-locked loop dynamic model is developed for VSCs. It explicitly incorporates the CPL impact, which indicates CPLs introduce coupling between the d-axis and q-axis components of VSC terminal voltage, and a positive feedback loop in VSC control scheme. Secondly, equal area criterion and phase-portrait analysis are used for qualitative and quantitative analysis to assess the CPL impact on TSS, respectively. The findings indicate the impact is related to the VSC output current. Therefore, a dynamic current control strategy for VSCs is proposed. It adds the current compensation term to neutralize CPL-induced destabilizing effects, guaranteeing the existence of stable equilibrium points that ensure both TSS and CPLs operation at rated power under grid faults. Meanwhile, a simple and fast VSC capacity calculation method is proposed. It can accurately calculate the required VSC capacity for achieving the above control objectives. Finally, simulation and experimental comparisons with existing methods verify the validity of the proposed strategy.
title_zh: 提升瞬态稳定性的带恒功率负载并网电压源变换器动态电流控制策略
abstract_zh: 恒功率负载（CPLs）的负阻抗特性会通过引入正反馈环路导致并网电压源变换器（VSCs）失稳。为此，本文提出了一种适用于带CPLs的并网VSCs的动态电流控制策略，以增强系统暂态同步稳定性（TSS）。首先，建立了VSCs的非线性锁相环动态模型，明确纳入了CPL的影响，表明CPLs会在VSC端电压的d轴和q轴分量之间引入耦合，并在VSC控制方案中形成正反馈环路。其次，分别采用等面积准则和相轨迹分析对CPL影响TSS的程度进行定性和定量分析。研究结果表明，该影响与VSC输出电流相关。因此，提出了VSCs的动态电流控制策略，通过添加电流补偿项来中和CPL引起的不稳定效应，保证稳定平衡点的存在，从而在电网故障下既确保TSS，又确保CPLs在额定功率下运行。同时，提出了一种简单快速的VSC容量计算方法，能够准确计算实现上述控制目标所需的VSC容量。最后，与现有方法的仿真和实验对比验证了所提策略的有效性。

title: A Precise Nonlinear Eddy-Current Magnetic Network Model for the Analysis of Electromagnetic Buffer
abstract: In this paper, a precise nonlinear eddy-current magnetic network (PNEMN) model is proposed to analyze the performance of the cylindrical permanent magnet (PM) electromagnetic buffer (EB). In this EB, the permanent magnet is radially magnetized and separated by iron teeth. When the EB is working, intense eddy currents are induced, severely distorting the original magnetic field, so that conventional magnetic equivalent circuit (MEC) models can no longer provide an accurate solution. To solve this problem, this paper adopted refined magnetic reluctance elements and incorporated eddy currents into the magnetic network model, fully coupling them with the original magnetic field. The convergence of this method is discussed in detail. To make this model more comprehensive, nonlinear magnetic saturation, end effects, and slot effects have also been taken into account. Optimal computational efficiency is achieved by judiciously selecting boundary conditions. A finite element model and the experiments on a prototype were built to verify the accuracy of the proposed model. Finally, the operating characteristics of the eddy current brake are analyzed, and its critical speed is about 7.5 m/s.
title_zh: 用于分析电磁缓冲器的精确非线性涡流磁网络模型
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种精确非线性涡流磁网络（PNEMN）模型，用于分析圆柱形永磁（PM）电磁缓冲器（EB）的性能。在该EB中，永磁体沿径向磁化并由铁齿分隔。当EB工作时，会感应出强烈的涡流，严重畸变原始磁场，使得传统磁等效电路（MEC）模型无法提供准确的解。为解决这一问题，本文采用精细化的磁阻单元，并将涡流纳入磁网络模型中，使其与原始磁场完全耦合。详细讨论了该方法的收敛性。为使模型更加全面，还考虑了非线性磁饱和、端部效应和开槽效应。通过合理选择边界条件实现了最优计算效率。建立了有限元模型并在样机上进行了实验，以验证所提模型的准确性。最后，分析了涡流制动器的工作特性，其临界速度约为7.5 m/s。

title: Sliding-Mode Speed Control for Predictive-Torque-Control-Based Induction-Machine Drives Based on Adaptive-Variable-Rate Reaching Law and Disturbance-Extended Sliding-Mode Observer
abstract: For the predictive-torque-control (PTC) based induction-machine (IM) drives, to promote the speed tracking performance as well as the robustness against various unknown disturbances, such as friction, external load disturbance and parameter mismatch. A sliding-mode control with adaptive-variable-rate reaching law (SMC-AVRRL) and a disturbance-extended sliding-mode observer (DESMO) is proposed. First, the speed loop of PTC which utilizes the classical PI control is analyzed. It indicates that the control performance of the PI controller degrades apparently under sudden load disturbances and induction-machine parameters mismatch. Then the sliding-mode control with adaptive-variable-rate reaching law is proposed. Taking the typical reaching law, namely exponential reaching law (ERL), as a comparison object, the AVRRL method can reduce the chattering and convergence time simultaneously. The stability of the proposed SMC-AVRRL is analyzed by the Lyapunov stability theory. Moreover, to further enhance the anti-disturbance capacity, the proposed SMC-AVRRL is then combined with a disturbance-extended sliding-mode observer (DESMO), named the SMC-AVRRL + DESMO method. The experimental results show that the proposed SMC-AVRRL + DESMO method can not only achieve high speed tracking accuracy, but also achieves better robustness.
title_zh: 基于自适应变速趋近律与扰动扩展滑模观测器的预测转矩控制感应电机驱动滑模速度控制
abstract_zh: 针对基于预测转矩控制（PTC）的感应电机（IM）驱动系统，为提升速度跟踪性能以及对各种未知扰动（如摩擦、外部负载扰动和参数失配）的鲁棒性，提出了一种采用自适应变速率趋近律的滑模控制（SMC-AVRRL）与一种扰动扩展滑模观测器（DESMO）。首先，分析了采用经典PI控制的PTC速度环，结果表明在突加负载扰动和感应电机参数失配情况下，PI控制器的控制性能明显下降。随后提出了采用自适应变速率趋近律的滑模控制。以典型的趋近律，即指数趋近律（ERL）作为对比对象，AVRRL方法能够同时减小抖振和收敛时间。通过Lyapunov稳定性理论分析了所提SMC-AVRRL的稳定性。此外，为进一步增强抗扰能力，将所提SMC-AVRRL与扰动扩展滑模观测器（DESMO）相结合，称为SMC-AVRRL + DESMO方法。实验结果表明，所提SMC-AVRRL + DESMO方法不仅能实现较高的速度跟踪精度，而且具有更好的鲁棒性。

title: Pricing Appliance Usage Privacy for Enhancing Usability of Smart Meter Data
abstract: Consumers’ privacy concerns often limit the usage of their smart meter data in several data-driven applications. While privacy-preserving algorithms can address the privacy concerns of consumers, these algorithms erase useful information; thus reducing the data usability. Data usability can be enhanced if the utility can directly utilize the smart meter data of consumers without transforming the same using privacy-preserving algorithms. However, this is not possible unless consumers give up their privacy rights over their smart meter data. Offering monetary compensations to consumers can be a possible approach to encourage them to give up the privacy rights over their smart meter data. Hence, this paper proposes a novel privacy pricing method that monetarily compensates the loss of appliance usage privacy incurred by the consumers who agreed to give up the privacy rights over their smart meter data. At first, a consumer’s appliance usage privacy is modeled based on how the consumer’s consumptions fluctuate over a given time period. Then, a nonlinear convex optimization problem is proposed using the privacy model to determine the privacy prices of a set of consumers under a given budget of the utility. The properties of the optimal solution are demonstrated mathematically. It is shown that the practical implementation of the proposed pricing method is unlikely to impact the consumption patterns of consumers. The impacts of the utility’s budget and the number of participating consumers on the privacy prices are illustrated using practical smart meter data while considering heterogeneity in the privacy concerns of consumers. Further, a novel metric is proposed which shows that, unlike the existing pricing methods, the privacy prices generated by the proposed method are sufficient to address the privacy concerns of most of the participating consumers.
title_zh: 面向智能电表数据可用性提升的家电使用隐私定价
abstract_zh: 消费者的隐私担忧往往限制了其智能电表数据在多种数据驱动应用中的使用。隐私保护算法虽然可以解决消费者的隐私担忧，但这些算法会抹去有用信息，从而降低数据可用性。如果电力公司能够直接利用消费者的智能电表数据，而无需通过隐私保护算法对其进行变换，则可以提高数据可用性。然而，除非消费者放弃对其智能电表数据的隐私权利，否则这是不可能实现的。向消费者提供货币补偿可能是鼓励其放弃智能电表数据隐私权利的一种可行途径。因此，本文提出了一种新颖的隐私定价方法，对同意放弃智能电表数据隐私权利的消费者所遭受的电器使用隐私损失给予货币补偿。首先，基于消费者用电量在给定时间段内的波动情况，对消费者的电器使用隐私进行建模。然后，利用该隐私模型提出了一个非线性凸优化问题，以在电力公司给定预算下确定一组消费者的隐私价格。通过数学方法证明了最优解的性质。结果表明，所提定价方法的实际实施不太可能影响消费者的用电模式。利用实际智能电表数据，在考虑

title: A Novel Magnetic Integrated Three-Phase EMI Filter for Differential-Mode and Common-Mode Interference Suppression in PMSM Drive Systems
abstract: The application of three-phase electromagnetic interference (EMI) filters in permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) drive systems can reduce common-mode (CM) interference while filtering out differential-mode (DM) interference in phase currents. Conventional filters will increase the volume and weight of the system. This article proposes a fully magnetic integrated three-phase EMI filter, with a magnetic core consisting of a toroid and a Y-branch limb. The toroid is primarily employed to concentrate the CM flux while providing the path for the DM flux. The Y-branch limb is used to carry the DM flux. The distribution of the flux in the proposed filter under different winding distribution patterns is analyzed. The DM and CM inductances are derived. The optimal winding distribution pattern is determined through quantitative and qualitative comparison. The magnetic saturation analysis is provided by deriving the maximum magnetic flux density of the proposed filter. The magnetic flux density of the proposed filter is verified through ANSYS simulation. The experiment is conducted to evaluate the performance of the proposed filter. The results show that the proposed filter can significantly reduce the volume and weight of the system compared to the conventional filter under the same DM and CM suppression performance. In addition, a DC side EMI filter is manufactured to assess its impact on the electrical performance of the motor side. The results indicate that the DC side EMI filter cannot replace the proposed filter. The proposed filter can enhance the performance and reliability of the PMSM drive system.
title_zh: 一种用于PMSM驱动系统差模与共模干扰抑制的新型磁集成三相EMI滤波器
abstract_zh: 三相电磁干扰（EMI）滤波器在永磁同步电机（PMSM）驱动系统中的应用，可以在滤除相电流中差模（DM）干扰的同时降低共模（CM）干扰。传统滤波器会增加系统的体积和重量。本文提出一种全磁集成三相EMI滤波器，其磁芯由环形磁芯和Y形分支磁柱组成。环形磁芯主要用于汇聚共模磁通，同时为差模磁通提供通路；Y形分支磁柱用于承载差模磁通。分析了所提滤波器在不同绕组分布方式下磁通的分布情况，推导了差模和共模电感，并通过定量与定性比较确定了最优绕组分布方式。通过推导所提滤波器的最大磁通密度，给出了磁饱和分析。通过ANSYS仿真验证了所提滤波器的磁通密度，并进行了实验以评估所提滤波器的性能。结果表明，在相同的差模和共模抑制性能下，与传统滤波器相比，所提滤波器能显著减小系统的体积和重量。此外，制作了直流侧EMI滤波器以评估其对电机侧电气性能的影响。结果表明，直流侧EMI滤波器无法替代所提滤波器。所提滤波器可以提升系统性能与可靠性

title: Physics-Informed Series-Aware Graph Transformer Model for Net Load Forecasting
abstract: The growing integration of renewable energy sources (RESs), such as photovoltaic (PV) and wind (WD), has significantly increased the variability of net load (NL), posing critical challenges on the net load forecasting. In this paper, a novel physics-informed series-aware graph Transformer (PISAGT) model is proposed for the net load forecasting, which synergistically combines the advantages of both direct and indirect forecasting methods to achieve superior forecasting performance. Firstly, a physics-informed loss module (PILM) is proposed, which introduces the physical characteristics of the net load into the loss function to incorporate physical knowledge in the gradient descent optimization, thereby enhancing the model’s generalization capability for more stable and trustworthy predictions.
