The fusion mechanism is underpinned by formal convergence guarantees, with weights converging at <inline-formula><tex-math notation="LaTeX">$\mathcal {O}(\log k/k)$</tex-math></inline-formula>, ensuring provable robustness alongside computational efficiency. Experimental validation across three real-world electric vehicle datasets yields SOC RMSE of 0.07% and voltage RMSE of 0.1 p.u. (<inline-formula><tex-math notation="LaTeX">$V_{\text{p.u.}}=V_{\text{measured}}/V_{\text{nom}}$</tex-math></inline-formula>, corresponding to 0.36-0.42 V absolute error), and coverage deviation within 0.2 percentage points of the nominal 95% prediction interval, all within millisecond-scale cycle times. These results establish a new state-of-the-art in the joint optimisation of estimation accuracy, uncertainty calibration, and real-time BMS deployment.
title_zh: 不确定性感知的电池荷电状态估计：一种多模态信号融合框架
abstract_zh: 尽管数据驱动的电池建模已取得重大进展，但现有框架均无法同时保证实时电池管理系统所需的估计精度、良好校准的预测不确定性以及计算可行性。本文通过提出一种不确定性感知的多模态信号融合框架来弥补这一空白，该框架从电压、电流和温度测量中分层提取互补特征，并通过线性合成、多项式基扩展和核映射自适应地将其组合。该融合机制以形式化收敛保证为基础，权重以 <inline-formula><tex-math notation="LaTeX">$\mathcal {O}(\log k/k)$</tex-math></inline-formula> 的速率收敛，在确保计算效率的同时提供了可证明的鲁棒性。在三个真实电动汽车数据集上的实验验证表明，SOC RMSE 为 0.07%，电压 RMSE 为 0.1 p.u.（<inline-formula><tex-math notation="LaTeX">$V_{\text{p.u.}}=V_{\text{measured}}/V_{\text{nom}}$</tex-math></inline-formula>，相当于 0.36-0.42 V 的绝对误差），覆盖率偏差在名义 95% 预测区间的 0.2 个百分点以内，且所有计算均在毫秒级周期时间内完成。这些结果在估计精度、不确定性校准和实时 BMS 部署的联合优化方面确立了新的最先进水平。

title: Why Shorter Time Steps Induce the Failure Probability Curse in Power Outage Risk Analysis: An Explanation and Solution
abstract: Recent climate change has led to more frequent and widespread extreme weather events, causing damage to power system components and resulting in significant outages and losses. Component fragility curves and sequential Monte Carlo simulations have been widely used for power system outage risk assessment. Fragility curves serve as the bridge linking weather events to component failures, while sequential Monte Carlo methods capture the temporal dynamics of weather and balance probabilities with consequences. However, a direct and improper combination of these two tools can introduce significant bias, especially under high time resolution. This phenomenon is referred to as the “failure probability curse.” This paper analyzes the fundamental cause of this issue and proposes a conditional-probability correction method for the sequential Monte Carlo simulation. The method can eliminate the inherent bias from high-time-resolution sampling in power outage risk analysis and reconcile sequential Monte Carlo with different physical failure mechanisms. Furthermore, the conditional-probability perspective provided in this paper offers support and explanation for related existing methods at the level of mathematical principles, enhancing the insights of the “failure probability curse” from both an explanation and solution perspective. Numerical experiments based on an illustrative system and the Tennessee power network confirm the validity of the proposed approach.
title_zh: 为何更短的时间步长会在停电风险分析中引发失效概率诅咒：解释与解决方案
abstract_zh: 近期的气候变化导致极端天气事件更加频繁和广泛，造成电力系统元件损坏，并引发重大停电和损失。元件易损性曲线和序贯蒙特卡洛模拟已被广泛用于电力系统停电风险评估。易损性曲线作为连接天气事件与元件故障的桥梁，而序贯蒙特卡洛方法则捕捉天气的时间动态性，并在概率与后果之间取得平衡。然而，将这两种工具直接且不当的结合会引入显著偏差，尤其是在高时间分辨率下。这种现象被称为“故障概率诅咒”。本文分析了该问题的根本原因，并提出了一种用于序贯蒙特卡洛模拟的条件概率修正方法。该方法可以消除停电风险分析中高时间分辨率采样带来的固有偏差，并使序贯蒙特卡洛与不同的物理失效机理相协调。此外，本文提供的条件概率视角在数学原理层面为相关的现有方法提供了支持和解释，从解释和求解两个层面深化了对“故障概率诅咒”的认识。基于一个示例系统和田纳西电网的数值实验验证了所提方法的有效性。

title: Model Predictive Torque Control Using Modified TSF and Parameter Adjustment of SRMs for Torque Ripple Reduction
abstract: This article introduces a model predictive torque control (MPTC) scheme using a modified hybrid torque sharing function (TSF) and the adaptive adjustment regarding parameters for switched reluctance motors (SRMs) to mitigate the torque ripple effect and enhance dynamic performance. Compared with classic TSF control, torque model prediction is adopted in MPTC instead of hysteresis control to reduce torque ripple. First, an enhanced hybrid TSF is designed for torque ripple suppression, where the rising reference phase torque can be adjusted in real-time according to the actual phase torque in the demagnetizing interval. Second, adaptive adjustment of angles based on the approximate model and the look-up table is utilized to further minimize torque ripple under multiple operating conditions. Then, the linear active disturbance rejection control with the adaptive bandwidth parameter is applied to the speed controller for better dynamic performance under multiple operating conditions. Eventually, experiments on a 12/8 SRM are conducted to ascertain the efficacy of the proposed MTPC by comparison.
title_zh: 采用改进TSF与SRM参数调节的模型预测转矩控制以降低转矩脉动
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种采用改进型混合转矩分配函数（TSF）及参数自适应调节的开关磁阻电机（SRM）模型预测转矩控制（MPTC）方案，以抑制转矩脉动效应并提升动态性能。与经典TSF控制相比，MPTC采用转矩模型预测代替滞环控制以减小转矩脉动。首先，设计了一种增强型混合TSF用于转矩脉动抑制，其中上升参考相转矩可根据退磁区间内的实际相转矩进行实时调节。其次，利用基于近似模型和查找表的角度自适应调节，进一步减小多工况下的转矩脉动。然后，将具有自适应带宽参数的线性自抗扰控制应用于速度控制器，以在多工况下获得更好的动态性能。最后，在一台12/8 SRM上进行实验，通过对比验证了所提MPTC的有效性。

title: Sensorless Control of Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Improved Synchronous Reference Frame Filter in Double Angle Axis
abstract: In the medium-to-high-speed speed control system of the interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (IPMSM), to address the issues of large harmonic component of the expanded back electromotive force (EMF) observed by conventional sliding mode observer (SMO) and the phase lag caused by the low-pass filter (LPF), a sensorless control method based on an improved synchronous reference frame filter (ISRFF) in double angle axis is proposed. Firstly, the extended back EMF in double angle and αβ-axis are processed through the LPF with same cut-off frequency to generate leading and lagging phase shifts. Secondly, the phase shifts are transformed to dq-axis, and the harmonics are filtered out by LPF. Then, the phase shifts are eliminated by a triangular transformation. The position observation accuracy of the SMO is improved while the rotor position error signal is constructed, thus the heterodyne method is omitted. Finally, the experimental results confirm that compared with conventional methods, the proposed method effectively filters out harmonics, reduces the maximum position error under steady-state conditions, and mitigates speed fluctuations during dynamic operation.
title_zh: 基于双角度轴改进同步参考坐标系滤波器的内置式永磁同步电机无传感器控制
abstract_zh: 在内置式永磁同步电机（IPMSM）的中高速调速系统中，针对传统滑模观测器（SMO）观测的扩展反电动势（EMF）谐波分量大以及低通滤波器（LPF）引起的相位滞后问题，提出了一种基于双角度轴改进同步参考坐标系滤波器（ISRFF）的无传感器控制方法。首先，对双角度和αβ轴下的扩展反电动势经相同截止频率的LPF处理，产生超前和滞后相移。其次，将相移变换至dq轴，并通过LPF滤除谐波。然后，通过三角变换消除相移。在构建转子位置误差信号的同时提高了SMO的位置观测精度，从而省去了外差法。最后，实验结果表明，与传统方法相比，所提方法能有效滤除谐波，减小稳态下的最大位置误差，并缓解动态运行过程中的转速波动。

title: An Efficient Algorithm to Calculate Locational Marginal Emissions in ACOPF via Adjoint Optimization Reformulation
abstract: This letter proposes a locally exact adjoint method to compute the locational marginal emissions (LMEs) in AC optimal power flow (ACOPF). Unlike conventional sensitivity analysis based on repeated load perturbations, the proposed method derives LMEs by linearizing the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions at the cost-minimizing equilibrium. We show that all-bus LMEs can be recovered simultaneously by solving a single reduced sparse linear system. Numerical results on the IEEE 118-bus and 2383-bus systems with heterogeneous thermal and renewable generation demonstrate that the proposed method captures clear spatial and temporal variation of LMEs effectively.
title_zh: 一种通过伴随优化重构在ACOPF中高效计算节点边际排放的算法
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种局部精确伴随方法，用于计算交流最优潮流（ACOPF）中的节点边际排放（LME）。与基于反复负荷扰动的传统灵敏度分析不同，所提方法通过在成本最小化均衡点处对Karush-Kuhn-Tucker（KKT）条件进行线性化来推导LME。我们证明，通过求解单个降阶稀疏线性方程组即可同时恢复所有母线的LME。在含异质火电与可再生能源发电的IEEE 118母线和2383母线系统上的数值结果表明，所提方法能够有效捕捉LME明显的空间和时间变化。

title: Fully Distributed Fault-Tolerant Secondary Control for Islanded Microgrids With Actuator Faults and Disturbances
abstract: This paper investigates the secondary control problem of AC islanded microgrids (MG) with unknown external disturbances and actuator faults. A fully distributed fault-tolerant secondary control strategy based on adaptive dynamic event-triggered mechanism (DETM) is proposed to address voltage and frequency deviations caused by droop control, achieving active power sharing while effectively reducing the communication burden. Considering the possibility of actuator faults, adaptive laws are introduced to estimate and compensate for fault parameters, thereby improving the system’s fault tolerance. The designed adaptive law and event-triggered mechanism (ETM) are implemented based on a fully distributed framework and do not rely on any global information. Compared with existing work, this paper introduces time-varying auxiliary functions and trigger functions, and obtains a strictly positive minimum trigger interval (MTI) without using global information, thus completely avoiding Zeno behavior in the presence of disturbances, which is more rigorous than simply theoretically excluding Zeno behavior. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is illustrated by simulation examples.
title_zh: 考虑执行器故障与扰动的孤岛微电网全分布式容错二次控制
abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有未知外部扰动和执行器故障的交流孤岛微电网（MG）二次控制问题。提出了一种基于自适应动态事件触发机制（DETM）的全分布式容错二次控制策略，以解决由下垂控制引起的电压和频率偏差问题，实现有功功率分配的同时有效降低通信负担。考虑到执行器发生故障的可能性，引入自适应律对故障参数进行估计和补偿，从而提高系统的容错能力。所设计的自适应律和事件触发机制（ETM）基于全分布式框架实现，不依赖任何全局信息。与现有工作相比，本文引入时变辅助函数和触发函数，在不使用全局信息的条件下获得了严格正的最小触发间隔（MTI），从而在有扰动的情况下完全避免了芝诺行为，比仅从理论上排除芝诺行为更为严谨。最后，通过仿真算例说明了所提控制策略的有效性。

title: Dynamic Reserve Sizing With Statistically Feasible Guarantees: An Uncertainty-Adaptive Robust Optimization Framework
abstract: The integration of intermittent renewable energy and increasing load volatility necessitates adaptive reserve sizing frameworks to balance grid reliability and economic efficiency. Static reserve allocation methods struggle with dynamic uncertainty, risking high costs or compromised security. This study introduces a probabilistic reserve sizing framework with three innovations: 1) a dynamic architecture for economic dispatch and Unit Commitment (UC) employing a unified joint chance constraint to manage system-wide, temporally-coupled risks under uncertainty; 2) a dual-stage statistically feasible robust optimization (RO) approach employing a novel unified dimension-collapsing map, enabling tractable learning-calibrated uncertainty set construction with dimension-free out-of-sample reliability guarantees; and 3) a Learning-to-Optimize acceleration strategy that transforms the robust UC into a tractable linear program, enabling scalability. Validation on standard test systems up to 118 buses demonstrates the framework’s ability to dynamically adjust reserves through uncertainty-adaptive quantification. The solution reconciles statistical feasibility with computational efficiency, achieving scalable, cost-effective, and reliable operations. By integrating statistically feasible RO with machine learning acceleration, this framework provides a practical approach to managing uncertainty and ensuring economic and operational balance in power systems with high renewable penetration.
title_zh: 具有统计可行性保证的动态备用容量确定：一种不确定性自适应鲁棒优化框架
abstract_zh: 间歇性可再生能源的接入和日益增长的负荷波动性要求采用自适应备用容量规划框架，以平衡电网可靠性与经济性。静态备用分配方法难以应对动态不确定性，存在成本过高或安全性受损的风险。本研究提出了一种概率性备用容量规划框架，具有三项创新：1）采用统一联合机会约束的经济调度与机组组合（UC）动态架构，用于管理不确定性下系统级、时间耦合的风险；2）采用新型统一降维映射的双阶段统计可行鲁棒优化（RO）方法，可实现易于处理的、经学习校准的不确定集构建，并提供与维度无关的样本外可靠性保证；3）一种学习优化加速策略，将鲁棒UC转化为可处理的线性规划，实现可扩展性。在最高118母线的标准测试系统上的验证表明，该框架能够通过不确定性自适应量化动态调整备用容量。该解决方案兼顾了统计可行性与计算效率，实现了可扩展、经济高效且可靠的运行。通过将统计可行的鲁棒优化与机器学习加速相结合，该框架为高可再生能源渗透率电力系统中管理不确定性、确保经济与运行平衡提供了一种实用方法。

title: Stability Region Boundary of Multi-Parallel Grid-Following Converter Systems Considering Nonlinear Coupling Interactions
abstract: In multi-parallel grid-following voltage source converters (MGFL-VSCs), the nonlinear dynamics of the control loops and their coupling interactions substantially affect the transient synchronization stability (TSS) of MGFL-VSCs. This study focuses on the effects of nonlinear coupling interactions on TSS of the MGFL-VSC systems. First, on the basis of differential–algebraic equation–stability region boundary (SRB) theory, the study analyzes the effects of nonlinear dynamics and coupling interactions and plots the SRB of MGFL-VSCs. Results show that the coupling interactions limit the maximum phase angle of the phase-locked loop. The SRB of MGFL-VSCs consists of a stable manifold of unstable equilibrium points, a stable manifold of semi-singular points, and certain singular surfaces. The composition of SRB is closely related to the coupling interactions of nonlinear control. Second, on the basis of the correlation between SRB and transient instability modes, the transient instability modes of MGFL-VSCs are divided into traditional and coupling interaction instability modes, and the evolution of instability modes is systematically studied in consideration of nonlinear coupling interactions. In addition, an online assessment method that is based on the Port–Hamiltonian energy function is proposed. This method can quantitatively estimate the effect of coupling interactions on TSS by using the nonlinear normalized energy index. Finally, experimental and simulation results are provided to compare the proposed approach with existing methods and verify its effectiveness.
title_zh: 考虑非线性耦合相互作用的多并联跟网型变流器系统稳定域边界
abstract_zh: 在多并联跟网型电压源变换器（MGFL-VSCs）中，控制环的非线性动力学及其耦合交互作用对MGFL-VSCs的暂态同步稳定性（TSS）具有显著影响。本研究聚焦于非线性耦合交互作用对MGFL-VSC系统TSS的影响。首先，基于微分-代数方程-稳定域边界（SRB）理论，分析了非线性动力学和耦合交互作用的影响，并绘制了MGFL-VSCs的SRB。结果表明，耦合交互作用限制了锁相环的最大相角。MGFL-VSCs的SRB由不稳定平衡点的稳定流形、半奇异点的稳定流形以及某些奇异面组成。SRB的构成与非线性控制的耦合交互作用密切相关。其次，基于SRB与暂态失稳模式之间的关联，将MGFL-VSCs的暂态失稳模式划分为传统失稳模式和耦合交互失稳模式，并考虑非线性耦合交互作用系统研究了失稳模式的演化。此外，提出了一种基于Port-Hamiltonian能量函数的在线评估方法。该方法可利用非线性归一化能量指标定量估计耦合交互作用对TSS的影响。最后，给出了实验和仿真结果，将所提方法与现有方法进行比较，验证了其有效性。

title: An MPC-Based Frequency Control Method Considering Nodal Frequency and RoCoF
abstract: The Centre of Inertia (COI) frequency and Rate of Change of Frequency (RoCoF) are traditional indicators used in frequency measurement and control. With the increasing integration of inverter-based resources (IBRs), frequency exhibits more significant spatial characteristics, making COI frequency insufficient to represent frequency dynamics at specific locations. Meanwhile, protection devices such as Under-Frequency Load Shedding (UFLS), anti-islanding protection, and Fault-Ride-Through (FRT) rely on the nodal frequency or RoCoF. Consequently, there is a risk of protection device activations caused by discrepancies between system-level COI frequency or RoCoF and local protection triggering thresholds. To address this issue, this paper proposes a Model Predictive Control (MPC)-based approach that incorporates nodal frequency and RoCoF constraints. First, the nodal inertia calculation methodology, which was originally designed for systems with synchronous generators and grid-forming resources, is extended to include grid-following resources. Second, an MPC-based frequency control method was developed to restore nodal frequency, reduce RoCoF, and minimise the likelihood of unintended protection triggers. Lastly, the proposed strategy was validated through MATLAB–PSCAD co-simulations on IEEE test systems.
title_zh: 一种考虑节点频率与RoCoF的基于MPC的频率控制方法
abstract_zh: 惯量中心（COI）频率和频率变化率（RoCoF）是频率测量与控制中常用的传统指标。随着基于逆变器资源（IBR）接入比例的不断提高，频率呈现出更为显著的空间特性，使得COI频率不足以表征特定位置的频率动态。同时，低频减载（UFLS）、防孤岛保护和故障穿越（FRT）等保护装置依赖于节点频率或RoCoF。因此，存在因系统级COI频率或RoCoF与本地保护触发阈值之间的差异而导致保护装置误动的风险。针对这一问题，本文提出一种基于模型预测控制（MPC）并纳入节点频率和RoCoF约束的方法。首先，将最初针对同步发电机和构网型资源设计的节点惯量计算方法扩展至包含跟网型资源。其次，开发了一种基于MPC的频率控制方法，用于恢复节点频率、降低RoCoF，并最大限度地降低保护意外触发的可能性。最后，通过在IEEE测试系统上进行MATLAB–PSCAD联合仿真验证了所提策略的有效性。

title: Wide-Area Power System Oscillations From Large-Scale AI Workloads
abstract: This paper develops a new dynamic power profiling approach for modeling AI-centric datacenter loads and analyzing their impact on grid operations, particularly their potential to induce wide-area grid oscillations. We characterize the periodic stochastic power fluctuations inherent to large-scale AI workloads during both the training and fine-tuning stages, driven by the state-of-the-art graphics processing unit (GPU) computing architecture design. These sustained, large power fluctuations, unlike conventional load ramping, act as persistent forcing inputs capable of interacting with and amplifying local and inter-area oscillation modes. Using the WECC 179-bus system and the NPCC 140-bus system, we have numerically studied the amplitude and variability of oscillatory responses under different factors. These factors include system strength, penetration level, fluctuation frequency range, individual datacenter size, geographical deployment, fluctuation suppression level, and workload ratio. Simulation results show that, notably, narrower fluctuation bands, larger single-site capacities, or dispersed siting can intensify oscillations across multiple modes. Our models and numerical studies provide a quantitative basis for integrating AI-dominant electricity demand into grid oscillation studies and further support the development of new planning and operational measures to power the growth of AI/computing load demands.
title_zh: 大规模AI负载引发的广域电力系统振荡
abstract_zh: 本文开发了一种新的动态功率特性建模方法，用于对以AI为中心的数据中心负荷进行建模，并分析其对电网运行的影响，尤其是其诱发广域电网振荡的潜力。我们刻画了大规模AI工作负载在训练和微调阶段所固有的周期性随机功率波动，这些波动由最先进的图形处理器（GPU）计算架构设计所驱动。这种持续的、大幅度的功率波动不同于传统的负荷爬坡，其表现为持续的强迫输入，能够与本地及区域间振荡模式相互作用并将其放大。我们利用WECC 179母线系统和NPCC 140母线系统，数值研究了不同因素下振荡响应的幅值和变异性。这些因素包括系统强度、渗透率、波动频率范围、单个数据中心规模、地理部署、波动抑制水平以及工作负载比例。仿真结果表明，值得注意的是，更窄的波动频带、更大的单站容量或分散选址可能会加剧多种模式的振荡。我们的模型和数值研究为将以AI为主导的电力需求纳入电网振荡研究提供了定量依据，并进一步支持制定新的规划和运行措施，以满足AI/计算负荷需求的增长。

title: Dominant Transient Stability of the Co-Located PLL-Based Grid-Following Renewable Plant and Synchronous Condenser Systems
abstract: Deploying synchronous condensers (SynCons) near grid-following renewable energy sources (GFLRs) is an effective and increasingly adopted strategy for grid support. However, the potential transient instability risks in such configurations remain an open research question. This study investigates the mechanism of dominant synchronization instability source transition upon SynCon integration and proposes a straightforward approach to enhance system stability by leveraging their interactive characteristics. Firstly, a dual-timescale decoupling model is established, partitioning the system into a fast subsystem representing phase-locked loop (PLL) dynamics and a slow subsystem characterizing SynCon rotor dynamics. The study then examines the influence of SynCons on the transient stability of nearby PLLs and their own inherent stability. The study shows that SynCon's voltage-source characteristics and its time-scale separation from PLL dynamics can significantly enhance the PLL's stability boundary and mitigate non-coherent coupling effects among multiple GFLRs. However, the dominant instability source shifts from the fast-time-scale PLL to the slow-time-scale SynCon after SynCon integration. Crucially, this paper demonstrates that the damping effect of PLL control can also be transferred from the fast to the slow time scale, allowing well-tuned PLL damping to suppress SynCon rotor acceleration. Consequently, by utilizing SynCon's inherent support capability and a simple PLL damping loop, the transient stability of the co-located system can be significantly enhanced. These conclusions are validated using a converter controller-based Hardware-in-the-Loop (CHIL) platform.
title_zh: 共用并网点的基于PLL的跟网型可再生能源电站与同步调相机系统的主导暂态稳定性
abstract_zh: 在跟网型可再生能源（GFLR）附近部署调相机（SynCon）是一种有效且日益被采纳的电网支撑策略。然而，此类配置中的暂态失稳风险仍是一个有待研究的开放性问题。本研究探讨了SynCon接入后主导同步失稳源转换的机理，并提出一种利用其交互特性来增强系统稳定性的简便方法。首先，建立双时间尺度解耦模型，将系统划分为表示锁相环（PLL）动态的快子系统和表征SynCon转子动态的慢子系统。随后，本研究考察了SynCon对附近PLL暂态稳定性的影响及其自身的固有稳定性。研究表明，SynCon的电压源特性及其与PLL动态的时间尺度分离可显著扩大PLL的稳定边界，并缓解多个GFLR之间的非同调耦合效应。然而，SynCon接入后，主导失稳源从快时间尺度的PLL转移到慢时间尺度的SynCon。关键的是，本文证明了PLL控制的阻尼效应同样可以从快时间尺度传递到慢时间尺度，使得整定良好的PLL阻尼能够抑制SynCon转子加速。因此，通过利用SynCon的固有支撑能力和简单的PLL阻尼回路，可以显著增强同址系统的暂态稳定性。这些结论

title: A Data-Driven Approach for Coherency Identification in Large-Scale Power Systems
abstract: This paper proposes a temporal clustering–based approach for coherency identification in power grids that explicitly accounts for instrument transformer uncertainties and PMU measurement errors arising from communication failures. The method models the system using multiple single-bus–infinite-bus representations and introduces a metric for the electrical distance between physical system buses and a fictitious infinite bus, which is used to cluster buses into coherent groups. A key challenge of clustering-based methods—namely, the defining the clustering threshold—is systematically addressed by deriving a mathematically rigorous, power system–governed equation, resulting in a consistent method suitable for online applications. The effectiveness of the proposed data-driven approach is demonstrated using both simulated and real PMU signals, including scenarios with packet losses.
title_zh: 一种面向大规模电力系统同调辨识的数据驱动方法
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于时间聚类的电网同调性辨识方法，该方法明确考虑了通信故障引起的互感器不确定性和PMU测量误差。该方法采用多个单母线–无穷大母线的表示形式对系统进行建模，并引入物理系统母线与虚拟无穷大母线之间电气距离的度量，用于将母线聚类为同调组。聚类方法的一个关键难题——即聚类阈值的确定——通过推导一个数学上严格、由电力系统规律决定的方程得以系统解决，从而形成一种适用于在线应用的一致性方法。通过仿真和真实PMU信号（包括丢包场景）验证了所提数据驱动方法的有效性。

title: Time-Variant Nonlinear Participation Factors for Power Systems
abstract: The participation factor (PF) is a key metric for assessing the involvement of system states into an oscillation mode in power systems. A traditional linear PF has been effective in small-signal stability analysis and control, but it cannot capture the evolving and complex dynamics of a modern power system with significant nonlinearity. Existing nonlinear PFs account for inter-modal resonances up to a desired order but are assumed to be constant, not varying with the system’s response. This paper proposes a novel Time-Variant Nonlinear Participation Factor (TNPF), which unifies linear and nonlinear PFs within a single framework and enables reliable real-time quantification of the participation of state variables in a mode under disturbances, especially when nonlinear dynamics are non-negligible and the amplitude of state perturbations varies over time. To demonstrate the advantages of the TNPF, an adaptive control strategy is developed to dynamically activate a subset of distributed, highly participating battery-based damping controllers for efficient stabilization in response to disturbances. Case studies on the IEEE 39-bus system, including scenarios with high penetration of inverter-based resources, are conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed TNPF.
title_zh: 电力系统的时变非线性参与因子
abstract_zh: 参与因子（PF）是评估电力系统中系统状态对某一振荡模式参与程度的关键指标。传统的线性PF在小干扰稳定分析和控制中行之有效，但无法刻画具有显著非线性的现代电力系统不断演变的复杂动态。现有的非线性PF可考虑至指定阶次的模态间共振，但被假设为常数，不随系统响应而变化。本文提出一种新颖的时变非线性参与因子（TNPF），在统一框架下融合线性与非线性PF，能够在扰动下对状态变量在某一模式中的参与程度进行可靠的实际量化，尤其是在非线性动态不可忽略且状态扰动幅值随时间变化时。为展示TNPF的优势，开发了一种自适应控制策略，可动态激活一部分分布式、高参与度的基于电池的阻尼控制器，以实现对扰动的高效稳定控制。在IEEE 39母线系统（包括高比例基于逆变器资源接入的场景）上进行了案例研究，验证了所提TNPF的有效性。

title: Multi-Fidelity Dynamic Line Rating Fusion for System Load Margin Enhancement With Large-Scale Offshore Wind Generations
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-fidelity dynamic line rating (DLR) fusion method for power system load margin enhancement with large-scale offshore wind integration. First, multi-fidelity DLR data from diverse sensors are fused using multi-fidelity deep sigma point processes (MFDSPP), a probabilistic nonlinear learning model that integrates heterogeneous data sources to estimate the minimum line rating and quantify its uncertainty. Conformal prediction (CP), a distribution-free uncertainty calibration technique that refines prediction intervals using empirical residuals, is developed to refine the uncertainty intervals of DLRs. Then, continuation power flow (CPF) analysis is used to calculate the system's maximum load margin for numerous $N-k$ contingencies. Sampling these scenarios generates a large dataset to train the deep sigma point processes (DSPP) model, establishing a direct nonlinear relationship between operational data and load margin. Finally, DLR-based line capacity constraints and DSPP-derived load-margin constraints are integrated into the real-time control framework to improve system stability. Case studies on the Northeast Power Coordinating Council (NPCC) system, incorporating real DLR sensor measurements, authentic $N-k$ contingency datasets, and four real large-scale offshore wind farms, demonstrate that the proposed method effectively maintains a load margin greater than 10% of the base load, unlocks an additional 2,189.7 MWh of clean energy, reduces operating costs by approximately 2.34%, and achieves more than a 2,000 × speedup compared with classical CPF-based sensitivity methods.
title_zh: 面向系统负荷裕度提升的大规模海上风电场景下多保真度动态载流量融合
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于提升大规模海上风电接入下电力系统负荷裕度的多保真动态增容（DLR）融合方法。首先，采用多保真深度sigma点过程（MFDSPP）融合来自多种传感器的多保真DLR数据，这是一种概率性非线性学习模型，可整合异构数据源以估计最小线路容量并量化其不确定性。引入共形预测（CP）——一种利用经验残差细化预测区间的无分布不确定性校准技术——来细化DLR的不确定性区间。然后，利用连续潮流（CPF）分析计算大量 $N-k$ 预想事故下系统的最大负荷裕度。通过对这些场景采样生成大规模数据集以训练深度sigma点过程（DSPP）模型，建立运行数据与负荷裕度之间的直接非线性关系。最后，将基于DLR的线路容量约束和DSPP导出的负荷裕度约束集成到实时控制框架中，以提高系统稳定性。在东北电力协调委员会（NPCC）系统上的案例研究（结合真实DLR传感器测量数据、真实的 $N-k$ 预想事故数据集以及四座真实的大型海上风电场）表明，所提方法能有效维持大于基准负荷10%的负荷裕度，额外释放2,189.7 MWh清洁能源，将运行成本降低约2.34%，并且与经典CPF相比实现超过2,000倍的加速

title: Analysis of Power Swing Characteristics of Grid-Forming VSC System Considering the Current Limitation Mode
abstract: This paper investigates power swing characteristics of grid-forming (GFM) voltage source converter (VSC) systems with the current limitation mode in both non-inertial and inertial GFM-VSC systems. Following grid faults, non-inertial GFM-VSC systems can re-synchronize with the grid. However, they may experience significant power swings driven by their control dynamics. In contrast, inertial GFM-VSC systems may exhibit loss of synchronization (LOS), characterized by the divergence of the control-dependent angle from the active power control loop. These behaviors differ from those of conventional synchronous generator (SG)-based systems, in which power swings are typically characterized by physical angle deviations among power sources. Based on these findings, this paper examines the performance of traditional impedance-based swing-detection schemes in GFM-VSC systems. The theoretical analysis is validated through simulations covering both single- and multi-machine systems.
title_zh: 考虑限流模式的构网型VSC系统功率摇摆特性分析
abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有电流限幅模式的构网型（GFM）电压源换流器（VSC）系统在非惯性和惯性GFM-VSC系统中的功率振荡特性。电网故障后，非惯性GFM-VSC系统可以与电网重新同步，然而其可能经历由控制动态驱动的显著功率振荡。相比之下，惯性GFM-VSC系统可能出现失步（LOS），其特征是依赖于控制的角度与有功功率控制环之间发散。这些行为不同于传统的基于同步发电机（SG）的系统，后者的功率振荡通常以电源之间物理角度偏差为特征。基于这些发现，本文研究了传统基于阻抗的振荡检测方案在GFM-VSC系统中的性能。理论分析通过涵盖单机和多机系统的仿真得到了验证。

title: Stochastic Stability Oriented Frequency Control: A Probabilistic Forecasting-Based High-Order Stochastic Koopman Approach
abstract: The growing integration of intermittent renewables aggravates power imbalances between supply and demand, increasing the uncertainty of system frequency variations. Traditional deterministic frequency control schemes often overlook the impact of stochastic frequency fluctuations on system stability. This paper proposes an innovative stochastic stability-oriented model predictive control approach for system frequency regulation in the face of uncertainty of renewable generation. Firstly, a generic nonlinear stochastic dynamic model is established to precisely quantify time-evolutionary impacts of non-Gaussian uncertainty on system frequency dynamics. Subsequently, a high-order stochastic Koopman operator (HSKO) approach is developed by integrating high-order probabilistic forecasts with the Koopman theorem, serving as a powerful tool for global linearization of nonlinear stochastic dynamic models. Therefore, an interpretable optimal control law can be seamlessly derived in line with existing conclusions on stochastic stability identification, which originally breaks through the technical bottleneck of frequency stabilization for power systems with nonlinear stochastic dynamics. Comparative experiments with several state-of-the-art dynamic models and frequency control approaches demonstrate the superiority of the proposed HSKO approach in terms of model fidelity, control optimality, and frequency stability.
title_zh: 面向随机稳定性的频率控制：一种基于概率预测的高阶随机Koopman方法
abstract_zh: 间歇性可再生能源接入的不断增加加剧了供需之间的功率不平衡，增加了系统频率变化的不确定性。传统确定性频率控制方案往往忽视随机频率波动对系统稳定性的影响。本文提出了一种面向随机稳定性的创新模型预测控制方法，用于在可再生能源发电不确定性下的系统频率调节。首先，建立了一个通用的非线性随机动态模型，以精确量化非高斯不确定性对系统频率动态的时间演化影响。随后，通过将高阶概率预测与Koopman定理相结合，开发了高阶随机Koopman算子（HSKO）方法，作为非线性随机动态模型全局线性化的有力工具。因此，可以根据现有的随机稳定性识别结论无缝推导出可解释的最优控制律，从根本上突破了具有非线性随机动态特性的电力系统频率稳定的技术瓶颈。与多种最先进的动态模型和频率控制方法的对比实验证明了所提出的HSKO方法在模型保真度、控制最优性和频率稳定性方面的优越性。

title: Cost-Oriented Scenario Reduction for Stochastic Optimization of Power System Operation With High-Penetration Renewable Energy
abstract: The growing uncertainty associated with renewable energy generation necessitates effective solutions addressing stochastic optimization of power system operations. Traditional stochastic optimization methods typically take scenario reduction as a preliminary step to alleviate computational burdens, which overlooks the connections between scenario reduction and stochastic optimization. This paper proposes a novel cost-oriented scenario reduction approach for stochastic optimal power flow (SOPF) to enhance the cost-effectiveness of operational decisions while maintaining system reliability. Firstly, an integrated scenario reduction and stochastic optimization (ISRSO) framework is established for SOPF, in which the reduced scenarios serve as a bridge between uncertainty quantification and uncertainty-aware optimization. Subsequently, a coordinated optimization model of scenario reduction and stochastic optimal power flow is formulated to jointly optimize the reduced scenarios and generation schedules, which preserves the probabilistic characteristics of the original scenarios and minimizes the operational cost of SOPF. Then, an alternating optimization algorithm is developed to convert the original nonconvex model into iterative convex problems with enhanced tractability. Simulation results on IEEE 14-bus and 118-bus test systems with realistic renewable energy generation data illustrate the statistical accuracy and cost-effectiveness of the proposed method.
title_zh: 面向高比例可再生能源电力系统运行随机优化的成本导向场景削减
abstract_zh: 与可再生能源发电相关的不确定性日益增长，需要有效的解决方案来应对电力系统运行中的随机优化问题。传统随机优化方法通常将场景削减作为减轻计算负担的预处理步骤，忽视了场景削减与随机优化之间的联系。本文提出了一种面向成本的随机最优潮流（SOPF）场景削减方法，以在保持系统可靠性的同时提高运行决策的成本效益。首先，为SOPF建立了场景削减与随机优化一体化（ISRSO）框架，其中削减后的场景作为不确定性量化与不确定性感知优化之间的桥梁。随后，构建了场景削减与随机最优潮流的协同优化模型，联合优化削减后的场景和发电计划，该模型既保留了原始场景的概率特性，又最小化了SOPF的运行成本。然后，开发了交替优化算法，将原始非凸模型转化为具有更强可处理性的迭代凸问题。基于IEEE 14节点和118节点测试系统及实际可再生能源发电数据的仿真结果证明了所提方法的统计准确性和成本效益。

title: Engineering battery architectures for multifunctionality and high performance
abstract: Next-generation batteries demand architectural innovations that overcome the design limits of electrochemistry alone in conventional lithium-ion batteries (LIBs). This review summarizes architectural design strategies for LIBs and emerging battery systems, classifying them into 1D fiber-based, 2D planar, and 3D architectures. 1D designs, such as coaxial fibers, twisted assemblies, and winding configurations, offer flexibility and mechanical resilience for wearable and microscale batteries. 2D architectures, including interdigitated, pillar-based, and mesh frameworks, are reviewed alongside deformable (serpentine and origami/kirigami) and nature-inspired (e.g., accordion-like) geometries that enhance stretchability and flexibility while preserving electrochemical performance. 3D structural batteries, focused on volumetric design and energy densification, are examined for their potential to combine mechanical resilience with electrochemical functionality. Each architectural class is assessed for its design principles, performance trade-offs, and fabrication feasibility. By correlating architectural designs with advancements in additive manufacturing, this review outlines pathways to address electro-chemo-mechanical coupling challenges and guide the development of next-generation architected batteries.
title_zh: 面向多功能性与高性能的电池结构工程
abstract_zh: 下一代电池需要架构创新，以克服传统锂离子电池（LIB）中仅靠电化学的设计局限。本综述总结了LIB和新兴电池系统的架构设计策略，将其分类为基于一维（1D）纤维、二维（2D）平面和三维（3D）架构。1D设计如同轴纤维、加捻组件和缠绕构型，为可穿戴和微型电池提供了柔性和机械韧性。2D架构包括叉指式、基于支柱和网状框架，同时还综述了可变形（蛇形和折纸/剪纸）以及仿生（如手风琴式）几何结构，这些设计在保持电化学性能的同时增强了可拉伸性和柔性。3D结构电池专注于体积设计和能量密集化，本文考察了其将机械韧性与电化学功能相结合的潜力。对每种架构类别都评估了其设计原理、性能权衡和制造可行性。通过将架构设计与增材制造的进展相关联，本综述概述了解决电-化学-机械耦合挑战的路径，并指导下一代架构化电池的开发。

title: Field Current Estimation for Brushless Wound-Field Synchronous Machine Equipped With Synchronous Exciter
abstract: Owing to the high reliability and low maintenance requirement, brushless synchronous generators (BLSG) are used in many applications from small power generating sets to large-capacity turbo-generators. In BLSG, direct measurement of the field current and its voltage is normally not possible. Consequently, accurate estimation of these quantities is essential for condition monitoring, state and parameter estimation, control and protection purposes. In this paper, a new method based on extended Kalman filter with unknown input (EKF-UI) is proposed for estimation of field current. This method which considers the field voltage as an unknown input is used for field current estimation in BLSG equipped with synchronous excitation system. The proposed method is validated by several case studies, including open loop and closed loop control systems and rotating rectifier faults. The experimental and simulation results show that, using the proposed method, the field current can be accurately estimated in both steady states and transients.
title_zh: 配备同步励磁机的无刷绕线式同步电机励磁电流估计
abstract_zh: 由于高可靠性和低维护需求，无刷同步发电机（BLSG）被广泛应用于从小型发电机组到大容量汽轮发电机的诸多场合。在BLSG中，通常无法直接测量励磁电流及其电压。因此，准确估计这些量对于状态监测、状态和参数估计、控制与保护至关重要。本文提出了一种基于含未知输入的扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF-UI）的励磁电流估计新方法。该方法将励磁电压视为未知输入，用于配备同步励磁系统的BLSG的励磁电流估计。所提方法通过多个案例研究进行了验证，包括开环和闭环控制系统以及旋转整流器故障。实验和仿真结果表明，利用所提方法，可以在稳态和暂态下准确估计励磁电流。

title: Elucidating Photo‐Kinetic Control in Photothermal Reverse Water‐Gas Shift Reaction
abstract: ABSTRACT Unlike the well‐known charge‐carrier kinetics in traditional photocatalysis, a knowledge gap remains regarding the photo‐kinetic effects in heterogeneous photothermal catalysis. Conventionally, light is mainly regarded as a source of charge carriers and localized heating, yet how these light‐induced effects alter intrinsic reaction kinetics, particularly the rate‐determining step (RDS), remains unclear. Here, we provide direct kinetic evidence that illumination tunes the RDS in an archetypal Mars‐van Krevelen (MvK) reverse water‐gas shift (RWGS) reaction over In‐doped MoO 2 . Under illumination, photogenerated electrons enrich In sites, promoting H 2 activation and spillover while accelerating H 2 O desorption, thereby shifting the RDS from the H 2 ‐reduction half‐reaction to the CO 2 ‐oxidation half‐reaction. This kinetic modulation significantly enhances catalytic performance and lowers the apparent activation energy. Overall, this work elucidates the kinetic role of light in photothermal CO 2 conversion, offering new insights into optimizing solar‐driven catalytic processes.
title_zh: 阐明光热逆向水煤气变换反应中的光动力学调控
abstract_zh: 摘要 与传统光催化中众所周知的载流子动力学不同，非均相光热催化中的光动力学效应仍存在认知空白。传统上，光主要被视为载流子和局部加热的来源，但这些光诱导效应如何改变本征反应动力学，尤其是速控步骤（RDS），仍不清楚。在此，我们提供了直接的动力学证据，表明光照可以调节In掺杂MoO2上典型Mars-van Krevelen（MvK）逆水煤气变换（RWGS）反应中的RDS。在光照下，光生电子富集于In位点，促进H2的活化与溢流，同时加速H2O的脱附，从而将RDS从H2还原半反应转变为CO2氧化半反应。这种动力学调控显著提升了催化性能并降低了表观活化能。总体而言，本工作阐明了光在光热CO2转化中的动力学作用，为优化太阳能驱动的催化过程提供了新见解。

title: Hybrid Single‐Crystalline Mesoporous Frameworks Merging Metal–Organic and Hydrogen‐Bonded Organic Networks
abstract: ABSTRACT Mesoporous materials represent an important class of porous materials; however, it remains a great challenge to systematically synthesize hybrid single‐crystalline mesoporous frameworks merging metal–organic and hydrogen‐bonded organic networks. Herein, we report a hybrid merged‐net strategy that integrates a supramolecular hydrogen‐bonded organic network with a single‐crystalline mesoporous metal–organic framework (MOF), significantly enhancing structural robustness without sacrificing intrinsic mesoporosity. The assembly of pyridine‐containing carboxylate linkers and iron‐containing trinuclear clusters affords M‐PPB featuring the (6,6)‐connected 6 2 T44 net, in which directional O─H⋯N hydrogen bonds between adjacent linkers form a one‐dimensional hydrogen‐bonded network. In contrast to the unstable parent (4,6)‐connected stp ‐MOF, M‐PPB—merging metal–organic and hydrogen‐bonded organic networks—exhibits enhanced robustness and achieves full porosity, displaying a pore volume of 1.58 cm 3 g − 1 . We further apply an isoreticular expansion strategy to synthesize extended MOFs—M‐PPPB—containing mesopores of about 4.2 nm and exhibiting a pore volume of up to 2.77 cm 3 g − 1 . On account of its ultrahigh porosity, M‐PPPB exhibits a methane uptake of 1.047 g g − 1 at 159 K and 10 bar, nearly twice that of M‐PPB, while its hydrogen uptake at 77 K and 100 bar increases by about 50%.
title_zh: 融合金属有机网络与氢键有机网络的杂化单晶介孔框架
abstract_zh: 摘要 介孔材料是多孔材料中的重要一类；然而，如何系统性地合成融合金属-有机网络与氢键有机网络的混合单晶介孔框架仍是一项巨大挑战。本文报道了一种混合融合网络策略，将超分子氢键有机网络与单晶介孔金属-有机框架（MOF）相结合，在不牺牲固有介孔性的前提下显著增强了结构稳健性。含吡啶的羧酸连接体与含铁三核簇的组装得到了具有（6,6）连接的 6 2 T44 网络的 M-PPB，其中相邻连接体之间的定向 O─H⋯N 氢键形成一维氢键网络。与不稳定的母体（4,6）连接 stp-MOF 相比，融合了金属-有机与氢键有机网络的 M-PPB 表现出更强的稳健性并实现了完全孔隙率，其孔体积为 1.58 cm 3 g − 1 。我们进一步采用同网状扩展策略合成了扩展型 MOF——M-PPPB，其介孔尺寸约为 4.2 nm，孔体积高达 2.77 cm 3 g − 1 。凭借其超高的孔隙率，M-PPPB 在 159 K 和 10 bar 条件下的甲烷吸附量达 1.047 g g − 1 ，几乎是 M-PPB 的两倍，而其在 77 K 和 100 bar 条件下的氢气吸附量提高了约 50%。

title: Sono‐Triggered In Situ Vaccine via a Chlorin‐Based Small Molecule Sensitizer for Systemic Cancer Therapy
abstract: ABSTRACT Unimolecule‐mediated sonodynamic therapy (SDT) offers a promising approach to combat tumors systemically by enabling synergistic sono‐triggered cytotoxicity and in situ vaccine‐like effects within tumors. Although chlorin‐based sensitizers have achieved clinical success in phototherapy, their translation to SDT has been impeded by inadequate ultrasound (US)‐triggered reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation, leading to suboptimal immunogenic cell death (ICD) and compromised antitumor immunity. To address this, we designed two organic sonosensitizers based on the natural product‐derived scaffold, Chenghai pyropheophorbide‐a (CHPpa). CHPpa‐er was constructed by appending a p ‐toluenesulfonamide group for specific endoplasmic reticulum (ER) targeting. Its analogue, CHPpa‐er‐Asp, was additionally functionalized with aspartic acid to modulate molecular polarity. Remarkably, despite differing by only one pharmacophore, the two compounds exhibited profoundly distinct profiles in target protein (K ATP channel) engagement and intracellular trafficking, highlighting the critical impact of rational molecular design. As the lead candidate, CHPpa‐er elicited precise, intraluminal ROS bursts under US, inducing severe ER stress and robust ICD. In two preclinical tumor models, CHPpa‐er‐mediated SDT effectively suppressed both primary tumor growth and metastasis by provoking potent systemic antitumor immunity. This work introduced a unimolecular sonosensitizer strategy that transformed SDT from a localized modality into a systemic intervention, offering a translatable platform for comprehensive cancer therapy.
title_zh: 基于二氢卟吩类小分子敏化剂的超声触发原位疫苗用于全身性癌症治疗
abstract_zh: 摘要 单分子介导的声动力疗法（SDT）通过在肿瘤内实现协同的超声触发细胞毒性与原位疫苗样效应，为全身性抗击肿瘤提供了一种有前景的方法。尽管基于二氢卟吩类光敏剂的光疗已取得临床成功，但其在 SDT 中的转化受到超声（US）触发活性氧（ROS）生成不足的阻碍，导致免疫原性细胞死亡（ICD）欠佳及抗肿瘤免疫受损。为解决这一问题，我们基于天然产物衍生骨架——程海焦脱镁叶绿酸-a（CHPpa）——设计了两款有机声敏剂。CHPpa-er 通过引入对甲苯磺酰胺基团实现对内质网（ER）的特异性靶向；其类似物 CHPpa-er-Asp 则额外功能化有天冬氨酸以调节分子极性。值得注意的是，尽管两者仅相差一个药效团，它们在靶蛋白（K ATP 通道）结合及细胞内转运方面表现出截然不同的特性，凸显了合理分子设计的关键影响。作为先导候选物，CHPpa-er 在 US 下引发精确的管腔内 ROS 爆发，诱导严重的 ER 应激和强效 ICD。在两种临床前肿瘤模型中，CHPpa-er 介导的 SDT 通过激发强效的全身抗肿瘤免疫，有效抑制了原发肿瘤生长与转移。本工作提出了一种单分子声敏剂策略，将 SDT 从局部治疗手段转变为全身性干预，提供了一个可转化的平台

title: On the Application of the IEC 60034-2-1 Standard to Line-Start Synchronous Reluctance Motors
abstract: The IEC 60034-2-1 standard does not specify a method for three-phase line-start synchronous motors (LS-SynRMs). Although the direct input-output method can be easily applied, it does not specify how to correct the losses to a reference ambient temperature. This paper analyzes the applicability of the methods specified in the IEC 60034-2-1 standard to LS-SynRMs. The impact of ambient temperature on the full-load efficiency of LS-SynRMs is assessed. A method for segregating motor losses and correcting the average temperature and losses of the stator windings to a reference ambient temperature is proposed, ensuring that the stated full-load efficiency of the motor is determined accurately regardless of the ambient temperature in the laboratory where the tests are performed. Results from experiments conducted on two commercial LS-SynRMs are provided. It was observed that reducing the ambient temperature from 45 °C to 5 °C may increase the full-load efficiency of the tested LS-SynRMs by more than 1 percentage point, mainly due to the reduction of stator winding losses. Consequently, a motor manufacturer may consider testing this type of motor at lower ambient temperatures to achieve a higher efficiency class. Therefore, it is necessary to define a method for determining the efficiency of LS-SynRMs that accounts for the correction of stator winding conduction losses to the standard reference ambient temperature of 25 °C. This paper intends to offer information that may contribute to overcoming the shortcomings and omissions of the IEC 60034-2-1 standard concerning the efficiency determination of LS-SynRMs, which is a relatively new technology on the market that is believed to be able to compete with line-operated induction motors in the low-power range, offering higher efficiency and constant operating speed.
title_zh: 关于IEC 60034-2-1标准在自起动同步磁阻电机中的应用
abstract_zh: IEC 60034-2-1 标准未规定三相线启动同步磁阻电机（LS-SynRM）的测试方法。虽然直接输入-输出法易于应用，但该标准并未说明如何将损耗修正到参考环境温度。本文分析了 IEC 60034-2-1 标准中规定的方法对 LS-SynRM 的适用性，评估了环境温度对 LS-SynRM 满载效率的影响。本文提出了一种电机损耗分离方法，以及将定子绕组平均温度和损耗修正至参考环境温度的方法，确保无论测试实验室的环境温度如何，都能准确测定电机标称的满载效率。文中给出了在两台商用 LS-SynRM 上开展实验的结果。研究发现，将环境温度从 45 °C 降至 5 °C 可使被测 LS-SynRM 的满载效率提高超过 1 个百分点，这主要归因于定子绕组损耗的降低。因此，电机制造商可考虑在较低环境温度下测试此类电机，以获得更高的效率等级。因此，有必要定义一种将定子绕组导通损耗修正至 25 °C 标准参考环境温度的 LS-SynRM 效率测定方法。本文旨在提供有助于克服 IEC 60034-2-1 标准在效率方面

title: Transient Stability of GFL Converters Subjected to Mode Switching of GFM Converters
abstract: Integrating grid-forming converters (GFMCs) into grid-following converter (GFLC)-dominated power systems enhances the grid strength, but GFMCs’ current-limiting characteristic triggers dynamic mode switching between constant voltage control (CVC) and current limit control (CLC). This switching feature poses critical transient stability risks to GFLCs, requiring urgent investigation. This paper first develops a mathematical model for this switched system. Then, it derives mode switching conditions for droop-controlled GFMCs, which are separately GFMC angle-dependent and GFLC angle-dependent. On this basis, the stability boundaries of GFLC within each subsystem are analyzed, and the impact of GFMC mode switching arising from GFLC angle oscillation is investigated. The findings reveal that the switched system's stability boundary coincides with that of the CLC subsystem. To enhance GFLC's transient stability and ensure GFMC converges to the CVC mode, this paper introduces a virtual fixed d-axis control (VFDC) strategy. Compared with existing methods, this method achieves decoupling and self-stabilization using only local state variables from individual converters. The conclusions are validated through simulations and Controller Hardware-in-the-Loop tests.
title_zh: GFM变换器模式切换下GFL变换器的暂态稳定性
abstract_zh: 将构网型变换器（GFMC）集成到以跟网型变换器（GFLC）为主导的电力系统中可增强电网强度，但 GFMC 的限流特性会触发恒压控制（CVC）与限流控制（CLC）之间的动态模式切换。该切换特性给 GFLC 带来了关键的暂态稳定风险，亟需深入研究。本文首先建立了该切换系统的数学模型，随后推导了下垂控制 GFMC 的模式切换条件，该条件分别与 GFMC 功角和 GFLC 功角相关。在此基础上，分析了各子系统中 GFLC 的稳定边界，并研究了由 GFLC 功角振荡引发的 GFMC 模式切换的影响。研究结果表明，切换系统的稳定边界与 CLC 子系统的稳定边界重合。为增强 GFLC 的暂态稳定性并确保 GFMC 收敛至 CVC 模式，本文提出了一种虚拟固定 d 轴控制（VFDC）策略。与现有方法相比，该方法仅利用各变换器的本地状态变量即可实现解耦与自稳定。结论通过仿真和控制器硬件在环（Controller Hardware-in-the-Loop）测试得到了验证。

title: White-Box High-Frequency Modeling of Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machines With Hairpin Windings
abstract: This paper further details the process of constructing a high-frequency (HF) white-box model for interior permanent magnet synchronous machines (IPMSMs) with hairpin windings based on the small-signal time-harmonic finite element analysis method. The model employs complex differential reluctivity tensors that vary with dc-biased magnetic induction and frequency, enabling accurate simulation of hysteresis, eddy current, and saturation effects in electrical steel sheets. To enhance modeling accuracy, the frequency-dependent resistance and leakage inductance of the end windings are calculated using the three-dimensional finite element method. More importantly, this study combines simulation and experimental methods to conduct a detailed comparative analysis of the influence of impregnation on motor parasitic capacitance and HF impedance characteristics, as well as the impact of rotor presence and position on motor HF impedance characteristics. Experimental results validate that the model established in this paper can accurately predict the differential-mode and common-mode impedance characteristics of IPMSMs with hairpin windings during the design stage.
title_zh: 采用发卡绕组的内置式永磁同步电机白盒高频建模
abstract_zh: 本文进一步详细阐述了基于小信号时谐有限元分析方法为扁线绕组内置式永磁同步电机（IPMSM）构建高频（HF）白箱模型的过程。该模型采用随直流偏置磁感应强度和频率变化的复数差分磁阻率张量，能够精确模拟电工钢片中的磁滞、涡流和饱和效应。为提高建模精度，采用三维有限元方法计算了端部绕组的频变电阻和漏电感。更重要的是，本研究结合仿真与实验方法，详细对比分析了浸渍对电机寄生电容及高频阻抗特性的影响，以及转子存在与否及其位置对电机高频阻抗特性的影响。实验结果验证了本文所建立的模型能够在设计阶段准确预测扁线绕组 IPMSM 的差模和共模阻抗特性。

title: Enhanced Continuous Terminal Sliding Mode Position Control for PMSM Servo Systems Considering Speed and Current Constraints
abstract: In high-precision permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) servo applications, it is essential to achieve both rapid and accurate positioning control while constraining the speed and current under multi-source disturbances. To achieve this objective, this paper proposes a composite control barrier function (CBF)-based enhanced terminal sliding mode control (TSMC) strategy. First, two finite-time generalized proportional integral observers (FTGPIOs) are designed for matched and unmatched disturbance estimation in PMSM servo systems. By capturing disturbances and their high-order derivatives, FTGPIOs deliver superior estimation accuracy, with finite-time convergence ensuring fast error reduction. Then, a disturbance-compensated finite-time TSMC approach is constructed for finite-time position tracking stability. Meanwhile, a disturbance-integrated robust CBF technique is designed for real-time optimization, effectively limiting speed and current deviations during positioning. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is validated via rigorous stability analysis as well as comprehensive simulation and experimental comparisons.
title_zh: 考虑速度与电流约束的PMSM伺服系统增强型连续终端滑模位置控制
abstract_zh: 在高精度永磁同步电机（PMSM）伺服应用中，必需在多源扰动下约束速度和电流的同时，实现快速而精确的定位控制。为实现这一目标，本文提出了一种基于复合控制屏障函数（CBF）的增强终端滑模控制（TSMC）策略。首先，设计了两个有限时间广义比例积分观测器（FTGPIO），用于 PMSM 伺服系统中匹配与不匹配扰动的估计。通过捕捉扰动及其高阶导数，FTGPIO 具有卓越的估计精度，且有限时间收敛确保了误差的快速减小。然后，构建了扰动补偿的有限时间 TSMC 方法以实现有限时间位置跟踪稳定。同时，设计了集成扰动的鲁棒 CBF 技术进行实时优化，有效限制定位过程中的速度和电流偏差。最后，通过严格的稳定性分析以及全面的仿真与实验对比，验证了所提方法的有效性。

title: Two-Stage Variable Universe Fuzzy Model-Free Sliding Mode Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Double-Power-Combination Reaching Law
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the parameter variation and external load disturbance of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) lead to the decrease of system control performance in actual operation, a two-stage variable universe fuzzy (TSVUF) model-free sliding mode control method of PMSM based on double-power-combination reaching law (DPCRL) is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a new ultra-local model of the motor speed loop is established according to the mathematical model of the PMSM under parameter perturbation. Secondly, a model-free double-power-combination reaching law sliding mode controller (MFDPSMC) for the speed loop is designed, and a TSVUF extended sliding mode disturbance observer (ESMDO) is designed to observe the unknown part of the ultra-local model, and the observed value is used to compensate the system. The TSVUF control method is used to dynamically adjust the reaching law gain of the ESMDO, which improves the observation performance of the observer. Finally, the experimental results show that the proposed control method effectively improves the response speed and anti-interference ability of the system.
title_zh: 基于双幂次组合趋近律的永磁同步电机两阶段变论域模糊无模型滑模控制
abstract_zh: 针对永磁同步电机(PMSM)参数变化和外部负载扰动导致实际运行中系统控制性能下降的问题,本文提出一种基于双幂次组合趋近律(DPCRL)的PMSM两阶段变论域模糊(TSVUF)无模型滑模控制方法。首先,根据参数摄动下PMSM的数学模型,建立了电机转速环的全新超局部模型。其次,设计了转速环的无模型双幂次组合趋近律滑模控制器(MFDPSMC),并设计了TSVUF扩展滑模扰动观测器(ESMDO)来观测超局部模型的未知部分,利用观测值对系统进行补偿。采用TSVUF控制方法动态调整ESMDO的趋近律增益,提高了观测器的观测性能。最后,实验结果表明,所提控制方法有效提高了系统的响应速度和抗干扰能力。

title: A Robust Online Encoder Fault Tolerant Control Strategy for IPMSM Drives
abstract: A novel encoder fault-tolerant-control (FTC) mechanism for interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (IPMSM) drives is investigated in this paper to ensure the IPMSM continues to operate in the event of an encoder fault. The proposed approach features a chattering-reduced sliding mode observer that replaces the conventional signum function with a smooth hyperbolic tangent function, enhancing the accuracy and robustness of speed and position estimation. In addition, an integral terminal sliding mode (ITSM) control law is adopted for both current and speed control-loops to ensure precise tracking control objective. Eventually, the encoder fault diagnosis is achieved through a residual-based threshold strategy that monitors the deviation between measured and estimated speeds. In the event of a fault, the reconfiguration mechanism chooses the estimated speed as feedback to the speed control-loop so that the overall drive system continues to operate. The closed-loop stability under three phases of drive operation such as non-faulty, transient, and reconfiguration is explicitly analyzed. Experimental results on an IPMSM testbench, including comprehensive comparisons with typical methods demonstrate the effectiveness of proposed FTC strategy under the most possible types of faults such as abrupt, intermittent, and incipient.
title_zh: IPMSM传动系统的一种鲁棒在线编码器容错控制策略
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一种用于内置式永磁同步电机(IPMSM)驱动系统的新型编码器容错控制(FTC)机制,以确保在编码器故障情况下IPMSM仍能继续运行。所提方法采用一种降抖振滑模观测器,用平滑的双曲正切函数替代传统的符号函数,提高了转速和位置估计的精度与鲁棒性。此外,电流环和转速环均采用积分终端滑模(ITSM)控制律,以确保精确的跟踪控制目标。最后,通过基于残差的阈值策略监测实测转速与估计转速之间的偏差来实现编码器故障诊断。发生故障时,重构机制选择估计转速作为转速控制环的反馈,使整个驱动系统继续运行。文中显式分析了驱动系统在非故障、暂态和重构三个运行阶段的闭环稳定性。在IPMSM试验台上的实验结果(包括与典型方法的全面对比)证明了所提FTC策略在突发型、间歇型和早期型等最可能的故障类型下的有效性。

title: Two-Switching-Sequence PWM-Based Simple Three-Phase Current Reconstruction Strategy for Single DC-Link Shunt PMSM Drives
abstract: This paper proposes a novel two-switching-sequence pulse width modulation (TSSPWM) strategy to solve the current reconstruction dead zone (CRDZ) problem for single DC-link shunt permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) drives. The switch conduction sequence and voltage vector synthesis principles of TSSPWM are first analyzed, which is different from the existing methods. TSSPWM contains measured voltage vectors and compensated voltage vectors in one switching period. It has symmetric PWM and mid-cycle current sampling structure. Based on the current error analysis, the phase currents reconstructed using this structure are close to the average current of a PWM cycle. Then, the implementation and CRDZ of TSSPWM are also provided. Since TSSPWM only applies one strategy to different CRDZs, it has the characteristics of small memory footprint and fast running speed. Finally, the experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method is lighter, faster and simpler than other methods under various operating conditions.
title_zh: 基于双开关序列PWM的单直流母线分流电阻PMSM传动系统简易三相电流重构策略
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种新颖的双开关序列脉宽调制(TSSPWM)策略,以解决单直流母线分流电阻永磁同步电机(PMSM)驱动系统的电流重构死区(CRDZ)问题。首先分析了TSSPWM与现有方法不同的开关导通序列和电压矢量合成原理。TSSPWM在一个开关周期内包含测量电压矢量和补偿电压矢量,具有对称PWM和周期中点电流采样结构。基于电流误差分析,利用该结构重构的相电流接近一个PWM周期的平均电流。然后,给出了TSSPWM的实现方法及其CRDZ。由于TSSPWM对不同CRDZ仅采用一种策略,因而具有内存占用小、运行速度快的特点。最后,实验结果表明,所提方法在各种运行工况下均比其他方法更轻量、更快速、更简单。

title: Constraint-Adaptive Reinforcement Learning for Large-Scale Power System Planning
abstract: High-penetration renewable integration and the spatial mismatch between energy supply and demandincrease the complexity of multi-regional power system planning. Existing AI techniques in planninginclude renewable forecasting and demand prediction. These methods enhance the input fidelity of Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) models. However, they mainly focus on explicit and observableparameters. Multi-regional planning also depends on latent and unobservable inter-regional responses. Suchlatent features are difficult to capture in the MILP pipeline. To address these limitations, we propose the Constraint-Adaptive Graph-Convolution (CAG-C) Reinforcement Learning (RL) model, which performs end-to-end policy optimization. The planning problem is formulated as a finite-horizon Markov Decision Process, where the agent iteratively adjusts regional power exchange strategies. A graph convolutional network encodes spatial and resource correlations, while a constraint-adaptive architecture transforms raw actions into feasible plans via region-wise scaling, power balance correction, and cost-optimal transmission allocation. This modular design decomposes the high-dimensional planning task into tractable subproblems, ensuring operational feasibility while enabling efficient learning. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed framework is both highly extensible and interpretable. As training progresses, the evolving solution trajectory reveals valuable insights into each region’s functional role, offering a promising new paradigm for future power system planning.
title_zh: 面向大规模电力系统规划的约束自适应强化学习
abstract_zh: 高比例可再生能源并网以及能源供需之间的空间错配增加了多区域电力系统规划的复杂性。规划中现有的人工智能技术包括可再生能源预测和需求预测,这些方法提高了混合整数线性规划(MILP)模型的输入保真度。然而,它们主要关注显式和可观测的参数。多区域规划还依赖于潜在且不可观测的区域间响应,此类潜在特征难以在MILP流程中捕捉。为解决这些局限性,我们提出约束自适应图卷积(CAG-C)强化学习(RL)模型,进行端到端策略优化。该规划问题被表述为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程,智能体迭代调整区域电力交换策略。图卷积网络编码空间和资源相关性,而约束自适应架构通过区域级缩放、功率平衡校正和成本最优传输分配将原始动作转换为可行方案。这种模块化设计将高维规划任务分解为可处理的子问题,在保证运行可行性的同时实现高效学习。数值结果表明,所提框架具有高度可扩展性和可解释性。随着训练的进行,不断演化的解轨迹揭示了每个区域功能角色的宝贵见解,为未来电力系统规划提供了一种有前景的新范式。

title: A Robust Position Sensor Offset Correction Method Based on Harmonic Current Injection for SPMSM
abstract: The performance of the surface-mounted permanent magnet synchronous motor (SPMSM) drive system under the rotor field orientation (RFO) control scheme may significantly deteriorate in the presence of position sensor offset (PSO). To address this problem, first, the effects of the SPMSM drive system under PSO are investigated. Furthermore, a robust online PSO correction method based on d-axis harmonic current injection is proposed. Compared with existing schemes, the proposed scheme is independent of motor parameters so that exhibits high robustness to parametric uncertainties. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by experiments.
title_zh: 基于谐波电流注入的SPMSM鲁棒位置传感器偏移校正方法
abstract_zh: 在转子磁场定向(RFO)控制方案下,位置传感器偏移(PSO)会显著降低表贴式永磁同步电机(SPMSM)驱动系统的性能。为解决这一问题,首先研究了PSO对SPMSM驱动系统的影响;进而提出了一种基于d轴谐波电流注入的鲁棒在线PSO校正方法。与现有方案相比,所提方案不依赖于电机参数,因而对参数不确定性具有较高的鲁棒性。最后,通过实验验证了所提方法的有效性。

title: Frequency and Voltage Independent Stability Conditions for Grid-Forming Devices
abstract: This letter presents a model-decomposition method that derives frequency and voltage independent stability conditions for grid-forming (GFM) devices, enabling separate stability requirements for frequency and voltage components under grid-interactive conditions. To this end, a GFM device-grid interconnected system is decomposed into two frequency and voltage decoupled subsystems and one frequency-voltage coupled subsystem. The decoupled subsystems naturally form a decomposition that necessitates frequency and voltage stability; the coupled subsystem achieves a decomposition of frequency and voltage coupling paths via the small-gain theorem, deriving independent stability conditions for each path. The stability results provide independent insights into frequency and voltage stability guarantees or requirements for GFM control designs or grid codes.
title_zh: 构网型装置的频率与电压无关稳定性条件
abstract_zh: 本信提出一种模型分解方法,为构网型(GFM)装置推导出频率和电压相互独立的稳定条件,从而在并网条件下对频率和电压分量分别提出稳定性要求。为此,将GFM装置-电网互联系统分解为两个频率电压解耦子系统和 一个频率电压耦合子系统。解耦子系统自然构成一个要求频率和电压稳定性的分解;耦合子系统则通过小增益定理实现频率和电压耦合路径的分解,为每条路径推导出独立的稳定条件。该稳定性结果为GFM控制设计或电网规范中的频率和电压稳定性保证或要求提供了相互独立的见解。

title: Volt-VAr-Watt Optimization in Four-Wire Low-Voltage Networks: Exact Nonlinear Models and Smooth Approximations
abstract: The proliferation of distributed energy resources is increasing the prevalence of both overvoltages and undervoltages in low-voltage (LV) distribution networks. Smart inverter functionalities such as Volt-VAr and Volt-Watt control can regulate voltage at the consumer level but are challenging to capture in optimization models due to their nondifferentiability. This paper proposes three nonlinear models for four-wire unbalanced optimal power flow that incorporate these nonsmooth functions without binary or integer variables. The first model encodes these nonsmooth functions directly as user-defined functions using control flow, a feat enabled by many state-of-the-art algebraic modeling languages. The second and third introduce bespoke smooth approximations with tunable approximation errors to address potential numerical issues from nondifferentiability, improving reliability and computational efficiency while maintaining accuracy. All three methods are evaluated on real four-wire unbalanced LV networks with varying rooftop solar integration levels, including a 539-bus system with 302 smart inverters. Results show that optimization-based methods can outperform incremental (quasi-steady-state) approaches, and this work is the first to demonstrate accurate, reliable, and tractable Volt-VAr-Watt optimization on real four-wire unbalanced LV network models.
title_zh: 四线制低压网络中的Volt-VAr-Watt优化：精确非线性模型与平滑近似
abstract_zh: 分布式能源的普及使得低压（LV）配电网中过电压和欠电压现象日益普遍。智能逆变器功能（如Volt-VAr和Volt-Watt控制）可在用户层面调节电压，但由于其不可微性，难以在优化模型中加以描述。本文针对四线不平衡最优潮流提出三种非线性模型，在无需二进制或整数变量的情况下纳入这些非光滑函数。第一种模型利用许多最先进的代数建模语言所支持的功能，通过控制流将这些非光滑函数直接编码为用户自定义函数。第二和第三种模型引入具有可调近似误差的定制平滑近似，以解决不可微性带来的潜在数值问题，在保持精度的同时提高可靠性和计算效率。三种方法均在具有不同屋顶光伏接入水平的实际四线不平衡低压网络上进行了评估，包括一个包含302台智能逆变器的539母线系统。结果表明，基于优化的方法可以优于增量式（准稳态）方法，并且本工作首次在实际四线不平衡低压网络模型上实现了精确、可靠且易于处理的Volt-VAr-Watt优化。

title: Data-Driven Variable Polyhedral Uncertainty Set for Renewable Planning
abstract: With the high penetration of renewables, the uncertainty of renewable generation becomes an important factor in power system operation and planning. In the planning model, renewable installed capacity is a decision variable, which makes the uncertainty set variable. This letter presents a novel tractable approach with a variable polyhedral uncertainty set (VPUS) to capture the temporal-spatial correlations of renewable generation. A modified surrogate affine policy (SAP) is introduced to solve the problem. Numerical tests are conducted on the planning problem of the simplified transmission system. The results indicate that the proposed approach can reduce investment and operational costs for flexibility.
title_zh: 用于可再生能源规划的数据驱动可变多面体不确定集
abstract_zh: 随着可再生能源的高比例接入，可再生能源出力的不确定性成为电力系统运行与规划中的重要因素。在规划模型中，可再生能源装机容量是决策变量，这使得不确定集合成为可变的。本信提出了一种采用可变多面体不确定集（VPUS）的新型可处理方法，以刻画可再生能源出力的时空相关性。引入了一种改进的代理仿射策略（SAP）来求解该问题。在简化输电系统的规划问题上进行了数值测试。结果表明，所提方法能够降低灵活性方面的投资与运行成本。

title: A Trajectory-Unified Method for State Estimation With Global Convergence Property: Theory and Method
abstract: This paper proposes a novel methodology for solving the state estimation (SE) problem with a global convergence property. The prevalent WLS-Gauss-Newton (WLS-GN) method may suffer from numerical divergence. To address this issue, we develop a Trajectory-Unified (TJU) method that employs a nonlinear dynamic system derived from the measurement constraints of the state estimation problem to ensure a SE solution if it exists. Consequently, the proposed WLS-TJU SE method serves as a valuable enhancement to the traditional WLS-GN, improving both the convergence property and robustness in power system state estimation. It is theoretically proven that the derived nonlinear dynamic system is completely stable, rendering the proposed WLS-TJU method a desired property–global convergence. From a theoretical viewpoint, numerical studies of the convergence regions of estimated SE solutions using both the WLS-GN and the proposed WLS-TJU SE method under various loading conditions and under different levels of measurement redundancy are conducted. The evaluation metric for the degree of convergence is the size of the convergence region. From a robustness viewpoint, the advantages of the proposed method in terms of convergence and robustness to network topology errors and loading conditions; particularly several cases are shown that the WLS-GN method diverges while the proposed WLS-TJU converges. Computationally speaking, the computational performance in large-scale systems including the 3120-bus system of the proposed SE method is also highlighted. The proposed WLS-TJU SE method shows a computational advantage of 3.22 times faster than the traditional WLS SE method in a 3120-bus system.
title_zh: 一种具有全局收敛性质的轨迹统一状态估计方法：理论与方法
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种具有全局收敛特性的求解状态估计（SE）问题的新方法。常用的WLS-Gauss-Newton（WLS-GN）方法可能出现数值发散。为解决这一问题，我们开发了一种轨迹统一（TJU）方法，该方法利用由状态估计问题的量测约束导出的非线性动态系统，在解存在的情况下确保获得SE解。因此，所提出的WLS-TJU SE方法是对传统WLS-GN的有价值增强，提升了电力系统状态估计的收敛性与鲁棒性。理论上证明了所导出的非线性动态系统是完全稳定的，使所提出的WLS-TJU方法具备理想特性——全局收敛。从理论角度出发，在各种负荷条件以及不同量测冗余度水平下，分别使用WLS-GN和所提出的WLS-TJU SE方法对SE估计解的收敛域进行了数值研究。收敛程度的评估指标为收敛域的大小。从鲁棒性角度出发，展示了所提方法在收敛性以及对网络拓扑错误和负荷条件鲁棒性方面的优势；特别是给出了若干WLS-GN方法发散而所提出的WLS-TJU方法收敛的算例。在计算方面，还重点展示了所提SE方法在大规模系统（包括3120母线系统）中的计算性能。所提出的WLS-TJU SE方法表

title: A Planning Framework for Power-to-Gas in Multi-Energy Distribution Systems
abstract: Power-to-gas (P2G) systems can provide multifaceted services within Multi-Energy Systems (MES) beyond traditional roles. When strategically deployed, P2G systems can mitigate congestion in the electricity grid, advance the heat transition through the utilization of their waste heat, and optimize the usage of existing gas grids. This research introduces a joint operations and planning model for P2G facilities, including the expansion of electricity, gas, and heat distribution systems. The model is formulated as a mixed integer second order cone program (MISOCP). It incorporates the variable efficiency of electrolyzers and a detailed representation of the electrolyzer waste heat extraction system (EHES), addressing spatial, temporal, and temperature mismatches between heat demand and supply. The model is demonstrated on a 22-node interconnected electricity–gas test network and a 95-node real-world electricity–gas network in the Netherlands. Results reveal tradeoffs in alleviating congestion in the electricity grid, preventing congestion in the gas grid, and maximizing waste heat sales. Optimally distributed P2G reduced congestion in the electricity distribution grid, but induced congestion in the gas distribution grid. Future research should focus on managing such Active Gas Distribution Networks (AGDNs) with distributed P2G and finding a balance between the benefits and challenges of P2G deployment in MES.
title_zh: 多能源配电系统中电转气的规划框架
abstract_zh: 电转气（P2G）系统可在多能源系统（MES）中提供超越传统角色的多方面服务。若进行战略性部署，P2G系统可缓解电网阻塞、通过利用废热推进供热转型，并优化现有燃气网络的利用。本研究提出了一个P2G设施的联合运行与规划模型，包括配电、配气和配热系统的扩展。该模型被表述为混合整数二阶锥规划（MISOCP）。模型纳入了电解槽的可变效率以及电解槽废热提取系统（EHES）的详细表征，以解决热需求与供给之间在空间、时间和温度上的不匹配。该模型在一个22节点电气互联测试网络和荷兰一个95节点实际电气网络上进行了演示。结果揭示了缓解电网阻塞、防止燃气网阻塞和最大化废热销售之间的权衡。最优分布式部署的P2G减轻了配电网的阻塞，但引发了配气网的阻塞。未来的研究应侧重于管理具有分布式P2G的有源配气网（AGDN），并在MES中部署P2G的收益与挑战之间找到平衡。

title: A 3-D Equivalent Magnetic Network Model for Performance Analysis of Modular Permanent Magnet Claw Pole Machines With Spliced Air Gaps
abstract: Due to the small size of the spliced air gap caused by modular design, it is time-consuming to predict the performance of modular permanent magnet claw pole machines (MPMCPM) by using finite element method. Therefore, a three-dimensional equivalent magnetic network (3-D EMN) model is proposed to predict the performance of MPMCPM with spliced air gaps in this paper. First, the permeance calculation methods for different 3-D mesh cells are presented. By using these specific mesh cells, permeances of claw pole meshes can be accurately calculated. Second, hexahedron meshes are laid out in areas with severe leakage flux, then leakage magnetic fields can be considered and the accuracy of the model can be improved. The high accuracy of the proposed 3-D EMN model is verified by comparing with finite element results and experiments conducted on a small-scale prototype machine. Meanwhile, the core loss is calculated and the influence of the rotating magnetic field on claw poles is also taken into account. Finally, the influence of spliced air gaps with different lengths on the performance of MPMCPM is predicted by adding spliced air gap permeances to the 3-D EMN model.
title_zh: 拼接气隙模块化永磁爪极电机性能分析的三维等效磁网络模型
abstract_zh: 由于模块化设计导致的拼接气隙尺寸较小，采用有限元方法预测模块化永磁爪极电机（MPMCPM）的性能十分耗时。为此，本文提出一种三维等效磁网络（3-D EMN）模型来预测具有拼接气隙的MPMCPM的性能。首先，给出了不同三维网格单元的磁导计算方法。利用这些特定的网格单元，可以精确计算爪极网格的磁导。其次，在漏磁严重的区域布置六面体网格，从而可以考虑漏磁场并提高模型的精度。通过与有限元结果以及在小型样机上开展的实验对比，验证了所提3-D EMN模型的高精度。同时，计算了铁心损耗，并考虑了旋转磁场对爪极的影响。最后，通过在3-D EMN模型中加入拼接气隙磁导，预测了不同长度拼接气隙对MPMCPM性能的影响。

title: Promise, proof and practice: how to realize the clinical value of consumer wearables
abstract: Over 400 million people own a wearable that continuously monitors their health, yet clinicians struggle to act on the data they generate. Realizing their clinical value requires context-specific validation and an integration pipeline designed around end-use.
title_zh: 前景、验证与实践：如何实现消费级可穿戴设备的临床价值
abstract_zh: 超过4亿人拥有持续监测其健康状况的可穿戴设备，然而临床医生却难以利用这些设备产生的数据采取行动。要实现其临床价值，需要针对具体场景的验证以及围绕最终用途设计的集成流程。

title: Developments, Challenges, and Opportunities in Au(I)/Au(III) Redox Catalysis
abstract: Abstract Leveraging the intrinsic π-acidic character of gold complexes, gold has found widespread application in organic synthesis. Despite the extensive use of gold as a π-bond activator, its application in redox catalysis for achieving cross-coupling reactions has historically lagged behind. The primary obstacle in advancing gold redox catalysis is the inherent high redox potential of the Au(I)/Au(III) couple, arising from the pronounced relativistic effect. The instability of Au(III) complexes due to facile reduction to gold nanoparticles presents an additional challenge. Over the years, extensive efforts were made to overcome these limitations which led to the identification of several strategies to achieve gold redox catalysis. These strategies primarily rely on the use of external oxidants, photocatalyst/light, aryldiazonium salts, hemilabile ligands, electricity and dinuclear gold-complexes to facilitate Au(I)/Au(III) catalysis. Banking on these strategies, gold redox catalysis has emerged as a promising technique for various transformations such as cross-coupling reactions, C-H functionalization reactions and difunctionalization of C-C multiple bonds. Interestingly, the high electronegativity and π-acid character of gold complexes offer unique reactivities and selectivities compared to commonly used transition metals for cross-coupling reactions. Clearly, the field of Au(I)/Au(III) catalysis has significantly expanded the utility of gold in organic synthesis and its applications in biological and materials science. This review summarizes an up-to-date development in this field since its inception, with a particular emphasis on mechanistic aspects, while outlining the key opportunities and future directions.
title_zh: Au(I)/Au(III)氧化还原催化的发展、挑战与机遇
abstract_zh: 摘要 利用金配合物固有的π酸性特性，金在有机合成中得到了广泛应用。尽管金作为π键活化剂被广泛使用，但其在实现交叉偶联反应的氧化还原催化中的应用长期以来相对滞后。推进金氧化还原催化的主要障碍是Au(I)/Au(III)电对固有的高氧化还原电位，这源于显著的相对论效应。Au(III)配合物因容易还原为金纳米颗粒而表现出的不稳定性带来了额外的挑战。多年来，人们为克服这些限制付出了大量努力，从而确立了实现金氧化还原催化的若干策略。这些策略主要依赖于使用外部氧化剂、光催化剂/光、芳基重氮盐、半易变配体、电化学以及双核金配合物来促进Au(I)/Au(III)催化。凭借这些策略，金氧化还原催化已成为一种用于多种转化的有前景技术，例如交叉偶联反应、C-H官能化反应以及C-C重键的双官能化反应。有趣的是，与常用于交叉偶联反应的过渡金属相比，金配合物的高电负性和π酸特性提供了独特的反应性和选择性。显然，Au(I)/Au(III)催化领域已显著扩展了金在有机合成中的实用性及其在生物学和材料科学中的应用。本综述总结了……的最新进展

title: Micro/Nanoliter Sample Separation: From Lab Bench to Marketplace
abstract: Abstract Microsample separation in lab-on-a-chip systems is a rapidly evolving research area addressing challenges across biomedical, chemical, and environmental sciences. Enabled by advances in micro- and nanofabrication, microfluidic platforms allow high-throughput separation and purification of complex microsamples through tailored channel structures and external driving forces, offering high-throughput, efficient, and integrated alternatives to conventional separation methods. Importantly, research progress in the laboratory is swiftly transitioning to address practical challenges. As our manuscript specifically focuses on the types and applications of microfluidic separation technologies, it is highly valuable for startups and other commercial entities looking to enter the separation technology market, as well as for end-user companies. The manuscript commences with a discussion on the development and construction processes of microfluidic separation, and then dive into a detailed analysis of the principles and classifications of separation technologies integrating a range of external fields forces. Another section focuses on emerging applications of microsample separation technologies, highlighting successfully commercialized microfluidic separation platforms while discussing the challenges currently hindering further commercialization of these technologies. Finally, we provide perspectives on the future direction of this technology, including the challenges and opportunities that arise with the development of artificial intelligence technologies in its applications.
title_zh: 微/纳升级样品分离：从实验室走向市场
abstract_zh: 摘要 芯片实验室系统中的微量样品分离是一个快速发展的研究领域，旨在应对生物医学、化学和环境科学中的挑战。得益于微纳加工技术的进步，微流控平台通过定制化的通道结构和外部驱动力，实现了复杂微量样品的高通量分离与纯化，为传统分离方法提供了高通量、高效且集成化的替代方案。重要的是，实验室中的研究进展正迅速转向解决实际挑战。由于我们的稿件专门聚焦于微流控分离技术的类型与应用，对于希望进入分离技术市场的初创企业及其他商业实体以及终端用户公司而言，它具有很高的参考价值。稿件首先讨论了微流控分离技术的发展与构建过程，然后深入分析整合多种外场驱动力的分离技术的原理与分类。另一部分聚焦于微量样品分离技术的新兴应用，重点介绍了已成功商业化的微流控分离平台，并讨论了当前阻碍这些技术进一步商业化的挑战。最后，我们对该技术的未来方向进行了展望，包括人工智能技术在其应用发展过程中所带来的挑战与机遇。

title: Distributionally Robust Optimal Dispatch for Microgrids With Sinkhorn Distance: An Exponential Cone Reformulation
abstract: Wasserstein distance (WD) has emerged as a promising and widely used method to tackle uncertainty in power system dispatch problems. However, existing studies have proved that the worst-case distribution identified by WD is discrete, which potentially causes Wasserstein ambiguity sets to hedge against an incorrect class of distributions when the underlying true distribution is continuous. To bridge this gap, this paper presents a novel distributionally robust optimal dispatch model for microgrids based on the Sinkhorn distance, a variant of the WD that further incorporates entropic regularization. The Sinkhorn ambiguity sets can yield a smoother worst-case distribution that is not restricted to discrete forms. By deriving a tractable exponential cone reformulation of the worst-case expected objective function and harnessing a conditional value-at-risk approximation to address distributionally robust joint chance constraints, the proposed model is admitted as a mixed-integer exponential cone problem. Numerical experiments on modified IEEE 33-bus, IEEE 123-bus, and 240-bus test systems demonstrate the efficacy and superiority of the developed approach, offering a reliable alternative for decision-making problems under uncertainty.
title_zh: 基于Sinkhorn距离的微电网分布式鲁棒优化调度：指数锥重构
abstract_zh: Wasserstein距离（WD）已成为解决电力系统调度问题中不确定性的一种有前景且被广泛使用的方法。然而，现有研究表明，WD识别的最坏情况分布是离散的，当潜在真实分布为连续分布时，这可能导致Wasserstein模糊集针对错误类别的分布进行对冲。为弥合这一差距，本文提出了一种基于Sinkhorn距离的微电网分布鲁棒优化调度新模型，Sinkhorn距离是WD的一种变体，进一步引入了熵正则化。Sinkhorn模糊集可以产生不受限于离散形式的更平滑的最坏情况分布。通过推导最坏情况期望目标函数的可处理指数锥重构，并利用条件风险价值（CVaR）近似处理分布鲁棒联合机会约束，所提模型被归结为混合整数指数锥问题。在改进的IEEE 33节点、IEEE 123节点和240节点测试系统上的数值实验验证了所开发方法的有效性和优越性，为不确定性下的决策问题提供了可靠的替代方案。

title: Robust Sliding Mode Control Strategy for Variable-Gear-Ratio Magnetic-Geared Machines
abstract: Variable-gear-ratio magnetic-geared machines (VGRMGMs) which could achieve adjustable gear ratios, shows substantial application prospects in driving systems. However, the VGRMGMs suffer from dynamic performance deficiencies such as slow dynamic responses and excessive speed overshoots. A robust sliding mode control (RSMC) strategy based on a load torque observer is proposed in this paper in order to improve the dynamic performance of the VGRMGM. A sliding mode speed controller and a torque observer for feedforward compensation in the current loop, is employed to improve the robustness and dynamic performance of the VGRMGM. Under speed–regulation conditions, the RSMC strategy achieves a 6% reduction in overshoot and a 25.4% improvement in response speed compared with conventional PI control. For load–variation conditions, the overshoot is reduced by 5%, and the response speed is improved by 32.1%, highlighting the VGRMGM superior transient performance. Experimental evaluations on a purpose-built test rig validate the enhancement of the RSMC strategy in terms of improved dynamic performance.
title_zh: 变齿轮比磁齿轮电机的鲁棒滑模控制策略
abstract_zh: 变齿轮比磁齿轮电机（VGRMGM）可实现可调齿轮比，在驱动系统中展现出广阔的应用前景。然而，VGRMGM存在动态响应缓慢和转速超调过大等动态性能不足的问题。为改善VGRMGM的动态性能，本文提出了一种基于负载转矩观测器的鲁棒滑模控制（RSMC）策略。采用滑模转速控制器和用于电流环前馈补偿的转矩观测器，以提高VGRMGM的鲁棒性和动态性能。在调速工况下，与传统PI控制相比，RSMC策略将超调降低了6%，响应速度提升了25.4%。在负载变化工况下，超调降低了5%，响应速度提升了32.1%，凸显了VGRMGM优异的暂态性能。在专门搭建的试验台上的实验评估验证了RSMC策略在改善动态性能方面的提升效果。

title: An Efficient Data Generation Method Based on Flow Matching for Bearing Fault Diagnosis Under Imbalanced Data Conditions
abstract: The process of fault diagnosis is greatly constrained by imbalanced datasets, as a lack of fault data results in models with poor diagnostic performance. To overcome this issue, generative adversarial networks (GANs) have been utilized. However, they often suffer from training instability and are prone to mode collapse, where this critical issue causes the generator to produce a very limited variety of outputs. Consequently, this article proposes an efficient data augmentation framework based on flow matching for the domain of bearing fault diagnosis under imbalanced data. First, the continuous wavelet transform of vibration signals is employed to train a conditional flow matching model. After training, the model can generate new synthetic data by transforming a random Gaussian noise vector into a high-fidelity time–frequency spectrum. A key advantage of this approach is its computational efficiency, where the model produces diverse and authentic samples with as few as 5-15 generation steps, significantly reducing the generation time compared to traditional diffusion models. Furthermore, to comprehensively evaluate the diversity and fidelity of synthesized samples, various evaluation techniques, such as kernel inception distance (KID), the GAN-test/GAN-train metric and t-distributed stochastic neighbor embedding (t-SNE) visualizations of the learned feature space, are employed. Ultimately, a series of imbalanced fault diagnosis experiments was conducted to validate the practical effectiveness of the proposed method, resulting in final diagnosis accuracies of 95.90% and 97.31% on two widely used datasets and 98.81% on an actual test bed.
title_zh: 基于流匹配的高效数据生成方法用于不平衡数据条件下的轴承故障诊断
abstract_zh: 故障诊断过程在很大程度上受到不平衡数据集的制约，因为故障数据的缺乏会导致模型诊断性能较差。为克服这一问题，研究者采用了生成对抗网络（GAN）。然而，GAN常常存在训练不稳定且易发生模式坍塌的问题，这一关键缺陷会导致生成器产生种类非常有限的输出。因此，本文针对不平衡数据下的轴承故障诊断领域，提出了一种基于流匹配的高效数据增强框架。首先，利用振动信号的连续小波变换训练条件流匹配模型。训练完成后，该模型可将随机高斯噪声向量转换为高保真时频谱，从而生成新的合成数据。该方法的一个关键优势在于其计算效率，模型仅需5-15个生成步骤即可产生多样且逼真的样本，与传统扩散模型相比显著缩短了生成时间。此外，为了全面评估合成样本的多样性和保真度，采用了多种评估技术，例如核初始距离（KID）、GAN-test/GAN-train指标以及所学特征空间的t分布随机邻域嵌入（t-SNE）可视化。最终，进行了一系列不平衡故障诊断实验以验证所提方法的实际有效性，最终诊断准确率分别达到95.90%和97.3

title: An Analytical Model for Spatiotemporal Risk of Grid Infrastructure Under Extreme Events
abstract: Accurately quantifying the spatiotemporal risks to power grid infrastructure under extreme events is critical to ensuring system stability and resilience. The recently proposed hazard resistance-based spatiotemporal risk analysis (HRSRA) model addresses a key limitation of the widely used Sequential Monte Carlo method, which tends to overestimate infrastructure damage risk due to repeated sampling in time-series analysis. However, the HRSRA method relies on extensive simulations. This letter proposes an analytical framework and derives closed-form expressions for key statistical metrics to quantify grid infrastructure risk during extreme events. Bypassing the numerical simulations of HRSRA, the proposed analytical method agrees well with power outage observations in Puerto Rico.
title_zh: 极端事件下电网基础设施时空风险解析模型
abstract_zh: 在极端事件下准确量化电网基础设施的时空风险，对于确保系统稳定性与韧性至关重要。最近提出的基于灾害抗力的时空风险分析（HRSRA）模型解决了广泛使用的序贯蒙特卡洛方法的一个关键局限，即该方法在时间序列分析中因重复采样而倾向于高估基础设施损坏风险。然而，HRSRA方法依赖于大量仿真。本文提出了一种解析框架，并推导了关键统计指标的闭式表达式，用于量化极端事件期间电网基础设施的风险。该解析方法无需进行HRSRA的数值仿真，其结果与波多黎各的停电观测数据吻合良好。

title: 1D Plasticity in Semiconductor Crystals
abstract: ABSTRACT The exceptional plasticity recently found in inorganic semiconductors can be classified into two types: the three‐dimensional (3D) orientation‐insensitive deformability in polycrystals, and the two‐dimensional (2D) anisotropic case in layered crystals. It is thus highly anticipated that one‐dimensional (1D) plasticity should also exist but it has not been found yet. Here this work reports the excellent 1D plasticity in tin selenide (SnSe) semiconductor crystals. In in‐plane directions, the bending strain is as large as ∼22.7% for the zig‐zag‐aligned specimen (plasticity) while as small as ∼1.4% for the armchair‐aligned one (brittleness). Such 1D plasticity is ascribed to the coherent and stronger bond topology along b ‐axis that allows for multiple deformation mechanisms including layer segments, interlayer slip, bridging, lattice distortion, and dislocations. This bonding topology enables that the 1D plasticity is also observed in isostructural SnS and GeSe crystals. High‐performance shape‐conformable thermoelectric generators are then successfully developed using materials with 1D plasticity. This work enriches the diagram for plasticity and thus provides a new direction for the design and discovery of ductile semiconductors.
title_zh: 半导体晶体中的一维塑性
abstract_zh: 摘要 最近在无机半导体中发现的卓越塑性可分为两类：多晶中的三维（3D）取向不敏感变形能力，以及层状晶体中的二维（2D）各向异性情形。因此，人们高度期待一维（1D）塑性的存在，但至今尚未被发现。本工作报道了硒化锡（SnSe）半导体晶体中优异的1D塑性。在面内方向上，沿zig-zag方向排列的样品（塑性）弯曲应变可高达约22.7%，而沿armchair方向排列的样品（脆性）弯曲应变仅约1.4%。这种1D塑性归因于沿b轴的连贯且更强的键合拓扑，其允许多种变形机制，包括层片段、层间滑移、桥接、晶格畸变和位错。这种键合拓扑使得在同构的SnS和GeSe晶体中也能观察到1D塑性。随后，利用具有1D塑性的材料成功开发了高性能的形状可贴合热电发生器。本工作丰富了塑性图谱，从而为延性半导体的设计与发现提供了新方向。

title: Self‐Healing and Environmentally Stable Supramolecular Liquid Crystalline Gels for Mechanochromic Optics and Tactile Sensing
