Genome mining shows that AvmG-like proteins are widespread and enriched in actinomycete polyketide gene clusters; characterization of the lydicamycin homolog LymR establishes conserved exo-IMDA activity in a distinct pathway. Structural and mutational analyses implicate a loop-defined catalytic cavity in steering the kinetically demanding cis-decalin outcome. Together, these findings expand the fold and mechanistic diversity of Diels–Alderases, define an exo-selective β-propeller pericyclase superfamily, and provide a new handle for mining and bioengineering cis-decalin biosynthetic pathways.
title_zh: β-螺旋桨Diels–Alder酶家族指导聚酮化合物生物合成中顺式十氢萘的形成
abstract_zh: 摘要 十氢萘形成的Diels–Alder酶（周环酶）体现了自然界如何反复招募不相关的蛋白质折叠来控制[4 + 2]环加成反应，然而生成顺式稠合十氢萘的外型选择性分子内Diels–Alder（IMDA）反应仍然罕见且知之甚少。在此，我们发现了一个此前未被识别的细菌周环酶家族，其在聚酮化合物组装中强制执行外型IMDA路径。以alchivemycin A——一种由高度官能化的顺式十氢萘核心定义的大环抗菌聚酮化合物——为研究对象，我们鉴定了AvmG为专属的十氢萘形成酶。破坏avmG会使途径代谢流转向反式十氢萘支路异构体，这与自发、内型偏好的环化一致，而下游大环化酶无法处理这些产物；相反，AvmG能够促进真正顺式十氢萘中间体的形成。AvmG与已知的[4 + 2]环化酶无同源关系，采用类似整合素α N端结构域的β-螺旋桨结构，揭示了一种出人意料的周环立体控制骨架。基因组挖掘表明AvmG样蛋白广泛存在并富集于放线菌聚酮化合物基因簇中；对lydicamycin同源蛋白LymR的表征确立了在另一条途径中保守的外型IMDA活性。结构和突变分析表明，由环状结构定义的催化空腔在引导动力学上要求苛刻的顺式十氢萘产物中起关键作用。总之，这些发现拓展了Diels–Alder酶的折叠和机制多样性，定义了一个外型选择性的β-螺旋桨周环酶超家族，并为挖掘和生物工程……提供了新抓手

title: 3D-to-3D Topotactic Transformation in Extra-Large-Pore Pure-Silica Zeolite
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Stable silica-based extra-large-pore (ELP) zeolites are highly desirable for processing bulky molecules but remain exceedingly challenging to synthesize directly. Here, we report JU-87, a stable, fully connected pure-silica ELP zeolite formed through a 3D-to-3D topotactic condensation of an interrupted 24-membered-ring zeolite precursor (JU-86). The calcination-induced full condensation of the SiO–···HOSi defects in JU-86 yields JU-87, which features one-dimensional 18-membered-ring channels (max. dimension: 17.36 Å) lined with pocket-like cavities and contains abundant, unprecedented, highly strained three-membered-ring units. Owing to its spacious channels, JU-87 can accommodate bulky dye molecules, demonstrating its potential for the adsorption and catalytic upgrading of large substrates.
title_zh: 超大孔纯硅分子筛中的3D到3D拓扑转变
abstract_zh: 摘要 稳定的硅基超大孔（ELP）分子筛对于加工大分子非常理想，但其直接合成仍然极具挑战性。在此，我们报道了JU-87，一种稳定的、完全连接的纯硅ELP分子筛，它通过一种含缺陷的24元环分子筛前体（JU-86）的3D到3D拓扑缩合反应形成。JU-86中SiO–···HOSi缺陷经煅烧诱导完全缩合生成JU-87，其特征在于一维18元环孔道（最大尺寸：17.36 Å），孔道内衬有口袋状空腔，并含有大量前所未有的高张力三元环单元。凭借其宽敞的孔道，JU-87可以容纳大体积染料分子，展示了其在大型底物吸附和催化升级方面的潜力。

title: Spirobifluorene-Cored Tetrameric Acceptors with a Perpendicular Interlocking Toroidal Topology for Efficient and Stable Organic Solar Cells
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Small-molecule fused-ring electron acceptors (FREAs) have greatly advanced the efficiency of organic solar cells (OSCs), yet their long-term operational stability remains a critical hurdle for practical applications. Covalently linking FREA units into oligomers offers a promising strategy to address this issue, but the rational design of molecular topology in such systems remains largely unexplored. In this work, we report a novel three-dimensional (3D) oligomeric acceptor with a high glass-transition temperature (192 °C), namely LT-F, constructed from an orthogonally configured spirofluorene core. This unique 3D configuration adopts a perpendicularly interlocking toroidal topology, which not only effectively suppresses excessive aggregation and moderates the crystallinity of the acceptor phase but also promotes a more uniform vertical phase distribution with a favorable gradient. Notably, LT-F enables strong intermolecular interactions with the host L8-BO acceptor, significantly inhibiting its thermal diffusion and thus substantially enhancing morphological stability under operational stress. As a result, the ternary device based on PM6:L8-BO:LT-F delivers champion power conversion efficiencies of 19.49% and 20.10% when using PEDOT:PSS and a self-assembly layer as the hole-transporting layers (HTLs), respectively, both outperforming the PM6:L8-BO binary counterparts. Moreover, the ternary device with a PEDOT:PSS HTL exhibits markedly improved long-term stability, retaining 90.6% of its initial efficiency after 1000 h of thermal aging at 100 °C and 80.1% after 1200 h under maximum power point tracking. These results highlight the critical importance of 3D topological design in oligomeric acceptors for simultaneously achieving high efficiency and robust stability, providing valuable guidelines for future molecular engineering in high-performance organic photovoltaics.
title_zh: 具有垂直互锁环状拓扑结构的螺芴核心四聚体受体用于高效稳定的有机太阳能电池
abstract_zh: 摘要 小分子稠环电子受体（FREAs）极大地推动了有机太阳能电池（OSCs）效率的提升，但其长期运行稳定性仍是实际应用的关键障碍。将FREA单元共价连接成低聚物是解决这一问题的一种有前景的策略，但此类体系中分子拓扑结构的合理设计仍在很大程度上未被探索。在这项工作中，我们报道了一种具有高玻璃化转变温度（192 °C）的新型三维（3D）低聚受体LT-F，它由正交构型的螺芴核构建。这种独特的3D构型采用垂直互锁的环形拓扑，不仅有效抑制了过度聚集并调节了受体相的结晶度，还促进了更有利的梯度、更均匀的垂直相分布。值得注意的是，LT-F与主体L8-BO受体之间产生强分子间相互作用，显著抑制其热扩散，从而大幅提升运行应力下的形态稳定性。因此，基于PM6:L8-BO:LT-F的三元器件在使用PEDOT:PSS和自组装层作为空穴传输层（HTLs）时，分别实现了19.49%和20.10%的最佳功率转换效率，均优于PM6:L8-BO二元对照器件。此外，采用PEDOT:PSS HTL的三元器件表现出显著改善的长期稳定性，在100 °C热老化1000小时后保持初始效率的90.6%，在1200小时后保持80.1%

title: Reconfiguring Lone-Pair Electrons for High-Performance n-Type SnSe Thermoelectrics
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Direct conversion of abundant waste heat into electricity offers a promising route to more efficient energy use, motivating the development of thermoelectric materials with high figure of merit (ZT). In SnSe, Sn 5s2 LPEs are widely recognized as the origin of ultralow lattice thermal conductivity. However, their role in charge transport remains insufficiently understood. Here, by introducing trace Ce3+ that lack stereochemically active LPEs, we reconfigure the collective activity of LPEs in SnSe, thereby enabling robust n-type conduction and enhanced three-dimensional (3D) charge transport through strengthened interlayer orbital overlap and improved carrier mobility. Consequently, Sn0.99Ce0.01Se crystal achieves a peak ZT of ∼3.0 at 745 K and a maximum power-generation efficiency of ∼10.4%. This work establishes a new paradigm for optimizing the thermoelectric performance of materials containing LPEs.
title_zh: 重构孤对电子实现高性能n型SnSe热电材料
abstract_zh: 摘要 将丰富的废热直接转化为电力为更高效的能源利用提供了一条有前景的途径，推动了具有高品质因数（ZT）的热电材料的发展。在SnSe中，Sn 5s2孤对电子（LPEs）被广泛认为是超低晶格热导率的根源。然而，它们在电荷输运中的作用仍未被充分理解。在此，通过引入缺乏立体化学活性LPEs的痕量Ce3+，我们重构了SnSe中LPEs的集体活性，从而通过增强层间轨道重叠和改善载流子迁移率，实现了稳健的n型导电和增强的三维（3D）电荷输运。因此，Sn0.99Ce0.01Se晶体在745 K下实现了约3.0的峰值ZT，最大发电效率约为10.4%。这项工作为优化含LPEs材料的热电性能建立了新范式。

title: Light-Driven Active Separation Sustains a Transmembrane Proton-Activity Difference for Electrochemical Microenvironment Regulation
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Electrochemical water technologies often require spatially distinct proton activities, yet passive membranes allow these microenvironments to equilibrate. Here we construct a topology-defined series of donor–acceptor covalent organic framework (COF) membranes with rhombic, honeycomb, and kagome lattices and establish a connection between local photoinduced responses and membrane-scale active ion transport. Among them, rhombic COF-PY-BT exhibits the strongest local photoresponse and the largest light-induced transmembrane bias under one-sided illumination. Crossed-control experiments establish that the direction of the macroscopic response follows the illumination direction, while periodic Berry-phase calculations reveal framework-dependent retention and cancellation of dipolar components. The resulting transmembrane bias counteracts proton back-diffusion and enables uphill proton transport, helping sustain a bulk ΔpH > 4 between near-neutral anodic and acidic cathodic compartments. When integrated as an active separator in a two-compartment electrolysis cell, COF-PY-BT lowers the apparent full-cell voltage by approximately 45% under dilute conditions and improves voltage stability. These results establish light-driven active membrane regulation as a strategy for sustaining nonequilibrium proton environments during electrochemical operation.
title_zh: 光驱动主动分离维持跨膜质子活度差以调控电化学微环境
abstract_zh: 摘要 电化学水技术通常需要空间上不同的质子活度，而无源膜会使这些微环境趋于平衡。在此，我们构建了一系列拓扑明确的给体–受体共价有机框架（COF）膜，分别具有菱形、蜂窝和kagome晶格，并建立了局部光诱导响应与膜尺度主动离子输运之间的联系。其中，菱形COF-PY-BT在单侧光照下表现出最强的局部光响应和最大的光诱导跨膜偏压。交叉对照实验证实宏观响应的方向遵循光照方向，而周期性Berry相位计算揭示了依赖于框架的偶极分量的保留与抵消。由此产生的跨膜偏压抵消了质子回流，实现了质子的逆浓度梯度输运，有助于在近中性的阳极区和酸性的阴极区之间维持大于4的整体ΔpH。作为双室电解槽中的活性隔膜集成时，COF-PY-BT在稀释条件下将表观全电池电压降低约45%，并改善了电压稳定性。这些结果确立了光驱动的主动膜调控作为在电化学运行过程中维持非平衡质子环境的一种策略。

title: Epoxide-Mediated Carbon Dioxide Coupling Yields the Five-Membered Cyclic Carbonate in Cytosporin Biosynthesis
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Organic carbonates (OCs) have a wide range of applications across materials science, synthetic chemistry, and medicine. The development of efficient catalytic processes for converting carbon dioxide (CO2) into OCs represents a crucial objective in sustainable chemistry and energy research. Among available strategies, the coupling of CO2 with epoxides to form cyclic carbonates is one of the most technologically and economically promising routes for CO2 valorization. Although considerable progress has been made in designing high-performance catalysts for this transformation, several limitations remain, including dependence on organic solvents, transition metal-based catalytic systems, and energy-intensive conditions, typically involving elevated temperatures and high CO2 pressures. While an increasing number of naturally occurring OCs have been identified, the biosynthetic mechanisms underlying their formation, especially for fungal-derived five-membered cyclic carbonates, remain largely unknown. In this study, we identified and functionally characterized all enzymes involved in cytosporin biosynthesis and elucidated the complete biosynthetic pathway. We demonstrated that the five-membered cyclic carbonate moiety in cytosporin E arises through a nonenzymatic, epoxide-mediated CO2 coupling reaction under neutral aqueous conditions. This strategy for constructing a five-membered cyclic carbonate is unprecedented in natural product biosynthesis and may offer valuable insights for developing environmentally benign synthetic routes toward OCs.
title_zh: 环氧化物介导的二氧化碳偶联在cytosporin生物合成中生成五元环状碳酸酯
abstract_zh: 摘要 有机碳酸酯（OCs）在材料科学、合成化学和医学领域具有广泛应用。开发将二氧化碳（CO2）高效催化转化为OCs的过程是可持续化学与能源研究中的关键目标。在现有策略中，CO2与环氧化物的偶联形成环状碳酸酯是CO2资源化利用在技术和经济上最具前景的路线之一。尽管在设计用于该转化的高性能催化剂方面已取得相当进展，但仍存在若干局限，包括对有机溶剂的依赖、基于过渡金属的催化体系以及高能耗条件（通常涉及高温和高CO2压力）。虽然已鉴定出越来越多的天然OCs，但其形成的生物合成机制，尤其是真菌来源的五元环状碳酸酯，仍在很大程度上未知。在本研究中，我们鉴定并对细胞孢子菌素生物合成所涉及的所有酶进行了功能表征，阐明了完整的生物合成途径。我们证明了细胞孢子菌素E中的五元环状碳酸酯部分是在中性水条件下通过非酶促的、环氧化物介导的CO2偶联反应形成的。这种构建五元环状碳酸酯的策略在天然产物生物合成中前所未有，可能为开发环境友好的OCs合成路线提供宝贵见解。

title: Wide-Temperature-Range Near-Zero Thermal Expansion via Stuffing-Controlled Dynamics in Diamond-Like Materials
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Near-zero thermal expansion (NZTE) materials are essential for emerging precision technologies, such as optical instruments and aerospace components. However, existing materials with robust performance over a broad temperature range are limited, especially if functional properties in addition to NZTE are sought. We report a data-driven materials design investigation and find that the zinc-blende structure is an excellent platform for obtaining NZTE and elucidating underlying crystal-chemical principles. Based on these, we introduced vacancy engineering and stuffed-atom incorporation, yielding a series of cubic quaternary chalcogenides AM3M′X4, where linkage ion vibrations are systematically modulated. We found that NaAg3TiS4, NaAg3TiSe4, and RbAg3TiSe4 are promising NZTE candidates with coefficients of thermal expansion below 2 × 10–6 K–1 over extended temperature windows (300–600 K). These are semiconducting materials distinct from low-thermal-expansion oxides. We explain the NZTE via the synergistic contributions of lattice softening, rigid-unit tilting, and linkage-ion transverse vibrations to the negative Grüneisen parameters. The stuffing of the zinc blende-based lattice provides a chemical way of tuning the linkage-ion transverse modes, thus controlling the thermal expansion in order to obtain NZTE.
title_zh: 金刚石类材料中通过填充调控动力学实现宽温区近零热膨胀
abstract_zh: 摘要 近零热膨胀（NZTE）材料对于光学仪器和航空航天部件等新兴精密技术至关重要。然而，在宽温度范围内具有稳健性能的现有材料十分有限，尤其是在寻求除NZTE之外的功能特性时更是如此。我们报道了一项数据驱动的材料设计研究，发现锌 blende 结构是获得NZTE并阐明其 underlying 晶体化学原理的极佳平台。基于此，我们引入了空位工程和填隙原子掺入，得到一系列立方四元硫属化合物 AM3M′X4，其中连接离子的振动被系统性调控。我们发现 NaAg3TiS4、NaAg3TiSe4 和 RbAg3TiSe4 是有前景的NZTE候选材料，其在较宽温度窗口（300–600 K）内的热膨胀系数低于 2 × 10–6 K–1。这些是不同于低热膨胀氧化物的半导体材料。我们通过晶格软化、刚性单元倾转和连接离子横向振动对负 Grüneisen 参数的协同贡献来解释NZTE。基于锌 blende 晶格的填充提供了一种调控连接离子横向模式的化学途径，从而控制热膨胀以获得NZTE。

title: Electrode Potential in Ionic Liquid Enlightened by Liquid Madelung Theory
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Electrode potentials in electrolytes vary systematically with salt concentration, yet establishing a quantitative connection between electrolyte structure and electrode potential remains a longstanding challenge. Here, we demonstrate that the liquid Madelung energy─an atomistically resolved Coulombic descriptor obtained from simulations of all constituent molecules and ions─quantitatively accounts for electrode-potential shifts observed for the solvent-based and ionic liquid electrolytes investigated in the present study, the latter representing the concentrated limit. Decomposition of the Li+ electrostatic energy into contributions from surrounding species reveals two key electrostatic factors governing the potential shift: reduced electrostatic stabilization arising from Li+–anion coordination in the first coordination shell and enhanced Li+–Li+ repulsion emerging in the second coordination shell at high concentrations. This atomistic framework captures structural fluctuations inaccessible to classical Debye–Hückel and pseudo-lattice theories, and can be applied to ionic liquids exhibiting apparent nanoscale heterogeneity. These results demonstrate that the liquid Madelung framework can be extended from conventional solvent-based to ionic liquid electrolytes and provide an atomistic electrostatic perspective for the rational design of next-generation electrolytes composed of complex polyatomic species.
title_zh: 离子液体中的电极电位由液体Madelung理论阐明
abstract_zh: 摘要 电极在电解质中的电位随盐浓度系统性变化，但在电解质结构与电极电位之间建立定量联系仍是一个长期存在的挑战。在此，我们证明液态 Madelung 能量——一种通过对所有组成分子和离子进行模拟获得的原子级分辨的库仑描述符——能够定量解释本研究中考察的溶剂基和离子液体电解质（后者代表浓度极限）所观测到的电极电位偏移。将 Li+ 的静电能量分解为周围物种的贡献，揭示了控制电位偏移的两个关键静电因素：第一配位壳层中 Li+–阴离子配位导致的静电稳定化减弱，以及高浓度下第二配位壳层中出现的增强的 Li+–Li+ 排斥。这一原子级框架捕捉了经典 Debye–Hückel 和伪晶格理论无法涉及的结构涨落，并可应用于表现出明显纳米尺度不均匀性的离子液体。这些结果表明，液态 Madelung 框架可以从传统的溶剂基电解质扩展到离子液体电解质，并为由复杂多原子物种组成的下一代电解质的合理设计提供原子级静电视角。

title: Group Transfer Radical Polymerization of Sulfone-Substituted Aliphatic Alkynes
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Radical homopolymerization of aliphatic alkynes remains a formidable challenge, primarily because the high reactivity of propagating vinyl radicals renders inevitable chain transfer via hydrogen atom transfer kinetically more favorable than chain propagation. By harnessing rationally designed distal sulfone-substituted aliphatic alkynes as monomers, here we report an efficient radical homopolymerization of aliphatic alkynes via 1,4-group transfer, affording a series of new polymers with defined ABC-type sequence. DFT calculations reveal that the 1,4-group transfer plays a critical role in facilitating chain propagation. The resulting polymers further exhibit outstanding performance as binders for high-temperature proton-exchange membrane fuel cells. Furthermore, the polymers can be chemically degraded to yield a diversity of valuable crotylamines. This work achieves the elusive radical polymerization of aliphatic alkynes that is inaccessible by traditional methods, providing a promising platform for the development of functional polymers.
title_zh: 磺酰基取代脂肪族炔烃的基团转移自由基聚合
abstract_zh: 摘要 脂肪族炔烃的自由基均聚反应仍然是一项艰巨的挑战，主要原因是增长乙烯基自由基的高反应活性使得通过氢原子转移的链转移在动力学上不可避免地比链增长更有利。通过采用合理设计的带有远端磺酰基取代的脂肪族炔烃作为单体，我们在此报道了一种通过 1,4-基团转移的脂肪族炔烃高效自由基均聚反应，得到了一系列具有明确 ABC 型序列的新聚合物。DFT 计算表明，1,4-基团转移在促进链增长中起关键作用。所得聚合物作为高温质子交换膜燃料电池的粘结剂表现出优异的性能。此外，这些聚合物可被化学降解，产生多种有价值的巴豆胺。这项工作实现了传统方法无法实现的脂肪族炔烃的自由基聚合，为功能聚合物的开发提供了一个有前景的平台。

title: Simultaneous Site- and Residue-Specific Incorporation of Fluorinated Amino Acids for In-Cell Structural Biology by 19F Magic Angle Spinning NMR Spectroscopy
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Magic-angle spinning (MAS) nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy is uniquely positioned to yield atomic-level structural and dynamic information on large proteins and protein assemblies in cellular environments. Yet, in-cell MAS NMR applications using the most common biomolecular reporter nuclei-1H, 13C, and 15N-remain hampered by a large cellular background, inherently low sensitivity, and limited resolution. In contrast, 19F is a high-receptivity nucleus that is naturally absent in biological molecules and is an excellent probe for in-cell MAS NMR. Here, we report a 19F-labeling strategy that combines site-specific incorporation of 4-(trifluoromethyl)-l-phenylalanine (tfmF) via genetic code expansion with fluorination of all tryptophan residues at the 7 position of the indole ring. We apply this approach to the N-terminal domain of the nucleocapsid protein from SARS-CoV-2, NNTD. For a microcrystalline 7F-Trp,tfmF28,U–15N–NNTD sample, 19F–19F correlations between the CF3 group of the tfmF and the F atoms of the three 7F-Trp residues are detected in 2D dipolar-based experiments, spanning a distance range from 10 to 21 Å. Additionally, for 7F-Trp,tfmF28,U–15N–NNTD electroporated into A2780 cells, the increased spectral resolution and sensitivity afforded by the incorporation of the CF3 group enable the acquisition of high-quality 19F in-cell MAS NMR spectra within a few hours. The simultaneous labeling with an aromatic fluorine atom and a CF3 group expands the toolbox of 19F MAS NMR for cellular structural biology.
title_zh: 通过19F魔角旋转NMR波谱实现氟化氨基酸的位点与残基特异性同时掺入用于细胞内结构生物学研究
abstract_zh: 摘要 魔角旋转（MAS）核磁共振（NMR）波谱技术在获取细胞环境中大分子蛋白质和蛋白质组装体的原子级结构和动力学信息方面具有独特优势。然而，使用最常见的生物分子报告核——1H、13C 和 15N——的胞内 MAS NMR 应用仍然受到细胞背景信号强、固有灵敏度低和分辨率有限的阻碍。相比之下，19F 是一种高灵敏度（receptivity）原子核，天然不存在于生物分子中，是胞内 MAS NMR 的极佳探针。在此，我们报道了一种 19F 标记策略，将通过遗传密码扩展进行的 4-(三氟甲基)-l-苯丙氨酸（tfmF）的位点特异性掺入与所有色氨酸残基吲哚环 7 位的氟化相结合。我们将该方法应用于 SARS-CoV-2 核衣壳蛋白的 N 端结构域 NNTD。对于微晶 7F-Trp,tfmF28,U–15N–NNTD 样品，在二维偶极实验中检测到 tfmF 的 CF3 基团与三个 7F-Trp 残基的 F 原子之间的 19F–19F 相关性，距离范围为 10 至 21 Å。此外，对于电穿孔进入 A2780 细胞的 7F-Trp,tfmF28,U–15N–NNTD，CF3 基团的掺入所提供的更高波谱分辨率和灵敏度使得可在数小时内获得高质量的 19F 胞内 MAS NMR 波谱。芳香氟原子与 CF3 基团的同时标记拓展了用于细胞结构生物学的 19F MAS NMR 工具箱。

title: Digital Nanopore Counting Enabling Direct Identification of Trace-Level Neoantigens in Native Biological Samples
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Tumor-specific neoantigens have been the most promising targets for TCR-based cancer therapies; however, their detection is greatly hindered by low abundance, sequence variability, and potential modifications. To address these, we developed a digital nanopore framework to unambiguously identify and effectively quantify candidate neoantigens directly in cell samples via event-resolved molecular identification and counting. By engineering a multirecognition-region nanopore and developing a universal water-osmosis driving force, we simultaneously enhanced the detection throughput and specificity. Combined with enriched current signatures and a gradient-boosting decision-tree classifier, the platform identifies individual ovalbumin-derived model neoantigens with single-amino-acid resolution from digitally assigned events in both exogenously incubated and endogenously expressed cell samples. We show that the limit of quantification is improved to the fmol level in native biological environments, enabling the direct identification of neoantigens from as few as 5000 cells within 30 min. We further demonstrate the identification of a native Epstein–Barr virus-associated neoantigen, highlighting the potential of this approach in ultrasensitive analysis of rare biomolecular species directly in biological samples.
title_zh: 数字纳米孔计数实现对天然生物样品中痕量水平新抗原的直接鉴定
abstract_zh: 摘要 肿瘤特异性新抗原一直是基于 TCR 的癌症疗法最具前景的靶点；然而，其检测因丰度低、序列可变性和潜在修饰而受到极大阻碍。为解决这些问题，我们开发了一种数字纳米孔框架，通过事件分辨的分子识别和计数，直接在细胞样品中明确鉴定并有效定量候选新抗原。通过设计多识别区纳米孔并开发一种通用的水渗透驱动力，我们同时提高了检测通量和特异性。结合丰富的电流特征和梯度提升决策树分类器，该平台可在外源孵育和内源表达的细胞样品中，从数字分配的事件中以单氨基酸分辨率鉴定单个卵清蛋白来源的模型新抗原。我们表明，定量限在天然生物环境中改善至 fmol 水平，从而能够在 30 分钟内从少至 5000 个细胞中直接鉴定新抗原。我们进一步展示了一种天然 Epstein–Barr 病毒相关新抗原的鉴定，凸显了该方法在生物样品中直接超灵敏分析稀有生物分子物种的潜力。

title: The Obligate Mutualism in Metal Nanoclusters
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Metal nanoclusters have garnered significant attention owing to their unique physicochemical properties. However, the synthesis of reduced, reactive metal-based nanoclusters, such as reduced Ni nanoclusters, remains challenging because of their intrinsic instability. Herein, we first reported ambient-stable, reduced Ni nanoclusters by subtly engineering the protecting ligands, and particularly revealed a previously unrecognized stabilization mechanism in which two Ni nanoclusters, each difficult to isolate individually, are stabilized through coexistence. Remarkably, the paired clusters remain stable in both the solid and solution phases and exhibit interdependent stability reminiscent of obligate mutualism in biological systems. This finding suggests that weak intercluster interactions can be harnessed to engineer mutually stabilized assemblies, providing access to metal nanoclusters that would otherwise be unattainable. Further studies reveal that the two nanoclusters play complementary catalytic roles and synergistically promote nitrate reduction. Hydrogen spillover between the paired clusters facilitates catalytic turnover, resulting in markedly enhanced activity relative to the individual nanoclusters. These results demonstrate that nanocluster supra-assembly, beyond the specific case of obligate mutualism, can simultaneously enhance stability and functionality. More broadly, this work establishes intercluster assembly as a general strategy for accessing, stabilizing, and optimizing atomically precise nanoclusters, opening new opportunities for the rational design of advanced catalytic systems.
title_zh: 金属纳米团簇中的专性互利共生
abstract_zh: 摘要 金属纳米团簇因其独特的物理化学性质而受到广泛关注。然而，由于固有的不稳定性，还原态、高反应活性金属基纳米团簇（如还原态 Ni 纳米团簇）的合成仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们首次通过巧妙设计保护配体报道了环境稳定的还原态 Ni 纳米团簇，并特别揭示了一种此前未被认识的稳定化机制：两个各自难以单独分离的 Ni 纳米团簇通过共存而相互稳定。值得注意的是，该配对团簇在固相和溶液相中均保持稳定，并表现出类似于生物系统中专性互利共生的相互依存稳定性。这一发现表明，可以利用弱的团簇间相互作用来构建相互稳定的组装体，从而获得原本无法获得的金属纳米团簇。进一步研究表明，这两种纳米团簇发挥互补的催化作用，并协同促进硝酸盐还原。配对团簇之间的氢溢流促进了催化转化，使其活性相对于单个纳米团簇显著增强。这些结果表明，除专性互利共生这一特例外，纳米团簇超组装可以同时增强稳定性和功能性。更广泛地说，这项工作确立了团簇间组装作为一种获取、稳定和优化原子精确纳米团簇的通用策略，为合理设计开辟了新机遇。

title: Mapping the Chemical Space of TADF Sensitizers Coupled with Virtual Screening for Narrowband Hyperfluorescence OLEDs
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Developing efficient thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TADF) sensitizers for narrowband red hyperfluorescence organic light-emitting diodes (HF-OLEDs) remains a major challenge because long-wavelength sensitization requires the simultaneous optimization of a small singlet–triplet energy gap (ΔEST), a low singlet excited-state energy (ES1), and a high solid-state photoluminescence quantum yield (ΦPL). Unlike their successful blue and green counterparts, red HF-OLEDs are still largely reliant on noble-metal phosphorescent sensitizers. Here, we establish a donor–acceptor–linker chemical-space mapping framework coupled with virtual screening to enable the rapid discovery of metal-free TADF sensitizers suitable for narrowband red HF-OLEDs while circumventing conventional iterative trial-and-error molecular optimization. Screening a virtual library of 160 molecular architectures identifies linker topology, rather than donor–acceptor identity alone, as the key structural determinant of excited-state energetics, with the 1,8-disubstituted naphthalene scaffold emerging as a privileged motif that simultaneously minimizes ΔEST and ES1. Guided by these insights, a gram-scalable modular synthesis furnishes a family of peri-naphthalene-based, spatially confined through-space charge-transfer (TSCT) TADF sensitizers exhibiting emission maxima reaching 667 nm, ultralow ΔEST values below 0.01 eV, and solid-state ΦPL values of up to 98% through aggregation-induced emission (AIE). When paired with all-carbon polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon (PAH) emitters, these sensitizers deliver narrowband red HF-OLEDs with a maximum external quantum efficiency (EQE) of 27.6%, setting a benchmark for all-carbon PAH-based red HF-OLEDs. Moreover, the same TSCT platform is readily extendable to shorter-wavelength systems, as demonstrated by yellow PAH-based HF-OLEDs with an outstanding maximum EQE of 27.7%.
title_zh: TADF敏化剂化学空间构建结合虚拟筛选用于窄谱超荧光OLED
abstract_zh: 摘要 开发用于窄带红光超荧光有机发光二极管（HF-OLED）的高效热激活延迟荧光（TADF）敏化剂仍然是一项重大挑战，因为长波长敏化需要同时优化小的单重态–三重态能隙（ΔEST）、低单重态激发态能量（ES1）以及高固态光致发光量子产率（ΦPL）。与成功的蓝光和绿光 counterparts 不同，红光 HF-OLED 在很大程度上仍依赖于贵金属磷光敏化剂。在此，我们建立了供体–受体–连接基化学空间映射框架，并结合虚拟筛选，实现无金属 TADF 敏化剂的快速发现，适用于窄带红光 HF-OLED，同时避免了传统的迭代试错分子优化。对一个包含 160 种分子架构的虚拟库进行筛选，发现连接基拓扑结构（而非仅供体–受体身份）是激发态能量学的关键结构决定因素，其中 1,8-二取代萘骨架脱颖而出，成为同时最小化 ΔEST 和 ES1 的优势 motif。在这些见解的指导下，克级可扩展的模块化合成提供了一系列基于 peri-萘、空间限域的通过空间电荷转移（TSCT）TADF 敏化剂，其发射峰最高达 667 nm，超低 ΔEST 值低于 0.01 eV，并通过聚集诱导发光（AIE）实现高达 98% 的固态 ΦPL。与全碳多环芳烃（PAH）发射体配对时，这些敏化剂 del

title: Electrochemical Deoxygenation of a TiIV–Oxo Complex to Enable Catalytic Reductive Oxygen-Atom Transfer from Organic Molecules
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Well-defined (TTP)TiII (TTP = 5,10,15,20-tetratolylporphyrin) complexes have been shown to promote stoichiometric deoxygenation of organic molecules, such as sulfoxides and epoxides, forming a stable (TTP)TiIV=O product. Here, we explore strategies to promote catalytic deoxygenation reactivity by regenerating (TTP)TiII through chemical or electrochemical reduction. A survey of Lewis acids revealed the effectiveness of B(OPh)3 in promoting activation and loss of the Ti-oxo group, enabling TiII-mediated reductive oxygen-atom transfer (OAT) of diphenyl sulfoxide. Cyclic voltammetry, coulometry, EPR spectroscopy, and X-ray crystallography have been used to probe and characterize TiIII and TiII species from the electroreductive deoxygenation of the TiIV=O complex. The data implicate a Lewis-acid-coupled electron-transfer deoxygenation pathway for TiIV=O turnover. These fundamental studies are complemented by electrochemical reactions demonstrating catalytic reductive oxygen-atom transfer from sulfoxides, pyridine N-oxides, and epoxides.
title_zh: TiIV–氧基配合物的电化学脱氧以实现有机分子的催化还原氧原子转移
abstract_zh: 摘要 结构明确（TTP)TiII（TTP = 5,10,15,20-四甲苯基卟啉）配合物已被证明可促进有机分子（如亚砜和环氧化物）的化学计量脱氧反应，生成稳定的 (TTP)TiIV=O 产物。在此，我们探索通过化学或电化学还原再生 (TTP)TiII 以促进催化脱氧反应活性的策略。对 Lewis 酸的调研表明 B(OPh)3 在促进 Ti-氧代基团的活化与脱除方面具有良好效果，实现了 TiII 介导的二苯基亚砜还原性氧原子转移（OAT）。采用循环伏安法、库仑法、EPR 波谱和 X 射线晶体学对 TiIV=O 配合物电还原脱氧过程中产生的 TiIII 和 TiII 物种进行了探测与表征。数据表明 TiIV=O 周转遵循 Lewis 酸耦合电子转移脱氧路径。这些基础研究还辅以电化学反应，展示了来自亚砜、吡啶 N-氧化物和环氧化物的催化还原性氧原子转移。

title: Native Proteomics Reveals Protease-Mediated Hemophore Release by Bacterial Pathogens
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Iron is an essential micronutrient for nearly all forms of life, including pathogenic microbes that must acquire it from their host during infection. At the host–pathogen interface, humans restrict microbial access to iron through nutritional immunity, which many pathogens overcome by secreting hemophores that scavenge extracellular heme (iron protoporphyrin IX). However, identifying hemophores and other ligand-binding proteoforms in complex proteomes remains challenging using conventional peptide-based bottom-up mass spectrometry (MS). Here, we introduce ProteoMIX (Proteome Analysis by Mixing), a function-based native top-down proteomics workflow that combines slow-mixing mode native MS with charge reduction to identify ligand-binding proteoforms directly from complex mixtures. Applying ProteoMIX to the Corynebacterium diphtheriae exoproteome identified ChtA30–314, an abundant soluble hemophore generated by proteolytic processing of the surface-exposed ChtA heme receptor. Using native top-down MS sequencing, cell fractionation, and gene deletion, we show that the protease DIP2069 releases ChtA30–314 by removing ChtA’s transmembrane helix, producing a soluble proteoform that delivers heme to support microbial growth. In contrast, the related paralog ChtC is not processed, enabling C. diphtheriae to generate localization-specific heme-binding proteoforms from related gene products. Extending this approach to Staphylococcus aureus, ProteoMIX also revealed soluble IsdA hemophores that coexist with surface-anchored variants, demonstrating the generality of the method and suggesting that protease-mediated hemophore release may operate across Gram-positive pathogens.
title_zh: 天然蛋白质组学揭示细菌病原体通过蛋白酶介导的血红素结合蛋白释放
abstract_zh: 摘要 铁是几乎所有生命形式所必需的微量元素，包括在感染期间必须从宿主获取铁的病原微生物。在宿主–病原体界面，人类通过营养免疫限制微生物获取铁，而许多病原体通过分泌清除胞外血红素（铁原卟啉 IX）的血红素结合蛋白（hemophore）来克服这一限制。然而，利用传统的基于肽段的自下而上质谱（MS）技术在复杂蛋白质组中鉴定 hemophore 和其他配体结合蛋白型仍具挑战性。在此，我们介绍 ProteoMIX（通过混合的蛋白质组分析），这是一种基于功能的天然自上而下蛋白质组学工作流程，将慢混合模式天然 MS 与电荷还原相结合，可直接从复杂混合物中鉴定配体结合蛋白型。将 ProteoMIX 应用于白喉棒杆菌（Corynebacterium diphtheriae）外泌蛋白质组，鉴定到 ChtA30–314——一种由表面暴露的 ChtA 血红素受体经蛋白水解加工生成的丰富的可溶性 hemophore。通过天然自上而下 MS 测序、细胞分级分离和基因敲除，我们证明蛋白酶 DIP2069 通过去除 ChtA 的跨膜螺旋释放 ChtA30–314，产生可溶性蛋白型，递送血红素以支持微生物生长。相比之下，相关旁系同源蛋白 ChtC 不被加工，使 C. diphtheriae 能够从相关基因产物生成定位特异性的血红素结合蛋白型。将该方法扩展到金黄色葡萄球菌（Staphylococcus aureus），ProteoMIX 还揭示了与表面锚定变体共存的可溶性 IsdA hemophore，证明了该方法的通用性

title: Integrating Molecular Extrusion and Antisolvent Bathing: Methoxy Number as a Key Parameter for Self-Assembled Monolayers in Perovskite Solar Cells
abstract: Abstract We directly incorporate self-assembled monolayers (SAM) into the perovskite precursor. Combined with antisolvent bathing, this approach enables one-step in situ molecular extrusion. By tuning the number of methoxy groups, we find that the mono-methoxy molecule 1MeO-4PACz exhibits optimal energy level alignment (HOMO = –5.36 eV), strong interfacial adhesion, and guides orderly perovskite crystallization, achieving an excellent balance between bulk and interfacial defects. The one-step device yields a power conversion efficiency of 22.35% and retains 90% of its initial efficiency after 1700 h in N2. In contrast, the tetra-methoxy molecule 4MeO-4PACz suffers from excessively strong coordination, becoming embedded in the bulk during crystallization and leading to increased defect density, resulting in a low efficiency of 6.87%. Two-step comparisons reveal the specific selectivity of the one-step process for molecular configuration. This work provides new insights into the design of SAM molecules toward scalable manufacturing.
title_zh: 分子挤出与反溶剂浴相结合：甲氧基数目作为钙钛矿太阳能电池自组装单分子层的关键参数
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们将自组装单分子层（SAM）直接掺入钙钛矿前驱体中。结合反溶剂浴处理，该方法实现了一步法原位分子挤出。通过调节甲氧基数量，我们发现单甲氧基分子 1MeO-4PACz 表现出最佳的能级对齐（HOMO = –5.36 eV）、强界面粘附，并引导钙钛矿有序结晶，在体相缺陷和界面缺陷之间实现了极佳的平衡。一步法制备的器件功率转换效率达 22.35%，并在 N2 中放置 1700 h 后保持初始效率的 90%。相比之下，四甲氧基分子 4MeO-4PACz 由于配位过强，在结晶过程中嵌入体相，导致缺陷密度增加，效率仅为 6.87%。两步法对比揭示了一步法对分子构型的特异性选择。这项工作为面向可扩展制造的 SAM 分子设计提供了新见解。

title: Eco-Friendly Charge-Trapping Memory Transistors with Balanced Rewritability for Neuromorphic Computing
abstract: Abstract Sustainable memory devices that combine reliable multilevel data storage, stable synaptic-weight modulation, and environmentally responsive degradability are increasingly needed for next-generation Internet of Things, wearable, and data-centric electronics, where rapid device replacement cycles continue to intensify electronic-waste concerns. Charge-trapping memory transistors offer an attractive platform for this purpose owing to their multilevel memory operation through modulation of trapped charge density and excellent retention characteristics, both of which are essential for preserving programmed conductance states in neuromorphic computing. However, previously reported biodegradable and bio-derived memory and synaptic transistors have mainly been limited in their practical neuromorphic applicability because of write-once-read-many behavior, insufficient retention, or unbalanced rewritable operation. Therefore, biodegradable and eco-friendly charge-trapping memory transistor platforms that integrate electrically rewritable non-volatile memory operation with balanced synaptic-weight modulation remain largely unexplored for their applicability to practical memory and neuromorphic computing systems. Here, we report a biodegradable charge-trapping memory transistor based on an optimized blended charge-trap layer composed of carboxymethyl cellulose sodium salt (CMC), a biodegradable polymer, and tannic acid (TA), a plant-derived polyphenolic molecule. CMC and TA exhibit charge-trapping behavior with different dominant tendencies toward electron and hole trapping, respectively, enabling their bias-dependent trapping contributions to be balanced by controlling the blending ratio. The optimized CMC (88%):TA (12%) charge-trap layer, combined with a tunneling layer, enables repetitive and well-balanced electrical program/erase operation, stable retention with a memory on/off current ratio exceeding 103 for 1000 s, and improved transistor switching characteristics. The resulting stable multilevel conductance modulation supports reversible potentiation and depression, which are implemented as synaptic weights in a hardware neural-network simulation for handwritten-digit recognition, achieving an accuracy comparable to the ideal software system. Moreover, the biodegradable charge-trap layer undergoes water-triggered dissolution in deionized water, leading to rapid loss of device integrity after immersion. These findings represent a significant step toward biodegradable charge-trapping memory transistors that simultaneously enable stable non-volatile retention, balanced synaptic-weight modulation, and environmentally responsive degradability for sustainable neuromorphic electronics.
title_zh: 具有平衡可重写性的环保型电荷俘获存储晶体管用于神经形态计算
abstract_zh: 摘要 对于下一代物联网、可穿戴和以数据为中心的电子器件而言，兼具可靠多级数据存储、稳定突触权重调制和环境响应降解性的可持续存储器件的需求日益增长，因为快速的器件更换周期持续加剧电子垃圾问题。电荷俘获存储晶体管因通过调制俘获电荷密度实现多级存储操作以及优异的保持特性而成为实现这一目标的理想平台，这两者对于在神经形态计算中保持编程电导状态都至关重要。然而，此前报道的可生物降解和生物衍生存储及突触晶体管由于一次写入多次读取行为、保持特性不足或可重写操作不平衡，在实用神经形态应用方面主要受到限制。因此，将电可重写的非易失性存储操作与平衡的突触权重调制相结合的可生物降解、环保的电荷俘获存储晶体管平台，在实用存储和神经形态计算系统中的应用性仍在很大程度上未被探索。在此，我们报道了一种可生物降解的电荷俘获存储晶体管，其基于由羧甲基纤维素钠盐（CMC，一种可生物降解聚合物）和单宁酸（TA，一种植物来源的多酚分子）组成的优化共混电荷俘获层。CMC 和 TA 表现出电荷俘获行为，且对电子和空穴俘获的主导倾向不同，r

title: Colossal Permittivity and Ferroelectricity in TiO2-Based Ceramics Induced by Defect Clusters
abstract: Abstract The substitution of donor–acceptor ion pairs in metal oxides creates local chemically unstable states, thereby altering properties and even generating functions unattainable in the host materials. Herein, ferroelectricity and colossal permittivity responses are co-evoked in rutile TiO2 ceramics via the donor–acceptor (Nb5+–Mg2+) ionic pairs co-doping strategy. The large ionic radii of the acceptor Mg2+ ions and donor Nb5+ ions replacing Ti4+ ions disrupt the local chemical stability states and induce lattice strain. Defect clusters formed by localized chemical valence imbalance undergo polarization, generating a local built-in electric field. This electric field drives the long-range ordered arrangement of defect clusters, endowing the co-doped TiO2 ceramics with room-temperature ferroelectricity. Furthermore, defect clusters and the local electric field also restrict the long-range migration of charge carriers, enabling the Nb5+–Mg2+ pairs co-doped TiO2 ceramics to achieve a high dielectric constant (ε′ = 40,000) while maintaining an acceptably low loss (tan δ = 0.063). This work proposes an approach for designing centrosymmetric oxides with combined ferroelectric and giant dielectric properties, offering excellent application prospects for multifunctional microelectronic components.
title_zh: 缺陷簇诱导的TiO2基陶瓷的巨介电常数与铁电性
abstract_zh: 摘要 在金属氧化物中取代供体–受体离子对会产生局部化学不稳定态，从而改变材料性质，甚至产生主体材料无法实现的功能。在此，我们通过供体–受体（Nb5+–Mg2+）离子对共掺杂策略，在金红石 TiO2 陶瓷中共同诱发铁电性和巨介电响应。受体 Mg2+ 离子和取代 Ti4+ 离子的供体 Nb5+ 离子的大离子半径破坏了局部化学稳定态并引起晶格应变。由局部化学价不平衡形成的缺陷团簇发生极化，产生局部内建电场。该电场驱动缺陷团簇的长程有序排列，赋予共掺杂 TiO2 陶瓷室温铁电性。此外，缺陷团簇和局部电场还限制了电荷载流子的长程迁移，使 Nb5+–Mg2+ 对共掺杂的 TiO2 陶瓷在保持可接受低损耗（tan δ = 0.063）的同时实现了高介电常数（ε′ = 40,000）。这项工作提出了一种设计兼具铁电和巨介电性能的中心对称氧化物的方法，为多功能微电子元件提供了出色的应用前景。

title: High-Performance CeO2-Doped SrTiO3 Nanocomposite Films for Electrostatic Energy Storage and Integrated Optical Transparency
abstract: Abstract This study demonstrates the design and realization of high-performance, transparent electrostatic energy storage film capacitors by integrating optical functionalities via a nanostructural engineering approach. A series of (1 – x)SrTiO3-xCeO2 [(1 – x)STO-xC, 0.0 ≤ x ≤ 0.5] films were grown on highly transparent (La0.03Ba0.97)SnO3 buffer electrode layers using pulsed laser deposition. The incorporation of CeO2 as a heterogeneous second phase generates lattice-mismatch-associated interfacial strain and structural heterogeneity, thereby transforming the nearly linear dielectric response of STO into a slim nonlinear polarization response with enhanced maximum polarization and low remanent polarization. The (1 – x)STO-xC films with x = 0.4 and 0.5 exhibit exceptional electrostatic energy storage performance, attaining a high recoverable energy density of up to 50 ± 3 J/cm3 and an ultrahigh efficiency of ∼90%. These films simultaneously maintain a high optical transmittance of ∼75% across the visible to near-infrared spectrum with a tunable optical bandgap. These films demonstrate robust frequency reliability from 20 Hz to 5 kHz and thermal stability from 25 to 120 °C. Notably, these lead-free (1 – x)STO-xC films comprise merely four elements (Sr, Ti, O, and Ce). This work establishes a viable strategy for fabricating a simplified-composition, multifunctional film that simultaneously delivers superior energy storage capability and high optical transparency, advancing their integration into next-generation transparent optoelectronic systems.
title_zh: 用于静电储能兼具光学透明集成的高性能CeO2掺杂SrTiO3纳米复合薄膜
abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究展示了一种通过纳米结构工程方法集成光学功能的高性能透明静电储能薄膜电容器的设计与实现。采用脉冲激光沉积法在高度透明的(La0.03Ba0.97)SnO3缓冲电极层上生长了一系列(1 – x)SrTiO3-xCeO2[(1 – x)STO-xC，0.0 ≤ x ≤ 0.5]薄膜。CeO2作为异质第二相的引入产生了与晶格失配相关的界面应变和结构非均质性，从而将STO的近线性介电响应转变为具有增强最大极化和低剩余极化的细瘦非线性极化响应。x = 0.4和0.5的(1 – x)STO-xC薄膜表现出卓越的静电储能性能，实现了高达50 ± 3 J/cm3的高可回收能量密度和约90%的超高效率。这些薄膜同时在可见光至近红外光谱范围内保持约75%的高透射率，并具有可调的光学带隙。这些薄膜表现出从20 Hz到5 kHz的稳健频率可靠性以及从25到120 °C的热稳定性。值得注意的是，这些无铅(1 – x)STO-xC薄膜仅由四种元素(Sr、Ti、O和Ce)组成。这项工作为制备同时具有卓越储能能力和高光学透明度的简化组分多功能薄膜确立了一种可行策略，推动了它们在下一代透明光电子系统中的集成应用。

title: Stochastic Damping Control Strategy for Wind Power Grid-Connected Systems Based on Itô-Moment Optimization
abstract: The stochastic variability of wind speed introduces significant challenges to the damping of low-frequency oscillations in power systems with high wind power penetration. To address this issue, this paper proposes a variable-gain wide-area supplementary damping control (VG-WSDC) strategy for grid-connected wind power systems, in which the controller gain is adaptively adjusted according to wind-speed fluctuations. An Itô-moment optimization (IMO) framework is employed to account for wind-speed stochasticity by reformulating stochastic damping performance requirements into a deterministic optimization problem based on low-order statistical moments. The proposed approach enables the simultaneous enhancement of critical mode damping and reduction of damping ratio variability under stochastic operating conditions. Simulation studies demonstrate that the proposed VG-WSDC effectively suppresses inter-area low-frequency oscillations and improves small-signal stability robustness in the presence of wind-speed uncertainty.
title_zh: 基于Itô矩优化的风电并网系统随机阻尼控制策略
abstract_zh: 风速的随机变异性给高风电渗透率电力系统中低频振荡的阻尼带来了重大挑战。为解决这一问题，本文提出了一种用于并网风电系统的变增益广域附加阻尼控制(VG-WSDC)策略，其中控制器增益根据风速波动自适应调整。采用Itô矩优化(IMO)框架，通过基于低阶统计矩将随机阻尼性能要求重新表述为确定性优化问题，以考虑风速的随机性。所提方法能够在随机运行条件下同时增强临界模式阻尼并降低阻尼比的变异性。仿真研究表明，所提出的VG-WSDC在风速不确定性存在的情况下能有效抑制区域间低频振荡并提高小干扰稳定性鲁棒性。

title: Control Design Impacts of Grid-Forming STATCOMs for Wind Farm Systems: Weak-Grid Integration and Stabilizing Effects
abstract: Grid-forming (GFM) control-based converters such as static compensators (STATCOM) are considered as promising solutions for their system support characteristics and robustness against weak grid conditions. Contrary to common belief, GFM converters can also exhibit weak-grid instability, and it is unclear to what extent they stabilize the network. This paper investigates how control design affects both the stable integration of GFM converters into weak grids and their resulting stabilizing effects on the interconnected power system, with particular emphasis on wind farm integration. The analysis reveals that weak-grid stability and system-level stabilization critically depend on the adopted control structure rather than on the grid-forming concept itself. This highlights the necessity of adopting different control design approaches for grid-following (GFL) and GFM converters by demonstrating the opposite effects of voltage feed-forward (VFF) action in the current controller on weak-grid stability. The influences of key GFM converter parameters, such as virtual impedance (VI), are analyzed in terms of passivity for stable integration into weak grids. Their impact on the frequency-dependent power flow Jacobian (FD-JB) is also evaluated for system stabilizing effects. The case studies confirm the findings that although the passivity approach is effective for the converter itself, the resulting stabilizing effect on the complete system can be different depending on its control design.
title_zh: 构网型STATCOM对风电场系统的控制设计影响：弱电网集成与稳定效果
abstract_zh: 基于构网型(GFM)控制的变换器，如静止无功补偿器(STATCOM)，因其系统支撑特性和对弱电网条件的鲁棒性而被视为有前景的解决方案。与普遍看法相反，GFM变换器也可能出现弱电网不稳定问题，且它们对网络的稳定化程度尚不明确。本文研究了控制设计如何影响GFM变换器在弱电网中的稳定集成及其对互联电力系统的稳定化效果，并特别关注风电场并网。分析表明，弱电网稳定性和系统级稳定化关键取决于所采用的控制结构，而非构网概念本身。通过论证电流控制器中电压前馈(VFF)作用对弱电网稳定性的相反影响，本文强调了针对跟网型(GFL)和GFM变换器采用不同控制设计方法的必要性。从无源性角度分析了虚拟阻抗(VI)等关键GFM变换器参数对稳定集成到弱电网中的影响，并评估了其对频变潮流雅可比矩阵(FD-JB)的影响以考察系统稳定化效果。案例研究证实了以下发现：尽管无源性方法对变换器本身有效，但其对完整系统的稳定化效果可能因控制设计的不同而有所差异。

title: Emergency-Aware and Frequency-Constrained HVDC Planning for a Multi-Area Asynchronously Interconnected Grid
abstract: High-voltage direct current (HVDC) technology has played a crucial role for long-distance transmission of renewable power generation. However, the integration of large-capacity HVDC lines introduces significant frequency security challenges during HVDC fault emergencies. This paper proposes an emergency-aware and frequency-constrained HVDC planning method to optimize the capacity of inter-area HVDC tie-lines in a multi-area asynchronously interconnected grid. Firstly, a coordinated emergency frequency control scheme is proposed to allocate the emergency control resources during HVDC faults. Then, an enhanced system frequency response model integrating event-driven emergency frequency control is developed and a weighted oblique decision tree approach is employed to extract frequency nadir security constraints. The proposed planning model considers all potential HVDC fault emergencies while treating candidate HVDC capacities as decision variables. Simulation results demonstrate superior performance in balancing economic efficiency with frequency security requirements, providing a practical solution for inter-area HVDC planning.
title_zh: 面向多区域异步互联电网的紧急感知与频率约束HVDC规划
abstract_zh: 高压直流(HVDC)技术在可再生电力发电的长距离输电中发挥了关键作用。然而，大容量HVDC线路的接入在HVDC故障紧急情况下带来了显著的频率安全挑战。本文提出了一种考虑紧急情况和频率约束的HVDC规划方法，以优化多区域异步互联电网中区域间HVDC联络线的容量。首先，提出了一种协调紧急频率控制方案，用于在HVDC故障期间分配紧急控制资源。然后，建立了集成事件驱动紧急频率控制的增强型系统频率响应模型，并采用加权倾斜决策树方法提取频率最低点安全约束。所提规划模型考虑所有潜在的HVDC故障紧急情况，同时将候选HVDC容量作为决策变量。仿真结果表明该方法在平衡经济性与频率安全需求方面具有优越性能，为区域间HVDC规划提供了实用解决方案。

title: Construction of molecular fans in metal-organic framework to overcome diffusion resistance for trace benzene capture
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Molecular size-matched pores of adsorbents provide strong adsorptive forces for benzene, but high diffusion resistance. Overcoming the diffusion resistance within molecular size-matched pores is essential to efficient capture of trace benzene from indoor air or industrial exhaust gas, but challenging. Herein, we report a stable Fe-based metal-organic framework (ZJU-701) featuring hierarchical micropores (5.8 ± 0.9, 10.2 ± 2.3, and 21.2 ± 1.4 Å) and molecular fans with 1,4-naphthylene as rotors between micropores. ZJU-701 shows adsorption rate constant of 5.84 × 10⁻3 min⁻¹ and adsorption capacity of 2.05 mmol g⁻¹ for benzene at P/P0 = 0.001 and 298 K, surpassing other benchmark adsorbents. Strikingly, ZJU-701 exhibits only 10.1% loss of dynamic adsorption capacity for trace benzene as the gas velocity increases from 0.03 to 0.12 m·s⁻¹, much lower than other benchmark adsorbents (30.6% ~ 76.9%). The rapid adsorption of benzene is attributed to the rotational motion of molecular fans in ZJU-701, verified by in-situ Infrared/Raman Spectroscopy and solid-state NMR. This work highlights a dynamic pore-engineering strategy with molecular fans to alleviate diffusion resistance within molecular size-matched pores and balance adsorption rate and capacity for trace gas capture.
title_zh: 在金属有机框架中构建分子风扇以克服扩散阻力实现痕量苯捕获
abstract_zh: 吸附剂中与分子尺寸匹配的孔对苯具有强吸附力，但扩散阻力较高。克服分子尺寸匹配孔内的扩散阻力对于从室内空气或工业废气中高效捕集痕量苯至关重要，但也极具挑战性。本文报道了一种稳定的铁基金属有机框架(ZJU-701)，其具有分级微孔(5.8 ± 0.9、10.2 ± 2.3和21.2 ± 1.4 Å)以及以1,4-亚萘基为转子、位于微孔之间的分子风扇。在P/P0 = 0.001和298 K条件下，ZJU-701对苯的吸附速率常数为5.84 × 10⁻3 min⁻¹，吸附容量为2.05 mmol g⁻¹，超越了其他基准吸附剂。引人注目的是，当气流速度从0.03增加到0.12 m·s⁻¹时，ZJU-701对痕量苯的动态吸附容量仅损失10.1%，远低于其他基准吸附剂(30.6% ~ 76.9%)。苯的快速吸附归因于ZJU-701中分子风扇的旋转运动，并通过原位红外/拉曼光谱和固体核磁共振进行了验证。这项工作突出了一种利用分子风扇的动态孔工程策略，可缓解分子尺寸匹配孔内的扩散阻力，并平衡痕量气体捕集的吸附速率与容量。

title: Topological valley quasi-bound states in the continuum for radiatively accessible robust transport
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Topological valley photonics enables on-chip light transport robust against backscattering, but valley edge states typically lie outside the light cone and cannot be directly excited from free space. Existing devices with radiative functionality mainly exploit on-chip–to–free-space emission through strongly leaky modes, where enhanced radiative coupling compromises transport performance. Achieving free-space–to–on-chip excitation while preserving low-loss topological transport therefore remains a challenge. Here, we experimentally demonstrate topological valley quasi-bound states in the continuum (QBICs) in terahertz valley photonic crystals. By introducing geometric modulation and Brillouin-zone folding, valley edge states are folded into the light cone and transformed into topological valley QBICs with controllable radiative coupling while preserving robust valley transport. Using time-domain terahertz near-field imaging, we directly visualize their transport and demonstrate tunable propagation lengths together with robust transport through sharp bends. We further realize on-chip routing functionalities based on splitter and junction architectures, illustrating free-space–to–on-chip excitation and subsequent signal processing. Our work establishes topological valley QBICs as a platform for interfacing free-space radiation with low-loss topological transport, opening new opportunities for integrated terahertz devices.
title_zh: 基于连续域中拓扑谷型准束缚态的辐射可及鲁棒传输
abstract_zh: 拓扑谷光子学实现了对背向散射具有鲁棒性的片上光传输，但谷边缘态通常位于光锥之外，无法从自由空间直接激发。现有的具有辐射功能的器件主要利用强泄漏模式实现片上到自由空间的发射，其中增强的辐射耦合会损害传输性能。因此，在保持低损耗拓扑传输的同时实现自由空间到片上的激发仍然是一项挑战。本文在太赫兹谷光子晶体中实验演示了拓扑谷连续域准束缚态(QBICs)。通过引入几何调制和布里渊区折叠，谷边缘态被折叠进光锥并转变为拓扑谷QBICs，在保持鲁棒谷传输的同时实现可控的辐射耦合。利用时域太赫兹近场成像，我们直接观察了其传输过程，展示了可调的传播长度以及穿过尖锐弯折的鲁棒传输。我们进一步基于分束器和结型架构实现了片上路由功能，展示了自由空间到片上的激发及后续信号处理。我们的工作确立了拓扑谷QBICs作为连接自由空间辐射与低损耗拓扑传输的平台，为集成太赫兹器件开辟了新机遇。

title: Proton signal enhancement of three orders of magnitude in high-field liquid-state NMR
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Dissolution-dynamic nuclear polarization (d-DNP) is a hyperpolarization technique that is used to enhance the sensitivity of liquid-state nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) in biophysical and chemical applications. D-DNP is used widely for the sensitivity enhancement of hetero-nuclei such as 13C, but it is barely used for 1H hyperpolarization, despite the abundance of 1H in organic matter. Here we show that OX063, a radical that has so far been used only for the hyperpolarization of low-γ nuclei such as 13C, may be used also to hyperpolarize 1H. This hyperpolarization route is enabled by the use of a klystron amplifier that provides three orders of magnitude more power than conventionally used solid-state microwave sources. Following hyperpolarization, the sample is ejected from the polarizer and liquefied, yielding 1H signal enhancements of ~ 1000 in high-field NMR. The use of OX063 limits not only T1 relaxation during sample transfer, but we also show that it preserves the liquid-state T2, and therefore offers superior sensitivity and resolution. The applicability of this method to polarize 1H of selected amino acids is demonstrated.
title_zh: 高场液态核磁共振中三个数量级的质子信号增强
abstract_zh: 溶解动态核极化（d-DNP）是一种用于增强液态核磁共振（NMR）在生物物理和化学应用中灵敏度的超极化技术。D-DNP被广泛用于13C等杂核的灵敏度增强，但尽管有机物中1H含量丰富，它却几乎未被用于1H超极化。在此我们表明，OX063——一种迄今为止仅用于13C等低γ核超极化的自由基——也可用于1H的超极化。该超极化途径的实现得益于使用速调管放大器，其提供的功率比常规使用的固态微波源高三个数量级。超极化后，样品从极化器中弹出并液化，在高场NMR中获得约1000倍的1H信号增强。使用OX063不仅限制了样品转移过程中的T1弛豫，我们还表明它能保持液态T2，因此提供更优的灵敏度和分辨率。文中展示了该方法在选定氨基酸1H极化中的适用性。

title: Diode Open-Circuit Fault Detection for Rotating Rectifiers of Brushless Exciters
abstract: The rotating rectifier represents a vulnerable link within the brushless excitation generator and is prone to diode open-circuit faults. A multi-diode fault will lead to significant fluctuations in the generator’s excitation current, thereby inducing power oscillations in the unit. Investigating the characteristics and detection approaches of open-circuit diode faults is of great significance. In this study, a typical brushless exciter is taken as an example for examination. First, an analysis is conducted on the diode conduction behavior of the rotating rectifier in the exciter. According to the variations in the air-gap magnetic field of the exciter under normal and single-diode open-circuit conditions of the rotating rectifier, it is observed that the fault might introduce fractional harmonics into the air-gap magnetic field. Based on the structural characteristics of the exciter stator and the spillover effect of the main magnetic field, a U-shaped iron core wound with coils is placed in the vicinity of the stator shell to achieve magnetic flux diversion and signal collection. The diode open-circuit fault is identified by the variations in harmonic components of the voltage induced in the coil. Subsequently, a two-dimensional finite element simulation model for a 5.8 MW three-phase brushless exciter is established. A three-phase, 14-pole brushless exciter and a rotating rectifier experimental platform were built for method validation. The results indicate that the induced voltage in the U-shaped core coil can effectively reflect the characteristics of diode open-circuit faults. This method is applicable to the online diagnosis of diode open-circuit faults in brushless exciters, enabling non-invasive detection, reducing the complexity of sensor installation, and exhibiting significant advantages in terms of high convenience and low risk.
title_zh: 无刷励磁机旋转整流器二极管开路故障检测
abstract_zh: 旋转整流器是无刷励磁发电机中的薄弱环节，易发生二极管开路故障。多二极管故障会导致发电机励磁电流显著波动，从而引起机组功率振荡。研究开路二极管故障的特性及检测方法具有重要意义。本研究以典型无刷励磁机为例进行分析。首先，对励磁机中旋转整流器的二极管导通行为进行了分析。根据旋转整流器在正常和单二极管开路条件下励磁机气隙磁场的变化，观察到该故障可能在气隙磁场中引入分数次谐波。基于励磁机定子的结构特点及主磁场的溢出效应，在定子机壳附近放置一个绕有线圈的U形铁芯，以实现磁通分流和信号采集。通过线圈中感应电压谐波分量的变化来识别二极管开路故障。随后，建立了5.8 MW三相无刷励磁机的二维有限元仿真模型。搭建了三相14极无刷励磁机和旋转整流器实验平台以进行方法验证。结果表明，U形铁芯线圈中的感应电压能够有效反映二极管开路的特性

title: S-Parameters as a Basis for Stator Model Parameter Extraction and SFRA Interpretation
abstract: Sweep Frequency Response Analysis (SFRA) is a widely used method for assessing the mechanical and electrical integrity of transformers and is increasingly applied to electrical rotating machines. To support fault diagnosis based on SFRA, a machine-specific model is required that captures the relevant physical behaviour. Up to now the parametrisation of this model is partly done with individual iterative curve fitting, for which a deep understanding of the machine and its parameters is necessary. A method exclusively based on measurements and calculation would help to overcome this need for expert knowledge. This paper introduces a measurement-based approach to parametrise a grey-box stator model using scattering parameters (S-parameters), where the parameters are derived analytically from measured data. The relationship between SFRA and S-parameters is analysed theoretically and experimentally and a conversion to derive the frequency response from S-parameter measurements is presented. The parameter extraction method is applied to three stators and verified through simulation and measurement. The results show that the SFRA response can be reproduced in simulation with a comparable accuracy to previous methods while significantly improving reproducibility and transparency. The approach offers a reliable foundation for model-based SFRA interpretation and future fault identification.
title_zh: 以S参数为基础的定子模型参数提取与SFRA解读
abstract_zh: 扫频响应分析（SFRA）是一种广泛用于评估变压器机械和电气完整性的方法，并越来越多地应用于旋转电机。为支持基于SFRA的故障诊断，需要一个能够描述相关物理行为的机器专用模型。迄今为止，该模型的参数化部分是通过逐条迭代曲线拟合完成的，这需要对机器及其参数有深入的理解。一种完全基于测量和计算的方法将有助于克服对专业知识的需求。本文介绍了一种基于测量的方法，利用散射参数（S参数）对灰箱定子模型进行参数化，其中参数由测量数据解析导出。从理论和实验两方面分析了SFRA与S参数之间的关系，并提出了由S参数测量导出频率响应的转换方法。将该参数提取方法应用于三个定子，并通过仿真和测量进行了验证。结果表明，仿真可以以与以往方法相当的精度复现SFRA响应，同时显著提高了可重复性和透明度。该方法为基于模型的SFRA解释和未来的故障识别提供了可靠的基础。

title: Proton-gated multisite concerted proton-electron transfer-like pathway in a dual-atom framework for selective water purification
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Precise oxidant activation is essential for advanced water treatment but is often limited by radical quenching and low oxidant efficiency. Peroxymonosulfate (PMS) is promising; however, directing O-O cleavage towards non-radical pathways requires tightly coupled proton‒electron transfer, which is rarely achieved in heterogeneous catalysts because of spatially mismatched active sites. Here, we report a Co/Ni dual-single-atom metal–organic framework (MOF), in which atomically dispersed Co/Ni sites and adjacent noncoordinated -NH groups form a preorganized local microenvironment for PMS activation. Combined experimental and computational evidence suggests that Ni-assisted electronic coupling facilitates charge redistribution towards Co-bound PMS, while adjacent noncoordinated -NH motifs provide a local proton-relay environment, collectively favoring an MS-CPET-like pathway. This pathway promotes heterolytic O–O cleavage and the formation of a high-valent cobalt–oxo intermediate (Co(IV) = O). Consequently, the catalyst delivers a normalized rate constant of 6.2 × 103 M−1 min−1 with more than 95% PMS consumption under the tested conditions. Remarkably, the system operates stably for more than 1000 h under continuous flow, with a treatment capacity exceeding 1000 L. This work demonstrates a promising strategy for achieving non-radical-dominated and sustainable water purification through electronic regulation and -NH proton coupling within the framework of bimetallic MOFs.
title_zh: 双原子框架中质子门控多位点协同质子-电子转移样路径用于选择性水净化
abstract_zh: 精确的氧化剂活化对于高级水处理至关重要，但常受限于自由基猝灭和氧化剂效率低下。过一硫酸盐（PMS）具有广阔前景；然而，将O–O裂解导向非自由基途径需要紧密耦合的质子-电子转移，而由于活性位点的空间失配，这在非均相催化剂中难以实现。在此，我们报道了一种Co/Ni双单原子金属有机框架（MOF），其中原子级分散的Co/Ni位点与相邻的非配位-NH基团共同形成用于PMS活化的预组织局部微环境。实验与计算相结合的证据表明，Ni辅助的电子耦合促进了电荷向Co结合的PMS重分布，而相邻的非配位-NH基序提供了局部质子中继环境，共同有利于类MS-CPET途径。该途径促进O–O异裂和高价钴-氧中间体（Co(IV)=O）的形成。因此，该催化剂在测试条件下的归一化速率常数为6.2 × 10³ M⁻¹ min⁻¹，PMS消耗超过95%。值得注意的是，该系统在连续流动条件下稳定运行超过1000 h，处理容量超过1000 L。这项工作展示了一种通过双金属MOF框架内的电子调控和-NH质子耦合实现非自由基主导的可持续水净化的有效策略。

title: Catalytic Enantioselective Synthesis of Upper‐rim‐Functionalized Inherently Chiral Calix[4]arenes Through Desymmetrizing Reductive Amination
abstract: ABSTRACT Inherently chiral calix[4]arenes (ICCs) are chiral macrocyclic compounds whose chirality arises from the asymmetric distribution of substituents in their rigid cone conformations. Although inherent chirality in these systems has long been recognized, the enantioselective synthesis of these structurally intriguing frameworks, especially non‐meta‐type ICCs, remains underexplored. In this work, we report a versatile method for the asymmetric synthesis of both ABCD‐ and ABCC‐type ICCs via an enantioselective desymmetrization strategy. Two classes of diamino‐substituted prochiral calix[4]arenes were efficiently desymmetrized through chiral phosphoric acid‐catalyzed reductive amination with various aldehydes, tolerating a broad range of upper‐rim substitutions and affording both ABCD‐ and ABCC‐type ICCs bearing diverse functional groups with high enantioselectivities. Control experiments suggest that the reaction proceeds via sequential enantioselective desymmetrization and kinetic resolution, with reduction of the imine identified as the enantiodetermining step. Various derivatizations of the ICC products were also performed, including three notable examples involving dimerization of ICCs. Moreover, we demonstrate that combining these asymmetric synthetic and derivatization methods could enable the asymmetric synthesis of all six possible stereoisomers of the ABCD‐type ICCs. Furthermore, incorporation of fluorophore groups into these inherently chiral frameworks furnished ICC derivatives with promising photophysical and chiroptical properties, further underscoring the potential of this methodology.
title_zh: 通过去对称化还原胺化催化对映选择性合成上缘功能化固有手性杯[4]芳烃
abstract_zh: 摘要 固有手性杯[4]芳烃（ICCs）是一类手性大环化合物，其手性源于取代基在刚性锥形构象中的不对称分布。尽管这类体系的固有手性早已被认识，但这些结构引人入胜的框架的对映选择性合成，尤其是非间位型ICCs，仍未被充分探索。在本工作中，我们报道了一种通过对称去对称化策略不对称合成ABCD型和ABCC型ICCs的通用方法。两类二氨基取代的前手性杯[4]芳烃通过手性磷酸催化的与各种醛的还原胺化被高效去对称化，可容忍广泛的上缘取代，并以高对映选择性获得带有多样官能团的ABCD型和ABCC型ICCs。对照实验表明，该反应经由连续的对映选择性去对称化和动力学拆分进行，其中亚胺的还原被确定为对映决定步骤。我们还对ICCs产物进行了多种衍生化，包括三个涉及ICCs二聚化的显著实例。此外，我们证明了将这些不对称合成和衍生化方法相结合，能够实现ABCD型ICCs全部六种可能立体异构体的不对称合成。此外，将荧光团基团引入这些固有手性框架，获得了具有良好光物理和手性光学性质的ICCs衍生物，进一步凸显了其潜

title: Covalent Organic Framework Colloids With Core‐Shell Donor/Acceptor Architecture and Ultralong‐Lived Charge‐Separated States
abstract: ABSTRACT Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) possess structural tunability, high surface area, and extended delocalization of π‐electrons but remain limited by challenges in constructing well‐defined structures that enable efficient charge separation. Here, we address this limitation through the construction of core‐shell colloidal COF particles using isostructural but electronically distinct donor (D) and acceptor (A) COFs. The resulting p‐n heterojunction architecture enables efficient spatial separation of photogenerated electrons and holes, while preserving high crystallinity. Nanoscale phase separation is confirmed by high‐angle annular dark‐field scanning transmission electron microscopy coupled with energy‐dispersive X‐ray spectroscopy (HAADF‐EDS) mapping and X‐ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) analysis. Light‐induced electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) measurements reveal enhanced populations and significantly longer lifetimes of charge‐separated states in the core‐shell COFs compared to their single‐phase counterparts, indicating suppressed charge recombination and improved charge separation. The resulting heterostructures show efficient CO 2 photoreduction to CO and HCOOH, coupled with H 2 O oxidation, thereby requiring no sacrificial agents. The results demonstrate the importance of well‐defined D/A interfaces in COF photocatalysis.
title_zh: 具有核壳给体/受体结构及超长寿命电荷分离态的共价有机框架胶体
abstract_zh: 摘要 共价有机框架（COFs）具有结构可调性、高比表面积和π电子的扩展离域，但在构建能够实现高效电荷分离的明确结构方面仍面临挑战。在此，我们通过使用同构但电子性质不同的给体（D）和受体（A）COFs构建核壳胶体COF颗粒来解决这一局限。所得的p-n异质结结构实现了光生电子和空穴的高效空间分离，同时保持了高结晶度。纳米级相分离通过高角环形暗场扫描透射电子显微镜结合能量色散X射线光谱（HAADF-EDS）面扫以及X射线光电子能谱（XPS）分析得到证实。光诱导电子顺磁共振（EPR）测量表明，与单相对应物相比，核壳COFs中电荷分离态的数量增多且寿命显著延长，表明电荷复合被抑制、电荷分离得到改善。所得异质结构可高效地将CO₂光还原为CO和HCOOH，并耦合H₂O氧化，因此无需牺牲剂。这些结果展示了明确的D/A界面在COF光催化中的重要性。

title: Organic Metal Chalcogenide Films With Giant Birefringence
abstract: ABSTRACT Birefringent films emerge as a compelling candidate for integrated photonic systems, gracefully balancing superior processability with seamless substrate compatibility. However, birefringent films typically retain only ∼20% of bulk crystal performance, which consequently limits film‐based birefringence to values rarely exceeding 0.1. To address this limitation, we introduce a two‐dimensional van der Waals (2D‐vDW) organic metal chalcogenide (OMC) PbHBT (HBT = 4‐mercaptophenol), featuring “molecular‐scale superlattices” of alternating inorganic PbS and organic Ph‐OH ligands. PbHBT crystal exhibits a birefringence of 0.39@546 nm. A nanoscale thickness‐controllable, highly oriented PbHBT film was prepared through an economical in situ layer‐by‐layer (LBL) spin‐coating liquid‐phase epitaxy (LPE) approach. The birefringence of the PbHBT film is 0.3 at 546 nm, maintaining 77% of the birefringence of its bulk crystal. Importantly, the PbHBT film achieves a birefringence of 0.65 in the visible spectrum and 0.43 in the near‐infrared, which are the highest notes ever achieved by a birefringent film. This excellent birefringence performance stems from the anisotropy of the electron cloud density of different crystal planes of the PbHBT and the high consistency of grain orientation after being fabricated into a film. This work opens avenues for thin‐film birefringent materials with large intrinsic birefringence and high retention, bridging the bulk‐film performance gap.
title_zh: 具有巨大双折射的有机金属硫属化物薄膜
abstract_zh: 摘要 双折射薄膜作为集成光子系统的一种极具吸引力的候选材料，在优异的可加工性与无缝的衬底兼容性之间实现了完美平衡。然而，双折射薄膜通常仅能保持体块晶体性能的约20%，因此将薄膜的双折射率限制在很少超过0.1的水平。为解决这一局限，我们引入了一种二维范德华（2D-vDW）有机金属硫属化物（OMC）PbHBT（HBT = 4-巯基苯酚），其具有由无机PbS与有机Ph-OH配体交替排列构成的"分子尺度超晶格"。PbHBT晶体在546 nm处表现出0.39的双折射率。通过一种经济高效的原位逐层（LBL）旋涂液相外延（LPE）方法，制备了纳米级厚度可控、高度取向的PbHBT薄膜。PbHBT薄膜在546 nm处的双折射率为0.3，保持了其体块晶体双折射率的77%。重要的是，PbHBT薄膜在可见光谱范围内实现了0.65的双折射率，在近红外范围内实现了0.43，这是双折射薄膜迄今达到的最高值。这种优异的双折射性能源于PbHBT不同晶面的电子云密度各向异性，以及制成薄膜后晶粒取向的高度一致性。这项工作为具有大本征双折射和高保持率的薄膜双折射材料开辟了道路，弥合了体块与薄膜之间的性能差距。

title: Integrated Fault Location Method Using Feeder-Centric Graph Neural Networks for Renewable-Penetrated DC Distribution Networks
abstract: This paper proposes a fault location method for DC distribution networks (DCDNs) based on graph neural networks (GNNs), which integrates the fault line selection (FLS) and fault distance estimation (FDE) that are conventionally handled independently. The proposed method focuses on the analysis of feeders, including FLS of multiple feeders and FDE of a single feeder. Specifically, a feeder-as-node graph is constructed, where synchronous measurement data are extracted as node features, ensuring consistent dimensionality and enhanced learning efficiency. Moreover, the proposed method explicitly embeds the logical interdependencies between FLS and FDE into the structural design and parameter updating mechanism. An output processing module is designed to estimate the fault distance by analyzing the FLS results, ensuring the model utilizes the data of the DCDN system-level information rather than a single feeder. Furthermore, a two-stage pre-training strategy is introduced to improve stability and generalization, in which partial parameters are frozen. The effectiveness and generalization of the proposed method are verified by hardware-in-the-loop experiments.
title_zh: 基于馈线中心图神经网络的可再生能源渗透直流配电网络集成故障定位方法
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的直流配电网（DCDN）故障定位方法，将传统上独立处理的故障选线（FLS）与故障测距（FDE）进行了集成。所提方法聚焦于馈线分析，包括多馈线的FLS和单馈线的FDE。具体而言，构建了以馈线为节点的图，其中提取同步测量数据作为节点特征，确保了维度的一致性并提升了学习效率。此外，所提方法将FLS与FDE之间的逻辑相互依赖关系明确嵌入到结构设计和参数更新机制中。设计了输出处理模块，通过分析FLS结果来估算故障距离，确保模型利用DCDN系统级信息的数据而非单一馈线的数据。进一步地，引入了两阶段预训练策略以提高稳定性和泛化能力，其中冻结了部分参数。通过硬件在环实验验证了所提方法的有效性和泛化能力。

title: Nodal Frequency Nadir Chance-Constrained Economic Dispatch Considering Contingency Frequency Service From Hydrogen Electrolysis
abstract: Providing contingency frequency services (CFSs) through grid-forming (GFM) converter-interfaced resources (CIRs) is a technically effective method for bolstering the frequency stability of low-inertia power systems. However, this approach often causes significant power curtailment or high capital investment. Moreover, the heterogeneous dynamic characteristics of CIRs and increasing uncertainty of renewable energy sources (RESs) renders system-level frequency metrics under deterministic conditions insufficient, necessitating the incorporation of uncertain nodal frequency nadir (NFN) to ensure comprehensive frequency stability. To address these gaps, this paper proposes a novel NFN chance-constrained economic dispatch framework, which leverages hydrogen electrolysis systems (HESs) as cost-effective sources of CFSs. The framework first establishes a synergistic operation strategy for integrated grid-following RESs and GFM HESs to enable efficient delivery of CFSs under stochastic contingencies. System-level power dispatch decisions and device-level CIR settings (i.e., control mode) are then co-optimized to minimize operation costs while ensuring both the system-level and node-level frequency stability. Finally, to overcome the computational burden of the nonlinear NFN chance constraints, a computationally tractable solution methodology is developed that leverages input convex neural networks with analytical sensitivity analysis and Benders decomposition methods. The effectiveness and scalability of the proposed approach are validated through numerical simulations on two test systems.
title_zh: 考虑氢电解 contingency 频率服务的节点频率最低值机会约束经济调度
abstract_zh: 通过构网型（GFM）变换器接口资源（CIR）提供应急频率服务（CFS）是增强低惯量电力系统频率稳定性的一种技术有效方法。然而，这种方法往往会导致显著的功率削减或高昂的资本投入。此外，CIR的异质动态特性以及可再生能源（RES）日益增长的不确定性，使得确定性条件下的系统级频率指标不再充分，需要纳入不确定的节点频率最低值（NFN）以确保全面的频率稳定性。为弥补这些不足，本文提出了一种新颖的NFN机会约束经济调度框架，利用氢电解系统（HES）作为低成本CFS来源。该框架首先建立了跟网型RES与GFM HES的协同运行策略，以在随机故障下实现CFS的高效交付。随后，对系统级功率调度决策和设备级CIR设置（即控制模式）进行联合优化，在确保系统级和节点级频率稳定性的同时最小化运行成本。最后，为克服非线性NFN机会约束的计算负担，开发了一种计算上易于处理的求解方法，该方法利用输入凸神经网络结合解析灵敏度分析和Benders分解方法。通过在两个测试系统上的数值仿真验证了所提方法的有效性和可扩展性。

title: A Faster μ -PMU Algorithm Using Arctangent Framework With Parameter Step Change
abstract: Phasor Measurement Units (PMUs) play a vital role in modern power systems by enabling real-time monitoring, control, and protection under dynamic conditions. However, their performance exhibits inaccuracy and longer response time when encountered with abrupt transients. To address these limitations, the paper introduces a highly responsive and precise algorithm for estimating synchrophasor, frequency and rate of change of frequency (ROCOF) that effectively cope with sudden amplitude or phase changes. The approach integrates the initial frequency estimation with a Logarithmic Entropy Ratio strategy for effective transient detection. A step modeling is used based on the Arctangent Laplacian Continuous Mixed p-Norm (ALCMpN) algorithm on asymmetric windows. Subsequently, a compensation technique enables blend between pre and post estimates which eliminates the influence of phase step and reduces the ROCOF error. IEC/IEEE 60255-118-1a compliance tests show that the proposed algorithm achieves TVE <0.001%, FE <0.05 mHz, and RFE <0.005 Hz/s which are within the P-class constraint. Field validation using Grid Event Signature Library (GESL) test data further verifies robust performance under real fault conditions. Real-time validation using RTDS–DSP hardware demonstrates reliable operation confirming its suitability for real-time PMU and protection applications in active distribution networks.
title_zh: 一种基于反正切框架并考虑参数阶跃变化的更快速 μ-PMU 算法
abstract_zh: 相量测量单元（PMU）通过在动态条件下实现实时监测、控制和保护，在现代电力系统中发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，在遭遇突变暂态时，其性能表现出不精确和响应时间较长的问题。为解决这些局限性，本文提出了一种高响应性、高精度的同步相量、频率和频率变化率（ROCOF）估计算法，能够有效应对幅值或相位的突然变化。该方法将初始频率估计与对数熵比策略相结合，实现有效的暂态检测。基于非对称窗口上的反正切拉普拉斯连续混合p范数（ALCMpN）算法采用阶跃建模。随后，一种补偿技术实现了估计前后的融合，消除了相位阶跃的影响并降低了ROCOF误差。IEC/IEEE 60255-118-1a合规性测试表明，所提算法实现了TVE <0.001%、FE <0.05 mHz和RFE <0.005 Hz/s，均在P类约束范围之内。利用电网事件特征库（GESL）测试数据进行的现场验证进一步证实了其在真实故障条件下的稳健性能。利用RTDS–DSP硬件进行的实时验证展示了其可靠运行，确认了其在有源配电网中适用于实时PMU和保护应用。

title: Federated Aggregation of Polyhedral Demand Flexibility Sets
abstract: This paper proposes a federated framework for demand flexibility aggregation to support grid operations. Unlike existing geometric methods that rely on a static, pre-defined base set as the geometric template for aggregation, our framework establishes a true federated process by enabling the collaborative optimization of this base set without requiring the participants to share sensitive data with the aggregator. Specifically, we first formulate the base set optimization problem as a bilevel program. Using optimal solution functions, we then reformulate the bilevel program into a single-level, unconstrained learning task. By exploiting the decomposable structure of the overall gradient, we further design a decentralized gradient-based algorithm to solve this learning task. The entire framework, encompassing base set optimization, aggregation, and disaggregation, operates by design without exchanging raw user data. Numerical results demonstrate that our proposed framework unlocks substantially more flexibility than the approaches with static base sets, thus providing a promising framework for efficient and privacy-enhanced approaches to coordinate demand flexibility at scale.
title_zh: 多面体需求灵活性集合的联邦聚合
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种支持电网运行的需求灵活性聚合联邦框架。与依赖静态、预定义基集作为聚合几何模板的现有几何方法不同，我们的框架通过实现该基集的协同优化来建立真正的联邦过程，而无需参与者与聚合商共享敏感数据。具体而言，我们首先将基集优化问题表述为双层规划。然后，利用最优解函数，我们将该双层规划重构为单层无约束学习任务。通过利用整体梯度的可分解结构，我们进一步设计了一种去中心化的基于梯度的算法来求解该学习任务。整个框架（包括基集优化、聚合和分解）在设计上无需交换原始用户数据即可运行。数值结果表明，与采用静态基集的方法相比，我们所提框架释放了显著更多的灵活性，从而为大规模协调需求灵活性提供了一种高效且增强隐私的有前景的框架。

title: Real-Time Charging Control for Electric Roadways
abstract: This paper studies the optimal wireless charging for electric vehicles (EVs) driving through an electric roadway (ER). We first develop a clairvoyant formulation to model and optimize the minute-level energy transmission between the ER and EVs, which incorporates ER microgrid operation, EV-side power balance, battery dynamics, and wireless power transfer limits as constraints. However, this formulation requires future information regarding how EVs will be driven, which is often unavailable during real-time operation. To circumvent the dependence on future information, we design a causal algorithm by leveraging the optimality of valley-filling charging profiles of the clairvoyant formulation. We theoretically establish the optimality of the proposed algorithm in an ideal setting without considering losses. The algorithm is then extended to account for practicalities such as estimation errors, losses, and incorporation of a stationary battery co-located with the ER. Finally, for distinct traffic conditions, we numerically validate the performance of the algorithm under realistic settings (incorporating losses) with different information patterns (with and without lookahead).
title_zh: 面向电气化公路的实时充电控制
abstract_zh: 本文研究电动汽车（EV）驶过电气化道路（ER）时的最优无线充电问题。我们首先建立了一个全知性公式，以建模和优化ER与EV之间的分钟级能量传输，其中将ER微电网运行、EV侧功率平衡、电池动态以及无线电力传输限制作为约束条件。然而，该公式需要关于EV未来行驶方式的未来信息，而这些信息在实时运行中通常不可获得。为了摆脱对未来信息的依赖，我们利用全知性公式的填谷充电曲线的最优性，设计了一种因果算法。我们在不考虑损耗的理想情况下从理论上证明了所提算法的最优性。随后，该算法被扩展以考虑实际情况，如估计误差、损耗以及与ER同址部署的固定电池。最后，针对不同的交通状况，我们在包含损耗的现实现场设置下，采用不同的信息模式（有和无前瞻）对算法性能进行了数值验证。

title: Bayesian-Optimized Deep Learning for Adaptive Real-Time FDIA Detection in Smart Grid Demand Response Systems
abstract: Smart grid demand response (DR) systems face escalating threats from False Data Injection Attacks (FDIAs), which corrupt load forecasts to distort real-time pricing, destabilize supply–demand equilibrium, and precipitate cascading grid failures. These intrusions manifest as multi-scale temporal anomalies from transient spikes to prolonged distortions in severely imbalanced datasets. We propose an adaptive deep learning architecture integrating: (i) a variance-adaptive 1D convolutional neural network (CNN) with dynamic kernel scaling to magnify anomalies while attenuating noise; (ii) a temporal-attention bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM) to resolve forward–backward dependencies; and (iii) Bayesian optimization (BO) with Matérn kernels to jointly optimize accuracy–latency trade-offs under strict computational constraints. An Enhanced SMOTE-RUS scheme synthesizes minority-class attacks while preserving appliance-level periodicity. Evaluated on 377k half-hourly forecasts from 290 U.S. households, the framework attains 99.26% accuracy, 93.16% F1-score, and 1.2 ms per-sample inference, exceeding the strongest baseline by 21.4%.
title_zh: 基于贝叶斯优化的深度学习用于智能电网需求响应系统中的自适应实时FDIA检测
abstract_zh: 智能电网需求响应（DR）系统正面临来自虚假数据注入攻击（FDIAs）的不断升级的威胁，这类攻击通过破坏负荷预测来扭曲实时电价、破坏供需平衡，并引发级联性电网故障。这些入侵在严重不平衡的数据集中表现为从瞬时尖峰到长期失真的多尺度时间异常。我们提出了一种自适应深度学习架构，整合了：(i) 具有动态核尺度缩放的方差自适应一维卷积神经网络（CNN），可放大异常同时抑制噪声；(ii) 时间注意力双向LSTM（BiLSTM），用于解析前后向依赖关系；以及(iii) 采用Matérn核的贝叶斯优化（BO），在严格计算约束下联合优化精度—时延权衡。一种增强型SMOTE-RUS方案在保留设备级周期性的同时合成少数类攻击样本。基于来自290个美国家庭的37.7万条半小时级预测数据进行评估，该框架实现了99.26%的准确率、93.16%的F1分数和每样本1.2 ms的推理速度，比最强基线高出21.4%。

title: Two-Stage Risk-Based Scheduling for Electricity–Biogas Rural Microgrids With Biomass Fermentation
abstract: Electricity-biogas rural microgrids (EBRMs) possess significant economic potential and the ability to coordinate multiple energy sources, making them a promising paradigm for energy management in rural areas. This paper proposes an energy scheduling method for an EBRM that utilizes renewable and biomass resources, with the goal of economically meeting rural electricity demand. The biogas fermentation process is modeled as a nonlinear biochemical dynamic system, where biogas production is governed by differential equations involving fermentation temperature and total solids (TS) concentration. A practical biogas fermentation model, which considers the dynamics of temperature and TS, is developed and subsequently linearized using McCormick relaxation. To more effectively capture renewable energy uncertainties beyond the tail focus of Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR), a Gini-weighted CVaR (GWCVaR) model is introduced to quantify the risk of load shedding, formulating a stochastic mixed-integer programming problem. To address the mismatch between long-term biogas scheduling and day-ahead microgrid dispatch, a two-stage optimization strategy is proposed. Finally, simulation results demonstrate its effectiveness. The proposed method achieves a 26.2% reduction in operating cost compared to a baseline without biogas integration, while the integrated GWCVaR reduces load-shedding risk by over 85% with only a 3.4% cost penalty.
title_zh: 含生物质发酵的电-沼气农村微电网两阶段风险调度
abstract_zh: 电-沼气农村微电网（EBRMs）具有显著的经济潜力和多能源协调能力，是农村能源管理的一种有前景的范式。本文提出了一种利用可再生能源和生物质资源的EBRM能量调度方法，旨在经济地满足农村电力需求。沼气发酵过程被建模为一个非线性生化动态系统，其中沼气产量由涉及发酵温度和总固体（TS）浓度的微分方程控制。建立了一个考虑温度和TS动态的实用沼气发酵模型，并使用McCormick松弛进行线性化。为了更有效地捕捉条件风险价值（CVaR）尾部关注之外的可再生能源不确定性，引入了基尼加权CVaR（GWCVaR）模型来量化切负荷风险，从而构建了一个随机混合整数规划问题。为解决长期沼气调度与日前微电网 dispatch 之间的失配问题，提出了一种两阶段优化策略。最后，仿真结果验证了其有效性。与不含沼气集成的基线相比，所提方法使运行成本降低了26.2%，而集成的GWCVaR仅以3.4%的成本代价将切负荷风险降低了85%以上。

title: Data-Driven Distribution Network Modeling Using Shallow Physics-Informed Neural Network
abstract: Accurate topology and line parameters are fundamental for the planning, operation, and control of distribution networks. Motivated by the physics and characteristics of the distribution network power flow, a shallow physics-informed neural network (SPINN), based on the input convex neural network (ICNN), is elegantly designed to perform data-driven distribution network modeling, enabling the joint estimation of distribution network topology and line parameters. The proposed data-driven distribution network modeling establishes an analytical expression and mapping between the SPINN parameters and distribution network parameters, allowing the distribution network parameters, i.e., topologies and line parameters, to be directly calculated and inferred from the neural network parameters. The performance of the distribution network modeling method is further proved theoretically and verified on the IEEE 33, 69, and 123-bus systems. The results show that our proposed method can accurately estimate the topology and line parameters.
title_zh: 基于浅层物理信息神经网络的配电网数据驱动建模
abstract_zh: 精确的拓扑和线路参数是配电网规划、运行和控制的基础。基于配电网潮流的物理特性，我们基于输入凸神经网络（ICNN）优雅地设计了一种浅层物理信息神经网络（SPINN），用于执行数据驱动的配电网建模，实现配电网拓扑与线路参数的联合估计。所提出的数据驱动配电网建模建立了SPINN参数与配电网参数之间的解析表达式和映射，使配电网参数（即拓扑和线路参数）可以直接从神经网络参数计算和推断。配电网建模方法的性能在理论上得到进一步证明，并在IEEE 33、69和123节点系统上得到验证。结果表明，我们提出的方法能够准确估计拓扑和线路参数。

title: Pushing the limits of single-cell proteomics to investigate bacterial heterogeneity using bacSCP
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Single-cell proteomics (SCP) has emerged as a powerful approach to quantify protein expression variability at cellular resolution, yet most state-of-the-art workflows are tailored to eukaryotic cells with only one study exploring how single bacteria can be analyzed by mass spectrometry. Here, we established bacSCP, a protocol extending SCP to bacterial cells, facing analytical challenges such as the thick bacterial cell wall hampering lysis, the extremely small cell size and resultant low protein content, and the comparatively high level of contaminating proteins from external sources. Using this bacSCP pipeline, we quantified more than 50 bacterial proteins from single Bacillus subtilis and Escherichia coli cells. Upon heat stress, we reproducibly observed up to 8-fold upregulation of chaperones including GroEL, GroES, and ClpC for a B. subtilis ΔmcsB strain. Importantly, single-cell measurements revealed potential heterogeneity within the heat-stressed subpopulation, enabling interrogation of stress-response variability at the proteome level. These results demonstrate the feasibility of bacSCP and provide a foundation for studying bacterial stress adaptation and phenotypic diversity with single-cell proteomic resolution.
title_zh: 利用bacSCP突破单细胞蛋白质组学极限以研究细菌异质性
abstract_zh: 单细胞蛋白质组学（SCP）已成为在细胞分辨率下量化蛋白质表达变异的强大方法，然而大多数最先进的工作流程都是针对真核细胞量身定制的，仅有一项研究探索了如何通过质谱分析单个细菌。在此，我们建立了bacSCP，一种将SCP扩展到细菌细胞的实验方案，面临的挑战包括阻碍裂解的厚细菌细胞壁、极小的细胞尺寸及由此产生的低蛋白质含量，以及相对较高的外部来源污染蛋白。利用该bacSCP流程，我们从单个枯草芽孢杆菌（Bacillus subtilis）和大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）细胞中定量了50多种细菌蛋白。在热应激下，我们在B. subtilis ΔmcsB菌株中可重复地观察到包括GroEL、GroES和ClpC在内的分子伴侣高达8倍的上调。重要的是，单细胞测量揭示了热应激亚群内部的潜在异质性，从而能够在蛋白质组水平上探究应激反应的变异性。这些结果证明了bacSCP的可行性，并为以单细胞蛋白质组分辨率研究细菌应激适应和表型多样性奠定了基础。

title: Deep Multi-Modal Fusion and Kalman Online Adaptation for Electric Load Forecasting Against Extreme Rainfall Events
abstract: Extreme rainfall (ERF), one of the most frequent and widespread severe weather hazards, has significant impacts on power systems. The sudden and unpredictable nature of precipitation can cause abrupt changes in power consumption behavior, posing significant challenges for accurate electric load forecasting. Satellite images provide fine-grained spatial characteristics of weather phenomena, which can be leveraged to capture rainfall patterns and trajectories that influence power demand. To this end, this paper proposes a multimodal learning and online adaptation-based load forecasting method for ERF disasters by taking both satellite images and time series data as input.
