Furthermore, density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal a synergistic mechanism where the MoP phase acts as a potent water dissociation promoter, facilitating the Volmer step. Consequently, the O x ‐MoSe 2‐x /MoP/CC electrode delivers a remarkable overpotential of only 34 mV at 10 mA cm −2 in 1 M phosphate buffer solution, surpassing commercial Pt/C, and exhibits superior long‐term stability. This work not only presents a high‐performance electrocatalyst but also highlights the pivotal role of nucleophilic modulation in engineering interfacial H‐bond networks for efficient neutral electrocatalysis.
title_zh: 通过亲核掺杂解析界面水构型：高连通氢键网络实现高效中性析氢
abstract_zh: 摘要 中性析氢反应（HER）由于强阳离子水合作用破坏界面氢键（H-bond）网络、阻碍传质而面临缓慢的动力学。本文提出一种亲核掺杂策略以重构界面水结构并提升中性HER性能。通过在碳布上构筑亲核氧掺杂硒化钼/磷化钼杂化物（Ox-MoSe2-x/MoP/CC），我们成功调控了局部电子环境以削弱阳离子水合效应。从头算分子动力学（AIMD）模拟结合原位拉曼光谱提供了有力证据，表明引入的亲核O物种引发了界面水的重构，促进形成高度连通的氢键网络。这些优化的网络作为中间产物传输的高效通道，显著降低了传质阻力。此外，密度泛函理论（DFT）计算揭示了协同机制：MoP相作为高效的水解离促进剂，加速了Volmer步骤。因此，Ox-MoSe2-x/MoP/CC电极在1 M磷酸盐缓冲溶液中于10 mA cm−2下仅表现出34 mV的优异过电位，超越了商用Pt/C，并展现出优异的长期稳定性。这项工作不仅提供了一种高性能电催化剂，还强调了亲核调控在构筑高效中性电催化界面氢键网络中的关键作用。

title: Revisiting the Closed‐Pore Formation and Interfacial Micro‐Environment Modulation Mechanisms of Polyacrylonitrile‐Derived Carbon Nanofibers Toward Efficient Sodium Storage
abstract: ABSTRACT Polyacrylonitrile‐based carbon nanofibers (CNFs) are widely regarded as promising sodium‐storage anodes owing to their high carbon yield/axial conductivity and superior mechanical flexibility. Nevertheless, the ambiguous understandings into the temperature‐dependent micro‐structure evolution, particularly the closed‐pore formation over pyrolysis, and the electrolyte induced electrode‐electrolyte interface micro‐environments, along with the involved influence mechanism upon sodium‐storage behaviors should be reasonably clarified. With systematical in(ex)‐situ physicochemical/electrochemical characterizations, it is first established that the optimal pyrolysis temperature of 1400°C combined with a “zipper‐like” point‐line‐plane solid‐phase fusion evolution effectively modulates micro‐structures, endowing the optimized pseudo‐graphitized CNFs film (i.e., GCNFs‐1400) with a synergistic balance among ions transport pathways (interlayer spacing), active storage sites (closed pores), and 3D conductive supporting framework (solid‐phase fusion). Concurrently, compared to the ester‐based electrolyte, the ether‐based electrolyte favors the formation of a thinner, more uniform, and chemically stable solid electrolyte interphase layer. It is the dual‐engineering of both material micro‐structures and interfacial micro‐environment that fully guarantees the competitive sodium‐storage properties of GCNFs‐1400 in terms of ultra‐high initial Coulombic efficiency (96.2%), rate capability, and long‐term stability toward presodiation‐free sodium‐ion batteries and sodium‐ion capacitors. More essentially, our in‐depth insights here provide meaningful guidance for future design of advanced hard carbon anodes toward efficient sodium storage.
title_zh: 重新审视聚丙烯腈衍生碳纳米纤维的闭孔形成与界面微环境调控机制以实现高效钠存储
abstract_zh: 摘要 聚丙烯腈基碳纳米纤维（CNFs）因其高碳收率/轴向导电性及优异的机械柔性而被广泛视为有前景的钠存储负极材料。然而，对其随温度变化的微观结构演变（尤其是热解过程中闭孔的形成）、电解液诱导的电极-电解液界面微环境，以及其对钠存储行为的影响机制仍需合理澄清。借助系统的（非）原位物理化学/电化学表征，首次确立了1400°C的最佳热解温度结合“拉链式”点-线-面固相熔融演变可有效调控微观结构，使优化的赝石墨化CNFs膜（即GCNFs-1400）在离子传输通道（层间距）、活性存储位点（闭孔）和三维导电支撑骨架（固相熔融）之间实现协同平衡。同时，与酯类电解液相比，醚类电解液有利于形成更薄、更均匀且化学性质稳定的固体电解质界面膜层。正是材料微结构与界面微环境的双重调控，充分保障了GCNFs-1400在超高首次库仑效率（96.2%）、倍率性能和长期稳定性方面的竞争优势，适用于无需预钠化的钠离子电池和钠离子电容器。

title: Towards Excessive Short-Circuit Current Suppression via MMC-HVDC: A Stochastic Hybrid AC/DC Transmission Expansion Planning Approach
abstract: To overcome the limitations of conventional short- circuit current (SCC) suppression approaches in transmission expansion planning (TEP), this letter proposes a novel SCC-constrained hybrid AC/DC TEP model considering wind uncertainty. To quantify the maximum SCC contribution of MMC, a planning-oriented equivalent current source (ECS) model is developed with different fault-type-dependent magnitudes which could be directly embedded into the TEP. Then, a unified SCC formulation is proposed, integrating the SCC contribution of high voltage alternating current (HVAC) lines, synchronous generators (SGs) and superconducting fault current limiters (SFCLs). Based on the SCC formulation, the proposed stochastic model is cast as a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) model. Numerical simulations suggest that the proposed formulations are effective in SCC modeling and suppression.
title_zh: 基于MMC-HVDC的过度短路电流抑制：一种随机混合交直流输电扩展规划方法
abstract_zh: 为克服传统输电扩展规划（TEP）中短路电流（SCC）抑制方法的局限性，本信提出了一种考虑风电不确定性的新型SCC约束交直流混合TEP模型。为量化MMC的最大SCC贡献，开发了一种面向规划的等效电流源（ECS）模型，其具有随故障类型而不同的幅值，可直接嵌入TEP中。随后，提出了统一的SCC公式，整合了高压交流（HVAC）线路、同步发电机（SGs）和超导故障限流器（SFCLs）的SCC贡献。基于该SCC公式，所提随机模型被表述为混合整数线性规划（MILP）模型。数值仿真表明，所提公式在SCC建模与抑制方面是有效的。

title: Integrating Multi-Neural DAE Experts Into Power System Dynamic Component Modeling for EMTP-Type Simulation
abstract: Traditional data-driven modeling methods encounter significant accuracy limitations when used to model the electromagnetic transients (EMT) of unidentified components in power systems based on limited measurement data. Moreover, their restricted generalization capabilities and compatibility issues further impede broad adoption. This paper proposes a novel multi-gate mixture-of-experts based differential-algebraic equation (MMOE-DAE) network to model components with unknown high-order dynamics. First, an MMOE-DAE network is established to model the relationships among the phases of the three-phase component by modulating multiple gated neural DAEs. Then, an automatic order upgrading module for high-order dynamic component modeling is proposed, and the identification of DAE order is facilitated by a fully gated network. Last, a model local parameter flexible calibration strategy based on fine-tuning is designed to improve the accuracy and stability of the MMOE-DAE training. Based on the commercial EMT simulation platform CloudPSS, dynamic equivalent models for different power components are constructed, and the accuracy and flexibility advantages of MMOE-DAE modeling are assessed through co-simulations.
title_zh: 将多神经DAE专家集成到电力系统动态元件建模中用于EMTP类仿真
abstract_zh: 传统的数据驱动建模方法在基于有限测量数据对电力系统中未知元件的电磁暂态(EMT)进行建模时面临显著的精度限制。此外,其泛化能力受限及兼容性问题进一步阻碍了其广泛应用。本文提出一种新颖的基于多门混合专家的微分-代数方程(MMOE-DAE)网络,用于对具有未知高阶动态特性的元件进行建模。首先,建立MMOE-DAE网络,通过调制多个门控神经DAE来建模三相元件各相之间的关系。然后,提出面向高阶动态元件建模的自动阶次升级模块,并通过全门控网络实现DAE阶次的辨识。最后,设计一种基于微调的模型局部参数灵活校准策略,以提高MMOE-DAE训练的精度和稳定性。基于商业EMT仿真平台CloudPSS,构建了不同电力元件的动态等值模型,并通过联合仿真评估了MMOE-DAE建模在精度和灵活性方面的优势。

title: Digital Twin Integrated Safe Deep Reinforcement Learning for Resilience Enhancement of Unbalanced Distribution Grids
abstract: The growing integration of distributed energy resources (DERs) into distribution grids and increasing extreme events bring security challenges into grids, while accurate grid model is difficult to be obtained due to the widespread deployment of DERs and unknown extreme events. This paper proposes a new method to strengthen the resilience of unbalanced distribution networks through the integration of a novel power system digital twin (DT) and deep reinforcement learning (DRL) based multi-step critical load restoration method. First, a combined data driven and model based identification method is proposed to develop power system DT, which achieves the identification of network topology and line characteristics of distribution grids even under unbalanced conditions. Moreover, a safe DRL based multi-step critical load restoration scheme with dynamic microgrids (MGs) formation capability is established to improve distribution system resilience after extreme events and realize zero voltage violations. Finally, a DT integrated DRL based resilience enhancement approach is proposed to achieve real-time model updating, minimal load loss and guaranteed grid safety under unbalanced and uncertain grid conditions.
title_zh: 数字孪生集成的安全深度强化学习用于提升不平衡配电网的韧性
abstract_zh: 分布式能源(DER)在配电网中日益增长的接入以及极端事件的不断增加给电网带来了安全挑战,同时由于DER的广泛部署和未知的极端事件,难以获得精确的电网模型。本文提出一种新方法,通过新型电力系统数字孪生(DT)与基于深度强化学习(DRL)的多步关键负荷恢复方法相结合,增强不平衡配电网的韧性。首先,提出数据驱动与模型驱动相结合的辨识方法来构建电力系统DT,即使在不平衡条件下也能实现配电网网络拓扑和线路特性的辨识。此外,建立具有动态微电网(MG)构建能力的基于安全DRL的多步关键负荷恢复方案,以提高极端事件后配电系统的韧性并实现零电压越限。最后,提出DT与DRL相结合的韧性增强方法,在不平衡和不确定的电网条件下实现实时模型更新、最小负荷损失以及保障电网安全。

title: Development of Generic Static Equivalent Models for Active Distribution Networks
abstract: The increasing integration of converter-interfaced renewable energy sources (CI-RES) in distribution networks (DNs), combined with the gradual decommissioning of synchronous generators (SGs), is shifting the responsibility for ancillary services (AS) provision from SGs to CI-RES. To meet this role, CI-RES must incorporate advanced frequency and voltage control functionalities. However, their intermittent nature, together with the continuous variation of active and reactive power exchanges between DNs and the transmission system (TS), introduces significant challenges for secure and reliable power system operation. Conventional simplified DN models are no longer adequate, as they fail to capture the impact of CI-RES control strategies on power flows. This paper proposes a new methodology for modeling and analyzing the steady-state behavior of DNs with high CI-RES penetration, considering different frequency and voltage control schemes. The approach is validated through simulations on benchmark medium- and low-voltage networks under different operating conditions, including variations in load type, CI-RES penetration level, and control strategies. The results demonstrate the robustness and scalability of the proposed method, showing that it delivers accurate equivalent models and outperforms conventional approaches, particularly when CI-RES are embedded with both frequency and voltage control schemes.
title_zh: 主动配电网的通用静态等值模型开发
abstract_zh: 换流器接口可再生能源(CI-RES)在配电网(DN)中日益增长的接入,加之同步发电机(SG)的逐步退役,正将辅助服务(AS)提供的责任从SG转移至CI-RES。为承担这一角色,CI-RES必须具备先进的频率和电压控制功能。然而,其间歇性特性以及DN与输电系统(TS)之间有功和无功功率交换的持续变化,给电力系统的安全可靠运行带来了重大挑战。传统的简化DN模型已不再适用,因为它们无法捕捉CI-RES控制策略对潮流的影响。本文提出一种新的方法论,用于建模和分析高CI-RES渗透率下DN的稳态行为,并考虑不同的频率和电压控制方案。该方法通过对中压和低压基准网络在不同运行条件下的仿真进行了验证,包括负荷类型、CI-RES渗透水平和控制策略的变化。结果证明了所提方法的鲁棒性和可扩展性,表明其能提供精确的等值模型并优于传统方法,尤其是当CI-RES同时嵌入频率和电压控制方案时。

title: Constrained Diffusion Models for Synthesizing Representative Power Flow Datasets
abstract: High-quality power flow datasets are essential for training machine learning models in power systems. However, security and privacy concerns restrict access to real-world data, making statistically accurate and physically consistent synthetic datasets a viable alternative. We develop a diffusion model for generating synthetic power flow datasets from real-world power grids that both replicate the statistical properties of the real-world data and ensure AC power flow feasibility. To enforce the constraints, we incorporate gradient guidance based on the power flow constraints to steer diffusion sampling toward feasible samples. To enhance learning efficiency and reduce model complexity, we further leverage insights from the fast decoupled power flow method and propose a variable decoupling strategy for the training and sampling of the diffusion model. These solutions lead to a physics-informed diffusion model, generating power flow datasets that outperform those from the standard diffusion in terms of feasibility and statistical similarity, as shown in experiments across IEEE benchmark systems.
title_zh: 用于合成代表性潮流数据集的约束扩散模型
abstract_zh: 高质量的潮流数据集对于训练电力系统中的机器学习模型至关重要。然而,安全与隐私问题限制了对真实数据的获取,使得统计上准确且物理上一致的合成数据集成为一种可行的替代方案。我们开发了一种扩散模型,用于从真实电网生成合成潮流数据集,该数据集既能复现真实数据的统计特性,又能保证交流潮流可行性。为施加约束,我们引入基于潮流约束的梯度引导,使扩散采样向可行样本方向引导。为提高学习效率并降低模型复杂度,我们进一步利用快速解耦潮流方法的洞见,提出用于扩散模型训练和采样的变量解耦策略。这些方案形成了一种物理信息驱动的扩散模型,所生成的潮流数据集在可行性和统计相似性方面优于标准扩散模型,IEEE基准系统上的实验验证了这一点。

title: PQMFA: Lightweight and Provably Secure Post-Quantum Multi-Factor Authentication Key Exchange Scheme for Smart Grid
abstract: The smart grid (SG) couples power infrastructure with pervasive communication and automated control, but this connectivity enlarges the attack surface of metering and communication links. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is therefore essential to prevent impersonation and unauthorized access. However, most MFA schemes rely on classical hardness assumptions and may not withstand quantum attacks. Moreover, SG terminals often operate under asymmetric resources and stringent latency constraints. Hence, it is urgent to develop post-quantum MFA schemes that are both secure and efficient, and practically deployable in SG environments. To ensure secure smart-grid communications in the post-quantum era, we propose a lattice-based lightweight and provably secure multi-factor authentication key exchange scheme (PQMFA). PQMFA integrates MFA into a lattice-based key exchange framework and leverages techniques such as fuzzy verifiers and honeywords to effectively resist password guessing attacks. Additionally, a novel lattice-based asymmetric computation method is introduced to reduce the computational overhead for smart meters. The security of PQMFA is formally proven under the Real-Or-Random (ROR) model. Comparative analysis with benchmark schemes demonstrates that PQMFA not only achieves strong resistance against various known attacks and ensures three-factor security, but also strikes a practical balance between security and efficiency.
title_zh: PQMFA：面向智能电网的轻量级可证明安全的后量子多因素认证密钥交换方案
abstract_zh: 智能电网(SG)将电力基础设施与泛在通信和自动控制相耦合,但这种连接性扩大了计量和通信链路的攻击面。多因素认证(MFA)因此对于防止冒充和未授权访问至关重要。然而,大多数MFA方案依赖经典困难性假设,可能无法抵御量子攻击。此外,SG终端通常工作在资源不对称和严格时延约束之下。因此,迫切需要开发在后量子时代既安全又高效且可在SG环境中实际部署的后量子MFA方案。为确保后量子时代智能电网通信的安全,我们提出一种基于格的轻量级可证明安全的多因素认证密钥交换方案(PQMFA)。PQMFA将MFA集成到基于格的密钥交换框架中,并利用模糊验证器和蜜令牌等技术有效抵御口令猜测攻击。此外,引入一种新颖的基于格的非对称计算方法,以降低智能电表的计算开销。PQMFA的安全性在Real-Or-Random(ROR)模型下得到了形式化证明。与基准方案的对比分析表明,PQMFA不仅能有效抵御各种已知攻击并确保三因素安全,还在安全性与效率之间取得了实际的平衡。

title: Analysis and Optimization of a New Consequent-Pole Hybrid Excited Machine Applied for Electric Vehicles
abstract: In this article, a new consequent-pole hybrid excited machine with segmented stator (CPHES machine) is proposed for electric vehicles (EVs). The stator is segmented into two parts to eliminate even-order harmonic fields in the air-gap. The stator tooth is divided into two types, in which the armature tooth is larger in size than the modulation tooth. Both the armature winding and the excitation winding housed in the stator are concentrated windings. Eight U-type permanent magnets (PMs) with the same polarity are housed in the consequent-pole rotor. The machine topology of this proposed machine is illustrated. The characteristics of the CPHES machine, such as the field coupling effect and the segmented stator, are discussed by the analytical model. The multi-objective optimization with sensitivity analysis is used to improve the output capability of the CPHES machine. The optimal outcomes can be obtained by a set of Pareto front. The finite element (FE) method is used to analyze the electromagnetic performances of the CPHES machine, including the air-gap flux density, the flux linkage, the no-load back electromagnetic force (back-EMF), the electromagnetic torque and the cogging torque. A prototype is manufactured and measured to verify the analytical method and the FE-predictions.
title_zh: 一种应用于电动汽车的新型相对极混合励磁电机的分析与优化
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于电动汽车(EV)的新型分段定子混合励磁隐极电机(CPHES电机)。定子被分为两部分,以消除气隙中的偶次谐波磁场。定子齿分为两类,其中电枢齿的尺寸大于调制齿。置于定子中的电枢绕组和励磁绕组均为集中绕组。八个同极性的U型永磁体(PM)置于隐极转子中。阐述了所提电机的拓扑结构。通过解析模型讨论了CPHES电机的特性,如磁场耦合效应和分段定子。采用带灵敏度分析的多目标优化来提高CPHES电机的输出能力。通过一组Pareto前沿获得最优结果。采用有限元(FE)法分析CPHES电机的电磁性能,包括气隙磁通密度、磁链、空载反电动势(back-EMF)、电磁转矩和齿槽转矩。制造并测试了一台样机,以验证解析方法和FE预测结果。

title: Ultrathin nano-layered boron nitride stabilizing perovskite quantum dot-based light-emitting diodes
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Perovskite quantum dot-based light-emitting diodes (QLEDs) have been regarded as promising emitters for lighting and displays. However, the operational stability still greatly hinders their practical applications. Here, we introduce ultrathin nano-layered boron nitride (BN) as buried interfacial layer to enhance device stability. As an effective blocking layer, BN not only interacts with perovskite to passivate interface defects and eliminate ion migration channel, but also directly suppresses ion migration. Meanwhile, BN makes exciton recombination behavior and electrical transport properties of perovskite QDs less sensitive to the heat. Resultantly, BN-optimized QLEDs achieved an average EQE of 30.05% and extrapolated operational lifetime T50 of 25,263 h at an initial luminance (L0) of 100 cd m−2, which is 1.7-fold and about 100-fold improvement compared to control devices, respectively. In this work, integrating 2D materials into perovskites through interface engineering provides a pragmatic tactic to enhance the performance of halide perovskite-based LEDs.
title_zh: 超薄纳米层状氮化硼稳定钙钛矿量子点发光二极管
abstract_zh: 钙钛矿量子点发光二极管（QLED）被认为是极具前景的照明与显示发光体。然而，其工作稳定性仍在很大程度上阻碍实际应用。在此，我们引入超薄纳米层状氮化硼（BN）作为埋底界面层以提升器件稳定性。作为一种有效的阻挡层，BN不仅与钙钛矿相互作用以钝化界面缺陷并消除离子迁移通道，还能直接抑制离子迁移。同时，BN使钙钛矿量子点的激子复合行为和电学传输特性对热的敏感性降低。结果是，经BN优化的QLED在初始亮度（L0）为100 cd m−2下实现了平均30.05%的EQE和外推工作寿命T50达25,263 h，分别比对照器件提高了1.7倍和约100倍。本工作通过界面工程将二维材料整合到钙钛矿中，为提升卤化物钙钛矿基LED的性能提供了一种务实策略。

title: IGNN: An Inference Graph Neural Network for Data Sensitivity Assessment Considering Data Inference Leakage in Cyber-Physical Power Grid
abstract: Modern Cyber-Physical Power Grids (CPPG) rely heavily on fine-grained data exchange, yet they face the concealed threat of Data Inference Leakage (DIL), where attackers infer sensitive parameters from seemingly non-sensitive data. Existing risk assessment methods typically focus on direct cyber-attacks or employ static binary classifications, failing to capture the dynamic risk propagation caused by complex physical and statistical data couplings. To address this, this paper proposes a unified data sensitivity assessment framework based on a novel Inference Graph Neural Network (IGNN). We first construct an inference relation graph that integrates both model-driven and data-driven correlations. An analytic hierarchy process (AHP) model is constructed to calibrate the intrinsic sensitivity baseline. Subsequently, a novel inference-weighted Graph Attention Network (GAT) is developed to quantify the final sensitivity by aggregating the risk propagating through the inference pathways. Experiments on IEEE 30-, 57-bus, ACTIV 200-bus, and case 1354-pegase systems demonstrate that the proposed method effectively quantifies data sensitivity and identifies high-risk data susceptible to DIL, exhibiting strong robustness across different system scales. Quantitative results indicate that the high-sensitivity data identified by our method yield a highly threatening inference accuracy of up to 0.9145, significantly outperforming GCN-based and rule-based benchmarks.
title_zh: IGNN：考虑信息物理电网中数据推理泄露的数据敏感性评估推理图神经网络
abstract_zh: 现代信息物理电力系统（CPPG）高度依赖细粒度的数据交换，但面临数据推理泄露（DIL）的隐蔽威胁，攻击者可从看似非敏感的数据中推断出敏感参数。现有风险评估方法通常关注直接网络攻击或采用静态二分类，无法捕捉由复杂物理与统计数据耦合引起的动态风险传播。为此，本文提出一种基于新型推理图神经网络（IGNN）的统一数据敏感性评估框架。我们首先构建一个融合模型驱动与数据驱动关联的推理关系图；构建层次分析法（AHP）模型以校准固有敏感性基线；随后开发一种新颖的推理加权图注意力网络（GAT），通过聚合沿推理路径传播的风险来量化最终敏感性。在IEEE 30、57节点、ACTIV 200节点以及case 1354-pegase系统上的实验表明，所提方法能有效量化数据敏感性并识别易受DIL影响的高风险数据，在不同系统规模下均表现出很强的鲁棒性。定量结果表明，本方法识别出的高敏感数据可产生高达0.9145的高威胁推理准确率，显著优于基于GCN和基于规则的基准方法。

title: One‐End‐Truncated Au 52 and Au 70 Quantum Rods: High‐Quantum‐Yield NIR‐II Emitters With Aspect‐Ratio‐Dominated Photophysics
abstract: ABSTRACT Precise control over absorption/emission in NIR‐II (1000–1700 nm) is essential for advancing photonic technologies. Atomically precise gold quantum rods (QRs) provide a structurally well‐defined platform for fine‐tuning NIR‐II anisotropic excitonic behavior at the atomic level. In this study, we report Au 52 (PET) 38 and Au 70 (PET) 50 (PET = 2‐phenylethanethiolate) as members of a distinct branch of Au QRs with one‐end‐truncated kernel topology. The Au 52 and Au 70 exhibit NIR‐II absorption at 1032 and 1275 nm and nanosecond fluorescence at 1100 and 1360 nm, respectively. Their high quantum yields (20.9% for Au 52 and 14.8% for Au 70 ) together with high brightness (5.6 × 10 4 M −1 cm −1 for Au 52 and a similar order of magnitude for Au 70 ) substantially exceed those of most molecular NIR‐II dyes, highlighting their promise as efficient inorganic NIR‐II fluorophores. Comparative analysis across two structurally distinct Au QR families, including one‐end‐truncated and double‐pointed rods, reveals that the longitudinal absorption and emission peak wavelengths, as well as the fluorescence linewidths, follow a common aspect‐ratio‐dependent scaling relation, suggesting length‐dependent modulation of the ground‐ and excited‐state electronic structure. These findings uncover a hierarchical interplay between rod elongation and kernel topology in defining NIR‐II excitonic behavior and expand the structural design space of atomically precise QRs.
title_zh: 单端截断的Au 52和Au 70量子棒：具有纵横比主导光物理特性的高量子产率NIR-II发射体
abstract_zh: 摘要 对NIR-II（1000–1700 nm）吸收/发射的精确调控对推进光子技术至关重要。原子精确的金量子棒（QR）为在原子水平精细调控NIR-II各向异性激子行为提供了结构明确平台。本研究报道了Au52(PET)38和Au70(PET)50（PET = 2-苯乙硫醇盐），它们是具有单端截断内核拓扑的独特金量子棒分支的成员。Au52和Au70分别在1032和1275 nm处表现出NIR-II吸收，并在1100和1360 nm处表现出纳秒荧光。它们的高量子产率（Au52为20.9%，Au70为14.8%）以及高亮度（Au52为5.6 × 104 M−1 cm−1，Au70具有相近数量级）大幅超过大多数分子NIR-II染料，凸显了其作为高效无机NIR-II荧光团的前景。对两个结构不同的金量子棒家族（包括单端截断和双尖端棒）的比较分析表明，纵向吸收和发射峰波长以及荧光线宽均遵循共同的依赖于长径比的标度关系，暗示基态和激发态电子结构存在长度依赖的调制。这些发现揭示了棒伸长与内核拓扑在决定NIR-II激子行为上的分层相互作用，并拓展了原子精确量子棒的结构设计空间。

title: Aggregation‐Enhanced Photocleavage for Time‐Resolved Multicolor Fluorescence Encryption and Quaternary Optical Storage
abstract: ABSTRACT Dynamic fluorescence systems capable of generating time‐resolved multicolor optical outputs are highly desirable for advanced information encryption and optical storage. However, precise regulation of fluorescence evolution kinetics remains challenging, as most reported systems either exhibit intrinsically fixed photochemical kinetics or require complex multicomponent assemblies. Herein, we report an aggregation‐regulated photochemical system in which the photocleavage kinetics can be continuously programmed through aggregation‐dependent excited‐state engineering. A donor–acceptor luminogen, TPEMN, with a photocleavable central vinyl bridge was rationally designed. Upon photoirradiation, TPEMN undergoes a pronounced aggregation‐enhanced photooxidative cleavage process in which photoreaction kinetics accelerate progressively with aggregation degree, accompanied by continuous multiple fluorescence evolutions from orange to blue. Systematic experimental and theoretical investigations reveal that aggregation suppresses excited‐state structural relaxation, prolongs excited‐state lifetime, facilitates intersystem crossing, and promotes reactive oxygen species generation, thereby markedly leading to accelerated photocleavage kinetics. This converts conventional binary photoresponses into well‐resolved time‐dependent fluorescence states, allowing demonstration of time‐gated information encryption with deceptive intermediates, multilevel anti‐counterfeiting with “burn‐after‐read” functionality, and high‐density quaternary optical storage. This work establishes aggregation‐regulated excited‐state engineering as a novel paradigm for manipulating photochemical reactivity, providing a conceptual framework for the development of high‐efficiency photoreactions, adaptive stimulus‐responsive materials, and dynamic information applications.
title_zh: 聚集增强光裂解用于时间分辨多色荧光加密和四进制光学存储
abstract_zh: 摘要 能够产生时间分辨多色光输出的动态荧光系统在高级信息加密和光存储领域备受青睐。然而，荧光演化动力学的精确调控仍然具有挑战性，因为大多数已报道的系统要么表现出固化的光化学动力学，要么需要复杂的多组分组装。本文报道一种聚集调控的光化学系统，其中光切割动力学可通过依赖聚集态的激发态工程进行连续编程。我们合理设计了一种在中心乙烯基桥上具有可光切割结构的给体-受体发光体TPEMN。在光照射下，TPEMN经历显著的聚集增强的光氧化切割过程，光反应动力学随聚集程度逐步加快，并伴随从橙色到蓝色的连续多重荧光演化。系统的实验和理论研究揭示，聚集抑制了激发态结构弛豫，延长了激发态寿命，促进了系间窜越并促进了活性氧生成，从而显著加快光切割动力学。这将传统的二元光响应转化为分辨良好的时间依赖荧光态，实现了带欺骗性中间态的时间门控信息加密、具有“阅后即焚”功能的多级防伪以及高密度四元光存储的演示。本工作建立了聚集调控……

title: Leveraging Protein Dynamics for Selective Inhibition of Threonyl‐tRNA Synthetase by Obafluorin Analogs
abstract: ABSTRACT The widespread emergence of antibiotic resistance necessitates the development of novel agents with unique mechanisms of action. Obafluorin (OB), a natural β‐lactone antibiotic, is a covalent inhibitor of threonyl‐tRNA synthetase (ThrRS), but the high conservation of the active site between prokaryote and eukaryote ThrRSs results in minimal selectivity, hindering the therapeutic potential of OB. Here, we report a structure dynamics‐based design strategy that transforms OB into a selective antibacterial agent. OB inhibits human and bacterial ThrRSs with nearly equal potency due to identical binding modes. The nitrophenyl moiety of OB is proposed as a ‘kinetic sensor’ that discriminates between sensitive and resistant ThrRS paralogs. Guided by this insight, we designed a series of OB analogs through rational modification of this moiety. Among them, OB‐D4 bearing a para ‐methoxyphenyl group in place of the nitrophenyl group, exhibited a 241‐fold selectivity for bacterial over human ThrRS, along with a markedly improved safety profile with minimal cytotoxicity. In a murine skin infection model, OB‐D4 effectively eradicated pathogens, resolving inflammation, and promoting wound healing. Together, this work establishes a ‘kinetic sensor’ strategy for achieving species selectivity, turning a fundamental challenge in drug discovery‐high active‐site conservation—into an exploitable opportunity based on dynamic differences.
title_zh: 利用蛋白质动力学实现Obafluorin类似物对苏氨酰-tRNA合成酶的选择性抑制
abstract_zh: 摘要 抗生素耐药性的广泛出现亟需开发具有独特作用机制的新型药物。Obafluorin（OB）是一种天然β-内酯类抗生素，是苏氨酰-tRNA合成酶（ThrRS）的共价抑制剂，但原核与真核ThrRS活性位点的高度保守性导致其选择性极低，限制了OB的治疗潜力。在此，我们报道了一种基于结构动力学的设计策略，将OB转化为选择性抗菌剂。由于相同的结合模式，OB以近乎相等的效力抑制人和细菌ThrRS。OB的硝基苯基部分被视为能够区分敏感与耐药ThrRS同源物的“动力学传感器”。在此认识指导下，我们通过对该基团的合理改造设计了一系列OB类似物。其中，以对甲氧基苯基取代硝基苯基的OB-D4对细菌ThrRS相对于人ThrRS表现出241倍的选择性，同时安全性显著改善、细胞毒性极低。在小鼠皮肤感染模型中，OB-D4有效清除病原体、消除炎症并促进伤口愈合。总之，本工作建立了实现物种选择性的“动力学传感器”策略，将药物发现中的基本挑战——活性位点高度保守——转化为基于动力学差异的可利用机遇。

title: Co‐Assembled Mirror‐Image DNA Nanostructure for Effective Alleviation of Acute Kidney Injury
abstract: ABSTRACT The high demand for acute kidney injury (AKI) therapy calls for the development of new therapeutics for renal management. Oxidative stress, coupled with excessive inflammation, is the main pathological mechanism for AKI. Specifically, complement component 5a (C5a) exacerbates the vicious cycle between oxidative stress and inflammatory responses. Herein, we developed a cascade‐functioning mirror‐image DNA nanostructure, L‐DNA tetrahedron (LDT), for sequentially blocking the extracellular complement C5a to alleviate inflammation and eliminating intracellular reactive oxygen species (ROS) to inhibit oxidative stress. A C5a‐neutralizing mirror‐image aptamer (LA) was incorporated into LDT via a ROS‐sensitive linker (thioketal, i.e., TK bond), which enabled the release of LA in the inflammatory microenvironment to block C5a. LA‐conjugated LDT (LDT‐LA) exhibited preferential renal uptake and enhanced renal retention compared with its counterpart made of D‐nucleic acids and provided effective treatment in ischemia‐reperfusion (I/R)‐, cisplatin‐, and glycerol‐induced AKI mouse models. Meanwhile, LDT‐LA exhibits excellent biocompatibility, making it a promising candidate for AKI therapy. The biostable, cascade‐functioning LDT‐LA could act as a multifunctional platform for the treatment of other diseases by conjugating with appropriate functional groups.
title_zh: 共组装镜像DNA纳米结构用于有效缓解急性肾损伤
abstract_zh: 摘要 急性肾损伤（AKI）治疗的高需求呼吁开发新的肾病治疗药物。氧化应激 coupled with 过度炎症是AKI的主要病理机制。特别是，补体成分5a（C5a）加剧了氧化应激与炎症反应之间的恶性循环。在此，我们开发了一种级联功能的镜像DNA纳米结构——L-DNA四面体（LDT），可依次阻断细胞外补体C5a以减轻炎症，并清除细胞内活性氧（ROS）以抑制氧化应激。通过ROS敏感连接子（硫缩酮，即TK键）将C5a中和镜像适配体（LA）整合到LDT中，使其在炎症微环境中释放LA以阻断C5a。与D-核酸对应物相比，LA偶联的LDT（LDT-LA）表现出优先的肾脏摄取和增强的肾脏滞留，并在缺血-再灌注（I/R）、顺铂和甘油诱导的AKI小鼠模型中提供了有效治疗。同时，LDT-LA具有优异的生物相容性，使其成为AKI治疗的有前景候选药物。生物稳定的、级联功能的LDT-LA可通过偶联适当的功能基团，作为治疗其他疾病的多功能平台。

title: Integrated DES‐Mediated Extraction and In Situ Polymerization Toward Coal Tar Phenolic‐Derived Defective Porous Carbon for High‐Energy‐Density Zinc‐Ion Hybrid Capacitors
abstract: ABSTRACT This work establishes a facile and integrated strategy combining deep eutectic solvent (DES) selective extraction and in situ polymerization to upcycle low‐value coal tar phenolics into high‐performance defective porous carbon for zinc‐ion hybrid capacitors (ZIHCs). Benefiting from strong hydrogen‐bonding interaction, aldehyde‐functionalized DES achieves efficient separation of phenolic components from coal tar with an extraction efficiency up to 94.73%. Eliminating tedious back‐extraction procedures, the phenolic‐enriched system realizes pH‐regulated in situ polymerization to fabricate three types of phenolic resin precursors with distinct molecular architectures. The three‐dimensional, oxygen‐rich precursor formed under alkaline conditions induces steric hindrance that suppresses aromatic stacking during carbonization, yielding highly defective porous carbon. Combined with rational activation treatment, all derived carbon materials exhibit well‐developed pore structures and favorable capacitive performance. Notably, the extraction phase is innovatively reused to fabricate a highly conductive gel electrolyte. The assembled ZIHC using prepared porous carbon and gel electrolyte achieves a favorable specific capacity of 257.9 mAh g −1 , a high energy density of 186.9 Wh kg −1 , and ultra‐long cycling durability. This study clarifies the intrinsic correlation between precursor microstructure, carbon defect configuration and electrochemical energy storage behavior, and provides a new strategy for high‐value sustainable utilization of coal tar toward advanced energy storage devices.
title_zh: DES介导萃取与原位聚合一体化制备煤焦油酚类衍生缺陷多孔碳用于高能量密度锌离子混合电容器
abstract_zh: 摘要 本工作建立了一种简便且一体化的策略，将深度共熔溶剂（DES）选择性提取与原位聚合相结合，将低价值煤焦油酚类物质升级回收为用于锌离子混合电容器（ZIHCs）的高性能缺陷多孔碳。得益于强氢键相互作用，醛功能化DES实现了煤焦油中酚类组分的高效分离，提取效率高达94.73%。免除了繁琐的反萃取步骤，富酚体系实现了pH调控的原位聚合，制备出三种具有不同分子结构的酚醛树脂前驱体。在碱性条件下形成的三维富氧前驱体产生空间位阻，抑制了碳化过程中的芳香堆积，从而获得高缺陷多孔碳。结合合理的活化处理，所有衍生碳材料均表现出发育良好的孔结构和良好的电容性能。值得注意的是，提取相被创新性地再利用以制备高导电性凝胶电解质。使用所制备多孔碳和凝胶电解质组装的ZIHC实现了257.9 mAh g−1的优良比容量、186.9 Wh kg−1的高能量密度以及超长循环耐久性。本研究阐明了前驱体微观结构、碳缺陷构型与电化学储能行为之间的内在关联，并为煤焦油面向先进储能的高价值可持续利用提供了新策略。

title: Designing Multilayered Photoanodes for Broad‐Scope Thiol Trifluoromethylation
abstract: ABSTRACT Broad substrate generality in radical organic synthesis is often limited by the kinetic mismatch between substrate‐dependent radical generation and the rapid, nonselective reactivity of highly active radical species. In this study, we report the development of Co 2 P‐loaded carbon nitride (CN) dots as a cocatalyst for WO 3 films, creating a multilayered photoanode designated as Co 2 P@CN‐WO 3 . Under 450 nm irradiation, the model reaction of p ‐methylthiophenol with trifluoromethanesulfonyl chloride resulted in 4‐(trifluoromethylthio)toluene, achieving a conversion of 95%, a selectivity of 91%, and an overall yield of 86.5%. The photoanode retained ca. 80% activity after 84 h of continuous operation. The protocol was remarkably applicable to 84 thiol substrates, and the yields of 16 challenging substrates can be further optimized by adjusting the parameters of the photoelectrocatalysis (PEC) system. Mechanistic studies reveal that the CN layer improves substrate–interface contact, whereas Co 2 P serves as a catalytically active site for sulfur‐centered radical generation and S─CF 3 bond formation, promoting this thiol trifluoromethylation. This work provides a photoelectrode design strategy for achieving broad‐scope radical transformations by PEC.
title_zh: 设计多层光阳极用于广谱硫醇三氟甲基化
abstract_zh: 摘要 自由基有机合成中的宽泛底物普适性常受限于底物依赖的自由基生成与高活性自由基物种快速、非选择性反应性之间的动力学失配。在本研究中，我们报道了负载Co2P的氮化碳（CN）量子点作为WO3薄膜的助催化剂，构建了命名为Co2P@CN-WO3的多层光阳极。在450 nm光照下，对甲基苯硫酚与三氟甲磺酰氯的模型反应生成4-(三氟甲硫基)甲苯，转化率达95%，选择性为91%，总产率为86.5%。该光阳极在连续运行84小时后仍保持约80%的活性。该方案 remarkably 适用于84种硫醇底物，其中16种 challenging 底物的产率可通过调节光电催化（PEC）系统参数进一步优化。机理研究表明，CN层改善了底物-界面接触，而Co2P则作为硫中心自由基生成和S─CF3键形成的催化活性位点，促进了该硫醇三氟甲基化反应。这项工作为实现PEC宽范围自由基转化提供了一种光电极设计策略。

title: Using X-ray free electron lasers to explore extreme states under quasi-static compression
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The exceptional brilliance of X-ray free electron lasers (XFELs) combined with quasi-static compression in diamond anvil cells (DACs) has enabled novel time-resolved methods for probing extreme states of matter. Coupling serial X-ray techniques with dynamic drivers for rapidly changing pressure and temperature, these studies offer insight into phase equilibria, chemical reaction kinetics, and geophysical processes. Here, we present the current state-of-the-art XFEL techniques used for DAC research, including serial X-ray heating, pulsed laser heating, and rapid compression. Essential questions for future investigation are also highlighted, regarding the interactions of intense X-rays with samples at high pressure and associated non-equilibrium states.
title_zh: 利用X射线自由电子激光探索准静态压缩下的极端状态
abstract_zh: X射线自由电子激光（XFELs）的卓越亮度与金刚石对顶砧（DACs）中的准静态压缩相结合，催生了探测物质极端状态的新型时间分辨方法。通过将串行X射线技术与压力和温度快速变化的动态驱动相结合，这些研究为认识相平衡、化学反应动力学和地球物理过程提供了洞察。在此，我们介绍了用于DAC研究的当前最先进的XFEL技术，包括串行X射线加热、脉冲激光加热和快速压缩。我们还强调了未来研究的关键问题，涉及强X射线与高压下样品的相互作用及相关的非平衡态。

title: Lyapunov exponents explain disorder-induced polarization and soliton jumping in a mechanical Markov system
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Using a mapping between spatial disorder and temporal stochasticity, we develop a new framework using Lyapunov exponents to explain exotic wave localization and mobility phenomena in disordered one-dimensional (1D) mechanical systems that can be constructed via a spatial analog of a Markov process, which we call “mechanical Markov systems.” We show that disorder induces robust polarization of zero modes (ZMs) in these mechanical Markov systems, and this phenomenon is explained using Lyapunov exponents. Remarkably, these ZMs become mobile solitons in the nonlinear regime despite the disorder-controlled localization of all other modes, and display a set of new nonlinear dynamics features including reflectionless chirality-dependent jumping, which can also be explained using Lyapunov exponents. Our results establish the Markov formalism as a powerful tool to explain and design localization and dynamics in disordered mechanical systems, opening opportunities for programmable metamaterials with novel linear and nonlinear responses.
title_zh: 李雅普诺夫指数解释机械马尔可夫系统中无序诱导的极化与孤子跃迁
abstract_zh: 利用空间无序与时间随机性之间的映射，我们开发了一个基于Lyapunov指数的新框架，以解释无序一维（1D）力学系统中奇异的波局域化和迁移现象，这些系统可通过马尔可夫过程的空间类比来构建，我们称之为“力学马尔可夫系统”。我们证明，无序在这些力学马尔可夫系统中诱导零模（ZMs）的稳健极化，并利用Lyapunov指数解释了这一现象。值得注意的是，尽管其他所有模式都受无序控制的局域化影响，这些零模在非线性区域成为可移动的孤子，并表现出一系列新的非线性动力学特征，包括无反射的手性依赖跳跃，这同样可用Lyapunov指数加以解释。我们的结果确立了马尔可夫形式体系作为解释和设计无序力学系统中局域化与动力学的强大工具，为具有新型线性和非线性响应的可编程超材料开辟了机遇。

title: The changing surface of the world’s roads
source: Scientific community and society : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Resilient road infrastructure is a cornerstone of the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), yet spatially consistent information on road surface conditions at the global scale remains limited. We overcome this gap based on a deep learning framework that extracts both road pavedness and road width from Planetscope satellite imagery. Thereby, mapping 95.5% of 9.2 million km of critical arterial roads for 2020 and 2024, nearly half of which was previously unclassified.The resulting dataset and multi-scale analytical framework enable assessments of road infrastructure in the context of development, climate adaptation, and equity.Unlike proxies such as nighttime lights, the data directly captures the physical infrastructure underpinning resilience at higher spatial resolution.This dataset reveals a multi-scale geography of human development, capturing infrastructure investment and accessibility at the planetary scale, enabling a global Humanitarian Passability Matrix for humanitarian logistics, while also providing local insights into road disparities—for example, revealing governance-related patterns in Ghana and highlighting climate-related vulnerabilities in Pakistan.
title_zh: 世界道路表面正在改变
abstract_zh: 韧性道路基础设施是联合国可持续发展目标（SDGs）的基石，然而全球尺度上空间一致的道路路面状况信息仍然有限。我们基于一个从Planetscope卫星影像中同时提取道路铺装状态和道路宽度的深度学习框架克服了这一空白。由此对2020年和2024年920万公里关键干线道路中的95.5%进行了制图，其中近一半此前未被分类。所得到的数据集和多尺度分析框架能够在发展、气候适应和公平性的背景下评估道路基础设施。与夜间灯光等代理指标不同，该数据以更高的空间分辨率直接捕捉支撑韧性的物理基础设施。该数据集揭示了人类发展的多尺度地理格局，在行星尺度上捕捉基础设施投资与可达性，支持面向人道主义物流的全球人道通行性矩阵，同时提供道路差异的局部洞察——例如揭示加纳与治理相关的模式，并凸显巴基斯坦与气候相关的脆弱性。

title: Nuclear-Powered Hybrid Energy System for Clean Hydrogen Production: Time-Step-Optimized Real-Time Multi-Domain Hardware Emulation
abstract: Increasing global emphasis on decarbonization and the proliferation of renewable energy, energy storage, and nuclear power is driving a surge of research interest into integrated sustainable energy modeling, simulation, operation and control. Traditional electromagnetic transient (EMT) methods typically discretize electrical networks using the trapezoidal rule. When coupled with the ordinary differential equations (ODEs) of other physical domains, however, the absolute stability region of the numerical integration scheme can shift, and discrepancies in time constants across subsystems further complicate integration of disparate models. While the demand for integrating EMT with multi-domain co-simulations is increasing, existing commercial EMT simulation tools either lack support for multi-domain physical coupling or are not specifically optimized for such hybrid simulations. To address this gap, this paper proposes a robust multiscale time-step estimation (RMTE) framework that enables real-time co-simulation of EMT networks and multi-domain subsystems. The framework includes a fast, efficient, and adaptive approach for selecting the optimal maximum time-step across heterogeneous physical domains. The proposed method is validated through a case study involving small modular reactors (SMRs), wind farm, photovoltaics (PV) and low-temperature proton exchange membrane (PEM) electrolysis for clean hydrogen production. Real-time hardware co-emulation is achieved on a field-programmable gate array (FPGA)-based platform. The results demonstrate significant improvements in simulation efficiency and execution time.
title_zh: 用于清洁制氢的核能混合能源系统：时间步长优化的实时多域硬件仿真
abstract_zh: 全球对脱碳的日益重视以及可再生能源、储能和核电的快速普及，正在推动对综合可持续能源建模、仿真、运行与控制的研究热潮。传统电磁暂态（EMT）方法通常采用梯形法对电网进行离散化。然而，当与其他物理域的常微分方程（ODEs）耦合时，数值积分格式的绝对稳定区域可能发生偏移，且各子系统之间时间常数的差异进一步增加了不同模型集成的复杂性。尽管将EMT与多域联合仿真的集成需求日益增长，现有商业EMT仿真工具要么缺乏对多域物理耦合的支持，要么未针对此类混合仿真进行专门优化。为弥补这一空白，本文提出了一种鲁棒多尺度时间步长估计（RMTE）框架，可实现EMT电网与多域子系统的实时联合仿真。该框架包含一种快速、高效且自适应的方法，用于在异构物理域之间选择最优的最大时间步长。所提出的方法通过一个涉及小型模块化反应堆（SMRs）、风电场、光伏（PV）以及用于清洁制氢的低温质子交换膜（PEM）电解的案例研究进行了验证。基于现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）的平台实现了实时硬件联合仿真。结果证明了仿真性能的显著提升

title: Performance Analysis of a Rare-Earth-Free Axial Flux Permanent Magnet Motor Using a PCB Stator
abstract: Simplicity in structure and minimal material usage are key factors in reducing manufacturing costs, which is essential for staying competitive in the global market of mass-produced sub-fractional horsepower brushless permanent magnet motors. This paper analyzes the performance of an axial flux permanent magnet motor using a printed circuit board (PCB) stator for sub-fractional horsepower drives that – in contrast to the coreless PCB motors – employs a ferrite core. The investigation shows that, despite this seemingly added cost, the overall motor not only exhibits superior performance compared to the conventional structure but actually comes at reduced cost. This is because low-cost ferrite magnets can be used instead of rare-earth magnets, and the core shape being optimized for cost-efficient PCB integration. The motor structure and key design considerations are described, and a specialized test rig is introduced to address the unique measurement challenges of sub-fractional horsepower machines. The motor’s performance is analyzed theoretically and experimentally under both no-load and load conditions. The findings confirm the potential of the investigated motor topology for radial fan applications.
title_zh: 采用PCB定子的无稀土轴向磁通永磁电机性能分析
abstract_zh: 结构简单和材料用量少是降低制造成本的关键因素，而这对于在大批量生产的小分马力无刷永磁电机的全球市场中保持竞争力至关重要。本文分析了一种采用印刷电路板（PCB）定子的轴向磁通永磁电机在小分马力驱动中的性能，与无铁芯PCB电机不同，该电机采用了铁氧体铁芯。研究表明，尽管看似增加了成本，但该电机整体不仅比传统结构表现出更优越的性能，实际上成本反而更低。这是因为可以使用低成本的铁氧体磁体代替稀土磁体，并且铁芯形状针对成本高效的PCB集成进行了优化。本文描述了电机结构和关键设计考虑，并介绍了一个专用测试台，以应对小分马力电机独特的测量挑战。在空载和负载条件下，对该电机的性能进行了理论和实验分析。研究结果证实了所研究电机拓扑在径向风机应用中的潜力。

title: Admittance Reshaping Method for Charging Current Ripple Suppression of the Battery Energy Storage System Under Distorted Grid Conditions
abstract: Grid voltage background harmonics can induce harmonic currents in the energy storage converter (ESC). Furthermore, the frequency-coupling characteristic of the battery energy storage system (BESS), which induces new harmonic current components, can result in current ripple during battery charging. This paper proposes an admittance-reshaping method to mitigate the influence of grid background harmonics on the battery charging current of the BESS. Firstly, the small-signal admittance model of the ESC is established. Then, a theoretical analysis and mathematical derivation of the charging current ripple are conducted. The general forms of the inner current-control loop and outer power-control loop admittance-reshaping factors are then developed to reshape the admittance model into a symmetrical system within the dq frame, as a result, the harmonic components are reduced. Furthermore, the admittance-reshaping factors’ parameters are appropriately selected to reduce the magnitude of harmonics. By decoupling the system and lowering the admittance value of the ESC, the quality of the grid-connected current is improved, while simultaneously suppressing the charging current ripple. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed admittance-reshaping method are verified by the presented simulation and experimental results.
title_zh: 畸变电网条件下电池储能系统充电电流纹波抑制的导纳重塑方法
abstract_zh: 电网电压背景谐波会在储能变流器（ESC）中诱发谐波电流。此外，电池储能系统（BESS）的频率耦合特性会诱发新的谐波电流分量，可能导致电池充电过程中的电流纹波。本文提出了一种导纳重塑方法，以减轻电网背景谐波对BESS电池充电电流的影响。首先，建立了ESC的小信号导纳模型。然后，对充电电流纹波进行了理论分析和数学推导。接着，给出了电流内环和功率外环导纳重塑因子的一般形式，将导纳模型重塑为dq坐标系下的对称系统，从而减小谐波分量。此外，通过适当选取导纳重塑因子的参数来降低谐波的幅值。通过解耦系统并降低ESC的导纳值，提高了并网电流质量，同时抑制了充电电流纹波。仿真和实验结果验证了所提导纳重塑方法的可行性和有效性。

title: Profit-Driven Adaptive Uncertainty Modeling for HVAC Systems Participation in Joint Energy and Regulation Markets
abstract: This paper presents a profit-driven adaptive uncertainty modeling framework for automatic generation control (AGC) signals to support bidding in joint energy and regulation markets. Conventional methods typically characterize uncertainty by minimizing estimation error, which is often misaligned with economic objectives and results in suboptimal decisions. To bridge this gap, a profit-driven bilevel optimization model is developed to jointly optimize the parameters of the uncertainty set and market bids, ensuring consistency between uncertainty representation and decision-making objectives. To address the geometric rigidity of traditional uncertainty sets and enhance the effectiveness of the proposed framework, this paper introduces an input-convex neural network–based uncertainty set (ICNN-US) capable of representing arbitrary convex shapes. A hypernetwork is further integrated to dynamically adapt the ICNN-US to varying optimization model parameters, enabling adaptive and context-aware uncertainty modeling. The framework incorporates a differentiable optimization layer to ensure computational tractability and enable efficient end-to-end training via gradient-based methods. Case studies based on real-world data demonstrate that the proposed framework improves economic performance by 5.86% compared with conventional estimation-oriented methods while consistently maintaining dispatch feasibility for AGC signal deployment.
title_zh: 面向HVAC系统参与能量与调节联合市场的利润驱动自适应不确定性建模
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种面向利润的AGC信号自适应不确定性建模框架，以支持在能量与调节联合市场中的投标。传统方法通常通过最小化估计误差来刻画不确定性，这往往与经济目标不一致，导致决策次优。为弥合这一差距，本文开发了一个利润驱动的双层优化模型，联合优化不确定性集合的参数和市场投标，确保不确定性表征与决策目标之间的一致性。为解决传统不确定性集合的几何刚性并增强所提框架的有效性，本文引入了基于输入凸神经网络的不确定性集合（ICNN-US），能够表示任意凸形状。进一步集成了超网络，使ICNN-US能够动态适应不断变化的优化模型参数，实现自适应且情境感知的不确定性建模。该框架结合了可微分优化层，以确保计算的可处理性，并通过基于梯度的方法实现高效的端到端训练。基于真实数据的案例研究表明，与传统面向估计的方法相比，所提框架的经济性能提升了5.86%，同时在AGC信号部署中始终保持调度可行性。

title: Surrogate Models in Power System Scheduling Problems: Learning Active Constraints via Graph Neural Networks
abstract: Power system scheduling problems are solved repeatedly and require fast computation for real time deployment of asset setpoints. Bilevel optimization is often employed due to its ability to capture the hierarchical structure between network operators and end users. However, the inherent complexity of bilevel models makes repeated solutions computationally expensive. To address this, we propose a surrogate modeling approach that predicts the set of active constraints in the full bilevel formulation, thereby significantly reducing computational effort. Rather than relying on extensive sampling over uncertain parameters, we exploit the bipartite graph structure of optimization problems and apply Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to learn constraint activity directly by leveraging the intrinsic geometric dependencies of the optimization models. We evaluate the end to end approach by comparing the surrogate objective values and computational speedup against the original problem, benchmarking against Random Forest (RF) and Feed-foward Neural Network (FNN) classifiers across a range of increasingly complex test cases, from linear programming problems to mixed integer linear programming and bilevel problems. Results show that GNN based models, which encode mathematical properties like complementary slackness and binary activations to reduce model complexity, achieve up to 10-20x speedup with an objective deviation under 4% and a 99% optimality ratio. This represents superior performance to RFs and FNN, highlighting the suitability of GNNs for directly encoding the mathematical structure of optimization models, thanks to its inherent topology awareness to solve complex constraint activity prediction tasks in power system scheduling.
title_zh: 电力系统调度问题中的代理模型：基于图神经网络学习有效约束
abstract_zh: 电力系统调度问题需要反复求解，并且为了实时部署资产设定点需要快速计算。由于能够刻画网络运营商与终端用户之间的层次结构，双层优化常被采用。然而，双层模型固有的复杂性使得反复求解在计算上代价高昂。为此，我们提出了一种代理建模方法，用于预测完整双层模型中起作用约束的集合，从而显著降低计算量。我们不依赖对不确定参数的大量采样，而是利用优化问题的二部图结构，并应用图神经网络（GNN），通过利用优化模型的内在几何依赖性直接学习约束活动性。我们通过将代理目标值和计算加速与原问题进行比较来评估该端到端方法，并在一系列复杂度递增的测试案例（从线性规划问题到混合整数线性规划和双层问题）上与随机森林（RF）和前馈神经网络（FNN）分类器进行了基准测试。结果表明，编码了互补松弛和二元激活等数学特性以降低模型复杂度的基于GNN的模型，实现了高达10-20倍的加速，目标偏差低于4%，最优性比率达99%。这优于RF和FNN的性能，凸显了GNN直接编码数学结构的适用性。

title: Autonomous Fixed-Time Model Predictive Control for Decentralized Coordination and Stabilization of Hybrid Fuel Cell/Battery/Supercapacitor Systems
abstract: For the fuel cell/battery/supercapacitor hybrid energy storage system (HESS) with constant power loads (CPLs), its controller needs to meet desired control goals, including decentralized dynamic power sharing, fast voltage regulation, large signal stabilization, reliability, and scalability. To this end, this paper proposes an autonomous fixed-time model predictive control (FxTMPC), which aims to achieve the above objectives with less system prior knowledge and sampling cost. First, the fixed-time disturbance observer (FxTDO) is constructed to estimate and feed-forward compensate for unknown and time-varying source-load side information, which not only reduces controller design complexity but also significantly improves robustness against disturbances. Second, the receding horizon optimization problem is solved offline based on source-load estimation variables, and FxTMPC is obtained by embedding fixed-time algorithms into the framework to correct the reference trajectory. Then, a decentralized hybrid droop control (DHDC) based on FxTMPC is developed, which achieves virtual impedance/resistance/capacitance at output terminals by modifying voltage reference values, not only enables different types of sources to respond to low/mid/high-frequency components of the load respectively, but also to reduce sensor usage with the assistance of FxTDO, thus achieving above the desired objectives with low cost. Finally, simulation and experimental results under multiple scenarios demonstrate that the proposed control strategy achieves HESS objectives with less prior knowledge and sensors, while comparative studies confirm its superiority.
title_zh: 混合燃料电池/电池/超级电容器系统分散协调与稳定的自主固定时间模型预测控制
abstract_zh: 对于带有恒功率负载（CPL）的燃料电池/电池/超级电容器混合储能系统（HESS），其控制器需要满足期望的控制目标，包括分散式动态功率分配、快速电压调节、大信号稳定、可靠性和可扩展性。为此，本文提出了一种自治固定时间模型预测控制（FxTMPC），旨在以更少的系统先验知识和采样成本实现上述目标。首先，构造固定时间扰动观测器（FxTDO）来估计并对未知的时变源荷侧信息进行前馈补偿，这不仅降低了控制器设计复杂度，还显著提高了抗扰鲁棒性。其次，基于源荷估计变量离线求解滚动时域优化问题，并通过在框架中嵌入固定时间算法来修正参考轨迹，从而得到FxTMPC。然后，开发了基于FxTMPC的分散式混合下垂控制（DHDC），通过修改电压参考值在输出端实现虚拟阻抗/电阻/电容，不仅使不同类型的电源分别响应负载的低/中/高频分量，还借助FxTDO减少了传感器的使用，从而以低成本实现上述期望目标。最后，多种场景下的仿真和实验结果表明，所提控制策略以更少的先验知识和传感器实现了HESS的目标。

title: Detection of Out-of-Distribution Power Quality Disturbance Using Dual-Channel Gramian Angular Field With Enhanced Mahalanobis Distance
abstract: Deep learning methods for the power quality disturbance (PQD) classification encounter significant deployment challenges in power system applications. With the increasing integration of renewable energy, electric vehicles, and other non-traditional loads, the out-of-distribution (OOD) data occurs frequently due to evolving power system conditions, which represents a critical yet underexplored challenge. In this study, the OOD problem in the PQD classification is formally defined, where models encounter the absence of disturbance patterns during training. Leveraging the unique characteristics of PQD data, a four-stage multimodal OOD detection method is developed for the OOD-driven framework to enhance PQD classification. The proposed method first transforms PQD waveforms into dual-channel Gramian Angular Field (GAF) maps, then extracts discriminative features with vision Transformers. Mahalanobis distance is employed for OOD scoring, and a multimodal auxiliary criterion is introduced to enhance the distinction between in-distribution (IND) and OOD. Comprehensive case studies are conducted using both simulated IEEE standard-compliant waveforms and practical PQD data. Results applied to the simulated PQD data demonstrate that the proposed method can achieve a 2.10% of false positive rate at 90% true positive recall (FPR90), outperforming all previous methods. Practical applications demonstrate a remarkable 9.64% improvement in the PQD classification accuracy compared to the unfiltered dataset containing OOD samples.
title_zh: 基于双通道格拉姆角场与增强马氏距离的电能质量扰动分布外检测
abstract_zh: 用于电能质量扰动（PQD）分类的深度学习方法在电力系统应用中面临显著的部署挑战。随着可再生能源、电动汽车和其他非传统负载的日益接入，由于电力系统运行条件的不断演变，分布外（OOD）数据频繁出现，这是一个关键但尚未充分探索的挑战。在本研究中，正式定义了PQD分类中的OOD问题，即模型在训练期间缺失某些扰动模式。利用PQD数据的独特特性，为OOD驱动的框架开发了一种四阶段多模态OOD检测方法，以增强PQD分类。所提方法首先将PQD波形转换为双通道格拉姆角场（GAF）图，然后利用视觉Transformer提取判别特征。采用马氏距离进行OOD评分，并引入多模态辅助判据以增强分布内（IND）与OOD之间的区分。基于符合IEEE标准的仿真波形和实际PQD数据开展了全面的案例研究。应用于仿真PQD数据的结果表明，所提方法在90%真阳性召回率下的假阳性率（FPR90）可达2.10%，优于以往所有方法。实际应用表明，与包含OOD样本的未过滤数据集相比，PQD分类准确率显著提升了9.64%。

title: Forecasting-Aided State Estimation in Distribution Networks Considering Behind-the-Meter Resources
abstract: Distribution system state estimation (DSSE) is essential in active distribution networks (ADNs). However, new emerging load demands, including the profiles of behind-the-meter (BTM) resources and responsive loads, increase the uncertainty during pseudo-measurement generation. Most existing methods struggle to accurately generate pseudo measurements of load demands incorporating the BTM resources. To address this, a dynamic equivalent model (DEM) for each node within the distribution system is constructed using the Numerical algorithm for Subspace State Space System IDentification (N4SID) algorithm to mimic the dynamics of these nodes. These DEMs are then integrated into an unscented Kalman filter (UKF) to predict and refine the measurements. The output of the UKF stage is utilized to perform the state estimation process using forecasting-aided state estimation (FASE). The proposed approach was tested and validated using the modified IEEE-123 tests system. The numerical results demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed DEMs, reducing the mean absolute error (MAE) from 5.90 kW, achieved by the state-of-the-art deep learning models, to 2.69 kW with UKF prediction and further to 1.64 kW with UKF correction.
title_zh: 考虑表后资源的配电网预测辅助状态估计
abstract_zh: 配电系统状态估计（DSSE）在有源配电网（ADN）中至关重要。然而，包括表后（BTM）资源和响应性负荷特性在内的新兴负荷需求，增加了伪测量生成过程中的不确定性。大多数现有方法难以准确生成包含BTM资源的负荷需求伪测量。为此，利用子空间状态空间系统辨识数值算法（N4SID）为配电系统中的每个节点构建动态等效模型（DEM），以模拟这些节点的动态特性。然后将这些DEM集成到无迹卡尔曼滤波器（UKF）中，以预测和修正测量值。UKF阶段的输出被用于通过预测辅助状态估计（FASE）执行状态估计过程。所提出的方法在改进的IEEE-123测试系统上进行了测试和验证。数值结果证明了所提出的DEM的有效性，将最先进的深度学习模型实现的平均绝对误差（MAE）从5.90 kW降低到UKF预测的2.69 kW，并进一步通过UKF修正降至1.64 kW。

title: An Improved Radial Displacement Control Considering Mass Difference Between Two Shaft Ends to Increase the Rotor Fatigue Life
abstract: Notch filters (NFs) are widely applied in the five-degrees of freedom (5-DoFs) magnetic levitation motors to reduce the vibration near the resonant frequency. However, due to the existence of axial thrust disk, rotor masses at the two ends of the shaft are generally different. It not only increases the difficulty of NF design, but also reduces of fatigue life of rotor system. Therefore, a cross displacement control (CDC) method is proposed in this paper to synchronize the displacements at the two ends, which reduces the number of NFs and improves the fatigue life of rotor system. Simulation and experimental results show that the fatigue life of rotor system can be improved by 17.70 times, 21% and 10% at 4000 r/min, 10000 r/min and 20000 r/min, respectively. On the basis of that, the phase-shift NF can also be added to reduce the vibration near the resonant frequency. Experimental results verify that the fatigue life of rotor system can be improved by 26.5% near the resonant frequency with proposed strategy, and the adjustable time of displacement can also be reduced by 51.7%.
title_zh: 考虑两轴端质量差异以提高转子疲劳寿命的改进径向位移控制
abstract_zh: 陷波滤波器（NF）广泛应用于五自由度（5-DoFs）磁悬浮电机中，以降低谐振频率附近的振动。然而，由于轴向推力盘的存在，转轴两端的转子质量通常不同。这不仅增加了陷波滤波器设计的难度，也降低了转子系统的疲劳寿命。因此，本文提出了一种交叉位移控制（CDC）方法来同步两端的位移，从而减少陷波滤波器的数量并提高转子系统的疲劳寿命。仿真和实验结果表明，在4000 r/min、10000 r/min和20000 r/min下，转子系统的疲劳寿命分别可提高17.70倍、21%和10%。在此基础上，还可以加入移相陷波滤波器来降低谐振频率附近的振动。实验结果验证了采用所提策略后，谐振频率附近转子系统的疲劳寿命可提高26.5%，位移调节时间也可减少51.7%。

title: Space‐Confined Water Isotope Transport in Conductive MOF Thin Film
abstract: ABSTRACT The century‐old challenge of isotope separation might be addressed by conductive metal–organic framework (cMOF) thin films featuring ordered nanopores, designable charge‐transport pathways, and potential flexibility. However, resolving and amplifying the microscopic kinetic differences between water isotopologues within such confined spaces remains nontrivial. In this work, proton‐ and electron‐coupled two‐dimensional π‐conjugated cMOF thin films (Cu 1 TPB 0.1 − x C) are fabricated through controllable layer‐by‐layer growth with oriented narrow pores and flexibility. Correlating electrical‐ and mass‐transduced gas‐sensor technologies, the subtle differences in the interactions of H 2 O and D 2 O with the framework were identified, revealing a complex multistage mass transport. Comparison of cMOFs with different pore sizes shows that this identification originates from distinct conduction mechanisms. Notably, the Cu 1 TPB 0.1 − x C thin film with a strong space‐confined effect exhibits a complex multistage electrical response due to its unique proton–electron‐coupled conduction characteristics, thereby enabling further differentiation of the transport processes of H 2 O and D 2 O on the outer surface and within the confined spaces. The oriented cMOF films therefore provide a real‐time platform for resolving and amplifying subtle isotope‐dependent transport dynamics in confined pores, offering mechanistic guidance for the design of porous materials with controlled water‐isotopologue transport.
title_zh: 导电MOF薄膜中空间限域的水同位素传输
abstract_zh: 摘要 导电金属有机骨架（cMOF）薄膜具有有序纳米孔、可设计的电荷传输路径和潜在的柔性，有望解决同位素分离这一百年难题。然而，在此类受限空间内解析并放大水同位素体之间微观动力学差异仍非易事。在本工作中，通过可控的逐层生长制备了具有取向窄孔和柔性的质子-电子耦合二维π共轭cMOF薄膜（Cu1TPB0.1−xC）。通过关联电学和质量换能气体传感器技术，识别了H2O和D2O与骨架相互作用的细微差异，揭示了复杂的多阶段质量传输。对不同孔径cMOF的比较表明，这种识别源于不同的传导机制。值得注意的是，具有强空间限域效应的Cu1TPB0.1−xC薄膜由于其独特的质子-电子耦合传导特性而表现出复杂的多阶段电响应，从而能够进一步区分H2O和D2O在外表面和受限空间内的传输过程。因此，取向cMOF薄膜为解析和放大受限孔道中依赖于同位素的细微传输动力学提供了实时平台，为设计具有可控水同位素体传输的多孔材料提供了机理指导。

title: Adaptive Induced‐Fit via Engineered Linker Regioisomerization in Biomimetic Zeolitic Imidazolate Frameworks for Boosting SF 6 /N 2 Separation
abstract: ABSTRACT Capturing and recovering sulfur hexafluoride (SF 6 ) is a crucial yet formidable challenge in mitigating global warming. Herein, we propose a programmable linker regioisomerization strategy within zeolitic imidazolate frameworks (ZIFs) to modulate their stimulus‐responsive structural flexibility, thereby significantly enhancing SF 6 capture efficiency from nitrogen (N 2 ) streams. Simultaneous regioisomerization of the methyl group in ZIF‐8 and the aldehyde group in ZIF‐90 on the imidazolate linkers yields ZIF‐94, which exhibits a rare guest‐induced reversible framework deformation upon SF 6 adsorption. This behavior confers an enzyme‐like induced‐fit recognition mechanism for SF 6 molecules, strengthening host–guest interactions. As a result, ZIF‐94 achieves a high SF 6 adsorption capacity of 1.97 mmol g −1 and an ultrahigh SF 6 stacking density of 1438.69 mg cm −3 at 298 K and 0.1 bar, along with dramatically enhanced SF 6 /N 2 selectivities over ZIF‐8 and ZIF‐90. In situ experiments and theoretical analyses reveal that the SF 6 ‐induced structural flexibility of ZIF‐94 allows the framework to dynamically adjust and optimize its cage structure to match gas molecules, thus leading to significantly reinforced SF 6 /N 2 separation performance. The experimental column breakthrough tests and pressure swing adsorption simulations confirm the practical separation performance for SF 6 /N 2 mixtures in ZIF‐94. This work offers useful insights for designing flexible adsorbents for gas separation applications.
title_zh: 仿生沸石咪唑酯框架中通过连接体区域异构化实现自适应诱导契合以促进SF6/N2分离
abstract_zh: 摘要 捕获和回收六氟化硫（SF6）是减缓全球变暖的关键 yet 艰巨的挑战。在此，我们提出在沸石咪唑酯骨架（ZIF）内进行可编程的连接基位置异构化策略，以调控其刺激响应的结构柔性，从而显著提高从氮气（N2）气流中捕获SF6的效率。在咪唑酯连接基上同时对ZIF-8中的甲基和ZIF-90中的醛基进行位置异构化，得到ZIF-94，该材料在吸附SF6时表现出罕见的客体诱导的可逆骨架形变。这种行为赋予了对SF6分子类似酶的诱导契合识别机制，增强了主客体相互作用。因此，ZIF-94在298 K和0.1 bar下实现了1.97 mmol g−1的高SF6吸附容量和1438.69 mg cm−3的超高SF6堆积密度，并且SF6/N2选择性显著优于ZIF-8和ZIF-90。原位实验和理论分析表明，ZIF-94的SF6诱导结构柔性使骨架能够动态调整和优化其笼结构以匹配气体分子，从而显著增强SF6/N2分离性能。实验穿透柱测试和变压吸附模拟证实了ZIF-94对SF6/N2混合物的实际分离性能。这项工作为设计用于气体分离应用的柔性吸附剂提供了有益的见解。

title: Metal Oxides Catalyze Formation of Dehydroamino Acids by Phosphate β‐Elimination Under Physiological Conditions
abstract: ABSTRACT The dehydroamino acids (DHAAs) dehydroalanine and dehydrobutyrine are formed in proteins posttranslationally from serine and threonine, respectively. They contain an electrophilic alkene, which reacts readily with nucleophiles by Michael addition, giving rise to a variety of chemical modifications as well as protein crosslinks. Recent work has shown DHAAs and their modifications to be highly prevalent in protein aggregates isolated from brains of Alzheimer's Disease (AD) patients. As there is no human enzyme known to catalyze the formation of DHAAs, this raised the question of how they are produced. We show here that metal oxides, particularly the iron oxides goethite and hematite, efficiently catalyze the formation of DHAAs in model phosphopeptides in vitro under physiologically relevant conditions. Iron oxides are known to accumulate in the human brain with age, and this deposition is enhanced in neurodegenerative disorders like AD. The DHAA formation by heterogeneous catalysis reported here provides a previously unknown mechanism linking iron deposition to protein crosslinking in AD and potentially other neurodegenerative diseases where iron accumulation and protein aggregation co‐occur.
title_zh: 金属氧化物在生理条件下通过磷酸盐β-消除催化脱氢氨基酸的生成
abstract_zh: 摘要 脱氢氨基酸（DHAAs）脱氢丙氨酸和脱氢丁氨酸分别由蛋白质中的丝氨酸和苏氨酸经翻译后形成。它们含有亲电性烯烃，可通过迈克尔加成与亲核试剂快速反应，产生多种化学修饰以及蛋白质交联。最近的工作表明，DHAAs及其修饰在从阿尔茨海默病（AD）患者大脑中分离的蛋白质聚集体中高度普遍存在。由于尚无已知的人类酶催化DHAAs的形成，这引发了它们如何产生的问题。我们在此表明，金属氧化物，特别是铁氧化物针铁矿和赤铁矿，在生理相关条件下能在体外高效催化模型磷酸肽中DHAAs的形成。已知铁氧化物会随年龄在人脑中积累，且这种沉积在AD等神经退行性疾病中增强。本文报道的通过多相催化形成DHAA的机制，提供了一种此前未知的将铁沉积与AD以及其他铁积累与蛋白质聚集共存的神经退行性疾病中蛋白质交联联系起来的机制。

title: Supramolecular Engineering of Dynamically Interlocked Dual‐Stiffness Interphase for Biomimetic Strong and Tough Double Network Aerogel
abstract: ABSTRACT Resolving the fundamental modulus‐toughness trade‐off in organic‐inorganic hybrids remains a formidable challenge in supramolecular chemistry and materials science. Herein, we present a molecular‐level design of a dynamically interlocked dual‐stiffness interphase to break this limit, utilizing an aramid nanofiber/silica double‐network architecture. Unlike traditional physical blending, this interphase is governed by a bidirectional hydrogen‐bonding network. Through deep spectroscopic investigations, we reveal that this strong interfacial interaction triggers an intramolecular proton transfer and electronic redistribution within the ANFs. More intriguingly, this supramolecular interaction drives a rare and critical structural phase transition within the inorganic network, transforming flexible six‐membered siloxane rings (SiO) 6 into rigid four‐membered rings (SiO) 4 . Macroscopically, this chemical interphase is integrated into a biomimetic skin‐core aerogel fiber. The bimodal chemical interactions—static anchoring and dynamic silanol‐mediated slippage—synergistically endow the hybrid with an ultrahigh modulus (1.15 GPa) and exceptional toughness (8.1 MJ m −3 ), while preserving intrinsic extreme‐temperature stability. This chemically driven dynamic phase‐reconfiguration mechanism establishes a universal theoretical framework for interphase engineering, offering profound insights for the precise construction of high‐performance multifunctional nanocomposites.
title_zh: 动态互锁双刚度界面相的超分子工程用于仿生高强度高韧性双网络气凝胶
abstract_zh: 摘要：解决有机-无机杂化材料中根本性的模量-韧性权衡问题，一直是超分子化学与材料科学领域的重大挑战。本文提出了一种分子层面的动态互锁双刚度界面相设计，以突破这一极限，该设计采用芳纶纳米纤维/二氧化硅双重网络结构。与传统的物理共混不同，该界面相由双向氢键网络主导。通过深入的光谱学研究，我们揭示了这种强界面相互作用可在ANFs内引发分子内质子转移和电子重新分布。更引人注目的是，这种超分子相互作用驱动了无机网络内一种罕见而关键的结构相变，将柔性的六元硅氧烷环(SiO)6转变为刚性的四元环(SiO)4。在宏观层面，该化学界面相被整合到仿生皮芯结构气凝胶纤维中。双模式化学相互作用——静态锚定与动态硅羟基介导的滑移——协同赋予该杂化材料超高模量(1.15 GPa)与卓越韧性(8.1 MJ m−3)，同时保持其固有的极端温度稳定性。这种化学驱动的动态相重构机制为界面相工程建立了通用理论框架，为高性能多功能纳米复合材料的精确构筑提供了深刻见解。

title: Sono‐Triggered In Situ Vaccine via a Chlorin‐Based Small Molecule Sensitizer for Systemic Cancer Therapy
abstract: ABSTRACT Unimolecule‐mediated sonodynamic therapy (SDT) offers a promising approach to combat tumors systemically by enabling synergistic sono‐triggered cytotoxicity and in situ vaccine‐like effects within tumors. Although chlorin‐based sensitizers have achieved clinical success in phototherapy, their translation to SDT has been impeded by inadequate ultrasound (US)‐triggered reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation, leading to suboptimal immunogenic cell death (ICD) and compromised antitumor immunity. To address this, we designed two organic sonosensitizers based on the natural product‐derived scaffold, Chenghai pyropheophorbide‐a (CHPpa). CHPpa‐er was constructed by appending a p ‐toluenesulfonamide group for specific endoplasmic reticulum (ER) targeting. Its analogue, CHPpa‐er‐Asp, was additionally functionalized with aspartic acid to modulate molecular polarity. Remarkably, despite differing by only one pharmacophore, the two compounds exhibited profoundly distinct profiles in target protein (K ATP channel) engagement and intracellular trafficking, highlighting the critical impact of rational molecular design. As the lead candidate, CHPpa‐er elicited precise, intraluminal ROS bursts under US, inducing severe ER stress and robust ICD. In two preclinical tumor models, CHPpa‐er‐mediated SDT effectively suppressed both primary tumor growth and metastasis by provoking potent systemic antitumor immunity. This work introduced a unimolecular sonosensitizer strategy that transformed SDT from a localized modality into a systemic intervention, offering a translatable platform for comprehensive cancer therapy.
