title: Electrically Switchable Circularly Polarized Light Detection in Optically Active Ferroelectric
abstract: ABSTRACT Circularly polarized light (CPL) detection is fundamental to advanced photonic and optoelectronic technologies, yet electrically reversible control of CPL selectivity remains a critical challenge. Optically active ferroelectrics are uniquely suited to address this challenge because they integrate symmetry‐enabled optical activity, switchable spontaneous polarization, and the bulk photovoltaic effect (BPVE) within a single material platform. Herein, we report an optically active hybrid perovskite ferroelectric, BnA 2 MA 2 Pb 3 Br 10 ( 1 ; BnA is 3‐butenylammonium, MA is methylammonium), in which electrically switchable CPL detection is successfully achieved. Leveraging the BPVE in 1 , the device exhibits highly sensitive self‐powered CPL detection, with an anisotropy factor of up to 0.62. More importantly, ferroelectric polarization reversal reverses the CPL selectivity, enabling electrically reconfigurable CPL detection. This work establishes optically active ferroelectrics as a viable platform for electrically reconfigurable self‐powered chiroptoelectronic devices.
title_zh: 光学活性铁电体中的电可切换圆偏振光探测
abstract_zh: 摘要：圆偏振光(CPL)探测是先进光子学与光电子技术的基础，然而CPL选择性的电可逆调控仍是一项关键挑战。光学活性铁电体因其在单一材料平台上集成了对称性赋予的旋光性、可切换的自发极化和体光伏效应(BPVE)，是应对这一挑战的独特选择。本文报道了一种光学活性杂化钙钛矿铁电体BnA2MA2Pb3Br10(1；BnA为3-丁烯基铵，MA为甲铵)，在其中成功实现了电可切换的CPL探测。借助1中的BPVE，该器件表现出高灵敏度的自供电CPL探测，各向异性因子高达0.62。更重要的是，铁电极化翻转可逆转CPL选择性，实现电可重构的CPL探测。本工作确立了光学活性铁电体作为电可重构自供电手性光电子器件可行平台的地位。

title: Elucidating Photo‐Kinetic Control in Photothermal Reverse Water‐Gas Shift Reaction
abstract: ABSTRACT Unlike the well‐known charge‐carrier kinetics in traditional photocatalysis, a knowledge gap remains regarding the photo‐kinetic effects in heterogeneous photothermal catalysis. Conventionally, light is mainly regarded as a source of charge carriers and localized heating, yet how these light‐induced effects alter intrinsic reaction kinetics, particularly the rate‐determining step (RDS), remains unclear. Here, we provide direct kinetic evidence that illumination tunes the RDS in an archetypal Mars‐van Krevelen (MvK) reverse water‐gas shift (RWGS) reaction over In‐doped MoO 2 . Under illumination, photogenerated electrons enrich In sites, promoting H 2 activation and spillover while accelerating H 2 O desorption, thereby shifting the RDS from the H 2 ‐reduction half‐reaction to the CO 2 ‐oxidation half‐reaction. This kinetic modulation significantly enhances catalytic performance and lowers the apparent activation energy. Overall, this work elucidates the kinetic role of light in photothermal CO 2 conversion, offering new insights into optimizing solar‐driven catalytic processes.
title_zh: 阐明光热逆水煤气变换反应中的光动力学控制
abstract_zh: 摘要：与传统光催化中广为人知的载流子动力学不同，非均相光热催化中的光动力学效应仍存在认知空白。传统上，光主要被视为载流子和局域热源的来源，但这些光诱导效应如何改变本征反应动力学，尤其是速率控制步骤(RDS)，仍不明确。在此，我们提供了直接的动力学证据，表明光照可调节In掺杂MoO2上典型Mars-van Krevelen(MvK)逆水煤气变换(RWGS)反应中的RDS。在光照下，光生电子富集于In位点，促进H2的活化与溢流，同时加速H2O脱附，从而将RDS从H2还原半反应转变为CO2氧化半反应。这种动力学调控显著提升了催化性能并降低了表观活化能。总之，本工作阐明了光在光热CO2转化中的动力学作用，为优化太阳能驱动的催化过程提供了新见解。

title: Radical Sulfinamidation of Alkenes Enabled by a PCET–HAT Relay
abstract: ABSTRACT Sulfinamides and related sulfur(VI) motifs are widely represented in bioactive molecules; however, their direct installation onto alkenes has traditionally relied on Lewis acid‐ or transition metal‐mediated two‐electron pathways, with more recent advances dominated by photoinduced single‐electron processes. Here, we report a metal‐ and light‐free radical sulfinamidation of alkenes that proceeds through a radical chain mechanism enabled by a proton‐coupled electron transfer–hydrogen atom transfer (PCET–HAT) relay, initiated by trace amounts of oxygen. This transformation operates under operationally simple conditions, enabling rapid access to structurally diverse sulfinamides with broad substrate scope and excellent functional group tolerance. The synthetic utility of this strategy is demonstrated by the late‐stage functionalization of complex natural products and drug molecules. Mechanistic investigations combining experimental studies and density functional theory calculations reveal a PCET‐initiated radical chain process in which a HAT event relays reactivity to generate sulfinyl radicals, accounting for the high efficiency and selectivity of the reaction. This work establishes a mechanistically distinct platform for alkene sulfinamidation and highlights the potential of radical chain processes enabled by PCET–HAT relays in synthetic chemistry.
title_zh: 通过PCET–HAT接力实现的烯烃自由基亚磺酰胺化
abstract_zh: 摘要：亚磺酰胺及相关硫(VI)结构单元在生物活性分子中广泛存在；然而，将它们直接安装到烯烃上传统上依赖Lewis酸或过渡金属介导的双电子途径，近期的进展则以光诱导单电子过程为主。本文报道了一种无金属、无光照的烯烃自由基亚磺酰胺化反应，该反应通过由质子耦合电子转移-氢原子转移(PCET–HAT)级联实现的自由基链机制进行，由痕量氧引发。该转化在操作简单的条件下进行，能够快速获得结构多样的亚磺酰胺，具有宽泛的底物范围和优异的官能团耐受性。通过复杂天然产物和药物分子的后期功能化展示了该策略的合成实用性。结合实验研究与密度泛函理论计算的机理研究表明，这是一个PCET引发的自由基链过程，其中HAT事件传递反应性以产生亚磺酰自由基，解释了反应的高效性与高选择性。本工作为烯烃亚磺酰胺化建立了一个机理上截然不同的平台，并凸显了PCET–HAT级联介导的自由基链过程在合成化学中的潜力。

title: Revisiting the Closed‐Pore Formation and Interfacial Micro‐Environment Modulation Mechanisms of Polyacrylonitrile‐Derived Carbon Nanofibers Toward Efficient Sodium Storage
abstract: ABSTRACT Polyacrylonitrile‐based carbon nanofibers (CNFs) are widely regarded as promising sodium‐storage anodes owing to their high carbon yield/axial conductivity and superior mechanical flexibility. Nevertheless, the ambiguous understandings into the temperature‐dependent micro‐structure evolution, particularly the closed‐pore formation over pyrolysis, and the electrolyte induced electrode‐electrolyte interface micro‐environments, along with the involved influence mechanism upon sodium‐storage behaviors should be reasonably clarified. With systematical in(ex)‐situ physicochemical/electrochemical characterizations, it is first established that the optimal pyrolysis temperature of 1400°C combined with a “zipper‐like” point‐line‐plane solid‐phase fusion evolution effectively modulates micro‐structures, endowing the optimized pseudo‐graphitized CNFs film (i.e., GCNFs‐1400) with a synergistic balance among ions transport pathways (interlayer spacing), active storage sites (closed pores), and 3D conductive supporting framework (solid‐phase fusion). Concurrently, compared to the ester‐based electrolyte, the ether‐based electrolyte favors the formation of a thinner, more uniform, and chemically stable solid electrolyte interphase layer. It is the dual‐engineering of both material micro‐structures and interfacial micro‐environment that fully guarantees the competitive sodium‐storage properties of GCNFs‐1400 in terms of ultra‐high initial Coulombic efficiency (96.2%), rate capability, and long‐term stability toward presodiation‐free sodium‐ion batteries and sodium‐ion capacitors. More essentially, our in‐depth insights here provide meaningful guidance for future design of advanced hard carbon anodes toward efficient sodium storage.
title_zh: 重新审视聚丙烯腈衍生碳纳米纤维的闭孔形成与界面微环境调控机制以实现高效钠存储
abstract_zh: 摘要：聚丙烯腈基碳纳米纤维(CNFs)因其高碳收率/轴向导电性和优异的机械柔性，被广泛认为是很有前景的钠存储负极材料。然而，对温度依赖性的微观结构演变(尤其是热解过程中闭孔的形成)、电解液诱导的电极-电解液界面微环境及其对钠存储行为的影响机制仍需合理阐明。通过系统的(非)原位物理化学/电化学表征，首次确立了1400°C的最佳热解温度结合“拉链式”点-线-面固相融合演变可有效调控微观结构，使优化的伪石墨化CNFs膜(即GCNFs-1400)在离子传输通道(层间距)、活性存储位点(闭孔)和3D导电支撑骨架(固相融合)之间实现协同平衡。同时，与酯类电解液相比，醚类电解液有利于形成更薄、更均匀且化学稳定的固体电解质界面层。正是材料微观结构与界面微环境的双重工程，充分保证了GCNFs-1400在超高首次库仑效率(96.2%)、倍率性能和长期稳定性方面的竞争优势，适用于免预钠化的钠离子电池和钠离子电容器。

title: Spacer Length as a Molecular Cue for Self‐Sorting, Living Growth, and Piezoresponse in Peptide Assemblies
abstract: ABSTRACT Supramolecular polymerization offers a powerful route to structurally precise and functionally complex materials; however, achieving controlled multicomponent assembly and emergent functionality remains a fundamental challenge. In this study, we show that minimal variations in methylene spacer length between bisurea motifs encode the self‐assembly behavior of peptide amphiphiles. Cy3‐ and Cy5‐labeled peptides undergo nucleation‐elongation‐driven assembly into nanofibers with spacer‐dependent secondary structures. FRET and super‐resolution microscopy reveal that identical spacers promote random co‐assembly, whereas even a single methylene mismatch induces high‐fidelity self‐sorting. Pre‐formed fibers exhibit negligible monomer exchange, indicating nonequilibrium assemblies. Leveraging this, seeded supramolecular polymerization affords well‐defined block copolymers with low dispersity and spatially resolved domains. Furthermore, spacer length and odd‐even parity modulate dipolar alignment, enabling spacer length‐dependent piezoresponse. Collectively, these findings demonstrate how subtle molecular design parameters act as a molecular cue to program multicomponent supramolecular polymerization, offering new opportunities for designing compartmentalized, functional biomaterials and supramolecular bioelectronic systems.
title_zh: 间隔基长度作为多肽组装体自分类、活性生长与压电响应的分子线索
abstract_zh: 摘要 超分子聚合为构筑结构精确且功能复杂的材料提供了一条强有力的途径；然而，实现可控的多组分组装与涌现功能仍是一项根本性挑战。在本研究中，我们证明了双脲基元之间亚甲基间隔基长度的微小变化能够编码肽两亲分子的自组装行为。Cy3和Cy5标记的肽经历成核-延伸驱动的组装，形成具有间隔基依赖的二级结构的纳米纤维。FRET和超分辨显微成像表明，相同的间隔基促进随机共组装，而即使只有一个亚甲基的不匹配也会诱导高保真自分选。预制纤维几乎不发生单体交换，表明其为非平衡组装体。利用这一特性，种子超分子聚合可制得分散度低且结构域空间分辨清晰的嵌段共聚物。此外，间隔基长度及其奇偶性可调控偶极排列，从而实现依赖间隔基长度的压电响应。总之，这些发现展示了微妙的分子设计参数如何作为分子线索来编程多组分超分子聚合，为设计区室化功能生物材料和超分子生物电子系统提供了新机遇。

title: Site‐Specific Molecular Engineering Redirects Radical Pathways for Selective Photocatalytic Coupling of Methane to C 2+ Hydrocarbons
abstract: ABSTRACT Toward carbon neutrality, multi‐carbon synthesis from photo‐driven oxidative coupling of CH 4 (POCM) remains a formidable challenge due to the activity‐selectivity trade‐off, originating from sluggish surface reaction kinetics and uncontrolled reactive radical reactions. Herein, alkyl thiols (C 9 SH) were site‑specifically grafted onto Au sites supported on planar TiO 2 , forming the archetypal C 9 S‐Au δ+ /Au/TiO 2 system featuring covalent gold‐thiolate interplay. Combined experimental and theoretical analyses revealed that covalent Au‐thiolate interaction could modulate the interfacial electronic structure and upshift the d ‑band center of Au sites, thereby strengthening *CH 3 adsorption and lowering the C─C coupling barrier, thus suppressing the · O 2 − ‐driven overoxidation. Moreover, the reconstructed C 9 S‐Au δ+ sites acted as rapid electron extraction channels, drawing electrons from adjacent Au nanoparticles and preserving long‐lived photogenerated holes for C─H activation. Meanwhile, the alkyl chains served as “molecular fences”, effectively promoting local CH 4 enrichment and stabilizing *CH 3 intermediates. The optimized C 9 S‐Au δ+ /Au/TiO 2 photocatalyst exhibited an excellent yield of 22.92 mmol g cat −1 h −1 for C 2+ products with 93.9% selectivity, ranking it among the state‐of‐the‐art noble‐metal‐loaded photocatalysts for POCM. This work establishes site‐specific molecular engineering as an effective strategy to regulate interfacial charge redistribution and redirect radical coupling pathways, enabling CH 4 conversion to multi‐carbon products with enhanced activity and selectivity simultaneously.
title_zh: 位点特异性分子工程重定向自由基路径实现甲烷选择性光催化偶联制C 2+烃
abstract_zh: 摘要 面向碳中和目标，光驱动CH4氧化偶联制多碳产物（POCM）因活性-选择性权衡而仍是一项严峻挑战，其根源在于缓慢的表面反应动力学和不可控的活性自由基反应。本文将烷基硫醇（C9SH）位点特异性地接枝到负载于平面TiO2上的Au位点上，构筑了具有共价金-硫醇盐相互作用的典型C9S-Auδ+/Au/TiO2体系。实验与理论相结合的分析表明，共价Au-硫醇盐相互作用可调制界面电子结构并使Au位的d带中心上移，从而增强*CH3吸附并降低C─C偶联能垒，进而抑制由·O2−驱动的过度氧化。此外，重构的C9S-Auδ+位点可作为快速电子抽取通道，从邻近Au纳米颗粒中抽取电子，并保持长寿命的光生空穴用于C─H活化。同时，烷基链充当“分子栅栏”，有效促进局部CH4富集并稳定*CH3中间体。优化后的C9S-Auδ+/Au/TiO2光催化剂对C2+产物表现出22.92 mmol gcat−1 h−1的优异产率和93.9%的选择性，位居POCM领域最先进的贵金属负载光催化剂之列。本研究确立了位点特异性分子工程作为调控界面电荷再分布和重定向自由基偶联路径的有效策略，使CH4转化为多碳产物

title: Hydroxyl‐Bridged Phosphorus Doping‐Induced Charge Polarization Enhancing Electron Delocalization for Efficient Photoreduction of CO 2
abstract: ABSTRACT 2D metal‐free carbon nitride (CN) with extensive π–π conjugated structures suffers from electron localization due to p z orbital overlap, which severely limits its photocatalytic CO 2 reduction performance. Herein, we propose an electron delocalization strategy via functional group‐modified heteroatom doping. Through DFT screening and three‐step copolymerization of phytic acid and urea, we precisely synthesized a 4‐coordinated OH‐bridged P‐doped carbon nitride (CN−POH) featuring a unique 2N–P═OOH microstructure within heptazine units. CN−POH achieves a CO production rate of 1.82 mmol g −1 h −1 , 15 times higher than pristine CN. Experimental and theoretical results reveal that P doping disrupts the π–π conjugation, triggering electron delocalization and transferring electrons to adjacent active N sites. The OH‐modified P atom forms 2N–P═OOH coordination, inducing spatial charge polarization between VBM and CBM, which significantly enhances charge separation and electron delocalization. This unique structure also converts CO 2 adsorption from physical to chemical mode under the effect of water solvents and facilitates CO 2 ‐to‐CO conversion via hydrogen bonding with the water solvent. Collectively, CN−POH emerges as a highly efficient photocatalyst for CO 2 reduction. This work provides a promising strategy for electron delocalization in CN materials and introduces a new reaction mechanism incorporating solvent molecule interactions.
title_zh: 羟基桥连磷掺杂诱导电荷极化增强电子离域以实现CO 2的高效光还原
abstract_zh: 摘要 具有广延π–π共轭结构的二维无金属氮化碳（CN）因pz轨道重叠而存在电子局域化问题，这严重限制了其光催化CO2还原性能。在此，我们提出一种通过官能团修饰杂原子掺杂实现电子离域的策略。借助DFT筛选以及植酸与尿素的三步共聚，我们精确合成了4配位OH桥连的磷掺杂氮化碳（CN−POH），其七嗪单元内具有独特的2N–P═OOH微观结构。CN−POH的CO生成速率为1.82 mmol g−1 h−1，是原始CN的15倍。实验和理论结果揭示，P掺杂破坏了π–π共轭，引发电子离域并将电子转移到相邻的活性N位点。OH修饰的P原子形成2N–P═OOH配位，在VBM与CBM之间诱导空间电荷极化，显著增强了电荷分离与电子离域。这种独特结构还在水溶剂的作用下将CO2吸附从物理模式转变为化学模式，并通过与水溶剂的氢键作用促进CO2到CO的转化。总之，CN−POH成为一种高效的CO2还原光催化剂。本工作为CN材料的电子离域提供了一种有前景的策略，并引入了一种包含溶剂分子相互作用的新反应机理。

title: Chiral Trigonal Pyramidal Germanium Halides for Enhanced Second Harmonic Generation
abstract: ABSTRACT Chiral organic–inorganic hybrid metal halides are highly promising candidates for second‐order nonlinear optical (NLO) materials. However, their NLO performance is fundamentally restricted by the limited structural polarization inherent to traditional pseudo‐octahedral coordination. In this work, we demonstrate the feasibility of using highly polar tricoordinate trigonal pyramids to overcome the thermodynamic constraints of the octahedral cages, enabling a structural shift from symmetric hexacoordination to discrete structures, thus enhancing second harmonic generation (SHG). By introducing the massive steric hindrance of the chiral R/S ‐1,2,3,4‐tetrahydro‐1‐naphthylamine ( R/S ‐THNA) cation with the intrinsic stereochemical activity of the Ge 2+ 4 s 2 lone pair, we synthesized chiral germanium halides, ( R/S ‐THNA)GeX 3 (X = Br, I). Crystallographic and topological analyses confirm the complete cleavage of secondary Ge···X interactions, yielding isolated [GeX 3 ] − chromophores. Furthermore, guided by transition dipole moment calculations, ( R ‐THNA)GeI 1.75 Br 1.25 was constructed via a mixed‐halide strategy. Single‐crystal SHG measurements reveal that ( R ‐THNA)GeI 1.75 Br 1.25 achieves an exceptional response, being 1.66 and 9.44 times those of ( R ‐THNA)GeI 3 and ( R ‐THNA)GeBr 3 crystals, respectively. Standard Kurtz–Perry measurements of ( R ‐THNA)GeI 1.75 Br 1.25 at a 125–150 µm particle size reveal a powder SHG efficiency of 3.06 times that of KH 2 PO 4 , representing a highly competitive value in chiral germanium halides. This work establishes a rational paradigm for designing high‐performance NLO materials through precise coordination tailoring.
title_zh: 用于增强二次谐波产生的手性三角锥形卤化锗
abstract_zh: 摘要 手性有机-无机杂化金属卤化物是二阶非线性光学（NLO）材料的极具前景的候选者。然而，其NLO性能从根本上受限于传统赝八面体配位固有的有限结构极化。在本工作中，我们证明了利用高极性的三配位三角锥克服八面体笼的热力学限制的可行性，实现从对称六配位向离散结构的转变，从而增强二次谐波产生（SHG）。通过引入具有大位阻的手性R/S-1,2,3,4-四氢-1-萘胺（R/S-THNA）阳离子以及Ge2+ 4s2孤对固有的立体化学活性，我们合成了手性锗卤化物(R/S-THNA)GeX3（X = Br, I）。晶体学与拓扑分析证实次级Ge···X相互作用被完全断裂，生成了孤立的[GeX3]−生色团。此外，在跃迁偶极矩计算的指导下，通过混合卤素策略构筑了(R-THNA)GeI1.75Br1.25。单晶SHG测量表明，(R-THNA)GeI1.75Br1.25表现出卓越的响应，分别是(R-THNA)GeI3和(R-THNA)GeBr3晶体的1.66倍和9.44倍。在125–150 µm粒径下，(R-THNA)GeI1.75Br1.25的标准Kurtz–Perry测量显示其粉末SHG效率为KH2PO4的3.06倍，在手性锗卤化物中具有很强竞争力。本工作确立了一种合理

title: Desymmetric Hydroacyloxylation of Paracyclophyne by Catalytic Coordination‐Induced Asymmetric Addition
abstract: ABSTRACT Strained arynes are highly reactive, transient, and neutral intermediates. Stereoselective manipulation of these species in asymmetric catalysis remains a significant challenge. In this study, we reported a new catalytic copper(I) complexation induced asymmetric addition mode on paracyclophyne intermediate. The direct addition of carboxylates to paracyclophynes is a fast, strain‐releasing reaction that typically leads to racemic products. Upon the introduction of a catalytic amount of a chiral copper(I) complex, an unprecedented stereoconvergent hydroacyloxylation reaction was developed, affording planar chiral [2.2]paracyclophane esters in high yields with excellent enantioselectivity. The resulting addition products can be readily transformed into a variety of functionalized hydroxyl‐[2.2]paracyclophanes via Fries rearrangement or Friedel–Crafts reactions. These are valuable synthetic building blocks for the construction of functionalized planar chiral [2.2]paracyclophane (PCP) derivatives, which currently rely heavily on preparative HPLC or classical chemical/kinetic resolution methods. Control experiments and DFT calculations reveal that copper(I) complexation stabilizes the reactive aryne intermediate and promotes the subsequent asymmetric nucleophilic addition via a six‐membered ring transition state.
title_zh: 通过催化配位诱导的不对称加成实现对环芳炔的去对称化氢酰氧基化
abstract_zh: 摘要 芳炔是高活性、瞬态且电中性的中间体。在不对称催化中对这些物种进行立体选择性操控仍是一项重大挑战。在本研究中，我们报道了一种对芳环炔中间体的新型催化铜(I)络合诱导的不对称加成模式。羧酸盐对芳环炔的直接加成是一种快速的释放张力反应，通常生成外消旋产物。在引入催化量的手性铜(I)配合物后，开发出一种前所未有的立体收敛性酰氧羟基化反应，以高产率和优异的对映选择性得到平面手性[2.2]对环蕃酯。所得加成产物可通过Fries重排或Friedel–Crafts反应轻松转化为多种官能化羟基-[2.2]对环蕃。这些是构建官能化平面手性[2.2]对环蕃（PCP）衍生物的宝贵合成砌块，而目前的制备仍严重依赖制备型HPLC或经典化学/动力学拆分方法。对照实验和DFT计算表明，铜(I)络合稳定了活性芳炔中间体，并通过六元环过渡态促进了随后的不对称亲核加成。

title: Dithiafulvalene‐Based Hole Transport Materials Enabling Efficient and Stable n‑i‑p Perovskite Solar Cells via a Robust Doping‑Oxidation Mechanism
abstract: ABSTRACT The stability of conventional hole transport materials (HTMs, e.g., Spiro‑OMeTAD) in n‑i‑p perovskite solar cells (PSCs) remains a critical challenge, particularly due to the unstable nitrogen‑centered radical cations ([Ar 3 N] ·+ ) generated during their p‑type doping oxidation. Herein, three indenofluorene (IF)‐based HTMs substituted with fluorene and 1,4‐dithiafulvalene (DTF) units were designed and synthesized, denoted IF‑FF, IF‑TF and IF‑TT. The incorporation of the DTF unit endows IF‑TT with improved planarity, optimized energy‑level alignment, enhanced stacking orientation, and effective interfacial passivation. More importantly, through cooperative doping‑oxidation with Magic Blue and LiTFSI, IF‑TT generates highly delocalized, structurally stable sulfur‑centered radical cations ([DTF] ·+ ), which greatly accelerates the post‐oxidation process. Notably, IF‑TT ·+ exhibits stronger interaction with LiTFSI than Spiro‑OMeTAD ·+ , resulting in a higher concentration of more stable radicals upon doping. Consequently, IF‑TT displays superior doping stability and charge‑transport properties. As a result, IF‑TT‑based PSCs achieve a remarkable power conversion efficiency of 25.89%, outperforming Spiro‑OMeTAD‑based devices (25.29%). Furthermore, the enhanced radical stability and improved film characteristics endow IF‑TT‑based devices with exceptional operational stability. This study highlights that stabilizing the radical species generated during doping is a key strategy for synergistically improving both the efficiency and long‑term stability of PSCs.
title_zh: 基于二硫富瓦烯的空穴传输材料通过稳健的掺杂-氧化机制实现高效稳定的n‑i‑p钙钛矿太阳能电池
abstract_zh: 摘要 n-i-p钙钛矿太阳能电池（PSCs）中传统空穴传输材料（HTMs，如Spiro-OMeTAD）的稳定性仍是关键挑战，尤其是因为其p型掺杂氧化过程中产生的不稳定氮中心自由基阳离子（[Ar3N]·+）。本文设计并合成了三种以茚并芴（IF）为骨架、用芴和1,4-二硫富瓦烯（DTF）单元取代的HTMs，分别记为IF-FF、IF-TF和IF-TT。DTF单元的引入赋予IF-TT更好的平面性、优化的能级排列、增强的堆叠取向以及有效的界面钝化。更重要的是，通过与Magic Blue和LiTFSI的协同掺杂氧化，IF-TT生成了高度离域、结构稳定的硫中心自由基阳离子（[DTF]·+），极大加速了后氧化过程。值得注意的是，IF-TT·+与LiTFSI的相互作用强于Spiro-OMeTAD·+，因而掺杂后产生浓度更高、更稳定的自由基。因此，IF-TT表现出更优的掺杂稳定性和电荷传输性能。基于此，IF-TT基PSCs实现了25.89%的卓越功率转换效率，优于基于Spiro-OMeTAD的器件（25.29%）。此外，增强的自由基稳定性和改善的薄膜特性赋予IF-TT基器件出色的工作稳定性。本研究强调，稳定掺杂过程中产生的自由基物种是协同提升PSCs效率和长期稳定性的关键策略。

title: Catalytic Enantioselective Synthesis of Upper‐rim‐Functionalized Inherently Chiral Calix[4]arenes Through Desymmetrizing Reductive Amination
abstract: ABSTRACT Inherently chiral calix[4]arenes (ICCs) are chiral macrocyclic compounds whose chirality arises from the asymmetric distribution of substituents in their rigid cone conformations. Although inherent chirality in these systems has long been recognized, the enantioselective synthesis of these structurally intriguing frameworks, especially non‐meta‐type ICCs, remains underexplored. In this work, we report a versatile method for the asymmetric synthesis of both ABCD‐ and ABCC‐type ICCs via an enantioselective desymmetrization strategy. Two classes of diamino‐substituted prochiral calix[4]arenes were efficiently desymmetrized through chiral phosphoric acid‐catalyzed reductive amination with various aldehydes, tolerating a broad range of upper‐rim substitutions and affording both ABCD‐ and ABCC‐type ICCs bearing diverse functional groups with high enantioselectivities. Control experiments suggest that the reaction proceeds via sequential enantioselective desymmetrization and kinetic resolution, with reduction of the imine identified as the enantiodetermining step. Various derivatizations of the ICC products were also performed, including three notable examples involving dimerization of ICCs. Moreover, we demonstrate that combining these asymmetric synthetic and derivatization methods could enable the asymmetric synthesis of all six possible stereoisomers of the ABCD‐type ICCs. Furthermore, incorporation of fluorophore groups into these inherently chiral frameworks furnished ICC derivatives with promising photophysical and chiroptical properties, further underscoring the potential of this methodology.
title_zh: 通过去对称化还原胺化催化对映选择性合成上缘功能化的固有手性杯[4]芳烃
abstract_zh: 摘要 固有手性杯[4]芳烃（ICCs）是一类手性大环化合物，其手性源于取代基在刚性锥构象中的不对称分布。尽管这类体系的固有手性早已被认识，但这些结构引人入胜的框架的对映选择性合成，尤其是非间位型ICCs，仍待深入探索。在本工作中，我们报道了一种通过去对称化策略不对称合成ABCD型和ABCC型ICCs的通用方法。两类二氨基取代的前手性杯[4]芳烃通过手性磷酸催化与各种醛的还原胺化反应实现高效去对称化，可耐受广泛的上缘取代，以高对映选择性获得带有多种官能团的ABCD型和ABCC型ICCs。对照实验表明，该反应经由连续的对映选择性去对称化和动力学拆分进行，其中亚胺的还原被确定为决定对映选择性的步骤。我们还对ICCs产物进行了多种衍生化，包括三个涉及ICCs二聚化的代表性实例。此外，我们展示了将这些不对称合成与衍生化方法相结合，可实现ABCD型ICCs全部六种可能立体异构体的不对称合成。进一步地，将荧光基团引入这些固有手性框架，获得了具有良好光物理和手性光学性质的ICCs衍生物，进一步凸显了其潜力

title: Covalent Organic Framework Colloids With Core‐Shell Donor/Acceptor Architecture and Ultralong‐Lived Charge‐Separated States
abstract: ABSTRACT Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) possess structural tunability, high surface area, and extended delocalization of π‐electrons but remain limited by challenges in constructing well‐defined structures that enable efficient charge separation. Here, we address this limitation through the construction of core‐shell colloidal COF particles using isostructural but electronically distinct donor (D) and acceptor (A) COFs. The resulting p‐n heterojunction architecture enables efficient spatial separation of photogenerated electrons and holes, while preserving high crystallinity. Nanoscale phase separation is confirmed by high‐angle annular dark‐field scanning transmission electron microscopy coupled with energy‐dispersive X‐ray spectroscopy (HAADF‐EDS) mapping and X‐ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) analysis. Light‐induced electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) measurements reveal enhanced populations and significantly longer lifetimes of charge‐separated states in the core‐shell COFs compared to their single‐phase counterparts, indicating suppressed charge recombination and improved charge separation. The resulting heterostructures show efficient CO 2 photoreduction to CO and HCOOH, coupled with H 2 O oxidation, thereby requiring no sacrificial agents. The results demonstrate the importance of well‐defined D/A interfaces in COF photocatalysis.
title_zh: 具有核-壳给体/受体结构及超长寿命电荷分离态的共价有机框架胶体
abstract_zh: 摘要 共价有机框架（COFs）具有结构可调性、高比表面积和π电子的扩展离域等优势，但在构建可实现高效电荷分离的明确结构方面仍面临挑战。在此，我们通过使用同构但电子性质不同的给体（D）和受体（A）COFs构建核-壳胶体COF颗粒来解决这一局限。所得p-n异质结结构在保持高结晶度的同时，实现了光生电子和空穴的高效空间分离。高角环形暗场扫描透射电子显微镜结合能量色散X射线光谱（HAADF-EDS）面扫和X射线光电子能谱（XPS）分析证实了纳米级相分离。光诱导电子顺磁共振（EPR）测量表明，与单相对应物相比，核-壳COFs中电荷分离态的数量增加且寿命显著延长，表明电荷复合受到抑制、电荷分离得到改善。所得异质结构可高效地将CO2光还原为CO和HCOOH，同时耦合H2O氧化，因此无需牺牲试剂。这些结果证明了明确的D/A界面在COF光催化中的重要性。

title: Organic Metal Chalcogenide Films With Giant Birefringence
abstract: ABSTRACT Birefringent films emerge as a compelling candidate for integrated photonic systems, gracefully balancing superior processability with seamless substrate compatibility. However, birefringent films typically retain only ∼20% of bulk crystal performance, which consequently limits film‐based birefringence to values rarely exceeding 0.1. To address this limitation, we introduce a two‐dimensional van der Waals (2D‐vDW) organic metal chalcogenide (OMC) PbHBT (HBT = 4‐mercaptophenol), featuring “molecular‐scale superlattices” of alternating inorganic PbS and organic Ph‐OH ligands. PbHBT crystal exhibits a birefringence of 0.39@546 nm. A nanoscale thickness‐controllable, highly oriented PbHBT film was prepared through an economical in situ layer‐by‐layer (LBL) spin‐coating liquid‐phase epitaxy (LPE) approach. The birefringence of the PbHBT film is 0.3 at 546 nm, maintaining 77% of the birefringence of its bulk crystal. Importantly, the PbHBT film achieves a birefringence of 0.65 in the visible spectrum and 0.43 in the near‐infrared, which are the highest notes ever achieved by a birefringent film. This excellent birefringence performance stems from the anisotropy of the electron cloud density of different crystal planes of the PbHBT and the high consistency of grain orientation after being fabricated into a film. This work opens avenues for thin‐film birefringent materials with large intrinsic birefringence and high retention, bridging the bulk‐film performance gap.
title_zh: 具有巨大双折射的有机金属硫属化合物薄膜
abstract_zh: 摘要 双折射薄膜因其优异的可加工性与无缝的衬底兼容性，成为集成光子系统的有力候选材料。然而，双折射薄膜通常仅能保持体块晶体性能的约20%，因此薄膜双折射值很少超过0.1。为解决这一局限，我们引入了一种二维范德华（2D-vDW）有机金属硫属化物（OMC）PbHBT（HBT = 4-巯基苯酚），其具有无机PbS与有机Ph-OH配体交替排列的“分子尺度超晶格”。PbHBT晶体在546 nm处双折射为0.39。通过经济高效的原位逐层（LBL）旋涂液相外延（LPE）方法，制备了纳米级厚度可控、高取向的PbHBT薄膜。该薄膜在546 nm处双折射为0.3，保持了体块晶体双折射的77%。重要的是，PbHBT薄膜在可见光谱区实现0.65、在近红外区实现0.43的双折射，是双折射薄膜迄今达到的最高值。这种优异的双折射性能源于PbHBT不同晶面电子云密度的各向异性以及成膜后晶粒取向的高度一致性。这项工作为具有大固有双折射和高保持率的薄膜双折射材料开辟了道路，弥合了体块与薄膜之间的性能差距。

title: Transformative Masked Ortho‐Quinone Chemistry: From Direct Guaiacol Activation to Lignin‐Based Adhesives
abstract: ABSTRACT Guaiacol moieties (1‐hydroxy‐2‐methoxy‐benzenes) are among the most abundant structural motifs in renewable biophenolic feedstocks, representing a potential industrial‐scale stream from softwood lignin through biorefinery valorization. Here, the transformative chemistry of masked ortho‐quinones (MoQs) is introduced, yielding reactive guaiacol derivatives to enable thiol‐guaiacol connectivity (TGC) polymers. Phenyliodine(III)diacetate (PIDA) oxidizes guaiacols to chemically pure MoQs within minutes at room temperature, generating activated triguaiacol monomers that undergo thiol‐MoQ Michael‐type polyaddition with multithiols. This bulk polymerization leads to TGC‐adhesives, reaching professional performance lap‐shear strengths up to 16.9 ± 0.9 MPa. The robust strategy is extended to directly activate technical lignin, generating curable multi‐MoQ prepolymers which bond aluminum with lap‐shear strengths of 9.1 ± 0.7 MPa, positioning MoQs as a sustainable platform chemistry to bridge from lignin to high‐performance materials.
title_zh: 变革性的掩蔽邻苯醌化学：从愈创木酚直接活化到木质素基胶粘剂
abstract_zh: 摘要 愈创木酚结构单元（1-羟基-2-甲氧基苯）是可再生生物酚类原料中最丰富的结构基元之一，通过生物炼制增值可成为来自软木木质素的潜在工业级原料流。在此，我们引入了掩蔽邻醌（MoQs）的转化化学，生成高活性愈创木酚衍生物，以构筑硫醇-愈创木酚连接（TGC）聚合物。苯基碘(III)二乙酸酯（PIDA）可在室温下数分钟内将愈创木酚氧化为化学纯的MoQs，生成活化的三愈创木酚单体，随后与多硫醇发生硫醇-MoQ迈克尔型加聚。这种本体聚合得到TGC胶粘剂，其搭接剪切强度高达16.9 ± 0.9 MPa，达到专业应用水平。该稳健策略还可直接活化工业木质素，生成可固化的多MoQ预聚物，粘接铝材的搭接剪切强度为9.1 ± 0.7 MPa，使MoQs成为连接木质素与高性能材料的可持续平台化学。

title: Deciphering Interfacial Water Configuration via Nucleophilic Doping: Highly Connected H‐Bond Networks for Efficient Neutral Hydrogen Evolution
abstract: ABSTRACT Neutral hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) faces sluggish kinetics due to strong cation hydration disrupting interfacial hydrogen‐bond (H‐bond) networks, impeding mass transport. Herein, we propose a nucleophilic doping strategy to reconstruct the interfacial water structure and boost neutral HER performance. By engineering a nucleophilic oxygen‐doped molybdenum selenide/molybdenum phosphide hybrid on carbon cloth (O x ‐MoSe 2‐x /MoP/CC), we successfully manipulate the local electronic environment to attenuate cation hydration effects. Ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) simulations coupled with in situ Raman spectroscopy provide compelling evidence that the incorporated nucleophilic O species trigger a reconfiguration of interfacial water, fostering the formation of highly connected H‐bond networks. These optimized networks serve as efficient highways for intermediate transport, significantly lowering the mass transfer resistance. Furthermore, density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal a synergistic mechanism where the MoP phase acts as a potent water dissociation promoter, facilitating the Volmer step. Consequently, the O x ‐MoSe 2‐x /MoP/CC electrode delivers a remarkable overpotential of only 34 mV at 10 mA cm −2 in 1 M phosphate buffer solution, surpassing commercial Pt/C, and exhibits superior long‐term stability. This work not only presents a high‐performance electrocatalyst but also highlights the pivotal role of nucleophilic modulation in engineering interfacial H‐bond networks for efficient neutral electrocatalysis.
title_zh: 通过亲核掺杂解析界面水构型：用于高效中性析氢的高度连通氢键网络
abstract_zh: 摘要 中性析氢反应（HER）由于强阳离子水合作用破坏界面氢键（H键）网络、阻碍传质，面临缓慢的动力学。在此，我们提出一种亲核掺杂策略来重构界面水结构并提升中性HER性能。通过在碳布上构筑亲核氧掺杂的硒化钼/磷化钼杂化物（Ox-MoSe2-x/MoP/CC），我们成功调控了局域电子环境以削弱阳离子水合效应。从头算分子动力学（AIMD）模拟结合原位拉曼光谱提供了有力证据，表明引入的亲核O物种触发了界面水的重构，促进形成高度连通的氢键网络。这些优化的网络作为中间体传输的高效通道，显著降低了传质阻力。此外，密度泛函理论（DFT）计算揭示了协同机制：MoP相作为强效水分解促进剂，加速Volmer步骤。因此，Ox-MoSe2-x/MoP/CC电极在1 M磷酸盐缓冲溶液中于10 mA cm−2下仅表现出34 mV的过电位，超越商用Pt/C，并展现出优异的长期稳定性。这项工作不仅提供了一种高性能电催化剂，还凸显了亲核调控在构筑高效中性电催化界面氢键网络中的关键作用。

title: Donor–Acceptor Charge‐Selective Materials for High‐Performance Perovskite Solar Cells: Molecular Design, Structure–Property Correlation and Device Performance
abstract: ABSTRACT Perovskite solar cells (PSCs) hold significant promise as the next‐generation photovoltaic technology with the certified power conversion efficiency already surpassing 27%. To further enhance device stability to meet industrial demands, it is crucial to develop high‐performance charge‐selective materials (CSMs) as they profoundly affect interfacial charge carrier dynamics and the stability of interface structure. Conventional organic CSMs often employ building blocks with a single electronic effect (e.g., using electron‐donating units to construct hole‐selective materials (HSMs) and electron‐withdrawing groups to develop electron‐selective materials (ESMs)), which usually face the dilemma that high charge transport ability, superior film morphology, and strong interfacial functionality cannot be achieved simultaneously. In contrast, donor(D)–acceptor(A) CSMs allow more precise tuning of molecular structure, aggregation behavior, electronic properties, and interfacial functionalities, thus providing an ideal design platform for exploration of efficient CSMs. Therefore, this review timely summarizes the progress of D–A type CSMs, covering both HSMs and ESMs. Specifically, we will deeply explore the relationships between molecular structures and material properties, as well as their effects on device performance and stability. Finally, future research directions in material design are proposed to advance the industrialization of PSCs.
title_zh: 用于高性能钙钛矿太阳能电池的给体-受体电荷选择性材料：分子设计、结构-性能关联及器件性能
abstract_zh: 摘要 钙钛矿太阳能电池（PSCs）作为下一代光伏技术具有重大前景，其认证功率转换效率已超过27%。为进一步提升器件稳定性以满足工业需求，开发高性能电荷选择性材料（CSMs）至关重要，因为它们深刻影响界面载流子动力学及界面结构的稳定性。传统有机CSMs通常采用仅具单一电子效应的构建单元（例如，利用给电子单元构筑空穴选择性材料（HSMs），利用吸电子基团开发电子选择性材料（ESMs）），往往面临高电荷传输能力、优异薄膜形貌与强界面功能性难以同时实现的困境。相比之下，给体（D）-受体（A）型CSMs可对分子结构、聚集行为、电子性质及界面功能进行更精细的调控，因此是探索高效CSMs的理想设计平台。因此，本综述及时总结了D-A型CSMs的进展，涵盖HSMs和ESMs。具体而言，我们将深入探讨分子结构与材料性质之间的关系，及其对器件性能和稳定性的影响。最后，提出了材料设计的未来研究方向，以推动PSCs的产业化。

title: Magnetic Field‐Induced Mass Transfer Acceleration and Spin Polarization for Highly Efficient Photocatalytic Urea Synthesis
abstract: ABSTRACT Different from traditional industrial urea synthesis using NH 3 and CO 2 , heterogeneous photocatalysis enables direct urea synthesis from N 2 and CO 2 in aqueous, where water acts as both solvent and hydrogen source. Its low yield is mainly restricted by poor reactant activation efficiency, mismatched reaction kinetics, slow C─N coupling and slow gas mass transfer via water hydrogen bond networks. Herein, an external magnetic field was adopted to boost photocatalytic urea synthesis. Upon magneto‐photocatalysis, water hydrogen bonds were disturbed to form gas diffusion channel and release sufficient hydrogen protons. Driven by the Lorentz force and magnetohydrodynamic convection, electron‐proton interactions were strengthened. Meanwhile, spin‐polarized electrons and regulated active sites activated N 2 and CO 2 and accelerated C─N coupling. Under ambient conditions and a 40‐mT magnetic field, ZIF‐67@MIL‐101(Fe) achieved a urea yield as high as 147.28 µmol g −1 h −1 . Mechanism to the enhancement along with reaction pathways were clarified via experimental and simulation results. Practical applicability was confirmed using simulated flue gas, and the obtained urea solution could cultivate wheat seedlings. Overall, this work proposed a magnetic field‐enhanced photocatalytic urea production strategy, offering a universal approach for efficient N 2 activation toward urea and other nitrogen‐containing chemicals.
title_zh: 磁场诱导的传质加速与自旋极化用于高效光催化尿素合成
abstract_zh: 摘要 不同于传统上利用NH3和CO2的工业尿素合成，多相光催化可在水相中由N2和CO2直接合成尿素，其中水既充当溶剂又充当氢源。其产率较低主要受限于反应物活化效率差、反应动力学不匹配、C─N偶联缓慢以及气体通过水氢键网络的传质缓慢。本文采用外加磁场来促进光催化尿素合成。在磁-光催化过程中，水氢键受到扰动形成气体扩散通道并释放充足的氢质子。在洛伦兹力和磁流体动力学对流的驱动下，电子-质子相互作用得到增强。同时，自旋极化电子和经过调控的活性位点活化了N2和CO2并加速了C─N偶联。在环境条件和40 mT磁场下，ZIF-67@MIL-101(Fe)实现了高达147.28 µmol g−1 h−1的尿素产率。通过实验和模拟结果阐明了增强机理及反应路径。利用模拟烟气验证了其实际适用性，所得尿素溶液可用于培育小麦幼苗。总体而言，本工作提出了一种磁场增强的光催化尿素生产策略，为高效活化N2以合成尿素及其他含氮化学品提供了一种通用途径。

title: Self‐Healing and Environmentally Stable Supramolecular Liquid Crystalline Gels for Mechanochromic Optics and Tactile Sensing
abstract: ABSTRACT Mechanochromic materials hold great promise for applications in anti‐counterfeiting, information encryption, and intelligent sensing. However, existing materials face long‐term challenges in achieving a wide color‐changing range, a robust dynamic network, and environmental adaptability. Herein, we constructed a 3D dynamic cross‐linked network through the synergistic effect of dipole–π and π–π interactions between liquid crystal molecules and acrylate copolymers. The resulting supramolecular liquid crystalline gel (SLCG) exhibited a wide range of interference color changes and excellent mechanical properties through the dissociation of supramolecular interactions. Meanwhile, the well‐designed dynamic network endowed the SLCG with self‐recovery, recycling, and self‐healing abilities. The SLCG can also effectively shield against adverse environmental effects, enabling stable mechanochromic performance across a broad temperature range and underwater. Subsequently, the SLCG can serve as an intelligent platform for applications in information encryption, on‐demand display, and visualized tactile sensing systems. This work paves the way for the development of high‐performance mechanochromic materials and their integration into next‐generation intelligent applications.
title_zh: 用于机械变色光学与触觉感知的自修复且环境稳定的超分子液晶凝胶
abstract_zh: 摘要 力致变色材料在防伪、信息加密和智能传感领域具有广阔的应用前景。然而，现有材料在实现宽变色范围、稳健的动态网络以及环境适应性方面长期面临挑战。本文通过液晶分子与丙烯酸酯共聚物之间偶极-π和π-π相互作用的协同效应，构建了三维动态交联网络。所得超分子液晶凝胶（SLCG）通过超分子相互作用的解离表现出宽范围的干涉色变化和优异的力学性能。同时，精心设计的动态网络赋予SLCG自恢复、可回收和自修复能力。SLCG还能有效屏蔽不利环境影响，使其在宽温度范围内和水下均保持稳定的力致变色性能。随后，SLCG可作为智能平台应用于信息加密、按需显示和可视化触觉传感系统。这项工作为高性能力致变色材料的开发及其在下一代智能应用中的集成铺平了道路。

title: Synergistic Catalysis of Single‐Atom Alloys and Ordered Indium Clusters in Aluminum Sheet for Enhanced Hydrogen Production
abstract: ABSTRACT The hydrolysis of aluminum (Al) in pure water is regarded as a greatly promising strategy for on‐demand hydrogen supply due to the high energy density of Al and the operational simplicity of the process. However, its precise reaction mechanism remains poorly understood. Here, we report an efficient smelting method to fabricate AlGaIn alloy sheet and elucidate the atomic‐scale reaction pathways of the hydrolysis process. Spherical aberration correction electron microscopy, X‐ray absorption fine structure, and in situ scanning electron microscopy reveal that AlGaIn alloy sheet shows a typical layered structure with rich grain boundaries and is composed of a uniform reactive surface AlGa film, AlGa 1 single‐atom alloys, and highly ordered In atom clusters. An optimized AlGaIn alloy sheet demonstrates excellent hydrolysis performance at room temperature when directly immersed in pure water without prior pulverization. Ambient‐pressure x‐ray photoelectron spectroscopy and density functional theory (DFT) calculations confirm that the hydrolysis reaction is initiated at the active sites on the reactive AlGa film and is further accelerated by a cooperative catalytic effect of AlGa 1 single‐atom alloys and highly ordered In atom clusters. In particular, In clusters mainly facilitate water dissociation, while AlGa 1 single‐atom alloys are responsible for enhancing *H combination and Al spillover.
title_zh: 铝片中单原子合金与有序铟簇的协同催化用于增强产氢
abstract_zh: 摘要 铝（Al）在纯水中的水解因Al的高能量密度和该工艺操作简单而被视为一种极具前景的按需供氢策略。然而，其精确的反应机理仍不清楚。本文报道了一种高效的熔炼方法来制备AlGaIn合金片，并阐明了水解过程的原子尺度反应路径。球差校正电子显微镜、X射线吸收精细结构和原位扫描电子显微镜表明，AlGaIn合金片呈现出具有丰富晶界的典型层状结构，由均匀的反应性表面AlGa膜、AlGa1单原子合金以及高度有序的In原子团簇组成。优化后的AlGaIn合金片在无需预先粉碎的情况下直接浸入纯水中，在室温下表现出优异的水解性能。环境压力X射线光电子能谱和密度泛函理论（DFT）计算证实，水解反应在反应性AlGa膜的活性位点上引发，并进一步被AlGa1单原子合金和高度有序In原子团簇的协同催化效应加速。特别是，In团簇主要促进水的解离，而AlGa1单原子合金则负责增强*H的复合和Al的溢流。

title: Nanotube Encapsulation of Single‐Molecule and 1D van der Waals Magnets: Confinement‐Tuned Magnetism
abstract: ABSTRACT Single‐molecule magnets (SMMs) and low‐dimensional van der Waals (vdW) magnets are highly promising for quantum technologies, spintronics, and data storage, yet their integration into practical devices is frequently impeded by chemical reactivity, aggregation, or loss of magnetic function during processing. Encapsulation within carbon nanotubes (CNTs) and boron nitride nanotubes (BNNTs) has emerged as a versatile strategy to protect, isolate, align, and electronically address these fragile magnetic species at the atomic scale. This review provides a comprehensive overview of encapsulated magnetic materials, focusing on two interconnected themes: molecular magnets and one‐dimensional (1D vdW magnetic heterostructures. We examine the fundamental principles governing nanotube encapsulation, contrasting the distinct host‐guest interactions in metallic/semiconducting CNTs versus insulating BNNTs. Foundational studies demonstrate that SMMs from Mn 12 acetate and TbPc 2 to endohedral metallofullerenes and organometallic DyCp 3 retain their magnetic bistability upon encapsulation, with confinement sometimes enhancing relaxation times and suppressing quantum tunneling. Parallel advances have enabled the synthesis of truly 1D 1D vdW magnetic materials inaccessible by conventional means, including transition metal trihalide chains (CrX 3 , VX 3 ), dihalide chains (CrX 2 ), and complex tellurides (V x Te y ), whose magnetic ground states such as ferromagnetic, antiferromagnetic, or spin glass are tunable through nanotube diameter and charge transfer. Spectroscopic signatures of host‐guest interactions, magnetic properties, and emerging applications in spintronics, quantum information, and biomedical imaging are critically assessed. We conclude by identifying key challenges such as synthetic control, scalability, and device integration that must be overcome to realize the technological potential of these remarkable magnetic heterostructures.
title_zh: 单分子与一维范德华磁体的纳米管封装：限域调控磁性
abstract_zh: 摘要 单分子磁体（SMMs）和低维范德华（vdW）磁体在量子技术、自旋电子学和数据存储方面具有广阔前景，但其在实际器件中的集成常常受到化学反应活性、聚集或加工过程中磁功能丧失的阻碍。将其封装于碳纳米管（CNTs）和氮化硼纳米管（BNNTs）中已成为一种多功能策略，可在原子尺度上保护、隔离、排列这些脆弱的磁性物种并实现其电子学寻址。本综述全面概述了封装磁性材料，重点聚焦两个相互关联的主题：分子磁体和一维（1D）vdW磁性异质结构。我们探讨了支配纳米管封装的基本原理，对比了金属/半导体性CNTs与绝缘BNNTs中截然不同的主-客体相互作用。基础研究表明，从Mn12醋酸盐和TbPc2到内嵌金属富勒烯以及金属有机DyCp3的SMMs在封装后仍保持其磁双稳态，限域效应有时还能延长弛豫时间并抑制量子隧穿。与此并行的进展使人们能够合成常规方法无法获得的真正1D vdW磁性材料，包括三卤化过渡金属链（CrX3、VX3）、二卤化链（CrX2）和复杂碲化物（VxTey），其磁性基态（如铁磁、反铁磁或自旋玻璃态）可通过纳米管直径和电荷转移进行调控。谱学特征o

title: Multifunctional Biomimetic Trojan Horse Nanosystem for Remodeling Infected Regenerative Microenvironments in Osteoporotic Bone Defects
abstract: ABSTRACT Infection is the most common complication of osteoporotic fractures, often characterized by bacterial resistance and intracellular infection, posing a major challenge in the treatment of osteoporotic fractures. Here, we developed a multifunctional biomimetic Trojan horse nanosystem based on hydroxyapatite nanotubes (NT‐HA) for microenvironment remodeling. The NT‐HA exhibits a dual‐stage antimicrobial peptide (AMP) delivery strategy, in which surface‐adsorbed AMPs are rapidly released to eliminate extracellular bacteria, while NT‐HA is internalized via endocytosis to release encapsulated AMPs for efficient intracellular bacterial clearance. After releasing AMPs, the NT‐HA can regulate the PI3K‐AKT signaling cascade, promoting the directed osteogenic differentiation of osteoporotic bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (OBMSCs). In the repair of infected osteoporotic bone defects in vivo, this Trojan horse nanosystem not only enhances bone regeneration by eliminating cellular infections and inducing OBMSCs osteogenesis but also reduces peri‐implant bone loss and strengthens bone strength, ultimately remodeling the regenerative microenvironment to achieve optimal bone defect repair and functional reconstruction.
title_zh: 用于重塑骨质疏松性骨缺损感染再生微环境的多功能仿生特洛伊木马纳米系统
abstract_zh: 摘要 感染是骨质疏松性骨折最常见的并发症，其特点常为细菌耐药和细胞内感染，给骨质疏松性骨折的治疗带来重大挑战。在此，我们开发了一种基于羟基磷灰石纳米管（NT‐HA）的多功能仿生特洛伊木马纳米系统，用于微环境重塑。NT‐HA展现出双阶段抗菌肽（AMP）递送策略：表面吸附的AMP快速释放以清除胞外细菌，而NT‐HA通过内吞作用内化后释放包封的AMP，从而高效清除胞内细菌。在释放AMP后，NT‐HA可调节PI3K‐AKT信号级联反应，促进骨质疏松骨髓间充质干细胞（OBMSCs）的定向成骨分化。在体内感染性骨质疏松骨缺损修复中，该特洛伊木马纳米系统不仅通过清除细胞内感染和诱导OBMSCs成骨来增强骨再生，还能减少种植体周围骨丢失并增强骨强度，最终重塑再生微环境，实现最佳的骨缺损修复与功能重建。

title: Self‐Feeding Living Materials Enabled by Cell Responsive Glycogen Nanoparticles as Metabolic Batteries
abstract: ABSTRACT Scaling engineered living materials to clinically relevant dimensions is limited by diffusion‐dependent depletion of oxygen and nutrients, which rapidly induces metabolic failure. We introduce glycogen as a nutritional nanoparticle that provides cell‐mediated, autonomous nutrient release to support long‐term survival under extreme metabolic stress. We demonstrate that human mesenchymal stromal cells (hMSCs) survive for weeks in anoxia and serum deprivation when provided extracellular glycogen. Contrary to long‐held assumptions, hMSCs secrete glycogen‐degrading enzymes, enabling cell‐density‐controlled extracellular glycogenolysis and sustained release of glucose and metabolic intermediates, positioning glycogen as the first‐of‐its‐kind metabolic battery. This cell‐responsive process maintains metabolic activity, limits glycolytic acidosis, and enhances pro‐angiogenic signaling. To translate this mechanism into a versatile materials platform, we engineered core‐shell dextran‐tyramine microcapsules that stably encapsulate glycogen while permitting diffusion of enzymes and degradation products. Integrated into centimeter‐scale GelMA constructs, these microcapsules maintained hMSC viability and function for at least 1 month under anoxia. In vivo, glycogen‐loaded implants promote deep cellular infiltration, enhanced matrix remodeling, increased M2 macrophage polarization, and orchestrated accelerated vascularization. This work establishes the novel concept of glycogen‐based nutritional nanoparticles as metabolic batteries to endow engineered tissues with autonomous self‐feeding capacity, enabling scalable and functional living materials for regenerative medicine and related technologies.

title: Long‐Term Bio‐Spin Readouts Enable Decoding Immune‐Imposed Stress at the Single‐Cell Level
abstract: ABSTRACT Electronic spin dynamics represent a fundamentally important yet largely unexplored state parameter of living cells, offering stable sensitivity to intracellular paramagnetic environments associated with cellular stress responses. However, how immune‐imposed intracellular stress evolves over time and relates to divergent single‐cell outcomes remains unclear, owing to the lack of continuous and nonconsumptive readouts. Here, we establish a long‐term bio‐spin readout based on nanodiamonds hosting nitrogen‐vacancy centers as inheritable intracellular spin reporters, enabling continuous spin relaxometry in living cells. By integrating population‐level ROS‐associated paramagnetic stress profiling with long‐term single‐cell tracking in Hela and A549 cancer cells during coculture with activated macrophages, we identify three characteristic oxidative‐stress trajectory patterns—remote immune stress, immune evasion, and apoptosis—whose distinct temporal dynamics cannot be resolved by endpoint assays alone. Longitudinal bio‐spin measurements reveal that immune pressure is encoded not only by instantaneous oxidative levels but also by the temporal accumulation and regulation of intracellular stress. An empirical bio‐spin transition range provides an operational reference for distinguishing recoverable stress responses from apoptosis‐associated trajectories, while characteristic completion times capture the interaction‐ and cell‐type‐dependent kinetics of stress evolution. Together, this work establishes bio‐spin dynamics for resolving immune‐imposed stress histories and their associations with divergent cellular outcomes in living systems.
title_zh: 长期生物自旋读出实现单细胞水平解码免疫施加的应激
abstract_zh: 摘要 电子自旋动力学是活细胞中一个极其重要但在很大程度上尚未被探索的状态参数，能够对与细胞应激反应相关的胞内顺磁环境提供稳定的敏感性。然而，由于缺乏连续且无损的读出手段，免疫诱导的胞内应激如何随时间演化以及如何与不同的单细胞命运相关联仍不清楚。在此，我们建立了一种基于含氮-空位中心纳米金刚石作为可遗传胞内自旋报告器的长期生物自旋读出方法，实现了对活细胞的连续自旋弛豫测量。通过在Hela和A549癌细胞与活化巨噬细胞共培养过程中，将群体水平的ROS相关顺磁应激分析与长期单细胞追踪相结合，我们识别出三种特征性的氧化应激轨迹模式——远端免疫应激、免疫逃逸和凋亡——它们独特的时间动力学无法仅通过终点检测来解析。纵向生物自旋测量表明，免疫压力不仅由瞬时氧化水平编码，还由胞内应激的时间累积与调控编码。经验性生物自旋转变范围为区分可恢复的应激反应与凋亡相关轨迹提供了操作性参考，而特征完成时间则捕捉了应激演化依赖于相互作用和细胞类型的动力学。总之，这项工作确立了用于解析免疫诱导应激历程及其相关性的生物自旋动力学方法

title: Lattice Strain and Built‐In Field Synergistically Boost Urea Oxidation via Dynamic NiOOH Mediation at Multiphase Heterointerfaces
abstract: ABSTRACT The practical application of nickel‐based heterojunction electrocatalysts for the urea oxidation reaction (UOR) is impeded by insufficient active sites and sluggish multi‐step reaction kinetics. Herein, a sulfur‐doped lignin‐derived carbon encapsulated Ni‐NiO‐MoO 2 micro‐nano array (Ni‐NiO‐MoO 2 @SC) is fabricated to tackle these issues. Experimental and theoretical results demonstrate that the multiphase heterointerfaces spontaneously generate a built‐in electric field due to the distinct work function and electronic structure of each component, and simultaneously induce lattice strain, which synergistically optimizes the electronic structure and accelerates the dynamic formation of active NiOOH species. In‐situ electrochemical characterizations and density functional theory calculations further confirm that the engineered interface promotes urea adsorption, facilitates N─N coupling and C─N bond cleavage, expedites *COOH intermediate desorption, and avoids excessive accumulation of NiOOH. Consequently, Ni‐NiO‐MoO 2 @SC delivers superior UOR activity with low potentials of 1.34/1.40 V at 10/500 mA cm −2 , respectively. Moreover, the sulfur‐doped carbon encapsulation and micro‐nano array architecture endow the catalyst with excellent corrosion resistance and mass transport capability, realizing long‐term stability (500 mA cm −2 at 1.53 V for 500 h) in membrane electrode assemblies. This work provides a versatile interface engineering and encapsulation strategy for high‐performance nickel‐based electrocatalysts toward urea electrolysis and beyond.
title_zh: 晶格应变与内置电场在多相异质界面通过动态NiOOH介导协同促进尿素氧化
abstract_zh: 摘要 镍基异质结电催化剂在尿素氧化反应（UOR）中的实际应用受到活性位点不足和多步反应动力学缓慢的阻碍。本文制备了一种硫掺杂木质素衍生碳包覆的Ni-NiO-MoO2微纳阵列（Ni-NiO-MoO2@SC）来解决这些问题。实验和理论结果表明，由于各组分的功函数和电子结构不同，多相异质界面自发产生内置电场，同时诱导晶格应变，二者协同优化了电子结构并加速了活性NiOOH物种的动态生成。原位电化学表征和密度泛函理论计算进一步证实，该工程化界面促进了尿素的吸附，有利于N─N偶联和C─N键断裂，加速了*COOH中间体的脱附，并避免了NiOOH的过度积累。因此，Ni-NiO-MoO2@SC展现出优异的UOR活性，在10/500 mA cm−2下的低电位分别为1.34/1.40 V。此外，硫掺杂碳包覆和微纳阵列结构赋予催化剂优异的耐腐蚀性和传质能力，在膜电极组件中实现了长期稳定性（500 mA cm−2、1.53 V下运行500 h）。这项工作为面向尿素电解及更广泛领域的高性能镍基电催化剂提供了一种通用的界面工程与包覆策略。

title: Thickness‐Gated Water and Electron Transport in Near‐Critical Ultrathin Polyethylene Membrane Electrodes
abstract: ABSTRACT Electrochemical systems are constrained by a materials paradox: chemically robust porous separators are typically hydrophobic and electronically insulating, forcing bulky, carbon‐rich interfaces to couple mass transport and electrical contact. Here we show that pushing freestanding porous polyethylene into a near‐critical ultrathin regime turns thickness into a geometric gate, enabling these functions to be switched without chemical modification. Near an inferred lower bound (∼10 nm), a 60 nm membrane already enters this regime: liquid‐entry pressure collapses into a sub‐bar window, enabling aqueous‐electrolyte permeation, while the electrical threshold shifts to sub‐volt soft dielectric breakdown, yielding persistent through‐plane conductivity. The same scaffold enhances nanowire‐matrix coupling via high conformability and real contact area, enabling a binder‐ and carbon‐free ∼300 nm ultrathin membrane electrode. As a stringent liquid‐phase electrochemical validation, this membrane electrode drives selective nitrate‐to‐ammonia electroreduction in flowing alkaline electrolytes with sustained performance. Near‐critical ultrathinness thus emerges as a gateable design dimension for re‐imagining commodity plastics as transmembrane‐active platforms.
title_zh: 近临界超薄聚乙烯膜电极中厚度门控的水与电子传输
abstract_zh: 摘要 电化学系统受制于一种材料悖论：化学性质稳健的多孔隔膜通常具有疏水性和电子绝缘性，迫使采用笨重的富碳界面来兼顾传质与电接触。在这里，我们展示了将独立多孔聚乙烯推向近临界超薄状态可使厚度成为一种几何门控，从而在无需化学改性的情况下切换这些功能。在推测的下限（约10 nm）附近，厚度为60 nm的膜已进入该状态：液体侵入压力骤降至亚巴级窗口，使水性电解液得以渗透；同时电学阈值转变为亚伏级的软介质击穿，产生持久的面外导电性。同一骨架通过高柔顺性和真实接触面积增强了纳米线与基体的耦合，实现了无粘结剂、无碳的约300 nm超薄膜电极。作为严格的液相电化学验证，该膜电极在流动碱性电解液中驱动了持续高性能的选择性硝酸盐电还原制氨。近临界超薄性由此成为一种可门控的设计维度，用于将大宗塑料重新构想为跨膜活性平台。

title: Chelation Compensation Strategy for High‐Performance Iron‐Based Redox Flow Batteries
abstract: ABSTRACT Iron‐based redox flow batteries (IRFBs) are compelling candidates for cost‐effective grid‐scale energy storage, benefiting from high safety, low cost, and the natural abundance of iron‐based active species. However, heterogeneous interface instability, side reactions, and kinetic deactivation lead to capacity decay and energy efficiency reduction, which limits the long‐term cycle stability of IRFBs. Chelation compensation is employed to regulate metal‐ion redox species through multidentate ligand design. Their coordination environment, solvation structure, and interfacial reactivity are thereby optimized, leading to improved energy efficiency and cycling stability. This review summarizes the major degradation mechanisms of IRFBs and highlights recent progress in chelation‐modified systems constructed with representative chelating functional groups. Particular attention is given to the influence of chelation on heterogeneous interface instability, side reactions, and reaction kinetics. Finally, current challenges and future directions in ligand design, electrolyte compatibility, mechanistic understanding, and practical implementation are discussed, offering guidance for the development of high‐performance chelation‐modified IRFBs for large‐scale energy storage.
title_zh: 面向高性能铁基氧化还原液流电池的螯合补偿策略
abstract_zh: 摘要 铁基氧化还原液流电池（IRFBs）凭借高安全性、低成本以及铁基活性物种的天然丰度，成为经济型电网级储能的极具吸引力的候选技术。然而，异质界面不稳定性、副反应和动力学失活会导致容量衰减和能量效率下降，限制了IRFBs的长期循环稳定性。螯合补偿策略被用于通过多齿配体设计调控金属离子氧化还原物种，从而优化其配位环境、溶剂化结构和界面反应性，进而提升能量效率和循环稳定性。本综述总结了IRFBs的主要衰减机制，并重点介绍了采用代表性螯合官能团构建的螯合修饰体系的最新进展。特别关注了螯合作用对异质界面不稳定性、副反应和反应动力学的影响。最后，讨论了配体设计、电解液相容性、机理认识和实际应用方面的当前挑战与未来方向，为开发面向大规模储能的高性能螯合修饰IRFBs提供指导。

title: Review on Textile Triboelectric Nanogenerators: From Material Design to Self‐Powered Wearable Energy Systems
abstract: ABSTRACT The rapid growth of wearable electronics, smart textiles, and the Internet of Things (IoT) has increased the demand for sustainable, self‐powered energy solutions. Textile‐based triboelectric nanogenerators (T‐TENGs) have emerged as a promising technology by combining efficient mechanical energy harvesting with the flexibility, breathability, stretchability, washability, and wearability of textiles. This review provides a comprehensive overview of recent advances in T‐TENGs, covering the complete design hierarchy from fundamental mechanisms to wearable applications. The operating principles of alternating‐current and emerging direct‐current TENGs, including contact electrification, electrostatic induction, electrostatic breakdown, and tribovoltaic effects, are discussed. Recent progress in triboelectric material engineering, fiber and yarn design, and textile architectures—including woven, knitted, braided, embroidered, multilayer, and 3D structures—is systematically reviewed with emphasis on performance enhancement and scalability. Applications in biomechanical sensing, wearable healthcare, human–machine interaction, smart textiles, and self‐powered wearable systems are summarized, highlighting the distinction between self‐powered sensing and fully autonomous wearable platforms. Finally, key challenges, including low current output, environmental stability, washability, durability, scalable manufacturing, performance standardization, and commercialization, are critically analyzed, and future research directions toward intelligent, fully autonomous, and commercially viable self‐powered wearable systems are outlined.
title_zh: 纺织摩擦电纳米发电机综述：从材料设计到自供电可穿戴能量系统
abstract_zh: 摘要 可穿戴电子设备、智能纺织品和物联网（IoT）的快速发展增加了对可持续、自供能解决方案的需求。基于纺织物的摩擦电纳米发电机（T-TENGs）将高效的机械能收集与纺织物的柔韧性、透气性、可拉伸性、可洗涤性和可穿戴性相结合，已成为一种前景广阔的技术。本综述全面概述了T-TENGs的最新进展，涵盖了从基本机理到可穿戴应用的完整设计层级。讨论了交流型和新兴直流型TENGs的工作原理，包括接触起电、静电感应、静电击穿和摩擦伏特效应。系统综述了摩擦电材料工程、纤维和纱线设计以及纺织物结构（包括机织、针织、编织、刺绣、多层和3D结构）方面的最新进展，重点强调性能提升和可扩展性。总结了在生物力学传感、可穿戴医疗、人机交互、智能纺织品和自供能可穿戴系统方面的应用，突出了自供能传感与完全自主可穿戴平台之间的区别。最后，批判性分析了关键挑战，包括低电流输出、环境稳定性、可洗涤性、耐久性、规模化制造、性能标准化和商业化，并展望了迈向智能化、完全自主和商业化

title: Synergistic Gradient Interphase Engineering for Ultra‐Stable and High‐Rate Quasi‐Solid‐State Sodium Metal Batteries
abstract: ABSTRACT Quasi‐solid‐state sodium metal batteries (QSSMBs) have emerged as a pivotal technology for safe, high‐energy‐density, and large‐scale energy storage. However, the practical application of QSSMBs is severely hindered by the formation of an unstable and high‐impedance solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) that fails to accommodate the dramatic volume fluctuations of sodium (Na) metal anodes, consequently leading to rapid capacity decay during high‐rate cycling. Herein, we propose a rational design strategy to construct a rigid‐inner/flexible‐outer gradient SEI architecture by modulating the stepwise reduction behavior of functional additives within a poly(1,3‐dioxolane) electrolyte. By introducing 2,2,2‐trifluoroethyl trifluoromethanesulfonate to undergo synergistic decomposition with fluoroethylene carbonate, this formulation enables the in situ construction of the dual‐layer gradient interphase. This unique SEI efficiently facilitates desolvation and accelerates Na + transport, while achieving even Na plating after cycling. Consequently, the designed electrolyte delivers outstanding electrochemical performance, enabling Na || sodium vanadium phosphate full cells to exhibit long cycle‐life of 5500 cycles at 20 C and 97.5% capacity retention after 1000 cycles at 25 C. This work highlights the critical role of gradient SEI engineering and offers an insightful design principle for developing next‐generation QSSMBs.
title_zh: 用于超稳定高倍率准固态钠金属电池的协同梯度界面工程
abstract_zh: 摘要 准固态钠金属电池（QSSMBs）已成为安全、高能量密度和大规模储能的关键技术。然而，QSSMBs的实际应用受到不稳定且高阻抗的固体电解质界面（SEI）形成的严重阻碍，该界面无法适应钠（Na）金属负极的剧烈体积波动，从而导致高倍率循环期间容量的快速衰减。在此，我们提出了一种合理的设计策略，通过调控聚（1,3-二氧戊环）电解质中功能添加剂的分步还原行为，构建刚内/柔外的梯度SEI结构。通过引入2,2,2-三氟乙基三氟甲磺酸酯与氟代碳酸乙烯酯发生协同分解，该配方实现了双层梯度界面的原位构建。这种独特的SEI有效促进去溶剂化并加速Na+传输，同时实现了循环后Na的均匀沉积。因此，所设计的电解质展现出卓越的电化学性能，使Na||磷酸钒钠全电池在20 C下实现5500次循环的长循环寿命，并在25 C下循环1000次后保持97.5%的容量保持率。这项工作凸显了梯度SEI工程的关键作用，为开发下一代QSSMBs提供了富有启发性的设计原则。

title: From Laboratory to Industry: Evaporating Functional Layers at High Rates for Fully Textured Perovskite/Silicon Tandems
abstract: ABSTRACT The commercialization of perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells requires not only scalable processing of the perovskite top cell but also deposition of the different functional layers at rates high enough to enable high‐throughput production. In this work, we bridge the gap between laboratory research and industrial requirements by demonstrating the deposition of hole‐transporting materials, inorganic scaffolds, and electron‐transporting materials at rates at least an order of magnitude higher than conventional baselines using point‐source evaporation. We systematically investigate the impact of accelerated deposition on film properties, composition, and device performance to guide high‐rate processing in industry‐standard scalable tools. By establishing the feasibility of high‐rate evaporation for multiple layers, this study provides realistic insights into the transition from lab‐scale processing of perovskite top cells toward industrial‐scale manufacturing and highlights aspects that have to be considered in the future when switching from laboratory equipment (typically point sources) to industrial equipment (typically linear sources). Through the use of higher evaporation rates for the functional layers, we reached a power conversion efficiency of ~30% in fully textured tandems, increasing to 32.3% with thermally evaporated PDAI passivation. These findings provide crucial insights needed to push perovskite photovoltaic technologies toward high‑throughput and scalable production processes.
title_zh: 从实验室到产业：面向全纹理钙钛矿/硅叠层电池的高速率蒸发功能层
abstract_zh: 摘要 钙钛矿/硅叠层太阳能电池的商业化不仅需要钙钛矿顶电池的可规模化加工，还要求各功能层的沉积速率足够高，以实现高通量生产。在本工作中，我们通过点源蒸发技术演示了空穴传输材料、无机支架和电子传输材料的沉积，其速率比常规基准至少高出一个数量级，从而弥合了实验室研究与工业需求之间的差距。我们系统研究了加速沉积对薄膜性质、组成和器件性能的影响，以指导在行业标准可扩展工具中的高速率加工。通过确立多层高速率蒸发的可行性，本研究为钙钛矿顶电池从实验室规模加工向工业规模制造的过渡提供了切合实际的见解，并强调了未来从实验室设备（通常为点源）转向工业设备（通常为线性源）时需要考虑的方面。通过在功能层采用更高的蒸发速率，我们在全绒面叠层电池中实现了约30%的功率转换效率，并借助热蒸发PDAI钝化提升至32.3%。这些发现为推动钙钛矿光伏技术走向高通量、可规模化的生产工艺提供了至关重要的见解。

title: Supramolecular Engineering of Nanocellulose/COF Composite Membranes: Reconciling Multidimensional Proton Pathways With Framework Anchoring
abstract: ABSTRACT Achieving high proton conductivity with dimensional stability remains a critical challenge for nanocellulose‐based proton exchange membranes (NC‐PEMs), as necessary acid functionalization invariably triggers severe swelling. Here we report a supramolecular engineering strategy that integrates sulfonated nanocellulose (SO 3 H‐NC) with a —2D covalent organic framework (TFP‐DABA), yielding a SO 3 H‐NC@TFP‐DABA membrane that overcomes this long‐standing trade‐off. Mechanistically, SO 3 H‐NC acts as a functional intercalator to induce the exfoliation of TFP‐DABA layers, exposing shielded acidic sites and reorganizing the hydrogen‐bond network into a continuous, multidimensional proton‐transport pathway. Simultaneously, TFP‐DABA framework imposes rigid dimensional confinement, effectively constraining the hydration‐induced swelling of the SO 3 H‐NC. Consequently, the optimized SO 3 H‐NC@TFP‐DABA 3/7 membrane delivers record‐breaking proton conductivities of 590.6 and 281.5 mS cm −1 at 80°C under 98% and 33% relative humidity (RH), respectively, corresponding to 13.4‐ and 5.1‐fold enhancements over Nafion 212. The superior transport efficiency facilitates a peak power density of 240 mW cm −2 in single‐cell tests, a threefold performance increase over the commercial standard. Meanwhile, the membrane maintains a swelling ratio of below 5%, nearly four times lower than that of Nafion 212. This work establishes a practical supramolecular design principle for constructing bio‐PEMs that are highly conductive yet dimensionally stable across a wide range of humidity conditions.
title_zh: 纳米纤维素/COF复合膜的超分子工程：多维质子通路与框架锚定的协调
abstract_zh: 摘要 在保持尺寸稳定性的同时实现高质子传导性仍是纳米纤维素基质子交换膜（NC-PEMs）面临的关键挑战，因为必要的酸功能化 invariably 会引发严重的溶胀。在此，我们报道了一种超分子工程策略，将磺化纳米纤维素（SO3H-NC）与二维共价有机框架（TFP-DABA）集成，制备出克服这一长期权衡关系的SO3H-NC@TFP-DABA膜。在机理上，SO3H-NC作为功能性插层剂诱导TFP-DABA层的剥离，暴露被屏蔽的酸性位点，并将氢键网络重组为连续的多维质子传输通道。同时，TFP-DABA框架施加刚性尺寸约束，有效抑制SO3H-NC的水化诱导溶胀。因此，优化后的SO3H-NC@TFP-DABA 3/7膜在80°C、98%和33%相对湿度（RH）下分别实现了590.6和281.5 mS cm−1的破纪录质子电导率，分别比Nafion 212提高13.4倍和5.1倍。卓越的传输效率使单电池测试中的峰值功率密度达到240 mW cm−2，比商业标准提高三倍。同时，该膜的溶胀率保持在5%以下，比Nafion 212低近四倍。这项工作为构建在宽湿度范围内兼具高导电性和尺寸稳定性的生物基质子交换膜（bio-PEMs）确立了实用的超分子设计原则。

title: Volatilization‐Kinetics‐Dictated Crystallization Enabling Efficient Perovskite/Silicon Tandem Solar Cells for Near‐Space Environment
abstract: ABSTRACT The remarkable progress in metal halide perovskite solar cells (PSCs) has propelled perovskite/silicon tandem architectures as a transformative solution in photovoltaics, enabling efficiencies beyond single‐junction limits while offering high specific power and radiation resistance for challenging environments, including near‐space and aerospace applications. Wide‐bandgap (WBG) perovskites on textured silicon, however, encounter hurdles in controlled crystallization and halide phase stability, leading to recombination losses and reduced performance. This work investigates additive engineering using volatile alkylammonium chlorides with tailored alkyl chain lengths to fine‐tune volatilization kinetics. By strategically slowing down the volatilization rate, the additive promotes homogeneous nucleation and retards grain growth, which is critical for achieving uniform perovskite coverage over the intricate topography of textured silicon substrates.​ An optimized additive promotes dense, oriented films with suppressed segregation, culminating in tandem solar cells boasting a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 31.1% and stability exceeding 1000 h. First‐ever flight test measurements and calibrations of perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells were conducted under near‐space conditions at altitudes reaching 37.29 km. These advancements may contribute to the development of robust tandem devices for various application settings.
title_zh: 挥发动力学主导的结晶实现适用于临近空间环境的高效钙钛矿/硅叠层太阳能电池
abstract_zh: 摘要 金属卤化物钙钛矿太阳能电池（PSCs）的显著进展使钙钛矿/硅叠层结构成为光伏领域的变革性解决方案，其效率超越了单结极限，同时在近太空和航空航天等严苛环境中提供高比功率和抗辐射能力。然而，绒面硅上的宽带隙（WBG）钙钛矿在可控结晶和卤化物相稳定性方面面临障碍，导致复合损失和性能下降。本工作研究了采用具有定制烷基链长度的挥发性烷基铵氯化物进行添加剂工程，以精细调节挥发动力学。通过策略性地减缓挥发速率，该添加剂促进均匀成核并延缓晶粒生长，这对于在绒面硅衬底复杂形貌上实现均匀的钙钛矿覆盖至关重要。优化后的添加剂促进了致密、取向的薄膜并抑制了偏析，最终使叠层太阳能电池实现了31.1%的功率转换效率（PCE）和超过1000小时的稳定性。首次在高达37.29 km高度的近太空条件下进行了钙钛矿/硅叠层太阳能电池的飞行测试测量与校准。这些进步可能有助于开发适用于各种应用场景的 robust 叠层器件。

title: Interfacial Stress Chemistry in Zinc Anodes for Aqueous Zinc‐Ion Batteries
abstract: ABSTRACT Aqueous zinc‐ion batteries (AZIBs) have emerged as promising candidates for grid‐scale and wearable energy storage applications owing to their intrinsic safety, low cost, and high theoretical capacity of Zn anodes. However, their practical deployment remains severely constrained by the poor reversibility and structural instability of Zn anodes during cycling, which have conventionally been attributed to isolated electrochemical failures, such as dendrite growth and parasitic water‐induced side reactions. Increasing evidence reveals these degradations originate from a self‐amplifying electrochemical‐mechanical coupling process involving interfacial stress evolution. Nevertheless, a unified mechanics‐centered framework for understanding failure mechanisms in AZIBs is still lacking, while the secondary stress effects induced by mainstream modification strategies have been largely overlooked. In this review, we establish a comprehensive electrochemical‐mechanical coupling framework to systematically elucidate the multiple origins of interfacial stress, critically assess state‐of‐the‐art stress characterization techniques, and explicitly uncover the mechanical mismatch and secondary stress effects associated with widely adopted anode modification strategies. Furthermore, we reorganize stress‐regulation strategies according to the mitigation of residual, induced, and crystallization stresses, and discuss the key challenges and forward‐looking research directions, providing fundamental mechanistic insights for rational design of ultra‐stable Zn anodes to advance AZIB commercialization.
title_zh: 水系锌离子电池锌负极的界面应力化学
abstract_zh: 摘要 水系锌离子电池（AZIBs）凭借其本征安全性、低成本以及Zn负极的高理论容量，已成为电网级和可穿戴储能应用的有前景候选者。然而，其实际部署仍受到Zn负极在循环过程中差的可逆性和结构不稳定性的严重制约，这通常被归因于孤立的电化学失效，如枝晶生长和寄生水诱导副反应。越来越多的证据表明，这些退化源于涉及界面应力演化的自放大电化学-力学耦合过程。然而，目前仍缺乏以力学为中心理解AZIBs失效机制的统一框架，而主流改性策略诱导的次级应力效应也在很大程度上被忽视。在本综述中，我们建立了全面的电化学-力学耦合框架，以系统阐明界面应力的多重来源，批判性评估最先进的应力表征技术，并明确揭示广泛采用的负极改性策略相关的力学失配和次级应力效应。此外，我们根据残余应力、诱导应力和结晶应力的缓解对应力调控策略进行了重新组织，并讨论了关键挑战和前瞻性研究方向，为合理设计超稳定Zn负极以推进AZIBs的商业化提供了基础性机理见解。

title: Redox‐Mediated Electrified Method for Green and Low‐Cost Spent Lithium‐Ion Battery Materials Recycling
abstract: ABSTRACT After 30 years of commercialization and mass production, lithium‐ion batteries have generated massive waste streams, especially with their expanding use in electric vehicles. Recycling spent batteries and valorizing useful components are therefore increasingly urgent for sustainable development. However, conventional pyrometallurgical and hydrometallurgical methods are limited by high energy consumption or large chemical input, creating demand for greener and more efficient recycling technologies. Here, using LiCoO 2 as an example, we report a closed‐loop electrified chemical process based on redox‐targeting reactions to recover valuable species from spent battery materials using only electricity and water. Complementary reductive leaching of LiCoO 2 and oxidative leaching of LiFePO 4 were performed with anthraquinone‐2,7‐disulfonate as a regenerative redox mediator to sequentially break down LiCoO 2 and achieve efficient separation of Co 2+ and Li + in the form of Co(OH) 2 and LiOH. This cost‐effective and environmentally friendly method was also extended to the recycling of LiNi x Mn y Co z O 2 with a high recovery rate of Li + and transition metal species. It is anticipated that the electrified chemical recycling method demonstrated here would provide a credible solution to the valorization of battery waste and contribute to the sustainable development of lithium‐ion batteries.
title_zh: 用于绿色低成本废旧锂离子电池材料回收的氧化还原介导电化学方法
abstract_zh: 摘要 经过30年的商业化和大规模生产，锂离子电池产生了大量废弃物，尤其是在电动汽车中应用不断扩大之际。因此，回收废旧电池并实现有用组分的资源化利用对可持续发展日益紧迫。然而，传统的火法和湿法冶金方法受限于高能耗或大量化学品投入，亟需更绿色、更高效的回收技术。在此，以LiCoO2为例，我们报道了一种基于氧化还原靶向反应的闭环电气化化学工艺，仅使用电力和水即可从废旧电池材料中回收有价物质。以蒽醌-2,7-二磺酸盐为可再生氧化还原介体，对LiCoO2进行互补性还原浸出并对LiFePO4进行氧化浸出，逐步分解LiCoO2并以Co(OH)2和LiOH的形式实现Co2+和Li+的高效分离。这种成本低廉且环境友好的方法还被拓展到LiNixMnyCozO2的回收，实现了Li+和过渡金属物种的高回收率。预期本文演示的电气化化学回收方法将为电池废弃物的资源化利用提供可信方案，并促进锂离子电池的可持续发展。

title: One‐End‐Truncated Au 52 and Au 70 Quantum Rods: High‐Quantum‐Yield NIR‐II Emitters With Aspect‐Ratio‐Dominated Photophysics
abstract: ABSTRACT Precise control over absorption/emission in NIR‐II (1000–1700 nm) is essential for advancing photonic technologies. Atomically precise gold quantum rods (QRs) provide a structurally well‐defined platform for fine‐tuning NIR‐II anisotropic excitonic behavior at the atomic level. In this study, we report Au 52 (PET) 38 and Au 70 (PET) 50 (PET = 2‐phenylethanethiolate) as members of a distinct branch of Au QRs with one‐end‐truncated kernel topology. The Au 52 and Au 70 exhibit NIR‐II absorption at 1032 and 1275 nm and nanosecond fluorescence at 1100 and 1360 nm, respectively. Their high quantum yields (20.9% for Au 52 and 14.8% for Au 70 ) together with high brightness (5.6 × 10 4 M −1 cm −1 for Au 52 and a similar order of magnitude for Au 70 ) substantially exceed those of most molecular NIR‐II dyes, highlighting their promise as efficient inorganic NIR‐II fluorophores. Comparative analysis across two structurally distinct Au QR families, including one‐end‐truncated and double‐pointed rods, reveals that the longitudinal absorption and emission peak wavelengths, as well as the fluorescence linewidths, follow a common aspect‐ratio‐dependent scaling relation, suggesting length‐dependent modulation of the ground‐ and excited‐state electronic structure. These findings uncover a hierarchical interplay between rod elongation and kernel topology in defining NIR‐II excitonic behavior and expand the structural design space of atomically precise QRs.
title_zh: 单端截断的Au52和Au70量子棒:具有长径比主导光物理特性的高量子产率NIR-II发射体
abstract_zh: 摘要 精确控制NIR-II（1000–1700 nm）区域的吸收/发射对推进光子技术至关重要。原子级精确的金量子棒（QRs）为在原子层面精细调节NIR-II各向异性激子行为提供了结构明确的平台。在本研究中，我们报道了Au52(PET)38和Au70(PET)50（PET = 2-苯乙硫醇盐）作为具有单端截断内核拓扑的一类独特金量子棒分支的成员。Au52和Au70分别在1032和1275 nm处表现出NIR-II吸收，并分别在1100和1360 nm处表现出纳秒荧光。它们的高量子产率（Au52为20.9%，Au70为14.8%）以及高亮度（Au52为5.6 × 104 M−1 cm−1，Au70具有相近数量级）大大超过了大多数分子型NIR-II染料，凸显了其作为高效无机NIR-II荧光团的前景。对两个结构不同的金量子棒家族（包括单端截断棒和双尖棒）的对比分析表明，纵向吸收和发射峰值波长以及荧光线宽遵循共同的依赖纵横比的标度关系，暗示基态和激发态电子结构的长度依赖性调制。这些发现揭示了棒伸长与内核拓扑在决定NIR-II激子行为中的分层相互作用，并拓展了原子级精确量子棒的结构设计空间。

title: 1D Plasticity in Semiconductor Crystals
abstract: ABSTRACT The exceptional plasticity recently found in inorganic semiconductors can be classified into two types: the three‐dimensional (3D) orientation‐insensitive deformability in polycrystals, and the two‐dimensional (2D) anisotropic case in layered crystals. It is thus highly anticipated that one‐dimensional (1D) plasticity should also exist but it has not been found yet. Here this work reports the excellent 1D plasticity in tin selenide (SnSe) semiconductor crystals. In in‐plane directions, the bending strain is as large as ∼22.7% for the zig‐zag‐aligned specimen (plasticity) while as small as ∼1.4% for the armchair‐aligned one (brittleness). Such 1D plasticity is ascribed to the coherent and stronger bond topology along b ‐axis that allows for multiple deformation mechanisms including layer segments, interlayer slip, bridging, lattice distortion, and dislocations. This bonding topology enables that the 1D plasticity is also observed in isostructural SnS and GeSe crystals. High‐performance shape‐conformable thermoelectric generators are then successfully developed using materials with 1D plasticity. This work enriches the diagram for plasticity and thus provides a new direction for the design and discovery of ductile semiconductors.
title_zh: 半导体晶体中的一维塑性
abstract_zh: 摘要：近期在无机半导体中发现的优异塑性可分为两类：多晶体中的三维（3D）取向不敏感变形能力，以及层状晶体中的二维（2D）各向异性塑性。因此，人们高度期待一维（1D）塑性的存在，但尚未被发现。本工作报道了硒化锡（SnSe）半导体晶体中优异的1D塑性。在面内方向上，沿锯齿方向排列的样品（塑性）的弯曲应变可高达约22.7%，而沿扶手椅方向排列的样品（脆性）的弯曲应变仅为约1.4%。这种1D塑性归因于沿b轴的相干且更强的键拓扑结构，它允许多种变形机制，包括层段、层间滑移、桥接、晶格畸变和位错。这种键拓扑使得在同构的SnS和GeSe晶体中也观察到1D塑性。随后，利用具有1D塑性的材料成功开发了高性能的形状可适配热电发电机。本工作丰富了塑性图谱，从而为延性半导体的设计与发现提供了新方向。

title: Aggregation‐Enhanced Photocleavage for Time‐Resolved Multicolor Fluorescence Encryption and Quaternary Optical Storage
abstract: ABSTRACT Dynamic fluorescence systems capable of generating time‐resolved multicolor optical outputs are highly desirable for advanced information encryption and optical storage. However, precise regulation of fluorescence evolution kinetics remains challenging, as most reported systems either exhibit intrinsically fixed photochemical kinetics or require complex multicomponent assemblies. Herein, we report an aggregation‐regulated photochemical system in which the photocleavage kinetics can be continuously programmed through aggregation‐dependent excited‐state engineering. A donor–acceptor luminogen, TPEMN, with a photocleavable central vinyl bridge was rationally designed. Upon photoirradiation, TPEMN undergoes a pronounced aggregation‐enhanced photooxidative cleavage process in which photoreaction kinetics accelerate progressively with aggregation degree, accompanied by continuous multiple fluorescence evolutions from orange to blue. Systematic experimental and theoretical investigations reveal that aggregation suppresses excited‐state structural relaxation, prolongs excited‐state lifetime, facilitates intersystem crossing, and promotes reactive oxygen species generation, thereby markedly leading to accelerated photocleavage kinetics. This converts conventional binary photoresponses into well‐resolved time‐dependent fluorescence states, allowing demonstration of time‐gated information encryption with deceptive intermediates, multilevel anti‐counterfeiting with “burn‐after‐read” functionality, and high‐density quaternary optical storage. This work establishes aggregation‐regulated excited‐state engineering as a novel paradigm for manipulating photochemical reactivity, providing a conceptual framework for the development of high‐efficiency photoreactions, adaptive stimulus‐responsive materials, and dynamic information applications.
title_zh: 聚集增强的光裂解用于时间分辨多色荧光加密和四进制光存储
abstract_zh: 摘要：能够产生时间分辨多色光输出的动态荧光系统对于高级信息加密和光存储极具吸引力。然而，精确调控荧光演化动力学仍具挑战性，因为大多数已报道的系统要么表现出固有固定的光化学动力学，要么需要复杂的多组分组装。本文报道了一种聚集调控的光化学系统，其中光裂解动力学可通过依赖于聚集态的激发态工程进行连续编程。我们合理设计了一种含有可光裂解中心乙烯基桥的供体–受体发光体TPEMN。在光照射下，TPEMN经历显著的聚集增强的光氧化裂解过程，光反应动力学随聚集程度逐渐加快，并伴随着从橙色到蓝色的连续多重荧光演变。系统的实验和理论研究揭示，聚集抑制了激发态结构弛豫，延长了激发态寿命，促进了系间窜越并促进活性氧的生成，从而显著加快了光裂解动力学。这将传统的二元光响应转化为分辨良好的时间依赖性荧光状态，实现了带诱饵中间态的时间门控信息加密、具有“阅后即焚”功能的多级防伪以及高密度四进制光存储的演示。本工作建立了聚集调……

title: Leveraging Protein Dynamics for Selective Inhibition of Threonyl‐tRNA Synthetase by Obafluorin Analogs
abstract: ABSTRACT The widespread emergence of antibiotic resistance necessitates the development of novel agents with unique mechanisms of action. Obafluorin (OB), a natural β‐lactone antibiotic, is a covalent inhibitor of threonyl‐tRNA synthetase (ThrRS), but the high conservation of the active site between prokaryote and eukaryote ThrRSs results in minimal selectivity, hindering the therapeutic potential of OB. Here, we report a structure dynamics‐based design strategy that transforms OB into a selective antibacterial agent. OB inhibits human and bacterial ThrRSs with nearly equal potency due to identical binding modes. The nitrophenyl moiety of OB is proposed as a ‘kinetic sensor’ that discriminates between sensitive and resistant ThrRS paralogs. Guided by this insight, we designed a series of OB analogs through rational modification of this moiety. Among them, OB‐D4 bearing a para ‐methoxyphenyl group in place of the nitrophenyl group, exhibited a 241‐fold selectivity for bacterial over human ThrRS, along with a markedly improved safety profile with minimal cytotoxicity. In a murine skin infection model, OB‐D4 effectively eradicated pathogens, resolving inflammation, and promoting wound healing. Together, this work establishes a ‘kinetic sensor’ strategy for achieving species selectivity, turning a fundamental challenge in drug discovery‐high active‐site conservation—into an exploitable opportunity based on dynamic differences.
title_zh: 利用蛋白质动力学实现Obafluorin类似物对苏氨酰-tRNA合成酶的选择性抑制
abstract_zh: 摘要：抗生素耐药性的广泛出现 necessitates 开发具有独特作用机制的新型药物。Obafluorin（OB）是一种天然β-内酯类抗生素，是苏氨酰-tRNA合成酶（ThrRS）的共价抑制剂，但原核与真核ThrRS活性位点的高度保守性导致其选择性极低，阻碍了OB的治疗潜力。在此，我们报道了一种基于结构动力学的设计策略，将OB转化为选择性抗菌剂。由于相同的结合模式，OB对人源和细菌ThrRS的抑制效力几乎相当。OB的硝基苯基部分被提出作为一种“动力学传感器”，可区分敏感和耐药的ThrRS同源蛋白。在这一认识的指导下，我们通过合理修饰该部分设计了一系列OB类似物。其中，用对甲氧基苯基取代硝基苯基的OB-D4对细菌ThrRS相对于人ThrRS表现出241倍的选择性，同时安全性显著改善，细胞毒性极低。在小鼠皮肤感染模型中，OB-D4有效清除病原体，消除炎症并促进伤口愈合。总之，本工作建立了一种实现物种选择性的“动力学传感器”策略，将药物发现中的一大根本挑战——活性位点高度保守——转化为基于动力学差异的可利用机遇。

title: A chlorinated organic cation enables stable 2D/3D tin iodide perovskite photovoltaics
abstract: Tin halide perovskites (THPs) offer narrower bandgaps and improved environmental safety compared with the widely studied lead-based perovskites, but their air sensitivity has hindered their progress and demands new material design to enable their practical applications. Here we report stable and efficient 2D/3D tin perovskite solar cells enabled by new ultrastable 2D and quasi-2D THPs based on the 4-chloro-phenethylammonium (4ClPEA) cation. The stronger π-stacking interactions and tighter interlayer packing in (4ClPEA)2SnI4 among (4XPEA)2SnI4 structures (X = H, F, Cl, Br) substantially impede oxygen and water diffusion, enabling superior air and moisture stability and bright photoluminescence lasting several months in ambient air. The addition of 4ClPEA markedly improves 2D/3D THP film crystallinity and orientation, leading to 16.2% efficient 2D/3D THP solar cells that show prolonged storage stability and operational stability at 55 °C surpassing 1,000 h. This study establishes a new strategy for designing stable and efficient THPs towards their practical applications.
title_zh: 一种氯化有机阳离子实现稳定的2D/3D碘化锡钙钛矿光伏器件

title: Programmable alkene skeleton construction via switchable radical and organometallic sorting
abstract: The programmable synthesis of complex alkene skeletons, including regioisomers, stereoisomers and conjugated homologues in a single operation, is a long-standing goal in synthetic chemistry, given the profound influence of these structural features on molecular function. Traditional methods typically rely on predesigned substrates or rigid reaction pathways, which often restrict structural diversity. Here we report a nickel-catalysed sequential coupling of alkynes, organohalides and a diboron reagent. This method not only simultaneously achieves regioselective and unique stereoselective modulation in alkyne difunctionalization, affording uncommon 1,2-trans and 2,1-cis alkenes, but also accomplishes the construction of conjugated homologues via the controlled incorporation of two alkynes, thereby achieving the rare divergent synthesis of two conjugated diene products. Mechanistic studies reveal that the electronic properties of the ligands regulate the generation of organometallic species versus radicals, while the intrinsic metal-binding ability of the various radicals further modulates their reactivity, collectively governing product selectivity.
title_zh: 通过可切换的自由基和有机金属分选实现可编程烯烃骨架构建
