title: Spectrally Programmable Spin‐Polarized Photocurrents in WSe 2 –NiPS 3 Magnetic van der Waals Heterostructures
abstract: ABSTRACT Efficient generation and control of spin‐polarized currents in semiconductors remain central challenges for spin‐based electronics, particularly due to impedance mismatch and the reliance on magnetic fields or ferromagnetic contacts. Here, we introduce a materials platform for spectrally programmable spin transport based on a van der Waals (vdW) heterostructure combining the antiferromagnetic semiconductor NiPS 3 with WSe 2 . In a p–n diode architecture, circularly polarized excitation produces pronounced photoconductive resonances with spin‐polarization reaching 80% near the Néel temperature and persisting at ≈30% at room temperature. Remarkably, selected spectral bands retain their polarization sign across the magnetic phase transition, evidencing robust, spectrally protected spin‐polarized current generation. Polarization‐resolved photogalvanic measurements reveal a dominant circular injection‐current mechanism, confirming spin‐polarized carrier transport. First‐principles calculations show that an applied electric field induces interfacial hybridization and spin‐layer locking, giving rise to localized symmetry breaking and enhanced optical absorption while preserving global time‐reversal symmetry. These results establish spectral tuning of excitation as a new control knob for spin transport, enabling spin‐current generation without magnetic fields or polarization switching. Our findings position magnetic vdW heterostructures as a versatile platform for opto‐spintronic functionality and spectrally programmable spintronic devices.
title_zh: WSe₂–NiPS₃磁性范德华异质结构中光谱可编程的自旋极化光电流
abstract_zh: 摘要 在半导体中高效产生和控制自旋极化电流仍是自旋电子学面临的核心挑战，尤其由于阻抗失配以及对磁场或铁磁接触的依赖。在此，我们介绍了一种基于范德华（vdW）异质结构的频谱可编程自旋输运材料平台，该结构将反铁磁半导体 NiPS 3 与 WSe 2 相结合。在 p–n 二极管结构中，圆偏振激发产生显著的光电导共振，其自旋极化在奈尔温度附近达到 80%，并在室温下保持在约 30%。值得注意的是，特定的光谱波段在磁相变过程中保持其极化符号不变，证明了稳健的、受频谱保护的自旋极化电流产生。极化分辨光电流测量揭示了占主导的圆偏振注入电流机制，证实了自旋极化载流子输运。第一性原理计算表明，外加电场可诱导界面杂化和自旋-层锁定，产生局域对称性破缺并增强光吸收，同时保持全局时间反演对称性。这些结果确立了激发的频谱调谐作为自旋输运的新调控手段，使自旋电流产生无需磁场或偏振切换。我们的研究结果表明，磁性 vdW 异质结构可作为光自旋电子学功能和频谱可编程自旋电子器件的多功能平台。

title: Binder Engineering for Phosphoric Acid Distribution and Retention in High‐Temperature Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell Cathodes
abstract: ABSTRACT High‐temperature proton exchange membrane fuel cells (HT‐PEMFCs) offer compelling advantages for energy conversion, including simplified water and thermal management and high tolerance to fuel impurities. In these systems, phosphoric acid (PA) serves as the primary proton conductor, enabling anhydrous proton transport. However, cathode performance and durability remain constrained by sluggish oxygen reduction kinetics and the challenge of controlling PA distribution and retention. Uneven acid distribution, manifesting as local flooding that blocks gas pathways and covers active sites or local depletion that disrupts proton‐conducting networks, causes severe mass‐transport losses and performance decay. Concurrently, gradual PA migration and loss during operation progressively degrade proton conduction pathways, accelerating voltage decay. Recent studies have established cathode binder engineering as an effective strategy to regulate both PA distribution and retention. This review systematically examines the design of cathode binder systems—encompassing polymer binder optimization and functional additive integration—and the characterization and diagnostic frameworks for evaluating their efficacy in PA management. We further integrate advanced PA characterization techniques with a comprehensive electrochemical performance evaluation framework. By establishing explicit connections among binder design, PA distribution and retention behavior, and device‐level performance assessment, this review provides an instructive guide for the rational development of high‐performance, durable HT‐PEMFC cathodes.
title_zh: 用于高温质子交换膜燃料电池阴极中磷酸分布与保持的黏结剂工程
abstract_zh: 摘要 高温质子交换膜燃料电池（HT-PEMFC）在能量转换方面具有显著优势，包括简化的水和热管理以及对燃料杂质的高耐受性。在这些系统中，磷酸（PA）作为主要的质子导体，实现无水质子输运。然而，阴极性能和耐久性仍受缓慢的氧还原动力学以及控制 PA 分布与保持的挑战所限制。不均匀的酸分布表现为局部淹渍（堵塞气体通道并覆盖活性位点）或局部耗竭（破坏质子传导网络），导致严重的传质损失和性能衰减。同时，运行过程中 PA 的逐渐迁移和损失会逐步劣化质子传导路径，加速电压衰减。近期研究表明，阴极黏结剂工程是调控 PA 分布与保持的有效策略。本综述系统考察了阴极黏结剂体系的设计——包括聚合物黏结剂优化和功能添加剂集成——以及用于评估其在 PA 管理中效能的表征与诊断框架。我们进一步将先进的 PA 表征技术与全面的电化学性能评估框架相结合。通过在黏结剂设计、PA 分布与保持行为以及器件级性能评估之间建立明确联系，本综述为高性能（材料）的合理开发提供了指导性指南。

title: Spatially Synergistic Dual‐Confinement Enables Underwater‐Stable Room‐Temperature Phosphorescent Hydrogels
abstract: ABSTRACT Organic room‐temperature phosphorescent (RTP) hydrogels are attractive as flexible luminescent materials for optoelectronic and biomedical applications, but their water‐rich and mechanically compliant nature makes it difficult to create microenvironments that simultaneously suppress nonradiative decay, resist external quenching, and maintain structural robustness. Here, we report an amphiphilic polymer chain‐driven in situ curing strategy that generates rigid luminescent epoxy microspheres uniformly within a PVA hydrogel matrix. Combined with annealing–reswelling‐induced matrix densification, this process creates a spatially synergistic dual‐confinement system, in which the inner epoxy domains immobilize phosphors while the outer dense PVA network helps impede the ingress of water and oxygen. The resulting hydrogels exhibit tunable multicolor RTP, an ultralong phosphorescence lifetime of up to 4342 ms, a daylight‐visible afterglow luminance of 87.9 cd m −2 , a time‐gated delayed‐emission quantum yield of 55.49%, and a tensile strength exceeding 10 MPa. Notably, the hydrogels retain a phosphorescence lifetime of 3172 ms after 170 days of water immersion. This work identifies spatially synergistic dual confinement as an effective route to jointly optimize phosphorescence efficiency, mechanical robustness, and long‐term underwater stability in soft luminescent hydrogels.
title_zh: 空间协同双限域实现水下稳定室温磷光水凝胶
abstract_zh: 摘要 有机室温磷光（RTP）水凝胶作为用于光电子和生物医学应用的柔性发光材料颇具吸引力，但其富水和机械柔软的特性使得难以构建既能抑制非辐射衰变、又能抵抗外部猝灭并保持结构稳健性的微环境。在此，我们报道了一种两亲性聚合物链驱动的原位固化策略，可在 PVA 水凝胶基质内均匀生成刚性发光环氧微球。结合退火–再溶胀诱导的基质致密化，该过程构建了空间协同的双重限域体系，其中内部环氧畴固定磷光体，而外部致密的 PVA 网络有助于阻碍水和氧的侵入。所得水凝胶表现出可调的多色 RTP，超长磷光寿命高达 4342 ms，日光下可见的余辉亮度为 87.9 cd m −2 ，时间门控延迟发射量子产率为 55.49%，拉伸强度超过 10 MPa。值得注意的是，水凝胶在水中浸泡 170 天后仍保持 3172 ms 的磷光寿命。这项工作确立了空间协同双重限域作为联合优化软质发光水凝胶的磷光效率、机械稳健性和长期水下稳定性的有效途径。

title: Evolution and Manipulation of Interstitial Oxygen Configuration in Titanium—A Review
abstract: ABSTRACT Oxygen has been regarded as a detrimental impurity in titanium alloys, as it triggers embrittlement and compromises ductility. Recent research advancements, however, have revolutionized this perception, revealing oxygen as a powerful microstructural architect capable of mediating phase transformations and deformation mechanisms to achieve strength–ductility combinations. This review systematically summarizes the pivotal roles of oxygen across various phases, including α, β, α′, α″, ω, and face‐centered cubic (FCC) phases. The underlying strengthening mechanisms and the oxygen embrittlement mechanisms were further analyzed, covering the strengthening theoretical models, interfacial segregation behaviors, and oxygen shuffling mechanism. These mechanistic insights are essential for understanding the evolution of dislocation configurations, twinning behaviors, and phase transformation dynamics. To harness oxygen's strengthening potential while mitigating its adverse effects, potential innovative strategies, including compositional, microstructural, and process design approaches, are proposed, which span from the atom‐scale to the micro‐scale. By integrating multiscale computational simulations, advanced in situ characterization, and the challenge of controlling oxygen uptake, this work provides a comprehensive framework for the intelligent design of next‐generation oxygen‐containing titanium alloys with exceptional mechanical properties.
title_zh: 钛中间隙氧构型的演化与调控——综述
abstract_zh: 摘要 氧一直被视为钛合金中的有害杂质，因为它会引发脆化并损害延展性。然而，近来的研究进展彻底改变了这一认知，揭示出氧是一种强大的微结构设计师，能够调控相变和变形机制，从而实现强度–延展性的协同组合。本综述系统总结了氧在各种相中的关键作用，包括 α、β、α′、α″、ω 和面心立方（FCC）相。进一步分析了潜在的强化机制和氧脆机制，涵盖强化理论模型、界面偏聚行为和氧 Shuffle 机制。这些机制性认识对于理解位错组态演化、孪生行为和相变动力学至关重要。为了利用氧的强化潜力同时减轻其不利影响，提出了潜在的创新策略，包括成分、微结构和工艺设计方法，涵盖从原子尺度到微观尺度。通过整合多尺度计算模拟、先进的原位表征以及控制氧摄取的挑战，这项工作为具有卓越力学性能的下一代含氧钛合金的智能化设计提供了全面框架。

title: The Past, Present, and Future of Biomass‐Derived Hard Carbon for Sodium‐Ion Batteries
abstract: ABSTRACT Given the cost‐effectiveness, renewability, and environmental friendliness features, biomass‐derived hard carbon has attracted significant attention in sodium‐ion batteries (SIBs). However, the macroproperties of the resultant hard carbon highly depend on the resources and components of the biomass precursors. And the structure–property relationship remains complicated, which brings huge challenges for subsequent research. To clarify such intrinsic correlation, this review systematically elucidates the physicochemical propert ies, multiscale mechanisms, as well as isolation approaches of the cellulose, hemicellulose, and lignin first, with special focus on the differential evolution behavior and its synergistic transformation mechanism of these three main components during the pyrolysis‐carbonization process. Then, the key regulation effects on microstructure and sodium storage performance have also been illuminate d based on the structural evolution of these component s. Subsequently, by comparing different modification methods, an innovative precursor pretreatment strategy for component matching and correlation with sodium storage characteristics has been proposed, which can control the path of degradation and reconstruction of components and thus optimize the electrochemical behaviors of the resulting hard carbons. Finally, multi‐dimensional solutions are raised in order to target the industrialization bottlenecks. These solutions provide a theoretical foundation and technical roadmap for the development of high‐performance, low‐cost SIBs anode materials.
title_zh: 生物质衍生硬碳在钠离子电池中的过去、现在与未来
abstract_zh: 摘要 鉴于其成本效益、可再生性和环境友好特性，生物质衍生硬碳在钠离子电池（SIBs）中受到了广泛关注。然而，所得硬碳的宏观性质高度依赖于生物质前体的资源和组分，且构效关系仍然复杂，为后续研究带来巨大挑战。为阐明这种内在关联，本综述首先系统阐述了纤维素、半纤维素和木质素的物理化学性质、多尺度机理以及分离方法，特别关注这三种主要组分在热解–碳化过程中的差异化演变行为及其协同转化机制。随后，基于这些组分的结构演变，阐明了其对微观结构和钠存储性能的关键调控作用。接着，通过比较不同的改性方法，提出了一种创新的组分匹配前体预处理策略及其与钠存储特性的关联，该策略可控制组分降解与重构的路径，从而优化所得硬碳的电化学行为。最后，提出了多维解决方案以针对产业化瓶颈。这些解决方案为开发高性能、低成本的 SIBs 负极材料提供了理论基础和技术路线图。

title: Mixed‐Dimensional 1D/2D Ternary CMOS for High‐Performance Integrated Circuits
abstract: ABSTRACT Ternary logic offers a path to higher information density and lower power consumption beyond the limits of binary CMOS, yet its progress has been limited by the absence of high‐performance ternary transistors and scalable circuit technologies. Here we report a mixed‐dimensional ternary CMOS (T‐CMOS) platform that monolithically integrates aligned carbon nanotubes (CNTs) and monolayer MoS 2 within silicon backend‐of‐line processes. The resulting CNT‐MoS 2 heterojunction transistors exhibit more than an order‐of‐magnitude performance improvement in output current and negative differential transconductance over previous ternary devices, enabling robust three‐level switching with large noise margins. By co‐fabricating CNT p‐FETs and MoS 2 n‐FETs into heterojunction devices, we realize CMOS‐compatible standard, positive and negative ternary inverters, as well as NMIN and NMAX logic gates. A fully functional ternary 2‐to‐9 decoder, the most complex low‐dimensional ternary circuit to date, is also demonstrated. Dynamic measurements and calibrated simulations confirm the scalability, cascade capability, and robustness of the T‐CMOS architecture, providing a viable pathway toward large‐scale ternary integrated circuits beyond binary limits.
title_zh: 用于高性能集成电路的混合维度1D/2D三元CMOS
abstract_zh: 摘要 三值逻辑为突破二值 CMOS 的限制、实现更高的信息密度和更低的功耗提供了途径，但由于缺乏高性能三值晶体管和可扩展的电路技术，其进展一直受限。在此，我们报道了一种混合维度三值 CMOS（T-CMOS）平台，该平台在硅后道工序（backend-of-line）中单片集成定向排列的碳纳米管（CNTs）和单层 MoS 2 。所得 CNT-MoS 2 异质结晶体管在输出电流和负微分跨导方面比以往的三值器件性能提升了一个数量级以上，实现了具有大噪声容限的稳健三电平开关。通过将 CNT p-FET 和 MoS 2 n-FET 共同制备为异质结器件，我们实现了与 CMOS 兼容的标准、正和负三值反相器，以及 NMIN 和 NMAX 逻辑门。还演示了功能完整的三值 2-to-9 译码器，这是迄今为止最复杂的低维三值电路。动态测量和校准仿真证实了 T-CMOS 架构的可扩展性、级联能力和稳健性，为超越二值极限的大规模三值集成电路提供了可行途径。

title: Field‐Regulated Triboelectric Nanogenerators for Enhanced Energy Conversion
abstract: ABSTRACT Triboelectric nanogenerators (TENGs) provide a versatile platform for distributed mechanical energy harvesting and self‐powered sensing. However, their practical deployment remains constrained by insufficient surface charge density, high output impedance, impedance mismatch, and environmental instability, particularly under low‐frequency and low‐intensity mechanical excitation. To move beyond purely mechanically driven contact electrification, optical, thermal, magnetic, and electric fields have recently been introduced into TENG systems to regulate interfacial charge generation, separation, transport, and retention. Unlike reviews centered on the simple structural integration or output superposition of otherwise independent energy‐harvesting units, this review focuses on mechanistic external‐field coupling and adopts field‐assisted charge modulation as a unifying framework for analyzing multifield‐coupled TENGs. Starting from Maxwell's displacement current, the fundamental working mechanism of conventional TENGs and the key parameters governing their output performance are discussed. Coupling mechanisms involving localized surface plasmon resonance, photon‐generated carriers, pyroelectric effects and heat‐excitation effects, magnetic nanomaterials, magnetically assisted structures, charge injection, and charge pumping are then highlighted. Finally, current challenges and future opportunities in unified theoretical modeling, field‐responsive materials, system‐level integration, power management, and long‐term reliability are discussed. By linking external‐field coupling mechanisms with materials design and device architecture, this review provides guidance for developing high‐output, adaptive, and multifunctional self‐powered systems.
title_zh: 用于增强能量转换的场调控摩擦纳米发电机
abstract_zh: 摘要 摩擦电纳米发电机（TENGs）为分布式机械能收集和自供电传感提供了一个多功能平台。然而，其实际应用仍受到表面电荷密度不足、高输出阻抗、阻抗失配以及环境不稳定性的限制，尤其是在低频和低强度机械激励条件下。为了超越纯机械驱动的接触起电，近年来人们将光场、热场、磁场和电场引入TENG系统，以调控界面电荷的产生、分离、传输和保持。与那些聚焦于彼此独立的能量收集单元的简单结构集成或输出叠加的综述不同，本综述聚焦于机理性的外场耦合，并采用场助电荷调制作为分析多场耦合TENGs的统一框架。从麦克斯韦位移电流出发，讨论了传统TENGs的基本工作机理及其决定输出性能的关键参数。随后重点阐述了涉及局域表面等离激元共振、光生载流子、热电效应与热激发效应、磁性纳米材料、磁辅助结构、电荷注入和电荷泵送的耦合机制。最后，讨论了统一理论建模、场响应材料、系统级集成、功率管理和长期可靠性方面当前的挑战与未来的机遇。通过关联外场耦

title: Enhanced Figure‐of‐Merit Energy Harvesting in [001]‐Oriented PMN‐PZT Ceramics Via Synergistic Multi‐Scale Engineering
abstract: ABSTRACT Developing piezoelectric materials with a high figure‐of‐merit (FOM = d 33 × g 33 /tan δ ) is crucial for advanced energy‐harvesting technologies. Here, a high FOM is achieved in [001]‐oriented Pb(Mg 1/3 Nb 2/3 )O 3 ‐PbZrO 3 ‐PbTiO 3 (PMN‐PZT) textured ceramics by synergistically integrating grain orientation, defect engineering, and morphotropic phase boundary (MPB) design. The textured ceramic exhibits exceptional properties (piezoelectric charge coefficient d 33 = 1120 pC·N −1 , piezoelectric voltage coefficient g 33 = 62 × 10 −3 V·m·N −1 , and an ultralow dielectric loss tan δ = 0.23%). Atomic‐scale analysis reveals that the [001] intrinsic anisotropy and mixed rhombohedral‐tetragonal domains facilitate polarization rotation to boost d 33 and g 33 , while Mn doping‐induced defect dipoles suppress dielectric loss. Consequently, an ultrahigh FOM of 30,180 × 10 −12 m 2 ·N −1 is realized. Furthermore, a cantilever energy harvester utilizing this textured ceramic delivers an outstanding power density of 0.72 µW·mm −3 , which is 78 times higher than that of commercial soft PZT. This work provides an effective strategy for designing high‐FOM piezoelectric materials for high performance energy harvesting applications.
title_zh: 通过多尺度协同工程增强[001]取向PMN-PZT陶瓷的优质因数能量收集
abstract_zh: 摘要 开发具有高品质因数（FOM = d 33 × g 33 /tan δ）的压电材料对先进能量收集技术至关重要。本文通过协同整合晶粒取向、缺陷工程和同质异晶相界（MPB）设计，在[001]取向的Pb(Mg 1/3 Nb 2/3 )O 3 -PbZrO 3 -PbTiO 3（PMN-PZT）织构陶瓷中实现了高FOM。该织构陶瓷表现出卓越的性能（压电电荷系数d 33 = 1120 pC·N −1，压电电压系数g 33 = 62 × 10 −3 V·m·N −1，以及超低介电损耗tan δ = 0.23%）。原子尺度分析表明，[001]固有各向异性和三方-四方混合畴有利于极化旋转，从而提升d 33和g 33，而Mn掺杂诱导的缺陷偶极子则抑制介电损耗。由此实现了高达30,180 × 10 −12 m 2 ·N −1的超高FOM。此外，采用该织构陶瓷的悬臂梁能量收集器可输出0.72 µW·mm −3的优异功率密度，是商用软性PZT的78倍。这项工作为设计用于高性能能量收集应用的高FOM压电材料提供了一种有效策略。

title: Beyond and Inside the Electrical Double Layer: Molecular‐Level Cation Effects in Aqueous Electrocatalysis
abstract: ABSTRACT Electrocatalytic reactions occur at a dynamic, ion‐regulated electrochemical interface, rather than at a static electrode boundary. In electrocatalytic processes such as hydrogen evolution/oxidation and CO 2 reduction, which operate at potentials below the electrode's potential of zero charge, electrolyte cations are not mere spectators but active participants that shape reaction behavior. Their size, charge density, solvation structure, and spatial organization within the electric double layer (EDL) govern interfacial energetics, transition states, and reaction activity and selectivity, giving rise to pronounced, system‐dependent cation effects. Furthermore, cation accumulation dynamically modifies the interfacial electric field, reorganizes water structure, and alters local pH, thereby coupling electrostatics, solvation, and mass transport in a highly nonlinear manner. These intertwined effects complicate mechanistic interpretation and have contributed to ongoing debates and seemingly contradictory conclusions across experimental and theoretical studies. Here, we synthesize the current understanding of cation effects at electrochemical interfaces, highlight emerging interfacial molecular structures revealed by in situ and operando studies that challenge classical EDL models, identify key unresolved debates, and outline pathways toward a quantitative, molecular‐level description of cation–interface–reactivity relationships.
title_zh: 超越并深入双电层内部：水系电催化中的分子级阳离子效应
abstract_zh: 摘要 电催化反应发生在动态的、离子调控的电化学界面上，而非静态的电极边界。在析氢/氢氧化和CO 2还原等电催化过程中，其工作电位低于电极的零电荷电位，此时电解质阳离子并非仅仅是旁观者，而是决定反应行为的活性参与者。它们的尺寸、电荷密度、溶剂化结构以及其在双电层（EDL）内的空间排布决定了界面能量学、过渡态以及反应活性与选择性，从而产生显著的、依赖于体系的阳离子效应。此外，阳离子积累会动态改变界面电场、重组水结构并改变局部pH，从而以高度非线性的方式耦合静电学、溶剂化和传质过程。这些相互交织的效应使机理解释变得复杂，并导致实验与理论研究之间持续存在的争论和看似矛盾的结论。在此，我们综述了当前对电化学界面阳离子效应的认识，重点介绍了原位和工况（operando）研究所揭示的挑战经典EDL模型的新兴界面分子结构，指出了关键的未决争论，并展望了迈向阳离子-界面-反应性关系的定量、分子水平描述的路径。

title: Enhanced Catalytic Dechlorination of Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) and H2 Production Enabled by Synergistic Gaδ+/Ga0 Active Sites in Liquid Metal Particles
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Polyvinyl chloride (PVC) is ubiquitous yet challenging to recycle due to its tendency to thermally decompose above 250 °C, releasing toxic, corrosive chlorinated compounds, and its inability to melt. Here, we report a catalytic strategy for PVC upcycling at 160 °C using gallium liquid metal particles (Ga-LMP) featuring a dynamic Ga-GaOOH core–shell architecture. These catalysts enable concurrent dechlorination and hydrogen evolution, yielding up to 7% H2 (based on initial hydrogen atoms in PVC) along with a highly dechlorinated (>95%) carbonaceous solid and aqueous HCl. Mechanistic investigations combining X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, infrared spectroscopy, solid-state NMR, inelastic neutron scattering, and ab initio molecular dynamics reveal a synergistic interplay between Gaδ+ sites in the GaOOH shell and metallic Ga0 in the core. Cationic Ga initiates C–Cl bond activation and HCl formation, while progressive reduction of the shell exposes Ga0 sites that promote C–H activation and H2 evolution. Control experiments with a Ga salt and bulk Ga liquid metal confirmed that neither oxidation state alone can achieve both transformations efficiently. This work establishes a dynamic dual-site paradigm for liquid metal catalysis, in which the in situ evolution and coexistence of oxidized and metallic species enable sequential and cooperative bond activation pathways. These findings provide a general design principle for novel liquid metal catalysts that target challenging polymer transformations under mild conditions.
title_zh: 液态金属颗粒中Gaδ+/Ga0协同活性位点促进聚氯乙烯（PVC）催化脱氯与H2生成
abstract_zh: 摘要 聚氯乙烯（PVC）无处不在，但由于其在250 °C以上易热分解并释放有毒、腐蚀性的氯化物且无法熔融而难以回收。本文报道了一种在160 °C下利用具有动态Ga-GaOOH核壳结构的镓液态金属颗粒（Ga-LMP）进行PVC升级回收的催化策略。这些催化剂可实现同时脱氯和析氢，生成高达7%的H2（以PVC中初始氢原子计），以及高度脱氯（>95%）的碳质固体和水相HCl。结合X射线光电子能谱、红外光谱、固态核磁共振、非弹性中子散射和从头算分子动力学的机理研究揭示了GaOOH壳层中Gaδ+位点与核心中金属Ga0之间的协同作用。阳离子Ga引发C–Cl键活化和HCl生成，而壳层的逐渐还原暴露出Ga0位点，促进C–H活化和H2析出。用Ga盐和块体Ga液态金属进行的对照实验证实，单独任一氧化态均无法高效实现这两种转化。本研究建立了液态金属催化的动态双位点范式，其中氧化物种和金属物种的原位演化与共存实现了顺序且协同的键活化路径。这些发现为在温和条件下针对具有挑战性的聚合物转化的新型液态金属催化剂提供了通用设计原则。

title: Construction of Orientationally Ordered Organometallic Chains by Directional Noncovalent Interactions
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Achieving orientational control during on-surface synthesis remains a major challenge because conventional approaches mainly rely on steric effects or substrate templating, which often lack chemical versatility. Here, we demonstrate that directional noncovalent interactions can regulate hierarchical reaction pathways through molecular recognition, enabling the formation of orientationally ordered surface nanostructures. Using 4,7-dibromobenzo[c][1,2,5]thiadiazole (2Br-BTD) on Ag(111) as a model system, we combine scanning tunneling microscopy, bond-resolved noncontact atomic force microscopy, and density functional theory calculations to reveal a sequential reaction pathway involving self-assembled monomers, cis-organometallic dimers, trans-covalent dimers, and ultimately alternating organometallic chains. Cooperative S···N chalcogen bonding is found to critically and selectively stabilize the cis-organometallic nodes throughout this process, driving both initial dimer formation and subsequent ordered chain synthesis. Chemically matched control experiments with 4,7-dibromobenzo[c][1,2,5]selenadiazole (2Br-BSe) and 5,8-dibromoquinoxaline (2Br-Qx) further demonstrate that analogous orientational selectivity can be achieved through strengthened Se···N chalcogen bonding and C–H···N hydrogen bonding, respectively. By contrast, the heteroatom-free analogue 1,4-dibromonaphthalene (2Br-Nap), which lacks such directional interaction motifs, exhibits no such selectivity. These results establish directional noncovalent interactions as an effective means of steering surface reaction pathways, offering new insights into the rational design of orientationally ordered low-dimensional nanostructures.
title_zh: 通过定向非共价相互作用构建取向有序的有机金属链
abstract_zh: 摘要 在表面合成过程中实现取向控制仍是一项重大挑战，因为传统方法主要依赖空间位阻效应或基底模板化，往往缺乏化学通用性。本文证明，方向性非共价相互作用可通过分子识别调控分级反应路径，从而实现取向有序表面纳米结构的形成。以Ag(111)上的4,7-二溴苯并[c][1,2,5]噻二唑（2Br-BTD）为模型体系，我们结合扫描隧道显微镜、键分辨非接触原子力显微镜和密度泛函理论计算，揭示了一条顺序反应路径，涉及自组装单体、顺式有机金属二聚体、反式共价二聚体，并最终形成交替有机金属链。研究发现，协同的S···N硫族键在整个过程中关键性地且选择性地稳定顺式有机金属节点，驱动初始二聚体的形成和随后的有序链合成。采用4,7-二溴苯并[c][1,2,5]硒二唑（2Br-BSe）和5,8-二溴喹喔啉（2Br-Qx）进行的化学匹配对照实验进一步证明，分别可通过增强的Se···N硫族键和C–H···N氢键实现类似的取向选择性。相比之下，缺乏此类方向性相互作用基元的无杂原子类似物1,4-二溴萘（2Br-Nap）则未表现出这种选择性。这些结果确立了方向性非共价相互作用作为引导表面反应的有效手段，

title: Programmable Organic Quasi-Superlattices with Molecular-Monolayer Precision for Enhanced Photoconductive Response
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Engineering van der Waals organic heterostructures with monolayer precision offers a powerful route to modulate charge transport and light–matter interactions in molecular systems. However, deterministic multilayer assembly remains challenging due to pervasive interlayer interdiffusion and the lack of generally applicable high-precision deposition strategies. Here, we introduce programmable organic quasi-superlattices enabled by the integration of air–water interfacial monolayer assembly with sequential transfer stacking, allowing polymeric semiconductors to be organized into periodic architectures with molecular-layer precision. By systematically tuning the number of periods, the intraperiod composition, and the thickness of the tunneling spacers, these quasi-superlattices exhibit markedly enhanced photoconductive performance, achieving signal-to-noise ratios of up to 2 × 106 under white-light illumination together with an ultralow dark current density on the order of 10–10–10–11 A cm–2. Superlattices optimized for near-infrared detection (900 nm) achieve a detectivity of 2.06 × 1012 Jones and a photoresponse time of less than 0.2 s under ultralow illumination (21 μW cm–2). These findings establish programmable molecular organization as a general strategy for accessing emergent optoelectronic functionality from vast chemical spaces via the controlled assembly of organic multilayer architectures.
title_zh: 分子单层精度的可编程有机准超晶格用于增强光电导响应
abstract_zh: 摘要 以单层精度构筑范德华有机异质结构为调控分子体系中的电荷输运和光–物质相互作用提供了一条强有力的途径。然而，由于普遍存在的层间互扩散以及缺乏普遍适用的高精度沉积策略，确定性的多层组装仍具挑战。本文通过将气–水界面单层组装与顺序转移堆叠相结合，引入了可编程的有机准超晶格，使聚合物半导体能够以分子层精度组织成周期性结构。通过系统调节周期数、周期内组分以及隧穿间隔层的厚度，这些准超晶格表现出显著增强的光电导性能，在白光照射下信噪比高达2 × 106，同时暗电流密度低至10–10–10–11 A cm–2量级。针对近红外检测（900 nm）优化的超晶格在超低光照（21 μW cm–2）下实现了2.06 × 1012 Jones的探测率和小于0.2 s的光响应时间。这些发现确立了可编程分子组织作为一种通用策略，可通过有机多层结构的可控组装从庞大的化学空间中获取新兴光电功能。

title: Cascaded Energy Transfer in Supramolecular Assemblies Enables Amplified and Photoswitchable Circularly Polarized Luminescence
abstract: ABSTRACT Photoresponsive circularly polarized luminescence (CPL) materials are promising for optical information processing and anti‐counterfeiting. However, integrating high luminescence dissymmetry factor ( g lum ) with high‐contrast reversible switching within a single system remains a significant challenge. In this study, we present a supramolecular CPL nanoplatform that combines hierarchical chirality amplification with light‐gated cascaded Förster resonance energy transfer (FRET). Selective host–guest recognition between a TPE‐functionalized chiral pillar[5]arene ( TPEP5 ) and a polymeric guest forms emissive supramolecular polymers with amplified chirality. Confined co‐assembly with the achiral relay dye 4,7‐di(2‐thienyl)‐benzo[2,1,3]thiadiazole (DBT) enables efficient FRET from TPEP5 to DBT, accompanied by concomitant chirality transfer, generating red‐shifted CPL with enhanced | g lum | values of 10 − 2 . Eventually, diarylethene (DAE) is incorporated as a final photoresponsive “gatekeeper”: UV irradiation induces DAE ring closure, activating FRET pathway and quenching CPL; subsequent visible‐light irradiation reverses the process, fully restoring emission and CPL activity. This orthogonal design preserves the structural integrity of the chiral scaffold over repeated switching cycles, achieving robust, fatigue‐resistant, and architecture‐preserving CPL on/off control. Therefore, our strategy provides a generalizable blueprint for intelligent chiral photonic materials with built‐in security functionality.
title_zh: 超分子组装体中的级联能量转移实现放大且光开关的圆偏振发光
abstract_zh: 摘要 光响应圆偏振发光（CPL）材料在光学信息处理和防伪领域前景广阔。然而，在单一体系中将高发光不对称因子（g lum）与高对比度可逆开关联用仍是一项重大挑战。在本研究中，我们提出了一种将分层次手性放大与光门控级联 Förster 共振能量转移（FRET）相结合的超分子 CPL 纳米平台。TPE 功能化手性柱[5]芳烃（TPEP5）与聚合物客体之间的选择性主客体识别形成具有放大手性的发射性超分子聚合物。与无中继染料 4,7-二(2-噻吩基)-苯并[2,1,3]噻二唑（DBT）的受限共组装实现了从 TPEP5 到 DBT 的高效 FRET，并伴随手性转移，产生 |g lum| 值提升至 10 − 2 的红移 CPL。最终，二芳基乙烯（DAE）被引入作为最终的光响应“门控”：紫外光照射诱导 DAE 环化，激活 FRET 通路并猝灭 CPL；随后的可见光照射则逆转该过程，完全恢复发射和 CPL 活性。这种正交设计在多次开关循环中保持了手性支架的结构完整性，实现了稳健、抗疲劳且保持架构的 CPL 开/关控制。因此，我们的策略为具有内置安全功能的智能手性光子材料提供了可推广的蓝图。

title: Organic Activatable Afterglow Imaging Probes: From Molecular Design to Biomedical Translation
abstract: ABSTRACT Organic activatable afterglow probes have developed into a distinct class of optical imaging tools. They allow for a temporal separation between signal emission and external irradiation, thereby enabling high‐contrast imaging. We have summarized the latest advances in the design of organic activated afterglow probes, with a particular focus on their excitation mechanisms, performance modulation, and activation strategies, including energy transfer, intramolecular regulation, and singlet oxygen( 1 O 2 )‐mediated processes. The roles of various external energy sources, including light, ultrasound, and X‐rays, in inducing afterglow emission are also discussed. We further highlight representative probe designs for detecting bioactive small molecules, enzymes, and microenvironment signals, and explore how these systems translate molecular activation events into afterglow signals. This review emphasizes biomedical applications, particularly tumor‐related imaging, visualization of immune cell dynamics, and disease‐related imaging of the liver and cardiovascular system. The role of these activated afterglow probes in surgical navigation and treatment monitoring is elucidated. The discussion also addresses remaining challenges in this field, including how to modulate probe performance, improve selectivity in complex biological environments, and enhance deep tissue imaging capabilities while ensuring translational safety.
title_zh: 有机可激活余辉成像探针：从分子设计到生物医学转化
abstract_zh: 摘要 有机可激活余辉探针已发展为一类独特的光学成像工具。它们使信号发射与外部照射在时间上分离，从而实现高对比度成像。我们综述了有机可激活余辉探针设计的最新进展，特别关注其激发机制、性能调控和激活策略，包括能量转移、分子内调控和单线态氧（1 O 2）介导的过程。文中还讨论了各种外部能量源（包括光、超声和 X 射线）在诱导余辉发射中的作用。我们进一步重点介绍了用于检测生物活性小分子、酶和微环境信号的代表性探针设计，并探讨了这些系统如何将分子激活事件转化为余辉信号。本综述强调生物医学应用，特别是肿瘤相关成像、免疫细胞动态可视化以及肝脏和心血管系统的疾病相关成像。文中阐述了这些可激活余辉探针在手术导航和治疗监测中的作用。讨论还涉及该领域尚存的挑战，包括如何调控探针性能、在复杂生物环境中提高选择性，以及在确保转化安全性的同时增强深层组织成像能力。

title: Leveraging AI for the sustainable energy transition: a systematic review of techniques, applications, and future prospects

title: Nuclear energy adoption pathways for SDG 7 in newcomer countries: Readiness barriers, technology options, and policy frameworks
abstract: The world’s shift toward low-carbon energy presents new challenges for non-nuclear countries. Due to the decommissioning of fossil-fuel power plants and the deployment of renewable energy sources, the need for reliable, low-carbon, and dispatchable energy production becomes more relevant. In this context, nuclear energy emerges as a potential complement to renewable electricity generation because of its capacity factor, low life cycle greenhouse gas emissions, and grid-stabilizing capacity. However, there is still a lack of studies that consider the integration of the technology, economics, and policy of nuclear adoption in light of Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) compliance while focusing on non-nuclear and nuclear-aspiring countries. To fill this gap, the current review provides an analysis of modern reactor development, global policies, economic realities, SDG compliance, and readiness barriers in different countries. The analysis assesses the extent to which Generation III/III + reactors, small modular reactors, and fusion technologies may address challenges related to safety, cost, and deployment flexibility. It then examines global trends in nuclear adoption, tools used in nuclear policies, financing issues, and existing cases in nuclear countries and newcomer countries. Moreover, the paper proposes a multi-dimensional model of readiness for nuclear energy adoption based on the analysis. The reviewed evidence indicates that nuclear energy can positively impact SDG 7 and other SDGs, but this requires a comprehensive nuclear energy governance system with regulations on safety, waste management, funding, workforce, grid capacity, and public acceptance. Thus, nuclear energy adoption should not be assessed solely in terms of technological capability; it also requires a comprehensive readiness framework for non-nuclear countries.
title_zh: 新兴国家实现可持续发展目标7的核能采纳路径：准备障碍、技术选择与政策框架
abstract_zh: 世界向低碳能源的转型给无核电国家带来了新挑战。由于化石燃料电厂的退役和可再生能源的部署，对可靠、低碳且可调度的能源生产的需求变得更加重要。在此背景下，核能因其容量因子、较低的生命周期温室气体排放以及电网稳定能力，成为可再生电力发电的潜在补充。然而，目前仍缺乏在符合可持续发展目标（SDG）的前提下，针对无核电国家和有核雄心国家，综合考虑核电采纳的技术、经济与政策整合的研究。为填补这一空白，本综述分析了不同国家的现代反应堆发展、全球政策、经济现实、SDG 符合性以及就绪性障碍。该分析评估了第三代/三代+（Generation III/III+）反应堆、小型模块化反应堆和聚变技术在多大程度上能够解决与安全性、成本和部署灵活性相关的挑战。随后，文章考察了核能采纳的全球趋势、核政策中使用的工具、融资问题以及现有核电国家和新加入国家的案例。此外，本文基于分析提出了一个多维度的核能采纳就绪性模型。所综述的证据表明，核能可对 SDG 7 及其他 SDG 产生积极影响，但这需要一个完善的核能治理体系及相关法规

title: Coordinated adaptive control for an ammonia-reformed hydrogen dual-fuel e-powertrain: Optimizing on-demand hydrogen production and power generation

title: Regulation-aware combinatorial optimization of energy community formation under geographic proximity constraints
abstract: Renewable Energy Communities (RECs) enable collective self-consumption by allowing geographically proximate households to share locally generated renewable energy. While most existing studies optimize the operation of a pre-defined community, the prior problem of how to partition a set of households into multiple regulation-compliant communities remains underexplored. This paper formalizes REC formation as a pre-operational combinatorial design problem: households are partitioned under a strict diameter-based proximity constraint derived from European national regulatory rules. Within this feasible space, we minimize the quadratic imbalance of yearly community energy balances, a structural proxy for self-consumption potential equivalent to variance minimization over community balances, and prove it tightens the theoretical upper bound of annual aggregate self-consumption. The problem is shown to be NP-hard via reduction from 3- Partition . A hybrid particle swarm optimization (PSO) framework with strict feasibility repair and local memetic refinement is proposed. Experiments on residential data from two urban zones of Murcia, Spain ( 𝑁 = 2 0 0 , 𝑁 = 1 5 1 households; 130 profiles from the FlexCHESS European project) under the Spanish regulatory distance cap of 2 km (Real Decreto-ley 29/2021) demonstrate 86–93% reduction in quadratic imbalance over random and geographic baselines, and 7–9% over greedy local search (Wilcoxon 𝑝 < 0 . 0 0 4 , 10 independent runs). Hourly validation on independently generated PVGIS-calibrated profiles (annual balances derived a posteriori , eliminating reconstruction circularity) reveals a strong negative correlation between annual imbalance and hourly self-consumption ( 𝜌 = − 0 . 4 2 , 𝑝 < 1 0 − 5 , 𝜌 2 ≈ 0 . 1 8 ), supporting the annual proxy as a useful pre-operational structural criterion. Ablation studies confirm robustness to PSO hyperparameters, and climate sensitivity analysis shows PSO dominance across irradiance levels from 1000 to 1900 kWh/kWp. Beyond solution quality, the proposed framework is intended as a pre-operational planning and screening tool that can assist municipalities, community organizers, and Distribution System Operators in identifying promising community configurations before undertaking detailed network-constrained or operational studies.
title_zh: 地理邻近性约束下能源社区形成的法规感知组合优化

title: Metal Ions and Protein Aggregation: Unraveling Molecular Interactions and Theranostic Prospects in Proteinopathies
abstract: Abstract Protein aggregation is a pathological process associated with several human diseases termed proteinopathies, including neurodegenerative and metabolic disorders such as Alzheimer’s disease, Parkinson’s disease, type II diabetes, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, and Huntington’s disease. In these conditions, specific proteins misfold and accumulate into insoluble aggregates, disrupting normal cellular function and contributing to disease progression. Many studies have investigated the molecular mechanisms that underlie the aggregation pathways, the structure of aggregates, such as oligomeric intermediates and fibrils, and their cellular toxicity. Studies have also investigated the effects of cofactors like metals, lipids, other amyloid proteins, and small molecules. Recent research has increasingly emphasized the critical roles of metal ions such as copper (Cu), zinc (Zn), iron (Fe), and manganese (Mn) in amyloid aggregation and toxicity. Alterations in metal ion transport, binding, or redox activity have been linked to the onset and progression of several amyloid-associated diseases. These metal ions can interact directly with amyloidogenic proteins, influencing their structural conformation, aggregation kinetics, and propensity to form toxic oligomers. This review aims to advance our understanding of how the regulation of metal ions within cells and their dysfunction contribute to the accumulation of harmful proteins, which is a key factor in proteinopathies. By examining the interactions between metal ions and key amyloidogenic proteins─including amyloid-β (Aβ), α-synuclein, tau, superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD1), human islet amyloid polypeptide (hIAPP), and insulin─we highlight both common and unique pathways through which metal ions influence protein aggregation. Additionally, this review explores the impact of metal ions on protein clearance mechanisms, such as autophagy and the ubiquitin–proteasome system, as well as emerging theranostic strategies. These include metal chelation therapies, metal-based imaging agents, and multifunctional compounds designed to restore metal balance while preventing aggregation and toxicity. By integrating biochemical, cellular, and therapeutic insights, this review contributes to a deeper understanding of the metallobiology of proteinopathies and supports the development of novel diagnostic and treatment approaches targeting metal–protein interactions.

title: Chemo-electrochemical Tandem Reduction Enables Eupolymer-Inorganic Solid-Electrolyte Interphases for Silicon-Based Anodes
abstract: Abstract Silicon-based anodes offer substantial potential for increasing batteries’ energy density but are limited by unstable solid-electrolyte interphases (SEIs). Here, we report a chemo-electrochemical tandem reduction strategy to construct an integrated eupolymer-inorganic SEI with both favorable mechanical robustness and fast Li+ transport. This strategy couples a selective ester–amine exchange reaction in the bulk electrolyte with a subsequent electrochemical reduction at the anode surface. The identified chemical intermediate exhibits facilitated de-fluorination kinetics, enriching the SEI with nanoscale inorganic species while triggering a free-radical polymerization of unsaturated additives. Benefiting from the integrated eupolymer-inorganic SEI, SiOx anodes demonstrate 80.1% capacity retention after 800 cycles and retain 551.9 mAh g–1 at 5 A g–1. Practical Ah-level Si/C∥NCM811 pouch cells operating under a cut-off voltage of 4.4 V achieve 90.9% capacity retention over 300 cycles, with an average Coulombic efficiency of 99.91%. This work provides profound insights into SEI tailoring, offering pathway toward long-life, fast-charging silicon-based batteries.
title_zh: 化学-电化学串联还原实现硅基负极的优聚合物-无机固态电解质界面
abstract_zh: 摘要 硅基负极为提升电池能量密度提供了巨大潜力，但其受限于不稳定的固体电解质界面（SEI）。本文报道了一种化学-电化学串联还原策略，构建兼具良好机械稳健性和快速Li+传输的一体化高分子-无机SEI。该策略将体相电解液中的选择性酯-胺交换反应与负极表面的后续电化学还原相耦合。所识别的化学中间体表现出促进的脱氟动力学，使SEI富含纳米级无机物种，同时引发不饱和添加剂的自由基硫酸聚合。得益于一体化高分子-无机SEI，SiOx负极在800次循环后容量保持率为80.1%，并在5 A g–1下保持551.9 mAh g–1。在4.4 V截止电压下运行的实用级Ah级Si/C∥NCM811软包电池在300次循环后实现90.9%的容量保持率，平均库仑效率为99.91%。这项工作为SEI定制提供了深刻见解，为实现长寿命、快充硅基电池提供了途径。

title: Intelligent Response and Dynamic Stress Equilibrium Structure Endow Lithium-Rich Oxide Cathodes with Long Cycle Life
abstract: Abstract Lithium-rich oxides (LROs) deliver an energy density of over 1000 Wh kg−1 for lithium-ion battery cathode applications, yet cycling-induced stress accumulation triggers structural degradation and poor cyclic stability. Herein, hierarchical twin structures are prefabricated in LROs. Prestress at twin boundaries forms interlaced stress networks to adaptively accommodate tensile/compressive strains upon cycling and dissipate localized stress concentration. The self-adaptive twin structure tolerates cyclic volume fluctuation, preserving the layered framework against irreversible spinel/rock-salt phase transition during long-term structural relaxation. The twin-modified LRO retains 94.98% capacity after 500 cycles (1 C) and 80.79% after 800 cycles, with 155.31 mAh g−1 at 5 C. The pouch cell delivers 12.59 Ah discharge capacity and maintains 84.83% capacity after 49 cycles. This work offers a strategy to tune electrochemo-mechanical properties for designing cathode materials.
title_zh: 智能响应与动态应力平衡结构赋予富锂氧化物正极长循环寿命
abstract_zh: 摘要 富锂氧化物（LROs）在锂离子电池正极应用中可提供超过1000 Wh kg−1的能量密度，但循环引起的应力积累会引发结构退化和较差的循环稳定性。本文在LROs中预制了分级孪晶结构。孪晶界处的预应力形成交织的应力网络，可在循环过程中自适应地适应拉伸/压缩应变并耗散局部应力集中。这种自适应性孪晶结构可容忍循环体积波动，在长期结构弛豫过程中保持层状框架免受不可逆尖晶石/岩盐相变的影响。孪晶改性的LRO在500次循环（1 C）后保持94.98%的容量，在800次循环后保持80.79%，并在5 C下达到155.31 mAh g−1。软包电池提供12.59 Ah的放电容量，并在49次循环后保持84.83%的容量。这项工作为设计正极材料提供了调控电化学-机械性能的策略。

title: Triplet or Charge-Separated State? Distinguishing Long-Lived, Photogenerated Electronic States in SWCNT/MoS2 Heterojunctions
abstract: Abstract Single-walled carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) and their interfaces with an array of materials are promising platforms for next-generation energy-harvesting and conversion devices. Yet the challenge of identifying the excited-state optical spectra of electronic states is a barrier to evaluating their potential for those applications. Here, we use photoinduced absorption-detected magnetic resonance (PADMR) spectroscopy to provide unambiguous assignments in the near-infrared (NIR) photoinduced absorption spectrum of (6,5) SWCNT/MoS2 heterojunctions. Driving the distinguishable magnetic resonance transitions of weakly magnetic dipole-coupled charge separated states versus SWCNT-localized triplets shows that the NIR-induced absorption peak that is bathochromically shifted from the first exciton bleach corresponds solely to separated charges. Triplet excited-state absorption is assigned at higher energy. Signatures for the interfacial charge-separated state and triplet states are stronger in the bilayer than in the neat nanotubes, revealing a charge recombination mechanism across the SWCNT/MoS2 interface that forms spin-polarized triplet states on the SWCNTs.
title_zh: 三重态还是电荷分离态？区分SWCNT/MoS2异质结中长寿命光生电子态
abstract_zh: 摘要 单壁碳纳米管（SWCNTs）及其与多种材料的界面是下一代能量收集与转换器件的有前景平台。然而，确定电子态激发态光谱的挑战是评估其在这些应用中潜力的障碍。本文利用光诱导吸收检测磁共振（PADMR）光谱，对（6,5）SWCNT/MoS2异质结的近红外（NIR）光诱导吸收光谱进行了明确归属。通过驱动弱磁偶极耦合的电荷分离态与SWCNT局域三重态的可区分磁共振跃迁，表明相对于第一激子漂白发生红移的NIR诱导吸收峰仅对应于分离电荷。三重激发态吸收归属在更高能量处。界面电荷分离态和三重态的信号在双层结构中比在纯纳米管中更强，揭示了SWCNT/MoS2界面上形成SWCNT自旋极化三重态的电荷复合机制。

title: Drug‐Derived Tetrahydropyrazines for Late‐Stage α ‐ and β ‐Functionalization of Piperazine‐Based Pharmaceuticals
abstract: ABSTRACT Piperazine is one of the most prevalent saturated nitrogen heterocycles in pharmaceuticals, yet late‐stage access to α ‐ and β ‐substituted piperazine analogues remains challenging. Here, we report a flavin‐photocatalyzed platform that converts complex piperazine‐containing drugs into persistent tetrahydropyrazine intermediates that serve as versatile branch points for downstream functionalization. Under blue‐light irradiation, riboflavin tetraacetate (RFTA) promotes sequential α ‐ and β ‐C─H bond cleavage of N ‐alkyl, N ‐aryl, and N ‐heteroaryl piperazines under mild conditions and with tolerance of diverse functional groups. The resulting drug‐derived tetrahydropyrazines can be isolated or directly telescoped into reactions with electrophiles and nucleophiles, enabling late‐stage access to cyclopropyl‐, trifluoromethyl‐, carbonyl‐, amide‐, and cyano‐substituted piperazine analogues. By decoupling C─H oxidation from subsequent bond construction, this two‐stage strategy enables transformations that would otherwise be incompatible with flavin‐mediated oxidation. The utility of this approach is demonstrated through the rapid preparation of diverse analogues of piperazine‐based pharmaceuticals and a preliminary structure–activity relationship (SAR) study of erastin, which reveals that piperazine‐core substitution and stereochemistry can substantially influence cellular activity. Stern–Volmer quenching experiments, cyclic voltammetry, and characterization of intermediates formed under photoirradiation provide insight into the reaction mechanism. This work establishes drug‐derived tetrahydropyrazines as practical late‐stage intermediates for expanding medicinally relevant chemical space around piperazine‐containing drug leads.
title_zh: 药物衍生的四氢吡嗪用于哌嗪类药物的后期α-和β-官能化

title: Regulating Interfacial Charge and Electric Double-Layer Structure by Choline Cations for Low-Polarization Aqueous Zinc–Sulfur Batteries
abstract: Abstract Aqueous zinc–sulfur batteries (ZSBs) offer inherent safety, low cost, and impressive theoretical energy density, but their performance is limited by a low discharge plateau. Here, choline cations (Ch+) are introduced to regulate the charge distribution and electric double-layer (EDL) thickness at the S cathode interface, constructing a Zn2+-enriched thin EDL that effectively suppresses voltage polarization. Ch+ not only accelerates Zn2+ transport across the EDL but also enhances Zn2+ enrichment within the EDL region, synchronously optimizing ion transport and interfacial kinetics to promote efficient S to ZnS conversion. Under this condition, the ZSB delivers a specific capacity of 1684 mAh g–1, a low polarization of 0.31 V and an energy density of 1108 Wh kg–1 at 0.1 A g–1, while retaining 601 mAh g–1 over 1000 cycles at 10 A g–1. This work provides a guideline for achieving low polarization and overcoming the energy density bottleneck in ZSBs.
title_zh: 胆碱阳离子调控界面电荷与双电层结构以实现低极化水系锌-硫电池
abstract_zh: 摘要 水系锌–硫电池（ZSBs）具有固有的安全性、低成本和可观的理论能量密度，但其性能受限于较低的放电电压平台。本文引入胆碱阳离子（Ch+）来调控硫正极界面的电荷分布和双电层（EDL）厚度，构建富Zn2+的薄双电层，从而有效抑制电压极化。Ch+不仅加速Zn2+跨越双电层的传输，还增强Zn2+在双电层区域内的富集，同步优化离子传输和界面动力学，促进S向ZnS的高效转化。在此条件下，该ZSB在0.1 A g–1下表现出1684 mAh g–1的比容量、0.31 V的低极化以及1108 Wh kg–1的能量密度，并在10 A g–1下循环1000次后仍保持601 mAh g–1。这项工作为实现低极化并突破ZSBs的能量密度瓶颈提供了指导。

title: Self‐Amplifying AIE Probe for HClO‐Activatable Imaging and Antioxidative/Anti‐Inflammatory Therapy of Thoracic Aortic Dissection
abstract: ABSTRACT Thoracic aortic dissection (TAD) is a highly lethal cardiovascular disease, yet its accurate diagnosis and effective treatment remain challenging due to poor imaging contrast and insufficient specificity. Leveraging the overexpressed reactive oxygen species (ROS) in TAD, we reported a hypochlorous acid (HClO)‐activatable molecular probe DT‐PZ. It enables two‐stage self‐amplifying fluorescence imaging (chemical activation and then physical aggregation) and light‐independent therapy on a single chemical entity. The probe initially exhibits quenched fluorescence via photoinduced electron transfer (PET). Two pathways can turn on the fluorescence via chemical activation: (1) oxidation by HClO blocks PET and turns on the emission; (2) photo‐triggered radicals generation of HClO (via chloride ions or myeloperoxidase) to activate neighboring probes, creating self‐amplifying fluorescence. Upon accumulation at the lesion site, the physical aggregation caused by the aggregation‐induced emission effect further amplifies the fluorescence signals. This two‐stage fluorescence amplification mechanism enables TAD visualization within 2 min in vivo. For therapy, the phenothiazine scavenges excess ROS during non‐illuminated periods, down‐regulates the NF‐κB/P65 signal pathway, and up‐regulates eNOS and P‐Akt expressions, protecting endothelial homeostasis and then improving murine survival from 50% to 90%. Collectively, DT‐PZ synergizes self‐amplifying fluorescence imaging with light‐independent antioxidation/anti‐inflammatory therapy, holding great promise for managing deep‐seated cardiovascular diseases.
title_zh: 用于胸主动脉夹层HClO可激活成像及抗氧化/抗炎治疗的自放大AIE探针
abstract_zh: 摘要 胸主动脉夹层（TAD）是一种致死率极高的心血管疾病，但由于成像对比度差和特异性不足，其准确诊断和有效治疗仍具挑战性。利用TAD中过表达的活性氧（ROS），我们报道了一种可被次氯酸（HClO）激活的分子探针DT-PZ。它可在单一化学实体上实现两阶段自放大荧光成像（先化学激活后物理聚集）以及不依赖光照的治疗。该探针最初通过光诱导电子转移（PET）表现出荧光猝灭。两条途径可通过化学激活打开荧光：(1) HClO的氧化阻断PET并开启发射；(2) 光触发的HClO自由基生成（通过氯离子或髓过氧化物酶）激活邻近探针，产生自放大荧光。在病灶部位积累后，聚集诱导发光效应引起的物理聚集进一步放大荧光信号。这种两阶段荧光放大机制可在体内2分钟内实现TAD可视化。在治疗方面，吩噻嗪在无光照期间清除过量ROS，下调NF-κB/P65信号通路，上调eNOS和P-Akt的表达，保护内皮稳态，从而将小鼠存活率从50%提高至90%。总之，DT-PZ将自放大荧光成像与不依赖光照的抗氧化/抗炎治疗相结合，在管理深部疾病方面具有巨大前景

title: Dual‐Affinity Host Engineering for Highly Reversible Zinc–Iodine Batteries
abstract: ABSTRACT Aqueous zinc–iodine (Zn–I 2 ) batteries are promising for large‐scale energy storage, yet their practical development is impeded by the coupled degradation of both electrodes, including instability Zn anode and sluggish iodine kinetics of cathode. Existing approaches typically focus on individual optimization of each electrode, limiting full cell to achieve synergistic enhancement and inevitably increases system complexity. Herein, a dual‐affinity three‐dimensional host is constructed by integrating one‐dimensional carbon nanotubes with two‐dimensional vermiculite nanosheets. The incorporation of vermiculite overcomes the intrinsically low polarity and weak adsorption capability with active material of the conventional 3D carbon frameworks. Benefiting from the densely stacked hybrid architecture with high mechanical strength, excellent electrical conductivity and dual affinity toward Zn and polyiodides, the 3D host concurrent regulate Zn deposition and iodine conversion chemistry. The zincophilic vermiculite regulate Zn 2+ flux, lower the nucleation barrier and promote uniform deposition, while the porous structure effectively suppress polyiodide shuttling through synergistic physical confinement and chemical anchoring. Consequently, the Zn composite anode exhibits remarkable cycling stability over 3000 cycles at 20 mA cm −2 at 60% depth‐of‐discharge, whereas the integrated Zn‐I 2 full cell maintains 90.0% capacity retention after 2000 cycles. This work offers a route for designing durable, highly efficient Zn‐I 2 batteries.
title_zh: 双亲和主体工程实现高可逆锌-碘电池
abstract_zh: 摘要 水系锌–碘（Zn–I2）电池在大规模储能方面前景广阔，但其实际发展受到两个电极耦合退化的阻碍，包括锌负极的不稳定性和正极缓慢的碘动力学。现有方法通常侧重于对每个电极的单独优化，限制了全电池实现协同增强，且不可避免地增加了系统复杂性。本文通过将一维碳纳米管与二维蛭石纳米片集成，构建了双亲和性三维宿主。蛭石的引入克服了传统3D碳骨架固有的低极性以及对活性物质较弱的吸附能力。得益于具有高机械强度、优异导电性以及对Zn和多碘化物双重亲和力的致密堆叠混合结构，该3D宿主可同时调控锌沉积和碘转化化学。亲锌的蛭石调控Zn2+通量，降低成核势垒并促进均匀沉积，而多孔结构则通过物理限域和化学锚定的协同作用有效抑制多碘化物穿梭。因此，锌复合负极在20 mA cm−2、60%放电深度下循环3000次以上表现出卓越的循环稳定性，而集成的Zn–I2全电池在2000次循环后仍保持90.0%的容量保持率。这项工作为设计耐用、高效的Zn–I2电池提供了一条途径。

title: Combining the optimization of electric vehicle charging station placement and charge scheduling
abstract: Renewable energy sources like solar and wind reduce greenhouse gas emissions but introduce price volatility that challenges charging infrastructure integration for battery electric vehicles (BEV). While prior approaches have primarily targeted industrial applications, such as airport ground vehicles, urban buses, or utility fleets with centralised control and predictable patterns, this study presents the first comprehensive framework for private passenger cars, whose decentralised, heterogeneous usage poses far greater modelling challenges. This study presents a novel framework integrating Charging Station Placement (CSP) and Electric Vehicle Charge Scheduling (EVCSP) to minimize system costs under such volatility. The framework begins with Step 1 generating synthetic mobility profiles for hundreds of private cars across 35,040 quarter-hourly intervals yearly, by using MiD (Mobility in Germany) surveys, activity databases for temporal detail, and OpenStreetMap mapping for dwell-time charging opportunities. Step 2 derives quarter-hourly electricity prices using the ParFuM energy market model. Step 3 formulates the integrated CSP-EVCSP as a mixed-integer linear programme (MILP) and addresses computational complexity via a three-stage hybrid approach: (i) a greedy-Lagrangian Set Covering Problem (SCP) selects minimal station locations covering all profiles; (ii) a charge-level heuristic enforces state-of-charge feasibility and capacity limits through iterative cost adjustments and urgency-based allocation; (iii) a reduced EVCSP—with fixed locations—optimizes price-responsive schedules. A case study for the city of Essen demonstrates its applicability, revealing cost savings from operational-spatial integration versus uncontrolled or coverage-only baselines. Case 1 optimizes placement and scheduling; Case 2 optimizes placement only; Case 3 benchmarks full-coverage optimal operation under 2030 prices.

title: Geometry‐Guided Screening of Metal/Oxide Heterointerfaces Enables Superior Sodium Metal Batteries at −40 °C
abstract: ABSTRACT Despite their high theoretical energy density, sodium metal batteries (SMBs) remain limited by unstable interfacial chemistry and sluggish Na + transport kinetics, particularly under ultralow‐temperature conditions. Herein, guided by a geometry‐driven design principle linking structural matching at metal/metal‐oxide heterointerfaces with current density distribution, we identify a Y/Y 2 O 3 heterostructure as an optimal surface modification layer and fabricate it on commercial aluminum foil via magnetron sputtering. The resulting Y/Y 2 O 3 heterojunction, featuring a built‐in electric field and moderate sodiophilicity, homogenizes Na + flux, and directs reversible deposition. Meanwhile, the heterointerface facilitates PF 6 − adsorption, directing interfacial reactions toward the generation of inorganic solid electrolyte interphase components, which contributes to improved interfacial stability under ultralow‐temperature conditions. Consequently, the Y/Y 2 O 3 ‐modified current collector promotes highly reversible Na plating/stripping, enabling Na@Y/Y 2 O 3 @Al||Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 full cells to retain robust cycling stability at −40 °C. The Y/Y 2 O 3 heterointerface design provides an effective platform for enabling durable SMB operation under harsh ultralow‐temperature conditions.
title_zh: 几何导向筛选金属/氧化物异质界面使钠金属电池在−40 °C下具有卓越性能
abstract_zh: 摘要 尽管钠金属电池（SMBs）具有高理论能量密度，但其仍受限于不稳定的界面化学和缓慢的Na+传输动力学，尤其是在超低温条件下。本文在将金属/金属氧化物异质界面处的结构匹配与电流密度分布相关联的几何驱动设计原则指导下，确定了Y/Y2O3异质结构作为最佳表面修饰层，并通过磁控溅射在商用铝箔上制备该结构。所得到的Y/Y2O3异质结具有内建电场和适度的亲钠性，可均匀化Na+通量并引导可逆沉积。同时，该异质界面促进PF6−的吸附，引导界面反应朝向生成无机固态电解质界面组分，从而改善超低温条件下的界面稳定性。因此，经Y/Y2O3修饰的集流体促进了高度可逆的钠沉积/剥离，使Na@Y/Y2O3@Al||Na3V2(PO4)3全电池在−40 °C下保持稳健的循环稳定性。Y/Y2O3异质界面设计为在严苛超低温条件下实现耐用的SMB运行提供了一个有效平台。

title: In Situ Peptide Assembly for Cancer Therapy
abstract: ABSTRACT Peptides have emerged as promising anticancer agents due to their biocompatibility and functional versatility, such as tumor targeting and cell penetrating capabilities. However, their clinical application is often limited by poor stability and rapid clearance. To overcome these drawbacks, peptide assembly strategies have been developed. Early approaches utilized preassembled peptide nanomaterials, but these approaches faced challenges in circulation and tumor penetration. Recently, in situ peptide assembly has gained increasing attention. This strategy involves administering molecular peptide‐drug precursors that undergo stimulus‐responsive activation in the tumor microenvironment to form nanostructures locally. This process utilizes an aggregation‐induced retention (AIR) effect for enhanced drug enrichment and retention at the tumor site. Furthermore, these in situ‐formed nanoassemblies can disrupt intracellular homeostasis and induce apoptosis, amplifying therapeutic outcomes. This review systematically elaborates on the mechanisms of in situ peptide assembly, classifies the diverse stimuli triggering this process, and comprehensively summarizes its applications in cancer therapy. Finally, current challenges and prospects in this advancing field are discussed.
title_zh: 用于癌症治疗的原位多肽组装
abstract_zh: 摘要 肽因其生物相容性和功能多样性（如肿瘤靶向和细胞穿透能力）而成为有前景的抗癌药物。然而，其临床应用常因稳定性差和快速清除而受限。为克服这些缺点，已开发出肽组装策略。早期方法采用预组装肽纳米材料，但这些方法在循环和肿瘤渗透方面面临挑战。近年来，原位肽组装日益受到关注。该策略涉及给予分子肽-药物前体，其在肿瘤微环境中经刺激响应激活后在局部形成纳米结构。该过程利用聚集诱导滞留（AIR）效应，增强药物在肿瘤部位的富集和滞留。此外，这些原位形成的纳米组装体可破坏细胞内稳态并诱导细胞凋亡，放大治疗效果。本综述系统阐述了原位肽组装的机制，对触发该过程的多种刺激进行了分类，并全面总结了其在癌症治疗中的应用。最后，讨论了这一发展领域当前的挑战与前景。

title: Polyproline: A Synthetic Polypeptide With Unique Properties
abstract: ABSTRACT Polyproline is a unique polypeptide defined by its unusual conformational rigidity and physicochemical behavior. Addressing long‐standing challenges in its synthesis and characterization, this mini‐review highlights recent advances in the ring‐opening polymerization of proline N ‐carboxyanhydride (NCA), enabling the controlled and scalable preparation of well‐defined polyproline architectures. These developments have unlocked diverse applications in advanced materials, including systems that exploit intrinsic thermoresponsive behavior arising from conformational transitions, leading to Lower Critical Solution Temperature (LCST)‐type phase separation with pronounced hysteresis. Emerging applications span smart 3D printed hydrogels, nanoparticles, membrane‐active materials, and polyproline‐based conjugates, where polyproline serves as a biocompatible alternative to poly(ethylene glycol) (PEG). Collectively, these advances position polyproline as a promising platform in biomaterials, offering benefits such as enhanced stability, reduced immunogenicity, and expanded functional versatility.
title_zh: 聚脯氨酸：一种具有独特性质的合成多肽
abstract_zh: 摘要 聚脯氨酸是一种独特的多肽，其特点在于异常的构象刚性和理化行为。本小综述针对其合成与表征中的长期挑战，重点介绍了脯氨酸N-羧基环内酸酐（NCA）开环聚合的最新进展，实现了结构明确的聚脯氨酸的可控、规模化制备。这些进展为先进材料中的多样化应用打开了大门，包括利用由构象转变引起的内在热响应行为的体系，该行为导致具有明显滞后的低临界溶解温度（LCST）型相分离。新兴应用涵盖智能3D打印水凝胶、纳米颗粒、膜活性材料以及聚脯氨酸基偶联物，其中聚脯氨酸可作为聚乙二醇（PEG）的生物相容性替代品。总体而言，这些进展使聚脯氨酸成为生物材料领域的一个有前景的平台，具有增强稳定性、降低免疫原性和扩展功能多样性等优势。

title: Defect Engineering on Amorphous NiFeB Alloys for the Selective Conversion of KA Oil Into Adipic Acid
abstract: ABSTRACT Developing high‐performance electrocatalysts for the efficient conversion of KA oil (a mixture of cyclohexanol and cyclohexanone) to adipic acid holds great significance. Herein, a series of Ni‐based catalysts, including NiM (M = Fe, Cr, and Mn) layered double hydroxides (LDHs), NiMB LDHs and amorphous NiMB alloys, were synthesized for KA oil conversion. Among the samples, Ni 4 Fe 1 B alloy exhibited the highest ECSA‐normalized current density of 581.5 mA cm −2 and adipic acid selectivity of 52.7% at 1.6 V. Such superior catalytic performance is attributed to the abundant defects induced by boron incorporation, leading to modified electronic structures of nickel sites and optimized adsorption toward KA oil and intermediates. Operando electrochemical x‐ray absorption fine structure analyses, combined with operando Raman spectra, suggested that the oxidation of KA oil by Ni 4 Fe 1 B alloy involved the transformation of Ni 2+ into higher valence states, indicative of a possible indirect oxidation pathway. In contrast, the valence state of Ni 2+ in the Ni 4 Fe 1 B and Ni 4 Fe 1 LDHs remained unchanged, suggesting a possible direct oxidation mechanism. Theoretical calculations revealed that the Ni 4 Fe 1 B alloy exhibited strong adsorption toward cyclohexanol and cyclohexanone molecules and a low energy barrier (0.76 eV) for the rate‐determining step, consistent with the experimental results.
title_zh: 非晶态NiFeB合金的缺陷工程用于KA油选择性转化为己二酸
abstract_zh: 摘要 开发高性能电催化剂以实现KA油（环己醇和环己酮的混合物）高效转化为己二酸具有重要意义。本文合成了一系列Ni基催化剂，包括NiM（M = Fe、Cr和Mn）层状双氢氧化物（LDHs）、NiMB LDHs以及非晶态NiMB合金，用于KA油转化。在所有样品中，Ni4Fe1B合金表现出最高的ECSA归一化电流密度581.5 mA cm−2，以及在1.6 V下52.7%的己二酸选择性。这种优异的催化性能归因于硼掺杂引入的丰富缺陷，导致镍位点的电子结构修饰以及对KA油和中间体的优化吸附。Operando电化学X射线吸收精细结构分析结合Operando拉曼光谱表明，Ni4Fe1B合金对KA油的氧化涉及Ni2+向更高价态的转变，表明可能存在间接氧化途径。相比之下，Ni4Fe1B和Ni4Fe1 LDHs中Ni2+的价态保持不变，表明可能存在直接氧化机制。理论计算表明，Ni4Fe1B合金对环己醇和环己酮分子表现出强吸附，且速控步骤能垒较低（0.76 eV），与实验结果一致。

title: Transient Regulation of Crystallization via Volatile Additives to Obtain High‐Quality Perovskite Films
abstract: ABSTRACT Exact regulation of nucleation and crystallization kinetics is essential for fabricating high‐performance perovskite solar cells (PSCs). However, regulating the fast assembly of precursors without incorporating residual impurities presents a significant difficulty. We present an approach of a “transient kinetic modulation” strategy employing octafluorotoluene (OCF) to control the crystallization of formamidinium (FA)‐based perovskites. Distinct from conventional additives that focus on cations or lead centers, OCF utilizes its electron‐deficient perfluorinated aromatic ring to form robust anion‐π interactions with iodide ions (I − ). This interaction effectively sequesters iodide species in the precursor solution, kinetically inhibiting the formation of PbI 3 − intermediates and reducing the disordered precipitation of phases. The resultant delayed nucleation and synchronized crystal growth provide perovskite films characterized by markedly increased grain size, alleviated lattice strain, and reduced defect density. Significantly, OCF totally volatilizes during annealing, guaranteeing a pure, residue‐free film. Consequently, the optimized devices achieve a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 25.44% with a high fill factor of 85.27%, alongside exceptional long‐term stability, retaining 93% of the initial PCE after 1800 h of ambient aging. This study establishes volatile additive modulation as an effective, non‐invasive method for crystallization management.
title_zh: 通过挥发性添加剂瞬态调控结晶以获得高质量钙钛矿薄膜
abstract_zh: 摘要 精确调控成核与结晶动力学对于制备高性能钙钛矿太阳能电池（PSCs）至关重要。然而，在不引入残留杂质的情况下调控前驱体的快速组装是一项重大难题。我们提出了一种采用全氟甲苯（OCF）的“瞬态动力学调控”策略，以控制甲脒（FA）基钙钛矿的结晶。与关注阳离子或铅中心的传统添加剂不同，OCF利用其缺电子的全氟芳香环与碘离子（I − ）形成稳健的阴离子-π相互作用。该相互作用有效地将碘物种隔离在前驱体溶液中，从动力学上抑制PbI 3 − 中间体的形成，并减少相的无序析出。由此产生的延迟成核和同步晶体生长使钙钛矿薄膜具有显著增大的晶粒尺寸、缓解的晶格应变和降低的缺陷密度。值得注意的是，OCF在退火过程中完全挥发，确保获得纯净、无残留的薄膜。因此，优化后的器件实现了25.44%的最高功率转换效率（PCE）和85.27%的高填充因子，并具有优异的长期稳定性，在环境老化1800小时后仍保持初始PCE的93%。本研究确立了挥发性添加剂调控作为一种有效、非侵入性的结晶管理方法。

title: Matrix‐Activated Aptamer Sensors for Human Serum Analysis
abstract: ABSTRACT Owing to their ease of operation, solution‐phase fluorescent sensors hold a crucial position among aptamer‐based detection tools. However, their performance is regularly compromised when exposed to increasing levels of blood fluids, such as human serum, which limits their potential in clinical settings. Here, we introduce a sensing platform that behaves advantageously within this biological medium, leveraging the most abundant proteins in the matrix, namely albumin and immunoglobulin G, as endogenous activators of fluorophore‐labeled aptamers. In the absence of a target, these serum proteins non‐specifically assemble with the aptamer probe in situ. Upon target binding, the aptamer‐protein complexes are disrupted, shifting the equilibria toward the probe unbound to biopolymers. The fluorescence anisotropy readout reveals the system's reactivity to small‐molecule targets, offering the unique ability to provide both enhanced and consistent responses across a range of high serum levels (25%–90%). As the sensor's performance may be sensitive to inter‐sample serum variations, a standard addition calibration approach is used to ensure reliable quantitative analyses. Overall, the proposed strategy addresses substantial serum‐induced perturbations and preserves assay functionality under biologically challenging conditions, thereby establishing a practical framework for extending homogeneous aptamer‐based sensing to clinically relevant blood matrices.
title_zh: 基质激活的适配体传感器用于人体血清分析
abstract_zh: 摘要 由于操作简便，溶液相荧光传感器在基于适配体的检测工具中占据重要地位。然而，当暴露于逐渐增加的血液液体（如人血清）中时，其性能常常受到损害，这限制了其在临床环境中的应用潜力。在此，我们介绍了一种在该生物介质中表现优异的传感平台，利用基质中含量最丰富的蛋白质，即白蛋白和免疫球蛋白G，作为荧光团标记适配体的内源性激活剂。在无目标物存在时，这些血清蛋白在原位与适配体探针发生非特异性组装。当目标物结合后，适配体-蛋白复合物被破坏，使平衡向未与生物聚合物结合的探针方向移动。荧光各向异性读数揭示了该体系对小分子目标物的响应能力，提供了在一系列高血清水平（25%–90%）范围内均能产生增强且一致响应的独特能力。由于传感器的性能可能对样品间血清差异敏感，因此采用标准加入校准方法以确保可靠的定量分析。总体而言，所提出的策略解决了显著的血清引起的干扰，并在生物学挑战性条件下保持了检测功能，从而为将均相适配体传感扩展至临床相关血液基质建立了实用框架。

title: Intramolecular Nickel‐Catalyzed Reductive Coupling: Enantioselective Synthesis of Tetrahydroisoquinolines and Related Heterocycles
abstract: ABSTRACT The P ‐chiral phosphine AntPhos was found to be the ligand of choice for nickel‐catalyzed intramolecular reductive coupling reactions of 5‐amino substituted 2,4‐dienoates bearing a tethered aldehyde. This approach to heterocyclic compounds has little precedent in the literature; it provides, inter alia, ready access to hydroxylated tetrahydroisoquinoline derivatives comprising an anti ‐configured amino alcohol motif, which are difficult to make in optically active form otherwise. These compounds qualify for diverse downstream functionalization as exemplified by the swift elaboration of a representative member of the series into a fluorinated heterocyclic building block as well as into the core region of potently cytotoxic phenanthroquinolizidine alkaloids in two differently substituted formats. Detailed NMR studies in combination with crystallographic data allowed the reactive oxanickelacycle intermediates primarily formed to be characterized with regard to the bonding mode of the allylnickel subunit that they comprise. Moreover, insights into conformational aspects pertinent to the understanding of the stereochemical course of this metal‐catalyzed C─C‐bond formation were gained, which leads to the generation of two stereogenic centers at the vic ‐amino alcohol subunit.
title_zh: 分子内镍催化还原偶联：四氢异喹啉及相关杂环化合物的对映选择性合成
abstract_zh: 摘要 P ‐手性膦配体AntPhos被发现是镍催化带有系链醛基的5-氨基取代2,4-二烯酸酯分子内还原偶联反应的首选配体。这种构建杂环化合物的方法在文献中鲜有先例；除其他外，它可便捷地获得含有anti 构型氨基醇结构单元的羟基化四氢异喹啉衍生物，而这类化合物难以通过其他方法以光学活性形式制备。这些化合物适用于多种下游官能化，例如将系列中的一个代表性成员快速转化为氟化杂环砌块，以及以两种不同取代形式转化为具有强细胞毒性的菲并喹诺里西定生物碱的核心区域。结合晶体学数据的详细NMR研究使得对主要生成的活性氧杂镍环中间体中烯丙基镍亚单元的键合模式进行了表征。此外，还获得了与理解该金属催化C─C键形成立体化学过程相关的构象方面的认识，该过程导致在vic 氨基醇亚单元上生成两个立体中心。

title: 2D Covalent Organic Frameworks as Robust n‐Type Organic Mixed Ionic‐Electronic Conductors for Electrochemical Transistors
abstract: ABSTRACT Organic mixed ionic‐electronic conductors (OMIECs) with exclusive electrochemical modulation and coupling between ions and electrons have exhibited intriguing efficiencies in bioelectronics, logic circuits, and wearable devices. However, OMIECs are typically linear polymers whose excessive structural swelling and morphological disorder during electrochemical doping led to low performance and instability. title: Electrochemical Cobalt/Vanadium Relay Catalysis: Enantioselective Markovnikov Hydrooxygenation of Alkenes
abstract: ABSTRACT The direct enantioselective intermolecular Markovnikov hydrooxygenation of alkenes remains a fundamental challenge, as it requires simultaneous control over regioselectivity, stereochemistry, and reactivity. Here we report an electrochemical cobalt/vanadium relay catalytic strategy that overcomes these constraints by decoupling regio‐ and stereochemical control across two distinct catalytic events. A cobalt hydride selectively engages alkenes through metal–hydride hydrogen atom transfer to generate a Markovnikov alkyl radical, while a vanadium catalyst mediates a subsequent stereodetermining bimolecular homolytic substitution (S H 2) to form the C─O bond with high enantioselectivity. Electrochemical modulation of the cobalt and vanadium redox states enables efficient catalytic relay under mild conditions, suppressing overoxidation pathways and eliminating the need for stoichiometric chemical oxidants. This approach provides access to a broad range of enantioenriched alcohols and derivatives with high functional group tolerance and scalability, offering streamlined access to pharmaceutically relevant scaffolds. More broadly, the demonstrated compatibility of vanadium‐catalyzed asymmetric bond formation with electrochemical control establishes a general framework for stereoselective C─O bond construction via radical intermediates.
title_zh: 电化学钴/钒接力催化：烯烃的马氏对映选择性加氢氧官能化反应
abstract_zh: 摘要 烯烃的直接对映选择性分子间 Markovnikov 羟氧基化仍然是一项基础性挑战，因为它需要同时控制区域选择性、立体化学和反应活性。在此，我们报道了一种电化学钴/钒接力催化策略，通过在两个不同的催化事件中解耦区域选择性和立体化学控制来克服这些限制。钴氢化物通过金属-氢原子转移选择性作用于烯烃，生成 Markovnikov 烷基自由基，而钒催化剂则介导随后的决定立体化学的双分子均裂取代（S H 2），以高对映选择性形成 C─O 键。对钴和钒氧化还原态的电化学调制实现了温和条件下的高效催化接力，抑制了过度氧化路径并免除了对化学计量化学氧化剂的需求。该方法可获得范围广泛的对映富集醇及其衍生物，具有高官能团耐受性和可扩展性，为药物相关骨架提供了简捷的合成途径。更广泛地说，所展示的钒催化不对称成键与电化学控制的相容性，为通过自由基中间体进行立体选择性 C─O 键构建建立了一个通用框架。

title: Barcoded Rabies In Situ Connectomics for high-throughput reconstruction of neural circuits
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Mechanistic understanding of how networks of neurons carry out neural computations requires knowledge of their underlying synaptic connectivity. However, current methods for reconstructing synaptic connections are extremely laborious and typically limited to mapping connections between nearby neurons. Here we developed Barcoded Rabies In Situ Connectomics (BRISC), which uses rabies viruses carrying random molecular barcodes to map both local and long-range monosynaptic inputs of hundreds of neurons in parallel. To ensure that the majority of post-synaptic starter neurons are uniquely labeled with distinct barcode sequences, we generated libraries of rabies viruses with sufficient diversity to label >1000 neurons and controlled the probability of barcode transmission between starter neurons by limiting their density. We applied BRISC to map inputs of single neurons in the mouse primary visual cortex. We read out the expression of viral barcodes in rabies-infected neurons in situ, preserving spatial information. We then matched barcode sequences between starter and presynaptic neurons, mapping the inputs of 385 neurons and identifying 7,814 putative synaptic connections, revealing layer- and cell-type-specific local connectivity rules and topographic organization of long-range inputs. These results show that BRISC can simultaneously resolve the synaptic connectivity of hundreds of neurons, enabling reconstruction of neural circuits at an unprecedented scale.
title_zh: 用于高通量重构神经回路的条形码狂犬病原位连接组学
abstract_zh: 对神经元网络如何执行神经计算进行机制性理解需要了解其潜在的突触连接。然而，目前的突触连接重建方法极为费力，且通常仅限于映射邻近神经元之间的连接。在此，我们开发了条形码狂犬病原位连接组学（BRISC），该技术利用携带随机分子条形码的狂犬病病毒，可并行映射数百个神经元的局部和长程单突触输入。为确保大多数突触后起始神经元被独特的条形码序列标记，我们构建了具有足够多样性的狂犬病病毒库以标记 >1000 个神经元，并通过限制起始神经元的密度来控制条形码在起始神经元之间传递的概率。我们将 BRISC 应用于映射小鼠初级视觉皮层中单个神经元的输入。我们在原位读取狂犬病感染神经元中病毒条形码的表达，从而保留空间信息。随后，我们在起始神经元和突触前神经元之间匹配条形码序列，映射了 385 个神经元的输入并鉴定了 7,814 个推定的突触连接，揭示了分层和细胞类型特异性的局部连接规则以及长程输入的拓扑组织。这些结果表明 BRISC 能够同时解析数百个神经元的突触连接，从而以前所未有的规模实现神经回路的重建。

title: Enhancing the Interphasic Stability of Sodium-Ion Batteries via Structural Distortion-Driven Defluorination of Aromatic Additives
abstract: Abstract The commercial viability of sodium-ion batteries is hindered by the interphasic instability of hard carbon (HC) anodes. Here, we reveal a fundamentally new interphasic engineering mechanism driven by the reduction-induced structural distortion of fluorinated aromatic additives (FAAs). We demonstrate that 1,2-difluorobenzene (2FB) preferentially accumulates at the HC interface via strong π–π interactions. Crucially, upon reduction, 2FB undergoes profound structural distortion driven by π* and σ* orbital mixing. This deformation significantly weakens the C–F bond, triggering facile defluorination to construct a robust, sodium fluoride (NaF)-rich inorganic solid electrolyte interphase (SEI). This highly protective, thin layer suppresses continuous SEI dissolution and hazardous Na plating while accelerating Na+ transport kinetics. Consequently, HC || Na(Ni1/3Fe1/3Mn1/3)O2 full cells delivered enhanced cycling stability under 3C fast-charging conditions. This work establishes a molecular design principle for engineering advanced electrochemical interfaces through orbital-level structural manipulation.
title_zh: 通过芳香族添加剂的结构畸变驱动脱氟增强钠离子电池的界面稳定性
abstract_zh: 摘要 钠离子电池的商业化可行性受到硬碳（HC）负极界面相不稳定的阻碍。在此，我们揭示了一种由氟化芳香族添加剂（FAAs）还原诱导的结构畸变所驱动的全新界面相工程机制。我们证明 1,2-二氟苯（2FB）通过强 π–π 相互作用优先积聚在 HC 界面。至关重要的是，2FB 在还原后经历了由 π* 和 σ* 轨道混合驱动的显著结构畸变。这种形变显著削弱了 C–F 键，引发容易的脱氟反应，从而构建出坚固且富氟化钠（NaF）的无机固体电解质界面相（SEI）。这一高度保护性的薄层可抑制 SEI 的持续溶解和危险的 Na 析出，同时加速 Na+ 传输动力学。因此，HC || Na(Ni1/3Fe1/3Mn1/3)O2 全电池在 3C 快充条件下表现出更高的循环稳定性。这项工作建立了一种通过轨道级结构操控来设计先进电化学界面的分子设计原则。

title: Thermally Robust Organic Photodetectors Enabled by Polymer Acceptors with Tunable Rigidity
abstract: Abstract Organic photodetectors (OPDs) have emerged as promising candidates for next-generation optoelectronic applications. However, their widespread adoption is hindered by the low thermal stability. This study addresses this issue by investigating the performance of OPDs employing three polymer acceptors: PF5-Y5, PYTS-C2, and PY2TS-C2 paired with the PBDB-T polymer donor. These devices demonstrate significantly improved resistance to thermal stress. After annealing at 150 °C for 1 h, the PF5-Y5-based OPDs can maintain a dark current density (Jd) below 1 × 10–6 A/cm2 and an external quantum efficiency (EQE) above 50%, leading to a specific detectivity of 1.7 × 1011 Jones. Detailed analysis reveals that the EQE drop in the PF5-Y5-based OPDs is due to decreased electron mobility, and Jd increases in the PY2TS-C2 and Y6 systems are attributed to enhanced aggregation and phase separation and C60 and electrode diffusion. These results highlight the advantages of polymer acceptors in enhancing thermal robustness and provide design strategies for developing thermally stable OPDs.
title_zh: 通过具有可调刚性的聚合物受体实现热稳定的有机光电探测器
abstract_zh: 摘要 有机光电探测器（OPDs）已成为下一代光电应用的有前途的候选者。然而，其低热稳定性阻碍了广泛应用。本研究通过考察采用三种聚合物受体（PF5-Y5、PYTS-C2 和 PY2TS-C2，与聚合物给体 PBDB-T 配对）的 OPDs 的性能来解决这一问题。这些器件表现出显著提高的抗热应力能力。在 150 °C 退火 1 小时后，基于 PF5-Y5 的 OPDs 可保持低于 1 × 10–6 A/cm2 的暗电流密度（Jd）和高于 50% 的外量子效率（EQE），比探测率达 1.7 × 1011 Jones。详细分析表明，基于 PF5-Y5 的 OPDs 中 EQE 的下降源于电子迁移率的降低，而 PY2TS-C2 和 Y6 体系中 Jd 的增加则归因于聚集和相分离的增强以及 C60 和电极的扩散。这些结果凸显了聚合物受体在增强热稳健性方面的优势，并为开发热稳定的 OPDs 提供了设计策略。

title: Anisotropic Lattice Compression Enables Defect-Rich Lithium-Ion Transport Channels for Extremely Fast-Charging Lithium-Ion Batteries
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Enhancing mass-transport kinetics via lattice defect engineering holds great promise for high-performance rechargeable batteries. Herein, we design a defect-rich anode system by self-catalyzing the growth of graphdiyne (GDY) on the La2CuO4 (LCO) surface. Orbital interactions between GDY and metal atoms induce a lattice compression in LCO. The degree of overlap between pz orbitals of sp-hybridized carbon atoms in GDY and dz2 orbitals of metal atoms varies across different crystallographic planes, resulting in a plane-dependent anisotropic lattice compression. This anisotropy generates specific grain boundaries rich in lattice distortions and vacancies, which lower the energy barrier for lithium (Li)-ion transport and establish defect-enhanced diffusion pathways. Furthermore, we reveal that the reversible alkyne–alkene transition of GDY during discharge–charge processes triggers a lattice-rebound effect, which actively pumps Li ions into the lattice, further enhancing the Li-ion transport kinetics. Benefiting from these features, the LCO@GDY anode exhibits remarkable fast-charging performance and long-term cycling stability, delivering a high capacity of 151.4 mAh g–1 with a capacity retention of 84.9% after 15000 cycles at 10 A g–1. Moreover, the LCO@GDY||LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 full cell delivers a specific capacity of 141.9 mAh g–1 with negligible capacity decay after 1000 cycles at a high rate of 6 C (1 C = 210 mA g–1). We anticipate that these findings will guide the construction of advanced defect-rich fast-charging materials, leading to the development of next-generation, high-performance fast-charging batteries.
title_zh: 各向异性晶格压缩产生富缺陷锂离子传输通道用于极速快充锂离子电池
