title: A fully integrated sample-to-answer diagnostic platform enables rapid quantification of post-transplant infection at the point-of-care
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Opportunistic infections after organ transplantation require frequent monitoring over years. However, current diagnostic tests are inaccessible to patients in resource-limited settings. Here, we present a microfluidic-enhanced nucleic acid test for on-site reporting (MONITOR), a fully integrated, sample-in-answer-out platform for point-of-care (POC) detection of opportunistic infections. MONITOR employs a gene-specific DNAzyme that, upon integration with recombinase polymerase amplification, enables CRISPR-like trans-cleavage signal amplification with single-molecule sensitivity. It further incorporates a rapid, extraction-free protocol for processing the urine sample, lyophilized assay reagents for cold-chain-free storage and transportation, and a 3D-printed microfluidic cartridge for self-contained, contamination-free fluid handling. A portable real-time fluorescence reader and smartphone application are further developed to enable on-site quantification. Clinical validation showed complete concordance with qPCR across the tested cohorts and a field trial identified high-risk patients with systemic BK polyomavirus infection. MONITOR fulfills ideal criteria for POC testing, offering a practical solution for decentralized, quantitative viral monitoring in low-resource settings.
title_zh: 全集成样本到答案诊断平台实现移植后感染的即时快速定量检测
abstract_zh: 器官移植后的机会性感染需要在多年内进行频繁监测。然而，目前的诊断检测在资源有限地区的患者中难以获得。本文中，我们提出了用于现场报告的微流控增强核酸检测（MONITOR），这是一个全集成、样本进结果出（sample-in-answer-out）的平台，用于机会性感染的床旁检测。MONITOR采用基因特异性DNAzyme，与重组酶聚合酶扩增结合后，可实现具有单分子灵敏度的类CRISPR反式切割信号放大。该平台还整合了快速免提取的尿液样本处理流程、用于无冷链储存和运输的冻干检测试剂，以及用于自包含、无污染流体处理的3D打印微流控芯片。此外还开发了便携式实时荧光读取器和智能手机应用程序，以实现现场定量。临床验证显示，在所测试的队列中与qPCR完全一致，现场试验识别出患有系统性BK多瘤病毒感染的高危患者。MONITOR满足床旁检测的理想标准，为资源有限环境中去中心化、定量的病毒监测提供了实用解决方案。

title: Innervated human cardiac muscle model reveals sympathetic drivers of KCNH2-associated arrhythmias
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Cardiac autonomic neurons regulate contractility. Autonomic nervous system dysregulation can cause sympathetic overdrive, leading to heart failure, and fatal arrhythmias. Here, we introduce innervated engineered human myocardium (iEHM), a model of neuro-cardiac junctions, constructed by fusing sympathetic neuronal organoids (SNO) and engineered human myocardium (EHM). Projections of sympathetic neurons formed presynaptic terminals in close proximity to cardiomyocytes and to the extensive vascular network co-developing in iEHM. Contractile responses to optogenetic stimulation of the accordingly engineered neuronal component demonstrated functional neuro-cardiac junctions. Modeling long-QT 2 in iEHM revealed sympathetic neuron hyperactivity and after depolarizations, underscoring a central role for sympathetic drive in KCNH2-associated arrhythmias. β-adrenoreceptor blockade was insufficient to rescue the pro-arrhythmic phenotype, while mexiletine targeting both neurons and cardiomyocytes, proved to be more effective. Collectively, our data establishes iEHM as a New Approach Methodology that provides a human-relevant, physiologically integrated model for mechanistic investigations and pharmacological testing.
title_zh: 神经支配的人心肌模型揭示交感神经对KCNH2相关心律失常的驱动作用
abstract_zh: 心脏自主神经元调节收缩性。自主神经系统失调可导致交感神经过度兴奋，进而引发心力衰竭和致命性心律失常。本文中，我们介绍了神经支配的工程化人体心肌，这是一种神经-心脏接头模型，通过融合交感神经元类器官和工程化人体心肌构建而成。交感神经元的突起在与心肌细胞邻近处形成突触前终末，并靠近在iEHM中共同发育的广泛血管网络。对相应工程化神经元组分进行光遗传学刺激后观察到的收缩反应证实了功能性神经-心脏接头的形成。在iEHM中建模长QT综合征2型揭示了交感神经元过度活动和后除极，凸显了交感神经驱动在KCNH2相关心律失常中的核心作用。β-肾上腺素能受体阻滞不足以挽救致心律失常表型，而同时作用于神经元和心肌细胞的美西律则更为有效。总之，我们的数据确立了iEHM作为一种新方法学，为机制研究和药理学检测提供了与人体相关、生理整合的模型。

title: Structural basis of transcription of the hachimoji eight-letter alphabet by E. coli RNA polymerase
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Expanded genetic alphabets with synthetic nucleotides can greatly increase the chemical diversity of nucleic acids, enabling new molecular functions. Because cellular transcription is executed by multi-subunit RNA polymerases, the compatibility of unnatural base pairs with this machinery is essential for engineering expanded genetic systems. Here we demonstrate that Escherichia coli RNA polymerase efficiently transcribes an eight-letter genetic alphabet with two orthogonal unnatural base pairs: P:Z and B:S pairs. To overcome G:Z misincorporation, we synthesize a higher-fidelity analogue, termed Z*, in which the C5 nitro group is replaced with a carboxamide. To elucidate substrate-recognition mechanisms, we determine four cryo-electron microscopy structures of RNA polymerase incorporating dZ:PTP or dP:Z*TP at 2.42–2.75 Å resolution. These structures, together with our early work on S:B pair, show that E. coli RNA polymerase is able to efficiently recognize these unnatural base pairs in the same manner as natural base pairs. Collectively, these results establish the feasibility of an eight-letter genetic alphabet for transcription.
title_zh: 大肠杆菌RNA聚合酶转录hachimoji八字母碱基体系的结构基础
abstract_zh: 含合成核苷酸的扩展遗传字母表可大幅增加核酸的化学多样性，从而实现新的分子功能。由于细胞转录由多亚基RNA聚合酶执行，非天然碱基对与该机制的兼容性对于构建扩展遗传系统至关重要。本文中，我们证明大肠杆菌RNA聚合酶能够高效转录包含两个正交非天然碱基对（P:Z和B:S碱基对）的八字母遗传字母表。为克服G:Z错掺入，我们合成了一种更高保真度的类似物，称为Z*，其中C5硝基被替换为甲酰胺基。为阐明底物识别机制，我们解析了RNA聚合酶掺入dZ:PTP或dP:Z*TP的四个冷冻电镜结构，分辨率为2.42–2.75 Å。这些结构结合我们此前关于S:B碱基对的研究表明，大肠杆菌RNA聚合酶能够以与天然碱基对相同的方式高效识别这些非天然碱基对。总之，这些结果确立了八字母遗传字母表用于转录的可行性。

title: Dual effect of α-synuclein disease variants on condensate formation
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: α-synuclein is a pre-synaptic protein implicated in synucleinopathies including Parkinson’s disease, Parkinson’s disease dementia, and dementia with Lewy bodies, where it accumulates in intracellular aggregates termed Lewy bodies and Lewy neurites. Recent studies have reported that α-synuclein undergoes phase separation to form biomolecular condensates both in vitro and in mammalian cells. α-synuclein condensates are thought to contribute to disease through progressive aggregation. Here we show that specific PD-associated α-synuclein variants fail to form biomolecular condensates. We demonstrate that only two α-synuclein variants associated with disease, E46K and E83Q, enhance condensate formation. While other α-synuclein disease variants including A30G, G51D, and A53E fail to form condensates in cells. In iPSC-derived neurons, the extent of synaptic enrichment of different α-synuclein variants is linked to their propensity to undergo VAMP2-mediated phase separation. Our results emphasize that α-synuclein dysfunction may follow divergent pathways, with both increased and decreased condensate formation.
title_zh: α-突触核蛋白疾病变异体对凝聚体形成的双重效应
abstract_zh: α-突触核蛋白是一种突触前蛋白，与突触核蛋白病相关，包括帕金森病、帕金森病痴呆和路易体痴呆，在这些疾病中它积累于被称为路易体和路易突起的细胞内聚集体中。近期研究报道，α-突触核蛋白在体外和哺乳动物细胞中均可发生相分离形成生物分子凝聚体。据认为，α-突触核蛋白凝聚体通过渐进性聚集促进疾病发生。本文表明，特定的PD相关α-突触核蛋白变异体无法形成生物分子凝聚体。我们证明，仅有两个与疾病相关的α-突触核蛋白变异体E46K和E83Q可增强凝聚体形成，而其他α-突触核蛋白疾病变异体（包括A30G、G51D和A53E）在细胞中无法形成凝聚体。在iPSC来源的神经元中，不同α-突触核蛋白变异体的突触富集程度与其经由VAMP2介导发生相分离的倾向相关。我们的结果强调，α-突触核蛋白功能障碍可能遵循不同的路径，表现为凝聚体形成的增强和减弱。

title: Multi-objective optimization in the context of generative chemistry
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Designing new medicines requires balancing multiple competing objectives, including biological activity, pharmacokinetics and safety. As generative chemistry expands our ability to explore chemical space, the choice of how objectives are defined, combined and evaluated becomes increasingly important. In this Perspective, we discuss the role of multi-objective optimization in molecular generation, highlighting practical considerations, methodological challenges and emerging opportunities for translating these approaches into effective drug discovery tools.
title_zh: 生成化学背景下的多目标优化
abstract_zh: 设计新药需要在多个相互竞争的目标之间取得平衡，包括生物活性、药代动力学和安全性。随着生成化学不断扩大我们探索化学空间的能力，如何定义、组合和评估这些目标的选择变得日益重要。在本视角文章中，我们讨论了多目标优化在分子生成中的作用，重点阐述了实际考量、方法学挑战以及将这些方法转化为有效药物发现工具的新兴机遇。

title: Identification and validation of central amygdala FGFR1 as a therapeutic target for alcohol use disorder using single-nucleus sequencing in rats
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: A significant minority of alcohol users develop alcohol addiction, characterized by continued use despite negative consequences, referred to as compulsive-like. We previously showed that vulnerability to compulsive-like alcohol use can be modeled in rats using punished alcohol self-administration and in male rats is mediated by PKCδ+ neurons in the central nucleus of the amygdala (CeA). Here, we used cell-type-specific transcriptomics to identify molecular mechanisms underlying individual differences in this behavior. Transcriptional changes were restricted to a limited number of CeA neuronal populations, including PKCδ+ neurons, where weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis identified an upregulated co-expression module in punishment-resistant rats with FGFR1 as a druggable upstream regulator. Selective silencing of FgfR1 in PKCδ+ neurons normalized elevated PKCδ+ expression, and reduced punishment-resistant alcohol self-administration. This effect was recapitulated by systemic administration of the FgfR1-antagonist PD173074. These findings identify distinct CeA circuits that promote addiction vulnerability, and position FGFR1 as potential therapeutic targets.
title_zh: 利用大鼠单核测序鉴定并验证中央杏仁核FGFR1作为酒精使用障碍的治疗靶点
abstract_zh: 少数饮酒者会发展为酒精成瘾，其特征是不顾负面后果仍持续饮酒，被称为强迫样行为。我们此前表明，强迫样饮酒行为的易感性可以在大鼠中通过惩罚性酒精自我给药建模，并且在雄性大鼠中由杏仁核中央核（CeA）中的PKCδ+神经元介导。在此，我们利用细胞类型特异性转录组学来识别该行为个体差异背后的分子机制。转录变化仅限于少数CeA神经元群体，包括PKCδ+神经元，其中加权基因共表达网络分析在抗惩罚大鼠中识别出一个上调的共表达模块，其可药物靶向的上游调节因子为FGFR1。在PKCδ+神经元中选择性沉默FgfR1可使升高的PKCδ+表达正常化，并减少抗惩罚性酒精自我给药。全身给予FgfR1拮抗剂PD173074可重现这一效应。这些发现识别了促进成瘾易感性的不同CeA回路，并将FGFR1定位为潜在的治疗靶点。

title: Toward an integrated and globally equitable understanding of political polarization
source: Scientific community and society : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Political polarization poses major societal risks, yet a globally relevant, interdisciplinary understanding remains lacking, as nearly half of all studies focus on the United States. We argue for renewed effort to bring global equity to polarization research, highlighting insights robust across countries, those unique to specific contexts, and key literature gaps. Closing these gaps means overcoming cultural and systemic barriers, including data-access restrictions and misaligned incentives. It also demands interdisciplinarity bridging traditional approaches and those addressing the polarizing role of the internet, social media, and AI. Otherwise, efforts to counter polarization, and its democratic harms, risk resting on unsuitable evidence.
title_zh: 迈向对政治极化的整合且全球公平的理解
abstract_zh: 政治极化带来重大的社会风险，但全球相关的跨学科理解仍然缺乏，因为近一半的研究集中在美国。我们主张重新努力使极化研究实现全球公平，突出各国稳健的见解、特定情境下独特的见解以及关键的文献空白。填补这些空白意味着克服文化和系统性障碍，包括数据获取限制和错位的激励机制。这还需要跨学科融合传统方法与解决互联网、社交媒体和AI极化作用的方法。否则，对抗极化及其民主危害的努力可能建立在不合适的证据之上。

title: Sex- and fiber type-specific remodeling of the muscle proteome implicates CSRP3 in resistance training-induced hypertrophy
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Skeletal muscle hypertrophy is a hallmark of resistance training that improves health and longevity. However, despite physiological differences between sexes and fiber types, the underlying proteome changes with resistance training have not been studied in a sex- and fiber type-specific manner. Herein, we show sex- and fiber type-specific remodeling of the human skeletal muscle proteome following 8 weeks of resistance training. Type II fibers exhibited much greater adaptations across both sexes, whereas the main sex difference was a greater remodeling of intermediate filaments in females. Of proteins that were specifically upregulated in type II fibers, overexpression of CSRP3 increased muscle mass in mice, indicating a role of fiber type-specific upregulation of CSRP3 in muscle hypertrophy. In addition, abundance of proteins involved in translation correlated with fiber hypertrophy and differed between sexes and fiber types. These findings demonstrate sex- and fiber type differences in muscle physiology and their contributions to resistance training-induced adaptions and implicate involvement of CSRP3 in resistance training-induced muscle hypertrophy.
title_zh: 肌肉蛋白质组的性别和纤维类型特异性重塑揭示CSRP3在抗阻训练诱导肥大中的作用
abstract_zh: 骨骼肌肥大是阻力训练的标志性特征，可改善健康并延长寿命。然而，尽管性别和纤维类型之间存在生理差异，阻力训练引起的潜在蛋白质组变化尚未以性别和纤维类型特异性的方式进行研究。在此，我们展示了8周阻力训练后人类骨骼肌蛋白质组的性别和纤维类型特异性重塑。两性中II型纤维均表现出更强的适应性，而主要的性别差异是女性中间丝的更大重塑。在II型纤维中特异性上调的蛋白质中，CSRP3的过表达增加了小鼠的肌肉质量，表明CSRP3的纤维类型特异性上调在肌肉肥大中的作用。此外，参与翻译的蛋白质丰度与纤维肥大相关，并在性别和纤维类型之间存在差异。这些发现证明了肌肉生理学中的性别和纤维类型差异及其对阻力训练诱导的适应性的贡献，并表明CSRP3参与阻力训练诱导的肌肉肥大。

title: Structure and mechanism of HDV ribozymes revealing Lewis acid catalysis by a metal ion
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: We have determined the molecular structure and investigated the catalytic mechanism of two ribozymes of the Hepatitis delta virus family, found in the nematode Caenorhabditis briggsae and virus Ackermannviridae. Crystal structures of both conform to the double-pseudoknot architecture adopted by the viral HDV ribozyme. The C. briggsae ribozyme has been determined both pre- and post-cleavage. In the former both nucleotides flanking the scissile phosphate are observed, along with a metal ion, and cytosine 75 N3 bound to the O5’ leaving group. The pH dependence of cleavage rate reveals a pKa of 6.5 and together with the inactivity of a C75U mutant provides evidence for its role as general acid. In contrast to other nucleolytic ribozymes that use catalytic metal ions, reaction rate does not depend on the pKa of the divalent metal ion. Limited adjustment of structure of the active center is consistent with direct bonding of the metal ion to the O2’ and non-bridging O, suggesting that the ion acts as a Lewis acid to activate nucleophilic attack. This mechanism appears to be general for the HDV ribozyme class, and distinguishes it from the majority of nucleolytic ribozymes that use general base catalysis.
title_zh: HDV核酶的结构与机制揭示金属离子的路易斯酸催化作用
abstract_zh: 我们确定了Delta肝炎病毒家族两个核酶的分子结构并研究了其催化机制，这两个核酶分别发现于线虫Caenorhabditis briggsae和Ackermannviridae病毒。两者的晶体结构均符合病毒HDV核酶采用的双假结构架。C. briggsae核酶在切割前和切割后两种状态下均已被解析。在切割前结构中，可观察到剪切磷酸两侧的核苷酸，以及一个金属离子和与O5'离去基团结合的胞嘧啶75的N3。切割速率的pH依赖性显示出6.5的pKa，结合C75U突变体的失活性，为其作为一般酸的作用提供了证据。与其他使用催化金属离子的核酸分解核酶不同，反应速率不依赖于二价金属离子的pKa。活性中心结构的有限调整与金属离子直接结合O2'和非桥连O相一致，表明该离子作为Lewis酸激活亲核攻击。该机制似乎适用于HDV核酶类，并将其与大多数采用一般碱催化机制的核酸分解核酶区分开来。

title: The physicochemical design, structure and permeability of the JCVI-syn3A minimal cell membrane
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Minimal cells offer a platform to uncover the fundamental physicochemical principles of cellular life. While genomes, proteomes, and metabolic networks of cells have been elucidated, the lipidome, which determines the physicochemical identity of the membrane, remains only partially characterized. Yet, the membrane is a central determinant of cellular viability, regulating solute permeability, mechanical stability, and environmental cues. Here, we investigate membranes that recapitulate the lipid composition of the minimal cell JCVI-syn3A, which is distinguished by an unusually high cholesterol content and simple composition. Combining cryo-electron microscopy, Langmuir monolayer experiments, permeability assays, and coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations, we demonstrate that cholesterol and sphingomyelin act as dominant condensing agents that stabilize the membrane while preserving an ordered yet fluid state. These lipids enhance lipid packing and acyl-chain order, whereas cardiolipin, POPC, and DOPG counterbalance condensation by promoting fluidity and compressibility. Cholesterol–sphingomyelin interactions emerge as a key thermodynamic driver that fine-tunes membrane order, fluidity, and permeability. Remarkably, membranes containing up to 60 mol% of cholesterol remain permeable to water and physiologically relevant osmolytes at rates compatible with growth of JCVI-syn3A. Together, our results define the physicochemical principles underlying minimal cell membranes and reveal how lipid composition enables passive permeation while maintaining membrane integrity.
title_zh: JCVI-syn3A最小细胞膜的物理化学设计、结构与渗透性
abstract_zh: 最小细胞为揭示细胞生命的基本物理化学原理提供了一个平台。虽然细胞的基因组、蛋白质组和代谢网络已被阐明，但决定膜物理化学特性的脂质组仍仅被部分表征。然而，膜是细胞活力的核心决定因素，调节溶质渗透性、机械稳定性和环境信号。在此，我们研究了重现最小细胞 JCVI-syn3A 脂质组成的膜，该细胞以其异常高的胆固醇含量和简单组成而著称。结合冷冻电子显微镜、Langmuir 单层实验、渗透性测定和粗粒化分子动力学模拟，我们证明胆固醇和鞘磷脂作为主要的凝聚剂发挥稳定膜的作用，同时保持有序而流动的状态。这些脂质增强了脂质堆积和酰基链有序度，而心磷脂、POPC 和 DOPG 则通过促进流动性和可压缩性来平衡凝聚效应。胆固醇-鞘磷脂相互作用成为微调膜有序度、流动性和渗透性的关键热力学驱动因素。值得注意的是，含有高达 60 mol% 胆固醇的膜仍能以与 JCVI-syn3A 生长相容的速率对水和生理相关的渗透物质保持渗透性。总之，我们的结果定义了最小细胞膜的物理化学原理，并揭示了脂质组成如何在维持膜完整性的同时实现被动渗透。

title: DNA methylation either antagonizes or promotes Polycomb recruitment at transposable elements in Arabidopsis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Transposable elements (TEs) are usually silenced by DNA methylation and H3K9me2, but in the absence of DNA methylation they can instead acquire the Polycomb-associated mark H3K27me3. Here, we initially set out to test whether DNA methylation and H3K27me3 compete during TE silencing establishment in Arabidopsis. Although we observe this competition at one newly inserted transgenic TE, we remarkably find that H3K27me3 deposition at another neo-inserted TE requires the de novo methyltransferase DRM2, revealing that DNA methylation can also promote Polycomb recruitment. Accordingly, genome-wide H3K27me3 profiling in different DNA methylation mutants shows that DNA methylation either antagonizes or promotes H3K27me3 in a locus-specific manner. Targeted DNA methylation experiments as well as the use of a drm2 catalytic mutant further demonstrate that DNA methylation directly influences Polycomb recruitment. Overall, our work reveals a previously unappreciated interplay between DNA methylation and Polycomb pathways that maintains genome and epigenome integrity in eukaryotes.
title_zh: 在拟南芥中DNA甲基化在转座元件处既拮抗又促进Polycomb招募
abstract_zh: 转座元件（TE）通常被DNA甲基化和H3K9me2沉默，但在缺乏DNA甲基化时，它们可以获得与Polycomb相关的标记H3K27me3。在此，我们最初旨在检验在拟南芥中TE沉默建立过程中DNA甲基化与H3K27me3是否存在竞争。尽管我们在一个新插入的转基因TE上观察到了这种竞争，但我们显著地发现，另一个新插入TE上的H3K27me3沉积需要从头甲基转移酶DRM2，表明DNA甲基化也可以促进Polycomb的招募。相应地，在不同DNA甲基化突变体中的全基因组H3K27me3图谱分析表明，DNA甲基化以基因座特异性方式拮抗或促进H3K27me3。靶向DNA甲基化实验以及drm2催化突变体的使用进一步证明，DNA甲基化直接影响Polycomb的招募。总体而言，我们的工作揭示了DNA甲基化与Polycomb通路之间此前未被认识到的相互作用，这种相互作用维持了真核生物基因组和表观基因组的完整性。

title: Disentangling cation–polyanion coupling reveals which anion motion dominates cation transport in solid electrolytes
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Polyanion dynamics, notably rotation, have long been linked to fast cation transport in solid electrolytes, yet their contribution to ionic conductivity remains unquantified, and even rotation’s role, disputed. Here, we quantify the contributions of polyanion translation, rotation, and vibration to conductivity in plastic crystals by combining a constraint algorithm and machine learning molecular dynamics. Contrary to prior belief that rotation primarily facilitates transport, we reveal that each motion mode can dominate: rotation when its frequency matches the cation hopping frequency, translation at higher rotation frequencies and vibration at lower rotation frequencies. We find that rotation and translation each can enhance conductivity by over two orders of magnitude by inducing cation disorder; rotation can further enhance cooperative cation transport; and polyanion rotation, translation, and vibration all modulate the migration barrier and prefactor. These findings demonstrate that polyanion dynamics are crucial to superionicity and offer design principles for superionic conductors.
title_zh: 解耦阳离子-多阴离子相互作用揭示固态电解质中哪种阴离子运动主导阳离子传输
abstract_zh: 长期以来，多阴离子动力学（尤其是转动）一直被认为与固体电解质中的快速阳离子输运相关，但其对离子电导率的贡献仍未被量化，甚至连转动的作用也存在争议。在此，我们通过结合约束算法和机器学习分子动力学，量化了塑性晶体中多阴离子平动、转动和振动对电导率的贡献。与先前认为转动主要促进输运的观点相反，我们揭示了每种运动模式都可能占主导地位：当转动频率与阳离子跳跃频率匹配时转动占主导，在较高转动频率下平动占主导，而在较低转动频率下振动占主导。我们发现，转动和平动均可通过诱导阳离子无序使电导率提高两个数量级以上；转动还可以进一步增强协同阳离子输运；而多阴离子的转动、平动和振动均可调节迁移势垒和指前因子。这些发现表明多阴离子动力学对超离子性至关重要，并为超离子导体提供了设计原则。

title: A spin-photon interface in the telecom C-band with long hole spin dephasing time
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Matter qubits that maintain coherence over extended timescales are essential for many pursued applications in quantum communication and quantum computing. Significant progress has already been made on extending coherence times of spins in semiconductor quantum dots while interfacing them with photons in the near-infrared wavelength range. However, similar results for quantum dots emitting at the telecom range, crucial for many applications, have so far lagged behind. Here, we report on InAs/InAlGaAs quantum dots integrated in a deterministically placed circular Bragg grating emitting at 1.55 μm. We quantify the g-factors of electrons and holes from polarization-resolved measurements of a positive trion in an in-plane magnetic field and study the dynamics of the ground-state hole spin qubit by heralding the spin in two-photon correlation measurements. We quantify the inhomogeneous dephasing times for the electron and hole for various magnetic fields and find a value of \({T}_{2}^{*}=(21.8\pm 0.2)\) ns for the hole spin, for an optimal magnetic field of B = 20 mT.
title_zh: 具有长空穴自旋退相干时间的电信C波段自旋-光子界面
abstract_zh: 能在长时间尺度上保持相干性的物质量子比特对于量子通信和量子计算领域中许多追求的应用至关重要。在半导体量子点中将自旋与近红外波长范围的光子耦合的同时延长其相干时间方面，已经取得了显著进展。然而，对于许多应用至关重要的、在电信波段发光的量子点，类似的结果迄今仍然滞后。本文报道了集成于确定性放置的圆形布拉格光栅中、在1.55 μm发光的InAs/InAlGaAs量子点。我们通过面内磁场下正三重态的偏振分辨测量量化了电子和空穴的g因子，并通过在双光子关联测量中预告自旋，研究了基态空穴自旋量子比特的动力学。我们量化了不同磁场下电子和空穴的非均匀退相干时间，发现在最佳磁场B = 20 mT下，空穴自旋的\({T}_{2}^{*}=(21.8\pm 0.2)\) ns。

title: Selective organ deposition of nanoparticles directed by metal–organic network coatings
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Despite significant advances in nanoengineering, developing a universal nanoparticle engineering strategy that enables tailored nanoparticle organ deposition post intravenous administration remains challenging. Here, we report a simple and modular strategy mediated by metal-organic network coatings composed of polyethylene glycol (PEG), proteins, phenolic ligands, and metal ions. The versatile binding affinity of phenolic ligands facilitates the formation of coatings on diverse nanoparticle platforms, including quantum dots, lipid, polymeric, inorganic, and metal–organic nanoparticles. The organ deposition selectivity of these coated nanoparticles is readily directed towards the kidney, lung, heart, and brain by varying the coating composition. Mechanistic studies reveal that the combined effect of PEG, phenolic ligands, and metal ions on the surface properties governs the overall biodistribution of the coated nanoparticles, while the protein component contributes to the coating integrity. This work provides a generalizable approach for developing an organ-targeting nanotechnology, with the potential to advance nanoparticle-mediated treatments and theranostics.
title_zh: 由金属-有机网络涂层导向的纳米颗粒选择性器官沉积
abstract_zh: 尽管纳米工程领域取得了重大进展，但开发一种通用性的纳米颗粒工程策略，以实现静脉给药后纳米颗粒的定制化器官沉积，仍然具有挑战性。本文报道了一种由聚乙二醇（PEG）、蛋白质、酚类配体和金属离子组成的金属-有机网络涂层介导的简单模块化策略。酚类配体多样性的结合亲和力促进了在多种纳米颗粒平台上形成涂层，包括量子点、脂质、聚合物、无机和金属-有机纳米颗粒。通过改变涂层组成，这些包覆纳米颗粒的器官沉积选择性可被轻松引导至肾脏、肺、心脏和大脑。机理研究揭示，PEG、酚类配体和金属离子对表面性质的联合效应决定了包覆纳米颗粒的整体生物分布，而蛋白质组分则有助于涂层的完整性。这项工作为开发器官靶向纳米技术提供了一种可推广的方法，有望推动纳米颗粒介导的治疗与诊疗一体化。

title: Biomechanical energy harvesting to improve post-stroke mobility
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Foot drop is a common post-stroke gait impairment that reduces toe clearance and compromises walking safety. Existing assistive interventions are often limited by passive compensation, external power requirements, and manual tuning. Here, we introduce a wearable, gait-timing-adaptive, self‑powered neuroprosthesis (SPN) that augments ankle dorsiflexion and corrects gait patterns, avoiding labor-intensive parameter tuning and eliminating the charging and reliability burdens of external batteries. The SPN leverages gait’s out‑of‑phase mechanics: it harvests mechanical energy during stance on the non‑paretic limb and immediately converts it into electrical stimulation of the tibialis anterior on the paretic limb during swing, increasing dorsiflexion when foot clearance is required. In ambulatory stroke survivors with preserved walking capacity, foot drop, and lower-limb impairment (Fugl-Meyer LE Score: 13-27/34, Modified Ashworth Scale-Ankle Plantarflexors: 0-2), the SPN assistance produced immediate, clinically meaningful gains during outdoor walking: dorsiflexion angle improved from −1.1° to 6.8°, walking distance increased by 67.3%, speed by 43.5%, and gait variability decreased by 71.9%. These findings demonstrate the SPN’s potential to restore dorsiflexion, enhance mobility, and improve overall quality of life for individuals recovering from stroke, particularly those at later stages of life.
title_zh: 生物力学能量采集改善中风后行动能力
abstract_zh: 足下垂是脑卒中后常见的步态障碍，会降低足趾离地间隙并损害行走安全性。现有的辅助干预手段常受限于被动补偿、外部电源需求和手动调参。在此，我们介绍了一种可穿戴、步态时序自适应、自供电神经假体（SPN），它可增强踝关节背屈并纠正步态模式，避免了费力的参数调节，并消除了外部电池的充电和可靠性负担。SPN利用了步态的异相力学特性：在非瘫痪侧下肢站立期收集机械能，并在摆动期立即将其转化为对瘫痪侧下肢胫骨前肌的电刺激，在需要足部离地间隙时增加背屈。在具有保留行走能力、足下垂和下肢功能障碍的社区脑卒中幸存者中（Fugl-Meyer LE评分：13-27/34，改良Ashworth量表-踝跖屈肌：0-2），SPN辅助在户外行走中产生了即时且具有临床意义的改善：背屈角从-1.1°提高到6.8°，步行距离增加67.3%，速度提高43.5%，步态变异性降低71.9%。这些发现表明SPN在恢复背屈、增强活动能力以及改善脑卒中康复者（尤其是晚年阶段人群）整体生活质量方面的潜力。

title: Photon-driven magnetization switching in Fe₃GeTe₂ enables programmable, multilevel magnetic memory
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The rediscovery of van der Waals magnets has revitalized research into intrinsic two-dimensional magnetism and motivated unconventional strategies, such as electrostatic gating and strain, to switch magnetic states. Photon-driven magnetization switching, however, remains largely unexplored but holds promise for fast, high-density, and energy-efficient spintronic applications. Here, we show that the itinerant van der Waals ferromagnet Fe₃GeTe₂ exhibits tunable magnetism under optical pulsed excitation, with the response governed by photon energy, fluence, and polarization. This is evident from our magneto-optic measurements, which reveal that pulses with 2.3 eV photon energy effectively reduce the coercivity of Fe₃GeTe₂. When coercivity is sufficiently lowered by strong pulse fluence, the magnetic order becomes helicity-dependent, enabling reversible suppression and restoration of the out-of-plane magnetization. Further studies indicate that these phenomena originate from distinct semiconductor-like transitions in Fe₃GeTe₂, through which photons of opposite helicity induce distinct modifications in the electronic structure, thereby altering magnetic anisotropy and the ground state differently via optical doping effect. Building on this understanding, we further demonstrate the potential of Fe₃GeTe₂ for optically controlled nonvolatile memory, capable of multilevel information storage with reversible writing and erasing, as well as spatially defined spin states, offering promise for next-generation spintronics.
title_zh: Fe₃GeTe₂中的光子驱动磁化翻转实现可编程多级磁存储
abstract_zh: 范德华磁体的重新发现使 intrinsic 二维磁性的研究重新焕发活力，并催生了诸如静电门控和应变等非常规策略来切换磁态。然而，光子驱动的磁化切换在很大程度上仍未被探索，但其在快速、高密度和节能自旋电子学应用方面具有前景。在此，我们展示了巡游型范德华铁磁体 Fe₃GeTe₂ 在光脉冲激发下表现出可调磁性，其响应由光子能量、通量和偏振控制。这从我们的磁光测量中得以证实，测量结果表明光子能量为 2.3 eV 的脉冲可有效降低 Fe₃GeTe₂ 的矫顽力。当强脉冲通量将矫顽力充分降低时，磁序变得依赖于螺旋度，从而能够对面外磁化进行可逆的抑制和恢复。进一步研究表明，这些现象源于 Fe₃GeTe₂ 中独特的类半导体跃迁，通过这些跃迁，相反螺旋度的光子对电子结构产生不同的改变，从而通过光掺杂效应以不同方式改变磁各向异性和基态。基于这一认识，我们进一步展示了 Fe₃GeTe₂ 在光学控制非易失性存储器方面的潜力，其能够以可逆写入和擦除的方式实现多级信息存储，以及空间定义的自旋态，为下一代自旋电子学提供了前景。

title: Observation of a spin-textured nematic Kondo lattice
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The Kondo lattice model, as one of the most fundamental models in condensed matter physics, has been employed to describe a wide range of quantum materials. Discovering new phases on the Kondo lattice and unveiling their mechanisms are crucial to the understanding of strongly correlated systems. Here, in a layered Kondo magnet USbTe, we observe a spin-textured nematic state and visualize a heavy electronic liquid-crystal phase. Employing scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy (STM/STS), we visualize a tetragonal symmetry breaking of heavy electronic states around the Fermi level, which coincides with the formation of heavy quasi-particles driven by band hybridization. Remarkably, using spin-polarized STM, we demonstrate that the nematic state is spin-polarized, which not only suggests its intrinsically electronic nature but also represents the unique magnetic texture of nematic heavy fermions. Our findings unveil a novel correlation-mediated order whose mechanism is inherently tied to Kondo-lattice physics. The observation of heavy nematic states enriches the phase diagram of correlated systems and provides a rare platform to explore the interplay of Kondo physics, spontaneous symmetry breaking, and quantum criticality.
title_zh: 自旋织构向列型近藤晶格的观测
abstract_zh: 近藤晶格模型作为凝聚态物理中最基本的模型之一，已被用于描述广泛的量子材料。在近藤晶格中发现新相并揭示其机制，对理解强关联体系至关重要。本文在层状近藤磁体USbTe中观察到自旋织构向列相，并可视化了一种重电子液晶相。利用扫描隧道显微镜和谱学（STM/STS），我们观察到费米能级附近重电子态发生四方对称性破缺，这与能带杂化驱动的重准粒子形成相一致。值得注意的是，利用自旋极化STM，我们证明该向列态是自旋极化的，这不仅表明其本质上的电子性质，也代表了重费米子向列态独特的磁织构。我们的发现揭示了一种新的关联介导的有序态，其机制与近藤晶格物理内在相关。重向列态的观测丰富了关联体系的相图，并为探索近藤物理、自发对称性破缺与量子临界性之间的相互作用提供了罕见平台。

title: Macrocyclization of native peptides through (thio)urea crosslinking of two amines
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Cyclopeptides have emerged as promising candidates for drug development. However, owing to the scarcity of efficient cyclization strategies for natural peptides, the development of diverse cyclopeptides remains a formidable challenge. In this study, a variety of macrocyclic peptides featuring (thio)urea bridges are developed through the site-selective lysine‑lysine crosslinking of native peptides, employing N, N’-carbonyldiimidazole or N, N’-thiocarbonyldiimidazole as bridging reagents. In particular, dual thiourea-bridged macrocyclic peptides are further synthesized by using a one-pot two-step multicomponent macrocyclization. These strategies enable the chemoselective macrocyclization of peptides bearing diverse nucleophilic residues to afford (thio)urea-bridged macrocyclic analogs, as exemplified by the successful transformation of the targeted peptide RGD (Arg-Gly-Asp) and the antimicrobial peptide Anoplin analogue. Biological evaluation demonstrates that the cyclopeptides, particularly the thiourea- and bis-thiourea-bridged analogs, exhibit enhanced target binding affinity, potent antitumor activity, as well as improved membrane permeability and stability. Molecular docking elucidates the structural origin of the enhanced bioactivity, suggesting that the reinforced molecular interactions might be a potential underlying cause.
title_zh: 通过两个胺基的（硫）脲交联实现天然多肽的大环化
abstract_zh: 环肽已成为药物开发的有前景的候选者。然而，由于天然肽的高效环化策略稀缺，多样化环肽的开发仍然是一项艰巨的挑战。在本研究中，通过使用 N, N'-羰基二咪唑或 N, N'-硫代羰基二咪唑作为桥连试剂，对天然肽进行位点选择性赖氨酸-赖氨酸交联，开发了一系列具有（硫）脲桥的大环肽。特别是，通过一锅两步多组分大环化进一步合成了双硫脲桥大环肽。这些策略能够对含有多种亲核残基的肽进行化学选择性大环化，以提供（硫）脲桥大环类似物，例如成功转化靶向肽 RGD（Arg-Gly-Asp）和抗菌肽 Anoplin 类似物。生物学评价表明，这些环肽，特别是硫脲和双硫脲桥类似物，表现出增强的靶标结合亲和力、有效的抗肿瘤活性，以及改善的膜渗透性和稳定性。分子对接阐明了生物活性增强的结构起源，表明增强的分子相互作用可能是其潜在原因。

title: Interfacial spin-order engineering mitigates the permeability-loss trade-off in amorphous soft magnetic composites
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: High magnetic permeability and low power loss are critical requirements for amorphous soft magnetic composites in high-frequency electronics. They are also typically mutually exclusive; low power loss requires insulating interfaces between magnetic particles, but conventional insulating interfaces cause magnetic dilution and decoupling, reducing permeability. Here, we introduce an interfacial spin-order engineering strategy that departs from traditional ferromagnetic interface solutions. By exploiting a thermally-electrically activated oxygen migration process, we construct a gradient oxygen-deficient functional layer between heterogeneous interfaces, enabling atomic-scale control of interfacial spin configurations. This engineered interface leads to a 150% increase in magnetic permeability and a 76% reduction in power loss, outperforming state-of-the-art counterparts. Neutron dark-field imaging provides direct, bulk-sensitive evidence that oxygen-defect-mediated spin ordering induces enlarged magnetic domains with intergranular magnetic connectivity. Mechanistically, defect-mediated super-exchange interactions reverse the spin orientation of Ce and Fe atoms at the heterointerface, transforming disordered or antiferromagnetic alignment into ferromagnetic coupling and thereby eliminating magnetic coupling barriers across particles. Our work demonstrates interfacial spin-ordering as a generalizable design principle, mitigating the long-standing permeability-loss trade-off.
title_zh: 界面自旋有序工程缓解非晶软磁复合材料的磁导率-损耗权衡
abstract_zh: 摘要 高磁导率和低损耗是高频电子器件中亚晶态软磁复合材料的关键要求。二者通常也相互排斥：低损耗要求磁性颗粒之间存在绝缘界面，但传统绝缘界面会引起磁稀释和退耦合，从而降低磁导率。在此，我们提出了一种有别于传统铁磁界面方案的界面自旋有序工程策略。通过热-电激活的氧迁移过程，我们在异质界面之间构建了梯度缺氧功能层，实现了界面自旋构型的原子级调控。这种工程化界面使磁导率提高150%，损耗降低76%，优于最先进的同类材料。中子暗场成像提供了直接的、体敏感的证据，表明氧缺陷介导的自旋有序诱导了具有晶间磁连通性的大磁畴。在机理上，缺陷介导的超交换作用逆转了异质界面处Ce和Fe原子的自旋取向，将无序或反铁磁排列转变为铁磁耦合，从而消除了颗粒间的磁耦合障碍。我们的工作证明界面自旋有序是一种可推广的设计原则，可缓解长期存在的磁导率-损耗权衡问题。

title: Trace Al/Rb regulation stabilizes Cu-Fe5C2 active sites for ambient-pressure photothermal CO2 hydrogenation to C2-C4 olefin
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Photothermal hydrogenation of CO2 offers a solar-driven route to multicarbon hydrocarbons, but controlling carbide formation and maintaining reconstructed active sites remain challenging for iron-based catalysts. Here, we develop a trace Al/Rb co-promoted CuFe2O4 catalyst that enables efficient and stable photothermal CO2 hydrogenation to light olefin under ambient pressure. The optimized catalyst achieves high C2-C4 olefin selectivity of approximately 63%, suppressing CH4 selectivity and sustaining stable photothermal-catalytic performance for 200 h. Integrated experimental characterizations and theoretical calculations reveal that the CuFe2O4 precursor undergoes reaction-induced reconstruction to form Cu-Fe5C2 interfacial structures. Trace Al/Rb promotion facilitates the formation and stabilization of reconstructed metal–carbide interfaces, with Al regulating the Fe-centered coordination environment and carbide stability, while Rb tunes the interfacial electronic structure and adsorption–hydrogenation balance. This cooperative regulation stabilizes carbide-based interfacial active sites and promotes CO2-derived C1 intermediates toward C–C coupling and C2-intermediate stabilization, thereby favoring C2-C4 olefin formation.
title_zh: 痕量Al/Rb调控稳定Cu-Fe5C2活性位点用于环境压力下光热CO2加氢制C2-C4烯烃
abstract_zh: 摘要 CO2光热加氢提供了一条太阳能驱动的多碳烃生成路径，但对于铁基催化剂而言，控制碳化物形成并维持重构活性位点仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们开发了一种微量Al/Rb共助催的CuFe2O4催化剂，可在常压下实现高效、稳定的光热CO2加氢制轻质烯烃。优化后的催化剂实现了约63%的高C2-C4烯烃选择性，抑制了CH4选择性，并保持200 h的稳定光热催化性能。综合实验表征和理论计算表明，CuFe2O4前驱体经历反应诱导重构形成Cu-Fe5C2界面结构。微量Al/Rb助催化促进了重构金属-碳化物界面的形成与稳定，其中Al调控以Fe为中心的配位环境和碳化物稳定性，而Rb则调节界面电子结构和吸附-加氢平衡。这种协同调控稳定了碳化物基界面活性位点，并促使CO2衍生的C1中间体发生C–C偶联和C2中间体稳定化，从而有利于C2-C4烯烃的生成。

title: Programmable hydrodynamics of active particles
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Self-propelled microparticles create flow fields that determine how they interact with surfaces, external flows, and each other. These flow fields fall into distinct classes–pushers, pullers, and neutral swimmers–each exhibiting fundamentally different collective behaviors. In all existing synthetic systems, this hydrodynamic character is permanently set during fabrication. Here we demonstrate that the hydrodynamic identity of microswimmers can be programmed and switched on demand. Using patterned laser heating of surface-bound nanoparticles, we create tailored temperature gradients that drive controllable boundary flows. Real-time illumination control transforms the swimmer’s flow field from pusher to puller during motion. Flow measurements confirm quantitative agreement with theory and track changes in power consumption and efficiency across modes. This control over hydrodynamic modes provides an experimental platform to explore active matter behavior under external physical constraints, including adaptive swimmer responses to crowding or confinement and the emergence of collective states from tunable pusher-puller mixtures.
title_zh: 活性粒子的可编程流体力学
abstract_zh: 自驱动微颗粒产生的流场决定了它们与表面、外部流动以及彼此之间的相互作用方式。这些流场可分为不同的类别——推型、拉型和中性游动者——每一类都表现出截然不同的集体行为。在所有现有的合成体系中，这种流体动力学特征在制备过程中被永久固定。本文证明了微游动者的流体动力学特性可以按需编程和切换。利用对表面束缚纳米颗粒的图案化激光加热，我们产生了定制化的温度梯度，以驱动可控的边界流动。实时照明控制使游动者在运动过程中其流场从推型转变为拉型。流动测量结果与理论定量吻合，并跟踪了不同模式下的功耗和效率变化。这种对流体动力学模式的控制提供了一个实验平台，用于探索外部物理约束下活性物质的行为，包括游动者对拥挤或受限环境的自适应响应，以及由可调推型-拉型混合物产生的集体态的涌现。

title: Subtyping metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease using electronic health record-linked genomic cohorts reveals diverse etiologies and progression
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is a heterogeneous condition with diverse etiologies and clinical presentations. Yet, a consensus of subtypes is lacking in MASLD. Based on latent class analysis of significant MASLD-related clinical variables, we identify five subgroups with distinct genetic, clinical, and risk profiles, which are well recapitulated in an independent cohort. Polygenic risk score and genetic variant analysis reveal genetic contributions across all subgroups. In particular, two subgroups, male-predominant cardiorenal (C2) and female-predominant with obesity and mood disorders (C3), are associated with high prevalence of type 2 diabetes, obesity, and sleep apnea. The latter also has relatively high usage of antidepressant medicine. On the other hand, the polygenic MASLD (C4) is characterized by the lowest incidence of metabolic comorbidities and ischemic heart disease. Nevertheless, this subgroup overall has the highest rate of liver transplant, which is likely driven, in part, by the combinatorial genetic effects of high-prevalent risk alleles in TM6SF2 and MBOAT7 together with low-prevalent protective allele in HSD17B13. Finally, the polygenic MASH subtype C5 shows increased risk of developing advanced fibrosis and acute renal failure. Together, our study provides key insights into MASLD heterogeneity, highlighting the opportunity for personalized therapies.
title_zh: 利用电子健康记录关联的基因组队列对代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病进行分型揭示多样的病因与进展
abstract_zh: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MASLD）是一种病因和临床表现多样的异质性疾病。然而，MASLD尚缺乏共识性的亚型划分。基于对MASLD相关重要临床变量的潜在类别分析，我们鉴定出五个具有不同遗传、临床和风险特征的亚组，并在一个独立队列中得到良好重现。多基因风险评分和遗传变异分析揭示了所有亚组的遗传贡献。其中，以男性为主的心肾亚型（C2）和以女性为主、伴肥胖和情绪障碍的亚型（C3）与2型糖尿病、肥胖和睡眠呼吸暂停的高患病率相关。后者还表现出相对较高的抗抑郁药物使用率。另一方面，多基因性MASLD（C4）的特征是代谢合并症和缺血性心脏病发病率最低。然而，该亚组总体肝移植率最高，这可能部分由TM6SF2和MBOAT7中高发风险等位基因与HSD17B13中低发保护性等位基因的组合遗传效应所驱动。最后，多基因性MASH亚型C5表现出发生晚期纤维化和急性肾功能衰竭风险的增加。总之，我们的研究为MASLD的异质性提供了关键见解，突出了个体化治疗的机会。

title: RAGE mediates LPS-induced inflammatory pain in human skin – a double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled full crossover study
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Inflammatory pain is a major clinical challenge, yet appropriate human models mimicking local infection are lacking. We established a human pain model based on intradermal administration of lipopolysaccharide, a component of Gram-negative bacteria, and investigated the time course and underlying molecular mechanisms of inflammatory pain hypersensitivity. A placebo-controlled pilot study with 12 healthy subjects showed that intradermal lipopolysaccharide injection induces hyperaemia peaking at 4.5 h and mechanical hypersensitivity peaking at 6 h. Hypersensitivity to increasingly acidic injections and mechanical pinch lasts longer than hyperaemia. The double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled full crossover main study (NCT07092215) included 40 healthy subjects and investigated the role of the Receptor for Advanced Glycation End-products. The primary hypothesis was: ‘The blood flow is different in lipopolysaccharide-injected skin spots compared to lipopolysaccharide-injected skin spots where azeliragon is co-injected’. The two secondary hypotheses were: ‘Acid-induced pain is different in lipopolysaccharide-injected skin spots compared to lipopolysaccharide-injected skin spots where azeliragon is co-injected’ and ‘Mechanical pinch-induced pain is different in lipopolysaccharide-injected skin spots compared to lipopolysaccharide-injected skin spots where azeliragon is co-injected’. Co-injection of the respective antagonist azeliragon largely reduces lipopolysaccharide-induced hyperaemia (−87%) and significantly attenuates hypersensitivity to mechanical (−55%) and increasingly acidic stimuli (−40%). In contrast, the Toll-like receptor 4 antagonist resatorvid has no effect on these readouts. In both naïve and inflamed skin, the TRPV1 antagonist BCTC inhibits the majority of acid-induced pain. Lipopolysaccharide-induced inflammation causes a substantial shift in the pH sensitivity of pain, suggesting that even mild tissue acidification contributes to inflammatory pain. The human lipopolysaccharide skin inflammation model depends largely on the Receptor for Advanced Glycation End-products, highlighting its potential as a target in inflammation.
title_zh: RAGE介导LPS诱导的人皮肤炎症性疼痛——一项双盲、随机、安慰剂对照的完全交叉研究

title: Self-organization of vascularized muscle from bovine embryonic stem cells
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Cultured beef offers a promising alternative to traditional meat. While adult stem cells are commonly used as the cell source for cultured beef, their proliferation and differentiation capacities are limited. Current manufacturing processes for cultured beef steaks often require separate preparation of multiple cell types and their intricate assembly. In this study, we propose and report the co-induction of muscle, neural, and endothelial cells from bovine embryonic stem cells (ESCs), accompanied by the formation of tissue-like structures in two- and three-dimensional cultures. Bovine myocytes are induced in a stepwise manner through the induction of presomitic mesoderm (PSM) from bovine ESCs. Muscle fibers with sarcomeres appear within 15 days, displaying calcium oscillations responsive to inputs from co-induced bovine neurons. Bovine endothelial cells are also co-induced via PSM, forming uniform vessel networks inside tissues. Our serum-free, rapid co-induction protocols represent a milestone toward self-organizing beef steaks with integrated vasculature and innervation.
title_zh: 牛胚胎干细胞自组织形成血管化肌肉
abstract_zh: 培养肉为传统肉类提供了一种有前景的替代方案。虽然成体干细胞常被用作培养肉的细胞来源，但其增殖和分化能力有限。目前培养牛排的制造工艺通常需要分别制备多种细胞类型并进行精细组装。在本研究中，我们提出并报道了从牛胚胎干细胞（ESCs）共诱导肌肉、神经和内皮细胞，并在二维和三维培养中伴随形成类组织结构。牛肌细胞通过从牛ESCs诱导体节前中胚层（PSM）以分步方式诱导产生。15天内出现具有肌节结构的肌纤维，并表现出响应共诱导牛神经元输入的钙振荡。牛内皮细胞也经由PSM共诱导产生，在组织内部形成均匀的血管网络。我们无血清、快速的共诱导方案代表了向具有整合血管和神经支配的自组织牛排迈出的里程碑。

title: Machine Learning for Rational Electrolyte Design in Lithium Batteries: Bridging Macroscopic Performance and Physically Interpretable Descriptors
abstract: ABSTRACT Rational design of high‐performance electrolytes is central to the development of next‐generation lithium batteries, but it remains hindered by vast molecular design space, intricate multiscale structure–property relationships, and multiple performance requirements. Although machine learning (ML) accelerates electrolyte discovery through data‐driven performance prediction, most existing studies rely on sparse performance data and provide limited physical interpretability, thereby falling short of true rational design. This review traces the evolution of ML‐enabled electrolyte research from macroscopic performance prediction to mesoscale mechanistic understanding, with particular emphasis on the limited coverage of electrolyte chemical space in existing performance datasets and the insufficient evaluation of model extrapolation. We then review the physically interpretable descriptors and examine their intercorrelations and domains of applicability using a common set of 26 representative solvents. The current maturity and remaining limitations of ML‐based descriptor prediction are further assessed to support the high‐throughput virtual screening of electrolyte candidates. Finally, we review recent advances in performance‐guided autonomous experimentation and discuss the key challenges associated with establishing descriptor‐guided closed‐loop discovery platforms. Although descriptor‐driven rational electrolyte design has yet to be fully realized, this review outlines an actionable roadmap for integrating physically interpretable descriptors, generalizable ML models, and autonomous experimentation toward interpretable, data‐driven electrolyte discovery.
title_zh: 用于锂电池理性电解质设计的机器学习：连接宏观性能与物理可解释描述符
abstract_zh: 摘要 高性能电解质的合理设计是下一代锂电池发展的核心，但仍然受到庞大的分子设计空间、复杂的多尺度结构-性能关系以及多重性能要求的阻碍。尽管机器学习（ML）通过数据驱动的性能预测加速了电解质的发现，但大多数现有研究依赖于稀疏的性能数据，且物理可解释性有限，因此尚未实现真正的合理设计。本综述追溯了ML赋能电解质研究从宏观性能预测到介观机理理解的演变过程，特别强调了现有性能数据集中电解质化学空间覆盖有限以及模型外推评估不足的问题。随后，我们综述了具有物理可解释性的描述符，并利用一组共有的26种代表性溶剂考察了它们之间的相关性和适用域。进一步评估了基于ML的描述符预测的当前成熟度和剩余局限，以支持电解质候选材料的高通量虚拟筛选。最后，我们综述了性能引导的自主实验的最新进展，并讨论了建立描述符引导的闭环发现平台所面临的关键挑战。尽管描述符驱动的电解质合理设计尚未完全实现，本综述为整合物理可解释描述符、可泛化的ML模型、

title: Transient Regulation of Crystallization via Volatile Additives to Obtain High‐Quality Perovskite Films
abstract: ABSTRACT Exact regulation of nucleation and crystallization kinetics is essential for fabricating high‐performance perovskite solar cells (PSCs). However, regulating the fast assembly of precursors without incorporating residual impurities presents a significant difficulty. We present an approach of a “transient kinetic modulation” strategy employing octafluorotoluene (OCF) to control the crystallization of formamidinium (FA)‐based perovskites. Distinct from conventional additives that focus on cations or lead centers, OCF utilizes its electron‐deficient perfluorinated aromatic ring to form robust anion‐π interactions with iodide ions (I − ). This interaction effectively sequesters iodide species in the precursor solution, kinetically inhibiting the formation of PbI 3 − intermediates and reducing the disordered precipitation of phases. The resultant delayed nucleation and synchronized crystal growth provide perovskite films characterized by markedly increased grain size, alleviated lattice strain, and reduced defect density. Significantly, OCF totally volatilizes during annealing, guaranteeing a pure, residue‐free film. Consequently, the optimized devices achieve a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 25.44% with a high fill factor of 85.27%, alongside exceptional long‐term stability, retaining 93% of the initial PCE after 1800 h of ambient aging. This study establishes volatile additive modulation as an effective, non‐invasive method for crystallization management.
title_zh: 通过挥发性添加剂瞬态调控结晶以获得高质量钙钛矿薄膜
abstract_zh: 摘要 成核和结晶动力学的精确调控对于制备高性能钙钛矿太阳能电池（PSCs）至关重要。然而，在不引入残留杂质的情况下调控前驱体的快速组装是一项重大难题。我们提出了一种采用全氟甲苯（OCF）的“瞬态动力学调控”策略来控制甲脒（FA）基钙钛矿的结晶。与关注阳离子或铅中心的传统添加剂不同，OCF 利用其缺电子的全氟芳环与碘离子（I⁻）形成稳健的阴离子-π 相互作用。这种相互作用有效地捕获前驱体溶液中的碘物种，在动力学上抑制 PbI₃⁻ 中间体的形成，并减少各相的无序沉淀。由此产生的延迟成核和同步晶体生长使钙钛矿薄膜具有显著增大的晶粒尺寸、缓解的晶格应变和降低的缺陷密度。重要的是，OCF 在退火过程中完全挥发，保证了纯净、无残留的薄膜。因此，优化后的器件实现了 25.44% 的冠军功率转换效率（PCE）和 85.27% 的高填充因子，并具有卓越的长期稳定性，在环境老化 1800 h 后仍保持初始 PCE 的 93%。本研究确立了挥发性添加剂调控作为一种有效、非侵入性的结晶管理方法。

title: Matrix‐Activated Aptamer Sensors for Human Serum Analysis
abstract: ABSTRACT Owing to their ease of operation, solution‐phase fluorescent sensors hold a crucial position among aptamer‐based detection tools. However, their performance is regularly compromised when exposed to increasing levels of blood fluids, such as human serum, which limits their potential in clinical settings. Here, we introduce a sensing platform that behaves advantageously within this biological medium, leveraging the most abundant proteins in the matrix, namely albumin and immunoglobulin G, as endogenous activators of fluorophore‐labeled aptamers. In the absence of a target, these serum proteins non‐specifically assemble with the aptamer probe in situ. Upon target binding, the aptamer‐protein complexes are disrupted, shifting the equilibria toward the probe unbound to biopolymers. The fluorescence anisotropy readout reveals the system's reactivity to small‐molecule targets, offering the unique ability to provide both enhanced and consistent responses across a range of high serum levels (25%–90%). As the sensor's performance may be sensitive to inter‐sample serum variations, a standard addition calibration approach is used to ensure reliable quantitative analyses. Overall, the proposed strategy addresses substantial serum‐induced perturbations and preserves assay functionality under biologically challenging conditions, thereby establishing a practical framework for extending homogeneous aptamer‐based sensing to clinically relevant blood matrices.
title_zh: 用于人体血清分析的基质激活适配体传感器
abstract_zh: 摘要 由于操作简便，溶液相荧光传感器在基于适配体的检测工具中占据重要地位。然而，当暴露于越来越高的血液液体（如人血清）水平时，其性能常常受到损害，这限制了其在临床环境中的潜力。在此，我们介绍了一种在此类生物介质中表现优异的传感平台，它利用基质中最丰富的蛋白质，即白蛋白和免疫球蛋白 G，作为荧光团标记适配体的内源性激活剂。在无靶标存在时，这些血清蛋白与适配体探针原位非特异性组装。靶标结合后，适配体-蛋白质复合物被破坏，使平衡向未与生物聚合物结合的探针方向移动。荧光各向异性读数揭示了该系统对小分子靶标的反应性，能够在一系列高血清水平（25%–90%）下提供增强且一致的响应。由于传感器的性能可能对样本间血清差异敏感，因此采用标准加入校准方法以确保可靠的定量分析。总体而言，所提出的策略解决了显著的血清诱导干扰，并在生物学挑战条件下保持了测定功能，从而为将均相适配体传感扩展至临床相关血液基质建立了实用框架。

title: Polyproline: A Synthetic Polypeptide With Unique Properties
abstract: ABSTRACT Polyproline is a unique polypeptide defined by its unusual conformational rigidity and physicochemical behavior. Addressing long‐standing challenges in its synthesis and characterization, this mini‐review highlights recent advances in the ring‐opening polymerization of proline N ‐carboxyanhydride (NCA), enabling the controlled and scalable preparation of well‐defined polyproline architectures. These developments have unlocked diverse applications in advanced materials, including systems that exploit intrinsic thermoresponsive behavior arising from conformational transitions, leading to Lower Critical Solution Temperature (LCST)‐type phase separation with pronounced hysteresis. Emerging applications span smart 3D printed hydrogels, nanoparticles, membrane‐active materials, and polyproline‐based conjugates, where polyproline serves as a biocompatible alternative to poly(ethylene glycol) (PEG). Collectively, these advances position polyproline as a promising platform in biomaterials, offering benefits such as enhanced stability, reduced immunogenicity, and expanded functional versatility.
title_zh: 聚脯氨酸：一种具有独特性质的合成多肽
abstract_zh: 摘要 聚脯氨酸是一种独特的多肽，以其异常的构象刚性和物理化学行为为特征。针对其合成与表征中长期存在的挑战，本小型综述重点介绍了脯氨酸N-羧基环内酸酐（NCA）开环聚合的最新进展，实现了结构明确的聚脯氨酸架构的可控与规模化制备。这些进展为先进材料中的多样化应用打开了大门，包括利用由构象转变产生的固有热响应行为的体系，该行为导致具有显著滞后的低临界溶解温度（LCST）型相分离。新兴应用涵盖智能3D打印水凝胶、纳米颗粒、膜活性材料以及聚脯氨酸基偶联物，其中聚脯氨酸可作为聚乙二醇（PEG）的生物相容性替代品。总体而言，这些进展使聚脯氨酸成为生物材料领域的一个有前景的平台，具有增强稳定性、降低免疫原性以及扩展功能多样性等优势。

title: Defect Engineering on Amorphous NiFeB Alloys for the Selective Conversion of KA Oil Into Adipic Acid
abstract: ABSTRACT Developing high‐performance electrocatalysts for the efficient conversion of KA oil (a mixture of cyclohexanol and cyclohexanone) to adipic acid holds great significance. Herein, a series of Ni‐based catalysts, including NiM (M = Fe, Cr, and Mn) layered double hydroxides (LDHs), NiMB LDHs and amorphous NiMB alloys, were synthesized for KA oil conversion. Among the samples, Ni 4 Fe 1 B alloy exhibited the highest ECSA‐normalized current density of 581.5 mA cm −2 and adipic acid selectivity of 52.7% at 1.6 V. Such superior catalytic performance is attributed to the abundant defects induced by boron incorporation, leading to modified electronic structures of nickel sites and optimized adsorption toward KA oil and intermediates. Operando electrochemical x‐ray absorption fine structure analyses, combined with operando Raman spectra, suggested that the oxidation of KA oil by Ni 4 Fe 1 B alloy involved the transformation of Ni 2+ into higher valence states, indicative of a possible indirect oxidation pathway. In contrast, the valence state of Ni 2+ in the Ni 4 Fe 1 B and Ni 4 Fe 1 LDHs remained unchanged, suggesting a possible direct oxidation mechanism. Theoretical calculations revealed that the Ni 4 Fe 1 B alloy exhibited strong adsorption toward cyclohexanol and cyclohexanone molecules and a low energy barrier (0.76 eV) for the rate‐determining step, consistent with the experimental results.
title_zh: 非晶NiFeB合金的缺陷工程用于KA油选择性转化为己二酸
abstract_zh: 摘要 开发高性能电催化剂以实现KA油（环己醇和环己酮的混合物）向己二酸的高效转化具有重要意义。本文合成了一系列Ni基催化剂，包括NiM（M = Fe、Cr和Mn）层状双氢氧化物（LDH）、NiMB LDH以及非晶NiMB合金，用于KA油的转化。在所有样品中，Ni4Fe1B合金表现出最高的ECSA归一化电流密度581.5 mA cm−2，并在1.6 V下实现52.7%的己二酸选择性。这种优异的催化性能归因于硼掺入诱导的丰富缺陷，其改变了镍位点的电子结构，并优化了对KA油及中间体的吸附。Operando电化学X射线吸收精细结构分析结合operando拉曼光谱表明，Ni4Fe1B合金氧化KA油涉及Ni2+向更高价态的转变，表明可能存在间接氧化路径。相反，Ni4Fe1B和Ni4Fe1 LDH中Ni2+的价态保持不变，表明可能存在直接氧化机理。理论计算表明，Ni4Fe1B合金对环己醇和环己酮分子表现出强吸附，且速率决定步骤的能垒较低（0.76 eV），与实验结果一致。

title: In Situ Peptide Assembly for Cancer Therapy
abstract: ABSTRACT Peptides have emerged as promising anticancer agents due to their biocompatibility and functional versatility, such as tumor targeting and cell penetrating capabilities. However, their clinical application is often limited by poor stability and rapid clearance. To overcome these drawbacks, peptide assembly strategies have been developed. Early approaches utilized preassembled peptide nanomaterials, but these approaches faced challenges in circulation and tumor penetration. Recently, in situ peptide assembly has gained increasing attention. This strategy involves administering molecular peptide‐drug precursors that undergo stimulus‐responsive activation in the tumor microenvironment to form nanostructures locally. This process utilizes an aggregation‐induced retention (AIR) effect for enhanced drug enrichment and retention at the tumor site. Furthermore, these in situ‐formed nanoassemblies can disrupt intracellular homeostasis and induce apoptosis, amplifying therapeutic outcomes. This review systematically elaborates on the mechanisms of in situ peptide assembly, classifies the diverse stimuli triggering this process, and comprehensively summarizes its applications in cancer therapy. Finally, current challenges and prospects in this advancing field are discussed.
title_zh: 用于癌症治疗的原位肽组装
abstract_zh: 摘要 多肽因其生物相容性和功能多样性（如肿瘤靶向和细胞穿透能力）而成为有前景的抗癌药物。然而，其临床应用常因稳定性差和快速清除而受限。为克服这些缺点，人们开发了多肽组装策略。早期方法采用预组装的多肽纳米材料，但这些方法在循环和肿瘤渗透方面面临挑战。近年来，原位多肽组装日益受到关注。该策略通过给予分子多肽-药物前体，其在肿瘤微环境中经刺激响应激活后于局部形成纳米结构。该过程利用聚集诱导滞留（AIR）效应，增强药物在肿瘤部位的富集和滞留。此外，这些原位形成的纳米组装体可破坏细胞内稳态并诱导细胞凋亡，从而放大治疗效果。本综述系统阐述了原位多肽组装的机制，对触发该过程的多种刺激进行了分类，并全面总结了其在癌症治疗中的应用。最后，讨论了这一前沿领域当前面临的挑战与前景。

title: Gene regulatory network analysis identifies auranofin as an anti-atherosclerotic drug
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Gene-regulatory networks (GRNs) offer a mechanistic framework for dissecting the complex molecular and genetic architecture of coronary artery disease and for identifying new therapeutic opportunities. Here, we present a GRN-driven drug-repurposing strategy that integrates transcriptional signatures induced by silencing key drivers of the human arterial wall foam cell regulator GRN 42 with drug-induced gene expression profiles from the NIH LINCS program. In vitro screening of top candidate compounds validates the computational predictions, identifying candidate foam cell modulators and showing that auranofin, an FDA-approved gold salt used to treat rheumatoid arthritis, effectively reduces foam cell formation. In vivo, auranofin attenuates atherosclerosis and inflammation in both male mice and rabbits. Clinically, auranofin was associated with reduced cardiovascular risk in a retrospective cohort of patients with rheumatoid arthritis. Together, these findings show that a GRN-based drug-repurposing framework, coupled with preclinical and clinical validation, can uncover new therapeutic applications for existing drugs, including auranofin, in coronary artery disease.
title_zh: 基因调控网络分析发现金诺芬为抗动脉粥样硬化药物
abstract_zh: 基因调控网络（GRN）为剖析冠状动脉疾病复杂的分子和遗传结构以及发现新的治疗机会提供了机制性框架。在此，我们提出一种GRN驱动的药物重定位策略，将沉默人动脉壁泡沫细胞调节因子GRN 42关键驱动因子所诱导的转录特征与NIH LINCS项目的药物诱导基因表达谱进行整合。对顶级候选化合物的体外筛选验证了计算预测，鉴定出候选泡沫细胞调节剂，并表明金诺芬（一种用于治疗类风湿性关节炎的FDA批准金盐）有效减少泡沫细胞形成。在体内，金诺芬减轻雄性小鼠和兔子的动脉粥样硬化及炎症。在临床中，在类风湿性关节炎患者的回顾性队列中，金诺芬与心血管风险降低相关。总之，这些发现表明，基于GRN的药物重定位框架结合临床前和临床验证，可为包括金诺芬在内的现有药物在冠状动脉疾病中发现新的治疗用途。

title: Geometry‐Guided Screening of Metal/Oxide Heterointerfaces Enables Superior Sodium Metal Batteries at −40 °C
abstract: ABSTRACT Despite their high theoretical energy density, sodium metal batteries (SMBs) remain limited by unstable interfacial chemistry and sluggish Na + transport kinetics, particularly under ultralow‐temperature conditions. Herein, guided by a geometry‐driven design principle linking structural matching at metal/metal‐oxide heterointerfaces with current density distribution, we identify a Y/Y 2 O 3 heterostructure as an optimal surface modification layer and fabricate it on commercial aluminum foil via magnetron sputtering. The resulting Y/Y 2 O 3 heterojunction, featuring a built‐in electric field and moderate sodiophilicity, homogenizes Na + flux, and directs reversible deposition. Meanwhile, the heterointerface facilitates PF 6 − adsorption, directing interfacial reactions toward the generation of inorganic solid electrolyte interphase components, which contributes to improved interfacial stability under ultralow‐temperature conditions. Consequently, the Y/Y 2 O 3 ‐modified current collector promotes highly reversible Na plating/stripping, enabling Na@Y/Y 2 O 3 @Al||Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 full cells to retain robust cycling stability at −40 °C. The Y/Y 2 O 3 heterointerface design provides an effective platform for enabling durable SMB operation under harsh ultralow‐temperature conditions.
title_zh: 几何引导的金属/氧化物异质界面筛选实现-40 °C下的高性能钠金属电池
abstract_zh: 摘要 尽管理论能量密度很高，钠金属电池（SMBs）仍受限于不稳定的界面化学和迟缓的Na+传输动力学，尤其是在超低温条件下。本文在几何驱动设计原则的指导下，将金属/金属氧化物异质界面的结构匹配与电流密度分布相关联，确定了Y/Y2O3异质结构作为最优表面修饰层，并通过磁控溅射将其制备在商用铝箔上。所得的Y/Y2O3异质结具有内建电场和适度的亲钠性，可均匀化Na+通量并引导可逆沉积。同时，该异质界面促进PF6−的吸附，引导界面反应向生成无机固体电解质界面组分方向进行，从而改善超低温条件下的界面稳定性。因此，Y/Y2O3修饰的集流体实现了高度可逆的钠沉积/剥离，使Na@Y/Y2O3@Al||Na3V2(PO4)3全电池在−40 °C下保持稳健的循环稳定性。Y/Y2O3异质界面设计为在严苛超低温条件下实现持久的SMB运行提供了有效平台。

title: Correction to “A Bifunctional Descriptor Inspired by Electron‐Donating Ability for Regulating Dendrite Growth and Parasitic Reactions in Zinc‐Ion Batteries”
