title: Proton Capture and Relay Codesign Enables a pH‐Neutral All‐Organic Aqueous Proton Battery
abstract: ABSTRACT Aqueous all‐organic proton batteries promise safe, sustainable, and high‐rate energy storage, but operation under near‐neutral conditions is hindered by low proton activity and competition from nonproton charge carriers. Here, we report a proton capture and relay codesign strategy that enables proton‐dominated charge storage without strongly acidic electrolytes. The electrode pair comprises two N‐centered redox molecules with high proton affinity: an air‐stable preprotonated imine cathode, DCTA‐2H, and a low‐potential azo anode, BCC. The electrolyte is concentrated NH 4 OAc, a near‐neutral proton‐transfer medium in which NH 4 + forms hydrogen‐bonded contacts with imine/azo sites and facilitates interfacial proton transfer rather than being stored predominantly as an intact ion. The resulting BCC||DCTA‐2H full cell delivers a discharge voltage of ≈0.85 V and a capacity of 270.9 mAh g BCC −1 , retains 86.5% of its capacity after 3,000 cycles, and remains operable at −50°C. This work establishes coupled electrode–electrolyte design as a route to near‐neutral all‐organic aqueous proton batteries.
title_zh: 质子捕获与传递协同设计实现pH中性的全有机水系质子电池
abstract_zh: 摘要 水系全有机质子电池有望实现安全、可持续和高速率的能量存储,但在近中性条件下的运行受到低质子活性以及非质子电荷载流子竞争的阻碍。在此,我们报道了一种质子捕获与传递协同设计策略,可在不使用强酸性电解质的情况下实现以质子为主导的电荷存储。该电极对由两种具有高质子亲和力的N中心氧化还原分子组成:一种是对空气稳定的预质子化亚胺正极DCTA-2H,另一种是低电位偶氮负极BCC。电解质为高浓度NH4OAc,这是一种近中性质子传递介质,其中NH4+与亚胺/偶氮位点形成氢键接触,促进界面质子传递,而非主要以完整离子的形式被存储。由此得到的BCC||DCTA-2H全电池放电电压约为0.85 V,容量为270.9 mAh gBCC−1,在3000次循环后容量保持率为86.5%,并可在-50°C下运行。这项工作确立了电极-电解质耦合设计作为通向近中性全有机水系质子电池的途径。

title: Raising the Mayan Pyramids: Construction of Polyoxothiomolybdates via In Situ Sulfurization for Enhanced Antitumor Therapy
abstract: ABSTRACT The advancement of atomic‐level sulfurization technology is ushering materials engineering from coarse regulation toward precise editing. As represented by polyoxothiometalates (POTMs), the available sulfurization methods remain limited and nongreen, imposing severe constraints on their structural diversity and functional applications. In this study, an in situ sulfurization approach was developed to construct the Mo‐based POTMs (POTMos) in a distinct and eco‐friendly manner. The emergence of unprecedented building blocks gave birth to two POTMos featuring single or fused Mayan‐pyramidal frameworks. Enabled by the structural modulation and enhanced biocompatibility via sulfur incorporation, the Mo‐57‐oxothio polyanion ( Mo 57 ) demonstrated potent antitumor efficacy. Combined experimental and theoretical analyses revealed that Mo 57 could disrupt the cell respiratory chain via two synergistic routes: catalytic oxidation of NADH and electrostatic adsorption of NAD + . Such dual interference triggered mitochondrial dysfunction and a consequent inhibition of tumor proliferation.
title_zh: 建造玛雅金字塔：通过原位硫化构建多氧硫代钼酸盐以增强抗肿瘤治疗
abstract_zh: 摘要 原子级硫化技术正推动材料工程从粗放调控走向精准编辑。以多氧硫代金属簇(POTMs)为代表,现有硫化方法仍然有限且不环保,严重制约了其结构多样性和功能应用。本研究开发了一种原位硫化方法,以独特且环保的方式构建了Mo基POTMs(POTMos)。前所未有的构筑基元的出现催生了两种分别具有单座或融合玛雅金字塔框架的POTMos。通过硫引入带来的结构调控和生物相容性增强,Mo-57-氧硫多阴离子(Mo57)展现出强效的抗肿瘤活性。实验与理论分析相结合揭示,Mo57可通过两条协同途径破坏细胞呼吸链:NADH的催化氧化和NAD+的静电吸附。这种双重干扰引发了线粒体功能障碍,进而抑制肿瘤增殖。

title: Created Ex Nihilo: A Near‐Infrared Afterglow Luminescent Framework of Imidazole Derivatives for Bioimaging
abstract: ABSTRACT Afterglow luminescence probes are limited by (i) a lack of new afterglow scaffolds; (ii) a dependence on initial external light activation, and (iii) aggregation‐caused quenching. Herein, we demonstrate for the first time that Ir(III) complexes of general formula Ir(C^N) 2 (N^N) + PF 6 − with an imidazole‐based N^N ligand exhibit bright afterglow luminescence in the presence of reactive oxygen and nitrogen species (RONS) or under ultrasound (US) irradiation. A series of Ir(III) complexes (Ir‐1–Ir‐4) establish a new afterglow luminescence mechanism based on experimental data and theoretical calculations. The key feature of the present mechanism is the reaction of the ─N═C─N─H unit of the imidazole ligands with various RONS. After modification of the luminescent framework by quinolyl‐triphenylamine C^N ligands, Ir‐4 is endowed with aggregation induced emission (AIE) properties and with enhanced near‐infrared afterglow luminescence. When assembled into water‐soluble nanoparticles (NPs) with the aid of an amphiphilic polymer, Ir‐4@R NPs demonstrated excellent afterglow luminescence imaging and effective sonodynamic therapy in vitro and in vivo. These Ir(III) complexes represent the first examples of an afterglow luminescent molecular framework based on readily available and versatile imidazole ligands, breaking through the existing limitation of molecular structures with afterglow luminescence.
title_zh: 无中生有：用于生物成像的咪唑衍生物近红外余辉发光框架
abstract_zh: 摘要 余辉发光探针受到以下限制:(i)缺乏新的余辉分子骨架;(ii)依赖初始外部光激活;(iii)聚集导致猝灭。本文首次证明,具有咪唑基N^N配体、通式为Ir(C^N)2(N^N)+PF6−的Ir(III)配合物在活性氧和氮物种(RONS)存在下或在超声(US)辐照下表现出明亮的余辉发光。一系列Ir(III)配合物(Ir-1–Ir-4)基于实验数据和理论计算确立了一种新的余辉发光机制。该机制的关键特征是咪唑配体的─N═C─N─H单元与各种RONS发生反应。通过喹啉基三苯胺C^N配体对发光框架进行修饰后,Ir-4被赋予了聚集诱导发光(AIE)特性以及增强的近红外余辉发光。在两亲性聚合物辅助下组装成水溶性纳米颗粒(NPs)后,Ir-4@R NPs在体外和体内均展现出优异的余辉发光成像和有效的声动力治疗。这些Ir(III)配合物是基于易得且通用的咪唑配体的余辉发光分子框架的首批实例,突破了现有余辉发光分子结构的局限。

title: The Part and the Whole: Field‐Dependent THz‐EPR Spectroscopy Probes Lattice‐Dependent Electronic Structure in Iron(II) Spin Crossover
abstract: ABSTRACT Frequency‐domain Fourier‐transform (FD‐FT) THz‐EPR spectroscopy provides direct access to kinetically trapped high‐spin ( HS ) states in iron(II) spin crossover (SCO) complexes. Using temperature‐induced excited spin‐state trapping (TIESST), the low‐temperature electronic structure of the HS state is accessed despite a diamagnetic low‐spin ( LS ) ground state. Field‐dependent spectra resolve the splitting of the HS ground‐state manifold and provide evidence for spin–phonon coupling, described by an avoided‐crossings Hamiltonian supported by ab initio calculations. THz‐EPR further quantifies the remaining HS fraction () and reveals shifts of magnetic transitions that depend on the surrounding spin‐state matrix. These results show that HS centers experience distinct local lattice environments in mixed HS / LS states and provide experimental access to the influence of spin‐state distribution on SCO processes. Cooperative switching scenarios, including domain formation and alternating HS / LS arrangements, can thus be distinguished. Field‐dependent THz‐EPR spectroscopy therefore provides direct access to lattice‐dependent effects in SCO materials.
title_zh: 局部与整体：场依赖的THz-EPR光谱探测铁(II)自旋交叉中依赖晶格的电子结构
abstract_zh: 摘要 频域傅里叶变换(FD-FT)THz-EPR波谱学可直接探测铁(II)自旋交叉(SCO)配合物中被动力学捕获的高自旋(HS)态。利用温度诱导激发自旋态捕获(TIESST),尽管基态为抗磁性低自旋(LS)态,仍可探测HS态的低温电子结构。场依赖谱分辨了HS基态流形的分裂,并提供了自旋-声子耦合的证据,该耦合由从头算计算支持的避免交叉哈密顿量描述。THz-EPR进一步定量了剩余的HS分数(),并揭示了依赖于周围自旋态矩阵的磁跃迁偏移。这些结果表明,在混合HS/LS态中HS中心经历不同的局部晶格环境,并为实验上探究自旋态分布对SCO过程的影响提供了途径。由此可以区分协同切换情景,包括畴的形成和交替的HS/LS排列。因此,场依赖THz-EPR波谱学为直接探测SCO材料中依赖于晶格的效应提供了途径。

title: Electric/Thermal Coupling Field Promotes Phonon Delocalization to Accelerate Defect‐Repair Kinetics in Spent LiFePO 4
abstract: ABSTRACT Solid‐phase regeneration is widely considered as the most promising scalable approach for recycling spent LiFePO 4 (S‐LFP) cathode. However, the sluggish defect‐repair kinetics in traditional solid‐phase routes remains mechanistically unclear, limiting the practical deployment of this technology. Here, theoretical calculations reveal that the phonon localization in defect‐rich S‐LFP is the essential factor responsible for the sluggish defect‐repair kinetics. Localized phonons retard thermal diffusion, hindering the energy available to overcome defect repair barriers, and concurrently intensify electron‐phonon coupling that suppresses the electron migration necessary for the reduction of Fe(III). Guided by this insight, we employ electric/thermal coupling field strategy to repair the S‐LFP cathode. Carriers driven by the electric field transfer energy to phonons through electron‐phonon scattering, which promotes energy redistribution across disparate phonon modes, collectively enhancing phonon delocalization. As a result, Li‐Fe antisites (Fe Li ) were repaired within 5 s at 700°C, and the complete structural repair and lithiation are achieved within 60 s. Experimental results indicate that the regenerated cathode delivers a discharge specific capacity of 151.2 mAh g −1 at 0.1C, and exhibits a capacity retention of 84.3% after 1100 cycles at 1 C. This theoretical breakthrough establishes a solid theoretical foundation for developing advanced S‐LFP restoration technologies.
title_zh: 电/热耦合场促进声子离域以加速废旧LiFePO4的缺陷修复动力学
abstract_zh: 摘要 固相再生被广泛认为是最有前景的废旧LiFePO4(S-LFP)正极规模化回收方法。然而,传统固相路线中缓慢的缺陷修复动力学的机理仍不明确,限制了该技术的实际应用。在此,理论计算揭示,富含缺陷的S-LFP中的声子局域化是导致缓慢缺陷修复动力学的关键因素。局域化声子阻碍热扩散,妨碍了克服缺陷修复势垒所需的能量,同时加剧了电子-声子耦合,从而抑制了Fe(III)还原所需的电子迁移。基于这一认识,我们采用电/热耦合场策略修复S-LFP正极。电场驱动的载流子通过电子-声子散射将能量传递给声子,促进能量在不同声子模式间的重新分布,共同增强声子离域化。因此,Li-Fe反位缺陷(FeLi)在700°C下5秒内即被修复,并在60秒内完成结构修复和锂化。实验结果表明,再生正极在0.1C下放电比容量为151.2 mAh g−1,在1 C下循环1100次后容量保持率为84.3%。这一理论突破为开发先进的S-LFP修复技术奠定了坚实的理论基础。

title: Enhanced Figure‐of‐Merit Energy Harvesting in [001]‐Oriented PMN‐PZT Ceramics Via Synergistic Multi‐Scale Engineering
abstract: ABSTRACT Developing piezoelectric materials with a high figure‐of‐merit (FOM = d 33 × g 33 /tan δ ) is crucial for advanced energy‐harvesting technologies. Here, a high FOM is achieved in [001]‐oriented Pb(Mg 1/3 Nb 2/3 )O 3 ‐PbZrO 3 ‐PbTiO 3 (PMN‐PZT) textured ceramics by synergistically integrating grain orientation, defect engineering, and morphotropic phase boundary (MPB) design. The textured ceramic exhibits exceptional properties (piezoelectric charge coefficient d 33 = 1120 pC·N −1 , piezoelectric voltage coefficient g 33 = 62 × 10 −3 V·m·N −1 , and an ultralow dielectric loss tan δ = 0.23%). Atomic‐scale analysis reveals that the [001] intrinsic anisotropy and mixed rhombohedral‐tetragonal domains facilitate polarization rotation to boost d 33 and g 33 , while Mn doping‐induced defect dipoles suppress dielectric loss. Consequently, an ultrahigh FOM of 30,180 × 10 −12 m 2 ·N −1 is realized. Furthermore, a cantilever energy harvester utilizing this textured ceramic delivers an outstanding power density of 0.72 µW·mm −3 , which is 78 times higher than that of commercial soft PZT. This work provides an effective strategy for designing high‐FOM piezoelectric materials for high performance energy harvesting applications.
title_zh: 通过多尺度协同工程增强[001]取向PMN-PZT陶瓷的优值能量收集
abstract_zh: 摘要 开发具有高品质因数(FOM = d33 × g33 /tan δ)的压电材料对先进能量收集技术至关重要。在此,通过协同整合晶粒取向、缺陷工程和同质异晶相界(MPB)设计,在[001]取向的Pb(Mg1/3Nb2/3)O3-PbZrO3-PbTiO3(PMN-PZT)织构陶瓷中实现了高FOM。该织构陶瓷表现出卓越的性能(压电电荷系数d33 = 1120 pC·N−1,压电电压系数g33 = 62 × 10−3 V·m·N−1,以及超低介电损耗tan δ = 0.23%)。原子尺度分析表明,[001]本征各向异性和菱方-四方混合畴促进极化旋转以提升d33和g33,而Mn掺杂诱导的缺陷偶极子抑制介电损耗。因此,实现了30,180 × 10−12 m2·N−1的超高FOM。此外,利用该织构陶瓷的悬臂梁能量收集器实现了0.72 µW·mm−3的出色功率密度,比商用软性PZT高78倍。这项工作为设计用于高性能能量收集应用的高FOM压电材料提供了有效策略。

title: Unraveling Spatial Electrochemical Heterogeneity and Additive‐Mediated Regulation in Scale‐up Aqueous Zinc‐Ion Pouch‐Type Cells
abstract: ABSTRACT Scaling aqueous zinc‐ion batteries (AZIBs) to pouch‐type configurations amplifies electric‐field and Zn 2+ flux heterogeneities, causing non‐uniform Zn deposition. Here, β‐cyclodextrin (β‐CD) and Tween 80 (Tw80) are systematically investigated to decouple bulk transport and interfacial kinetic regulation in scale‐up pouch‐type cells. β‐CD increases ionic conductivity (3.44 to 5.95 mS cm − 1 ) and the Zn 2+ transference number (0.16 to 0.47), promoting uniform bulk ion flux and extending symmetric pouch‐type cell lifespan beyond 1000 h at 1 mA cm − 2 . Conversely, Tw80 operates via interfacial adsorption to regulate local reaction kinetics, achieving stable cycling for >600 h. Spatially resolved analysis, operando Raman spectroscopy, and in situ thermal imaging reveal that β‐CD suppresses macroscopic heterogeneity across near‐tab, central, and edge regions by stabilizing bulk solvation, whereas Tw80 mitigates localized interfacial instability. In practical Zn||V 2 O 5 pouch‐type full cells, β‐CD delivers superior long‐term capacity retention, while Tw80 excels under high‐rate conditions. This work identifies spatial electrochemical heterogeneity as a primary scaling limit and offers general design principles connecting additive chemistry, transport kinetics, and format‐dependent deposition for practical AZIBs.
title_zh: 揭示放大化水系锌离子软包电池中的空间电化学异质性与添加剂介导的调控
abstract_zh: 摘要 将水系锌离子电池（AZIBs）扩展至软包型构型会放大电场和Zn2+通量的不均匀性，导致Zn沉积不均匀。本文系统研究了β-环糊精（β-CD）和Tween 80（Tw80），以在放大软包型电池中解耦体相传输与界面动力学调控。β-CD提高了离子电导率（3.44至5.95 mS cm−1）和Zn2+迁移数（0.16至0.47），促进均匀的体相离子通量，并使对称软包型电池在1 mA cm−2下寿命超过1000 h。相反，Tw80通过界面吸附调控局部反应动力学，实现>600 h的稳定循环。空间分辨分析、operando拉曼光谱和原位热成像表明，β-CD通过稳定体相溶剂化结构抑制极耳附近、中央和边缘区域的宏观不均匀性，而Tw80则缓解局部界面不稳定性。在实际Zn||V2O5软包型全电池中，β-CD表现出优异的长期容量保持率，而Tw80在高倍率条件下表现突出。这项工作将空间电化学不均匀性确定为主要的放大限制因素，并为实用AZIBs提供了连接添加剂化学、传输动力学与构型依赖性沉积的通用设计原则。

title: Field‐Regulated Triboelectric Nanogenerators for Enhanced Energy Conversion
abstract: ABSTRACT Triboelectric nanogenerators (TENGs) provide a versatile platform for distributed mechanical energy harvesting and self‐powered sensing. However, their practical deployment remains constrained by insufficient surface charge density, high output impedance, impedance mismatch, and environmental instability, particularly under low‐frequency and low‐intensity mechanical excitation. To move beyond purely mechanically driven contact electrification, optical, thermal, magnetic, and electric fields have recently been introduced into TENG systems to regulate interfacial charge generation, separation, transport, and retention. Unlike reviews centered on the simple structural integration or output superposition of otherwise independent energy‐harvesting units, this review focuses on mechanistic external‐field coupling and adopts field‐assisted charge modulation as a unifying framework for analyzing multifield‐coupled TENGs. Starting from Maxwell's displacement current, the fundamental working mechanism of conventional TENGs and the key parameters governing their output performance are discussed. Coupling mechanisms involving localized surface plasmon resonance, photon‐generated carriers, pyroelectric effects and heat‐excitation effects, magnetic nanomaterials, magnetically assisted structures, charge injection, and charge pumping are then highlighted. Finally, current challenges and future opportunities in unified theoretical modeling, field‐responsive materials, system‐level integration, power management, and long‐term reliability are discussed. By linking external‐field coupling mechanisms with materials design and device architecture, this review provides guidance for developing high‐output, adaptive, and multifunctional self‐powered systems.
title_zh: 场调控摩擦纳米发电机实现高效能量转换
abstract_zh: 摘要 摩擦电纳米发电机（TENGs）为分布式机械能收集和自供电传感提供了一个多功能平台。然而，其实际应用仍受到表面电荷密度不足、高输出阻抗、阻抗失配以及环境不稳定性（特别是在低频和低强度机械激励下）的限制。为了突破纯粹的机械驱动接触起电，近年来光场、热场、磁场和电场被引入TENG体系，以调控界面电荷的产生、分离、传输和保持。与聚焦于独立能量收集单元的简单结构集成或输出叠加的综述不同，本综述聚焦于机理性的外场耦合，并采用场辅助电荷调制作为分析多场耦合TENGs的统一框架。从麦克斯韦位移电流出发，讨论了传统TENGs的基本工作机理及其决定输出性能的关键参数。随后重点介绍了涉及局域表面等离激元共振、光生载流子、热释电效应与热激发效应、磁性纳米材料、磁辅助结构、电荷注入和电荷泵浦的耦合机制。最后，讨论了统一理论建模、场响应材料、系统级集成、功率管理和长期可靠性方面的当前挑战与未来机遇。通过将外场耦

title: Decoding Multiscale Degradation of Layered Cathodes in All‐Solid‐State Lithium Batteries: An Advanced Diagnostics‐Driven Framework
abstract: ABSTRACT All‐solid‐state lithium batteries (ASSLBs) with layered oxide cathodes such as LiNi 1‐x‐y Mn x Co y O 2 (NMC), LiNi 1‐x‐y Co x Al y O 2 (NCA), LiNiO 2 (LNO), and lithium‐rich layered oxides (LLOs) offer superior energy density and safety, yet their performance is severely limited by complex, coupled degradation mechanisms at the cathode/inorganic solid‐state electrolyte (SSE) interface and within the cathode bulk. This review establishes a Diagnosis‐Mechanism‐Mitigation (D‐M‐M) framework that decodes these multiscale degradation phenomena by cross‐validating multimodal diagnostic evidence from electronic structure to the cell level. Two categories are dissected: interfacial degradation, encompassing chemical decomposition, space‐charge layer formation, and resistive interphase growth; and bulk cathode degradation, including structural phase transitions, cation disorder, oxygen loss, and microstructural cracking. Drawing on advanced spectroscopy, microscopy, 3D imaging, and in situ/operando methods, each degradation cascade is traced from its diagnostic signature to its mechanism and to the validated mitigation it informed, from interfacial coatings to dopant engineering and microstructure optimization. Machine learning and artificial intelligence are assessed for interpreting complex diagnostic datasets and guiding predictive cathode design. The framework is further extended to practically relevant conditions (thick electrodes, low stack pressure, and large‐format cells), and the field's unresolved controversies are delineated together with the experiments that would decide them.
title_zh: 解码全固态锂电池层状正极的多尺度退化：先进的诊断驱动框架
abstract_zh: 摘要 采用层状氧化物正极（如LiNi 1-x-y Mn x Co y O 2（NMC）、LiNi 1-x-y Co x Al y O 2（NCA）、LiNiO 2（LNO）和富锂层状氧化物（LLOs））的全固态锂电池（ASSLBs）具有优异的能量密度和安全性，但其性能受到正极/无机固态电解质（SSE）界面以及正极体相内复杂、耦合的退化机制的严重限制。本综述建立了一个诊断-机理-缓解（D-M-M）框架，通过交叉验证从电子结构到电池级的多模态诊断证据来解析这些多尺度退化现象。剖析了两类退化：界面退化，包括化学分解、空间电荷层形成和阻抗性界面相生长；以及正极体相退化，包括结构相变、阳离子无序、氧损失和微裂纹。借助先进的光谱学、显微学、3D成像以及原位/工况方法，从诊断特征到机理再到其指导的经过验证的缓解措施（从界面包覆到掺杂工程和微结构优化），逐一追溯每条退化级联路径。评估了机器学习和人工智能在解释复杂诊断数据集和指导预测性正极设计方面的作用。该框架进一步扩展到实际相关条件（厚电极、低堆叠压力和大尺寸电池），并界定了该领域尚未解决的争议以及能够解决的实验

title: Flexible Osmotic Energy Batteries Enabled by Stacked Bicontinuous‐Network Hydrogels
abstract: ABSTRACT Reverse dialysis based on hydrogel membranes holds promise for the development of soft electrochemical batteries. However, the energy conversion efficiency is often constrained by excessive swelling, which dilates nanochannels and degrades permselectivity. Here, we present a bicontinuous‐network hydrogel (BCNH) engineered by precisely modulating the hydrophilic and hydrophobic phases to achieve high‐performance osmotic energy conversion. Benefiting from the BCN structure, the hydrophilic ion‐conducting pathways are spatially confined by a percolating hydrophobic matrix, which dramatically suppresses swelling. This structural restraint preserves high permselectivity and enhances mechanical robustness. The resulting BCNH membrane, which simultaneously offers high permselectivity and rapid ionic flux, delivers an outstanding osmotic power density of 21.07 W·m −2 , significantly outperforming conventional homogeneous hydrogels. By integrating cation‐selective and anion‐selective BCNHs into flexible full cells, we achieve a high‐power density of 10.07 W·m −2 , enabling the scalable fabrication of highly flexible battery arrays. Combining integrated high selectivity, ultralow swelling, and robust mechanical properties, the BCNH platform establishes a transformative material foundation for advanced flexible electronics and sustainable energy conversion technologies.
title_zh: 基于堆叠双连续网络水凝胶的柔性盐差能电池
abstract_zh: 摘要 基于水凝胶膜的反向透析为软电化学电池的开发提供了前景。然而，其能量转换效率往往受到过度溶胀的限制，溶胀会使纳米通道扩张并降低离子选择性渗透。在此，我们提出了一种双连续网络水凝胶（BCNH），通过精确调控亲水和疏水相来实现高性能渗透能转换。得益于BCN结构，亲水离子传导通道被渗流的疏水基质空间限域，从而显著抑制了溶胀。这种结构约束保持了高离子选择性渗透并增强了机械稳健性。所得到的BCNH膜同时具有高离子选择性渗透和快速离子通量，提供了21.07 W·m -2 的出色渗透功率密度，显著优于常规均相水凝胶。通过将阳离子选择性和阴离子选择性BCNH集成到柔性全电池中，我们实现了10.07 W·m -2 的高功率密度，实现了高柔性电池阵列的可扩展制造。结合集成的高选择性、超低溶胀和稳健的机械性能，BCNH平台为先进柔性电子和可持续能量转换技术奠定了变革性的材料基础。

title: Spectrally Programmable Spin‐Polarized Photocurrents in WSe 2 –NiPS 3 Magnetic van der Waals Heterostructures
abstract: ABSTRACT Efficient generation and control of spin‐polarized currents in semiconductors remain central challenges for spin‐based electronics, particularly due to impedance mismatch and the reliance on magnetic fields or ferromagnetic contacts. Here, we introduce a materials platform for spectrally programmable spin transport based on a van der Waals (vdW) heterostructure combining the antiferromagnetic semiconductor NiPS 3 with WSe 2 . In a p–n diode architecture, circularly polarized excitation produces pronounced photoconductive resonances with spin‐polarization reaching 80% near the Néel temperature and persisting at ≈30% at room temperature. Remarkably, selected spectral bands retain their polarization sign across the magnetic phase transition, evidencing robust, spectrally protected spin‐polarized current generation. Polarization‐resolved photogalvanic measurements reveal a dominant circular injection‐current mechanism, confirming spin‐polarized carrier transport. First‐principles calculations show that an applied electric field induces interfacial hybridization and spin‐layer locking, giving rise to localized symmetry breaking and enhanced optical absorption while preserving global time‐reversal symmetry. These results establish spectral tuning of excitation as a new control knob for spin transport, enabling spin‐current generation without magnetic fields or polarization switching. Our findings position magnetic vdW heterostructures as a versatile platform for opto‐spintronic functionality and spectrally programmable spintronic devices.
title_zh: WSe2–NiPS3磁性范德华异质结构中的光谱可编程自旋极化光电流
abstract_zh: 摘要 在半导体中高效产生和控制自旋极化电流仍是自旋电子学的核心挑战，这尤其源于阻抗失配以及对磁场或铁磁接触的依赖。在此，我们引入了一种基于反铁磁半导体NiPS3与WSe2结合的范德华（vdW）异质结的材料平台，实现光谱可编程的自旋传输。在p–n二极管结构中，圆偏振激发产生了显著的光电导共振，自旋极化在奈尔温度附近达到80%，并在室温下保持约30%。值得注意的是，特定光谱波段在磁相变过程中保持其极化符号，证明了稳健的、光谱保护的自旋极化电流产生。偏振分辨光电流测量揭示了主导的圆偏振注入电流机制，证实了自旋极化载流子输运。第一性原理计算表明，外加电场诱导界面杂化和自旋-层锁定，产生局域对称性破缺和增强的光吸收，同时保持全局时间反演对称性。这些结果确立了激发的光谱调控作为自旋传输的新调控手段，可在无需磁场或极化切换的情况下产生自旋电流。我们的发现将磁性vdW异质结定位为光自旋电子学功能和光谱可编程自旋电子器件的多功能平台。

title: Self‐Assembling Copolymers Encapsulating Single Endothelial Cells Induce Endogenous ECM Deposition and Vascular Regeneration
abstract: ABSTRACT Cell therapy combined with biomimetic polymer engineering offers a promising strategy for cardiovascular regeneration. Compartmentalizing single cells in hydrogels creates three‐dimensional (3D) micro‐niches that enhance bio‐responsiveness and the therapeutic efficacy of cell therapy. A non‐microfluidic strategy for single‐cell encapsulation using a stimuli‐responsive amphiphilic copolymer, gelatin‐poly(glycerol sebacate)‐methacrylate (GPM) is developed. When incubated with cells at room temperature, GPM self‐assembled into single‐cell vesicles via ligand–receptor–mediated interactions, creating a nanoscale matrix around each cell with near 100% encapsulation efficiency. The presence of bioactive moieties, dynamic mechanical properties, and matrix metalloproteinase mediated degradability enabled reciprocal, cell‐matrix interactions. Consequently, 3D cultures of GPM vesicles encapsulating single endothelial cell (GPM/EC vesicles) promoted deposition of thread‐like extracellular matrix (ECM), which facilitated cell migration and served as a guidance scaffold for vessel‐like network formation. For enhanced in vivo distribution and immunoprotection, GPM/reprogrammed EC vesicles were assembled into injectable microspheres, termed mGPM‐rEC. Upon injection into a mouse hindlimb ischemia model, mGPM‐rEC demonstrated robust cell survival and intramuscular migration with the deposition of dense ECM. This ECM functioned as a reservoir for growth factors and signaling molecules, recruiting host vasculature to promote neovascularization and providing structural and mechanical support for implanted cells to form de novo blood vessels.
title_zh: 自组装共聚物包裹单内皮细胞诱导内源性ECM沉积与血管再生
abstract_zh: 摘要 细胞疗法与仿生聚合物工程相结合为心血管再生提供了一种有前景的策略。将单细胞分隔包裹于水凝胶中可构建三维（3D）微环境，增强细胞疗法的生物响应性和治疗效力。本研究开发了一种基于刺激响应性两亲性共聚物——明胶-聚(癸二酸甘油酯)-甲基丙烯酸酯（GPM）的非微流控单细胞封装策略。在室温下与细胞共孵育时，GPM通过配体-受体介导的相互作用自组装形成单细胞囊泡，在每个细胞周围构建纳米级基质，封装效率接近100%。生物活性基团的存在、动态力学性能以及基质金属蛋白酶介导的可降解性实现了细胞-基质之间的双向相互作用。因此，包裹单个内皮细胞的GPM囊泡（GPM/EC囊泡）的3D培养促进了线状细胞外基质（ECM）的沉积，从而促进细胞迁移并作为血管样网络形成的导向支架。为了增强体内分布和免疫保护，将GPM/重编程EC囊泡组装成可注射微球，称为mGPM-rEC。注射入小鼠后肢缺血模型后，mGPM-rEC表现出强健的细胞存活和肌肉内迁移能力，并伴有致密ECM的沉积。该ECM作为生长因子和信号分子的储库，招募宿主脉管系统以促进新血管生成，并提供结构和力学支

title: Unveiling hidden air pollution exposure and impacts with low-cost sensor network-based frameworks
source: Scientific community and society : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: India has made some progress in mitigating severe air pollution; however, many regions continue to experience fine particulate matter (PM2.5) levels exceeding World Health Organization and national standards. Despite this, local-scale exposure information beyond urban centers, intra-regional inequities, and short-term mortality impacts remain poorly understood. This study integrates dense, low-cost sensor-based PM2.5 measurements with machine learning models, recent family health survey data, and India-specific relative risk information to assess sub-regional exposure inequity among socioeconomic groups and short-term mortality impacts in Bihar, one of the most polluted and understudied states of India. Here we show a clear north-south divide in PM2.5 exposure, with northern districts having mean exposure levels 1.2 times higher. District-level mortality (per 100,000) varied up to 1.7-fold, with daily mortality showing 3.2-fold variability. We observe limited exposure inequity at the state level but substantial inter- and intra-regional inequities within Bihar.
title_zh: 基于低成本传感器网络框架揭示隐性的空气污染暴露及其影响
abstract_zh: 印度在缓解严重空气污染方面取得了一定进展；然而，许多地区的细颗粒物（PM2.5）水平仍超过世界卫生组织和国家标准。尽管如此，城市中心以外的局地尺度暴露信息、区域内部不平等以及短期死亡率影响仍知之甚少。本研究将密集的低成本传感器PM2.5测量与机器学习模型、近期家庭健康调查数据以及印度特异性的相对风险信息相结合，以评估比哈尔邦（印度污染最严重且研究最不足的邦之一）各社会经济群体之间的亚区域暴露不平等及短期死亡率影响。我们发现PM2.5暴露存在明显的南北差异，北部地区的平均暴露水平高出1.2倍。地区级死亡率（每10万人）差异高达1.7倍，日死亡率呈现3.2倍的变异。我们在邦级层面观察到有限的暴露不平等，但在比哈尔邦内部存在显著的区域间和区域内不平等。

title: Spatially Synergistic Dual‐Confinement Enables Underwater‐Stable Room‐Temperature Phosphorescent Hydrogels
abstract: ABSTRACT Organic room‐temperature phosphorescent (RTP) hydrogels are attractive as flexible luminescent materials for optoelectronic and biomedical applications, but their water‐rich and mechanically compliant nature makes it difficult to create microenvironments that simultaneously suppress nonradiative decay, resist external quenching, and maintain structural robustness. Here, we report an amphiphilic polymer chain‐driven in situ curing strategy that generates rigid luminescent epoxy microspheres uniformly within a PVA hydrogel matrix. Combined with annealing–reswelling‐induced matrix densification, this process creates a spatially synergistic dual‐confinement system, in which the inner epoxy domains immobilize phosphors while the outer dense PVA network helps impede the ingress of water and oxygen. The resulting hydrogels exhibit tunable multicolor RTP, an ultralong phosphorescence lifetime of up to 4342 ms, a daylight‐visible afterglow luminance of 87.9 cd m −2 , a time‐gated delayed‐emission quantum yield of 55.49%, and a tensile strength exceeding 10 MPa. Notably, the hydrogels retain a phosphorescence lifetime of 3172 ms after 170 days of water immersion. This work identifies spatially synergistic dual confinement as an effective route to jointly optimize phosphorescence efficiency, mechanical robustness, and long‐term underwater stability in soft luminescent hydrogels.
title_zh: 空间协同双重限域实现水下稳定室温磷光水凝胶
abstract_zh: 摘要 有机室温磷光（RTP）水凝胶作为用于光电子和生物医学应用的柔性发光材料颇具吸引力，但其富含水和机械柔软的特性使得难以构建同时抑制非辐射衰减、抵御外部猝灭并保持结构稳定性的微环境。在此，我们报道了一种两亲性聚合物链驱动的原位固化策略，可在PVA水凝胶基质中均匀生成刚性发光环氧微球。结合退火-再溶胀诱导的基质致密化，该过程构建了空间协同的双重限域体系，其中内部环氧畴固定磷光体，而外层致密的PVA网络有助于阻碍水和氧的进入。所得水凝胶表现出可调的多色RTP、长达4342 ms的超长磷光寿命、日光下可见的余辉亮度87.9 cd m−2、时间门控延迟发射量子产率55.49%以及超过10 MPa的拉伸强度。值得注意的是，该水凝胶在水中浸泡170天后仍保持3172 ms的磷光寿命。本工作确立了空间协同双重限域作为联合优化软质发光水凝胶的磷光效率、机械稳健性和长期水下稳定性的有效途径。

title: Evolution and Manipulation of Interstitial Oxygen Configuration in Titanium—A Review
abstract: ABSTRACT Oxygen has been regarded as a detrimental impurity in titanium alloys, as it triggers embrittlement and compromises ductility. Recent research advancements, however, have revolutionized this perception, revealing oxygen as a powerful microstructural architect capable of mediating phase transformations and deformation mechanisms to achieve strength–ductility combinations. This review systematically summarizes the pivotal roles of oxygen across various phases, including α, β, α′, α″, ω, and face‐centered cubic (FCC) phases. The underlying strengthening mechanisms and the oxygen embrittlement mechanisms were further analyzed, covering the strengthening theoretical models, interfacial segregation behaviors, and oxygen shuffling mechanism. These mechanistic insights are essential for understanding the evolution of dislocation configurations, twinning behaviors, and phase transformation dynamics. To harness oxygen's strengthening potential while mitigating its adverse effects, potential innovative strategies, including compositional, microstructural, and process design approaches, are proposed, which span from the atom‐scale to the micro‐scale. By integrating multiscale computational simulations, advanced in situ characterization, and the challenge of controlling oxygen uptake, this work provides a comprehensive framework for the intelligent design of next‐generation oxygen‐containing titanium alloys with exceptional mechanical properties.
title_zh: 钛中间隙氧构型的演化与调控——综述
abstract_zh: 摘要 氧长期以来被视为钛合金中的有害杂质，因为它会引发脆化并损害延展性。然而，近年来的研究进展彻底改变了这一认知，揭示氧是一种强大的微观组织设计师，能够调控相变和变形机制，从而实现强度-塑性的兼顾。本综述系统总结了氧在α、β、α′、α″、ω和面心立方（FCC）等各相中的关键作用，并进一步分析了其强化机制和氧脆机制，涵盖强化理论模型、界面偏析行为和氧迁移（shuffling）机制。这些机制性认识对于理解位错组态演化、孪生行为和相变动力学至关重要。为了在利用氧的强化潜力的同时减轻其不利影响，我们提出了从原子尺度到微观尺度的潜在创新策略，包括成分、微观组织和工艺设计方法。通过整合多尺度计算模拟、先进原位表征以及控氧摄入的挑战，本工作为具有卓越力学性能的下一代含氧钛合金的智能化设计提供了全面框架。

title: The Past, Present, and Future of Biomass‐Derived Hard Carbon for Sodium‐Ion Batteries
abstract: ABSTRACT Given the cost‐effectiveness, renewability, and environmental friendliness features, biomass‐derived hard carbon has attracted significant attention in sodium‐ion batteries (SIBs). However, the macroproperties of the resultant hard carbon highly depend on the resources and components of the biomass precursors. And the structure–property relationship remains complicated, which brings huge challenges for subsequent research. To clarify such intrinsic correlation, this review systematically elucidates the physicochemical propert ies, multiscale mechanisms, as well as isolation approaches of the cellulose, hemicellulose, and lignin first, with special focus on the differential evolution behavior and its synergistic transformation mechanism of these three main components during the pyrolysis‐carbonization process. Then, the key regulation effects on microstructure and sodium storage performance have also been illuminate d based on the structural evolution of these component s. Subsequently, by comparing different modification methods, an innovative precursor pretreatment strategy for component matching and correlation with sodium storage characteristics has been proposed, which can control the path of degradation and reconstruction of components and thus optimize the electrochemical behaviors of the resulting hard carbons. Finally, multi‐dimensional solutions are raised in order to target the industrialization bottlenecks. These solutions provide a theoretical foundation and technical roadmap for the development of high‐performance, low‐cost SIBs anode materials.
title_zh: 生物质衍生硬碳在钠离子电池中的过去、现在与未来
abstract_zh: 摘要 鉴于其成本效益、可再生性和环境友好性，生物质衍生硬碳在钠离子电池（SIBs）中受到了广泛关注。然而，所得硬碳的宏观性能高度依赖生物质前体的来源和组成，且其构效关系依然复杂，给后续研究带来巨大挑战。为阐明这一内在关联，本综述首先系统阐述了纤维素、半纤维素和木质素的物理化学性质、多尺度机理及分离方法，特别关注这三种主要组分在热解-碳化过程中的差异演化行为及其协同转化机制。随后，基于这些组分的结构演化，阐明了其对微观结构和储钠性能的关键调控作用。接着，通过比较不同改性方法，提出了一种用于组分匹配及其与储钠特性关联的创新前体预处理策略，该策略可控制组分降解与重构的路径，从而优化所得硬碳的电化学行为。最后，针对产业化瓶颈提出了多维度解决方案。这些解决方案为开发高性能、低成本的SIBs负极材料提供了理论基础和技术路线图。

title: Mixed‐Dimensional 1D/2D Ternary CMOS for High‐Performance Integrated Circuits
abstract: ABSTRACT Ternary logic offers a path to higher information density and lower power consumption beyond the limits of binary CMOS, yet its progress has been limited by the absence of high‐performance ternary transistors and scalable circuit technologies. Here we report a mixed‐dimensional ternary CMOS (T‐CMOS) platform that monolithically integrates aligned carbon nanotubes (CNTs) and monolayer MoS 2 within silicon backend‐of‐line processes. The resulting CNT‐MoS 2 heterojunction transistors exhibit more than an order‐of‐magnitude performance improvement in output current and negative differential transconductance over previous ternary devices, enabling robust three‐level switching with large noise margins. By co‐fabricating CNT p‐FETs and MoS 2 n‐FETs into heterojunction devices, we realize CMOS‐compatible standard, positive and negative ternary inverters, as well as NMIN and NMAX logic gates. A fully functional ternary 2‐to‐9 decoder, the most complex low‐dimensional ternary circuit to date, is also demonstrated. Dynamic measurements and calibrated simulations confirm the scalability, cascade capability, and robustness of the T‐CMOS architecture, providing a viable pathway toward large‐scale ternary integrated circuits beyond binary limits.
title_zh: 面向高性能集成电路的混合维度1D/2D三元CMOS
abstract_zh: 摘要 三值逻辑为超越二值CMOS的限制、实现更高的信息密度和更低的功耗提供了途径，但受制于高性能三值晶体管和可扩展电路技术的缺乏，其进展一直受限。在此，我们报道了一种混合维度三值CMOS（T-CMOS）平台，可在硅后道工艺（backend-of-line）中单片集成定向排列的碳纳米管（CNTs）和单层MoS2。所得CNT-MoS2异质结晶体管在输出电流和负微分跨导方面比以往三值器件提升了一个数量级以上，可实现具有大噪声容限的稳健三电平开关。通过将CNT p-FETs和MoS2 n-FETs共同制备为异质结器件，我们实现了与CMOS兼容的标准、正和负三值反相器，以及NMIN和NMAX逻辑门。此外，还展示了功能完整的三值2线-9线译码器，这是迄今为止最复杂的低维三值电路。动态测量和校准仿真证实了T-CMOS架构的可扩展性、级联能力和鲁棒性，为超越二值极限的大规模三值集成电路提供了可行路径。

title: Beyond and Inside the Electrical Double Layer: Molecular‐Level Cation Effects in Aqueous Electrocatalysis
abstract: ABSTRACT Electrocatalytic reactions occur at a dynamic, ion‐regulated electrochemical interface, rather than at a static electrode boundary. In electrocatalytic processes such as hydrogen evolution/oxidation and CO 2 reduction, which operate at potentials below the electrode's potential of zero charge, electrolyte cations are not mere spectators but active participants that shape reaction behavior. Their size, charge density, solvation structure, and spatial organization within the electric double layer (EDL) govern interfacial energetics, transition states, and reaction activity and selectivity, giving rise to pronounced, system‐dependent cation effects. Furthermore, cation accumulation dynamically modifies the interfacial electric field, reorganizes water structure, and alters local pH, thereby coupling electrostatics, solvation, and mass transport in a highly nonlinear manner. These intertwined effects complicate mechanistic interpretation and have contributed to ongoing debates and seemingly contradictory conclusions across experimental and theoretical studies. Here, we synthesize the current understanding of cation effects at electrochemical interfaces, highlight emerging interfacial molecular structures revealed by in situ and operando studies that challenge classical EDL models, identify key unresolved debates, and outline pathways toward a quantitative, molecular‐level description of cation–interface–reactivity relationships.
title_zh: 双电层之内与之外：水系电催化中的分子级阳离子效应
abstract_zh: 摘要 电催化反应发生在动态的、离子调控的电化学界面上，而非静态电极边界处。在析氢/氧化和CO2还原等在低于电极零电荷电位的电位下运行的电催化过程中，电解质阳离子并非旁观者，而是决定反应行为的活性参与者。它们在双电层（EDL）内的尺寸、电荷密度、溶剂化结构和空间排布决定了界面能量学、过渡态以及反应活性和选择性，从而产生显著的、体系依赖的阳离子效应。此外，阳离子累积会动态改变界面电场、重组水结构并改变局部pH，以高度非线性的方式将静电学、溶剂化和传质耦合在一起。这些相互交织的效应使机理解释复杂化，并导致实验和理论研究中的持续争论和看似矛盾的结论。在此，我们综述了目前对电化学界面阳离子效应的认识，重点介绍了原位和operando研究揭示的挑战经典EDL模型的新兴界面分子结构，指出了关键的未决争论，并概述了通向阳离子-界面-反应性关系的定量、分子层面描述的路径。

title: Critical role for the TGF-β1/mTORC1 signaling axis in defining the transcriptional identity of CTHRC1+ pathologic fibroblasts
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Fibrosis, marked by excess extracellular matrix (ECM) deposition, is the end stage of many diseases. Single-cell studies have highlighted the emergence of disease-specific fibroblast populations, including a high collagen–synthesizing
                    
                      CTHRC1
                      +
                    
                    subpopulation. The profibrotic cytokine TGF-β1 promotes fibrogenesis via cooperation between Smad and mTORC1/4E-BP1 signaling axes. Using CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing, we report that more than one-third of TGF-β1–regulated matrisome genes are under mTORC1 control. Mapping the transcriptome of TGF-β1–stimulated fibroblasts revealed similarity to
                    
                      CTHRC1
                      +
                    
                    fibroblasts identified in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF). This overlap is lost when mTORC1 is disabled. Using the selective mTORC1 inhibitor RMC-5552, we confirm a causal role for mTORC1 in promoting the acquisition of the collagen-high,
                    
                      CTHRC1
                      +
                    
                    phenotype in response to TGF-β1 stimulation in fibroblasts derived from patients with either IPF or lung adenocarcinoma. We conclude that mTORC1 plays a key role in shaping the transcriptional identity of these fibroblasts, with implications for therapeutic inhibition of mTORC1 in fibrosis and cancer.
title_zh: TGF-β1/mTORC1信号轴在定义CTHRC1+病理性成纤维细胞转录特性中的关键作用
abstract_zh: 纤维化的特征是细胞外基质（ECM）过度沉积，是许多疾病的终末阶段。单细胞研究揭示了疾病特异性成纤维细胞群的出现，包括高胶原合成的CTHRC1+亚群。促纤维化细胞因子TGF-β1通过Smad与mTORC1/4E-BP1信号轴之间的协作促进纤维化。利用CRISPR-Cas9基因编辑，我们报道超过三分之一的TGF-β1调控的基质体基因受mTORC1控制。对TGF-β1刺激的成纤维细胞转录组进行映射，发现其与特发性肺纤维化（IPF）中鉴定出的CTHRC1+成纤维细胞具有相似性。当mTORC1失活时，这种重叠消失。利用选择性mTORC1抑制剂RMC-5552，我们证实mTORC1在促进源自IPF或肺腺癌患者的成纤维细胞响应TGF-β1刺激时获得高胶原、CTHRC1+表型中具有因果作用。我们得出结论，mTORC1在塑造这些成纤维细胞的转录身份中发挥关键作用，对纤维化和癌症中治疗性抑制mTORC1具有重要意义。

title: Estimating the carcinogenesis timelines in early-onset versus late-onset cancers and changes across birth cohorts
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Understanding when key mutations occur in cancer is critical for prevention and detection, especially for early-onset cancers that have risen in recent years. Yet, intermediate mutational steps remain difficult to observe. Here, we extend a tumor kinetic model and combine it with long-term cancer registry data to estimate mutational timelines. Using differential equation systems to represent sequential carcinogenic stages and a convolution-based method, we derive and estimate the expected ages of mutational transitions for breast, colorectal, and thyroid cancers. Model results suggest early-life initiations across all cancers. Malignant transitions occur ∼10 years earlier in early- vs late-onset breast and colorectal cancers (late 30s versus late 40s to 50s), while thyroid cancer shows similarly early transitions (late 20s) regardless of onset age. Across cohorts (1950–1954, 1965–1969, and 1980–1984), more recent cohorts show accelerated progression and earlier malignancy. These findings can inform early-onset cancer etiologic studies and intervention strategies.
title_zh: 早发型与晚发型癌症致癌时间线估算及跨出生队列的变化
abstract_zh: 理解癌症中关键突变发生的时间对于预防和检测至关重要，尤其是近年来不断增多的早发性癌症。然而，中间突变步骤仍然难以观察。在本研究中，我们扩展了一个肿瘤动力学模型，并将其与长期癌症登记数据相结合以估算突变时间线。利用微分方程系统表示连续的致癌阶段，并采用基于卷积的方法，我们推导并估算了乳腺癌、结直肠癌和甲状腺癌突变转变的预期年龄。模型结果表明，所有癌症中均存在生命早期的启动。早发与晚发乳腺癌和结直肠癌的恶性转变时间相差约10年（30多岁后期与40多岁后期至50多岁相比），而甲状腺癌无论发病年龄如何均表现出相近的早期转变（20多岁后期）。在各出生队列（1950–1954、1965–1969和1980–1984年）中，较晚的队列显示出更快的进展和更早的恶性转变。这些发现可为早发性癌症的病因学研究和干预策略提供参考。

title: Moon’s farside near-zero paleomagnetic field suggests a global lunar dynamo cessation
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Recent paleomagnetic studies of Apollo and Chang’e returned samples suggest that the lunar dynamo was active from ∼4.2 billion years ago (Ga) and ceased by ∼1.0 Ga. However, uncertainties remain regarding the temporal and spatial distribution of the lunar paleomagnetic field, as almost all of the returned samples are from the nearside, except for those returned by Chang’e-6. Here, we present the first paleomagnetic analysis of a lunar meteorite, Northwest Africa 15528, which is a feldspathic regolith breccia likely from the farside of the Moon. Our results not only indicate that it recorded a near-zero magnetic field (below a few hundred nanoteslas) at ∼0.7 Ga but also show that lunar meteorites can provide critical paleomagnetic information. Combined with two young Apollo samples from the nearside, Apollo 15015 (formed at ∼0.9 Ga) and Apollo 15465 (formed at ∼0.5 Ga), our findings suggest the absence of a global dynamo-generated lunar magnetic field for the past one billion years.
title_zh: 月球背面近零古地磁场表明月球全球发电机作用已终止
abstract_zh: 近期对Apollo和Chang'e返回样本的古地磁研究表明，月球发电机自约42亿年前（Ga）开始活动，并在约1.0 Ga前停止。然而，月球古地磁场的时间和空间分布仍存在不确定性，因为除Chang'e-6返回的样本外，几乎所有返回样本均来自月球正面。在此，我们首次对月球陨石Northwest Africa 15528进行古地磁分析，该陨石是一块长石质月壤角砾岩，可能来自月球背面。我们的结果不仅表明它在约0.7 Ga时记录到近零磁场（低于几百纳特斯拉），还表明月球陨石可提供关键的古地磁信息。结合来自月球正面的两个年轻Apollo样本——Apollo 15015（形成于约0.9 Ga）和Apollo 15465（形成于约0.5 Ga），我们的发现表明，在过去十亿年中不存在发电机产生的全球性月球磁场。

title: Electrical control of induced magnetism in an air-stable two-dimensional semiconductor
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Dilute magnetic semiconductors (DMSs) provide a platform for electrically controlling spin interactions; however, conventional systems face limited gate tunability and structural disorder. Here, we demonstrate gate-switchable magnetism in air-stable, dilute Fe-doped PtSe
                    2
                    , a two-dimensional (2D) DMS that remains structurally homogeneous down to the atomically thin limit. Bulk crystals exhibit ferromagnetism with a Curie temperature of 320 kelvin, and this coupling persists in metallic devices down to seven layers. As thickness and carrier concentration further decrease, the system transitions to antiferromagnetic order, with a gate-tunable Néel temperature reaching 105 kelvin in five-layer semiconducting devices. Our first-principles calculations reveal a carrier-density–dependent crossover from Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida–mediated ferromagnetism to superexchange-driven antiferromagnetism. These findings demonstrate how induced magnetic order evolves from bulk to the 2D limit, providing a pathway to functional spintronic devices with electrically controlled magnetic states.
title_zh: 空气中稳定二维半导体中感生磁性的电学调控
abstract_zh: 稀磁半导体（DMSs）为电学调控自旋相互作用提供了平台；然而，传统体系面临栅极可调性有限和结构无序的问题。在此，我们展示了在空气中稳定、稀Fe掺杂的PtSe2中的栅极可切换磁性，这是一种在原子级薄极限下仍保持结构均匀的二维（2D）DMS。块体晶体表现出居里温度为320开尔文的铁磁性，且这种耦合在低至七层的金属器件中仍然存在。随着厚度和载流子浓度进一步降低，该体系转变为反铁磁有序，其可栅极调控的奈尔温度在五层半导体器件中达到105开尔文。我们的第一性原理计算揭示了从Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida介导的铁磁性到超交换驱动的反铁磁性的载流子密度依赖性交叉。这些发现展示了诱导磁有序如何从块体演化至二维极限，为实现电学调控磁态的功能性自旋电子器件提供了途径。

title: A male-biased hypothalamic circuit modulates postmating sleep suppression in mice
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Many species display mating-related sleep suppression to maximize reproductive success, yet the underlying neural mechanisms in mammals remain unclear. Here, we report that male mice exhibit delayed sleep onset and reduced sleep duration in periods following successful mating, while females are unaffected. Single-cell transcriptomics identifies a group of sleep-promoting Rxfp1-expressing neurons in the preoptic area of hypothalamus (POA
                    Rxfp1
                    neurons), and fiber photometry reveals selective inhibition of them during and after mating in male mice. Lifting this inhibition via chemogenetic activation reverses sleep suppression in mated males. Monosynaptic retrograde tracing from these POA
                    Rxfp1
                    neurons identifies male-biased γ-aminobutyric acid–releasing inputs from the principal nucleus of the bed nucleus of the stria terminalis (BNSTpr). Notably, optogenetic activation of these neurons induces immediate wakefulness specifically in male mice, and BNSTpr → POA
                    Rxfp1
                    neurons are hyperactive after mating. Together, these findings establish a BNSTpr → POA
                    Rxfp1
                    circuit that integrates reproductive signals for male-specific sleep suppression in mice.
title_zh: 雄性偏向的下丘脑回路调节小鼠交配后睡眠抑制
abstract_zh: 许多物种表现出与交配相关的睡眠抑制以最大化繁殖成功率，然而其在哺乳动物中的潜在神经机制仍不清楚。在此，我们报告雄性小鼠在成功交配后的时间段表现出睡眠起始延迟和睡眠时长减少，而雌性小鼠不受影响。单细胞转录组学在下丘脑视前区识别出一群促进睡眠的表达Rxfp1的神经元（POA Rxfp1神经元），光纤光度法揭示雄性小鼠在交配期间和交配后这些神经元被选择性抑制。通过化学遗传学激活解除这种抑制可逆转交配后雄性小鼠的睡眠抑制。从这些POA Rxfp1神经元的单突触逆行追踪识别出来自终纹床核主核（BNSTpr）的雄性偏向的γ-氨基丁酸能输入。值得注意的是，光遗传学激活这些神经元 specifically 在雄性小鼠中诱导立即觉醒，且BNSTpr → POA Rxfp1神经元在交配后过度活跃。总之，这些发现确立了一条整合生殖信号以实现雄性特异性睡眠抑制的BNSTpr → POA Rxfp1神经回路。

title: Combinatorial action of regulatory systems generates colistin heteroresistance
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
The mechanism by which phenotypic heterogeneity is generated within a bacterial population and leads to colistin heteroresistance has been unclear. Heteroresistance is a form of antibiotic resistance in which a minor subpopulation of resistant cells coexists with a majority susceptible population. Colistin heteroresistance is common among
                    Enterobacter
                    isolates, threatens its utility as a therapeutic, and has become a model to study the fundamental bases of heteroresistance. Here, we identify the sigma factor σ
                    E
                    as the source of heterogeneity in colistin resistance. Single-cell tracking revealed that σ
                    E
                    is active in 1% of the population, and only those cells survive colistin exposure. However, σ
                    E
                    expression and heterogeneity were insufficient for survival, as a mutant lacking the PhoPQ system controlling lipid A modifications necessary for colistin resistance retained heterogeneity but lost resistance. These findings lead to a paradigm in heteroresistance; the combinatorial action of regulatory systems, encompassing a heterogeneity generator and a distinct resistance generator, gives rise to colistin heteroresistance.
title_zh: 调控系统的组合作用产生黏菌素异质性耐药
abstract_zh: 细菌群体内表型异质性如何产生并导致多黏菌素异质性耐药的机制一直不清楚。异质性耐药是抗生素耐药的一种形式，其中少数耐药细胞亚群与多数敏感细胞群共存。多黏菌素异质性耐药在肠杆菌属（Enterobacter）分离株中很常见，威胁其作为治疗药物的效用，并已成为研究异质性耐药基础的模式系统。在此，我们发现sigma因子σE是多黏菌素耐药异质性的来源。单细胞追踪显示σE在1%的群体中处于活跃状态，且只有这些细胞能在多黏菌素暴露后存活。然而，σE的表达和异质性不足以介导存活，因为缺失控制多黏菌素耐药所必需的脂质A修饰的PhoPQ系统的突变体仍保留异质性但失去耐药性。这些发现引出了异质性耐药的新范式：调控系统的组合作用——包括一个异质性产生器和一个独立的耐药产生器——共同导致了多黏菌素异质性耐药。

title: How do microplastics move through water and land? Earth scientists find ways to track their journey
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query

title: A newly established reverse genetic system for a circular RNA virus reveals new requirements for infection and its biocontrol potential
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Ambiviruses are fungal-infecting circular RNA viruses that uniquely combine viroid-like and viral features, yet the function of their conserved ORF-B protein and their effects on hosts remain unknown, hindered by the lack of a reverse genetics system. Here, we constructed the first infectious cDNA clone of an ambivirus, Fusarium graminearum ambivirus 1 (FgAV1), using a head-to-tail dimer placed downstream of a fungal promoter. FgAV1 was horizontally transmitted via hyphal anastomosis to virus-free
                    Fusarium graminearum
                    strains. Notably, a reverse-oriented dimer construct was also infectious and transmissible. Targeted mutagenesis revealed that both ORF-A- and ORF-B-encoded proteins and the presence of embedded ribozymes are indispensable for ambivirus replication. Our results further demonstrate that FgAV1 infection triggers a fungal RNAi response, extending the antiviral role of host sRNAs to circular RNA viruses. Furthermore, FgAV1 infection suppressed fungal growth and significantly reduced the virulence of
                    F. graminearum
                    on wheat. These findings provide novel insights into ambivirus replication and their potential in fungal pathogen biocontrol.
title_zh: 新建立的环状RNA病毒反向遗传系统揭示感染的新要求及其生物防治潜力
abstract_zh: 双义病毒（ambiviruses）是感染真菌的环状RNA病毒，独特地结合了类病毒和病毒的特征，然而其保守的ORF-B蛋白的功能及其对宿主的影响仍未知，这受到缺乏反向遗传学系统的阻碍。在此，我们利用置于真菌启动子下游的头尾相连二聚体构建了首个双义病毒——禾谷镰刀菌双义病毒1（Fusarium graminearum ambivirus 1, FgAV1）的感染性cDNA克隆。FgAV1通过菌丝融合水平传播至无病毒的禾谷镰刀菌（Fusarium graminearum）菌株。值得注意的是，反向取向的二聚体构建体同样具有感染性和可传播性。靶向诱变表明，ORF-A和ORF-B编码的蛋白以及嵌入核酶的存在对双义病毒复制均不可或缺。我们的结果进一步表明，FgAV1感染触发真菌RNAi反应，将宿主sRNAs的抗病毒作用扩展到环状RNA病毒。此外，FgAV1感染抑制真菌生长，并显著降低禾谷镰刀菌（F. graminearum）对小麦的毒力。这些发现为双义病毒的复制及其在真菌病原体生物防治中的潜力提供了新见解。

title: Activation of transposable elements is linked to a region- and cell type–specific interferon response in Parkinson’s disease
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Parkinson’s disease (PD) is a neurodegenerative disorder involving a neuroinflammatory response, the cause of which remains unclear. Transposable elements (TEs) have been linked to inflammation, but their potential role in PD remains unexplored. Using bulk- and single-nuclei RNA-seq of postmortem brain tissue from four brain regions, we studied TE transcription and its correlation with PD neuroinflammation. Over a thousand TEs, including LINE-1 s and ERVs, were expressed in a cell type– and region-specific manner in the human brain. Increased TE expression was found in microglia and neurons in the substantia nigra and putamen of PD brains, but not amygdala or prefrontal cortex, compared to controls. This TE activation correlated with an innate immune response in the same brain regions. The link between an interferon response and TE activation was mechanistically confirmed using human pluripotent stem cell–derived microglia and neurons. Our findings provide insights into TE transcription in the PD brain and suggest that TEs may contribute to neuroinflammation and pathological progression in PD.
title_zh: 转座元件的激活与帕金森病中区域和细胞类型特异性干扰素应答相关
abstract_zh: 帕金森病（PD）是一种涉及神经炎症反应的神经退行性疾病，其病因尚不清楚。转座元件（TEs）与炎症相关，但其在PD中的潜在作用仍未被探索。利用来自四个脑区的死后脑组织的批量RNA-seq和单核RNA-seq，我们研究了TE转录及其与PD神经炎症的关联。包括LINE-1和ERVs在内的上千种TE在人大脑中以细胞类型和区域特异性的方式表达。与对照组相比，PD大脑的黑质和壳核中TE表达升高，但杏仁核和前额叶皮层中未见此现象。这种TE激活与相同脑区的先天免疫应答相关。利用人多能干细胞来源的小胶质细胞和神经元，我们在机制上证实了干扰素应答与TE激活之间的联系。我们的发现为PD大脑中的TE转录提供了见解，并表明TE可能促进PD中的神经炎症和病理进展。

title: Intra-cluster receptor density (IRD): A molecular switch for TNFR1 clusters’ signaling
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Tumor necrosis factor receptor 1 (TNFR1) signaling regulates cell fate in inflammation, immune responses, and tumorigenesis. While TNF-α–mediated TNFR1 pathways are well known, the role of receptor clustering remains unclear. Utilizing homo-FRET using fluorescence anisotropy, we show that intra-cluster receptor density (IRD) governs TNFR1 signaling outcomes. Soluble TNF-α (sTNF-α) increases IRD at cluster cores but decreases it at rims via receptor reorganization. Reducing IRD through membrane tension, zafirlukast, actin depolymerization, or cholesterol depletion suppresses sTNF-α signaling, whereas increasing IRD by lowering membrane tension or exposing cells in a 3D gel-like microenvironment triggers ligand-independent activation. These findings reveal IRD as a key regulator of receptor signaling, with potential relevance across related receptor families and innovative strategies in modulating TNFR1 signaling.
title_zh: 簇内受体密度（IRD）：TNFR1簇信号传导的分子开关
abstract_zh: 肿瘤坏死因子受体1（TNFR1）信号传导调控炎症、免疫应答和肿瘤发生中的细胞命运。虽然TNF-α介导的TNFR1通路已广为人知，但受体聚集的作用仍不清楚。利用基于荧光各向异性的同型FRET，我们发现簇内受体密度（IRD）决定TNFR1信号传导结果。可溶性TNF-α（sTNF-α）通过受体重组增加簇核心处的IRD，但降低簇边缘处的IRD。通过膜张力、扎鲁司特、肌动蛋白解聚或胆固醇耗竭降低IRD可抑制sTNF-α信号传导，而通过降低膜张力或在3D凝胶样微环境中培养细胞来增加IRD可触发不依赖配体的激活。这些发现揭示了IRD是受体信号传导的关键调控因子，对相关受体家族具有潜在意义，并为调控TNFR1信号传导提供了创新策略。

title: Delayed submarine caldera subsidence creates extreme tsunami hazard
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
The 2022 Hunga volcano eruption generated one of the largest and most destructive volcanic tsunamis ever recorded. We interpret the timing, nature and relative hazard of volcanic-tsunamigenic processes by combining geophysical, oceanographic, atmospheric, and eye-witness observations of this event. Hydro-acoustic signal (
                    T
                    waves) detected on seismic stations up to 2600 km away provided a key to discerning tsunami triggers from explosions, volcanic mass flows, and caldera subsidence. The largest tsunami was generated by the first of at least two sudden caldera-subsidence events. This occurred 1 hour after globally detected explosions that produced smaller tsunami. Our results provide rare insights into the rates of caldera subsidence and highlight the complex multiple sources of tsunamis resulting from eruptions of oceanic volcanoes.
title_zh: 海底破火山口延迟沉降造成极端海啸灾害
abstract_zh: 2022年洪加火山喷发产生了有记录以来规模最大、破坏性最强的火山海啸之一。我们结合该事件的地球物理、海洋学、大气和目击观测，解释了火山致海啸过程的时间、性质和相对危害。在距震源2600公里范围内的地震台站上探测到的水声信号（T波）为区分爆炸、火山物质流和火山口沉降等海啸触发因素提供了关键依据。最大的海啸由至少两次突然的火山口沉降事件中的第一次引发。这发生在全球探测到的爆炸（其产生了较小海啸）之后1小时。我们的结果为火山口沉降速率提供了罕见的见解，并强调了海洋火山喷发所导致的海啸的复杂多源性。

title: Defective EV-mediated transport of SHH alters neural fate specification in EPM1 epilepsy
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
The extracellular milieu, including extracellular vesicles (EVs), plays a pivotal role in brain development. In this study, we sought to elucidate the pathogenesis of progressive myoclonus epilepsy type 1 (EPM1), a disease caused by mutations in the
                    CSTB
                    gene, using cerebral organoids (COs) derived from patient cells. The results demonstrate that EPM1 COs display increased electrophysiological activity and disrupted excitatory/inhibitory (E/I) balance. Single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of ventral EPM1-COs revealed an abnormal specification of progenitor fate, with a shift toward dorsal neuron identities. We demonstrated that this misspecification is driven by a functional alteration of the ventral signaling niche, resulting from impaired EV dynamics and altered protein cargo. Mechanistically, we identified Sonic Hedgehog (SHH) as a direct physical interactor of CSTB and demonstrated that CSTB deficiency leads to reduced SHH content and secretion. Our findings establish CSTB as a safeguard of ventral patterning and identify the CSTB-SHH-EV axis as a potential therapeutic target for mitigating the E/I imbalance associated with EPM1.
title_zh: EV介导的SHH转运缺陷改变EPM1癫痫中的神经命运特化
abstract_zh: 细胞外微环境（包括细胞外囊泡EVs）在脑发育中发挥关键作用。在本研究中，我们试图利用源自患者细胞的脑类器官（COs）阐明进行性肌阵挛癫痫1型（EPM1）的发病机制，该疾病由CSTB基因突变引起。结果表明，EPM1 COs表现出电生理活动增强以及兴奋/抑制（E/I）平衡被破坏。对腹侧EPM1-COs的单细胞RNA测序分析揭示了祖细胞命运特化的异常，并向背侧神经元身份转变。我们证明这种错误特化是由腹侧信号生态位的功能改变所驱动，而后者源于EV动力学受损和蛋白质货物改变。在机制上，我们鉴定出Sonic Hedgehog（SHH）是CSTB的直接物理相互作用蛋白，并证明CSTB缺失导致SHH含量和分泌减少。我们的发现确立了CSTB作为腹侧模式化的守护者，并将CSTB-SHH-EV轴确定为缓解EPM1相关E/I失衡的潜在治疗靶点。

title: Sea nettle jellyfish venom targets proteoglycans to cause cell death and pain
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Sea nettle jellyfish cause millions of painful stings annually with little known about how their venom works and no rational treatments available. Here, we perform a systematic analysis of sea nettle venom/host interactions. The venom shows dose-dependent cytotoxic activity in human cells, and this can be blocked by dual inhibition of apoptosis and necroptosis. Using whole-genome CRISPR screening, we identified human genes and pathways that modify venom action. The top gene cluster identified regulates proteoglycan biosynthesis. We show that exogenous heparin, a drug used clinically as an anticoagulant, blocks venom cytotoxicity at a physiologically relevant dose. This effect was therapeutic, inhibiting venom even 1 hour after exposure. In vivo, heparin protected against acute spontaneous pain, thermal hyperalgesia, and mechanical allodynia induced by venom. This provides the exciting possibility of repurposing heparin, a safe, commercially available drug, as a prophylactic or therapeutic to reduce the impact of sea nettle stings.
title_zh: 海荨麻水母毒液靶向蛋白聚糖引发细胞死亡和疼痛
abstract_zh: 海荨麻水母每年造成数百万次疼痛性蜇伤，但其毒液的作用机制知之甚少，也没有合理的治疗方法。在此，我们对海荨麻毒液/宿主相互作用进行了系统分析。毒液在人细胞中表现出剂量依赖性的细胞毒性，这可以通过同时抑制凋亡和坏死性凋亡来阻断。利用全基因组CRISPR筛选，我们鉴定了改变毒液作用的人类基因和通路。鉴定出的最主要的基因簇调控蛋白聚糖的生物合成。我们发现外源性肝素（一种临床用作抗凝剂的药物）在生理相关剂量下可阻断毒液的细胞毒性。该效应具有治疗作用，即使在暴露后1小时仍能抑制毒液。在体内，肝素可保护机体免受毒液诱导的急性自发性疼痛、热痛过敏和机械性异常疼痛。这为重新利用肝素这一安全、市售的药物作为预防或治疗手段以减轻海荨麻蜇伤的影响提供了令人兴奋的可能性。

title: From leaf veins to bus lanes: Emerging simplicity in complex spatial systems
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
