title: Cell body position of Drosophila Moonwalker Descending Neurons regulates locomotor circuit function
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
Both mammalian and invertebrate nervous systems contain densely packed neuronal cell bodies in stereotyped locations, which express cell surface molecules and gap junction proteins. An open question that has rarely been addressed is: What role does cell body position play in neuronal circuit function? Here we show that the four adult
                    Drosophila
                    Moonwalker Descending Neurons (MDNs), command neurons for backward locomotion, must maintain cell body contact to initiate backward walking. MDNs express the transcription factor Hunchback, which drives expression of the cell adhesion molecule Lar. Hunchback, Lar, and its ligand Dlp, promote MDN cell body clustering, which blocks initiation of backward walking. When the cell bodies are clustered, electrical synapses form between MDN cell bodies. The gap junction protein Innexin 8 (also known as Shaking B) maintains a more depolarized resting membrane potential and allows synchronous firing of MDNs. Together, these electrophysiological properties are necessary to initiate backward walking. These findings reveal a previously unappreciated role for cell body location, and the properties it mediates, in neural circuit function.
title_zh: 果蝇Moonwalker下行神经元的胞体位置调控运动神经回路功能
abstract_zh: 哺乳动物和无脊椎动物神经系统都包含位于定型位置的密集神经元细胞体，这些细胞体表达细胞表面分子和间隙连接蛋白。一个鲜有探讨的悬而未决的问题是：细胞体位置在神经环路功能中发挥什么作用？在此我们表明，果蝇成体的四个Moonwalker下行神经元（MDN）——后退运动的指令神经元——必须维持细胞体之间的接触才能启动后退行走。MDN表达转录因子Hunchback，后者驱动细胞黏附分子Lar的表达。Hunchback、Lar及其配体Dlp促进MDN细胞体聚集成簇，从而阻断后退行走的启动。当细胞体聚集成簇时，MDN细胞体之间会形成电突触。间隙连接蛋白Innexin 8（又称Shaking B）维持更去极化的静息膜电位，并使MDN能够同步放电。这些电生理特性共同是启动后退行走所必需的。这些发现揭示了细胞体位置及其介导的特性在神经环路功能中一个此前未被认识的作用。

title: Lenacapavir allosterically remodels the HIV-1 capsid
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Lenacapavir (LEN) is a highly potent, long-acting capsid inhibitor that holds exceptional promise for treatment and prevention of HIV-1 infection. LEN causes the mature viral capsid to rupture and lose integrity, but the underlying mechanism has been unclear. Here, we show that LEN is an allosteric modulator of HIV-1 capsid structure that fractures the capsid’s fullerene cone architecture in two steps: initially by rupturing at high-curvature declinations, followed by fissuring of the capsid body. At the molecular level, LEN alters the noncovalent bonding interactions between capsid subunits and reduces local lattice curvature. We propose a stress-strain model to rationalize how LEN remodels HIV-1 capsid structure and thereby impairs the replication capacity of the virus.
title_zh: Lenacapavir变构重塑HIV-1衣壳
abstract_zh: 来那卡帕韦（LEN）是一种高效、长效的衣壳抑制剂，在HIV-1感染的治疗和预防方面具有 exceptional 的前景。LEN会导致成熟病毒衣壳破裂并失去完整性，但其潜在机制一直不明。在本研究中，我们表明LEN是HIV-1衣壳结构的变构调节剂，分两步破坏衣壳的富勒烯锥结构：首先在高曲率棱角处破裂，随后衣壳主体发生裂开。在分子层面，LEN改变了衣壳亚基之间的非共价键相互作用，并降低了局部晶格曲率。我们提出了一种应力-应变模型，以合理解释LEN如何重塑HIV-1衣壳结构，从而损害病毒的复制能力。

title: Mechanical cues of an interpenetrating polysaccharide matrix regulate self-assembly of collagen fibers
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Collagen molecules self-assemble into supramolecular fibers within a molecularly crowded, polysaccharide-rich extracellular matrix (ECM) that has fluid-like, viscoelastic properties. Here, we determine that the viscoelasticity of alginate networks regulates the assembly of type I collagen fibers. The viscoelasticity and shear moduli of the alginate network were tuned by the polymer weight percentage and degree of cooperative ionic and covalent norbornene-tetrazine cross-linking. Stepwise shear strain applied to covalently cross-linked hydrogels generated higher stress than in ionic hydrogels. Hydrogels with reduced viscoelasticity also showed reduced water permeability. Second-harmonic generation confocal imaging revealed that decreasing viscoelasticity significantly suppressed collagen fiber self-assembly. Simulations demonstrated mechanical coupling between the hydrogel network and the aggregate size of collagen molecules, which was consistent with experimental results showing impaired rate and magnitude of self-assembly in covalently cross-linked networks. These results provide a framework for understanding how ECM mechanical properties can influence the assembly and organization of fibrillar macromolecules.
title_zh: 互穿多糖基质的机械信号调控胶原纤维的自组装
abstract_zh: 胶原蛋白分子在分子拥挤、富含多糖且具有流体样黏弹性的细胞外基质（ECM）中自组装成超分子纤维。在本研究中，我们证实海藻酸盐网络的黏弹性可调控I型胶原纤维的组装。通过聚合物重量百分比以及离子与共价降冰片烯-四嗪协同交联的程度，可调节海藻酸盐网络的黏弹性和剪切模量。对共价交联水凝胶施加阶跃剪切应变所产生的应力高于离子交联水凝胶。黏弹性降低的水凝胶还表现出较低的水渗透性。二次谐波生成共聚焦成像显示，黏弹性的降低显著抑制了胶原纤维的自组装。模拟结果表明，水凝胶网络与胶原蛋白分子聚集体尺寸之间存在机械耦合，这与共价交联网络中自组装速率和幅度受损的实验结果一致。这些结果为理解ECM机械特性如何影响纤维状大分子的组装与组织提供了框架。

title: A salivary protein NlSP2 engages the OsCBSX3–SNAC3 module to enhance rice immunity
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
The molecular dialogue between rice and the brown planthopper (BPH;
                    Nilaparvata lugens
                    ) is mediated by insect salivary effectors, yet the molecular mechanisms underlying plant perception and immune activation remain largely unclear. Here, we characterized the BPH salivary protein NlSP2, which is secreted into rice tissues during feeding. Silencing of
                    NlSP2
                    in BPH impairs salivary sheath formation, feeding ability, and survival, whereas its ectopic expression in rice enhances resistance to BPH via MAPK activation, H
                    2
                    O
                    2
                    accumulation, and induction of defense-related genes. We identify the rice cystathionine β-synthase domain–containing protein OsCBSX3 as a direct intracellular target of NlSP2. Genetic analyses establish OsCBSX3 as a positive regulator of BPH resistance and an essential component of NlSP2-triggered immunity. NlSP2 binding promotes OsCBSX3 nuclear accumulation. In the nucleus, OsCBSX3 interacts with the NAC transcription factor SNAC3; NlSP2 enhances this interaction and potentiates SNAC3-mediated transcriptional activation of defense genes. Loss of
                    SNAC3
                    compromises rice resistance to BPH. Together, our results elucidate a complete signaling pathway linking insect effector perception to defense gene activation and highlight the OsCBSX3–SNAC3 module as a key regulator of rice immunity, providing insights into plant–insect interactions and potential targets for breeding resistant crops.
title_zh: 唾液蛋白NlSP2通过OsCBSX3–SNAC3模块增强水稻免疫
abstract_zh: 水稻与褐飞虱之间的分子对话由昆虫唾液效应子介导，但植物感知与免疫激活的分子机制仍 largely 不清楚。在此，我们鉴定了褐飞虱唾液蛋白NlSP2，该蛋白在取食过程中被分泌到水稻组织中。在褐飞虱中沉默NlSP2会损害唾液鞘形成、取食能力和存活率，而其在水稻中的异位表达则通过MAPK激活、H2O2积累及防御相关基因的诱导增强对褐飞虱的抗性。我们发现含有胱硫醚β-合酶结构域的水稻蛋白OsCBSX3是NlSP2的直接胞内靶标。遗传分析表明OsCBSX3是褐飞虱抗性的正调控因子，也是NlSP2触发免疫的必需组分。NlSP2的结合促进OsCBSX3在细胞核中的积累。在细胞核中，OsCBSX3与NAC转录因子SNAC3相互作用；NlSP2增强这一相互作用，并增强SNAC3介导的防御基因转录激活。SNAC3的功能丧失会削弱水稻对褐飞虱的抗性。总之，我们的结果阐明了从昆虫效应子感知到防御基因激活的完整信号通路，并强调OsCBSX3–SNAC3模块是水稻免疫的关键调控因子，为植物-昆虫相互作用研究及潜在靶标提供了见解

title: Shallow creep and confined ruptures in frictionally unstable mica schist
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Crustal faults across geological settings are often enriched in phyllosilicates because of the hydrothermal alteration of wall rocks. The frictional behavior of these altered rocks at mid-crustal conditions remains poorly understood. Here, we show that mica-schist gouge under crustal hydrothermal conditions can host mixed behavior promoting shallow aseismic creep and confined seismic ruptures. We conduct triaxial deformation experiments on natural samples from the East Anatolian Fault, Turkey, and simulate the resulting dynamics on the Pütürge segment during seismic cycles using a physical model of rock friction and a realistic thermal structure. Mica schist exhibits potentially unstable weakening between 300° and 400°C, promoting depth-confined earthquakes. The frictional properties of mica schist are compatible with the 2020 moment magnitude (
                    M
                    w
                    ) 6.8 Elazığ earthquake and the northern rupture arrest of the 2023
                    M
                    w
                    7.8 Kahramanmaraş event, illustrating how the thermal and lithological structure affects rupture style and segmentation.
title_zh: 摩擦不稳定的云母片岩中的浅层蠕滑与受限破裂
abstract_zh: 由于围岩的热液蚀变，各种地质环境中的地壳断层往往富含层状硅酸盐矿物。这些蚀变岩石在中地壳条件下的摩擦行为仍知之甚少。在本研究中，我们展示了在地壳热液条件下，云母片岩断层泥可以表现出混合行为，促进浅部无震蠕滑和受限的地震破裂。我们对来自土耳其东安纳托利亚断层的天然样品进行了三轴变形实验，并利用岩石摩擦物理模型和真实的热结构，模拟了Pütürge段在地震周期中的动力学过程。云母片岩在300°C至400°C之间表现出潜在的不稳定弱化，促进深度受限的地震。云母片岩的摩擦性质与2020年矩震级（Mw）6.8的Elazığ地震以及2023年Mw 7.8 Kahramanmaraş事件的北向破裂终止相吻合，说明了热结构和岩性结构如何影响破裂方式和分段。

title: Three thousand five hundred years of sheeppox virus evolution inferred from archaeological and codicological genomes
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Sheeppox virus (SPPV) is a major livestock pathogen causing economic hardship through reduced production and death of vulnerable sheep, with written descriptions of sheeppox-like disease recorded since antiquity. We report 21 novel ancient SPPV genomes spanning the Eurasian steppe Bronze Age (∼1700 BCE) to the Early Modern period in Western Europe, including multiple genomes obtained from medieval parchment. We estimate that major capripoxvirus lineages diverged ∼11,500 to 3700 years ago, overlapping known translocations and bio-cultural developments in sheep. Our dataset supports SPPV diverging first within the lineage leading to goatpox virus and lumpy skin disease virus, and that known gene inactivation events within SPPV and goatpox virus occur in our earliest SPPV genomes. These findings reveal that the food security of Eurasian communities has been threatened by sheeppox for more than 3700 years and provide insights into the genomic evolution and potential host adaptation of SPPV.
title_zh: 从考古与古文书学基因组推断绵羊痘病毒三千五百年的演化
abstract_zh: 羊痘病毒（SPPV）是一种重要的家畜病原体，通过降低产量和导致易感绵羊死亡而造成经济损失，关于类羊痘疾病的文字记载可追溯至古代。我们报告了21个新的古代SPPV基因组，时间跨度从欧亚草原青铜时代（约公元前1700年）到西欧近代早期，其中包括从羊皮纸中获得的多个基因组。我们估计主要羊痘病毒属谱系在约11500年至3700年前分化，与已知的绵羊迁徙和生物文化发展相吻合。我们的数据集支持SPPV在导致山羊痘病毒和结节性皮肤病病毒的谱系中最先分化，并且已知的SPPV和山羊痘病毒内的基因失活事件出现在我们最古老的SPPV基因组中。这些发现揭示了欧亚社会的粮食安全3700多年来一直受到羊痘的威胁，并为SPPV的基因组演化和潜在的宿主适应性提供了见解。

title: The actomyosin cortex controls t-tubule remodeling in skeletal muscle
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: A network of plasma membrane invaginations called t-tubules plays an essential role in controlling calcium release from the endoplasmic reticulum at the triads during muscle contraction. Although the importance of t-tubules for muscle physiology is well established, and abnormalities are found in muscle disorders, the mechanisms that mediate t-tubule growth are unknown. We show that the actomyosin cortex beneath the plasma membrane, regulated by Arp2/3 complexes containing Arpc5, acts as a gatekeeper for the membrane availability during t-tubule growth. Enlarged t-tubules are formed upon disruption of Arpc5, impairing the synchronization between plasma membrane depolarization and calcium release. Knockout of Arpc5 in mouse skeletal muscle results in impaired locomotion and posture. Furthermore, we show that human triadopathy patients and Arpc5 knockout mice accumulate enlarged t-tubules. We propose that cortex-dependent membrane availability affects muscle function, offering a potential pathophysiological mechanism for muscle disorders.
title_zh: 肌动蛋白-肌球蛋白皮层控制骨骼肌中t-小管的重塑
abstract_zh: 称为t-小管的质膜内陷网络在肌肉收缩过程中对控制三联体处内质网的钙释放起着至关重要的作用。尽管t-小管对肌肉生理的重要性已经确立，且在肌肉疾病中发现了其异常，但介导t-小管生长的机制仍不清楚。我们表明，质膜下由含Arpc5的Arp2/3复合体调控的肌动蛋白-肌球蛋白皮层，在t-小管生长过程中充当膜可用性的守门者。Arpc5被破坏后形成扩大的t-小管，损害了质膜去极化与钙释放之间的同步。在小鼠骨骼肌中敲除Arpc5会导致运动和姿势受损。此外，我们发现人类三联体病患者和Arpc5敲除小鼠积累了扩大的t-小管。我们提出，依赖于皮层的膜可用性影响肌肉功能，为肌肉疾病提供了一种潜在的病理生理机制。

title: Sequential clearance of neutrophil extracellular traps for precision therapy of sepsis
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Sepsis, a life-threatening syndrome driven by dysregulated host response to infection, is critically exacerbated by the uncontrolled formation of neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs), which amplify inflammation, promote microthrombosis, and precipitate multiple organ dysfunction. However, current therapeutic approaches remain inadequate in effectively targeting and modulating NETs, leaving a significant clinical gap in managing sepsis progression. Herein, we propose a “sequential NETs-clearance” strategy to precisely mitigate NET-associated pathologies by simultaneously inhibiting NET overproduction and facilitating their targeted capture and degradation. We engineered a multifunctional metal-organic framework (MOF818) with intrinsic antioxidant activity, functionalized with a NETs-capturing poly(amidoamine) dendrimer and loaded with a NETs-degrading enzyme, micrococcal nuclease (MNase). This integrated platform efficiently scavenges excessive reactive oxygen species (ROS) to inhibit NETosis, while simultaneously capturing existing NETs via electrostatic interactions and enzymatically cleaving their DNA scaffold, thereby disrupting the self-sustaining inflammatory cascade. In vitro, this combinatorial treatment markedly reduced NET-mediated inflammatory responses, while treatment in murine models of sepsis significantly mitigated systemic cytokine storms, alleviated organ damage, and improved survival in septic mice. Importantly, this therapeutic efficacy was corroborated in ex vivo human specimens, where the nanocomposite significantly suppressed NETosis and reduced inflammatory cytokines in neutrophils and plasma derived from sepsis patients. This work establishes a versatile nanotherapeutic paradigm for multi-target modulation of NETs and oxidative stress, offering a promising translational avenue for the precise treatment of sepsis.
title_zh: 序贯清除中性粒细胞胞外陷阱用于脓毒症的精准治疗
abstract_zh: 脓毒症是一种由宿主对感染的反应失调驱动的危及生命的综合征，中性粒细胞胞外诱捕网（NETs）的失控形成会严重加剧病情，NETs会放大炎症、促进微血栓形成并诱发多器官功能障碍。然而，目前的治疗方法在有效靶向和调节NETs方面仍然不足，在管理脓毒症进展方面留下了显著的临床空白。在此，我们提出一种“序贯清除NETs”策略，通过同时抑制NETs的过度产生并促进其靶向捕获和降解，精确缓解NETs相关病理。我们设计了一种具有内在抗氧化活性的多功能金属有机框架（MOF818），用捕获NETs的聚（酰胺胺）树枝状大分子进行功能化修饰，并负载降解NETs的酶——微球菌核酸酶（MNase）。该集成平台可高效清除过量活性氧（ROS）以抑制NETosis，同时通过静电相互作用捕获现有NETs并酶切其DNA支架，从而破坏自我维持的炎症级联反应。体外实验中，这种联合治疗显著减少了NET介导的炎症反应；在脓毒症小鼠模型中的治疗显著缓解了全身细胞因子风暴，减轻了器官损伤，并提高了脓毒症小鼠的存活率。重要的是，这种治疗效果在离体人体标本中得到证实，纳米复合材料在标本中显著抑制了NETosis并减少了炎

title: Observation of the quantum phase of free fall and the consistency with the equivalence principle
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: The unification of quantum theory and the general theory of relativity, describing gravity, is one of the most important challenges in science. Einstein’s general theory of relativity is based on the principle of equivalence and has been confirmed to great accuracy for large bodies. However, in the quantum domain, the equivalence principle has been predicted to take a unique form involving a gauge phase, which is equal, in the context of a measurement on Earth, to the quantum phase of a free-falling wave packet relative to its counterpart wave packet which is static in Earth’s frame. To measure this phase, we realize a novel cold-atom interferometer in which one wave packet stays static in the laboratory frame while the other is in free fall. The observed relative phase of the wave packets confirms the predicted phase and shows that, in our low energy regime, the equivalence principle may be applied to the quantum domain. Our observation constitutes a fundamental test of the interface between quantum theory and gravity. The new interferometer also opens the door for further probing of the latter interface, as well as to searches for new physics.
title_zh: 自由落体量子相位的观测及其与等效原理的一致性
abstract_zh: 量子理论与描述引力的广义相对论的统一，是科学界最重要的挑战之一。爱因斯坦的广义相对论建立在等效原理的基础上，并已在大质量物体上得到高精度的证实。然而，在量子领域，等效原理被预言采取一种涉及规范相位的独特形式，在地球上的测量语境下，该规范相等于自由下落波包相对于静止于地球参考系的对应波包的量子相位。为了测量这一相位，我们实现了一种新颖的冷原子干涉仪，其中一个波包在实验室参考系中保持静止，而另一个处于自由落体状态。观测到的波包相对相位证实了预言的相位，并表明在我们的低能区间内，等效原理可应用于量子领域。我们的观测构成了对量子理论与引力之间界面的基础性检验。这种新干涉仪也为进一步探究该界面以及寻找新物理学打开了大门。

title: Functional mapping and engineering of the Sec translocon unlocked by a cell-free system
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Almost all membrane proteins are inserted or translocated across membranes by the universally conserved Sec translocon. Despite its central role, experimental access to Sec function has remained limited. Here, we present ProSecCO (Protein Secretion in Cell-free via synthetic Operons), which is a cell-free protein synthesis platform that inserts SecYEG into synthetic vesicles, enabling direct testing of Sec in real-time and high-throughput, circumventing longstanding viability constraints. Screening 300 Sec variants in a single experiment, we consolidate three decades of Sec research, while vastly expanding mutant diversity for structure-function insights. Mapping over 30 functionally critical regions that modulate Sec activity across three orders of magnitude, we uncover dozens of super-active translocation variants and one variant of improved insertion activity. We further leverage ProSecCO to increase membrane protein quality and nanobody export, highlighting the potential of our system for advancing applications in synthetic biology and biotechnology.
title_zh: 利用无细胞系统解锁Sec易位子的功能图谱与工程化改造
abstract_zh: 几乎所有膜蛋白都由普遍保守的Sec易位子插入或易位穿过膜。尽管Sec易位子发挥着核心作用，但对其功能的实验研究一直受限。在此，我们提出ProSecCO（通过合成操纵子进行无细胞蛋白质分泌），这是一个将SecYEG插入合成囊泡的无细胞蛋白质合成平台，可绕过长期存在的生存能力限制，实现对Sec的实时、高通量直接测试。在单次实验中对300种Sec变体进行筛选，我们整合了三十年的Sec研究成果，同时大幅扩展了变体多样性以获得结构-功能层面的认识。我们绘制了30多个在三个数量级上调节Sec活性的功能关键区域，发现了数十种超活性易位变体以及一种插入活性改善的变体。我们进一步利用ProSecCO提高膜蛋白质量和纳米抗体输出，凸显了该系统在推进合成生物学与生物技术应用方面的潜力。

title: Digital twins are funhouse mirrors: Five systematic distortions
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Scientists and practitioners are aggressively moving to deploy digital twins—large language model (LLM)-based models of individuals—across social science and policy research. We conducted 19 preregistered studies with 164 diverse outcomes (e.g., attitudes toward hiring algorithms and intention to share misinformation) and compared human responses with those of their digital twins (trained on each person’s previous answers to more than 500 questions). We establish an empirical benchmark for digital twin performance: Digital twins’ answers are only modestly more accurate than those from the (homogeneous) base LLM and correlate weakly with human responses (average correlation coefficient of 0.20). To guide future development, we document five ways in which digital twins distort human behavior: (i) insufficient individuation, (ii) stereotyping, (iii) representation bias, (iv) ideological biases, and (v) hyper-rationality. We make our full dataset and code public as a standardized testbed. Our results caution against premature deployment while laying the groundwork for the transparent, replicable, and iterative science necessary for responsible deployment of digital twins.
title_zh: 数字孪生是哈哈镜：五种系统性失真
abstract_zh: 科学家和从业者正积极推动在社会科学和政策研究领域部署数字孪生——基于大语言模型（LLM）的个体模型。我们开展了19项预注册研究，涵盖164种多样化结果（例如对招聘算法的态度和分享错误信息的意图），并将人类回答与其数字孪生（基于每个人此前对500多个问题的回答训练而成）的回答进行比较。我们建立了数字孪生性能的实证基准：数字孪生的答案仅比（同质的）基础LLM略为准确，且与人类回答的相关性较弱（平均相关系数为0.20）。为指导未来开发，我们记录了数字孪生扭曲人类行为的五种方式：(i)个体化不足，(ii)刻板印象，(iii)代表性偏差，(iv)意识形态偏差，以及(v)过度理性。我们将完整数据集和代码公开作为标准化测试平台。我们的结果警示应避免过早部署，同时为负责任地部署数字孪生所需的透明、可重复和迭代科学奠定了基础。

title: AKT5 is a bona fide potassium channel and controls petiole growth in Arabidopsis
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Potassium ion (K
                    +
                    ) is essential for plant growth and development. Despite decades of study, the
                    Shaker
                    -type K
                    +
                    channel AKT5 has remained functionally unassigned. Here, we report that AKT5 functions as a bona fide voltage-dependent K
                    +
                    channel and serves as an essential regulator of petiole elongation. Structural analyses of AKT5 in a closed state and the AKT5-D403 variant in a pre-open state provide direct structural evidence for functional K
                    +
                    channel activity. AKT5 assembled into a canonical tetramer with two-fold symmetry and, upon phosphorylation, operated as an inward-rectifying K
                    +
                    channel activated at strongly hyperpolarized membrane potentials. AKT5 was predominantly expressed in young petioles, and loss of AKT5 function largely suppressed petiole elongation throughout the diurnal cycle, resulting in compact rosettes and reduced biomass under crowded growth conditions. These findings show that AKT5 is involved in a regulator of plant competitive growth and high-density performance.
title_zh: AKT5是一个真正的钾通道并调控拟南芥叶柄生长
abstract_zh: 钾离子（K+）对植物的生长发育至关重要。尽管经过数十年的研究，Shaker型K+通道AKT5的功能一直未被确定。在此，我们报道AKT5作为一种真正的电压依赖性K+通道发挥作用，并是叶柄伸长的重要调控因子。对处于关闭状态的AKT5及处于预开放状态的AKT5-D403变体的结构分析为K+通道的功能活性提供了直接的结构证据。AKT5组装成具有二次对称性的典型四聚体，并在磷酸化后作为在强烈超极化膜电位下激活的内向整流K+通道运行。AKT5主要在幼嫩叶柄中表达，AKT5功能的丧失在整个昼夜周期中显著抑制叶柄伸长，导致莲座叶丛紧凑并在拥挤生长条件下生物量降低。这些发现表明，AKT5参与调控植物的竞争性生长和高密度条件下的表现。

title: Hillslope memory of sequential earthquakes
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Large earthquakes can trigger landslides that reshape mountain landscapes within minutes, yet their geomorphic legacy can unfold over millennia. A fundamental question is whether a major earthquake leaves hillslopes in a less or more stable state for the next. Here we exploit two sequential earthquakes (2013 and 2022) at close to the same location near Lushan, China, to quantify how the first event preconditions hillslope failure during the second. The 2013 earthquake produced a dual effect: Regional susceptibility declined as unstable material was removed, yet localized coseismic damage weakened a different population of hillslopes that later failed in 2022. These opposing outcomes generate three damage-recovery pathways of hillslope response that define how mass is redistributed and mechanical strength reorganizes according to a prolonged “hillslope memory” with implications for the landscape evolution of mountain belts. Hillslope response to sequential earthquakes is fundamentally path dependent, demanding landslide hazard assessments that explicitly incorporate history.
title_zh: 坡体对序列地震的记忆
abstract_zh: 大地震可在几分钟内触发滑坡并重塑山地景观，但其地貌学遗产可在数千年间展开。一个基本问题是，一次大地震会使边坡处于对下一次地震更不稳定还是更稳定的状态。在此，我们利用中国芦山附近几乎同一地点发生的两次连续地震（2013年和2022年），量化第一次事件如何在第二次事件期间预置边坡失稳。2013年地震产生了双重效应：随着不稳定物质被移除，区域易发性下降，但局部同震损伤削弱了另一群边坡，使其随后在2022年失稳。这些相反的结果产生了三种边坡响应的损伤-恢复路径，界定了质量如何重新分布以及机械强度如何按照持续的“边坡记忆”重新组织，对山带的景观演化具有重要意义。边坡对连续地震的响应具有根本的路径依赖性，要求滑坡灾害评估明确纳入历史信息。

title: Light-tunable charge dynamics enable ultralow-power bidirectional lead-free perovskite synapses for intelligent vision
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Advanced vision systems for autonomous robotics require high efficiency, ultralow power consumption, and real-time decision-making. However, conventional vision sensors that rely on single-mode optical excitation fundamentally constrain their versatility. Here, we report a fully light-tunable optoelectronic synaptic device based on perovskite PEA
                    2
                    SnI
                    4
                    /C
                    60
                    heterostructures that uniquely supports dual-mode bidirectional synaptic behaviour with potentiation under visible light and depression under near-infrared illumination, enabled by a synergistic mechanism of sub-bandgap absorption and interfacial carrier trapping-detrapping for wavelength-selective control. The heterostructure device features long-lasting synaptic plasticity, with excitatory and inhibitory retention times of 350 s and over 8000 s, respectively, and an ultralow energy consumption of ∼1 fJ per event. These exceptional characteristics enable unprecedented performance in neuromorphic vision tasks, including attention-enhanced traffic sign recognition, physical reservoir computing, and dynamic target detection using a 7 × 7 array device, which establishes a powerful and energy-efficient platform for next-generation robotic eyes and advances all-optical neuromorphic perceptions toward intelligent autonomy.
title_zh: 光可调电荷动力学实现用于智能视觉的超低功耗双向无铅钙钛矿突触
abstract_zh: 面向自主机器人的先进视觉系统需要高效率、超低功耗和实时决策能力。然而，依赖单一模式光激发的传统视觉传感器从根本上限制了其多功能性。在此，我们报道了一种基于钙钛矿PEA2SnI4/C60异质结构的全光可调光电突触器件，其独特地支持双模式双向突触行为：可见光下增强、近红外光照下抑制，这得益于亚带隙吸收与界面载流子捕获-去捕获的协同机制，实现了波长选择性控制。该异质结构器件具有持久的突触可塑性，兴奋性和抑制性保持时间分别为350 s和超过8000 s，且每次事件的能耗超低，约为1 fJ。这些卓越特性在神经形态视觉任务中实现了前所未有的性能，包括注意力增强的交通标志识别、物理储备池计算，以及使用7×7阵列器件的动态目标检测，这为下一代机器视觉建立了一个强大且节能的平台，并推动全光神经形态感知走向智能自主。

title: Bifidobacterium animalis subsp. lactis V9 overcomes CYFRA 21-1–linked immunochemotherapy resistance in NSCLC via microbial metabolites
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Gut dysbiosis drives therapeutic resistance, yet the relationships among typical tumor markers, gut microbiota, and treatment efficacy remain poorly defined. Here, elevated serum CYFRA 21-1 in advanced non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) correlates with gut dysbiosis, including
                    Bifidobacterium animalis
                    depletion and reduced immunomodulatory metabolites. Fecal supernatant from patients with high-CYFRA attenuated immunochemotherapy efficacy in tumor-bearing mice, linked to disrupted tryptophan and phenylalanine metabolism. Adjuvant
                    B. animalis
                    subsp.
                    lactis
                    V9 enhanced tumor control and antitumor immunity, coinciding with elevated quinaldic acid and catechol, metabolites associated with caspase-dependent apoptosis and ferroptosis. Cell-free fecal supernatant transferred antitumor effects, independent of bacterial colonization. In a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled pilot trial (
                    n
                     = 30), adjunctive
                    B. lactis
                    V9 associated with a higher objective response rate (47% versus 33%), disease control rate (87% versus 67%), and prolonged progression-free survival in responders, who exhibited enriched
                    B. animalis
                    and elevated quinaldic acid/catechol (area under the curve = 0.73/0.82). These findings suggest CYFRA 21-1 may identify a modifiable, microbiome-linked state of treatment resistance.
title_zh: 动物双歧杆菌乳亚种V9通过微生物代谢产物克服NSCLC中CYFRA 21-1相关的免疫化疗耐药性
abstract_zh: 肠道菌群失调会导致治疗耐药，然而典型肿瘤标志物、肠道菌群与治疗效果之间的关系仍不明确。本研究发现，晚期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者血清CYFRA 21-1升高与肠道菌群失调相关，包括动物双歧杆菌（Bifidobacterium animalis）减少及免疫调节代谢物降低。高CYFRA患者的粪便上清可削弱荷瘤小鼠的免疫化疗疗效，这与色氨酸和苯丙氨酸代谢紊乱有关。辅助给予B. animalis subsp. lactis V9增强了肿瘤控制和抗肿瘤免疫，同时奎啉酸和儿茶酚水平升高，这些代谢物与caspase依赖性凋亡和铁死亡相关。无细胞粪便上清可传递抗肿瘤效应，且不依赖细菌定植。在一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的先导性试验（n = 30）中，联合使用B. lactis V9与更高的客观缓解率（47%对33%）、疾病控制率（87%对67%）相关，并延长应答者的无进展生存期，这些应答者体内B. animalis富集且奎啉酸/儿茶酚升高（曲线下面积分别为0.73/0.82）。这些发现表明，CYFRA 21-1可能识别一种可干预的、与微生物群相关的治疗耐药状态。

title: Electrified thermochemical reaction engineering with metamaterial reactors
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: The electrification of thermochemical reactors presents an opportunity to not only decarbonize high-grade heat generation but also to customize heating and heat transfer processes in a manner that facilitates process intensification and enhanced conversion. We present metamaterial reactors that use the high-frequency magnetic induction of axially tailored metamaterial baffles to produce customized axial heating profiles. The baffle consists of a combinatorial sequence of two types of lattices each with distinctive heating properties, and the sequence can be inverse designed around the reaction engineering properties of the reactor to produce temperature profiles tailored for a given reaction, flow condition, and maximum temperature. We use these metamaterial reactors to enhance the temperature uniformity in a set of packed bed flow reactors, each driving the reverse water gas shift reaction under different maximum temperature and flow conditions, demonstrating systematic increases in conversion compared to uniformly heated systems. These concepts encapsulate new opportunities in electrified thermochemical reaction engineering in which electrified powering is codesigned with reaction and heat transfer processes to enhance chemical conversion.
title_zh: 基于超材料反应器的电气化热化学反应工程
abstract_zh: 热化学反应器的电气化不仅可以使高品位热量的产生脱碳，还可以定制加热和传热过程，从而促进过程强化和提高转化率。我们提出了超材料反应器，利用轴向定制超材料挡板的高频磁感应产生定制的轴向加热分布。挡板由两种具有不同加热特性的晶格的组合序列构成，该序列可围绕反应器的反应工程特性进行逆向设计，以产生针对特定反应、流动条件和最高温度而定制的温度分布。我们利用这些超材料反应器提高了一系列填充床流动反应器中的温度均匀性，每个反应器在不同最高温度和流量条件下驱动逆水煤气变换反应，与均匀加热系统相比，转化率实现了系统性提升。这些理念概括了电气化热化学反应工程中的新机遇，即电气化供能与反应和传热过程协同设计，以提高化学转化率。

title: Genetic evidence and cross-species functional characterization implicate CNN2 in age-related macular degeneration susceptibility
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) is a leading cause of irreversible visual impairment in the aging population globally. Although genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have identified many AMD susceptibility loci, the genes and mechanisms underlying many of these associations remain unresolved. Here, we integrated expression quantitative trait locus (eQTL) data with AMD GWAS to prioritize nine putative genes. Through in vivo screening in zebrafish, we demonstrated that the downregulation of
                    cnn2
                    and
                    sarm1
                    expression led to ocular structural abnormalities and visual functional impairment. Subsequent mouse model studies confirmed that
                    Cnn2
                    deficiency affected photoreceptor structure and function, impaired contrast sensitivity, and caused abnormalities in cone cell immunostaining. Given that
                    CNN2
                    is predominantly expressed in endothelial cells, we propose that endothelial dysfunction may cascade to impair photoreceptor function. Collectively, through in silico prioritization and cross-species functional characterization, we identify
                    CNN2
                    as a candidate susceptibility gene in AMD pathogenesis, providing vital underlying mechanistic insights.
title_zh: 遗传学证据和跨物种功能特征分析表明CNN2与年龄相关性黄斑变性易感性相关
abstract_zh: 年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）是全球老龄化人口中不可逆性视损伤的主要原因之一。尽管全基因组关联研究（GWAS）已鉴定出许多AMD易感位点，但其中许多关联背后的基因和机制仍未明确。在此，我们将表达数量性状位点（eQTL）数据与AMD GWAS整合，筛选出九个候选基因。通过斑马鱼体内筛选，我们证实cnn2和sarm1表达的下调会导致眼部结构异常和视觉功能损伤。随后的小鼠模型研究证实，Cnn2缺失会影响感光细胞的结构和功能，损害对比敏感度，并引起视锥细胞免疫染色异常。鉴于CNN2主要在内皮细胞中表达，我们提出内皮功能障碍可能级联损伤感光细胞功能。总之，通过计算筛选和跨物种功能表征，我们确定CNN2是AMD发病机制中的候选易感基因，并提供了重要的潜在机制见解。

title: Complex effects of sex reversal on reproductive success in wild frogs
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Sex reversal, when the environment overrides genotypic sex determination, may hasten or delay climate-driven extinction in ectothermic animals, depending on sex-reversed individuals’ reproductive ability and offspring viability. Empirically, next to nothing is known about these traits in natural populations. Here, we present a comprehensive dataset of wild frogs to compare sex-reversed and sex-concordant males for fertility, attractiveness to females, intrasexual competitiveness, and offspring survival in various environments. We demonstrate uncompromised potential of sex-reversed males to mate and produce viable offspring, which are all genotypic females but have increased sex-reversal propensity. However, sex-reversed males realize reduced paternity in natural populations, possibly due to cryptic female choice. Furthermore, offspring of sex-reversed sires exhibit increased vulnerability to viral infection after heat stress. Our theoretical model predicts that these handicaps of sex-reversed males compromise their ability to compensate by producing female offspring for climate-driven male bias in phenotypic sex ratios, which reduces population viability. Therefore, sex reversal exacerbates the biodiversity consequences of environmental change.
title_zh: 野生青蛙性反转对繁殖成功的复杂影响
abstract_zh: 性逆转——即环境因素 overriding 基因型性别决定——可能加速或延缓外温动物因气候变化而灭绝的进程，这取决于性逆转个体的繁殖能力及后代存活力。在实证方面，人们对自然种群中这些性状几乎一无所知。本研究提供了一个全面的野生青蛙数据集，比较了性逆转雄性与性别一致雄性在生育力、对雌性的吸引力、同性间竞争力以及各种环境中后代存活力方面的差异。我们证明性逆转雄性在交配和产生可存活后代方面的潜力不受损害，其后代全部为基因型雌性，但性逆转倾向增加。然而，性逆转雄性在自然种群中实现的父权比例降低，这可能由于隐性的雌性选择。此外，性逆转父本的后代在热应激后对病毒感染的易感性增加。我们的理论模型预测，性逆转雄性的这些劣势损害了它们通过产生雌性后代来补偿气候驱动的表型性别比雄性偏倚的能力，从而降低了种群存活力。因此，性逆转加剧了环境变化对生物多样性的影响。

title: Muscle coactivation-inspired stiffness-driven control strategy for antagonistic soft robots
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Soft robots excel at safe and adaptive interaction but are often constrained by limited load capacity and manipulation precision. Antagonistic soft actuators offer a promising route to address these challenges by coupling actuation with variable stiffness, inspired by biological systems such as elephant trunks and octopus tentacles. However, existing control strategies largely treat stiffness as a passive mechanical property, whereas those that incorporate stiffness regulation typically rely on analytical models, limiting their deployment in soft robots with difficult-to-model dynamics. Here, we introduce a muscle coactivation-inspired, data-driven control strategy that explicitly integrates motion control with stiffness modulation, enabling precise and robust control without reliance on analytical models or system-specific tuning. The robot requires only minutes of learning from simple motions to acquire diverse functionalities, including grasping, stiffness sensing, liquid pumping, and reconfigurable bridging. By explicitly harnessing stiffness regulation, this work establishes a general and scalable control paradigm that expands the functional scope of antagonistic soft robots beyond passive compliance.
title_zh: 受肌肉共同激活启发的刚度驱动拮抗式软体机器人控制策略
abstract_zh: 软体机器人在安全、适应性交互方面表现出色，但常常受限于有限的负载能力和操作精度。拮抗式软体执行器为应对这些挑战提供了一条有前景的途径，其将驱动与可变刚度耦合，灵感来自象鼻和章鱼触手等生物系统。然而，现有的控制策略大多将刚度视为被动的机械属性，而那些纳入刚度调节的策略通常依赖解析模型，限制了其在动力学难以建模的软体机器人中的应用。在此，我们提出了一种受肌肉共同激活启发的数据驱动控制策略，明确地将运动控制与刚度调制相结合，在不依赖解析模型或特定系统调优的情况下实现精确而鲁棒的控制。该机器人仅需几分钟从简单动作中学习即可获得多种功能，包括抓取、刚度感知、液体泵送和可重构桥接。通过明确利用刚度调节，这项工作建立了一种通用且可扩展的控制范式，将拮抗式软体机器人的功能范围扩展到被动柔顺之外。

title: Aortic disease-linked mutations reveal unexpected convergent allosteric mechanisms of protein kinase G misregulation
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Thoracic aortic aneurysms and dissections (TAAD) are life-threatening conditions linked to gain-of-function mutations in cGMP-dependent protein kinase I (PKG I), a central regulator of vascular smooth muscle signaling. Among these, substitutions at Val
                    234
                    have been associated with kinase overactivation and early-onset disease, despite this residue being distal from the active site and cGMP binding regions. Using NMR, molecular dynamics simulations, and complementary kinase and binding assays, we show that Val
                    234
                    acts as a crucial allosteric hub of PKG autoinhibition. TAAD-associated variants at Val
                    234
                    disrupt PKG regulation through two distinct yet complementary allosteric mechanisms: by biasing the kinase toward active conformations that increase sensitivity to cGMP and by decreasing the folding stability of the regulatory domain, thereby weakening inhibitory contacts independently of cGMP control. Despite these differences, both mechanisms result in excessive PKG signaling at basal and intermediate cGMP levels, while maximal activity remains unaltered. Together, these findings explain how distal mutations can unpredictably rewire kinase allostery and drive pathogenic vascular signaling.
title_zh: 主动脉疾病相关突变揭示蛋白激酶G失调的意想不到的趋同变构机制
abstract_zh: 胸主动脉瘤和夹层（TAAD）是危及生命的疾病，与cGMP依赖性蛋白激酶I（PKG I）的功能获得性突变相关，该酶是血管平滑肌信号传导的核心调节因子。其中，Val234位点的替换与激酶过度激活和早发疾病相关，尽管该残基远离活性位点和cGMP结合区域。利用NMR、分子动力学模拟以及互补的激酶和结合实验，我们表明Val234是PKG自抑制的关键别构枢纽。TAAD相关的Val234变异通过两种不同但互补的别构机制破坏PKG调节：一是使激酶偏向活性构象，增加对cGMP的敏感性；二是降低调节结构域的折叠稳定性，从而在不受cGMP控制的情况下削弱抑制性接触。尽管存在这些差异，两种机制均导致在基础和中等cGMP水平下PKG信号过度激活，而最大活性保持不变。总之，这些发现解释了远端突变如何以不可预测的方式重构激酶别构并驱动致病性血管信号传导。

title: The larval Drosophila mushroom body balances lateralized sensing and interhemispheric integration
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Bilaterian animals must integrate sensory input from both sides of their bodies to make coherent perceptual decisions. In
                    Drosophila
                    larvae, olfactory receptor neurons target the ipsilateral brain hemisphere. Using calcium imaging, unilateral sensory perturbations, connectome analysis, and optogenetics, we identified the mushroom body (MB) as a key substrate for interhemispheric integration. Kenyon cell odor responses were almost entirely ipsilateral, indicating minimal coupling between the two MBs at the input level. In contrast, modulatory MB input neurons (MBINs) responded symmetrically to unilateral stimulation, suggesting broad pooling of reinforcement signals across hemispheres. Nevertheless, some MB output neurons (MBONs) preserved stimulus laterality up to 5 synapses from the sensory periphery, and asymmetric activation of these MBONs biased turning behavior. We also demonstrate that larvae can exploit instantaneous spatial comparisons for navigation in certain sensory contexts. These findings suggest that the deeply lateralized architecture of the larval olfactory system balances the need for interhemispheric integration with the advantages of parallel sensory processing.
title_zh: 果蝇幼虫蘑菇体平衡单侧感知与半球间整合
abstract_zh: 两侧对称动物必须整合来自身体两侧的感觉输入，以做出连贯的知觉决策。在果蝇幼虫中，嗅觉受体神经元投射至同侧脑半球。通过钙成像、单侧感觉扰动、连接组分析和光遗传学，我们发现蘑菇体（MB）是半球间整合的关键基质。Kenyon细胞的气味反应几乎完全局限于同侧，表明两个MB在输入层面的耦合极小。相比之下，调谐性MB输入神经元（MBINs）对单侧刺激呈对称反应，提示强化信号在两半球间广泛汇聚。然而，一些MB输出神经元（MBONs）在距离感觉外周最多5个突触处仍保持刺激的偏侧性，且这些MBONs的不对称激活会偏转运动行为。我们还证明，幼虫在某些感觉情境下可利用瞬时空间比较进行导航。这些发现表明，幼虫嗅觉系统深度偏侧化的架构在半球间整合需求与并行感觉处理优势之间取得了平衡。

title: Fluorescent protein ticker tape (FPTT): Multiplexed recording of transcriptional dynamics in living cells and in vivo
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Recording and real-time imaging of promoter activities are critical for deciphering signaling cross-talk, but technologies for simultaneously capturing multiple transient events in living cells are lacking. Here, we design fluorescent protein–based ticker tapes (FPTT) for multiplexed, scalable, longitudinal recording of single-cell physiological activities by integrating multispectral monomeric fluorescent proteins with self-assembling protein fibers. FPTT logged dose-dependent, reversible endogenous cFos transcriptional histories in hippocampal neurons at 3-hour resolution over 8 days. We engineered FPTT variants for human nuclear factor κB (NF-κB), Janus kinase/signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3), mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR), nuclear factor of activated T cells (NFAT), and adenosine 3′,5′-monophosphate (cAMP) signaling. This expanded toolset enabled quantification of cFos and NF-κB cross-talk in neurons, tracking of STAT3/cAMP dynamics during mouse liver injury, discovery of unexpected NFAT/STAT3 cross-talk, and characterization of cell cycle–dependent oscillating mTOR dynamics. Last, we achieved simultaneous analysis of four major pathways during T cell activation. FPTT provides a versatile platform to investigate transcriptional histories and signaling interplay, with broad applications in developmental biology and disease modeling.
title_zh: 荧光蛋白磁带（FPTT）：在活细胞和体内多重记录转录动力学
abstract_zh: 启动子活动的记录与实时成像对于解析信号串扰至关重要，但目前缺乏能在活细胞中同时捕获多个瞬时事件的技术。在此，我们设计了基于荧光蛋白的“磁带式”记录器（FPTT），通过将多光谱单体荧光蛋白与自组装蛋白纤维整合，实现对单细胞生理活动的多重、可扩展、纵向记录。FPTT以3小时分辨率在8天内记录了海马神经元中内源性cFos转录历史的剂量依赖性、可逆性变化。我们构建了针对人核因子κB（NF-κB）、Janus激酶/信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）、雷帕霉素机制靶标（mTOR）、活化T细胞核因子（NFAT）和3′,5′-单磷酸腺苷（cAMP）信号的FPTT变体。这一扩展的工具集实现了神经元中cFos与NF-κB串扰的定量分析、小鼠肝损伤过程中STAT3/cAMP动态的追踪、意外发现的NFAT/STAT3串扰的揭示，以及细胞周期依赖的mTOR振荡动态的表征。最后，我们在T细胞激活过程中实现了四条主要通路的同步分析。FPTT为研究转录历史和信号互作提供了一个多功能平台，在发育生物学和疾病建模中具有广泛应用。

title: The OsUVR8-OsNAC3-OsERF117 signaling module mediates metabolic acclimation and climate adaptation in rice
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Ultraviolet-B (UV-B; 280 to 315 nanometers) radiation increasingly threatens crop productivity, yet the genetic basis of plant adaptation remains poorly understood. We delineate a UV-B signaling module in rice that links photoreceptor activation to transcriptional reprogramming and metabolic acclimation. The AP2/ERF transcription factor OsERF117 acts as a central regulator, directly activating flavonoid and melatonin biosynthetic genes to drive photoprotective metabolite accumulation and enhance UV-B stress tolerance. Promoter variation in
                    OsERF117
                    defines 10 haplotypes across 4093 rice accessions, with high-expression haplotypes enriched in high-UV-B regions and correlated with adaptive divergence.
                    OsERF117
                    is transcriptionally activated by OsNAC3, with a cis-regulatory SNP at an OsNAC3-binding site modulating responsiveness and contributing to subspecies diversification. Genetic and biochemical evidence supports a model in which UV-B–activated OsUVR8 promotes OsNAC3 activity and antagonizes OsCOP1-mediated ubiquitination and degradation in rice. This OsUVR8-OsCOP1-OsNAC3-OsERF117 module reveals how UV-B perception drives regulatory and metabolic diversification, offering targets for breeding UV-B–resilient crops.
title_zh: OsUVR8-OsNAC3-OsERF117信号模块介导水稻的代谢适应和气候适应
abstract_zh: 紫外线B（UV-B；280至315纳米）辐射日益威胁作物产量，但植物适应的遗传基础仍知之甚少。我们在水稻中描绘了一个将光受体激活与转录重编程和代谢驯化联系起来的UV-B信号模块。AP2/ERF转录因子OsERF117作为核心调控因子，直接激活类黄酮和褪黑素生物合成基因，驱动光保护代谢物积累并增强UV-B胁迫耐受性。OsERF117的启动子变异在4093份水稻材料中定义了10种单倍型，其中高表达单倍型富集于高UV-B地区并与适应性分化相关。OsERF117受OsNAC3转录激活，OsNAC3结合位点处的一个顺式调控SNP调节其响应性并促成亚种分化。遗传和生化证据支持以下模型：UV-B激活的OsUVR8促进OsNAC3活性，并拮抗OsCOP1介导的泛素化和降解。该OsUVR8-OsCOP1-OsNAC3-OsERF117模块揭示了UV-B感知如何驱动调控和代谢多样化，为培育耐UV-B作物提供了靶标。

title: A MAP-SNARE interaction links cortical microtubules to the exocytic fusion machinery during auxin-dependent growth remodeling
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Auxin exerts diverse physiological effects through local maxima and tissue-scale gradients established by directional transport, which depends on the plasma membrane (PM) distribution and vesicular trafficking of auxin transporters. Cortical microtubules are positioned beneath the PM and have been implicated in trafficking events. However, how microtubules interface with terminal vesicle trafficking machinery at the PM remains unclear. Here, using auxin-dependent apical hook opening in Arabidopsis, we identify a molecular bridge linking cortical microtubules to PM-associated SNARE machinery. The microtubule-associated protein WDL4 interacts with the PM Qa-SNARE SYP121 and connects it to cortical microtubules through separate SNARE-binding and microtubule-binding domains. This coupling enhances the interaction between SYP121 and its R-SNARE partner VAMP721. Consistently, PM-localized VAMP721 signals were reduced in
                    wdl4
                    mutants. Disruption of WDL4 or SYP121 impaired PM accumulation and recycling of the auxin efflux carrier PIN1 and attenuated apical hook opening. Our findings elucidate a mechanism by which a microtubule-associated factor modulates SNARE-mediated auxin transporter trafficking during auxin-dependent growth remodeling.
title_zh: MAP-SNARE相互作用在生长素依赖的生长重塑过程中将皮层微管与胞外分泌融合机器联系起来
abstract_zh: 生长素通过方向性运输建立的局部最大值和组织尺度梯度发挥多种生理效应，而方向性运输依赖于质膜（PM）上生长素转运蛋白的分布和囊泡运输。皮层微管位于质膜下方，并被认为参与运输事件。然而，微管如何在质膜上与末端囊泡运输机器对接仍不清楚。在此，利用拟南芥中依赖生长素的顶端弯钩打开过程，我们鉴定了连接皮层微管与质膜相关SNARE机器的分子桥梁。微管相关蛋白WDL4与质膜Qa-SNARE SYP121相互作用，并通过独立的SNARE结合结构域和微管结合结构域将其连接到皮层微管。这种耦合增强了SYP121与其R-SNARE伙伴VAMP721之间的相互作用。相应地，wdl4突变体中质膜定位的VAMP721信号减弱。破坏WDL4或SYP121会损害生长素外排载体PIN1在质膜的积累和循环，并削弱顶端弯钩的打开。我们的发现阐明了一种机制，即微管相关因子在依赖生长素的生长重塑过程中调控SNARE介导的生长素转运蛋白运输。

title: Human cortical networks trade communication efficiency for computational reliability
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Brains are often described as cost-efficient communication networks that optimally balance long-connection costs against fast communication. Inspired by the “use it or lose it” principle, we present a game-theoretic model of self-organizing neural units showing the brain is suboptimal in both regards. Regional competition for connectivity under propagative dynamics yields networks resembling the human cortex yet more efficient and economical. In addition, using a reservoir computing framework, we find comparable information processing capacity, but synthetic optimal communication networks show lower computational reliability. Last, virtual lesions reveal why these networks are fragile: To optimize communication, they funnel information through a spatially clustered “oligarchy” of transmodal hubs. The human brain instead uses a distributed “rich-club” backbone that better resists targeted attacks, despite higher wiring costs and less efficient communication. Cortical networks thus trade both cost and efficiency for reliable computation, highlighting computational reliability as an overlooked and perhaps even more prominent driver of brain connectivity than wiring cost or communication efficiency.
title_zh: 人类皮层网络以通信效率换取计算可靠性
abstract_zh: 大脑常被描述为成本高效的通信网络，能在长连接成本与快速通信之间实现最优平衡。受“用进废退”原理启发，我们提出了一个自组织神经单元的博弈论模型，表明大脑在这两方面均非最优。在传播动力学下，区域间对连接性的竞争生成的网络类似于人类皮层，却更高效、更经济。此外，利用储备池计算框架，我们发现两者信息处理能力相当，但人工合成的最优通信网络计算可靠性更低。最后，虚拟损伤揭示了这些网络脆弱的原因：为了优化通信，它们将信息汇聚到由跨模态枢纽组成的、空间聚集的“寡头集团”中。而人脑则采用分布式“富人俱乐部”骨干结构，尽管布线成本更高、通信效率更低，却能更好地抵御针对性攻击。因此，皮层网络以成本和效率换取可靠的计算，凸显了计算可靠性是一个被忽视、甚至可能比布线成本或通信效率更为重要的大脑连接性驱动因素。

title: Hijacking pre-tRNA enables LTR-retrotransposon–initiated constitutive heterochromatin formation
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Pericentric heterochromatin serves as a fundamental component of eukaryotic chromosomes, endowing specialized genomic architecture with broad functional consequences. Although it is universally marked by H3K9me3 modification, the underlying pericentric DNA sequences diverge substantially across species. Here, by leveraging a transposition reporter system combined with a genome-wide RNA interference (RNAi) screen, we identified a specialized mechanism for recruiting SUV39H methyltransferase to initiate pericentric heterochromatin formation. This pathway depends on a highly ordered complex comprising the Puf68, pre–transfer RNAs (tRNAs), and the primer binding site (PBS). Puf68 binds with high affinity to poly-U tracts in pre-tRNA 3′ trailer, forming a Puf68/pre-tRNA complex that subsequently base-pairs with the PBS of nascent long terminal repeat (LTR)–retrotransposons. Through direct interaction, Puf68 recruits Su(var)3-9 to these regions, catalyzing H3K9 trimethylation. Notably, Puf68 is sufficient to initiate de novo heterochromatin assembly both at pericentric and ectopically integrated LTR-retrotransposon regions. Our findings not only uncover a previously unrecognized mechanism of heterochromatin initiation but also resolve a long-standing question of how hosts harness nascent LTR-retrotransposon transcripts.
title_zh: 劫持pre-tRNA使LTR逆转录转座子得以启动组成型异染色质的形成
abstract_zh: 着丝粒周异染色质是真核染色体的重要组成部分，赋予其特殊的基因组架构并带来广泛的功能影响。尽管它普遍以H3K9me3修饰为标志，但不同物种间潜在的着丝粒周DNA序列差异巨大。在此，通过利用转座报告系统结合全基因组RNA干扰（RNAi）筛选，我们鉴定了一种招募SUV39H甲基转移酶以启动着丝粒周异染色质形成的特化机制。该通路依赖于由Puf68、前体转移RNA（tRNAs）和引物结合位点（PBS）组成的高度有序复合物。Puf68以高亲和力结合前体tRNA 3′尾部的poly-U序列，形成Puf68/前体tRNA复合物，随后与新生长末端重复序列（LTR）逆转录转座子的PBS碱基配对。通过直接相互作用，Puf68将Su(var)3-9招募至这些区域，催化H3K9三甲基化。值得注意的是，Puf68足以在着丝粒周及异位整合的LTR逆转录转座子区域启动异染色质的从头组装。我们的发现不仅揭示了一种此前未被认识的异染色质启动机制，也解答了宿主如何利用新生LTR逆转录转座子转录本这一长期悬而未决的问题。
