title_zh: 减缓情景下南大洋碳损失加剧
abstract_zh: 南大洋（SO）通过吸收人为二氧化碳（CO2）在全球碳循环中发挥着关键作用。然而，在未来的减缓努力下，这一作用是否会持续仍不确定。利用Community Earth System Model version 2（CESM2）进行的理想化排放驱动模拟，我们发现SO在零排放和负排放阶段从净CO2汇转变为可观的源。这种释放源于海表温度的区域性持续上升以及表面碱度的全球一致性下降。这些变化共同维持了海洋CO2分压（Pco2）的升高，尽管大气CO2在下降，从而逆转了海-气Pco2梯度（

title: A decagon wave around Saturn’s south pole
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Saturn has a unique long-lived, nearly stationary hexagon wave close to its north pole that is coupled to an intense eastward jet. Despite decades of observation, no similar wave has been reported so far in the southern hemisphere or elsewhere on Saturn. Ground-based and Hubble Space Telescope (HST) images obtained in 2025 revealed the presence of a decagonal wave at planetographic latitudes ∼58°S to 63°S. HST images in 2023 and 2024 showed vertices with weaker albedo contrasts and linear sides of the decagon, implying an evolving phenomenon. The decagon moves eastward with a velocity of 2.5 meters per second, much slower than the zonal jet at 60.5°S with 116 meters per second, and the longitudes of its vertices oscillate with a period of 32 days and amplitudes of 4.6° to 8.4°. From its properties, the decagon could be a large-scale meandering wave trapped vertically and confined meridionally by the dominant jet curvature. Shallow water model simulations suggest that the decagon may have originated from a spatially periodic disturbance in the jet peak or may have been driven by a dark anticyclonic vortex immediately to the north.
title_zh: 土星南极附近的十边形波浪
abstract_zh: 土星在其北极附近有一个独特的长期存在、近乎静止的六边形波动，与一股强烈的向东急流相耦合。尽管经过数十年的观测，迄今尚未在土星南半球或其他地方发现类似的波动。2025年获得的地面观测和哈勃空间望远镜（HST）图像揭示了在行星图形学纬度约58°S至63°S存在一个十边形波动。2023年和2024年的HST图像显示了反差较弱的十边形顶点和笔直的边，表明这是一个不断演变的现象。该十边形以每秒2.5米的速度向东移动，远慢于60.5°S处每秒116米的纬向急流，其顶点的经度以32天的周期和4.6°至8.4°的振幅振荡。根据其性质，该十边形可能是一种在垂直方向被俘获、在经向方向上受主导急流曲率约束的大尺度蜿蜒波。浅水模型模拟表明，该十边形可能起源于急流峰值处的空间周期性扰动，也可能由紧邻其北侧的一个暗色反气旋涡旋驱动。

title: A single-point mutation in TRPA1 drives heat resilience in oviparous embryos
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
The molecular basis for species-specific thermal adaptation in vertebrate sensory systems is not well understood. We show that a single–amino-acid change in the pore domain of ion channel transient receptor potential ankyrin 1 (TRPA1) during the synapsid-diapsid split rewired its heat sensitivity. Many oviparous vertebrates retaining the ancestral residue display TRPA1 heat activation, protecting embryonic development under high temperatures, whereas selection for an aspartate in mammals reduced thermal responsiveness. Blocking heat-activated TRPA1 in oviparous embryos impaired dorsal-root-ganglion axon growth, disrupted myelination, and caused limb weakness at hatching. Mechanistically, TRPA1-mediated Ca
                    2+
                    influx triggers nuclear translocation of SP1, activating
                    CADM1
                    and
                    MDGA1
                    . Together, these results uncover an unexpected developmental role of TRPA1 in heat resilience, linking a single mutational event to embryonic survival under thermal stress and highlighting ion-channel evolution in adaptation.
title_zh: TRPA1中的单点突变驱动卵生胚胎的热耐受性
abstract_zh: 脊椎动物感觉系统中物种特异性热适应的分子基础尚不清楚。我们发现，在合弓类-双弓类分化期间，离子通道瞬时受体电位锚蛋白1（TRPA1）孔道结构域中的单个氨基酸变化重新改变了其热敏感性。许多保留祖先残基的卵生脊椎动物的TRPA1表现出热激活，以保护高温下的胚胎发育，而哺乳动物中对天冬氨酸的选择降低了热反应性。阻断卵生胚胎中热激活的TRPA1会损害背根神经节轴突生长，破坏髓鞘形成，并导致孵化时肢体无力。在机制上，TRPA1介导的Ca2+内流触发SP1的核转位，激活CADM1和MDGA1。总之，这些结果揭示了TRPA1在热耐受性中一个意想不到的发育作用，将单一突变事件与热应激下的胚胎存活联系起来，并凸显了离子通道进化在适应中的作用。

title: Tetrabutoxy-substituted quintulene: A missing bowl-shaped cycloarene
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
The synthesis of corannulene and sumanene has pioneered the burgeoning field of buckybowl chemistry. Quintulene, a long-missing member of cycloarenes family, represents a distinctive type of bowl-shaped aromatics with curvature arising from edge topology and central cavity. Nevertheless, its synthesis has remained elusive for more than 40 years, primarily due to the high geometric strain. Herein we report the synthesis of tetrabutoxy-subtituted quintulene
                    1
                    through a rationally designed fold-in strategy. Single crystal analysis confirms the bowl-shaped geometry with a bowl-to-bowl inversion barrier of 19.1 kcal/mol. Quintulene
                    1
                    adopts a Clar-type localized aromatic character, consistent with other cycloarenes, but prone to hydrogenation and over-oxidation. Remarkably, the substantially structural strain attenuates local aromaticity in the benzenoid segments of quintulene
                    1
                    , enabling an almost quantitative fivefold Diels-Alder reaction. This work not only fills a critical gap in cycloarene chemistry but also underscores how geometric strain and electronic structure can reshape reactivity in curved π-systems.
title_zh: 四丁氧基取代的五并苯：一种缺失的碗状环芳烃
abstract_zh: 碗烯和薁烯的合成开创了蓬勃发展的碗状芳烃化学领域。Quintulene是环芳烃家族中长期缺失的一员，代表了一类独特的碗状芳香化合物，其曲率源于边缘拓扑和中心空腔。然而，由于其高几何张力，其合成四十多年来一直难以实现。本文报道了通过合理设计的折叠策略合成了四丁氧基取代的quintulene 1。单晶分析证实了其碗状几何结构，碗-碗翻转能垒为19.1 kcal/mol。Quintulene 1呈现Clar型定域芳香性，与其他环芳烃一致，但易发生加氢和过度氧化。值得注意的是，显著的结构张力削弱了quintulene 1苯环片段的局部芳香性，从而实现了几乎定量的五重Diels-Alder反应。这项工作不仅填补了环芳烃化学中的一个关键空白，也凸显了几何张力和电子结构如何重塑弯曲π体系中的反应性。

title: Targeting CTGF+ cancer-associated fibroblasts disrupts tumor–stroma crosstalk in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is characterized by a heavily fibrotic tumor microenvironment (TME), primarily driven by cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs). Due to the high heterogeneity and diverse biological behaviors of CAFs, the current strategies targeting CAFs have limited benefits in clinic. This study identifies a subset of CAFs marked by high expression of connective tissue growth factor (CTGF), which enhances tumor cell migration and correlates with advanced PDAC stages. By combining in silico screening and functional assays, we identified DP as a first-in-class small-molecule inhibitor targeting CTGF. Structural optimization of DP led to the synthesis of a series of derivatives, from which the optimal compound QX03-46 was identified. Targeting CTGF
                    +
                    CAFs with QX03-46 significantly disrupted the CTGF/TGF-β1 signaling axis and suppressed CAF functions, resulting in decreased extracellular matrix deposition and oncogenic cytokine secretion. Furthermore, it enhanced the efficacy of anti-programmed cell death ligand 1 therapy, promoting a more favorable immune response. Our findings illuminate the critical role of CTGF
                    +
                    CAFs in PDAC progression and position QX03-46 as a promising therapeutic candidate for targeting the fibrotic TME.
title_zh: 靶向CTGF+癌症相关成纤维细胞可破坏胰腺导管腺癌中的肿瘤-基质串扰
abstract_zh: 胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）的特征是严重纤维化的肿瘤微环境（TME），主要由癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAFs）驱动。由于CAFs的高异质性和多样的生物学行为，目前针对CAFs的策略在临床上效果有限。本研究鉴定了一类以结缔组织生长因子（CTGF）高表达为标志的CAFs亚群，该亚群增强肿瘤细胞迁移并与晚期PDAC分期相关。通过结合计算机筛选和功能实验，我们鉴定出DP作为首个靶向CTGF的小分子抑制剂。对DP的结构优化合成了系列衍生物，并从中筛选出最优化合物QX03-46。用QX03-46靶向CTGF+ CAFs显著破坏了CTGF/TGF-β1信号轴并抑制了CAF功能，导致细胞外基质沉积和致炎细胞因子分泌减少。此外，它还增强了抗程序性细胞死亡配体1疗法的疗效，促进更有利的免疫反应。我们的发现阐明了CTGF+ CAFs在PDAC进展中的关键作用，并将QX03-46定位为靶向纤维化TME的有前景的治疗候选药物。

title: Rapidly evolving aphid gall effector proteins exhibit saposin-like folds
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
Many insects manipulate plants by injecting effector proteins. In one extreme example of this molecular “hijacking,”
                    Hormaphis cornu
                    aphids inject bicycle proteins into
                    Hamamelis virginiana
                    , contributing to the development of novel organs called galls. Bicycle proteins share no amino acid sequence similarity with proteins of known function. Here, we report the crystal structures of two divergent bicycle proteins. Both proteins contain saposin-like folds: one with multiple disulfide bonds exhibits a swapped domain topology; the other has no disulfide bonds and possesses two distinct, tandem domains. To explore the structural evolution of bicycle proteins, we attempted to predict bicycle protein structures with Alphafold2 (AF2) and other deep learning programs. While AF2 did not recover the two experimental structures using existing databases, it succeeded when provided with multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) of protein sequences from newly sequenced closely related species. Using this approach, we generated 2,400 high-confidence bicycle protein predictions from seven aphid species. While all aphid bicycle proteins contain predicted saposin-like folds, they display a vast diversity of structural and physicochemical properties. While this diversity thwarts prediction of conserved functions encoded in structure, it suggests that bicycle proteins have evolved to target diverse plant processes and/or to evade plant immune surveillance. Our extension of AF2 with custom MSAs of proteins from closely related species provides a generalizable, powerful approach for predicting structures of rapidly evolving protein families.
title_zh: 快速进化的蚜虫瘿效应蛋白表现出类似鞘脂激活蛋白的折叠结构
abstract_zh: 许多昆虫通过注入效应蛋白来操控植物。在这种分子"劫持"的一个极端例子中，Hormaphis cornu蚜虫将bicycle蛋白注入Hamamelis virginiana，促成了被称为虫瘿的新器官的发育。Bicycle蛋白与已知功能的蛋白没有氨基酸序列相似性。在此，我们报道了两种不同bicycle蛋白的晶体结构。两种蛋白都含有saposin样折叠：一种具有多个二硫键，表现出交换的结构域拓扑；另一种没有二硫键，具有两个不同的串联结构域。为探索bicycle蛋白的结构进化，我们尝试用Alphafold2（AF2）和其他深度学习程序预测bicycle蛋白结构。虽然AF2利用现有数据库未能恢复这两个实验结构，但在提供新测序的近缘物种蛋白序列的多序列比对（MSAs）后获得了成功。利用该方法，我们从七种蚜虫物种中生成了2,400个高置信度的bicycle蛋白预测。虽然所有蚜虫bicycle蛋白都含有预测的saposin样折叠，但它们表现出极其多样的结构和物理化学性质。尽管这种多样性阻碍了对结构中编码的保守功能的预测，但它表明bicycle蛋白已进化为靶向多样的植物过程和/或逃避植物免疫监视。我们通过近缘物种蛋白的自定义MSAs对AF2的扩展

title: KRAS is required for plexiform neurofibroma formation and represents a targetable vulnerability in established tumors
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Patients with neurofibromatosis type 1 develop Schwann cell tumors called neurofibromas that arise within peripheral nerves, driven by loss of neurofibromin and consequent increased RAS/RAF/MEK signaling. MEK inhibitors achieve partial responses for benign neurofibromas but are limited by toxicity and incomplete efficacy, necessitating alternative approaches. Using the
                    Dhh-
                    Cre;
                    Nf1
                    fl/fl
                    neurofibroma mouse model, we found that genetic ablation of
                    Kras
                    , but not
                    Hras
                    , markedly reduced neurofibroma development, inhibited MAPK activation, and rescued disrupted Remak bundles that are a morphologic hallmark of neurofibromas. These findings reveal a RAS paralog–specific requirement for KRAS in NF1-deficient neurofibroma initiation. Pharmacological KRAS inhibition with BI6674, an orally bioavailable KRAS
                    multi
                    inhibitor, reduced tumor volume and proliferation in established neurofibromas and remodeled the tumor immune microenvironment, decreasing macrophages and dendritic cells. Combining KRAS and MEK inhibition further enhanced tumor regression. These findings demonstrate that KRAS is essential for neurofibroma formation and represents a promising therapeutic target, supporting clinical evaluation of KRAS inhibition for neurofibromas in patients with neurofibromatosis type 1.
title_zh: KRAS是丛状神经纤维瘤形成所必需的，并代表已形成肿瘤中一种可靶向的脆弱性
abstract_zh: 1型神经纤维瘤病患者会发展为称为神经纤维瘤的施万细胞肿瘤，其发生于外周神经内，由神经纤维蛋白缺失及随之增强的RAS/RAF/MEK信号驱动。MEK抑制剂对良性神经纤维瘤可实现部分缓解，但受限于毒性和不完全的疗效，因此需要替代策略。利用Dhh-Cre; Nf1 fl/fl神经纤维瘤小鼠模型，我们发现Kras而非Hras的基因消融显著减少了神经纤维瘤的发生，抑制了MAPK激活，并挽救了作为神经纤维瘤形态学标志的受损Remak束。这些发现揭示了NF1缺陷型神经纤维瘤发生过程中RAS同源基因对KRAS的特异性需求。使用BI6674（一种口服生物可利用的KRAS multi抑制剂）进行KRAS药理学抑制，可减小已形成神经纤维瘤的肿瘤体积和增殖，并重塑肿瘤免疫微环境，减少巨噬细胞和树突状细胞。KRAS与MEK抑制联合使用进一步增强肿瘤消退。这些发现表明KRAS对神经纤维瘤的形成至关重要，是一个有前景的治疗靶点，支持对1型神经纤维瘤病患者进行KRAS抑制的临床评估。

title: Self-adaptive and configurable transfer printing of flexible electronics via rheology of liquid foam
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Flexible electronics (FEs) have the potential to endow objects with the virtues and functionalities of electronics. The key is transferring manufactured FEs from original rigid substrates and printing onto targets. However, existing transfer printing accommodates limited circumstances due to immutable mechanical properties of either solid or liquid stamps. Here, a self-adaptive, configurable transfer printing method is developed based on the unique rheology of liquid foam that enables integration of ultrathin FEs onto arbitrary surfaces conformally, three-dimensionally and non-invasively. The liquid foam exhibits adaptive mechanical properties between solid and liquid, converting among elastic, plastic and dynamic behaviors spontaneously. We demonstrate liquid foam can support FEs with shape maintained prepared with no defect, transform FEs to irregular topographies in a stress-free manner, and extend the reach of FEs to inner surfaces of semi-closed objects i.e., cranial cavity, which were barely feasible before. This approach overcomes key bottlenecks of current technologies and opens numerous opportunities for FEs in wearables and brain-computer interfaces.
title_zh: 通过液态泡沫流变学实现柔性电子器件的自适应与可重构转印
abstract_zh: 柔性电子器件（FEs）有望赋予物体电子学的优势和功能。关键在于将制造好的FEs从原始刚性基底转移并印刷到目标物上。然而，由于固体或液体印章的机械性能不可改变，现有转印技术的适用场景有限。在此，我们基于液体泡沫独特的流变学特性开发了一种自适应、可重构的转印方法，能够将超薄FEs保形、三维且无创地集成到任意表面上。液体泡沫在固态和液态之间表现出自适应的机械性能，可在弹性行为、塑性行为和动态行为之间自发转换。我们证明，液体泡沫可以无缺陷地支撑保持形状的FEs，以无应力的方式将FEs转变为不规则形貌，并将FEs的应用拓展到半封闭物体（即颅腔）的内表面，而这些在此前几乎无法实现。该方法克服了当前技术的关键瓶颈，为FEs在可穿戴设备和脑机接口领域开辟了众多机遇。

title: Restoring pre-osteoarthritis cartilage matrix integrity via Col9 mRNA halts osteoarthritis progression
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Osteoarthritis (OA) is a prevalent degenerative joint disease characterized by the progressive breakdown of cartilage. Here, we sought to define a pre-osteoarthritis (pre-OA) state using nanoindentation-based mechanical testing and evaluation of collagen organization in cartilage matrix. The reductions in elastic modulus and impaired viscoelasticity preceded any overt histological degeneration. This mechanical dysfunction was primarily driven by early disorganization of type II collagen, occurring before substantial depletion of cartilage components. We subsequently identified type IX collagen (Col IX), which played a critical role at the pre-OA stage. Intra-articular administration of
                    Col9
                    mRNAs delivered by polymer-based nanomicelle restored pre-OA cartilage to a healthy, native-like collagen network architecture and preserved cartilage mechanical integrity, ultimately halting OA progression in the rat model. These findings identify viscoelastic dysfunction as an early biomechanical hallmark of pre-OA cartilage and establish
                    Col9
                    mRNA as a potential anti-OA drug to prevent its onset. Together, these results provide a translatable framework in which quantitative mechanical-ultrastructural metrics guide ultra-early, presymptomatic intervention for degenerative diseases.
title_zh: 通过Col9 mRNA恢复骨关节炎前软骨基质完整性以阻止骨关节炎进展
abstract_zh: 骨关节炎（OA）是一种常见的退行性关节疾病，其特征是软骨的进行性破坏。在本研究中，我们试图利用基于纳米压痕的力学测试以及软骨基质中胶原组织结构的评估，来定义骨关节炎前期（pre-OA）状态。弹性模量的降低和粘弹性的受损先于任何明显的组织学退变。这种力学功能障碍主要由II型胶原的早期紊乱所驱动，发生在软骨成分大量耗竭之前。我们随后鉴定出IX型胶原（Col IX），其在pre-OA阶段发挥关键作用。关节腔内注射由聚合物基纳米胶束递送的Col9 mRNA，可将pre-OA软骨恢复为健康的、接近天然的胶原网络结构，并保持软骨力学完整性，最终在大鼠模型中阻止OA的进展。这些发现将粘弹性功能障碍确定为pre-OA软骨的早期生物力学标志，并将Col9 mRNA确立为预防OA发病的潜在抗OA药物。总之，这些结果提供了一个可转化的框架，其中定量的力学-超微结构指标可指导退行性疾病的超早期、症状前干预。

title: Abrupt declines in fish productivity often precede stock collapses in marine fisheries
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Marine life is under multiple pressures, including climate change and overfishing, which can threaten fishery sustainability especially when it results in large, abrupt, and persistent shifts in fish productivity. Reports of abrupt shifts in marine systems are not uncommon, but a global assessment of their occurrence and drivers is seriously lacking. Here, we systematically classified the temporal dynamics of fish stock productivity from agency-assessed fisheries worldwide. We detected productivity abrupt shift in more than a quarter of the 315 fish stocks analyzed. Abrupt declines were markedly overrepresented in marine regions with highest warming rates, while abrupt increases were more likely under lower fishing intensity. We also demonstrate that abrupt productivity declines preceded stock collapses by about a decade in a quarter of the stocks that shifted. Overall, our results highlight the importance of considering productivity abrupt shifts to prevent an increasing risk of fish population collapse in warming oceans.
title_zh: 海洋渔业中鱼类生产力的骤降往往先于种群崩溃出现
abstract_zh: 海洋生物正面临包括气候变化和过度捕捞在内的多重压力，当这些压力导致鱼类生产力出现大幅、突然且持久的转变时，可能会威胁渔业的可持续性。海洋系统突变的报告并不少见，但对其发生情况和驱动因素的全球性评估严重缺乏。在此，我们对全球官方机构评估渔业的鱼类种群生产力时间动态进行了系统分类。在分析的315个鱼类种群中，超过四分之一检测到生产力突变。在变暖速率最高的海域，生产力骤降显著过多，而在捕捞强度较低的情况下，生产力骤升更为可能。我们还证明，在发生转变的种群中，约四分之一的种群在崩溃前约十年即出现生产力骤降。总体而言，我们的结果突出了考虑生产力突变的重要性，以防止在变暖的海洋中鱼类种群崩溃风险不断上升。

title: Magnetic-field-tunable cyclotron hyperbolic polaritons
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Hyperbolic polaritons are conventionally associated with structural anisotropy or phononic Reststrahlen bands. Here, we predict a class of hyperbolic polaritons arising from magnetic-field-induced cyclotron motion of charge carriers. When a perpendicular magnetic field is applied to high-mobility semimetals, the cyclotron response drives the in-plane dielectric function from metallic- to insulating-like below the cyclotron resonance frequency, while the out-of-plane response remains metallic. This anisotropy creates a hyperbolic dielectric environment that supports field-tunable cyclotron hyperbolic polaritons. We develop a comprehensive theoretical framework incorporating coupling to other collective excitations and predict characteristic terahertz near-field signatures of cyclotron hyperbolic polaritons, providing guidance for their future experimental observation. Our work identifies cyclotron motion as a route to hyperbolic polaritons and establishes a versatile platform for magnetically programmable nanophotonics.
title_zh: 磁场可调的回旋加速器双曲极化激元
abstract_zh: 双曲极化激元通常与结构各向异性或声子Reststrahlen带相关联。在此，我们预测了一类由磁场诱导的载流子回旋运动产生的双曲极化激元。当垂直磁场施加于高迁移率半金属时，回旋响应使面内介电函数在回旋共振频率以下由类金属转变为类绝缘体，而面外响应仍保持金属性。这种各向异性形成了支持场可调回旋双曲极化激元的双曲介电环境。我们建立了包含与其他集体激发耦合的综合性理论框架，并预测了回旋双曲极化激元的特征性太赫兹近场信号，为其未来的实验观测提供了指导。我们的工作确立了回旋运动作为产生双曲极化激元的一条途径，并为磁可编程纳米光子学构建了一个多功能平台。

title: From wild to domestic: Single-cell transcriptomic perspectives on hippocampal regulation and evolution
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
How domestication shapes brain evolution remains an open question. In this study, we integrated single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq), population genomics, and machine learning to investigate the hippocampal evolution under domestication. Across-species comparisons revealed that hippocampal cell type profiles are largely conserved across vertebrate species, while supporting the presence of adult hippocampal neurogenesis in birds. We further found that domestication and selective breeding likely influence the cellular composition and molecular regulation of the hippocampus. Our findings provide cellular evidence supporting the hypothesis that domestication affects adult hippocampal neurogenesis. Additionally, we showed that genes associated with neural progenitor cells (NPC) states and cell-marker programs are enriched for signatures of selection. Many of these genes function as regulators of neurogenesis and pathways mediating stress and fear reduction. Specifically, we identified selection at the
                    FKBP5
                    promoter that may influence its expression in the NPC lineage, potentially contributing to stress-response regulation during domestication. Collectively, these results suggest that domestication is associated with hippocampal remodeling as part of an adaptive response to human-managed environments. This study provides a cellular and genetic perspective on how domestication reshapes the brain and offers a basis for further investigation into the mechanisms of neural evolution within the context of microevolution.
title_zh: 从野生到家养：海马调控与演化的单细胞转录组学视角
abstract_zh: 驯化如何塑造大脑进化仍是一个悬而未决的问题。在本研究中，我们整合了单核RNA测序、群体基因组学和机器学习方法来研究驯化过程中的海马进化。跨物种比较显示，海马细胞类型图谱在脊椎动物物种间高度保守，同时支持鸟类成体海马神经发生的存在。我们进一步发现，驯化和选育可能影响海马的细胞组成和分子调控。我们的发现为驯化影响成体海马神经发生的假说提供了细胞层面的证据。此外，我们发现与神经祖细胞状态和细胞标志物程序相关的基因富集选择信号。其中许多基因作为神经发生的调节因子以及介导压力和恐惧减轻的通路发挥作用。具体而言，我们在FKBP5启动子区发现了选择信号，这可能影响其在神经祖细胞谱系中的表达，并可能在驯化过程中对压力反应的调节发挥作用。总之，这些结果表明驯化与海马重塑相关，是对人类管理环境适应性反应的一部分。本研究为驯化如何重塑大脑提供了细胞和遗传学视角，并为在微进化背景下进一步研究神经进化机制奠定了基础。

title: Three-dimensional printing of ice structures via evaporative cooling in vacuum
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: We demonstrate an approach to three-dimensional (3D) printing of ice structures by exploiting evaporative cooling. A micrometer-sized water jet is used to 3D print inside a vacuum chamber. The reduced ambient pressure leads to rapid evaporation of the extruded water, extracting latent heat, and quickly cooling the water well below 0 °C. Once deposited, the water freezes almost instantaneously into stable ice structures. We achieved high-fidelity printing via two distinct deposition techniques: layer-by-layer deposition for intricate 3D structures (e.g., a Christmas tree), and support-free mid-air printing for upright profiles (e.g., an in profile face), all achieved without cryogenic infrastructure, supporting materials, or external refrigeration. This approach directly visualizes fundamental thermodynamic principles—latent heat, evaporative cooling, and pressure-dependent phase transitions—while offering a relatively simple and scalable platform for ice-templated microfluidics and tissue engineering, or even extraterrestrial 3D printing.
title_zh: 利用真空蒸发冷却实现冰结构的三维打印
abstract_zh: 我们展示了一种利用蒸发冷却进行冰结构三维打印的方法。微米级水射流被用于在真空腔内进行三维打印。环境压力降低导致挤出的水快速蒸发，吸收潜热，使水迅速冷却至远低于0 °C。水一经沉积，几乎瞬间冻结为稳定的冰结构。我们通过两种不同的沉积技术实现了高保真打印：用于复杂三维结构的逐层沉积（如圣诞树），以及用于直立轮廓的无支撑空中打印（如侧脸轮廓），所有这些均无需低温基础设施、支撑材料或外部制冷。该方法直观展示了基本热力学原理——潜热、蒸发冷却和压力依赖的相变——同时为冰模板微流控和组织工程，甚至地外三维打印提供了一个相对简单且可扩展的平台。

title: Transforming neural activity to operate without glucose metabolism using brain-derived ketone bodies
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: The vertebrate brain is exquisitely sensitive to disruptions in glucose metabolism, and failure of adequate glucose delivery causes neurological dysfunction. Here, we identified an animal with the capacity to defy this rule: We show that neural circuits in frogs, animals with seemingly typical glucose demands, can stop metabolizing glucose by, in part, shifting to ketone bodies made exclusively within the brain after emergence from hibernation. This involves ketone body synthesis and transport from astrocytes to neurons to power synaptic transmission, along with the upregulation of gene expression that controls fatty acid catabolism and ketone body transport. Brain-derived ketone bodies also prevent decrements in activity that occur during hypoxia. These results provide insight into how frogs restart brain circuits following months of underwater hibernation when facing severe hypoxia and hypoglycemia that otherwise strongly impair neural performance in most animals. More broadly, they reveal the vertebrate brain has the capacity to serve as its own fuel reserve during the cessation of glucose metabolism, switching seamlessly to locally sourced ketone bodies while maintaining neural activity. This reframes glucose metabolism in the vertebrate brain not as a hard-wired necessity, but as a plastic trait that can in some cases be entirely abandoned.
title_zh: 利用脑源性酮体将神经活动转变为不依赖葡萄糖代谢的运行模式
abstract_zh: 脊椎动物的大脑对葡萄糖代谢的紊乱极为敏感，葡萄糖供应不足会导致神经功能障碍。在本研究中，我们发现了一种能够违背这一规律的动物：我们表明，在表面上具有典型葡萄糖需求的青蛙中，其神经回路可以在从冬眠中苏醒后，部分通过转向仅在大脑内产生的酮体来停止代谢葡萄糖。这涉及酮体的合成以及从星形胶质细胞向神经元的运输以支持突触传递，同时伴随控制脂肪酸分解代谢和酮体转运的基因表达的上调。脑源性酮体还可防止缺氧期间活动能力的下降。这些结果揭示了青蛙在经历数月水下冬眠后，在面对严重缺氧和低血糖（这在大多数动物中会严重损害神经功能）时如何重启大脑回路。更广泛地说，它们揭示了脊椎动物的大脑在葡萄糖代谢停止期间有能力作为自身的燃料储备，无缝切换到局部来源的酮体同时维持神经活动。这重新界定了脊椎动物大脑中的葡萄糖代谢：它并非硬性必需，而是一种在某些情况下可以完全放弃的可塑性特征。

title: Cold-adapted RNA polymerase from Pseudomonas phage Njord improves synthesis of therapeutic mRNA
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
An RNA polymerase identified in the genome of
                    Pseudomonas
                    phage Njord offers a promising tool for the synthesis of mRNA and other therapeutic nucleic acids. Originating from a marine microbial ecosystem, Njord RNAP transcribes RNA at high yield even under low temperature conditions. Key properties of the enzyme relevant to mRNA synthesis are presented including transcriptional fidelity, promoter specificity, incorporation of modified nucleotides, and the impurity profile of the RNA. Specific attention is given to the formation of contaminating double-stranded RNA (dsRNA) species. Analysis of transcription reactions shows that DNA-templated promoter-independent transcription is a major source of detectable dsRNA impurities and that Njord RNAP displays a minimal level of this activity. Consistent with the known inflammatory role of dsRNA in synthetic mRNA, transcriptomic analysis of cell culture and a live animal study demonstrates that mRNA synthesized with Njord RNAP elicits only a minimal immune response. This natural enzyme enables efficient mRNA synthesis at ambient temperature and produces transcripts essentially free of dsRNA, offering significant potential to streamline mRNA manufacturing processes.
title_zh: 来自假单胞菌噬菌体Njord的冷适应RNA聚合酶可改善治疗性mRNA的合成
abstract_zh: 在假单胞菌噬菌体Njord基因组中发现的一种RNA聚合酶为mRNA及其他治疗性核酸的合成提供了一种有前景的工具。Njord RNAP源自海洋微生物生态系统，即使在低温条件下也能高产量的转录RNA。本文介绍了该酶与mRNA合成相关的关键特性，包括转录保真度、启动子特异性、修饰核苷酸的掺入以及RNA的杂质谱。特别关注了污染性双链RNA（dsRNA）物种的形成。对转录反应的分析表明，以DNA为模板的非启动子依赖性转录是可检测dsRNA杂质的主要来源，而Njord RNAP的这种活性极低。鉴于dsRNA在合成mRNA中已知的炎症作用，细胞培养的转录组分析和活体动物研究表明，用Njord RNAP合成的mRNA仅引起极小的免疫反应。这种天然酶能够在常温下高效合成mRNA，并产生基本不含dsRNA的转录产物，为简化mRNA制造工艺提供了重要潜力。

title: Flagellar toxicity: Flagellar synthesis is lytic for Bacillus subtilis in the absence of PBP1
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
Flagella are large transenvelope nanomachines but how they transit the peptidoglycan in gram-positive bacteria is poorly understood. A recent model suggested that flagellar basal bodies diffuse in the membrane and become captured at locations in the peptidoglycan with a pore diameter that could accommodate the axle-like flagellar rod. To test the role of pore size on flagellar assembly, cells were disrupted for penicillin binding protein 1 (PBP1/PonA), a cell wall synthesis protein thought to decrease peptidoglycan pore frequency and/or diameter. The absence of PBP1 in the ancestral strain of
                    Bacillus subtilis
                    however resulted in a severe growth defect and cell lysis that was dependent on flagellar synthesis. Genetic analysis indicated that toxicity was due to completion of the flagellar hook, which activated the flagellar sigma factor SigD. SigD, in turn, activated a suite of peptidoglycan degrading enzymes that caused cellular lysis when PBP1 was absent. In addition, mutations that resulted in high levels of the stress response transcription factor Spx could lessen the toxicity, while PBPX, a putative teichoic acid D-alanylase, was required for autolysis. In sum, our results indicate that flagellar synthesis, not normally associated with cell viability, causes cell wall stress and under some conditions, cell death. Moreover, the cost of flagellar synthesis on envelope integrity may be underappreciated due to strain domestication, and specialized systems may be needed to compensate for the assembly of transenvelope machines in general.
title_zh: 鞭毛毒性：在缺乏PBP1时鞭毛合成对枯草芽孢杆菌具有溶菌作用
abstract_zh: 鞭毛是大型跨膜被膜纳米机器，但它们如何穿过革兰氏阳性菌的肽聚糖仍知之甚少。最近的一个模型提出，鞭毛基体在膜中扩散，并在肽聚糖中孔径足以容纳轴状的鞭毛杆的位置被捕获。为检验孔径对鞭毛组装的作用，研究者破坏了青霉素结合蛋白1（PBP1/PonA）——一种被认为可降低肽聚糖孔频率和/或孔径的细胞壁合成蛋白。然而，在枯草芽孢杆菌（Bacillus subtilis）祖先菌株中缺失PBP1会导致严重的生长缺陷和依赖于鞭毛合成的细胞裂解。遗传分析表明，毒性源于鞭毛钩的完成，其激活了鞭毛 sigma 因子 SigD。SigD 进而激活一系列肽聚糖降解酶，在PBP1缺失时引起细胞裂解。此外，导致应激反应转录因子Spx高水平表达的突变可减轻毒性，而推定的磷壁酸D-丙氨酰化酶PBPX则是自溶所必需的。总之，我们的结果表明，通常与细胞存活力无关的鞭毛合成会引起细胞壁应激，并在某些条件下导致细胞死亡。此外，由于菌株驯化，鞭毛合成对被膜完整性的代价可能被低估，而各属中跨膜被膜机器的组装可能需要专门的系统来补偿

title: Salmonella lipopolysaccharide stimulates uptake of long-chain fatty acids in the small intestine
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
Enteric bacterial pathogens profoundly alter intestinal physiology during infection, yet their effects on host lipid metabolism remain poorly understood. Using mass spectrometry lipidomics, we found that infection of the mouse intestine with the bacterial pathogen
                    Salmonella enterica
                    serovar Typhimurium (
                    S
                    . Typhimurium) stimulates uptake of long-chain fatty acids by small intestinal epithelial cells. This response coincided with increased expression of epithelial genes involved in lipid uptake and transport and required the long-chain fatty acid transporter CD36. Fatty acid uptake was triggered by
                    S
                    . Typhimurium lipopolysaccharide (LPS) and was impaired by bacterial mutations that alter LPS acyl chains. Mechanistically,
                    S
                    . Typhimurium induced lipid absorption through myeloid cell Toll-like receptor 4, a receptor for LPS.
                    Escherichia coli
                    , a related commensal bacterium, also induced intestinal lipid absorption through LPS, although to a lesser extent than
                    S
                    . Typhimurium. Finally, disruption of long-chain fatty acid absorption impaired host defense during bacterial stimulation, suggesting that bacteria-induced lipid uptake contributes to protection against enteric infection. Together, these findings identify LPS from Gram-negative intestinal bacteria as a key regulator of dietary lipid uptake by the intestinal epithelium.
title_zh: 沙门氏菌脂多糖促进小肠对长链脂肪酸的摄取
abstract_zh: 肠道细菌病原体在感染期间会深刻改变肠道生理，但其对宿主脂质代谢的影响仍知之甚少。利用质谱脂质组学，我们发现鼠伤寒沙门氏菌感染小鼠肠道会刺激小肠上皮细胞对长链脂肪酸的摄取。这一反应与脂质摄取和转运相关上皮基因表达的增加相吻合，并依赖于长链脂肪酸转运蛋白CD36。脂肪酸的摄取由伤寒沙门氏菌脂多糖（LPS）触发，并因改变LPS酰基链的细菌突变而受损。在机制上，伤寒沙门氏菌通过髓系细胞的Toll样受体4（LPS的受体）诱导脂质吸收。相关共生菌大肠杆菌也通过LPS诱导肠道脂质吸收，尽管程度低于伤寒沙门氏菌。最后，破坏长链脂肪酸吸收会削弱细菌刺激期间的宿主防御，表明细菌诱导的脂质摄取有助于抵御肠道感染。总之，这些发现将革兰氏阴性肠道细菌的LPS确定为肠上皮摄取膳食脂质的关键调节因子。

title: Breast cancer prevention by prophylactic Lalba mRNA-LNP vaccination
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
Tumor-suppressive immunity is more evident in early-stage compared to advanced tumors making it the ideal point for cancer interceptive immunotherapies. We previously described that higher peripheral T cell diversity is associated with more pronounced CD8
                    +
                    T cell infiltration in ductal carcinoma in situ of the breast, implying a close interaction between peripheral and intratumor immunity. Here, we developed lipid nanoparticle (LNP)-encapsulated messenger ribonucleic acid (mRNA) vaccines expressing the alpha-lactalbumin (LALBA) protein unique to mammary luminal progenitors (LPs) to test whether enhancing immune response by prophylactic vaccination against the putative cell-of-origin of breast cancer suppresses tumorigenesis. Vaccination of outbred Sprague-Dawley rats with N1-methylpseudouridine-modified or unmodified Lalba mRNA-LNP induced different degrees of LALBA-specific and nonspecific immune responses. The vaccination suppressed carcinogen-induced mammary tumorigenesis and improved tumor-free and overall survival without obvious toxicity in the normal mammary glands and other organs. Single-cell transcriptomic analysis revealed that vaccination decreases the frequency of a proliferative LP population in immunoreactive early epithelial hyperplasia. Overall, we provide proof of principle that prophylactic Lalba mRNA-LNP has the potential to suppress the initiation and progression of early breast neoplastic lesions.
title_zh: 预防性Lalba mRNA-LNP疫苗预防乳腺癌
abstract_zh:
肿瘤抑制性免疫在早期肿瘤中比晚期肿瘤更为明显，这使其成为癌症拦截性免疫治疗的理想时机。我们此前描述过，外周T细胞多样性越高，与乳腺导管原位癌中更显著的CD8
                    +
                    T细胞浸润相关，提示外周免疫与肿瘤内免疫之间存在密切相互作用。在本研究中，我们开发了脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）包封的表达乳腺管腔祖细胞（LPs）特有的α-乳清蛋白（LALBA）的信使核糖核酸（mRNA）疫苗，以检验通过针对乳腺癌推定起源细胞的预防性接种增强免疫应答是否能抑制肿瘤发生。用N1-甲基假尿苷修饰或未修饰的Lalba mRNA-LNP对远交系Sprague-Dawley大鼠进行接种，可诱导不同程度的LALBA特异性和非特异性免疫应答。该接种抑制了致癌物诱导的乳腺肿瘤发生，并改善了无瘤生存期和总生存期，且对正常乳腺及其他器官无明显毒性。单细胞转录组分析显示，接种降低了免疫反应性早期上皮增生中一个增殖性LP群体的频率。总体而言，我们提供了预防性Lalba mRNA-LNP具有抑制早期乳腺肿瘤病变起始和进展潜力的原理验证。

title: Structural basis for membrane binding by coagulation factors V and VIII and their specificity for phosphatidylserine-containing membranes
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Phosphatidylserine on the surface of activated cells serves as a signal for coagulation factor binding and the membrane-dependent assembly of enzyme complexes that drive the accelerated host response to vascular damage. Here, we use single-particle cryo-EM of liposome-bound proteins to establish common mechanisms utilized by coagulation factors V and VIII for membrane binding and phospholipid specificity. The interface between these peripheral proteins and the membrane shows contacts between the discoidin C1 and C2 domains and the interfacial phospholipid headgroup region of the membrane bilayer. There is no evidence for the insertion of membrane-contacting protein loops into the membrane core. This refutes previous models of high affinity protein binding by insertion into the hydrophobic core of the membrane. We also resolve density for the headgroup of phosphatidylserine bound to conserved pockets within the C1 and C2 domains. These single binding pockets in each C domain highlight the network of putative hydrogen bonds that contribute to binding specificity for phosphatidylserine. Our results now provide a high-resolution structural view of the protein–membrane interface for these coagulation proteins and highlight the utility of using liposomes as near-physiologic membrane mimetics in structural studies. The principles established in this work may also apply to other biological systems wherein function is regulated by reversible membrane binding.
title_zh: 凝血因子V和VIII膜结合及其对含磷脂酰丝氨酸膜特异性的结构基础
abstract_zh: 活化细胞表面的磷脂酰丝氨酸可作为凝血因子结合以及驱动宿主对血管损伤加速反应的膜依赖性酶复合物组装的信号。在本研究中，我们利用与脂质体结合的蛋白质的单颗粒冷冻电镜技术，确立了凝血因子V和VIII用于膜结合和磷脂特异性的共同机制。这些外周蛋白与膜之间的界面显示盘状结构C1和C2结构域与膜双层界面的磷脂头部基团区域之间存在接触。没有证据表明与膜接触的蛋白环会插入膜核心。这反驳了以往认为蛋白质通过插入膜的疏水核心实现高亲和力结合的模型。我们还解析了与C1和C2结构域内保守口袋结合的磷脂酰丝氨酸头部基团的密度。每个C结构域中的这些单一结合口袋突出了推定氢键网络，该网络有助于对磷脂酰丝氨酸的结合特异性。我们的结果为这些凝血蛋白的蛋白–膜界面提供了高分辨率结构视图，并凸显了在结构研究中使用脂质体作为近似生理膜模拟物的实用性。本工作中确立的原理也可能适用于其他通过可逆膜结合调控功能的生物系统。

title: Changes in the transcriptome and synthetic lethal dependencies following KRAS mutant expression reveal profound tissue specificity
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
Oncogenic KRAS mutations exhibit a striking tissue-restricted tropism, occurring with high frequency in pancreatic, colorectal, and lung adenocarcinomas while remaining rare in other lineages. The molecular basis for why these specific tissues are uniquely permissive to KRAS transformation, and how this context shapes therapeutic vulnerabilities, remains poorly defined. Here, we utilized CRISPR-mediated genome engineering to generate endogenous, conditional KRAS-mutant isogenic cell line models across three primary permissive lineages (lung, colon, and pancreas) and the nonpermissive breast lineage. Integrated genome-wide CRISPR fitness screens and comparative transcriptome analyses revealed that KRAS-driven synthetic lethal (SL) dependencies are profoundly shaped by their tissue of origin. Strikingly, we observed minimal overlap in SL hits across lineages, with only three genes shared among the permissive lines, suggesting that the
                    KRAS
                    oncogene operates through divergent, context-specific genetic networks. Mechanistically, we show that KRAS activation induces a universal MYC-driven metabolic signature, but the specific machinery required to sustain this state is lineage-restricted. We identified a dependency on the diphthamide synthesis pathway to maintain translational fidelity amid a KRAS-induced hypertranslational state. These findings demonstrate that even when driven by the same oncogene, tumors exhibit distinct regulatory landscapes and unique genetic vulnerabilities. Our results provide a framework for developing lineage-aware therapeutic strategies, moving beyond universal KRAS inhibition toward targeted interventions tailored to a tumor’s specific tissue context.
title_zh: KRAS突变表达后转录组与合成致死依赖性的变化揭示深层的组织特异性
abstract_zh: 致癌性KRAS突变表现出显著的组织限制性趋向性，在胰腺癌、结直肠癌和肺腺癌中高频发生，而在其他谱系中罕见。为何这些特定组织对KRAS转化具有独特的允许性，以及这种背景如何塑造治疗脆弱性，其分子基础仍不明确。在此，我们利用CRISPR介导的基因组工程，在三种原发允许性谱系（肺、结肠和胰腺）以及非允许性乳腺谱系中构建了内源性、条件性KRAS突变的同基因细胞系模型。整合的全基因组CRISPR适合度筛选和比较转录组分析表明，KRAS驱动的合成致死（SL）依赖性深受其起源组织的影响。值得注意的是，我们观察到各谱系之间SL命中结果的重叠极小，允许性细胞系之间仅共享三个基因，表明KRAS癌基因通过不同的、依赖于具体背景的遗传网络发挥作用。在机制上，我们表明KRAS激活诱导了一种普遍的MYC驱动的代谢特征，但维持这种状态所需的特定机制具有谱系限制性。我们鉴定出对白喉酰胺合成通路的依赖，以在KRAS诱导的超翻译状态下维持翻译保真性。这些发现表明，即使由同一癌基因驱动，肿瘤也表现出不同的调控格局和独特的遗传脆弱性。我们的结果为开发具有谱系意识的

title: Tumor-intrinsic IFNγ signaling and niche adaptation drive early colonization in ovarian cancer metastasis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The mechanisms enabling disseminating tumor cells to survive and colonize peritoneal niches during ovarian cancer metastasis remain incompletely understood. Here, we present MetTag, a single-cell barcoding and transcriptome profiling approach with time-stamped batch identifiers to resolve temporal dynamics of dissemination. Sequencing of MetTag barcodes reveals enrichment of early-disseminated clones across metastatic sites, and targeted depletion of pioneers diminishes the outgrowth of later arriving cells. MetTag-coupled single-cell RNA sequencing uncovers a distinct interferon-gamma-centric transcriptional trajectory enriched among pioneer clones. CRISPR/Cas9 screening and subsequent interferon-gamma receptor 1 knockout in pioneer cells significantly reduces metastatic burden, highlighting a critical window where active interferon-gamma signaling shapes the post-seeding metastatic niche and outgrowth. Mechanistically, the tumor-intrinsic interferon-gamma response and peritoneal macrophages cooperatively shield disseminating tumor cells from anoikis. Our study defines the temporal clonal architecture of peritoneal metastasis, revealing a first come, first served dissemination principle, where pioneer fitness determines the success of subsequent colonizers.
title_zh: 肿瘤内在的IFNγ信号传导及生态位适应驱动卵巢癌转移中的早期定植
abstract_zh: 使播散性肿瘤细胞在卵巢癌转移过程中得以存活并定植于腹壁龛位的机制仍未被完全理解。在此，我们提出MetTag，这是一种带有时间戳批次标识符的单细胞条形码和转录组 profiling 方法，用于解析播散的时间动态。对MetTag条形码的测序揭示了早期播散克隆在各转移部位的富集，而靶向清除先遣细胞会削弱随后到达细胞的生长。MetTag联合单细胞RNA测序揭示了一条以干扰素γ为中心的独特转录轨迹，该轨迹在先遣克隆中富集。CRISPR/Cas9筛选及随后在先遣细胞中敲除干扰素γ受体1显著降低了转移负荷，凸显了活性干扰素γ信号塑造种植后转移龛位及生长的关键时间窗口。在机制上，肿瘤内在的干扰素γ应答与腹膜巨噬细胞协同保护播散性肿瘤细胞免于失巢凋亡。我们的研究界定了腹膜转移的时间克隆结构，揭示了"先到先得"的播散原则，即先遣细胞的适应性决定了后续定植者的成败。

title: Suppressing Polyamide Crystallization Unlocks Ultrapermeable and Highly Selective Nanofiltration Membranes
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Nanofiltration (NF) membranes are essential for water purification. However, their performance is still largely optimized through empirical methods, as polyamide crystallinity remain difficult to control in scalable interfacial polymerization processes. In this study, we introduce an ultra-low-temperature interfacial polymerization strategy at −20 °C that enables direct polyamide chain assembly, suppresses crystallization, and forms a smooth, defect-free, fully amorphous selective layer. Comprehensive characterization confirms the formation of a homogeneous amorphous network, enabling a fourfold increase in water permeability and a threefold improvement in Cl-/SO42- selectivity compared with room-temperature controls, surpassing high-performance NF membranes. The smooth surface further improves the antifouling performance of the NF membrane. Life cycle assessment based on experiments with real industrial wastewater, demonstrate that using the fabricated membrane can reduce treatment costs by 79.1%. This work establishes temperature-controlled chain assembly as a scalable lever for NF design and provides a practical pathway toward next-generation membranes for water treatment.
title_zh: 抑制聚酰胺结晶解锁超高渗透性和高选择性纳滤膜
abstract_zh: 纳滤（NF）膜是水净化的关键。然而，其性能仍主要通过经验方法进行优化，因为在可规模化的界面聚合过程中，聚酰胺结晶度仍然难以控制。在本研究中，我们提出了一种在−20 °C下的超低温界面聚合策略，可直接实现聚酰胺链组装，抑制结晶，并形成光滑、无缺陷、完全无定形的选择层。综合表征证实了均一无定形网络的形成，与室温对照相比，水渗透性提高了四倍，Cl-/SO42-选择性提高了三倍，超越了高性能NF膜。光滑的表面还进一步提升了NF膜的抗污染性能。基于真实工业废水实验的生命周期评估表明，使用所制备的膜可将处理成本降低79.1%。这项工作确立了温度控制的链组装作为一种可规模化的NF设计手段，并为下一代水处理膜提供了实用途径。

title: Perceived humanness and empathy are dissociated in relationship advice generated by a large language model
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Differentiating generated and human-written content is increasingly difficult. We examine how incentives to convey humanness and task characteristics shape perceptions of textual content across five studies. In Studies 1–2, humans and GPT-4 write relationship advice or relationship descriptions with or without instructions to appear human. New participants judge each text’s source. Instructions to appear human increase perceived humanness only for GPT-4, reducing the human advantage. Study 3 shows that these effects persist under instructions to avoid sounding like an AI model and replicate across GPT-4 and GPT-4o. Study 4 demonstrates that GPT models can produce empathy without humanness and humanness without empathy. Study 5 shows that GPT-4 increases perceived humanness by adopting informal, conversational language and other surface-level stylistic cues, whereas human writers show little adjustment. Together, the findings indicate that perceived humanness depends on incentives to appear human and the context in which writing is produced.
title_zh: 大型语言模型生成的情感建议中感知的人性与共情相互分离
abstract_zh: 区分生成内容与人类撰写的内容正变得越来越困难。我们通过五项研究考察了传达人性的动机和任务特征如何影响人们对文本内容的感知。在研究1–2中，人类和GPT-4撰写情感关系建议或情感关系描述，有的带有、有的不带有“表现得像人类”的指令。新的参与者判断每段文本的来源。结果表明，“表现得像人类”的指令仅能提高GPT-4文本的感知人性，从而缩小了人类的优势。研究3表明，这些效应在“避免听起来像人工智能模型”的指令下依然存在，并在GPT-4和GPT-4o上均可重复。研究4证明GPT模型可以在缺乏人性的情况下产生共情，也可以在缺乏共情的情况下表现出人性。研究5表明，GPT-4通过采用非正式的、口语化的语言及其他表层风格线索来提高感知人性，而人类写作者几乎不做调整。总之，这些研究结果表明，感知人性取决于表现得像人类的动机以及写作产生的情境。

title: Ultra-low-power probabilistic graphical computing based on memristors enabling communications signal processing
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Improving the energy efficiency of baseband processors has become a critical challenge in mobile communications, especially for energy-constrained edge devices. Applications in conventional baseband signal processors usually adopt independently optimized algorithmic architectures and primarily rely on digital systems, whose energy efficiency is fundamentally limited by frequent data movement and computationally intensive dynamic operations. To overcome the fundamental energy-scaling bottleneck in modern signal processing, here we report a probabilistic graphical computing paradigm based on memristors, which not only unifies the framework of Bayesian inference-based baseband signal processing algorithms, but also achieves a substantial improvement in energy efficiency via memristor-based in-memory computing. Results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves energy consumption below 10 pJ per bit and up to an 11.4-fold improvement in energy efficiency over conventional implementations, while maintaining error rates below 1×10−4 in the representative application. These results provide a flexible, noise-resilient route to ultra-low-power signal processing in edge devices.
title_zh: 基于忆阻器的超低功耗概率图计算实现通信信号处理
abstract_zh: 提高基带处理器的能效已成为移动通信中的关键挑战，尤其是对于能量受限的边缘设备而言。传统基带信号处理器中的应用通常采用独立优化的算法架构，且主要依赖数字系统，其能效从根本上受限于频繁的数据移动和计算密集型的动态操作。为了克服现代信号处理中的根本性能耗扩展瓶颈，本文报道了一种基于忆阻器的概率图计算范式，它不仅统一了基于贝叶斯推断的基带信号处理算法框架，还通过基于忆阻器的存内计算实现了能效的大幅提升。结果表明，所提出的方法实现了每比特低于10 pJ的能耗，能效比传统实现方案最高提升11.4倍，同时在代表性应用中保持低于1×10−4的误码率。这些结果为边缘设备中的超低功耗信号处理提供了一条灵活且具有噪声鲁棒性的途径。

title: Excitation of acyclic trisubstituted alkenes via triplet energy transfer for diastereo- and enantioselective [2 + 2] photocycloaddition
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Photochemistry offers a powerful platform for enabling unique bond cleavage and formation. However, achieving precise stereochemical control while suppressing persistent racemic background reactions remains a fundamental challenge in this field. Herein, we report a highly enantio- and diastereoselective [2 + 2] photocycloaddition of 2-cyanoacrylamides—acyclic trisubstituted alkenes—using a dual catalytic system. Despite non-selective triplet energy transfer to both catalyst-bound and unbound substrates, high stereoselectivity is achieved through a dual Curtin–Hammett kinetic control strategy. This method features broad substrate scope, accommodating diverse arenes and alkenes, and enables the construction of α-chiral quaternary nitriles as well as contiguous quaternary stereocenters. Notably, stereoconvergent transformations are observed from mixtures of varied E/Z isomers and rotamers, and dearomative cycloadditions proceed efficiently across a range of aromatic systems. Mechanistic studies support a pathway involving fast ring-closure kinetics of matched diradical intermediates, with the cyano group playing a critical role.
title_zh: 通过三重态能量转移激发非环状三取代烯烃实现非对映选择性和对映选择性[2 + 2]光环加成反应
abstract_zh: 光化学为实现独特的键断裂与键形成提供了一个强大的平台。然而，在抑制持续进行的消旋背景反应的同时实现精确的立体化学控制，仍是该领域的一项根本性挑战。本文报道了一种基于双催化体系、针对2-氰基丙烯酰胺（非环状三取代烯烃）的高对映选择性和非对映选择性[2 + 2]光环加成反应。尽管三线态能量转移对催化剂结合和未结合的底物均无选择性，但通过双Curtin–Hammett动力学控制策略实现了高立体选择性。该方法具有广泛的底物适用范围，可容纳多种芳烃和烯烃，并能够构建α-手性季腈以及连续的季碳立体中心。值得注意的是，从不同E/Z异构体和旋转异构体的混合物中观察到了立体汇聚转化，且去芳构化环加成反应在多种芳香体系中均能高效进行。机理研究支持涉及匹配双自由基中间体快速闭环动力学的途径，其中氰基发挥着关键作用。

title: Quantifying nanoscale 3D stresses in zirconium and hydrides
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Zirconium alloys are widely used to manufacture the core components of nuclear reactors. Despite having good mechanical properties, they are susceptible to hydrogen embrittlement and hydride formation. In this study, scanning three-dimensional synchrotron X-ray diffraction is employed to determine, for the first time, the 3D internal stresses within hydrides and the surrounding zirconium matrix at 200 nm spatial resolution. The three-dimensional measured grain morphologies are imported into a crystal plasticity finite element model to simulate the evolution of localized stresses induced by hydride precipitation. Both experimental and numerical results consistently reveal significant compressive hydrostatic stresses within hydrides, with magnitudes exceeding 1 GPa, accompanied by pronounced variations in the individual stress components. Stresses and dislocation densities are localized at the hydride-zirconium boundaries. A force equilibrium analysis demonstrates that the measured stresses in the surrounding zirconium matrix are sufficient to recover internal stresses within hydrides, further validating the measured values.
title_zh: 量化锆及氢化物中的纳米尺度三维应力
abstract_zh: 锆合金被广泛用于制造核反应堆的堆芯部件。尽管具有良好的力学性能，它们仍易发生氢脆和氢化物形成。在本研究中，采用三维同步辐射X射线衍射扫描技术，首次以 200 nm 的空间分辨率测定了氢化物内部及其周围锆基体中的三维内应力。将实验测得的三维晶粒形貌导入晶体塑性有限元模型，以模拟氢化物析出所引起的局部应力演化。实验与数值结果一致地表明，氢化物内部存在超过 1 GPa 的显著静水压应力，并伴随各应力分量的显著变化。应力和位错密度局域于氢化物-锆边界处。力平衡分析表明，周围锆基体中测得的应力足以恢复氢化物内部的内应力，进一步验证了测量值的有效性。

title: Iridescent, Flexible, Hydrophobic Polymer Composite Films from Self-Assembled Cellulose Nanocrystals
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Cellulose nanocrystals (CNCs) are known for their ability to form iridescent films with structural color via solidification of a chiral nematic liquid crystalline phase. However, the inherent brittleness and hydrophilicity of CNCs make them fragile and susceptible to moisture, limiting their versatility. To address these issues, an innovative strategy has been developed to overcome the incompatibility between hydrophilic CNCs and hydrophobic polycaprolactone (PCL), and a series of hydrophobic iridescent CNC-PCL composite films has been prepared. The soft PCL was homogenously entrapped in the chiral nematic CNC matrix through film swelling, solvent exchange, and ambient drying, while the photonic structure of the assembled CNCs was well retained. These composite materials are iridescent, flexible, and hydrophobic, making them promising candidates for waterproof photonic coatings. Furthermore, their structural color, flexibility, and hydrophobicity were readily adjusted by tuning the proportion of PCL in the CNC matrix. It is expected that this new strategy will open the door for future researchers to develop water-resistant and flexible photonic materials by blending photonic crystals and hydrophobic polymers, as well as expanding their application scenarios.
title_zh: 自组装纤维素纳米晶制备的虹彩、柔性、疏水聚合物复合薄膜
abstract_zh: 摘要 纤维素纳米晶体（CNC）因其能够通过手性向列液晶相的凝固形成具有结构色的虹彩薄膜而闻名。然而，CNC 固有的脆性和亲水性使其易碎且容易受潮，从而限制了其多功能性。为了解决这些问题，我们开发了一种创新策略来克服亲水性CNC和疏水性聚己内酯（PCL）之间的不相容性，并制备了一系列疏水性虹彩CNC-PCL复合薄膜。通过薄膜溶胀、溶剂交换和环境干燥，软 PCL 被均匀地捕获在手性向列 CNC 矩阵中，同时组装好的 CNC 的光子结构得到了很好的保留。这些复合材料具有虹彩、柔性和疏水性，使其成为防水光子涂层的有希望的候选材料。此外，通过调整 CNC 矩阵中 PCL 的比例，可以轻松调整它们的结构颜色、柔韧性和疏水性。预计这一新策略将为未来研究人员通过混合光子晶体和疏水性聚合物来开发防水且柔性的光子材料并扩展其应用场景打开大门。

title: Controlling surface reactions of hydrogen atoms by the electron spin
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Gas molecules possess various internal degrees of freedom. Whereas recent advances in surface dynamics have clarified the roles of translational, vibrational and rotational motion in gas-surface reactions, the effect of its electron spin on surface reactions remains poorly understood. Here, we demonstrate the spin dependence of H adsorption and abstraction reactions on a Ni surface using a spin-polarized atomic-hydrogen beam. The results indicate that H adsorption is suppressed when the H electron spin is oriented perpendicular to the magnetization direction of the Ni(111) surface. Furthermore, the same spin preference is observed for the H abstraction reaction on a D-covered surface. These findings suggest that controlling the spin orientation of molecules and surfaces by applying an external magnetic field provides a viable means to modulate surface reaction rates.
title_zh: 通过电子自旋控制氢原子的表面反应
abstract_zh: 气体分子具有多种内部自由度。尽管表面动力学的最新进展已阐明了平动、振动和转动在气-表面反应中的作用，但电子自旋对表面反应的影响仍知之甚少。在此，我们利用自旋极化的原子氢束，演示了 Ni 表面上 H 吸附和抽取反应的自旋依赖性。结果表明，当 H 电子自旋垂直于 Ni(111) 表面磁化方向时，H 吸附受到抑制。此外，在覆盖 D 的表面上，H 抽取反应也表现出相同的自旋偏好。这些发现表明，通过施加外部磁场来控制分子和表面的自旋取向，为调控表面反应速率提供了一种可行手段。

title: Drought development characteristics modulate global dry–wet abrupt alternation through distinct land–atmosphere feedbacks
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Rapid transitions from drought to extreme precipitation can trigger cascading impacts, but the influence of antecedent drought development on subsequent precipitation remains unclear. Dry–wet abrupt alternation events were identified using a global event-scale framework and separated into successive dry and wet phases. These events followed approximately 32% of droughts, and their frequency increased significantly in 58% of the 26 IPCC-SREX regions assessed in 1951-2020. Model-based analysis showed that drought-development characteristics contributed 25.7% of the predictive information distinguishing droughts with and without subsequent extreme precipitation. Rapid and intense soil-moisture decline was associated with earlier, more convective precipitation, particularly in mid- and high-latitude climate-transition regions, whereas prolonged and severe drought development was associated with delayed, more stratiform precipitation, especially in arid and tropical regions. Here, we show that antecedent drought development is linked to distinct, region-dependent pathways from drought to extreme precipitation, providing a basis for anticipating compound hydrological extremes.
title_zh: 干旱发展特征通过不同的陆-气反馈调节全球干湿急转
abstract_zh: 从干旱到极端降水的快速转变可引发级联影响，但先前干旱发展对后续降水的影响仍不明确。我们使用全球事件尺度框架识别了干-湿急转事件，并将其划分为连续的干旱期和湿润期。这些事件约发生在32%的干旱之后，且在1951-2020年期间，所评估的26个IPCC-SREX区域中有58%的区域其频率显著增加。基于模型的分析表明，干旱发展特征为区分后续是否发生极端降水的干旱贡献了25.7%的预测信息。快速而强烈的土壤水分下降与较早、更多对流的降水相关，尤其是在中高纬度气候过渡区域，而 prolonged 且严重的干旱发展则与较晚、更多层状云的降水相关，尤其是在干旱和热带地区。在此，我们表明先前的干旱发展与从干旱到极端降水的、依赖于区域的不同路径相关联，为预见复合型水文极端事件提供了基础。

title: Model-free pattern separation of two-color ultrafast X-ray diffraction
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Two-color X-ray imaging with Free Electron Laser pulses offers a powerful approach for probing ultrafast structural dynamics in nanoscale systems, combining (near-)atomic spatial resolution with femtosecond temporal precision. The first X-ray pulse captures the object’s initial state, while the second, time-delayed pulse records its subsequent evolution. A key challenge lies in disentangling the two patterns simultaneously recorded by the same detector. We demonstrate the realization of this approach on structurally varying nanoscale particles using two X-ray pulses of different photon energies, 1 and 1.2 keV. Sub-micrometer helium nanodroplets generated in vacuum are irradiated by the two X-ray pulses separated in time by up to 750 femtoseconds. Taking advantage of the high photon-energy resolution of the imaging detector, we separate the overlapping diffraction signals by analyzing individual pixel counts and applying pattern recognition. The helium nanodroplets’ spherical shape allows us to cross-validate this approach by fitting the radial scattering profiles with Mie solutions for abichromatic field. The excellent agreement between the two methods, particularly in the sparsely illuminated outer regions of the diffraction patterns where high-resolution structural information is encoded, highlights the quality of this approach and its potential for future advanced X-ray movie techniques.
title_zh: 双色超快X射线衍射的无模型图案分离
abstract_zh: 利用自由电子激光脉冲进行双色 X 射线成像，将（近）原子空间分辨率与飞秒时间精度相结合，为探测纳米级系统中的超快结构动力学提供了一种强大的方法。第一个 X 射线脉冲捕获物体的初始状态，而第二个延时脉冲记录其随后的演化。一个关键的挑战在于解开同一探测器同时记录的两种模式。我们使用不同光子能量（1 和 1.2 keV）的两个 X 射线脉冲在结构变化的纳米级粒子上演示了这种方法的实现。真空中产生的亚微米氦纳米液滴受到时间间隔高达 750 飞秒的两个 X 射线脉冲的照射。利用成像探测器的高光子能量分辨率，我们通过分析单个像素计数和应用模式识别来分离重叠的衍射信号。氦纳米液滴的球形形状使我们能够通过将径向散射分布与双色场的米氏解拟合来交叉验证这种方法。两种方法之间的出色一致性，特别是在编码高分辨率结构信息的衍射图案的稀疏照明外部区域中，突出了这种方法的质量及其在未来先进 X 射线电影技术中的潜力。

title: Paleogeographic controls on Phanerozoic weathering rates and implications for climate regulation
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Earth’s climate has remained habitable for billions of years, a stability usually attributed to a negative feedback from silicate weathering – the chemical breakdown of silicate rocks on land, which consumes atmospheric carbon dioxide faster as climate warms. However, whether temperature or hydrology primarily drives this feedback remains uncertain. Here we show the two controls leave geographic fingerprints: in an ensemble of climate simulations with randomized continents, temperature-controlled weathering depends on tropical land fraction, whereas hydrology-controlled weathering depends on continental fragmentation. Stronger weathering removes more carbon dioxide, cooling the planet, so each regime predicts anti-correlation between temperature and its controlling geography. Reconstructed global temperatures spanning 480 million years are anti-correlated with tropical land fraction, except from roughly 295 to 200 million years ago – overlapping the supercontinent Pangea – when they anti-correlate with continental fragmentation. The mechanism stabilizing Earth’s climate may thus have evolved, with temperature control apparently dominant for most of this period.
title_zh: 古地理对显生宙风化速率的控制及其对气候调节的启示
abstract_zh: 地球气候在数十亿年间保持宜居，这一稳定性通常归因于硅酸盐风化的负反馈——即陆地硅酸盐岩石的化学分解，其随气候变暖而加快消耗大气二氧化碳。然而，温度还是水文是这一反馈的主要驱动因素仍不确定。在此，我们表明这两种控制因素会留下地理指纹：在一系列具有随机大陆的气候模拟中，温度控制的风化依赖于热带陆地比例，而水文控制的风化依赖于大陆破碎度。更强的风化会移除更多二氧化碳使行星冷却，因此每种机制都预测温度与其控制性地理因素之间存在反相关。跨越4.8亿年的全球温度重建与热带陆地比例呈反相关，但在大约2.95亿至2亿年前——与超大陆泛古陆重叠的时期——温度与大陆破碎度呈反相关。因此，稳定地球气候的机制可能发生了演化，其中温度控制在大部分时期显然占主导地位。

title: Microenvironment-aware transcriptome reconstruction in spatial transcriptomics
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Imaging-based spatial transcriptomics provides single-cell resolution, but remains limited to targeted gene panels, leaving much of the transcriptome and cellular-state variation unobserved. Existing approaches infer unmeasured genes primarily through transcriptional alignment between spatial and reference datasets, which effectively recover broad cell identities, but may not fully capture context-dependent variation within cell types. Here we show that local microenvironmental organization is associated with transcriptional variation beyond cell identity and provides complementary constraints for transcriptome reconstruction. Based on this observation, we present Emerge, a microenvironment-aware framework that integrates transcriptional identity with the local microenvironment to reconstruct transcriptome-scale expression. Across MERFISH and Xenium datasets spanning neural and tumor ecosystems, we show that Emerge improves recovery of structured transcriptional variation and reveals coordinated relationships among cellular states, ecological niches and intercellular communication programs that are only partially captured by targeted gene panels. Together, we demonstrate that Emerge extends transcriptome reconstruction from gene completion to context-aware recovery of cellular states.
title_zh: 空间转录组学中感知微环境的转录组重构
abstract_zh: 基于成像的空间转录组学提供了单细胞分辨率，但仍局限于靶向基因面板，使转录组的很大一部分和细胞状态变异未被观测。现有方法主要通过空间数据与参考数据集之间的转录比对来推断未测量的基因，这可有效恢复广泛的细胞身份，但可能无法完全捕获细胞类型内依赖情境的变异。在此，我们表明局部微环境组织与细胞身份之外的转录变异相关联，并为转录组重建提供了互补约束。基于这一观察，我们提出Emerge，这是一个感知微环境的框架，将转录身份与局部微环境相结合以重建转录组规模的表达。在跨越神经和肿瘤生态系统的MERFISH和Xenium数据集中，我们表明Emerge改进了对结构性转录变异的恢复，并揭示了细胞状态、生态龛位和细胞间通讯程序之间的协调关系，而这些关系仅被靶向基因面板部分捕获。总之，我们证明Emerge将转录组重建从基因补全扩展到对细胞状态的情境感知恢复。

title: Tuning of AMPA receptor activation by inhibitory auxiliary subunits and epilepsy-associated disease mutations
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: AMPA receptors (AMPARs) facilitate excitatory neurotransmission and are implicated in neurological and neuropsychiatric disorders. Binding of the neurotransmitter glutamate triggers AMPAR activation, which is modulated by potentiating and inhibitory auxiliary subunits. While modulation by potentiating auxiliary subunits has been studied extensively, activation involving inhibitory subunits has not been examined. Here, we present structures of the activated GluA2 AMPAR alone and in complex with inhibitory subunits GSG1L or γ5. Our results suggest that gating kinetics strongly depend on auxiliary subunit identity, while pore size and conductance do not. We find that receptor deactivation becomes slower if an auxiliary subunit promotes tightening of the interface between two ligand-binding domain dimers during activation. In addition, we functionally characterize the effects of epilepsy-associated disease mutations on AMPAR activation and desensitization kinetics, displaying strong dependence on the type of bound auxiliary subunit. Modulation by auxiliary subunits therefore has to be considered when designing AMPAR-targeting therapeutics.
title_zh: 抑制性辅助亚基及癫痫相关疾病突变对AMPA受体激活的调控
abstract_zh: AMPA受体（AMPARs）促进兴奋性神经传递，并与神经系统和神经精神疾病相关。神经递质谷氨酸的结合触发AMPAR激活，该过程受增强型和抑制型辅助亚基的调节。尽管增强型辅助亚基的调节作用已被广泛研究，但涉及抑制型亚基的激活过程尚未被考察。本文报道了激活态GluA2 AMPAR单独存在及与抑制型亚基GSG1L或γ5形成复合物的结构。我们的结果表明，门控动力学强烈依赖于辅助亚基的种类，而孔径和电导则不然。我们发现，若辅助亚基在激活过程中促进两个配体结合域二聚体之间界面的收紧，则受体的失活会变慢。此外，我们对癫痫相关疾病突变对AMPAR激活和脱敏动力学的影响进行了功能表征，其影响强烈依赖于所结合辅助亚基的类型。因此，在设计靶向AMPAR的疗法时，必须考虑辅助亚基的调节作用。

title: Multiple overlapping SNARE complexes drive endosome maturation in Drosophila nephrocytes
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Endosomal maturation determines whether internalized cargo is recycled or degraded, yet the logic governing early endosomal fusion remains incompletely defined. Although commonly depicted as a linear Rab5-to-Rab7 transition mediated by a single SNARE pathway, we show that early endosome maturation is driven by multiple parallel, non-interchangeable SNARE complexes. Using Drosophila nephrocytes as a tractable in vivo model, we define a Syx12L–Snap29–Ykt6 complex that mediates homotypic early endosomal fusion and identify two related assemblies–Syx7L–Snap29–Ykt6 and Syx7L–Snap29–Vamp7–that promote later endosomal and lysosomal fusion with distinct Rab requirements. When the canonical Syx12L pathway is disrupted, alternative complexes remain active and generate aberrant endolysosomal swirls which also form in the absence of Rab5 or early endosomal tethers. Thus, Rab5-independent membrane progression toward lysosomes persists but is insufficient to produce fully functional degradative organelles. Together, our findings reveal a network of parallel fusion pathways underlying endosome maturation.
title_zh: 多个重叠的SNARE复合体驱动果蝇肾细胞的内体成熟
abstract_zh: 内体成熟决定了内吞货物是被循环还是被降解，但调控早期内体融合的逻辑仍未被完全阐明。尽管通常被描述为由单一SNARE通路介导的线性Rab5向Rab7转变，我们表明早期内体成熟是由多个平行且不可互换的SNARE复合物驱动的。利用果蝇肾细胞作为易于研究的体内模型，我们定义了一个介导同型早期内体融合的Syx12L–Snap29–Ykt6复合物，并鉴定了两个相关的组装体——Syx7L–Snap29–Ykt6和Syx7L–Snap29–Vamp7——它们以不同的Rab需求促进后续的内体和溶酶体融合。当经典的Syx12L通路被破坏时，替代复合物仍保持活性并产生异常的内溶酶体漩涡，这些漩涡在Rab5或早期内体系链缺失时也会形成。因此，不依赖Rab5的膜向溶酶体的进程持续存在，但不足以产生功能完全的降解性细胞器。总之，我们的发现揭示了内体成熟背后的平行融合通路网络。

title: Weighted sliced inverse regression for scalable supervised dimensionality reduction of spatial transcriptomics data
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: With the rise of spatially resolved transcriptomics biotechnologies, performing spatially-aware analysis of the resulting data is crucial to maximise advances in biological understanding. Dimensionality reduction is a first step in most analyses of spatial transcriptomics data, and common approaches that preserve total variation of gene expression features do not usually preserve biologically meaningful spatial variation. To this end, we develop weighted sliced inverse regression (wSIR), a sufficient dimension reduction technique that aims to retain the predictive power of the spatial coordinates. wSIR is applicable to multiple distinct spatial transcriptomic datasets and is highly scalable, with over 100, 000 cells processed in under two minutes on a standard laptop. The feature loadings are interpretable, and new non-spatial data can be projected into wSIR’s low-dimensional space for downstream analyses. We examine wSIR’s performance and demonstrate its biological relevance through two case studies in human breast cancer and mouse early embryonic development.
title_zh: 加权切片逆回归用于空间转录组学数据的可扩展有监督降维
abstract_zh: 随着空间分辨转录组学生物技术的兴起，对所得数据进行空间感知分析对于最大化生物学理解的进展至关重要。降维是大多数空间转录组学数据分析的第一步，而保留基因表达特征总变异的常用方法通常无法保留具有生物学意义的空间变异。为此，我们开发了加权切片逆回归（wSIR），这是一种充分降维技术，旨在保留空间坐标的预测能力。wSIR适用于多种不同的空间转录组数据集，且具有高度可扩展性，在标准笔记本电脑上两分钟内即可处理超过100,000个细胞。其特征载荷具有可解释性，且新的非空间数据可被投影到wSIR的低维空间中进行下游分析。我们通过人类乳腺癌和小鼠早期胚胎发育的两个案例研究检验了wSIR的性能并证明了其生物学相关性。
