title: Real-time black-box optimization for dynamic discrete environments using embedded Ising machines
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Many real-time systems require the optimization of discrete variables. Black-box optimization (BBO) algorithms and multi-armed bandit (MAB) algorithms perform optimization by repeatedly taking actions and observing the corresponding immediate rewards without any prior knowledge. Recently, a BBO method using an Ising machine has been proposed to find the best action represented by a combination of discrete values and maximize the immediate reward in static environments. By contrast, real-time systems operate in dynamic environments and necessitate MAB algorithms that maximize the average reward over repeated trials. Due to the enormous number of actions resulting from the combinatorial nature of discrete optimization, conventional MAB algorithms cannot effectively optimize actions for dynamic, discrete environments. Here, we show a heuristic method to maximize the average reward for dynamic discrete environments by extending the BBO method, in which an Ising machine efficiently explores actions while accounting for interactions between variables and environmental changes. We demonstrate the adaptability to dynamic environments of the proposed method in a wireless communication system with moving users.
title_zh: 利用嵌入式伊辛机实现动态离散环境的实时黑箱优化
abstract_zh: 许多实时系统需要对离散变量进行优化。黑箱优化（BBO）算法和多臂老虎机（MAB）算法通过反复执行动作并观测相应的即时奖励、在没有任何先验知识的情况下进行优化。最近，有研究提出了一种利用Ising机的BBO方法，用于寻找由离散值组合表示的最佳动作，并在静态环境中最大化即时奖励。相比之下，实时系统运行于动态环境中，需要在反复试验中最大化平均奖励的MAB算法。由于离散优化的组合特性导致动作数量极其庞大，传统MAB算法无法在动态离散环境中有效地优化动作。在此，我们展示了一种通过扩展上述BBO方法来最大化动态离散环境平均奖励的启发式方法，其中Ising机在考虑变量间相互作用和环境变化的同时高效地探索动作。我们在具有移动用户的无线通信系统中验证了该方法对动态环境的适应性。

title: Biomimetic EUK-134 Synergy Strategy for Dynamic Cyclic Antioxidant Defense and Defect Passivation in Perovskite Solar Cells
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Organic–inorganic hybrid perovskites are highly susceptible to oxidative degradation under illumination and oxygen exposure. The primary degradation mechanism involves photogenerated electrons reducing adsorbed oxygen to form highly reactive superoxide radicals (O2•–). These radicals not only initiate lattice iodide loss and organic cation volatilization but also produce hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) as a dismutation byproduct, which further accelerates material decomposition and severely compromises long-term stability. Here, we introduce the biomimetic enzyme mimetic EUK-134 into the perovskite precursor solution, which possesses dual superoxide dismutase (SOD) and catalase (CAT) activities. It effectively scavenges O2•– and decomposes H2O2, blocking the reactive oxygen species (ROS)-mediated degradation pathway. Concurrently, the Cl– ions from EUK-134 modulate perovskite crystallization and fill iodide vacancies, whereas the phenolic oxygen groups passivate undercoordinated Pb2+ sites. This synergistic effect achieves a champion power conversion efficiency of 24.48%. Notably, the unencapsulated device retains 90.39% of its initial efficiency after 2000 h of aging in nitrogen and maintains 75.45% after 1000 h under ambient conditions (25 °C, RH ≈ 40–60%, room light), significantly outperforming the control device. This work provides a reliable and powerful strategy for fabricating highly stable and long-lived photovoltaic devices.
title_zh: 仿生 EUK-134 协同策略用于钙钛矿太阳能电池的动态循环抗氧化防御与缺陷钝化
abstract_zh: 摘要 有机-无机杂化钙钛矿在光照和氧气暴露下极易发生氧化降解。其主要降解机制涉及光生电子还原吸附的氧，生成高反应性的超氧自由基（O2•–）。这些自由基不仅引发晶格碘化物损失和有机阳离子挥发，还产生歧化副产物过氧化氢（H2O2），进一步加速材料分解并严重损害长期稳定性。在此，我们将仿生酶模拟物EUK-134引入钙钛矿前驱体溶液，其兼具超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和过氧化氢酶（CAT）双重活性。它能有效清除O2•–并分解H2O2，阻断活性氧（ROS）介导的降解途径。同时，EUK-134中的Cl–离子调控钙钛矿结晶并填充碘空位，而酚氧基团钝化欠配位的Pb2+位点。这种协同效应实现了24.48%的冠军光电转换效率。值得注意的是，未封装器件在氮气中老化2000小时后保持其初始效率的90.39%，并在环境条件下（25 °C，RH ≈ 40–60%，室内光照）1000小时后保持75.45%，显著优于对照器件。这项工作为制造高稳定性、长寿命光伏器件提供了一种可靠而强有力的策略。

title: Using Ag nanoclusters to achieve mutually reinforcing water desalination and sterilization
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Sustainable water purification requires simultaneous desalination and disinfection, yet integrated solutions remain challenging due to mutual interference between the two processes. Here, we report a synchronous capacitive desalination-sterilization (CDIS) system driven by a rationally engineered dual-functional anode of silver nanoclusters embedded in carbon nanofibers (Ag NCs@CNF). This electrode uniquely combines efficient chloride-ion storage with molecular-ike electrocatalytic activity, enabling concurrent high-capacity desalination (84.25 mgCl g−1) and complete sterilization ( > 4.0 log reduction, detection limit) via in situ reactive species (RS) generation. Beyond performance, we provide the unambiguous mechanistic insight into microbe-ion dynamics in capacitive systems. Contrary to the spatial-competition paradigm, we reveal that performance decay primarily stems from electrostatic shielding by live bacteria, while inactivated cells undergo a fragmentation-aggregation process that eliminates shielding. Remarkably, bacterial inactivation further enhances cycling stability by scavenging RS and mitigating anode oxidation. This work establishes an efficient integrated electrochemical purification platform and offers a theoretical framework for designing sustainable water-treatment technologies.
title_zh: 利用银纳米团簇实现海水淡化与灭菌的相互强化
abstract_zh: 可持续的水净化需要同时实现脱盐和消毒，但由于两个过程之间的相互干扰，一体化解决方案仍具挑战性。在此，我们报道了一种由合理设计的双功能阳极——嵌入碳纳米纤维中的银纳米簇（Ag NCs@CNF）——驱动的同步电容脱盐-杀菌（CDIS）系统。该电极独特地将高效的氯离子存储与类分子电催化活性相结合，通过原位产生活性物种（RS），实现高容量脱盐（84.25 mgCl g−1）与完全杀菌（>4.0 log降低，检测限）的同步进行。除性能之外，我们还对电容系统中的微生物-离子动力学提供了明确的机制认识。与空间竞争范式相反，我们揭示性能衰减主要源于活菌的静电屏蔽，而失活细胞则经历消除屏蔽的碎片化-聚集过程。值得注意的是，细菌失活通过清除RS和减轻阳极氧化进一步提高了循环稳定性。这项工作建立了一个高效的集成电化学净化平台，并为设计可持续水处理技术提供了理论框架。

title: Noncollinear kagome magnet driven by giant antisymmetric exchange
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Kagome lattices host exotic phenomena such as quantum spin liquids, topological Weyl nodes, and flat bands. The kagome ferromagnet Co3Sn2S2 has been a focus of debate due to conflicting reports on its magnetic character. Here, using weakly perturbative probes—primarily neutron scattering and Mössbauer spectroscopy—we determine its ground state and magnetic Hamiltonian. The spin wave spectrum is reproduced by a simple Hamiltonian dominated by a large in-plane nearest-neighbor Heisenberg interaction J and an antisymmetric Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction that is roughly one third of J. This Hamiltonian yields a canted, noncollinear ferromagnetic ground state with an umbrella-type structure, which our data show to be the true ground state at all temperatures below TC. Additionally, the spin susceptibility above TC exhibits a reduced critical exponent, akin to other spin-anisotropic systems. Our findings explain the unconventional magnetism in Co3Sn2S2, including the giant anomalous Hall effect and the origin of chiral phonons.
title_zh: 巨型反对称交换驱动的非共线笼目磁体
abstract_zh: Kagome 晶格具有量子自旋液体、拓扑韦尔节点和平带等奇异现象。由于关于其磁性特性的报道相互矛盾，kagome 铁磁体 Co3Sn2S2 一直是争论的焦点。在这里，我们使用弱微扰探针（主要是中子散射和穆斯堡尔谱）确定其基态和磁哈密顿量。自旋波谱由一个简单的哈密顿量再现，该哈密顿量由一个大的面内最近邻海森堡相互作用 J 和大约是 J 的三分之一的反对称 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用控制。这个哈密顿量产生一个倾斜的非共线铁磁基态，具有伞形结构，我们的数据显示在低于 TC 的所有温度下都是真实的基态。此外，高于 TC 的自旋敏感性表现出降低的临界指数，类似于其他自旋各向异性系统。我们的研究结果解释了 Co3Sn2S2 的非常规磁性，包括巨大的反常霍尔效应和手性声子的起源。

title: Interfacial hydride transfer for dehalogenation with water
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Reductive dehalogenation of organohalides through hydrodehalogenation with water is critical for environmental and chemical industries. Conventional hydrodehalogenation proceeds via electron transfer pathways (e.g., stepwise electron/hydrogen radical transfer, or two-electron transfer followed by protonation), which are often hampered by limited dehalogenation kinetics and selectivity. While the interfacial transfer of reductive hydride (Hδ−) species presents a compelling concerted two-electron pathway, its application has been constrained by the difficult surface hydride formation under mild conditions. Here, we overcome this challenge by developing mechanochemically activated zero-valent iron (ZVI) that generates reactive silicon-hydride (Si–Hδ⁻) species in the presence of trace water. Trace water induces ZVI corrosion to produce H2, which is heterolytically cleaved by in situ formed surface Siδ+–Oδ⁻ Lewis pairs, yielding nucleophilic Si–Hδ⁻ motifs. These motifs drive direct interfacial hydride transfer for highly efficient hydrodehalogenation and regioselective deuteration with rate constants 2-50 times greater than conventional radical-based hydrogen transfer on ZVI. The water-mediated regeneration of the hydride donor enables continuous-flow decontamination of actual halogenated groundwater and valorization of organohalides into high-purity deuterated products with selectivity of 93.4%. This work presents a promising mechanochemical platform that suggests a more sustainable approach for selective hydrodehalogenation of organohalides.
title_zh: 界面氢化物转移用于水的脱卤反应
abstract_zh: 通过用水加氢脱卤来还原有机卤化物对于环境和化学工业至关重要。传统的加氢脱卤通过电子转移途径（例如逐步电子/氢自由基转移，或质子化后的双电子转移）进行，这通常受到有限的脱卤动力学和选择性的阻碍。虽然还原性氢化物（Hδ−）物质的界面转移呈现出引人注目的协同双电子途径，但其应用受到温和条件下难以形成表面氢化物的限制。在这里，我们通过开发机械化学活化的零价铁（ZVI）克服了这一挑战，该零价铁在微量水存在下产生反应性氢化硅（Si–Hδ⁻）物质。微量水诱导 ZVI 腐蚀产生 H2，H2 被原位形成的表面 Siδ+–Oδ⁻ 路易斯对异解裂解，产生亲核 Si–Hδ⁻ 基序。这些基序驱动直接界面氢化物转移，以实现高效加氢脱卤和区域选择性氘化，其速率常数比 ZVI 上传统的基于自由基的氢转移大 2-50 倍。氢化物供体的水介导再生能够对实际卤化地下水进行连续流动净化，并将有机卤化物增值为高纯度氘代产品，选择性为 93.4%。这项工作提出了一个有前途的机械化学平台，提出了一种更可持续的有机卤化物选择性加氢脱卤方法。

title: General access to azoles through tailored nitrogen–nitrogen bond construction
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Cyclic compounds containing a nitrogen-nitrogen bond are highly significant in chemistry and pharmacology due to their unique structures and versatile chemical properties. The diverse range of available cyclic nitrogen–nitrogen containing compounds offers numerous applications due to their stability, reactivity, and biological activity, making them attractive targets for diverse applications, from materials science to medicinal chemistry. In materials science, their optical and electronic properties make them useful in dyes, pigments, and photoresponsive materials and in medicinal chemistry they provide a foundational scaffold for creating drugs with specific biological functions, particularly in targeting nucleic acids, enzymes, and receptors. However, technologies that enable direct construction of the key nitrogen–nitrogen bond are elusive. Here, this limitation is addressed by disclosing a tailored copper-mediated technology that enables direct nitrogen–nitrogen bond formation from prevalent reagents. The developed process is believed to proceed through a decarboxylative skeletal editing pathway involving both carbon–nitrogen bond cleavage and nitrogen–nitrogen bond construction, offering a modular approach for straightforward access to a wide set of decorated nitrogen-containing heterocyclic scaffolds for widespread adoption.
title_zh: 通过定制氮–氮键构建普遍合成唑类化合物
abstract_zh: 含有氮-氮键的环状化合物由于其独特的结构和多种化学性质，在化学和药理学中具有非常重要的意义。各种可用的环状氮-含氮化合物由于其稳定性、反应性和生物活性而提供了多种应用，使它们成为从材料科学到药物化学等各种应用的有吸引力的目标。在材料科学中，它们的光学和电子特性使其可用于染料、颜料和光响应材料，在药物化学中，它们为创造具有特定生物功能的药物提供了基础支架，特别是在靶向核酸、酶和受体方面。然而，能够直接构建关键氮-氮键的技术却难以捉摸。在这里，通过公开一种定制的铜介导技术来解决这一限制，该技术能够从常用试剂直接形成氮-氮键。据信，所开发的过程通过脱羧骨架编辑途径进行，涉及碳-氮键断裂和氮-氮键构建，提供了一种模块化方法，可以直接获得广泛的装饰含氮杂环支架以供广泛采用。

title: High-resolution structures of human NHE6 and NHE9 elucidate endosomal ion and lipid interactions
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Endosomal NHE6 (SLC9A6) and NHE9 (SLC9A9) transporters are essential for maintaining pH homeostasis within endosomes and their dysfunction has been linked to neurological and neurodegenerative disorders. NHE6 and NHE9 are widely considered to function as electroneutral exchangers that couple the export of protons to the import of sodium or potassium ions across cellular membranes, thereby forming the basis of proton leak pathways for internal pH balancing and fine-tuning. Among the 13 identified SLC9 family members, only NHE6 and NHE9 are targeted to endosomes. Despite their biological importance and therapeutic potential, the structural basis for their activity and regulation remains elusive. Here, we present the cryo-EM structures of human NHE9 and two splice variants of NHE6 that differ by alternative inclusion of the β-hairpin motif-containing loop domain located between transmembrane helices 2 and 3, showcasing structural diversity within the organellar NHE subfamily. By mapping the sodium-binding site, our results provide mechanistic insights into ion transport, and for NHE6 we provide evidence for a conserved PIP2-mediated regulatory mechanism. These findings provide a framework for understanding endosomal NHE function with implications for disorders such as Alzheimer’s disease and glioblastoma.
title_zh: 人源NHE6和NHE9的高分辨率结构阐明内体离子与脂质相互作用
abstract_zh: 内体 NHE6 (SLC9A6) 和 NHE9 (SLC9A9) 转运蛋白对于维持内体内 pH 稳态至关重要，其功能障碍与神经系统和神经退行性疾病有关。 NHE6 和 NHE9 被广泛认为是电中性交换器，可将质子的输出与跨细胞膜的钠或钾离子的输入耦合起来，从而形成内部 pH 平衡和微调的质子泄漏途径的基础。在已确定的 13 个 SLC9 家族成员中，只有 NHE6 和 NHE9 靶向内体。尽管它们具有生物学重要性和治疗潜力，但其活性和调节的结构基础仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们展示了人类 NHE9 和 NHE6 的两个剪接变体的冷冻电镜结构，它们的不同之处在于位于跨膜螺旋 2 和 3 之间的包含 β-发夹基序的环结构域的选择性包含，展示了细胞器 NHE 亚家族内的结构多样性。通过绘制钠结合位点图谱，我们的结果提供了离子传输的机制见解，并且对于 NHE6，我们为保守的 PIP2 介导的调节机制提供了证据。这些发现为理解内体 NHE 功能提供了一个框架，并对阿尔茨海默病和胶质母细胞瘤等疾病具有影响。

title: Heterogeneity in the response to the metabolic environment drives fosfomycin heteroresistance
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Heteroresistance is a form of antibiotic resistance in which a phenotypically unstable subpopulation of resistant cells coexists with a majority susceptible population. Many mechanisms of heteroresistance are unclear and the impact of the extracellular environment on this phenomenon is unknown. Studying fosfomycin heteroresistance in Enterobacter cloacae complex, we observed that glucose availability greatly increased the frequency of the resistant subpopulation. Glucose downregulated the glycerol and fosfomycin importer GlpT via catabolite repression. Heteroresistance was generated by heterogeneity in single-cell expression of GlpT, in addition to expression of fosA, which acted as a resistance enhancer. Due to the impact of environmental glucose on glpT expression, we observed that the resistant subpopulation was more frequent during infection in murine models of hyperglycemia/diabetes. Thus, we reveal a paradigm where heterogeneity in response to the environment tunes resistant subpopulation frequency, which suggests that the metabolic context of infection in specific disease states may be important to consider in treatment decisions.
title_zh: 对代谢环境响应的异质性驱动磷霉素异质性耐药
abstract_zh: 异质性耐药是抗生素耐药的一种形式，其中表型不稳定的耐药细胞亚群与占多数的敏感菌群共存。许多异质性耐药机制尚不清楚，细胞外环境对该现象的影响也不得而知。在研究阴沟肠杆菌复合群（Enterobacter cloacae complex）对磷霉素的异质性耐药时，我们观察到葡萄糖的可利用性显著增加了耐药亚群的出现频率。葡萄糖通过代谢物阻遏下调了甘油和磷霉素转运蛋白GlpT的表达。异质性耐药由GlpT单细胞表达的异质性以及作为耐药增强因子的fosA表达共同产生。由于环境葡萄糖对glpT表达的影响，我们观察到在高血糖/糖尿病小鼠模型感染期间耐药亚群更为常见。因此，我们揭示了一种范例，即对环境响应的异质性调节了耐药亚群的频率，这提示在治疗决策中应考虑特定疾病状态下感染的代谢背景可能具有重要意义。

title: Microbial-derived tryptophan metabolites in the infant gut associate with increased risk of asthma following cesarean section
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Delivery by cesarean section (CS) is a risk factor for childhood asthma and a strong determinant of the early-life gut microbiome. It has been reported that a CS-perturbed gut microbiome plays a mediating role in the association between CS and asthma risk. However, the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Here, using deeply phenotyped participants in the Canadian birth cohort (CHILD), we characterized the CS microbial composition at 3 months and 1 year of age using machine learning models and described the perturbation using CS scores. The association between CS and the gut microbiota composition was more pronounced at 3 months (area under the curve (AUC) = 0.78) and attenuated at age 1 year (AUC = 0.60). An increased asthma risk at age 5 years was associated only with 1-year CS microbial scores (Odds ratio 1.41, P = 0.004; adjusted odds ratio 1.30, P = 0.034), consistent with our previous work. Extending this, we identified metabolic imbalances associated with 1-year CS microbial scores, marked by elevated tryptophan metabolites in the stool metabolome. These results replicate our previous findings about the mediating role of the 1-year CS microbial signature in the association between CS and asthma risk from the Danish COPSAC2010 cohort, and provide new insight into the underlying mechanism of host-microbe interaction following cesarean section.
title_zh: 婴儿肠道中微生物来源的色氨酸代谢物与剖宫产后哮喘风险升高相关
abstract_zh: 剖宫产（CS）分娩是儿童哮喘的危险因素，也是生命早期肠道微生物组的强决定因素。据报告，受CS扰动的肠道微生物组在CS与哮喘风险的关联中起中介作用。然而，其潜在机制仍不清楚。在此，我们利用加拿大出生队列（CHILD）中深度表型化的参与者，使用机器学习模型表征了3个月和1岁时的CS微生物组成，并用CS评分描述这种扰动。CS与肠道微生物群组成之间的关联在3个月时更为显著（曲线下面积（AUC）=0.78），并在1岁时减弱（AUC=0.60）。5岁时哮喘风险的增加仅与1岁CS微生物评分相关（比值比1.41，P=0.004；校正比值比1.30，P=0.034），这与我们先前的 work 一致。在此基础上，我们鉴定了与1岁CS微生物评分相关的代谢失衡，其特征为粪便代谢组中色氨酸代谢物升高。这些结果重复了我们先前关于1岁CS微生物特征在CS与哮喘风险关联中中介作用的发现（来自丹麦COPSAC2010队列），并为剖宫产后宿主-微生物相互作用的潜在机制提供了新见解。

title: Sensory plasticity of dorsal horn silent neurons as a critical mechanism for neuropathic pain
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The spinal cord dorsal horn (DH) integrates sensory processing but undergoes critical plasticity following nerve injury, leading to mechanical allodynia, or “touch-evoked pain”. It has been proposed that after nerve injury, innocuous sensory neurons gain access to nociceptive-specific (NS) circuits in the DH due to altered spinal inhibitory controls, thereby converting touch into pain. It is however unclear how sensory processing is reorganized under these conditions to generate this symptom. In this study, we used two-photon calcium imaging in mice to show that spinal disinhibition or nerve injury converts most DH excitatory neurons into highly polymodal cells, and unmasks an unprecedented number of previously silent neurons responding to a wide dynamic range (WDR) of sensory modalities. Using computational modeling, we further show that neuropathic pain likely does not result primarily from the transformation of excitatory NS neurons into WDR neurons, but rather from the activation of this previously dormant circuit.
title_zh: 背角沉默神经元的感觉可塑性是神经病理性疼痛的关键机制
abstract_zh: 脊髓背角（DH）整合感觉处理，但在神经损伤后经历关键的可塑性变化，导致机械性异常性疼痛，即“触诱发痛”。有观点提出，神经损伤后，由于脊髓抑制性调控的改变，无害性感觉神经元得以进入背角中伤害感受特异性（NS）回路，从而将触觉转化为疼痛。然而，在这些条件下感觉处理如何被重组以产生这一症状仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们利用小鼠双光子钙成像表明，脊髓去抑制或神经损伤将大多数背角兴奋性神经元转变为高度多模态细胞，并揭示了数量空前的先前沉默的神经元对广泛动态范围（WDR）的感觉模态产生反应。通过计算建模，我们进一步表明，神经病理性疼痛可能并非主要源于兴奋性NS神经元向WDR神经元的转化，而是源于这一先前休眠回路的激活。

title: Longitudinal evidence for decreasing statistical learning abilities across childhood
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Statistical learning enables us to identify patterns in our environment and predict future events, thereby supporting a range of motor, cognitive, and linguistic skills. Despite its significance, the developmental trajectory of statistical learning has remained unclear due to a lack of comprehensive longitudinal studies. Cross-sectional research has hinted at enhanced statistical learning in children up to 11-13 years, followed by a decline into adulthood, yet definitive insights require a longitudinal approach. Our study addresses this gap by assessing statistical learning in the same participants at ages 7, 8, 11, and 14. Utilising linear mixed models and latent class analyses, we observe a decline in statistical learning with age, and find that higher executive functions—cognitive functions that underlie higher-order goal-directed behaviour—are associated with this decline. This study provides evidence that statistical learning is more effective in early childhood, offering insights into the developmental trajectory of this fundamental cognitive ability.
title_zh: 儿童期统计学习能力随年龄增长而下降的纵向证据
abstract_zh: 统计学习使我们能够识别环境中的模式并预测未来事件，从而支持一系列运动、认知和语言技能。尽管其意义重大，但由于缺乏全面的纵向研究，统计学习的发展轨迹一直不明确。横断面研究提示，儿童在11-13岁之前统计学习增强，随后到成年期下降，但确切的结论需要纵向方法。我们的研究通过对同一批参与者在7岁、8岁、11岁和14岁进行统计学习评估来弥补这一空白。利用线性混合模型和潜在类别分析，我们观察到统计学习随年龄下降，并发现较高的执行功能——支撑高阶目标导向行为的认知功能——与这一下降相关。本研究提供了统计学习在幼儿期更为有效的证据，为这一基本认知能力的发展轨迹提供了洞见。

title: Offline generative network reconfiguration guides insight-like accelerated learning by assimilation into schema in rats
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Complex cross-modal de-novo associative learning generally requires numerous encoding exposures, but acquisition of an underlying mental schema of associative abstract rules enables insight-like accelerated new learning. Reports indicate that post-encoding sleep/rest offline epochs play an active role in insight learning, but the supporting neuronal ensemble mechanisms remained elusive. We developed a complex cross-modal learning task where six cue-place paired-associations (PAs) learned by male rats over weeks created a mental schema that enabled rapid within-day acquisition of 3-6 novel PAs. Simultaneous electrophysiological recording of hippocampus (HPC)-medial prefrontal (mPFC) ensembles across exploration-rest-sleep states indicated that accelerated learning of new PAs combined inferential activation of HPC map-based cue-place abstract associations and offline generative network reconfiguration in coordination with mPFC generalized outcome coding. HPC network reconfiguration during post-encoding sleep/rest predicted insight-like accelerated learning of 3-6 new PAs that consolidated and transferred rapidly via ripple-coordinated cell-assembly co-activation to mPFC. HPC ripple disruption during post-encoding sleep/rest prevented schema-based accelerated learning. Our findings reveal that map-based associative inference via offline predictive HPC-mPFC generative network reconfiguration supports insight-like accelerated learning by assimilation into schema and systems consolidation.
title_zh: 离线生成网络重构通过同化到图式中引导大鼠顿悟式加速学习
abstract_zh: 复杂的跨模态去新异联想学习通常需要多次编码暴露，但获取联想抽象规则的潜在心理图式能够实现顿悟式的加速新学习。有报告指出，编码后睡眠/休息的离线时期在顿悟学习中发挥主动作用，但其背后的神经元集群机制仍不清楚。我们开发了一项复杂的跨模态学习任务，雄性大鼠经过数周学习六组线索-位置配对联想（PAs）后形成了心理图式，使其能够在一天内快速习得3-6组新的PAs。在海马（HPC）-内侧前额叶（mPFC）集群跨越探索-休息-睡眠状态的同步电生理记录表明，新PAs的加速学习结合了基于HPC地图的线索-位置抽象联想的推理激活，以及与mPFC广义结果编码相协调的离线生成性网络重构。编码后睡眠/休息期间的HPC网络重构可预测3-6组新PAs的顿悟式加速学习，这些新PAs通过涟波协同的细胞集群共激活被快速巩固并转移到mPFC。编码后睡眠/休息期间的HPC涟波干扰阻断了基于图式的加速学习。我们的研究揭示，通过离线预测性的HPC-mPFC生成性网络重构实现的基于地图的联想推理，以同化入图式和系统巩固的方式支持顿悟式加速学习。

title: Diverse biosynthetic pathways in Arctic hydrothermal biofilms
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) which encode diverse secondary metabolites are ubiquitous across microbiomes and support critical ecological functions. They also serve as attractive targets for new drug discovery. Here we combined genome-resolved metagenomics with long-read Nanopore RNA sequencing, yielding 1016 bacterial and 124 archaeal medium-to-high quality MAGs from previously unchartered microbial communities in Arctic hydrothermal vent biofilms. We identified 2965 BGCs from 870 metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs) comprising a distinctive and rich diversity of BGCs, with ribosomally synthesized and post-translationally modified peptides (RiPPs) predominating across all samples. RiPPs and non-ribosomal peptide synthetases (NRPs), also known to encode metabolites with antimicrobial potential, are represented among the most expressed transcripts. Terpenes, though less expressed, contribute to microbial signaling and defense. Notably, we identify hydrogen cyanide (HCN) synthesis pathways in archaeal genomes, challenging the view that cyanogenesis is restricted to bacteria and eukaryotes. Our findings demonstrate that microbial adaptation to extreme environments favors RiPP-based biosynthesis and that HCN may play a role in archaeal ecological interactions. Moreover, microbial communities in Arctic hydrothermal vent biofilms provide a rich reservoir of unique bioactive compounds, with implications for drug discovery.
title_zh: 北极热液生物膜中多样的生物合成途径
abstract_zh: 编码多种次级代谢产物的生物合成基因簇（BGCs）在微生物组中普遍存在，并支持关键的生态功能。它们也是新药发现的重要靶标。本研究将基因组解析宏基因组学与长读长Nanopore RNA测序相结合，从此前未知的北极热液喷口生物膜微生物群落中获得了1016个细菌和124个古菌中等至高质量的MAGs。我们从870个宏基因组组装基因组（MAGs）中鉴定出2965个BGCs，其BGCs具有独特而丰富的多样性，其中核糖体合成并经翻译后修饰的肽（RiPPs）在所有样品中占主导地位。已知可编码具有抗菌潜力代谢产物的RiPPs和非核糖体肽合成酶（NRPs）也在表达量最高的转录本之列。萜类虽然表达量较低，但对微生物信号传导和防御具有贡献。值得注意的是，我们在古菌基因组中鉴定到氰化氢（HCN）合成通路，挑战了产氰作用仅限于细菌和真核生物的观点。我们的研究结果表明，微生物对极端环境的适应有利于基于RiPPs的生物合成，并且HCN可能在古菌生态相互作用中发挥作用。此外，北极热液喷口生物膜中的微生物群落为药物发现提供了丰富的独特生物活性化合物资源。

title: Increased encoding of aversive stimuli by lateral habenula neurons during Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol withdrawal
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The lateral habenula (LHb) integrates cortical and basal forebrain (BF) input and is implicated in negative affective states, but its involvement in negative affect associated with cannabis withdrawal is unknown. Here, effects of withdrawal from the psychoactive cannabis constituent, Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol (Δ9-THC), on fear conditioning (FC) and LHb function were measured in rats using calcium photometry and electrophysiology. FC-associated LHb calcium signals, freezing behavior, and LHb excitatory-inhibitory (E-I) ratios were increased during Δ9-THC withdrawal, and local GABA release was impaired, indicating disinhibition of LHb output neurons. GABA release was also impaired at optogenetically activated BF-LHb axons, and not from ventral tegmental area-LHb inputs. The results indicate that Δ9-THC withdrawal increases LHb excitability through disinhibition, contributing to increased fear of primary and conditioned aversive stimuli. Our findings implicate the LHb in cannabis withdrawal-associated negative affect and offer insight into the neural mechanisms of cannabis use disorder.
title_zh: Δ9-四氢大麻酚戒断期间外侧缰核神经元对厌恶性刺激编码增强
abstract_zh: 外侧缰核（LHb）整合皮层和基底前脑（BF）的输入，并与负性情感状态相关，但其在戒断大麻相关的负性情感中的作用尚不清楚。本研究中，通过钙光度测量和电生理学方法，检测了大鼠戒断大麻精神活性成分Δ9-四氢大麻酚（Δ9-THC）后对恐惧条件反射（FC）和LHb功能的影响。在Δ9-THC戒断期间，FC相关的LHb钙信号、僵滞行为以及LHb兴奋-抑制（E-I）比值升高，局部GABA释放受损，表明LHb输出神经元发生去抑制。光遗传激活的BF-LHb轴突的GABA释放同样受损，而腹侧被盖区-LHb输入则不受影响。结果表明，Δ9-THC戒断通过去抑制增加LHb兴奋性，导致对初级和条件性厌恶性刺激的恐惧增强。我们的发现提示LHb参与大麻戒断相关的负性情感，并为大麻使用障碍的神经机制提供了见解。

title: Spatial transcriptomics reveals laminar and cell-type-specific A-to-I RNA editing signatures in the macaque cortex
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: ADAR-mediated A-to-I RNA editing is crucial for proper neuronal function. However, its spatial signatures in the cerebral cortex remain largely unexplored. To address this, we developed SRDRE, an analysis framework for identifying RNA editing sites in spatial transcriptomics data. By analyzing over 40 million cells across 142 spatially annotated cortical regions in the adult macaque cortex, we uncovered laminar and cell-type-specific RNA editing landscapes. Notably, neuronal RNA editing levels correlated with cortical hierarchy in the visual and somatosensory systems. Parvalbumin neurons exhibited the highest editing activity in most regions. Furthermore, we identified primate-enriched sites within ion channel genes, specifically in excitatory neuronal subtypes of the prefrontal cortex. Finally, in a preliminary exploratory analysis, we observed altered RNA editing in deeper layers of the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex in macaques exhibiting depressive-like behaviors, suggesting a potential link that warrants further investigation. These findings underscore the role of RNA editing and its potential contributions to cortical specialization, brain evolution, and neuropsychiatric disorders.
title_zh: 空间转录组学揭示猕猴皮层中分层和细胞类型特异的A-to-I RNA编辑特征
abstract_zh: ADAR介导的A-to-I RNA编辑对正常的神经元功能至关重要。然而，其在大脑皮层中的空间特征在很大程度上尚未被探索。为此，我们开发了SRDRE，一个用于在空间转录组学数据中识别RNA编辑位点的分析框架。通过分析成年猕猴皮层中142个空间标注皮层区域的超过4000万个细胞，我们揭示了分层的和细胞类型特异性的RNA编辑图谱。值得注意的是，神经元RNA编辑水平在视觉和体感系统中与皮层层级相关。小白蛋白神经元在大多数区域表现出最高的编辑活性。此外，我们在离子通道基因中鉴定出灵长类富集的编辑位点， particularly 位于前额叶皮层的兴奋性神经元亚型中。最后，在一项初步的探索性分析中，我们观察到表现出抑郁样行为的猕猴其背外侧前额叶皮层深层RNA编辑发生改变，提示二者之间存在值得进一步研究的潜在联系。这些发现凸显了RNA编辑的作用及其对皮层特化、大脑演化和神经精神疾病的潜在贡献。

title: Site-specific programming characterizes dynamic post-translational acetylation of histone H2B lysine 108 in mouse embryonic stem cells
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Dynamic histone modifications are critical for regulating stem cell fate. However, generalized strategies for site-specific programming of histone modifications profiling on unperturbed chromatin in embryonic stem cells (ESCs) remain challenging. In this study, we established a genetic code expansion-based platform in mouse ESCs (mESCs) for site-specific proteomic mapping and functional analysis within native chromatin. Using this platform, we revealed Rps19bp1 promotes Sirt1-mediated deacetylation of histone H2B lysine 108 acetylation (H2B-K108ac). Moreover, Site-specific-AcK revealed that H2B-K108ac induces the formation of H2B puncta and modulates chromatin accessibility. Functionally, elevation of H2B-K108ac via genetic code expansion and the loss of Rps19bp1 cause significant alterations in the expression of genes associated with mESC differentiation. Furthermore, Rps19bp1 deficiency promotes neural differentiation in mESC-derived teratoma. Our study develops a robust platform for linking specific histone acetylation with chromatin dynamics and cell fate determination, which lays a foundation for future exploration of additional histone PTMs in ESCs.

title: Yellow protein co-opted to sustain obligate symbiosis in leaf beetles
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Yellow proteins are best known for their roles in pigmentation, behavior, and development across insects. Here, we uncover their striking evolutionary co-option for a wholly distinct function: sustaining a Paleocene-aged digestive symbiosis in tortoise beetles. We show that a female-specific Yellow forms the gelatinous spheres that encapsulate the bacterium Stammera during vertical transmission, allowing it to subsist extracellularly despite its drastically reduced genome (0.24 Mb) and limited metabolic capacity. Yellow expression is highly localized to symbiont-harboring glands in the ovaries, where the protein is assembled into a matrix and secreted during egg-laying. Functional knockdown of yellow disrupts sphere integrity and compromises symbiont viability under dry conditions, underscoring the protein’s embedding properties and protective role for Stammera. These findings reveal a novel function for an ancient gene family and demonstrate how tortoise beetles have repurposed Yellows to overcome the extreme metabolic constraints faced by their symbionts during extracellular transmission.
title_zh: 叶甲虫中 Yellow 蛋白被招募以维持专性共生

title: Low-Dimensional Ionotronics
abstract: Abstract Ionotronics encompasses a broad range of phenomena and devices based either on the electron-controlled manipulation of ions in electrolytic media or on the use of ionic behavior to control electronic functionality. Although the term itself is relatively recent, the scientific foundations of ionotronics span more than a century of research. Owing to their promising applications in areas ranging from energy storage and harvesting to robotic actuation, nanofiltration, water desalination, sensing, and neuromorphic computation, ionotronic systems have recently attracted rapidly growing attention, particularly in the context of low-dimensional electrodes. These advanced architectures can profoundly modify the electrode–electrolyte interface, where ion transport and interfacial phenomena play a central role. Such systems exhibit distinctive physics arising either from nanoscale confinement, which restricts the electrolyte to only a few layers of ions or solvent molecules, or from low-dimensional electronic effects imposed by confining materials such as graphene, carbon nanotubes, and MXenes. This Focus Review aims to provide a comprehensive yet accessible overview of the fundamental phenomena governing low-dimensional ionotronic systems, with particular emphasis on the underlying physics that determines their performance and enables emerging applications.
title_zh: 低维离子电子学
abstract_zh: 摘要 离子电子学涵盖了一系列现象和器件，它们或基于电解质介质中电子控制的离子操控，或基于利用离子行为来控制电子功能。尽管这一术语本身出现较晚，但离子电子学的科学基础跨越了一个多世纪的研究。由于在能量存储与收集、机器人驱动、纳米过滤、海水淡化、传感和神经形态计算等领域的广阔应用前景，离子电子学系统近年来受到迅速增长的关注，尤其是在低维电极的背景下。这些先进结构能够深刻改变电极-电解质界面，而离子传输和界面现象在其中发挥着核心作用。此类系统表现出独特的物理特性，这些特性或源于纳米尺度限域效应（将电解质限制在仅几层离子或溶剂分子），或源于石墨烯、碳纳米管和MXenes等限域材料施加的低维电子效应。本综述旨在全面而易于理解地概述支配低维离子电子学系统的基本现象，特别强调决定其性能并促成新兴应用的基础物理。

title: The urinary pathobiont Actinobaculum massiliense can generate androgens via the dirAB pathway
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: While overlooked during the Human Microbiome Project, characterizing the urinary microbiota in health and disease is a new frontier in microbiome science. Recent studies have associated differential abundance of bacterial taxa including Propionimicrobium lymphophilum and Actinobaculum/Actinotignum spp. with prostate cancer. In this study, we collected urine from subjects before prostate biopsy and applied a Human Sterolbiome Discovery High-throughput (HSDH) assay to identify culturable urinary bacteria with the ability to generate androgens. Application of the HSDH Assay to urine samples led to the isolation of eight P. lymphophilum strains positive for cortisol side-chain cleavage (steroid-17,20-desmolase), 17β-HSDH activity, or both. In addition, we isolated three strains of Actinobaculum massiliense that carry the DHEA isomerase reductase (dir) genes. The dirA gene encodes a multifunctional 3β/17β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase/Δ4,5-isomerase and the dirB gene encodes a 17β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase isoform. Structural prediction and molecular dynamics reveal probable catalytic mechanisms based on the shared catalytic triad but distinct binding-pocket geometries of DirA and DirB, which enabled predictions of their respective reactions. Phylogenetic analysis of DirA and DirB revealed homologs in urinary tract commensals and in bacteria associated with steroid degradation in aquatic and terrestrial environments. Taken together, the development of the HSDH Assay and the identification of the dir pathway genes provide the methodological foundation and provide the molecular basis for advancing our understanding of the role of urinary tract bacteria in host endocrine physiology.
title_zh: 尿道病原共生菌Actinobaculum massiliense可通过dirAB通路产生雄激素
abstract_zh: 尽管在人类微生物组计划期间被忽视，但表征健康和疾病状态下的泌尿道微生物群是微生物组科学的新前沿。近期研究已将包括Propionimicrobium lymphophilum和Actinobaculum/Actinotignum spp.在内的细菌分类群的差异丰度与前列腺癌联系起来。在本研究中，我们在前列腺穿刺活检前收集受试者的尿液，并应用人类甾醇生物组发现高通量（HSDH）检测法来鉴定能够生成雄激素的可培养泌尿道细菌。将HSDH检测法应用于尿液样本后，分离出八株对皮质醇侧链裂解（类固醇-17,20-解链酶）、17β-HSDH活性或两者均呈阳性的P. lymphophilum菌株。此外，我们还分离出三株携带DHEA异构酶还原酶（dir）基因的Actinobaculum massiliense菌株。dirA基因编码一种多功能3β/17β-羟基类固醇脱氢酶/Δ4,5-异构酶，dirB基因编码一种17β-羟基类固醇脱氢酶同工酶。结构预测和分子动力学揭示了基于DirA和DirB共有催化三联体但各自结合口袋几何结构不同而可能的催化机制，从而能够预测它们各自的反应。对DirA和DirB的系统发育分析揭示了其在泌尿道共生菌以及水生和陆地环境中与类固醇降解相关细菌中的同源物。综上所述，HSDH检测法的开发和dir通路基因的鉴定提供了方法论基础，并提供了分子

title: Ten critical questions for scaling up floating developments
source: Scientific community and society : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Floating developments may offer climate-adaptive solutions to space scarcity and water management challenges in coastal, inland, and offshore contexts. We present ten research questions to explore the potential for safe, inclusive, sustainable and economically viable upscaling towards large-scale floating developments.
title_zh: 漂浮式开发规模化扩展的十个关键问题
abstract_zh: 浮动开发项目可以为沿海、内陆和近海地区的空间稀缺和水资源管理挑战提供气候适应性解决方案。我们提出了十个研究问题，以探索安全、包容、可持续和经济上可行的大规模浮动开发升级的潜力。

title: Ultrastable Lithium Metal Batteries Enabled by the Fluorinated Li/Electrolyte Interphase with High Mechanical Strength
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract A rationally designed solid-electrolyte interphase (SEI) is critical for enabling a high mechanical modulus, low mass transfer resistance, and uniform, rapid ion transport in lithium metal batteries. Herein, we report a promising artificial SEI layer fabricated by coating fluorinated hydroxyapatite on the commercially available polypropylene separator. Fluorination reaction for hydroxyapatite greatly improves its Young’s modulus, physically suppressing Li dendrite growth. More importantly, the uniformly coated nanoscale fluorinated hydroxyapatite with a solid−solid nanoporous network enables efficient Li-ion transport during Li plating/stripping and F− release, which not only endows the formed SEI with local outer regions of ordered laminar Li2O as revealed by cryo-transmission electron microscopy but also effectively promotes the formation of a stable LiF-rich inner layer. The obtained double-deck SEI, with high mechanical strength, suppresses SEI fracture during repeated cycles, promotes uniform Li-ion flux, and stabilizes the Li/electrolyte interface. As a result, Li anodes based on this fluorinated hydroxyapatite exhibit an ultrastable cycling life over 1200 h with a capacity of 3 mAh cm−2 at a current density of 3 mA cm−2. When coupled with a LiFePO4 cathode, the obtained full cell shows a high capacity retention of 96% after 600 cycles.
title_zh: 具有高机械强度的氟化锂/电解质界面实现超稳定锂金属电池
abstract_zh: 摘要 一个经合理设计的固体电解质界面（SEI）对于锂金属电池获得高机械模量、低传质阻力以及均匀快速的离子传输至关重要。本文报道了一种有前景的人工SEI层，其通过在市售聚丙烯隔膜上涂覆氟化羟基磷灰石制备而成。羟基磷灰石的氟化反应显著提高了其杨氏模量，从物理上抑制了锂枝晶生长。更重要的是，均匀涂覆的纳米级氟化羟基磷灰石凭借固-固纳米多孔网络，在锂沉积/剥离过程中实现了高效的锂离子传输和F−释放，这不仅使所形成的SEI具有低温透射电子显微镜所揭示的局部外层有序层状Li2O，还有效促进了富LiF稳定内层的形成。所获得的双层SEI具有高机械强度，可抑制循环过程中SEI的破裂，促进均匀的锂离子通量，并稳定锂/电解质界面。因此，基于该氟化羟基磷灰石的锂负极在3 mA cm−2的电流密度和3 mAh cm−2的容量下展现出超过1200小时的超稳定循环寿命。与LiFePO4正极匹配时，所获得的全电池在600次循环后仍保持96%的高容量保持率。

title: A spatial and temporal transcriptomic atlas of mouse intestinal regeneration in the jejunum
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The intestinal epithelium exhibits a remarkable capacity for regeneration following injury, yet the spatial and temporal dynamics of the damage-repair cycle remain incompletely understood. We present a spatial transcriptomics atlas of ionizing radiation-induced injury and repair in the mouse jejunum, capturing mRNA from 16,921 genes across approximately 26 million bins at 2-µm resolution in 23 biological samples spanning six days post-irradiation. Analysis reveals transcriptional patterns and niche signals undetectable by bulk or single-cell approaches, including spatially restricted interferon-target gene activation, an altered differentiation trajectory in the lower villus during early repair, two transcriptionally distinct crypt regenerative cell populations, and global transcriptional upregulation consistent with hypertranscription as a hallmark of intestinal regeneration, with evidence for hypertranscription extending to human Crohn’s disease. In this work, we provide a spatiotemporal atlas of mouse intestinal regeneration at subcellular 2-µm resolution that will inform future therapeutic strategies for inflammatory bowel diseases and gastrointestinal pathologies arising from injury or cancer therapy.
title_zh: 小鼠空肠肠道再生的时空转录组图谱
abstract_zh: 肠上皮在损伤后表现出卓越的再生能力，但损伤修复周期的空间和时间动态仍不完全清楚。我们展示了小鼠空肠中电离辐射引起的损伤和修复的空间转录组图谱，以 2 µm 分辨率捕获了辐射后 6 天的 23 个生物样本中约 2600 万个箱中 16,921 个基因的 mRNA。分析揭示了大量或单细胞方法无法检测到的转录模式和生态位信号，包括空间限制的干扰素靶基因激活、早期修复过程中下绒毛的分化轨迹改变、两个转录上不同的隐窝再生细胞群，以及与作为肠道再生标志的超转录一致的整体转录上调，有证据表明超转录延伸到人类克罗恩病。在这项工作中，我们提供了亚细胞 2 µm 分辨率的小鼠肠道再生时空图谱，这将为未来因损伤或癌症治疗引起的炎症性肠病和胃肠道病理的治疗策略提供信息。

title: Structural basis for rosuvastatin-induced activation of skeletal muscle ryanodine receptor 1
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Statin therapies, used to lower high blood cholesterol, have been proposed to cause skeletal muscle side effects including myalgia and rhabdomyolysis. The ryanodine receptor 1 (RyR1)/Ca²⁺ release channel in skeletal muscle has recently been identified as an off-target binder of statins. Here, we report the cryo-electron microscopy structure of RyR1 in complex with rosuvastatin. Rosuvastatin occupies a single binding site in the pore region of RyR1 stabilizing the open conformation. In the closed conformation, the rosuvastatin binding site is occupied by the RyR1 auxiliary transmembrane helices (TMx1-2). Structural comparison indicates steric overlap of rosuvastatin with simvastatin (at Sim-1) but not with atorvastatin on RyR1, while all these statins may interfere with the conformational stability of the TMx1-2 helices. In contrast to simvastatin and atorvastatin, rosuvastatin does not exhibit multiple binding sites on RyR1 while similarly promoting RyR1 activation, indicating its potential as a preferable lead structure for developing statins that minimizes adverse side effects on RyR1.
title_zh: 瑞舒伐他汀激活骨骼肌兰尼碱受体1的结构基础
abstract_zh: 他汀类药物疗法用于降低高血胆固醇，已被提出会引起包括肌痛和横纹肌溶解在内的骨骼肌副作用。骨骼肌中的兰尼碱受体1（RyR1）/Ca²⁺释放通道最近被确定为他汀类药物的脱靶结合蛋白。在此，我们报告了RyR1与瑞舒伐他汀复合物的冷冻电子显微镜结构。瑞舒伐他汀占据RyR1孔道区的一个单一结合位点，稳定其开放构象。在闭合构象中，瑞舒伐他汀结合位点被RyR1辅助跨膜螺旋（TMx1-2）占据。结构比较表明，瑞舒伐他汀与辛伐他汀（在Sim-1位点）在RyR1上存在空间位阻重叠，但与阿托伐他汀没有重叠，而所有这些他汀类药物都可能干扰TMx1-2螺旋的构象稳定性。与辛伐他汀和阿托伐他汀不同，瑞舒伐他汀在RyR1上不表现出多个结合位点，同时同样促进RyR1的激活，表明其作为开发对RyR1不良反应最小化的他汀类药物的优选先导结构的潜力。

title: Distinct constraints but shared dynamics shape the macroevolution of volatile organic compound chemodiversity
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Complex metabolic systems have evolved across the tree of life, producing remarkable chemodiversity, yet the structure and evolutionary modes underlying this diversity remain poorly understood. Here, we investigate the macroevolution of chemodiversity using a comprehensive dataset of gymnosperm foliage volatile organic compounds (VOCs) collected from the literature. We find that chemodiversity is dominated by a small fraction of “core” compounds. Although few in number, these core VOCs are widespread and abundant. To understand the full picture, we investigate the macroevolution of both high-dimensional global chemodiversity, and the dominant core chemodiversity. We find that both global and core chemodiversity have evolved through similar dynamics: punctuated evolution rather than gradual drift. We also identify a dichotomy in constraint, where global chemodiversity exhibits weak covariance—reflecting high evolutionary lability—and the core chemodiversity is characterized by high covariance and strong integration. We perform ancestral state reconstruction and find that this complex system is not a recent innovation; the major, core VOCs were already established in ancestral lineages prior to the Carboniferous period. These findings not only reveal the hierarchical structure of the gymnosperm VOC system, with its underlying constraints and dynamics, but also provide a framework for exploring the structure and evolutionary dynamics of chemodiversity.
title_zh: 不同的约束条件与共同的动态过程共同塑造挥发性有机化合物化学多样性的宏演化
abstract_zh: 复杂的代谢系统已经在生命之树中进化，产生了显着的化学多样性，但这种多样性背后的结构和进化模式仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们使用从文献中收集的裸子植物叶子挥发性有机化合物（VOC）的综合数据集来研究化学多样性的宏观进化。我们发现化学多样性由一小部分“核心”化合物主导。这些核心挥发性有机化合物虽然数量不多，但分布广泛且丰富。为了了解全貌，我们研究了高维全局化学多样性和主导核心化学多样性的宏观进化。我们发现全球和核心化学多样性都是通过类似的动态演化的：间断进化而不是逐渐漂移。我们还确定了约束中的二分法，其中全局化学多样性表现出弱协方差（反映了高进化不稳定性），而核心化学多样性的特点是高协方差和强集成。我们进行祖先状态重建，发现这个复杂的系统并不是最近的创新；主要的核心挥发性有机化合物在石炭纪之前就已经在祖先谱系中建立了。这些发现不仅揭示了裸子植物VOC系统的层次结构及其潜在的约束和动力学，而且为探索化学多样性的结构和进化动力学提供了框架。

title: K-MARVEL: K-Mer-based antimicrobial resistance virtual exploration lab
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The rapid spread of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) necessitates new computational surveillance tools. Current methods for analysis of next-generation sequencing data have trade-offs: assembly-based approaches are computationally intensive, and direct long-read mapping is hampered by high error rates that obscure resistance-conferring mutations. Here, we present K-MARVEL, an open-source method that captures antimicrobial resistance genes (ARGs) and resistance-conferring mutations from both short- and long-read datasets. Operating in protein k-mer space, K-MARVEL tolerates nucleotide-level sequencing errors. We benchmarked K-MARVEL on 209 long-read and 205 short-read datasets across 22 bacterial species and achieved F1-scores of 0.976 (short-read) and 0.958 (long-read), outperforming assembly-based methods in speed and memory usage. K-MARVEL had higher F1-scores than seven widely used short-read-based ARG classifiers (0.979) and two widely used long-read-based classifiers (0.961) for homology-model-based ARGs. K-MARVEL can accurately identify both homologous ARGs and structural genes containing resistance-conferring mutations, including multiple variants, directly from raw sequencing data.
title_zh: K-MARVEL：基于K-mer的抗微生物耐药性虚拟探索实验室
abstract_zh: 抗菌药物耐药性（AMR）的快速传播需要新的计算监测工具。目前用于分析下一代测序数据的方法存在权衡：基于组装的方法计算量大，而直接长读段比对则因高错误率掩盖了赋予耐药性的突变而受阻。在此，我们提出K-MARVEL，一种开源方法，可从短读段和长读段数据集中捕获抗菌药物耐药基因（ARG）和赋予耐药性的突变。K-MARVEL在蛋白质k-mer空间中运行，可容忍核苷酸水平的测序错误。我们在22个细菌物种的209个长读段和205个短读段数据集上对K-MARVEL进行了基准测试，取得了0.976（短读段）和0.958（长读段）的F1分数，在速度和内存使用方面优于基于组装的方法。对于基于同源模型的ARG，K-MARVEL的F1分数高于七种广泛使用的基于短读段的ARG分类器（0.979）和两种广泛使用的基于长读段的分类器（0.961）。K-MARVEL可以直接从原始测序数据中准确鉴定同源ARG以及含有赋予耐药性突变（包括多个变异体）的结构基因。

title: Motifs of brain cortical folding from birth to adulthood
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Cortical folding of the brain is widely regarded as an interplay between genetic programming and biomechanical forces, closely linked to cytoarchitectonic regionalisation. Abnormal folding patterns are frequently observed in neurodevelopmental conditions and psychiatric disorders. However, significant inter-individual variability of secondary and tertiary folds obscures the detection of shape biomarkers and confounds the investigation of folding-functional relationships. Here, we investigate cortical folding heterogeneity at a fine scale, using Multimodal Surface Matching with Hierarchical Templates (MSM-HT), a hierarchical surface registration, to parse cortical folding patterns into a representative family of distinct anatomical templates. By applying this technique both to young adults from the Human Connectome Project (HCP) and neonates in the Developing HCP and Brain Imaging in Babies (BIBS) cohorts, we identify and characterise common lobe-wise folding patterns: observing consistency across both age groups, with neonatal samples showing less variation. Crucially, we highlight significant hemispheric asymmetry within the temporal lobe in adults, with a consistent trend in neonates. This study provides a critical step towards understanding brain asymmetry and complex relationships between folding and function, offering a robust framework to generalise the uncovered cortical folding motifs across datasets and developmental stages.

title: Antifreezing and Highly Elastic Hydrogels Based on Hydrogen-Bond Regulation and Hydrophobic Crosslinking for Multifunctional Flexible Devices
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Conventional hydrogels tend to freeze at low temperatures and exhibit significant mechanical hysteresis during cyclic deformation, which impairs their cycling stability and substantially restricts their applications in flexible devices employed in extremely cold environments. Herein, a synergistic strategy combining hydrophobic crosslinking and hydrogen-bond regulation is proposed to achieve antifreezing and highly elastic hydrogels. The hydrogels are one-step prepared by polymerization of acrylamide in zinc triflate solutions using hydrophobic 1,9-bis(acryloyloxy)nonane as a crosslinker. The hydrophobic crosslinker endows the hydrogel with an ultrahigh stretchability of 2266% and a toughness of 0.51 MJ m−3, while Zn(OTf)2 regulates the hydrogen-bonding interactions to reduce mechanical hysteresis and depress the freezing point. The as-prepared hydrogels show a hysteresis ratio of 6.61% during cyclic deformations and maintain mechanical flexibility even at ultralow temperatures of −70 °C. Owing to the antifreezing and highly elastic features, the resultant hydrogels demonstrate robust functionalities as electrolytes for zinc-ion pouch batteries and strain/temperature sensors at ultralow temperatures. This study provides an effective route to achieve high stretchability, low hysteresis, and superior antifreezing performance in one hydrogel for flexible energy storage and wearable sensing materials under extreme cold conditions.
title_zh: 基于氢键调控与疏水交联的抗冻高弹性水凝胶用于多功能柔性器件

title: Dual Photo-Functional Au/TiO2/NiO Nanocone Arrays Empower Flexible Zn−Urea−Air Batteries
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Photo-assisted Zn−air batteries provide an integrated route for solar energy conversion and storage, but their energy efficiency is still limited by sluggish bifunctional oxygen electrocatalysis at the air electrode. Herein, an Au nanoparticle-modified TiO2/NiO nanocone array air electrode (Au/n-TO/NiO) is developed for photo-assisted zinc−urea−air batteries. The nanocone TO architecture enhances broadband light harvesting, local electric-field intensity, and interfacial reactant enrichment, while the TO/NiO heterojunction promotes photogenerated charge separation. Under 365 nm irradiation, photogenerated holes preferentially migrate toward Ni-related active sites and accelerate urea oxidation, thereby reducing charging polarization. Meanwhile, Au nanoparticles serve as localized surface plasmon resonance centers, enabling efficient 808 nm photothermal conversion to regulate the oxygen reduction microenvironment during discharge. Benefiting from this functional partitioning of photoexcitation and photothermal regulation, the Au/n-TO/NiO-based battery exhibits a reduced charging plateau from 1.899 V in the dark to 1.585 V under combined illumination with urea, while the discharge plateau increases from 1.087 to 1.214 V. The apparent electrical round-trip efficiency consequently increases from 57.2% to 76.6% under the specified operating conditions. Furthermore, the flexible gel-state device achieves an apparent electrical round-trip efficiency of 81.5% under illumination with urea, demonstrating the potential of this strategy for flexible photo-assisted metal−air batteries.
title_zh: 双光功能Au/TiO2/NiO纳米锥阵列助力柔性Zn−尿素−空气电池
abstract_zh: 摘要 光辅助锌空气电池为太阳能转换和存储提供了一条综合途径，但其能量效率仍然受到空气电极缓慢的双功能氧电催化的限制。在此，开发了一种用于光辅助锌尿素空气电池的金纳米粒子修饰的TiO2/NiO纳米锥阵列空气电极（Au/n-TO/NiO）。纳米锥 TO 结构增强了宽带光捕获、局部电场强度和界面反应物富集，而 TO/NiO 异质结则促进光生电荷分离。在365 nm照射下，光生空穴优先向Ni相关活性位点迁移，加速尿素氧化，从而减少充电极化。同时，Au纳米粒子作为局部表面等离子体共振中心，实现高效的808 nm光热转换，以调节放电过程中的氧还原微环境。受益于光激发和光热调节的这种功能划分，Au/n-TO/NiO基电池的充电平台从黑暗中的1.899 V降低到尿素组合照明下的1.585 V，而放电平台从1.087增加到1.214 V。因此，在指定的工作条件下，表观电往返效率从57.2%增加到76.6%。此外，柔性凝胶态器件在尿素照明下实现了 81.5% 的表观电往返效率，证明了该策略在柔性光辅助金属空气电池中的潜力。

title: High-Performance Microwave-Synthesized Graphene Supercapacitive Synapses for Reservoir Preprocessing in Neuromorphic Computing
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Reservoir computing bridges the gap between artificial intelligence and the physical environment. The realization of such systems depends on artificial synapses that emulate neurobiological plasticity in response to external stimuli. Functioning as reservoirs, these synapses convert the input signals into reservoir states, which are then retrieved by the readout layer. However, energy is merely dissipated during the operation of existing artificial synapses. Herein, we propose an energy-storage-involved reservoir architecture based on graphene-based supercapacitors. Reduced graphene oxide electrode, fabricated via metal-assisted microwave reduction, exhibits a mesoporous structure and low defect density. The supercapacitor delivers a specific capacitance of 352 F g–1 at a current density of 1 A g–1. Under current stimuli, the energy-storage device replicates biological synaptic functions through voltage responses. Next, the voltage responses can be used to mimic human perceptual learning, in which sensory systems are enhanced through experience. Moreover, integrated with a diffractive deep neural network in simulation, supercapacitor-based reservoir preprocessing can accurately identify static and dynamic handwritten images, outperforming an artificial neural network and an unprocessed diffractive deep neural network. These results pave the way for neuromorphic computing that integrates energy-storage-involved information processing, offering promising applications for energy-efficient artificial intelligence hardware.
title_zh: 高性能微波合成石墨烯超级电容器突触用于神经形态计算中的储备池预处理
abstract_zh: 摘要 水库计算弥合了人工智能和物理环境之间的差距。这种系统的实现依赖于模拟神经生物学可塑性以响应外部刺激的人工突触。这些突触充当储存器，将输入信号转换为储存器状态，然后由读出层检索。然而，能量仅在现有人工突触的操作过程中耗散。在此，我们提出了一种基于石墨烯超级电容器的涉及储能的储层结构。通过金属辅助微波还原制备的还原氧化石墨烯电极具有介孔结构和低缺陷密度。超级电容器在 1 A g–1 的电流密度下提供 352 F g–1 的比电容。在电流刺激下，储能装置通过电压响应复制生物突触功能。接下来，电压响应可用于模仿人类感知学习，其中感觉系统通过经验得到增强。此外，在模拟中与衍射深度神经网络相结合，基于超级电容器的水库预处理可以准确识别静态和动态手写图像，其性能优于人工神经网络和未经处理的衍射深度神经网络。这些结果为集成能量存储相关信息处理的神经形态计算铺平了道路，为节能人工智能硬件提供了有前途的应用。

title: Mechanics-Guided Layer-by-Layer Transfer of Molecular Bilayer Semiconductors
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Layer-controlled organic thin films are essential components of organic electronic devices. Although layer-transfer methods are effective for device prototyping, managing crack formation during this process is challenging. In this study, we investigate the fracture mechanics of bilayer-type organic semiconductor (OSC) films as a model for developing a crack-suppressed transfer methodology. We find that crack formation is strongly dependent on film thickness and is suppressed when the film is reduced to a single molecular bilayer (SMB) thickness. The observed crack directionality in thick films is clearly correlated with the crystallographic orientation. These fracture behaviors can be qualitatively explained by combining a macroscopic elasticity model with calculations of intermolecular interaction energies. Based on this understanding, we successfully fabricate highly ordered multilayered artificial lattices through sequential SMB transfers. Furthermore, by expanding the π-electron core to tune intermolecular interactions, we achieve the direct patterning of OSC films, even on lyophobic substrates, providing a suitable interface for organic thin-film transistors (OTFTs). OTFTs incorporating crack-suppressed SMBs exhibit sharp on/off switching with a subthreshold swing of less than 150 mV dec–1 and a relatively high device mobility exceeding 5 cm2 V–1 s–1. These findings pave the way for molecular layer engineering for surface tailoring and organic device manufacturing.
title_zh: 力学导向的分子双层半导体逐层转移
abstract_zh: 摘要 层控有机薄膜是有机电子器件的重要组成部分。尽管层转移方法对于器件原型设计非常有效，但在此过程中管理裂纹形成具有挑战性。在这项研究中，我们研究了双层型有机半导体（OSC）薄膜的断裂力学，作为开发裂纹抑制转移方法的模型。我们发现裂纹的形成很大程度上取决于薄膜的厚度，并且当薄膜减小到单分子双层（SMB）厚度时，裂纹的形成会受到抑制。厚膜中观察到的裂纹方向性与晶体取向明显相关。这些断裂行为可以通过将宏观弹性模型与分子间相互作用能的计算相结合来定性解释。基于这种理解，我们通过顺序 SMB 传输成功制造了高度有序的多层人工晶格。此外，通过扩展π电子核心来调节分子间相互作用，我们实现了OSC薄膜的直接图案化，甚至在疏液基板上也是如此，为有机薄膜晶体管（OTFT）提供了合适的界面。包含裂纹抑制 SMB 的 OTFT 具有敏锐的开/关切换能力，亚阈值摆幅小于 150 mV dec-1，器件迁移率相对较高，超过 5 cm2 V-1 s-1。这些发现为表面定制和有机器件制造的分子层工程铺平了道路。

title: Multi-stage single-cell atlas of a chordate non-embryonic development unveils dedifferentiating bud founder cells
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Colonial tunicates are the only chordates capable of forming fully functional bodies from somatic tissues through non-embryonic development, or budding. In Botryllus schlosseri, budding produces new individuals (zooids) from a portion of the peribranchial epithelium of a preexisting zooid. While the anatomy of this process has been described in detail, the cellular and molecular mechanisms underpinning bud initiation remain elusive. Here, we present a multi-stage single-cell transcriptomic atlas of a non-embryonic development in a chordate, capturing initiation and development of zooids. We identify an epithelial founder cell population that gains developmental potential through possible dedifferentiation, challenging the long-standing hypothesis that a long-lived, circulating pluripotent stem cell drives new zooid formation. Although some circulating cells exhibit stem-like expression profiles, these populations are either hematopoietic or germline restricted lineages. This atlas provides a foundational resource for understanding the cellular origin and mechanisms underlying agametic development and possibly whole-body regeneration in chordates.
title_zh: 脊索动物非胚胎发育的多阶段单细胞图谱揭示去分化的芽基创始细胞
abstract_zh: 群体被囊动物是唯一能够通过非胚胎发育（即出芽）从体组织形成完整功能个体的脊索动物。在Botryllus schlosseri中，出芽由既有个体的围鳃上皮的一部分产生新个体（个虫）。尽管该过程的解剖学已被详细描述，但支撑芽体起始的细胞和分子机制仍不清楚。在此，我们构建了脊索动物非胚胎发育的多阶段单细胞转录组图谱，捕获了个虫的起始与发育。我们鉴定出一类上皮创始细胞群体，其可能通过去分化获得发育潜能，这挑战了长期存在的假说，即由长寿的循环多能干细胞驱动新个虫的形成。尽管一些循环细胞表现出干细胞样的表达谱，这些群体要么是造血限制谱系，要么是生殖系限制谱系。该图谱为理解无性发育以及可能的脊索动物整体再生背后的细胞起源与机制提供了基础资源。

title: Interface-Driven Evolution of Interlayer and Hybrid Excitons in CVD-Grown Large-Area MoS2/WS2 Vertical Heterostructures
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Van der Waals heterostructures grown by chemical vapor deposition (CVD) offer a scalable platform for optoelectronic applications. However, understanding and accurately assigning their excitonic spectral features remain challenging. This is due to variable interfacial quality arising from interfacial disorder and interlayer coupling, as well as overlapping spectral signatures. Here, we synthesize continuous, large-area (up to 600 μm) MoS2/WS2 vertical heterostructures using two distinct single-step CVD processes. This approach enables a systematic comparison of excitonic behavior across varying interface qualities. Temperature-dependent photoluminescence, supported by ultra-low-frequency Raman spectroscopy, resolves the evolution of distinct interlayer exciton (ILE) spectral features. In heterobilayers, the ILE evolves from localized states in the presence of interfacial disorder to delocalized states stabilized by uniform interlayer coupling. Notably, we identify a hybrid exciton, arising from strong interlayer electronic hybridization, centered at ∼1.90 eV between the neutral A-excitons of MoS2 and WS2. Importantly, hybrid exciton formation correlates with a suppression of ILE radiative emission. By systematically disentangling disorder-trapped, delocalized, and hybrid excitonic regimes, this work provides clear experimental evidence of interface-driven excitonic transitions. These findings highlight the critical role of interfacial quality in governing excitonic behavior in scalable MoS2/WS2 heterostructures.
title_zh: CVD生长的大面积MoS2/WS2垂直异质结构中界面驱动的层间与杂化激子演化
abstract_zh: 摘要 通过化学气相沉积 (CVD) 生长的范德华异质结构为光电应用提供了一个可扩展的平台。然而，理解并准确分配它们的激子光谱特征仍然具有挑战性。这是由于界面无序和层间耦合以及重叠光谱特征引起的界面质量变化。在这里，我们使用两种不同的单步 CVD 工艺合成连续的大面积（高达 600 μm）MoS2/WS2 垂直异质结构。这种方法可以对不同界面质量的激子行为进行系统比较。由超低频拉曼光谱支持的温度依赖性光致发光解决了独特的层间激子 (ILE) 光谱特征的演变。在异双层中，ILE 从存在界面无序的局域态演化为通过均匀层间耦合稳定的离域态。值得注意的是，我们发现了一种由强层间电子杂化产生的混合激子，其中心位于 MoS2 和 WS2 的中性 A 激子之间~1.90 eV。重要的是，混合激子的形成与 ILE 辐射发射的抑制相关。通过系统地解开无序捕获、离域和混合激子状态，这项工作为界面驱动的激子跃迁提供了清晰的实验证据。这些发现强调了界面质量在控制可扩展的 MoS2/WS2 异质结构中激子行为中的关键作用。

title: Oxygen-Vacancy-Rich Na1.3Ti1.8Ni0.1Sb0.1(PO4)3@C Anode for High-Rate and Low-Temperature Sodium-Ion Storage
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract NASICON-type NaTi2(PO4)3 as an electrode material for sodium-ion batteries has attracted considerable attention due to its high structural stability and safety, yet its low intrinsic electronic conductivity limits high-rate and low-temperature performance. In this work, an oxygen-vacancy-rich Na1.3Ti1.8Ni0.1Sb0.1(PO4)3@C (N1.3T1.8N0.1S0.1P@C) nanopowder as a high-performance anode material is synthesized by a solvothermal method. The Ni2+/Sb5+ co-doping effectively modulates the local TiO6/PO4 lattice environment, introduces oxygen vacancies, and optimizes the lattice electronic structure, enhancing both electron and ion transport. A continuous carbon coating forms a stable conductive network, further improving kinetics and structural integrity. As a result, Na∥N1.3T1.8N0.1S0.1P@C half-cells retain 91% of their capacity after 5000 cycles at 20 C and maintain 86% capacity over 10,000 cycles at 10 C under 0 °C. The full cell paired with Na3V2(PO4)3 cathodes exhibits 87% capacity retention after 1000 cycles at 5 C and delivers excellent performance even at 50 C without pre-sodiation, highlighting their potential for low-temperature applications. This study provides a general doping-defect engineering strategy for NASICON-type anodes, enabling high-rate, low-temperature, and long-cycle performance for sodium-ion batteries.
title_zh: 富氧空位的Na1.3Ti1.8Ni0.1Sb0.1(PO4)3@C负极用于高倍率和低温钠离子存储
abstract_zh: 摘要 NASICON型NaTi2(PO4)3作为钠离子电池电极材料由于其结构稳定性和安全性高而受到广泛关注，但其较低的本征电导率限制了高倍率和低温性能。本工作采用溶剂热法合成了富含氧空位的Na1.3Ti1.8Ni0.1Sb0.1(PO4)3@C (N1.3T1.8N0.1S0.1P@C)纳米粉体作为高性能负极材料。 Ni2+/Sb5+共掺杂有效调节局部TiO6/PO4晶格环境，引入氧空位，优化晶格电子结构，增强电子和离子传输。连续的碳涂层形成稳定的导电网络，进一步提高动力学和结构完整性。结果，Na||N1.3T1.8N0.1S0.1P@C 半电池在 20 C 下循环 5000 次后仍保留 91% 的容量，在 0 °C 下于 10 C 循环 10,000 次后仍保持 86% 的容量。与 Na3V2(PO4)3 阴极配对的全电池在 5 C 下循环 1000 次后容量保持率为 87%，即使在 50 C 下无需预钠化也能提供出色的性能，凸显了其在低温应用中的潜力。这项研究为 NASICON 型阳极提供了一种通用的掺杂缺陷工程策略，使钠离子电池具有高倍率、低温和长循环性能。

title: Boosting Reversibility and Capacity in Aqueous Zinc-Ion Batteries via Lanthanum-Doped MnO2 Cathodes
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Manganese-based aqueous zinc-ion batteries (AZIBs) are regarded as promising candidates for large-scale energy storage owing to their safety, low cost, and environmental sustainability. Nevertheless, their practical deployment is limited by the poor electrical conductivity and structural instability of manganese-based cathodes, particularly the dissolution of active materials during cycling. In this study, lanthanum-doped manganese dioxide (La-doped MnO2) was synthesized through a mechanochemical reaction, followed by annealing to overcome these challenges. The incorporation of lanthanum markedly improves both the electrical conductivity and structural stability of MnO2. Consequently, the La-doped MnO2 cathode delivers enhanced electrochemical performance, achieving a high specific capacity of 288 mA·h·g–1 at 0.1 A·g–1 and excellent cycling stability, with 81% capacity retention at 0.4 A·g–1 after 500 cycles. These results reveal the potential of La-doped MnO2 as a high-performance cathode material for next-generation aqueous ZIBs.
title_zh: 通过镧掺杂MnO2正极提升水系锌离子电池的可逆性与容量
abstract_zh: 摘要 锰基水系锌离子电池（AZIB）由于其安全性、低成本和环境可持续性而被认为是大规模储能的有前途的候选者。然而，它们的实际应用受到锰基正极的导电性差和结构不稳定性的限制，特别是循环过程中活性材料的溶解。在这项研究中，通过机械化学反应合成了掺镧二氧化锰（La掺杂MnO2），然后通过退火来克服这些挑战。镧的加入显着提高了MnO2的导电性和结构稳定性。因此，La掺杂MnO2正极具有增强的电化学性能，在0.1 A·g–1下实现了288 mA·h·g–1的高比容量，并且具有出色的循环稳定性，500次循环后在0.4 A·g–1下容量保持率为81%。这些结果揭示了 La 掺杂 MnO2 作为下一代水性 ZIB 的高性能阴极材料的潜力。

title: Biphasic Dip Coating for Versatile and Material-Efficient Nanoparticle Thin Films
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Colloidal quantum dot (cQD) thin films are central to solution-processed optoelectronics, yet scalable deposition methods that preserve device performance while improving material utilization remain limited. Here, we adapt a biphasic meniscus dip coating strategy that enables controlled deposition of cQD films while substantially reducing the volume of active nanocrystal solution required. In this approach, a thin cQD layer is supported by an immiscible underlayer, such that film formation occurs exclusively at the liquid–air interface of the active phase. Using this geometry, we fabricate PbS quantum dot photodetectors with responsivities up to ∼1000 mA/W at 1200 nm, comparable to conventional spin-coated devices. Relative to spin coating, the biphasic configuration reduces active solution consumption by up to 20-fold while maintaining film quality and reproducible device performance. A mass-volume cost analysis shows that the reduced active reservoir shifts the economic viability of dip coating into thickness and throughput regimes more relevant to practical device fabrication. We further extend the method to CsPbBr3 nanocrystals and curved substrates, highlighting its generality across material systems and geometries. Together, these results establish biphasic dip coating as a material-efficient and device-compatible manufacturing strategy for solution-processed optoelectronics.
title_zh: 双相浸渍涂敷制备多功能且节材的纳米粒子薄膜
abstract_zh: 摘要：胶体量子点 (cQD) 薄膜是溶液加工光电子学的核心，但在提高材料利用率的同时保持器件性能的可扩展沉积方法仍然有限。在这里，我们采用双相弯液面浸涂策略，能够控制 cQD 薄膜的沉积，同时大大减少所需的活性纳米晶体溶液的体积。在这种方法中，薄的 cQD 层由不混溶的底层支撑，这样薄膜的形成仅发生在活性相的液-气界面。利用这种几何结构，我们制造了 PbS 量子点光电探测器，其在 1200 nm 处的响应度高达 ∼1000 mA/W，与传统的旋涂器件相当。相对于旋涂，双相配置可将活性溶液消耗量减少多达 20 倍，同时保持薄膜质量和可重复的器件性能。质量体积成本分析表明，活性储层的减少将浸涂的经济可行性转变为与实际设备制造更相关的厚度和吞吐量状态。我们进一步将该方法扩展到 CsPbBr3 纳米晶体和弯曲基板，突出了其在材料系统和几何形状中的通用性。总之，这些结果将双相浸涂确立为溶液加工光电子产品的一种材料高效且设备兼容的制造策略。

title: Dynamic Actuatable Hydrogels for Integrated Environmental Sensing and Remediation Applications
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Hydrogel-based adsorbents have emerged as versatile materials for environmental remediation and sensing owing to their tunable chemistries, hydrated networks, and compatibility with multifunctional nanomaterials. However, conventional static hydrogels remain constrained by diffusion-limited mass transport, slow adsorption kinetics, and limited integration of pollutant detection with remediation. This review highlights the emerging shift from passive adsorption toward dynamic and actuatable hydrogels as adaptive sense–respond–act material systems capable of accelerated pollutant capture, real-time monitoring, and autonomous regeneration. We first discuss static hydrogel design principles, including polymer composition, nanomaterial incorporation, and structural architectures that govern adsorption capacity, selectivity, kinetics, and reusability. We then examine dynamic hydrogel platforms, including intrinsically stimuli-responsive networks, extrinsically actuated composites, and shape-programmed architectures that actively enhance mass transport and interfacial exposure. Particular emphasis is placed on emerging systems that integrate sensing with decontamination, positioning actuatable hydrogels as adaptive environmental interfaces and soft robotic materials. A comparative discussion of static and dynamic systems evaluates their performance, practical limitations, and translational potential for water remediation, resource recovery, and integrated sensing technologies. Finally, challenges in scalability, stability, and system integration are critically assessed, and future directions are proposed toward autonomous, intelligent hydrogel platforms for next-generation environmental technologies.
title_zh: 用于集成环境传感与修复的动态可驱动水凝胶
abstract_zh: 摘要：基于水凝胶的吸附剂由于其可调节的化学性质、水合网络以及与多功能纳米材料的兼容性，已成为环境修复和传感的多功能材料。然而，传统的静态水凝胶仍然受到扩散限制的质量传输、缓慢的吸附动力学以及污染物检测与修复的有限整合的限制。这篇综述强调了从被动吸附到动态可驱动水凝胶的转变，作为自适应感知-响应-行为材料系统，能够加速污染物捕获、实时监测和自主再生。我们首先讨论静态水凝胶设计原理，包括聚合物组成、纳米材料掺入以及控制吸附能力、选择性、动力学和可重复使用性的结构体系。然后，我们研究动态水凝胶平台，包括内在刺激响应网络、外在驱动复合材料和主动增强质量传输和界面暴露的形状编程结构。特别强调将传感与净化相结合的新兴系统，将可驱动水凝胶定位为自适应环境界面和软机器人材料。对静态和动态系统的比较讨论评估了它们的性能、实际局限性以及水修复、资源回收和集成传感技术的转化潜力。最后，对可扩展性、稳定性和系统集成方面的挑战进行了严格的评估，

title: Conformal Transfer Printing of PEDOT: PSS Patterns onto Structurally Complex Surfaces
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Fabricating conductive circuits on complex curved surfaces remains a significant challenge for conformal electronics, particularly for soft and additively manufactured polymer substrates. We report a robust, conformal GOPS-assisted transfer-printing strategy for integrating inkjet-printed PEDOT:PSS patterns onto traditionally hard-to-print and non-planar surfaces. In this approach, conductive features are first defined on a planar polyimide donor substrate and subsequently transferred to the target substrate. The incorporation of (3-glycidyloxypropyl)trimethoxysilane (GOPS) into PEDOT:PSS facilitates strong covalent bonding, ensuring exceptional interfacial adhesion and structural integrity of transferred patterns. This transfer process is compatible with diverse non-planar substrates, including compliant PDMS, curved glass, and stereolithography (SLA)-printed resins. While direct printing on these substrates often suffers from poor wetting or non-planar surfaces, this transfer strategy yields continuous pathways that preserve the original morphology and electrical performance. Transferred films exhibited excellent stability, maintaining functionality through repetitive bending and aqueous immersion without delamination. As a demonstration, a functional organic electrochemical transistor (OECT) was fabricated on a curved 3D-printed substrate through a multi-step process, independently transferring electrodes and a semiconducting channel, and exhibited concentration-dependent responses to dopamine from 5 to 1000 nM. These results establish a versatile route for integrating printed conductive patterns and functional devices on complex polymer geometries.
title_zh: PEDOT: PSS图案向结构复杂表面的保形转印
abstract_zh: 摘要 在复杂的曲面上制造导电电路对于保形电子产品来说仍然是一个重大挑战，特别是对于软质和增材制造的聚合物基板。我们报告了一种强大的、保形的 GOPS 辅助转移印刷策略，用于将喷墨印刷的 PEDOT:PSS 图案集成到传统上难以印刷和非平面的表面上。在这种方法中，首先在平面聚酰亚胺供体基板上限定导电特征，然后将其转移到目标基板上。将(3-缩水甘油氧基丙基)三甲氧基硅烷 (GOPS) 纳入 PEDOT:PSS 中可促进牢固的共价键合，确保转印图案卓越的界面附着力和结构完整性。该转移工艺与多种非平面基材兼容，包括兼容的 PDMS、曲面玻璃和立体光刻 (SLA) 印刷树脂。虽然在这些基材上直接印刷通常会遇到润湿性差或非平面表面的问题，但这种转移策略产生的连续路径可以保留原始形态和电气性能。转移薄膜表现出优异的稳定性，通过重复弯曲和水浸保持功能而不会分层。作为演示，功能性有机电化学晶体管 (OECT) 通过多步工艺在弯曲 3D 打印基板上制造，独立转移电极和半导体通道，并对 5 至 1000 nM 的多巴胺表现出浓度依赖性响应。这些结果为国际化建立了一条通用途径

title: Manganese Carbonyl-Based Peroxidase-like Nanoenzyme Cascading with Glucose Oxidase, Combined with Porphyrin-COFs-Based Phototherapy and CO-Mediated Immunomodulation for Diabetic Wound Repair
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Diabetic wounds remain a global health challenge due to vascular insufficiency, bacterial infection, and persistent inflammation. Herein, we designed and prepared a triple-synergistic nanoenzyme platform with antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and angiogenesis-promoting effects, which was formed by coloading a porphyrin covalent organic framework (Por-COF) with glucose oxidase (GOx) and manganese carbonyl (MnCO). Under near-infrared irradiation, Por-COFs produce a large number of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and localized hyperthermia. Simultaneously, GOx consumes the glucose in wounds to produce gluconic acid and H2O2, which trigger the decomposition of MnCO into immunomodulatory carbon monoxide (CO) and catalytically active Mn2+/3+ ions. The released Mn2+/3+ ions catalyze H2O2 to produce highly toxic •OH through peroxidase-like activity, enhancing bacterial elimination, while the produced CO improves M1-to-M2 macrophage polarization to resolve inflammation and suppresses heat-shock proteins to enhance PTT efficacy. This prepared nanoplatform (Por-COF@GOx/MnCO) achieved more than 99.99% antibacterial efficiency against Escherichia coli, Staphylococcus aureus, and methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus and accelerated wound healing by promoting angiogenesis, ROS scavenging, and immunomodulation. The designed triple-synergistic nanoplatform—integrating glucose oxidase cascading MnCO-based peroxidase-like activity, phototherapy, and CO immunomodulation—shows great potential as a therapeutic strategy for diabetic wound repair.
title_zh: 羰基锰类过氧化物酶纳米酶与葡萄糖氧化酶级联，结合卟啉-COFs基光疗与CO介导免疫调节用于糖尿病伤口修复
abstract_zh: 摘要 由于血管功能不全、细菌感染和持续炎症，糖尿病伤口仍然是全球健康挑战。在此，我们设计并制备了具有抗菌、抗炎和促进血管生成作用的三重协同纳米酶平台，该平台由卟啉共价有机框架（Por-COF）与葡萄糖氧化酶（GOx）和羰基锰（MnCO）共负载而形成。在近红外照射下，Por-COFs产生大量活性氧（ROS）并产生局部高温。同时，GOx 消耗伤口中的葡萄糖产生葡萄糖酸和 H2O2，从而触发 MnCO 分解为免疫调节性一氧化碳 (CO) 和具有催化活性的 Mn2+/3+ 离子。释放的Mn2+/3+离子通过类过氧化物酶活性催化H2O2产生剧毒·OH，增强细菌消除，而产生的CO改善M1到M2巨噬细胞极化以解决炎症并抑制热休克蛋白以增强PTT功效。这种制备的纳米平台（Por-COF@GOx/MnCO）对大肠杆菌、金黄色葡萄球菌和耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌的抗菌效率达到99.99%以上，并通过促进血管生成、ROS清除和免疫调节来加速伤口愈合。设计的三重协同纳米平台——整合葡萄糖氧化酶级联基于MnCO的过氧化物酶样活性、光疗和CO免疫调节——显示出作为糖尿病伤口修复治疗策略的巨大潜力。

title: Impact of commodity prices volatility on the sovereign risk of European economies: the case of the Russo-Ukrainian conflict
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of the Russo-Ukrainian conflict on the relationship between commodity price volatility and sovereign risk in European economies. Focusing on key agricultural commodities (wheat, rapeseed, and maize) and energy commodities (oil, gas, and coal) we examine the situation in European crop exporting and producing countries: France, Germany, Poland, Romania, Hungary, Bulgaria, Czechia, Italy, Portugal, Spain, the Netherlands, Denmark, Belgium, Finland, and the United Kingdom. Our results reveal that the spillovers originate primarily from the sovereign risk, while commodities are mainly shock receivers. Since the conflict began, the contribution of gas spillovers has increased, while that of wheat, maize, and coal has decreased. Moreover, the transmission of risks from Central Europe and Finland has also intensified. Overall, the findings suggest that geopolitical tensions drive the spillover transmission of commodity-related risk across the European Union and the UK.
title_zh: 大宗商品价格波动对欧洲经济体主权风险的影响：俄乌冲突的案例
abstract_zh: 本文研究了俄罗斯-乌克兰冲突对欧洲经济体大宗商品价格波动与主权风险之间关系的影响。我们重点关注主要农产品（小麦、油菜籽和玉米）和能源商品（石油、天然气和煤炭），研究了欧洲农作物出口和生产国的情况：法国、德国、波兰、罗马尼亚、匈牙利、保加利亚、捷克、意大利、葡萄牙、西班牙、荷兰、丹麦、比利时、芬兰和英国。我们的研究结果表明，溢出效应主要源自主权风险，而大宗商品主要是冲击接收器。自冲突开始以来，天然气溢出的贡献有所增加，而小麦、玉米和煤炭的溢出贡献则有所下降。此外，来自中欧、芬兰的风险传导也加剧。总体而言，研究结果表明，地缘政治紧张局势推动了大宗商品相关风险在欧盟和英国的溢出传播。

title: Temperature-Dependent Voltammetry Reveals the Potential-Dependent Formation of Reaction Species and Their Impact on Interfacial Excess Charge during the Ammonia Oxidation Reaction on Pt
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The electrocatalytic ammonia oxidation reaction (AOR) has historically garnered significant interest, since ammonia could be used as a carbon-free fuel and convenient H2 carrier. Key challenges hindering its application are the high overpotentials and rapid catalyst poisoning, which remain poorly understood. Here, we study the overpotential-dependent formation of reaction species via temperature-dependent cyclic voltammetry and electrochemical Arrhenius analysis on polycrystalline Pt in conjunction with infrared spectroscopy. Further, we link the evolution of the kinetic parameters to the degree of polarization and excess charge via CO-displacement measurements. Strikingly, with increasing overpotential, we discover the parallel formation of a reaction species (not a direct intermediate) that modulates the electron chemical potential and, thus, the potential of zero charge. Due to this coupling, the parallel formation of this “poisoning” species appears to depolarize the surface with increasing overpotential. To recover the interfacial polarization, the overpotential needs to be increased further, before the activity can be restored and substantial Faradiac current can arise. What emerges is a new kinetic picture, where not only formation but also stabilization of interfacial excess charge are decisive for the catalyst activity. In general, the study demonstrates the utility of performing temperature-dependent cyclic voltammetry for revealing how transient changes in local chemicals modulate the overall inner-sphere kinetics.
title_zh: 温度依赖的伏安法揭示Pt上氨氧化反应中反应物种的电位依赖性形成及其对界面过剩电荷的影响
abstract_zh: 摘要 电催化氨氧化反应（AOR）历来引起了人们的极大兴趣，因为氨可以用作无碳燃料和方便的氢气载体。阻碍其应用的主要挑战是高过电势和快速催化剂中毒，但人们对此仍知之甚少。在这里，我们通过温度依赖性循环伏安法和多晶 Pt 的电化学阿伦尼乌斯分析结合红外光谱研究了反应物种的过电势依赖性形成。此外，我们通过 CO 位移测量将动力学参数的演变与极化程度和过量电荷联系起来。引人注目的是，随着超电势的增加，我们发现了一种反应物质（不是直接中间体）的平行形成，它调节电子化学势，从而调节零电荷的电势。由于这种耦合，这种“中毒”物质的平行形成似乎随着过电势的增加而使表面去极化。为了恢复界面极化，需要进一步增加过电势，然后才能恢复活性并产生大量法拉第电流。出现的是一个新的动力学图，其中界面过量电荷的形成和稳定对于催化剂活性都具有决定性作用。总的来说，该研究证明了执行温度依赖性循环伏安法对于揭示局部化学物质的瞬态变化如何调节整体内球动力学的效用。

title: An embryo-derived peptide signal directs endosperm polarity in Arabidopsis
abstract: Angiosperm seed formation requires the coordinated development of the products of double fertilization—the embryo and the endosperm. The endosperm mediates efficient nutrient transfer from surrounding maternal tissues to the developing embryo. This function requires a polarized tissue organization, which manifests as early polar gene expression and polar cellularization dynamics. We show that the receptor kinase HAIKU2 (IKU2) acts in coordination with the transcription factor WRKY10/MINISEED3 (MINI3) to ensure robust endosperm polarity establishment through the activity of the homeodomain transcription factors WUSCHEL-RELATED HOMEOBOX 8 (WOX8) and WOX9. This process depends on egg cell fertilization and is mediated through the peptide PATHOGEN-INDUCED PEPTIDE–LIKE 7 (PIPL7), which acts as a potential IKU2 ligand. Our results reveal how a molecular paracrine dialog between the embryo and endosperm ensures optimal seed developmental coordination.
title_zh: 一种胚胎来源的肽信号指导拟南芥胚乳极性
abstract_zh: 被子植物种子的形成需要双重受精的产物——胚胎和胚乳的协调发育。胚乳介导从周围母体组织到发育中胚胎的有效营养转移。该功能需要极化的组织组织，表现为早期的极性基因表达和极性细胞化动力学。我们发现受体激酶 HAIKU2 (IKU2) 与转录因子 WRKY10/MINISEED3 (MINI3) 协同作用，通过同源结构域转录因子 WUSCHEL 相关同源盒 8 (WOX8) 和 WOX9 的活性确保稳健的胚乳极性建立。该过程取决于卵细胞受精，并通过肽类病原体诱导肽 7 (PIPL7) 介导，PIPL7 可作为潜在的 IKU2 配体。我们的结果揭示了胚胎和胚乳之间的分子旁分泌对话如何确保最佳的种子发育协调。

title: Neutrophil-Inspired Programmable Bacteria for Pyroptosis-Driven Tumor Eradication
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Neutrophils represent a critical component of innate immunity, possessing intrinsic cytotoxic programs involving chemotaxis, degranulation, and lytic effector deployment. Here we report a neutrophil-inspired programmable bacteria (NPB) system developed via synthetic biology and molecular engineering. The nonpathogenic Escherichia coli MG1655 is programmed to execute a sequential four-stage program inspired by the “homing–bursting–lethality” logic of neutrophils with spatiotemporally controlled activation: (I) Preferential homing to hypoxic tumor regions; (II) Sonodynamic actuation of bacterial disruption and on-demand payload release via VHb-mediated ROS generation; (III) Tumor-associated gelatinase-responsive activation of Granzyme B zymogen (m-GzmB-T); and (IV) Pyroptosis-mediated enhancement of systemic antitumor immunity. The NPB system combined with focused ultrasound exhibited consistent antitumor efficacy across murine CT26, MC38, and EMT6 tumor models, while promoting systemic antitumor immune responses and durable immune memory. This work demonstrates the potential of engineering live bacteria with sequential physical and biochemical control mechanisms to execute bioinspired therapeutic cascades, providing a programmable and modular platform for precision cancer immunotherapy.
title_zh: 用于焦亡驱动肿瘤清除的中性粒细胞启发的可编程细菌
abstract_zh: 摘要 中性粒细胞代表先天免疫的关键组成部分，具有涉及趋化性、脱颗粒和裂解效应器部署的内在细胞毒性程序。在这里，我们报告了一种通过合成生物学和分子工程开发的中性粒细胞启发的可编程细菌（NPB）系统。非致病性大肠杆菌 MG1655 被编程为执行一个连续的四阶段程序，其灵感来自中性粒细胞的“归巢-爆发-致死”逻辑，具有时空控制的激活：（I）优先归巢到缺氧肿瘤区域； (II) 通过 VHb 介导的 ROS 生成，声动力驱动细菌破坏和按需释放有效负载； (III)颗粒酶B酶原(m-GzmB-T)的肿瘤相关明胶酶响应性激活； (IV)细胞焦亡介导的全身抗肿瘤免疫的增强。 NPB系统结合聚焦超声在小鼠CT26、MC38和EMT6肿瘤模型中表现出一致的抗肿瘤​​功效，同时促进全身抗肿瘤免疫反应和持久的免疫记忆。这项工作展示了利用连续的物理和生化控制机制改造活细菌来执行生物启发的治疗级联的潜力，为精准癌症免疫治疗提供了可编程和模块化平台。
