title: Synthesis of mesoporous salen polymer nanospheres for highly efficient photocatalytic extraction of uranium from seawater
abstract: Efficient uranium extraction from seawater is essential to the long-term sustainability of nuclear energy, yet the rational design of high-performance materials for this purpose remains a formidable challenge. Herein, we develop an ionization regulated self-assembly strategy to synthesize mesoporous Salen polymer nanospheres (mDSR) for photocatalytic uranium extraction. Partial ionization improves the aqueous solubility of otherwise insoluble Salen ligands and enhances their reactivity towards formaldehyde, while preserving sufficient precursor-micelle interactions for co-assembly, thereby directing the formation of ordered mesostructures. This strategy is facile, universal, and it can accommodate a series of structurally distinct Salen ligands, enabling the modular construction of mesoporous polymers with programmable molecular functions. The mDSR nanospheres feature a large pore size (6.2 nm), a high surface area (68 m2 g−1), and intrinsic photocatalytic activity. As a result, under simulated sunlight and without sacrificial agents, mDSR achieves a high uranium uptake capacity of 867 mg U g−1 from a 10 ppm U(VI) solution, outperforming most adsorbents. This protocol establishes a new paradigm for functional mesoporous polymers.
title_zh: 介孔salen聚合物纳米球的合成用于高效光催化从海水中提取铀
abstract_zh: 从海水中高效提取铀对于核能的长期可持续性至关重要，但为此目的合理设计高性能材料仍然是一项艰巨的挑战。在此，我们开发了一种电离调节的自组装策略来合成用于光催化铀提取的介孔 Salen 聚合物纳米球（mDSR）。部分电离提高了不溶性 Salen 配体的水溶性，并增强了它们对甲醛的反应性，同时保留了足够的前体-胶束相互作用以进行共组装，从而引导有序介观结构的形成。该策略简单、通用，并且可以容纳一系列结构不同的 Salen 配体，从而实现具有可编程分子功能的介孔聚合物的模块化构建。 mDSR 纳米球具有大孔径（6.2 nm）、高表面积（68 m2 g−1）和固有的光催化活性。因此，在模拟阳光下且无需牺牲剂的情况下，mDSR 从 10 ppm U(VI) 溶液中实现了 867 mg U g−1 的高铀吸收能力，优于大多数吸附剂。该协议为功能性介孔聚合物建立了新的范例。

title: Biomimetic sebum organogel enhances cell membrane fluidity for scarless wound healing
abstract: Wound scars impose a substantial clinical burden and aesthetic appearance, affecting millions of individuals globally. Herein, inspired by the physical protection and signal-regulating functions of human sebum, we developed a biomimetic sebum organogel for scarless wound healing. This organogel is composed of calcium phosphotungstate sub-nanowires (PWC) and squalene (Sql)—a natural component of human sebum. The PWC gelatinize Sql with high adhesion force for wound retention and Sql release. The released Sql integrates into the plasma membrane of fibroblasts, where it enhances lipid bilayer fluidity, relieves wound tension by facilitating membrane-associated cytoskeleton adaptation, and subsequently suppresses Yes-associated protein (YAP) activation. Through this mechanism, the biomimetic sebum organogel reduces scar formation and promotes regeneration of skin appendages. Our findings present an accessible strategy for scar prevention and also highlight the regulation of cellular membrane fluidity as a promising target for mitigating fibrotic conditions across a range of diseases.
title_zh: 仿生皮脂有机凝胶增强细胞膜流动性以实现无瘢痕伤口愈合
abstract_zh: 伤口疤痕带来了巨大的临床负担和美观，影响着全球数百万人。在此，受人类皮脂的物理保护和信号调节功能的启发，我们开发了一种仿生皮脂有机凝胶，用于无疤痕伤口愈合。这种有机凝胶由磷钨酸钙亚纳米线 (PWC) 和角鲨烯 (Sql)（人类皮脂的天然成分）组成。 PWC 胶化 Sql 具有高粘附力，用于伤口保留和 Sql 释放。释放的 Sql 整合到成纤维细胞的质膜中，增强脂质双层的流动性，通过促进膜相关细胞骨架适应来缓解伤口张力，并随后抑制 Yes 相关蛋白 (YAP) 激活。通过这种机制，仿生皮脂有机凝胶可减少疤痕形成并促进皮肤附属器的再生。我们的研究结果提出了一种预防疤痕的可行策略，并强调细胞膜流动性的调节是减轻一系列疾病的纤维化状况的有希望的目标。

title: Elucidating the Suppression of High‐Voltage Degradation in O3‐type NaNi 1/3 Fe 1/3 Mn 1/3 O 2 : A Voltage‐Switching Strategy for Na‐ion Batteries
abstract: ABSTRACT Elevating depth‐of‐charge (DoC) enhances the energy density of layered oxide cathodes for sodium‐ion batteries; however, such high‐DoC cycling inevitably triggers severe structural and interfacial degradation. In practice, battery management systems commonly adapt voltage‐derating strategies dynamically according to battery state of health, achieving a favorable trade‐off between energy density and cycle life. Nevertheless, a critical yet overlooked question remains: how high‐DoC‐induced damaged regions evolve when reverted to moderate‐DoC cycling. Here, using NaNi 1/3 Fe 1/3 Mn 1/3 O 2 (NFM111) as a prototype, a voltage‐switching strategy is employed to elucidate the dynamic and long‐term behavior of these damaged regions. During high‐DoC cycling (charging to 4.3 V), the rapid capacity fading is driven by pronounced formation of bulk defects and interfacial disordered spinel phases. However, upon switching these cells to moderate‐DoC cycling (charging to 4.0 V), these pre‐existing damaged regions become stabilized: their rapid propagation is suppressed, and they no longer accelerate degradation in surrounding intact regions. This enables degraded NFM111 to deliver capacity retention comparable to that of cells cycled solely under moderate‐DoC conditions. This work presents a dynamic and evolving picture of high‐DoC degradation and subsequent moderate‐DoC stabilization in NFM111 cathodes, providing mechanistic insights into voltage‐derating process and the lifetime prolongation of compromised cells.
title_zh: 阐明O3型NaNi1/3Fe1/3Mn1/3O2中高压衰减的抑制机制：一种钠离子电池的电压切换策略
abstract_zh: 摘要：提高充电深度（DoC）可提高钠离子电池层状氧化物阴极的能量密度；然而，如此高的 DoC 循环不可避免地会引发严重的结构和界面退化。在实践中，电池管理系统通常根据电池的健康状况动态调整电压降额策略，从而在能量密度和循环寿命之间实现有利的权衡。然而，一个关键但被忽视的问题仍然存在：当恢复到中等 DoC 循环时，高 DoC 诱导的受损区域如何演变。在这里，使用 NaNi 1/3 Fe 1/3 Mn 1/3 O 2 (NFM111) 作为原型，采用电压切换策略来阐明这些受损区域的动态和长期行为。在高 DoC 循环（充电至 4.3 V）期间，容量快速衰减是由大量缺陷和界面无序尖晶石相的明显形成驱动的。然而，将这些细胞切换到中等 DoC 循环（充电至 4.0 V）后，这些预先存在的受损区域变得稳定：它们的快速增殖受到抑制，并且它们不再加速周围完整区域的降解。这使得降解的 NFM111 能够提供与仅在中等 DoC 条件下循环的电池相当的容量保留率。这项工作展示了 NFM111 阴极中高 DoC 退化和随后的中等 DoC 稳定的动态和演变图景，为电压降额过程和受损电池的寿命延长提供了机制见解。

title: Interaction Between Three‐Dimensional Topological Spin Textures With Layer‐Dependent Sign Change Tunes Lattice Symmetry
abstract: ABSTRACT Three‐dimensional (3D) topological spin textures host rich internal structures in thickness dimensions and enable emergent topological phenomena. However, whether their layer‐resolved textures and internal singularities fundamentally modify intralayer interactions lies beyond rigid‐tube interaction models and remains unexplored. Here we show that, in 3D hybrid skyrmion‐antiskyrmion strings, the layer‐dependent topology gives rise to interactions with a sign change across the film thickness, producing a switch between attraction and repulsion both among different layers within each texture and between neighboring 3D strings. This vertically asymmetric attractive‐repulsive interaction drives a tunable transition between square and triangular string lattices, in agreement with our experiment. Computational simulations identify quadrupolar Bloch points as internal topological junctions whose vertical migration mediates the intralayer competition between repulsive skyrmion segments near the surfaces and attractive antiskyrmion segments in the interior. We further show that the averaged topological charge quantifies the relative thickness fractions of the two competing topological segments and robustly captures the lattice phase boundary over a broad range of magnetic parameters. These findings highlight the importance of the surface‐bulk difference in topological materials and establish vertically asymmetric interactions as an intrinsic mechanism for topological phase control in 3D magnetic systems.
title_zh: 具有层依赖符号变化的三维拓扑自旋织构之间的相互作用调控晶格对称性
abstract_zh: 摘要：三维（3D）拓扑自旋纹理在厚度维度上拥有丰富的内部结构，并能够实现新兴的拓扑现象。然而，它们的层解析纹理和内部奇点是否从根本上改变了层内相互作用超出了刚性管相互作用模型的范围，仍未得到探索。在这里，我们表明，在 3D 混合斯格明子-反斯格明子弦中，依赖于层的拓扑会引起整个薄膜厚度上符号变化的相互作用，从而在每个纹理内的不同层之间以及相邻 3D 弦之间产生吸引力和排斥力之间的切换。这种垂直不对称的吸引-排斥相互作用驱动方形和三角形弦晶格之间的可调过渡，与我们的实验一致。计算模拟将四极布洛赫点识别为内部拓扑连接点，其垂直迁移介导表面附近的排斥斯格明子片段与内部有吸引力的反斯格明子片段之间的层内竞争。我们进一步表明，平均拓扑电荷量化了两个竞争拓扑段的相对厚度分数，并在广泛的磁参数范围内稳健地捕获晶格相界。这些发现强调了拓扑材料中表面体积差异的重要性，并将垂直不对称相互作用确立为 3D 磁系统中拓扑相位控制的内在机制。

title: Integrating Machine Learning and High‐Throughput Calculations for the Rational Design of Photocatalytic 2D‐COFs on Overall Water Splitting
abstract: ABSTRACT Two‐dimensional covalent organic frameworks (2D‐COFs) with tunable structures offer a promising platform for photocatalytic overall water splitting (OWS) under visible‐light. However, it is challenging to quickly find photocatalytic OWS materials from the massive amounts of 2D‐COFs and then achieve precise synthesis. In this work, we constructed 11 934 hcb‐type 2D‐COFs by assembling 28 building blocks and 9 linkages. The machine learning (ML) and high‐throughput computation (HTC) were integrated to predict feasible photocatalytic OWS hcb‐type 2D‐COFs. Through training 10 initial algorithms and optimizing the hyperparameters of top 4 algorithms in terms of performance, the ETR model for predicting the band‐edge levels with R 2 of 0.97 and 0.99 was developed, and the KNR and RFR models were built for predicting Δ G *H and Δ G *OH with R 2 of 0.99 and 0.83, respectively. 2581 2D‑COFs (21.63% of dataset) are screened to be potential structures for visible‑light‑driven water splitting. After applying the optimal ML models on all assembled 2D‐COFs, a list of high‐frequency building blocks and linkages is suggested as a set of suitable candidates for the first time. Then TBTZ_FBN0_Imine (TBTZ‐FBN0‐COF) was assembled and experimentally synthesized. Its OWS activity verified our ML‐HTC paradigm, which provides the researchers recommendation to construct photocatalytic OWS 2D‐COFs.
title_zh: 整合机器学习与高通量计算用于光催化2D-COFs全分解水的合理设计
abstract_zh: 摘要 具有可调结构的二维共价有机框架（2D‐COFs）为可见光下光催化全解水（OWS）提供了有前景的平台。然而，从海量2D‐COFs中快速找到光催化OWS材料并实现精准合成极具挑战。本工作中，我们通过组装28种构筑单元和9种连接方式构建了11 934种hcb型2D‐COFs。结合机器学习（ML）与高通量计算（HTC）来预测可行的光催化OWS hcb型2D‐COFs。通过训练10种初始算法并对性能排名前4的算法进行超参数优化，建立了预测带边能级的ETR模型（R²分别为0.97和0.99），以及预测ΔG*H和ΔG*OH的KNR和RFR模型（R²分别为0.99和0.83）。筛选出2581种2D‐COFs（占数据集的21.63%）作为可见光驱动水分解的潜在结构。在所有组装的2D‐COFs上应用最优ML模型后，首次提出了一份高频构筑单元和连接方式清单，作为合适候选。随后组装并实验合成了TBTZ_FBN0_Imine（TBTZ‐FBN0‐COF），其OWS活性验证了我们的ML‐HTC范式，为研究者构建光催化OWS 2D‐COFs提供了推荐。

title: Decoupling the Dual Thermal Failure Pathways at the PDINN/Ag Cathode Interface in Conventional Organic Solar Cells
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)

title_zh: 传统有机太阳能电池中PDINN/Ag阴极界面双热失效路径的解耦
abstract_zh: 摘要 有机太阳能电池（OSC）的传统结构虽然可以提高功率转换效率（PCE），但热稳定性较差，这主要是由于对阴极侧界面退化的了解不够。在此，我们系统地研究了具有 PM6:L8-BO/PDINN/Ag 配置的传统 OSC 中广泛使用的电子传输层 PDINN 的热失效机制。我们确定了一个两阶段的降解途径：在初始加热阶段，PDINN 降解会在阴极接触附近的相邻有源层中诱导 n 型掺杂，从而降低短路电流密度 (JSC)。在长时间的热应力下，Ag− 迁移通过 PDINN 夹层，产生深空穴陷阱并改变阴极功函数。由此产生的 PM6:L8-BO/PDINN/Ag 界面处的能级不匹配极大地增加了电子提取势垒，加剧了电荷复合，并导致开路电压 (VOC) 和填充因子 (FF) 显着损失。在这种机理理解的指导下，我们在有源层和 PDINN 之间引入热蒸发的 C60/SnO2 双层作为扩散阻挡中间层。修改后的器件在 85 °C 下连续加热 1000 小时后保留了其初始 PCE 的 80%（初始 PCE：16.96%），与未修改的参考器件（T80）的快速降解形成鲜明对比。

title: HgSe/PbS Core-Shell Colloidal Quantum Dots Synthesized by a Simple Two-Step Method for Room-Temperature Long-Wave Infrared Photodetection
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Mercury chalcogenides (HgX) colloidal quantum dots (CQDs), particularly mercury selenide (HgSe) CQDs, have emerged as a promising candidate for long-wave infrared (LWIR, 8–14 μm) photodetectors due to their exceptional bandgap tunability by solution processing. Nevertheless, the intrinsic limitations of bare HgSe CQDs—high surface defect density and oxidation susceptibility—severely compromise their optoelectronic performance. In this paper, a simple two-step method to grow high-quality HgSe/PbS core-shell CQDs in the LWIR region by synergistically optimizing the thickness of the PbS shell for surface passivation and the oxidation resistance of the HgSe cores is presented. Further, its applications in LWIR detection are explored using a simple metal–semiconductor–metal (MSM) based photodetector Au/(HgSe/PbS)/Au. As a result, a high responsivity of 42 mA/W with a high specific detectivity of 2.41 × 109 Jones under a 25 mW/cm2, 10 μm illumination is obtained from the LWIR photodetector Au/[HgSe(13 nm)/PbS(5 nm)](1 μm)/Au at room-temperature. Therefore, such a simple two-step method of core-shell engineering approach establishes a versatile platform for developing next-generation LWIR optoelectronics.
title_zh: 简单两步法合成用于室温长波红外光电探测的HgSe/PbS核-壳胶体量子点
abstract_zh: 摘要 汞硫属化物 (HgX) 胶体量子点 (CQD)，特别是硒化汞 (HgSe) CQD，由于其通过溶液处理具有出色的带隙可调性，已成为长波红外 (LWIR，8–14 μm) 光电探测器的有前途的候选者。然而，裸 HgSe CQD 的固有局限性——高表面缺陷密度和氧化敏感性——严重损害了其光电性能。本文提出了一种简单的两步方法，通过协同优化用于表面钝化的 PbS 壳厚度和 HgSe 核的抗氧化性，在长波红外区域生长高质量 HgSe/PbS 核壳 CQD。此外，使用基于简单金属-半导体-金属 (MSM) 的光电探测器 Au/(HgSe/PbS)/Au 探索了其在长波红外检测中的应用。结果，在室温下，长波红外光电探测器Au/[HgSe(13 nm)/PbS(5 nm)](1 μm)/Au在25 mW/cm2、10 μm照明下获得了42 mA/W的高响应度和2.41 × 109 Jones的高比探测率。因此，这种简单的两步核壳工程方法为开发下一代长波红外光电子学建立了通用平台。

title: 6LiInP2Se6 Single Crystals: Growth, Defect Structure, α-Particle Spectroscopy, and Direct-Conversion X-ray Response
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Room-temperature semiconductor crystals combining high resistivity, efficient charge transport, and a well-defined defect landscape are central to direct-conversion radiation detection. Here, we report the first demonstration of direct-conversion X-ray response in the layered selenophosphate 6LiInP2Se6 (LIPSe). Two crystal growth routes are advanced in parallel: chemical vapor transport (CVT), optimized for thin, high-purity flakes, and Bridgman–Stockbarger growth with iterative purification, scaled to centimeter-sized ingots. Both yield single crystals having clean (00l) surfaces and indistinguishable powder X-ray diffraction, Raman, and microscopic signatures, as well as matched band-edge alignment from photoelectron yield spectroscopy. Thermally stimulated current spectroscopy resolves trap levels spanning ∼0.13–0.68 eV, with estimated total trap densities of ∼1.2 × 1013 cm–3 (CVT) and ∼9.8 × 1014 cm–3 (Bridgman), while both crystals retain the high bulk resistivity required for room-temperature operation. Under 241Am irradiation, CVT detectors deliver well-resolved α-particle pulse-height spectra (∼22% energy resolution) with polarization-limited hole collection, while Bridgman detectors yield lower-bound single-carrier Hecht μτ products of ∼10–6–10–5 cm2 V–1 for both carriers. Under modulated X-ray exposure, sensitivities of ∼2.1 × 103 µC Gyair–1 cm–2 (CVT, ∼33 kV cm–1) and ∼6.5 × 103 µC Gyair–1 cm–2 (Bridgman, ∼22 kV cm–1) are achieved, where the larger Bridgman absorption volume offsets its trap-limited transport, identifying thickness scaling under continued defect control as the most direct path forward.
title_zh: 6LiInP2Se6单晶：生长、缺陷结构、α粒子谱学及直接转换X射线响应
abstract_zh: 摘要 室温半导体晶体结合了高电阻率、高效电荷传输和明确的缺陷景观，是直接转换辐射检测的核心。在这里，我们报告了层状硒磷酸盐 6LiInP2Se6 (LIPSe) 中直接转换 X 射线响应的首次演示。两条晶体生长路线并行推进：针对薄、高纯度薄片进行优化的化学气相传输（CVT），以及采用迭代纯化的布里奇曼-斯托克巴格生长，缩小至厘米尺寸的晶锭。两者都产生具有清洁 (00l) 表面和难以区分的粉末 X 射线衍射、拉曼和微观特征的单晶，以及来自光电子产率光谱的匹配带边缘对准。热受激电流能谱解析的陷阱能级范围为～0.13–0.68 eV，估计总陷阱密度为～1.2 × 1013 cm–3 (CVT) 和～9.8 × 1014 cm–3 (Bridgman)，同时两种晶体都保留了室温操作所需的高体电阻率。在 241Am 照射下，CVT 探测器可通过偏振限制空穴收集提供高分辨率的 α 粒子脉冲高度光谱（~22% 能量分辨率），而布里奇曼探测器则为两种载流子产生约 10–6–10–5 cm2 V–1 的下限单载流子 Hecht μτ 产物。在调制 X 射线照射下，实现了~2.1 × 103 µC Gyair–1 cm–2（CVT，~33 kV cm–1）和~6.5 × 103 µC Gyair–1 cm–2（Bridgman，~22 kV cm–1）的灵敏度，其中较大的 Bridgman 吸收体积抵消了其陷阱限制的传输，从而识别了连续条件下的厚度缩放

title: Co-deformable Conductive Composite Films via Elasticity-Driven Reversible Dynamic Bonds
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The booming development of flexible electronics urgently calls for flexible conductive materials with outstanding mechanical strength, desirable elastic recovery, and reliable conductivity. Herein, a UV-curable polyacrylate conductive composite film (polyacrylate-AA-ChCl, PAAC) is rationally designed, featuring enhanced elastic recovery endowed by reversible hydrogen bonds. A polyacrylate (PA) film is first fabricated via UV-initiated polymerization using acrylate monomers and a vinyl-terminated polyurethane prepolymer as the cross-linker, exhibiting high transparency (>90%), solvent resistance (>72 h), favorable mechanical strength, and folding resistance. Subsequently, a polymerizable deep eutectic solvent (PDES)—specifically, acrylic acid/choline chloride (AA/ChCl)—was incorporated. This endows the composite with stable ionic conductivity while preserving its original mechanical properties. The resultant PAAC composite as a flexible strain sensor achieves excellent compatibility between components, outstanding mechanical durability (14.2 MPa and 735%), reliable conductivity (GF = 1.58) under deformation, and a low glass transition temperature (Tg = 4.5 °C). This work proposes a facile, scalable, and high-performance strategy for fabricating flexible conductive composites, which offers novel insights into the advancement of flexible electronics, wearable devices, and eco-friendly functional materials.
title_zh: 基于弹性驱动可逆动态键的共形变导电复合薄膜
abstract_zh: 摘要 柔性电子器件的蓬勃发展迫切需要具有优异的机械强度、良好的弹性恢复能力和可靠的导电性能的柔性导电材料。本文合理设计了一种紫外光固化聚丙烯酸酯导电复合薄膜（聚丙烯酸酯-AA-ChCl，PAAC），具有可逆氢键赋予的增强弹性恢复能力。首先使用丙烯酸酯单体和乙烯基封端的聚氨酯预聚物作为交联剂，通过紫外线引发聚合制备聚丙烯酸酯（PA）薄膜，该薄膜具有高透明度（>90%）、耐溶剂性（>72 h）、良好的机械强度和耐折叠性。随后，加入了可聚合的低共熔溶剂 (PDES)，特别是丙烯酸/氯化胆碱 (AA/ChCl)。这赋予复合材料稳定的离子电导率，同时保留其原有的机械性能。所得的 PAAC 复合材料作为柔性应变传感器，实现了组件之间优异的兼容性、出色的机械耐久性（14.2 MPa 和 735%）、变形下可靠的导电性（GF = 1.58）以及较低的玻璃化转变温度（Tg = 4.5 °C）。这项工作提出了一种用于制造柔性导电复合材料的简便、可扩展和高性能的策略，为柔性电子、可穿戴设备和环保功能材料的进步提供了新颖的见解。

title_zh: 超越漏斗式高通量筛选：面向多元钙钛矿电催化剂探索的专家引导多尺度联结平台

title: Deciphering Electrocatalytic Sulfur Reduction Reactions in Al–S Batteries via Single-Particle Electrodes
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The kinetically sluggish sulfur reduction reaction (SRR) governs the performance of ultrahigh-capacity aluminum–sulfur batteries, while deciphering the SRR process is critical for rationally electrocatalyzing reaction kinetics to unlock their full energy output. To overcome this challenge, a single-particle electrochemical methodology has been developed to investigate the SRR process on a cobalt/nickel and nitrogen codoped graphene (CoNi-NG) electrocatalyst. The SRR process involves a major route of S8 → Al2S8 → Al2S4 → Al2S3 with a minor route of Al2S8 → Al2S6 → Al2S4, where Al2S4 conversion governs the overall SRR kinetics and Al2S4 contributes the most to the shuttle effect owing to its fastest generation and slowest consumption. The CoNi-NG raises the Co d-orbital energy level via Ni-to-Co electron transfer to accelerate cleavage of polysulfides, which doubles the exchange current density of rate-determining Al2S4 conversion. Consequently, the sulfur composite (S@CoNi-NG) electrode delivers a specific capacity of ∼1480 mAh gsulfur–1. Such a single-particle methodology for quantitatively deciphering electrocatalytic SRRs offers mechanistic guidance for rationally enhancing battery performance.
title_zh: 通过单颗粒电极解析铝-硫电池中的电催化硫还原反应
abstract_zh: 摘要 动力学缓慢的硫还原反应（SRR）控制着超高容量铝硫电池的性能，而破译SRR过程对于合理地电催化反应动力学以释放其全部能量输出至关重要。为了克服这一挑战，开发了一种单颗粒电化学方法来研究钴/镍和氮共掺杂石墨烯（CoNi-NG）电催化剂上的 SRR 过程。 SRR过程涉及S8→Al2S8→Al2S4→Al2S3的主要路线和Al2S8→Al2S6→Al2S4的次要路线，其中Al2S4转化控制整个SRR动力学，而Al2S4由于其最快的生成和最慢的消耗而对穿梭效应贡献最大。 CoNi-NG 通过 Ni-to-Co 电子转移提高 Co d 轨道能级，以加速多硫化物的裂解，从而使决定速率的 Al2S4 转化的交换电流密度加倍。因此，硫复合材料（S@CoNi-NG）电极的比容量为~1480 mAh gsulfur-1。这种用于定量解读电催化 SRR 的单粒子方法为合理增强电池性能提供了机械指导。

title: Dual-Site Engineering Unlocks Spin Modulation and Local Field-Controlled Charge Switching in Triangulenes
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Open-shell nanographenes, featuring highly tunable and correlated magnetic states, constitute a promising platform for engineering graphene nanomagnets towards molecular-scale spintronics and quantum information technologies. However, their magnetic states are largely dictated by topological constraints and strong electronic correlations, limiting independent control of spin and charge degrees of freedom. Here, we introduce a structural dual-site engineering strategy that integrates intrinsic spin modulation with adsorption- and field-controlled charge state tuning in a single magnetic nanographene, enabling a level of multifunctional control not previously demonstrated. We design and synthesize nitrogen, sulfur-co-engineered [3]triangulene (N,S-Tri), incorporating a central nitrogen dopant and an edge sulfur substitution with complementary functions. The central nitrogen modifies the occupation of the frontier π states and thereby tunes the molecular spin configuration, while the edge sulfur site weakly participates in the low-energy π-state and simultaneously acts as a tunable chemical anchor that regulates molecule–substrate coupling and charge transfer. Using low-temperature scanning probe microscopy, we directly visualize switching from neutral to cationic states, driven by adsorption-site variation on Au(111), or reversible switching by local electrostatic gating. This dual-functional design moves beyond static doping or interface charge transfer in graphene nanomagnets, enabling field-controlled dynamic modulation of spin and charge states, and opening new opportunities for device-oriented applications where molecule–electrode interactions and electrostatic field control play central roles.
title_zh: 双位点工程解锁三角烯中的自旋调制与局域场控制的电荷切换
abstract_zh: 摘要 开壳纳米石墨烯具有高度可调和相关的磁态，为将石墨烯纳米磁体工程化以实现分子级自旋电子学和量子信息技术提供了一个有前途的平台。然而，它们的磁态很大程度上取决于拓扑约束和强电子相关性，限制了对自旋和电荷自由度的独立控制。在这里，我们引入了一种结构双位点工程策略，该策略将本征自旋调制与单个磁性纳米石墨烯中的吸附和场控电荷状态调谐集成在一起，从而实现了先前未证实的多功能控制水平。我们设计并合成了氮、硫协同设计的[3]三角烯（N,S-Tri），其中包含具有互补功能的中心氮掺杂剂和边缘硫取代。中心氮改变了前沿π态的占据，从而调节分子自旋构型，而边缘硫位点微弱地参与低能π态，同时充当调节分子-底物耦合和电荷转移的可调节化学锚。使用低温扫描探针显微镜，我们直接可视化由 Au(111) 吸附位点变化驱动的中性态到阳离子态的切换，或通过局部静电门控的可逆切换。这种双功能设计超越了石墨烯纳米磁体中的静态掺杂或界面电荷转移，实现了自旋和电荷状态的场控动态调制，并开辟了新的领域。

title: A Host–Guest Strategy to Achieve Selective and Robust CO2-to-CO Electrocatalysis in Aqueous Media
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Heterogeneous materials incorporating molecular catalysts hold strong promise for efficient electrocatalytic CO2 reduction to value-added products. While activity and selectivity are traditionally tuned through ligand design, increasing attention is being paid to the second-coordination sphere, which modulates reactivity beyond the metal center. Inspired by enzymatic systems, this outer-sphere environment enhances catalysis through spatial confinement and noncovalent interactions. Here, we report a host–guest strategy to control CO2 reduction using the [bpyMn(CO)3MeCN]+ catalyst encapsulated in an anionic cage. When immobilized on an electrode surface, the assembly selectively produces CO. Mechanistic studies indicate that the cage promotes proton-coupled CO2 binding while preventing catalyst deactivation. This demonstrates that supramolecular second-sphere engineering is a powerful strategy for enhancing electrocatalytic performance and provides a basis for future developments in molecular electrocatalysts.
title_zh: 主客体策略实现水相介质中选择性且稳定的CO2到CO电催化
abstract_zh: 摘要 结合分子催化剂的异质材料对于高效电催化二氧化碳还原为增值产品具有广阔的前景。虽然活性和选择性传统上是通过配体设计来调节的，但人们越来越关注第二配位球，它调节金属中心以外的反应性。受酶系统的启发，这种外球环境通过空间限制和非共价相互作用增强催化作用。在这里，我们报告了一种主客体策略，使用封装在阴离子笼中的 [bpyMn(CO)3MeCN]+ 催化剂来控制 CO2 还原。当固定在电极表面上时，该组件选择性地产生 CO。机理研究表明，笼子促进质子耦合 CO2 结合，同时防止催化剂失活。这表明超分子第二球体工程是增强电催化性能的有力策略，并为分子电催化剂的未来发展奠定了基础。

title: Atomically Precise Pt19: The Largest All-Organic Ligand–Protected Platinum Nanocluster with Enhanced Stability and Electrocatalytic Activity
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Versatile organic ligands can notably enhance the stability and tunability of metal nanoclusters (NCs), and, consequently, all-organic ligand–protected metal nanoclusters have recently attracted widespread attention. Platinum (Pt) remains an indispensable metal in various fields, particularly in catalysis and cancer therapeutics. However, all-organic ligand–protected Pt nanoclusters are rarely reported due to substantial synthesis challenges, which have hindered progress in Pt nanocluster research and their practical applications. Herein, we report the successful synthesis of the largest all-organic ligand–protected Pt nanocluster to date, [Pt19(NapNC)27][PF6]2 (abbreviated as Pt19; NapNC: isocyanonaphthalene), achieved through the development of a ligand-exchange method. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction (SC-XRD) revealed a face-centered cubic (FCC), nonequivalent structure that has not been previously documented for all-organic ligand–protected Pt nanoclusters. Compared with its partially organic parent nanoclusters, this novel nanocluster exhibits considerably enhanced stability in both the ground and excited states. Furthermore, the Pt19 nanocluster demonstrates superior activity in the electrocatalytic methanol oxidation reaction (MOR) relative to its parent nanoclusters and commercial Pt/C. Based on its well-defined structure, we gained deep insights into the exceptional MOR activity of Pt19 and revealed, for the first time, the steric and electronic preferences of the active sites for electrocatalytic MOR.
title_zh: 原子级精确的Pt19：具有增强稳定性与电催化活性的最大全有机配体保护铂纳米团簇
abstract_zh: 摘要 多功能有机配体可以显着提高金属纳米团簇（NC）的稳定性和可调性，因此，全有机配体保护的金属纳米团簇最近引起了广泛的关注。铂（Pt）仍然是各个领域不可或缺的金属，特别是在催化和癌症治疗领域。然而，由于合成上的巨大挑战，全有机配体保护的Pt纳米团簇很少被报道，这阻碍了Pt纳米团簇研究及其实际应用的进展。在此，我们报告了通过配体交换方法的开发，成功合成了迄今为止最大的全有机配体保护的Pt纳米团簇[Pt19(NapNC)27][PF6]2（缩写为Pt19；NapNC：异氰萘）。单晶 X 射线衍射 (SC-XRD) 揭示了面心立方 (FCC) 的非等效结构，这种结构以前从未有过全有机配体保护的 Pt 纳米团簇的记录。与其部分有机母体纳米团簇相比，这种新型纳米团簇在基态和激发态下均表现出显着增强的稳定性。此外，相对于其母体纳米团簇和商业 Pt/C，Pt19 纳米团簇在电催化甲醇氧化反应 (MOR) 中表现出优异的活性。基于其明确的结构，我们深入了解了 Pt19 卓越的 MOR 活性，并首次揭示了电催化 MOR 活性位点的空间和电子偏好。

title: From Dehydrogenation to Derivatization: Functionalization of Alkanes and Alkyl Groups by Molecular Catalysis
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Alkane dehydrogenation has evolved from a fundamental organometallic challenge into a transformative technology for upgrading abundant hydrocarbon feedstocks and modifying complex molecules. This Perspective charts the evolution of modern alkane dehydrogenation, emphasizing the strategic divergence between well-established two-electron pathways and emerging radical-mediated reaction manifolds. For the dehydrogenation of structurally unbiased simple alkanes, research remains centered on noble-metal-based molecular catalysts, represented by pincer–transition-metal systems, where activity and regioselectivity are not only governed by catalysts’ first coordination sphere but also subtly affected by ligands’ scaffold. In contrast, for the dehydrogenation of hydrocarbons with electronically or thermodynamically differentiated C(sp3)–H bonds, a complementary paradigm has emerged in which reactivity is mainly dictated by the intrinsic properties of substrates. The interplay of bond dissociation energies (BDEs) and bond polarity can be harnessed by a diverse array of hydrogen atom transfer (HAT) reagents (or catalysts). We discuss how these two distinct mechanisms dictate the scope of both the dehydrogenation and dehydrogenation-triggered derivatization, which extends beyond small alkane functionalizations to controlled upcycling of macromolecular polyolefins. By analyzing the interplay between thermodynamic constraints, catalyst sustainability, and process integration, we outline a forward-looking roadmap for next-generation catalytic dehydrogenation systems.
title_zh: 从脱氢到衍生化：通过分子催化实现烷烃和烷基官能团化
abstract_zh: 摘要 烷烃脱氢已从一项基本的有机金属挑战发展成为一项用于升级丰富的碳氢化合物原料和改性复杂分子的革命性技术。本视角描绘了现代烷烃脱氢的演变，强调了成熟的双电子途径和新兴的自由基介导的反应流形之间的战略分歧。对于结构无偏的简单烷烃的脱氢，研究仍然集中在以钳过渡金属体系为代表的贵金属分子催化剂上，其中活性和区域选择性不仅受催化剂的第一配位球的控制，而且还受到配体支架的微妙影响。相比之下，对于具有电子或热力学差异的C(sp3)-H键的碳氢化合物的脱氢，出现了一种补充范式，其中反应性主要由底物的固有性质决定。键解离能 (BDE) 和键极性的相互作用可以通过多种氢原子转移 (HAT) 试剂（或催化剂）来利用。我们讨论这两种不同的机制如何决定脱氢和脱氢触发的衍生化的范围，其范围超出了小烷烃官能化，延伸到大分子聚烯烃的受控升级循环。通过分析热力学约束、催化剂可持续性和工艺集成之间的相互作用，我们概述了下一代催化脱氢系统的前瞻性路线图。

title: Homogeneous Iron Porphyrin as a Molecular CO Shuttle Enables Electrochemical Multicarbon Product Formation from CO2
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Homogeneous molecular catalysts for electrochemical CO2 reduction are generally limited to two-electron-reduced C1 products, primarily CO. Here we propose and demonstrate a fundamentally distinct role for molecular catalysts: as reversible CO shuttles that enhance the local CO activity at the electrical double layer. Using a water-soluble iron porphyrin as a CO shuttle, we observe the formation of isotopically verified C1–C4 hydrocarbons from CO2 in aqueous electrolyte. These products are not observed even in CO-saturated electrolyte in the absence of the iron porphyrin, indicating that the shuttle enhances local CO activity at the electrode surface beyond what bulk saturation can provide. Electrochemical and spectroscopic data support the formation of a stable FeII–CO species outside the compact layer, which releases CO upon further reduction at the electrode surface, consistent with an electrochemically gated shuttle mechanism. These findings suggest a potential design principle in which homogeneous catalysts function as molecular intermediate shuttles at the electrode surface and provide an alternative framework for interpreting beyond-CO products observed in heterogenized molecular catalyst systems.
title_zh: 均相铁卟啉作为分子CO穿梭体实现CO2电化学多碳产物生成
abstract_zh: 摘要 用于电化学 CO2 还原的均相分子催化剂通常仅限于双电子还原的 C1 产物，主要是 CO。在这里，我们提出并证明了分子催化剂的一个根本不同的作用：作为可逆的 CO 穿梭，增强双电层的局部 CO 活性。使用水溶性铁卟啉作为 CO 穿梭，我们观察到在水性电解质中由 CO2 形成经过同位素验证的 C1-C4 碳氢化合物。即使在不存在铁卟啉的 CO 饱和电解质中也观察不到这些产物，这表明穿梭增强了电极表面的局部 CO 活性，超出了本体饱和所能提供的范围。电化学和光谱数据支持在致密层外形成稳定的 FeII-CO 物质，其在电极表面进一步还原时释放 CO，这与电化学门控穿梭机制一致。这些发现提出了一种潜在的设计原理，即均相催化剂在电极表面充当分子中间体穿梭机，并为解释在多相分子催化剂系统中观察到的超越CO产物提供了替代框架。

title: Modular Platform for Directing-Group-Free Radical Dicarbofunctionalization of Unactivated Alkenes via Dual Nickel/Energy-Transfer Catalysis
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Multicomponent cross-coupling reactions of alkenes offer a powerful strategy for constructing three-dimensional, sp3 -rich molecular architectures, a key objective in modern medicinal chemistry. However, the regioselective dicarbofunctionalization of unactivated alkenes without the use of directing groups remains a significant challenge. Herein, we report a visible-light-induced, Ni-catalyzed platform that enables the radical 1,2-dicarbofunctionalization of unactivated alkenes using diverse alkyl radical precursors and aryl, vinyl, acyl, alkynyl, and alkyl coupling partners. Mechanistic studies support a catalytic cycle in which multiple electron donor–acceptor (EDA) complexes mediate radical generation, atom-transfer radical addition (ATRA), and cross-electrophile coupling (XEC) or bimolecular homolytic substitution (SH2) processes. Additionally, preferential formation of a complex between the Ni catalyst and the radical precursor suppresses undesired homocoupling of the electrophilic partner. Notably, delivery of gaseous radical precursors such as trifluoromethyl iodide (TFMI) from the robust metal–organic framework (MOF) Al(OH)fum (fum– = fumarate) or Al–fum offers advantages in terms of both operational safety and reaction efficiency, and the MOF further boosts the yields of reactions by decreasing the concentration of free amine (employed for radical generation) in solution. Collectively, this flexible, directing-group-free approach establishes a general platform for the rapid construction of structurally complex and pharmaceutically relevant molecules from readily available precursors.
title_zh: 通过双镍/能量转移催化实现非活化烯烃无导向基自由基双碳官能化的模块化平台
abstract_zh: 摘要 烯烃的多组分交叉偶联反应为构建三维、富含 sp3 的分子结构提供了强大的策略，这是现代药物化学的一个关键目标。然而，在不使用导向基团的情况下对未活化的烯烃进行区域选择性二碳官能化仍然是一个重大挑战。在此，我们报告了一种可见光诱导的镍催化平台，该平台能够使用不同的烷基自由基前体和芳基、乙烯基、酰基、炔基和烷基偶联伙伴对未活化的烯烃进行自由基 1,2-二碳官能化。机理研究支持催化循环，其中多个电子供体-受体（EDA）复合物介导自由基生成、原子转移自由基加成（ATRA）和交叉亲电子偶联（XEC）或双分子均裂取代（SH2）过程。此外，Ni催化剂和自由基前体之间优先形成络合物抑制了不期望的亲电子配偶体的自偶联。值得注意的是，从坚固的金属有机骨架（MOF）Al(OH)fum（fum–=富马酸盐）或Al-fum输送气态自由基前体，例如三氟甲基碘（TFMI），在操作安全性和反应效率方面具有优势，并且MOF通过降低溶液中游离胺（用于自由基生成）的浓度进一步提高反应产率。总的来说，这种灵活的、无导向基团的方法为快速构建结构复杂且药物相关的分子建立了一个通用平台。

title: A method for adaptive spectral clustering in flexibility markets
abstract: Market-based frameworks require aggregating flexible, granular resources into stable trading products to achieve efficient grid congestion management. The heterogeneous nature of demand-side flexibility, which entangles topological constraints with dynamic user preferences, renders static clustering ineffective. Frequent reclustering could capture these dynamics, but it introduces operational volatility and remains mathematically intractable for near-real-time operations. To resolve this stability-efficiency trade-off, this paper proposes a grid-aware State-Adaptive Hybrid Clustering (SAHC) method. Unlike rigid topological partitioning, SAHC employs a spectral approach to capture non-linear interactions between grid physics and economic behavior. The framework integrates a day-ahead initialization—Affinity Aggregation with Spectral Clustering (AASC)—with a dynamic intra-day engine that autonomously switches between a lightweight stateful update (Power Iteration Clustering) and a stateless re-estimation (Nyström approximation) based on spectral structural integrity. Simulations on the IEEE 33-bus system under an abrupt behavioral shift demonstrate that SAHC achieves lower computational latency with minor effects on economic efficiency. The approach attains flexibility costs comparable to high-fidelity benchmarks while reducing computation time by more than one order of magnitude relative to full spectral decomposition, enabling operation under strict real-time constraints. These results support SAHC as a scalable solution that ensures market continuity without the limitations of static approaches.
title_zh: 灵活性市场中的一种自适应谱聚类方法
abstract_zh: 基于市场的框架需要将灵活、精细的资源聚合成稳定的交易产品，以实现高效的电网拥塞管理。需求方灵活性的异构性将拓扑约束与动态用户偏好纠缠在一起，导致静态集群无效。频繁的重新集群可以捕获这些动态，但它会带来操作波动性，并且对于近实时操作来说在数学上仍然难以处理。为了解决这种稳定性与效率的权衡，本文提出了一种网格感知状态自适应混合聚类（SAHC）方法。与严格的拓扑划分不同，SAHC 采用谱方法来捕获网格物理和经济行为之间的非线性相互作用。该框架将日前初始化（带有谱聚类的亲和聚合（AASC））与动态日内引擎集成在一起，该引擎根据谱结构完整性在轻量级有状态更新（Power Iteration Clustering）和无状态重新估计（Nyström 近似）之间自动切换。对 IEEE 33 总线系统在突然行为转变下的模拟表明，SAHC 实现了较低的计算延迟，同时对经济效率的影响较小。该方法实现了与高保真基准相当的灵活性成本，同时相对于全谱分解将计算时间减少了一个数量级以上，从而能够在严格的实时约束下进行操作。这些结果支持 SAHC 作为可扩展的解决方案，确保市场连续性而不受限制

title: Nanoscale In 2 O 3 Induced Fast Kinetics and Stable Interface for High‐Loading Solid‐State Cathode
abstract: ABSTRACT Sulfide‐based all‐solid‐state lithium batteries (ASSLBs) with high‐loading cathodes are currently hindered by sluggish Li + /electron kinetics and poor interfacial compatibility. Conventional carbon additives, despite their high conductivity, often trigger detrimental side reactions with sulfide electrolytes. To mitigate these issues, we introduce a multifunctional nanoscale In 2 O 3 conductive agent, integrated via a facile one‐step ball milling process. This nano‐In 2 O 3 effectively mediates interactions between large Li 5.5 PS 4.5 Cl 1.5 (LPSC) and LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 (NCM811) particles, enhancing mixing homogeneity and collision efficiency. The resulting composite cathode features a low‐tortuosity Li + transport network and establishes rapid “NCM‐nano In 2 O 3 ‐NCM” electronic pathways within particle gaps. Crucially, In 2 O 3 improves interfacial compatibility between the LPSC and conductive additives, suppressing interfacial degradation. Consequently, a high‐loading cathode (18.34 mg cm −2 ) demonstrates a specific capacity of 131 mAh g −1 at 3C and exhibits excellent cyclability, retaining 97.6% capacity after 500 cycles in NCM811||Li cells. This strategy highlights the potential of nanoscale metal oxide additives for achieving high‐energy‐density ASSLBs through optimized interfacial and transport kinetics.
title_zh: 纳米In 2 O 3诱导快速动力学与稳定界面助力高载量固态正极
abstract_zh: 摘要 采用高载量正极的硫化物基全固态锂电池（ASSLBs）目前受限于缓慢的Li⁺/电子动力学和较差的界面相容性。传统碳添加剂虽然导电性高，但常与硫化物电解质引发有害副反应。为缓解这些问题，我们引入了一种多功能纳米级In₂O₃导电剂，通过简便的一步球磨工艺复合。该纳米In₂O₃有效介导了大的Li₅.₅PS₄.₅Cl₁.₅（LPSC）与LiNi₀.₈Co₀.₁Mn₀.₁O₂（NCM811）颗粒之间的相互作用，提升了混合均匀性和碰撞效率。所得复合正极具有低迂曲度的Li⁺传输网络，并在颗粒间隙内建立了快速的“NCM‐纳米In₂O₃‐NCM”电子通路。关键的是，In₂O₃改善了LPSC与导电添加剂之间的界面相容性，抑制了界面退化。因此，高载量正极（18.34 mg cm⁻²）在3C下表现出131 mAh g⁻¹的比容量，并展现出优异的循环性能，NCM811||Li电池在500次循环后容量保持率为97.6%。该策略凸显了纳米金属氧化物添加剂通过优化界面与传输动力学实现高能量密度ASSLBs的潜力。

title: Green hydrogen production system design optimisation with strategic reliability decisions
abstract: Green hydrogen (GH) is central to global decarbonisation strategies, yet its large-scale deployment remains constrained by high costs, limited operational experience, and the lack of integrated planning frameworks that jointly account for reliability, maintenance, and renewable resource variability across diverse grid connectivity and demand conditions. This study develops a novel reliability-based mixed-integer nonlinear programming (MINLP) framework that uses stochastic optimisation to simultaneously optimise technology selection, subsystem sizing, maintenance planning, and availability investment decisions for GH production systems, with green ammonia serving as the downstream energy carrier for long-distance transport. A case study in Eastern Canada identifies a wind-dominated configuration with supplemental solar and battery storage as the optimal solution, achieving a levelised cost of hydrogen (LCOH) of $4.44 kg −1 . Comparative geographic analyses reveal that wind-dominant regions achieve costs 18% to 41% lower than solar-dominant regions across best- to worst-case operating conditions, where lower solar capacity factors and stronger seasonal generation patterns necessitate substantially larger storage investments with limited production benefits. The framework also identifies two primary sources of renewable energy curtailment: the mismatch between installed renewable capacity and electrolyser absorption capability, and electrolyser downtime. Improving electrolyser availability reduces total curtailment by up to 48%, yet imposing stricter curtailment limits increases system costs without improving hydrogen production, with low-demand systems experiencing the greatest economic penalty due to higher incremental maintenance requirements. The findings demonstrate that maintenance strategies, curtailment management, grid interaction, and technology configuration must be jointly optimised under region-specific resource and demand conditions to achieve viable GH production. This study provides a practical framework to support these decisions during the design phase.
title_zh: 包含战略可靠性决策的绿氢生产系统设计优化
abstract_zh: 绿色氢（GH）是全球脱碳战略的核心，但其大规模部署仍然受到高成本、有限的运营经验以及缺乏综合规划框架的限制，这些框架无法共同考虑不同电网连接和需求条件下的可靠性、维护和可再生资源的可变性。本研究开发了一种新型的基于可靠性的混合整数非线性规划（MINLP）框架，该框架使用随机优化来同时优化 GH 生产系统的技术选择、子系统规模、维护规划和可用性投资决策，其中绿色氨作为长距离运输的下游能源载体。加拿大东部的一项案例研究确定了以风为主并补充太阳能和电池存储的配置作为最佳解决方案，实现了 4.44 美元 kg -1 的平准化氢成本 (LCOH)。比较地理分析表明，在最佳到最差的运行条件下，以风能为主的地区的成本比以太阳能为主的地区低18%至41%，在这些地区，较低的太阳能容量系数和较强的季节性发电模式需要大幅增加存储投资，而生产效益有限。该框架还确定了可再生能源削减的两个主要来源：可再生能源装机容量与电解槽吸收能力之间的不匹配，以及电解槽的停机时间。提高电解槽的可用性可将总弃电量减少高达 48%，但实施更严格的弃电限制会增加

title: When Copper Falls: Overriding the Irving–Williams Stability Trend Through Outer-Sphere Hydrogen Bonding
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The Irving–Williams series (Mn Zn) is a well-established thermodynamic stability trend among high-spin divalent first-row transition-metal complexes. However, complete isostructural Mn–Zn series are rare, and those that enable direct evaluation of a defined secondary coordination sphere are even rarer. As a result, whether outer-sphere noncovalent interactions can alter this periodic trend without changing the primary coordination environment has remained unresolved. Here, we present a complete isostructural octahedral series, (allLH)2MCl2 (M = Mn–Zn), supported by a flavin-derived bidentate ligand, allLH. An outer-sphere N–H···Cl hydrogen-bonding network provided by allLH locks all complexes into a single meridional isomer, enabling direct thermodynamic comparison across the row. In stark contrast to the classical Irving–Williams series, Cu(II) becomes the least stable species in the (allLH)2MCl2 series. Experimental and computational analyses show that this reversal arises from a finely balanced noncovalent constraint imposed by the rigid hydrogen-bonded scaffold. This scaffold retains the octahedral geometry of (allLH)2CuCl2 but only partially accommodates Jahn–Teller distortion, leaving the resulting stabilization insufficient to offset the accompanying attenuation of outer-sphere hydrogen-bond stabilization. This study demonstrates that a well-established metal-ion stability trend can be overcome by designing outer-sphere noncovalent interactions without altering the primary coordination environment.
title_zh: 当铜被超越：通过外球氢键打破Irving–Williams稳定性趋势
abstract_zh: 摘要 欧文-威廉姆斯系列 (Mn Zn) 是高自旋二价第一排过渡金属配合物中公认的热力学稳定性趋势。然而，完整的同构 Mn-Zn 系列很少见，而那些能够直接评估确定的二级配位层的系列则更加罕见。因此，外层非共价相互作用是否可以在不改变主要配位环境的情况下改变这种周期性趋势仍然悬而未决。在这里，我们提出了一个完整的同构八面体系列，(allLH)2MCl2 (M = Mn-Zn)，由黄素衍生的二齿配体 allLH 支持。 allLH 提供的外球 N–H…Cl 氢键网络将所有配合物锁定为单一子午异构体，从而实现跨行的直接热力学比较。与经典的欧文-威廉姆斯系列形成鲜明对比，Cu(II) 成为 (allLH)2MCl2 系列中最不稳定的物质。实验和计算分析表明，这种逆转是由刚性氢键支架施加的精细平衡的非共价约束引起的。该支架保留了 (allLH)2CuCl2 的八面体几何形状，但仅部分适应 Jahn-Teller 畸变，导致所得的稳定性不足以抵消外球氢键稳定性的伴随衰减。这项研究表明，通过设计外层非共价相互作用，可以在不改变主要配位环境的情况下克服既定的金属离子稳定性趋势。

title: Sequence-defined Digital Bottlebrush Polymers for Programmable Oligonucleotide Delivery
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Oligonucleotide therapeutics hold transformative potential, yet their clinical translation is hindered by delivery barriers, including rapid renal/hepatic clearance and poor organ specificity. Bottlebrush polymer conjugates have emerged as a promising vector to address these limitations, but conventional architectures with uniform backbones can only achieve an unmodifiable, rigid biodistribution profile. Here, we report a library of sequence-defined “digital” bottlebrush polymers, precisely engineered with controlled placements of chemical motifs that modify physicochemical properties─including lipids, cholesterol, and cationic groups─along a polyphosphodiester backbone. Systematic evaluation of the digital bottlebrush polymer library reveals distinct structure–property relationships and enables organ-biased systemic delivery to several traditionally difficult-to-reach tissues, including muscle and skin. In a mouse model of rheumatoid arthritis, a single dose of a spleen-homing polymer-conjugated antisense oligonucleotide targeting TNF-α significantly reduced arthritis severity and preserved animal body weight. These findings establish a versatile design framework for tailoring bottlebrush polymers to specific therapeutic applications.
title_zh: 用于可编程寡核苷酸递送的序列明确数字瓶刷聚合物
abstract_zh: 摘要 寡核苷酸疗法具有变革潜力，但其临床转化受到递送障碍的阻碍，包括快速的肾脏/肝脏清除和较差的器官特异性。 Bottlebrush 聚合物缀合物已成为解决这些限制的有前途的载体，但具有均匀主链的传统架构只能实现不可修改的、刚性的生物分布曲线。在这里，我们报告了一个序列定义的“数字”洗瓶刷聚合物库，通过精确设计化学基序的受控位置来改变理化性质（包括脂质、胆固醇和阳离子基团）沿着聚磷酸二酯主链。对数字洗瓶刷聚合物库的系统评估揭示了独特的结构-性能关系，并能够实现器官偏向的系统递送到几个传统上难以到达的组织，包括肌肉和皮肤。在类风湿性关节炎小鼠模型中，单剂靶向 TNF-α 的脾归巢聚合物缀合反义寡核苷酸可显着降低关节炎的严重程度并保持动物体重。这些发现建立了一个通用的设计框架，用于根据特定的治疗应用定制洗瓶刷聚合物。

title: Cobalt-Catalyzed, Aminoquinoline-Directed Functionalization of Nonactivated C(sp3)-H Bonds under Mild Conditions
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Second- and third-row transition metal catalysis in C(sp3)-H bond functionalization is well-established and is currently used in the synthesis of complex natural products, which can be considered the ultimate test of new synthetic methodologies. However, readily available and abundant first-row metals have been mostly employed in the functionalization of C(sp2)-H bonds. Their use in transformations of nonactivated (not benzylic or α to a heteroatom) C(sp3)-H bonds is rare and typically limited by the inability to functionalize secondary C–H bonds, high reaction temperatures, and the need to employ multiple equivalents of silver(I) oxidants. We report here a new approach to cobalt-catalyzed carbon–hydrogen bond functionalization by using a double-directing group strategy, enabling efficient activation of primary and secondary C(sp3)-H bonds under mild conditions to form β- or γ-lactams. Barium manganate is employed as an oxidant. Several Co(III) intermediates have been isolated and their reactivity is explored, supporting their involvement in the catalytic cycle. The reaction shows unusually high KIE kH/kD (>11) for C–H functionalization, allowing the use of deuterium as a blocking group, which enables amplified or switchable site selectivity. Mechanistic studies suggest a possible contribution of quantum tunneling in the C–H activation step.
title_zh: 温和条件下氨基喹啉导向的钴催化非活化C(sp3)-H键官能化
abstract_zh: 摘要 C(sp3)-H键功能化中的第二列和第三列过渡金属催化已经成熟，目前用于复杂天然产物的合成，可以被认为是新合成方法的终极测试。然而，容易获得且丰富的第一行金属主要用于 C(sp2)-H 键的功能化。它们在非活化（不是苄基或α到杂原子）C(sp3)-H键的转化中的应用很少，并且通常受到无法功能化二级C-H键、高反应温度以及需要使用多当量银(I)氧化剂的限制。我们在这里报告了一种钴催化碳氢键功能化的新方法，通过使用双导向基团策略，能够在温和条件下有效激活伯和仲C(sp3)-H键以形成β-或γ-内酰胺。使用锰酸钡作为氧化剂。几种 Co(III) 中间体已被分离出来，并探索了它们的反应性，支持它们参与催化循环。该反应显示出异常高的 C–H 官能化 KIE kH/kD (>11)，允许使用氘作为封闭基团，从而实现放大或可切换的位点选择性。机理研究表明量子隧道效应可能在 C-H 激活步骤中发挥作用。

title: Maximizing the Magnetic Anisotropy of Dy Complexes by Fine-Tuning Organic Ligands: A Systematic Multireference High-Throughput Exploration of over 25k Molecules
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The design of the coordination environment of magnetic ions is key to achieving properties such as large magnetic anisotropy and slow magnetic relaxation, but a systematic exploration of the relevant chemical space for these compounds is missing. Here, we automatically extract all entries of mononuclear Dy coordination complexes from crystallographic databases and use multireference ab initio methods to compute their magnetic anisotropy. In addition, we generate and simulate magnetic anisotropy for 25k new molecules with the general formula [Dy(H2O)5L2]n+ and pentagonal bipyramidal coordination geometry, a motif selected as very promising for its properties and for imparting synthetic realism to the generated compounds. While the screening of crystallography databases allows for correlations between electronic structure and coordination geometry to naturally emerge, molecules with crystal field splittings over 1600 cm–1 are identified by systematically exploring new organic ligands. This corresponds to a ∼100% increase of magnetic anisotropy over the reference compound with L = tBuPO(NHiPr)2, ∼40% over any known pentagonal bipyramidal Dy complex, and approaching the values of dysprosocenium. The systematic study presented in this work demonstrates the very large extent to which the fine-tuning of Dy’s second coordination sphere by organic ligands can affect magnetic anisotropy, and that automated high-throughput screening is capable of identifying chemical motifs statistically able to maximize such a property, therefore paving the way to the rational and automated design of magnetic molecules beyond established first coordination shell considerations.
title_zh: 通过精细调控有机配体最大化Dy配合物的磁各向异性：对超过2.5万个分子的系统性多参考高通量探索
abstract_zh: 摘要 磁性离子配位环境的设计是实现大磁各向异性和慢磁弛豫等性能的关键，但缺乏对这些化合物相关化学空间的系统探索。在这里，我们自动从晶体学数据库中提取单核 Dy 配位配合物的所有条目，并使用多参考从头计算方法来计算其磁各向异性。此外，我们还生成并模拟了 25k 个具有通式 [Dy(H2O)5L2]n+ 和五角双锥配位几何形状的新分子的磁各向异性，该图案因其特性和赋予生成的化合物赋予合成真实性而被选为非常有前途的图案。虽然晶体学数据库的筛选允许自然出现电子结构和配位几何之间的相关性，但通过系统地探索新的有机配体，可以识别晶体场分裂超过 1600 cm-1 的分子。这对应于磁各向异性比 L = tBuPO(NHiPr)2 的参考化合物增加约 100%，比任何已知的五角双锥 Dy 络合物增加约 40%，并接近镝的值。这项工作中提出的系统研究表明，有机配体对 Dy 的第二配位层的微调可以在很大程度上影响磁各向异性，并且自动化高通量筛选能够识别化学基序，统计上能够最大化这种特性，从而为合理和自动化的磁各向异性铺平了道路。

title: Programmable Recognition of Organyl 5′-Phosphates by Human Argonaute-2
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract To effectuate RNA interference (RNAi), Argonaute (AGO) proteins recognize and load RNA guide strands by their requisite 5′-phosphate (5′-P). However, the structural features that govern AGO2 tolerance for chemically modified 5′-P architectures remain poorly defined, despite their importance for small interfering RNA (siRNA) drug design. Moreover, degradative enzymes also recognize 5′-P, yet few stereoelectronic features are known to differentiate AGO2 recognition from competing degradation pathways. Here, we show that AGO2 accommodates a substantially broader range of 5′-P derivatives than previously recognized, and that select 5′-P mimics can exploit novel interactions with the protein to reinforce guide anchoring. Through systematic diversification of 35 organic substituents, we interrogated structural determinants of guide anchoring and enzymatic susceptibility. Our analysis identified previously uncharacterized 5′-P mimics, including methyl and phenylpropargyl 5′-phosphates (5′-PO-Me, 5′-PO-PhPrp), phenylpropargyl 5′-phosphorothioate (5′-PS-PhPrp), and 5′-mesylphosphoramidate (5′-MsPA), that preserve efficient AGO2 loading in cells while inhibiting phosphatase-mediated degradation. We further found that 5′-exonuclease susceptibility depends strongly on canonical 5′ phosphate chemistry rather than steric accessibility. Structural analysis of a 5′-PO-PhPrp guide:AGO2 complex shows that the phenylpropargyl substituent engages a π-stacking network within a cluster of aromatic side chains (Y529/F811/Y815), while extended 5′-P substituents are accommodated through rotation of the 5′-P and coordinated rearrangement of water molecules within the 5′-P binding pocket. Collectively, these findings reveal the structural basis for plasticity of guide anchoring in AGO2 and establish chemically programmable 5′-end interactions as a general strategy for modulating oligonucleotide stability and activity.
title_zh: 人源Argonaute-2对有机基5′-磷酸的可编程识别
abstract_zh: 摘要 为了实现 RNA 干扰 (RNAi)，Argonaute (AGO) 蛋白通过必需的 5'-磷酸 (5'-P) 识别并加载 RNA 引导链。然而，尽管 AGO2 对小干扰 RNA (siRNA) 药物设计很重要，但控制 AGO2 对化学修饰 5'-P 结构耐受性的结构特征仍然不清楚。此外，降解酶也识别 5'-P，但很少有立体电子特征能够区分 AGO2 识别和竞争性降解途径。在这里，我们表明 AGO2 容纳的 5'-P 衍生物范围比之前认识的要广泛得多，并且选择的 5'-P 模拟物可以利用与蛋白质的新相互作用来增强引导锚定。通过 35 个有机取代基的系统多样化，我们探究了引导锚定和酶敏感性的结构决定因素。我们的分析发现了以前未表征的 5'-P 模拟物，包括甲基和苯基炔丙基 5'-磷酸酯 (5'-PO-Me、5'-PO-PhPrp)、苯基炔丙基 5'-硫代磷酸酯 (5'-PS-PhPrp) 和 5'-甲磺酰氨基磷酸酯 (5'-MsPA)，它们可保持细胞中 AGO2 的有效负载，同时抑制磷酸酶介导的降解。我们进一步发现 5'-核酸外切酶敏感性很大程度上取决于规范的 5' 磷酸化学而不是空间可及性。 5'-PO-PhPrp 引导物：AGO2 复合物的结构分析表明，苯基炔丙基取代基在芳香侧链簇 (Y529/F811/Y815) 内形成 π 堆积网络，而扩展的 5'-P 取代基则通过 ro 容纳。

title: Synergistic Dimensional and Defect Engineering in Ga-Doped IGTO Nanofiber Transistors for Dual-Band Neuromorphic Vision and Optical Encryption
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Here, we report a synergistic strategy that integrates one-dimensional (1D) nanostructuring with precise Ga doping to fabricate high-performance indium-gallium-tin oxide (IGTO) nanofiber field-effect transistors (FETs). The optimized 5% Ga doping effectively suppresses oxygen vacancies (from 38.8 to 29.7%) via strong G–O bonds, enabling an excellent mobility of 2.79 cm2 V–1 s–1, a high on/off ratio of 4.15 × 107, a steep subthreshold swing of 0.50 V/dec, and remarkable bias-stress stability, thereby overcoming the classic mobility-stability trade-off in oxide semiconductors. Beyond the superior electrical characteristics, the IGTO nanofiber FETs exhibit a tunable dual-band photoresponse (340 nm UV and 430 nm visible), which successfully emulates essential synaptic behaviors, including excitatory postsynaptic currents, paired-pulse facilitation, and short-term to long-term memory transitions. Capitalizing on this wavelength-selective responsivity, we further demonstrate a proof-of-concept optical encryption-decryption system for MNIST digits, achieving a recognition accuracy of 95%. This work establishes a “dimensional control, precise doping, and defect engineering” paradigm, showcasing the great potential of IGTO nanofibers as a versatile platform for neuromorphic vision systems and secure optoelectronic applications.
title_zh: 镓掺杂IGTO纳米纤维晶体管中维度与缺陷协同工程用于双波段神经形态视觉与光学加密
abstract_zh: 摘要 在这里，我们报告了一种协同策略，将一维（1D）纳米结构与精确的 Ga 掺杂相结合，以制造高性能氧化铟镓锡（IGTO）纳米纤维场效应晶体管（FET）。优化的 5% Ga 掺杂通过强 G-O 键有效抑制氧空位（从 38.8% 降至 29.7%），实现 2.79 cm2 V-1 s-1 的优异迁移率、4.15 × 107 的高开/关比、0.50 V/dec 的陡峭亚阈值摆幅以及卓越的偏置应力稳定性，从而克服了氧化物半导体中经典的迁移率与稳定性权衡。除了卓越的电气特性之外，IGTO 纳米纤维 FET 还具有可调谐的双波段光响应（340 nm 紫外光和 430 nm 可见光），可成功模拟基本的突触行为，包括兴奋性突触后电流、成对脉冲促进以及短期到长期记忆转换。利用这种波长选择性响应性，我们进一步演示了针对 MNIST 数字的概念验证光学加密解密系统，识别精度达到 95%。这项工作建立了“尺寸控制、精确掺杂和缺陷工程”范例，展示了 IGTO 纳米纤维作为神经形态视觉系统和安全光电应用的多功能平台的巨大潜力。

title: From p -Type to n -Type: Chlorination-Induced Electronic and Structural Modulation of Axially Substituted Siloxane Silicon Phthalocyanines
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The development of air-stable n-type organic semiconductors remains a critical challenge for organic thin-film transistor (OTFT) technologies. Silicon phthalocyanines (SiPcs) bearing axial siloxane substituents have recently achieved record charge carrier mobilities but exhibit p-type behavior due to their relatively high-lying frontier orbital energies. Herein, we report the synthesis, characterization, and OTFT integration of two new chlorinated siloxane silicon phthalocyanines, (Si4O)2SiPcCl8 and (Si4O)2SiPcCl16, designed to lower the lowest unoccupied molecular orbital (LUMO) energy and enable n-type transport. Peripheral chlorination effectively reduces the LUMO levels to −3.8 and −4.0 eV, respectively, confirming the desired electronic modulation. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction reveals that chlorination disrupts the dense π-stacking observed in the parent unchlorinated derivative through two distinct mechanisms: increased intermolecular separation in (Si4O)2SiPcCl8 and severe core distortion in (Si4O)2SiPcCl16. These structural perturbations directly impact device performance: (Si4O)2SiPcCl8 OTFTs achieve average electron mobilities of 1.6 × 10−2 cm2 V−1 s−1, comparable to one of the best-performing alkyl-substituted SiPcs, while the highly distorted (Si4O)2SiPcCl16 derivative exhibits an order-of-magnitude lower mobility. Thin-film characterization by powder X-ray diffraction and atomic force microscopy, corroborated by density functional theory calculations, demonstrates that the (Si4O)2SiPcCl8 films adopt a favorable texture aligning the high-mobility crystallographic axis parallel to the substrate. This work establishes clear structure−property relationships for chlorinated SiPcs and provides a rational framework for the design of high-performance n-type phthalocyanine semiconductors.
title_zh: 从p型到n型：轴向取代硅氧烷硅酞菁的氯代诱导电子与结构调控
abstract_zh: 摘要 空气稳定的n型有机半导体的开发仍然是有机薄膜晶体管（OTFT）技术的一个关键挑战。带有轴向硅氧烷取代基的硅酞菁（SiPcs）最近实现了创纪录的载流子迁移率，但由于其相对较高的前沿轨道能量而表现出p型行为。在此，我们报告了两种新型氯化硅氧烷硅酞菁 (Si4O)2SiPcCl8 和 (Si4O)2SiPcCl16 的合成、表征和 OTFT 集成，旨在降低最低未占分子轨道 (LUMO) 能量并实现 n 型传输。外围氯化有效地将 LUMO 水平分别降低至 -3.8 和 -4.0 eV，从而确认了所需的电子调制。单晶 X 射线衍射表明，氯化通过两种不同的机制破坏了母体未氯化衍生物中观察到的密集 π 堆积：(Si4O)2SiPcCl8 中分子间分离的增加和 (Si4O)2SiPcCl16 中严重的核心扭曲。这些结构扰动直接影响器件性能：(Si4O)2SiPcCl8 OTFT 的平均电子迁移率达到 1.6 × 10−2 cm2 V−1 s−1，与性能最好的烷基取代 SiPc 之一相当，而高度扭曲的 (Si4O)2SiPcCl16 衍生物表现出较低的迁移率。通过粉末 X 射线衍射和原子力显微镜进行的薄膜表征，并通过密度泛函理论计算证实，(Si4O)2SiPcCl8 薄膜采用了良好的织构，与高迁移率 cr 对齐。

title: A Biomimetic Interfacial Strategy of UV-Curable Bio-Based Amphiphobic Coatings for Antifouling and Antibacterial Protection
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Surface protection is critical for advanced systems such as marine equipment and medical implants, where fouling and microbial deposition cause irreversible degradation. However, developing protective coatings that integrate multifunctionality (e.g., amphiphobicity and antifouling), environmental compatibility, and durability remains challenging. Inspired by beetle cuticle architecture, a bioinspired spontaneous interfacial reconfiguration strategy was introduced to construct a multifunctional coating that synergizes low-surface-energy enrichment with bioactive molecular interactions. Following this strategy, a bio-based amphiphobic and antibacterial coating (PCGBF@GT) was fabricated via a rapid, environmentally benign UV-curing process (within 5 min). Spontaneous migration of fluorinated segments in the castor oil-derived resin provides robust amphiphobicity and fouling resistance. Meanwhile, the incorporation of glycidyl methacrylate-modified tannic acid (GT) introduces hydrogen-bonding interactions and positive zeta potential, stabilizing the interface and enabling broad-spectrum antibacterial activity against Escherichia coli (99.92 ± 0.90%) and Staphylococcus aureus (99.83 ± 0.06%). This work demonstrates a sustainable, bioinspired pathway toward high-performance protective coatings for marine and biomedical applications.
title_zh: 用于防污和抗菌保护的UV固化生物基双疏涂层仿生界面策略
abstract_zh: 摘要 表面保护对于海洋设备和医疗植入物等先进系统至关重要，在这些系统中，污垢和微生物沉积会导致不可逆的退化。然而，开发集多功能（例如两亲性和防污性）、环境相容性和耐用性于一体的保护涂层仍然具有挑战性。受甲虫角质层结构的启发，引入了生物启发的自发界面重构策略来构建多功能涂层，该涂层可将低表面能富集与生物活性分子相互作用协同作用。按照这一策略，通过快速、环保的紫外线固化工艺（5 分钟内）制造了生物基双疏抗菌涂层 (PCGBF@GT)。蓖麻油衍生树脂中氟化链段的自发迁移提供了强大的双疏性和防污性。同时，甲基丙烯酸缩水甘油酯改性单宁酸（GT）的引入引入了氢键相互作用和正zeta电位，稳定了界面并对大肠杆菌（99.92±0.90％）和金黄色葡萄球菌（99.83±0.06％）具有广谱抗菌活性。这项工作展示了一条可持续的、受生物启发的途径，为海洋和生物医学应用提供高性能保护涂层。

title: Strain-Controlled Interfacial Transport Governs Contact Resistance in Top and Edge n/p-Type Metal-TMD Junctions
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Contact resistance at two-dimensional (2D) metal-semiconductor interfaces remains a key bottleneck limiting transition-metal dichalcogenide (TMD) transistor performance. Strain engineering can reduce contact resistance, yet a predictive framework linking strain-induced electronic structure changes to interfacial carrier injection remains lacking. Here, we develop a multiscale framework combining first-principles calculations with analytical transport models to quantify strain-dependent contact resistance in metal-TMD junctions. We investigate n-type Au/MoS2 and p-type Pd/WSe2 contacts in top and edge geometries within experimentally accessible strain ranging from –1 to +1%. Tensile strain reduces n-type contact resistance by up to 46%/%ε, whereas compressive strain lowers p-type resistance by up to 34%/%ε. Edge contacts outperform top contacts by ∼2× due to direct interfacial hybridization. Under optimal strain and doping, room-temperature contact resistance reaches 0.32–0.74 and 0.51–0.84 kΩ·μm for Au/MoS2 and Pd/WSe2, respectively. These results quantitatively agree with experiments and benchmarks across alternative metal contacts, establishing a predictive framework for ultralow-resistance 2D-TMD transistors.
title_zh: 应变调控的界面输运决定顶接触与边接触n/p型金属-过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）结的接触电阻
abstract_zh: 摘要 二维 (2D) 金属-半导体界面的接触电阻仍然是限制过渡金属二硫属化物 (TMD) 晶体管性能的关键瓶颈。应变工程可以降低接触电阻，但仍然缺乏将应变引起的电子结构变化与界面载流子注入联系起来的预测框架。在这里，我们开发了一个多尺度框架，将第一原理计算与分析传输模型相结合，以量化金属-TMD 结中应变相关的接触电阻。我们研究了实验可达到的应变范围从 –1% 到 +1% 的顶部和边缘几何形状中的 n 型 Au/MoS2 和 p 型 Pd/WSe2 接触。拉伸应变可将 n 型接触电阻降低高达 46%/%ε，而压缩应变可将 p 型电阻降低高达 34%/%ε。由于直接界面杂化，边缘接触的性能比顶部接触高约 2 倍。在最佳应变和掺杂条件下，Au/MoS2 和 Pd/WSe2 的室温接触电阻分别达到 0.32–0.74 和 0.51–0.84 kΩ·μm。这些结果在数量上与替代金属接触的实验和基准一致，为超低电阻 2D-TMD 晶体管建立了预测框架。

title: Oxoisoaporphine Half-Sandwich Osmium(II) Derivative: A Catalytic Trigger for Innate Tumor Chemoimmunotherapy
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Chemoimmunotherapy, particularly strategies that induce a tumor specific antitumor immune response, has emerged as a promising approach to improved cancer treatment. Nonetheless, only a limited number of drugs can successfully stimulate an antitumor immune response in vivo. Recent studies have highlighted the potential of metal-based anticancer agents in chemoimmunotherapy. Herein, we report a half-sandwich osmium(II) complex, Os-1, which acts as a catalyst for H2O2 generation through autocatalytic hydride transfer from coenzyme NADH to oxygen. Sustained H2O2 self-supply generation disrupts tumor redox homeostasis and induces DNA damage, leading to the activation of the cGAS-STING signaling pathway. Os-1 demonstrates potent cytotoxicity in vitro and elicits a robust antitumor immune response in vivo. Furthermore, Os-1 exhibits a synergistic antitumor growth effect when combined with a PD-1 inhibitor. To the best of our knowledge, this study is the first to describe the rational design of a small-molecule metal catalyst that provides for the in situ generation of H2O2 in cancer cells, thus overcoming the exogenous-additive bottleneck of oxidative therapy. This self-sufficient system not only promotes oxidative damage but also activates the cGAS-STING pathway, thereby integrating synergistically oxidative and immunotherapeutic actions.
title_zh: Oxoisoaporphine半夹锇(II)衍生物：天然肿瘤化学免疫疗法的催化触发器
abstract_zh: 摘要化学免疫疗法，特别是诱导肿瘤特异性抗肿瘤免疫反应的策略，已成为改善癌症治疗的一种有前景的方法。尽管如此，只有有限数量的药物可以成功地刺激体内抗肿瘤免疫反应。最近的研究强调了金属抗癌剂在化学免疫疗法中的潜力。在此，我们报道了一种半夹心锇(II)络合物Os-1，它通过自催化氢化物从辅酶NADH转移到氧气来充当H2O2生成的催化剂。持续的 H2O2 自给生成会破坏肿瘤氧化还原稳态并诱导 DNA 损伤，从而激活 cGAS-STING 信号通路。 Os-1 在体外表现出强大的细胞毒性，并在体内引发强大的抗肿瘤免疫反应。此外，Os-1 与 PD-1 抑制剂联合使用时表现出协同抗肿瘤生长作用。据我们所知，这项研究首次描述了小分子金属催化剂的合理设计，该催化剂可在癌细胞中原位产生H2O2，从而克服氧化疗法的外源添加剂瓶颈。这种自给自足的系统不仅促进氧化损伤，还激活 cGAS-STING 通路，从而整合协同氧化和免疫治疗作用。

title: Surface‐Strained NiMo Cathodes Enable Kinetics‐Decoupled Hydrogen Bubble Management for Stable Near‐Neutral Water Electrolysis
abstract: ABSTRACT Gas evolution during water electrolysis forms bubble layers that block active sites and increase transport and ohmic losses. Decoupling bubble‐mediated mass transport from intrinsic hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) kinetics remains challenging because surface modifications affect both activity and bubble dynamics. Here, a surface‐strained NiMo cathode ( s ‐NiMo) enables kinetics‐decoupled hydrogen bubble management in a near‐neutral electrolyte. In 0.5 m potassium phosphate buffer (pH 7.0), NiMo and s ‐NiMo exhibit nearly identical intrinsic HER kinetics, consistent with similar H* adsorption energetics. Under bubble‐regulated operation, s ‐NiMo shows a 63 mV lower steady‐state overpotential at −20 mA cm −2 . High‐speed imaging reveals smaller, faster‐departing H 2 bubbles, reducing the mean residence time from 0.5 s to 0.2 s. Interfacial analyses indicate enhanced hydrophilicity and more negative surface‐charge‐related characteristics. Ensemble calculations based on the Universal Model for Atoms show that the surface‐associated *H 2 state is 0.52 eV higher in the s ‐NiMo‐representative environment, while electrochemical fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy reveals a 1.5‐fold higher nanobubble event density. In a single‐cell electrolyzer at 300 mA cm −2 , s‐NiMo maintains a 280 mV lower cell voltage over 100 h. These findings establish bubble management as an independent design axis for stable near‐neutral water electrolysis.
title_zh: 表面应变NiMo阴极实现动力学解耦的氢气泡管理以实现稳定的近中性电解水
abstract_zh: 摘要 电解水过程中的产气会形成气泡层，堵塞活性位点并增加传质和欧姆损耗。由于表面修饰同时影响活性和气泡动力学，将气泡介导的传质与本征析氢反应（HER）动力学解耦仍具挑战性。在此，一种表面应变NiMo阴极（s‐NiMo）可在近中性电解液中实现动力学解耦的氢气泡管理。在0.5 m磷酸钾缓冲液（pH 7.0）中，NiMo与s‐NiMo表现出几乎相同的本征HER动力学，与其相似的H*吸附能量一致。在气泡调控运行条件下，s‐NiMo在−20 mA cm⁻²下稳态过电位低63 mV。高速成像显示H₂气泡更小、脱离更快，平均停留时间从0.5 s降至0.2 s。界面分析表明亲水性增强且表面电荷相关特性更负。基于原子普适模型的系综计算表明，在s‐NiMo代表性环境中表面相关的*H₂态高0.52 eV，而电化学荧光寿命成像显微技术显示纳米气泡事件密度提高1.5倍。在300 mA cm⁻²的单电解槽中，s‐NiMo在100 h内维持低280 mV的槽电压。这些发现确立了气泡管理作为近中性稳定电解水的独立设计维度。

title: Breaking the Degradation Domino in Li‐Rich Layered Oxide Cathode Via Precise Electrostatic Pinning and Gradient Shielding
abstract: ABSTRACT Benefiting from the anionic redox activity, lithium‐rich layered oxide cathodes exhibit high specific capacity, but the migration of transition metal (TM) can exacerbate vacancy clustering, resulting in domino‐like structural degradation. To stabilize the structure, the electrostatic pinning effect is precisely incorporated into the Li layer to mitigate the TM migration via strong electrostatic repulsion. Concurrently, this configuration effectively modulates the electronic distribution around the oxygen ligands, thereby stabilizing the oxygen redox. Furthermore, robust electrostatic interactions endow the material with the capability to adaptively adjust its interlayer spacing, thereby buffering the structural evolution of the layered framework during (de)lithiation processes. The modified cathode achieves an 89.1% capacity retention over 400 cycles in half‐cells and an impressive 96.2% over 1000 cycles in full cells. To further decouple the capacity‐stability trade‐off while concurrently enhancing both bulk and interfacial stability, we engineered a gradient shielding architecture. This design not only attains 219.8 mAh g −1 at 0.5C and delivers capacity retention of 90.8% after 400 cycles but also promotes the formation of a compact CEI at the near‐surface region, markedly improving interfacial stability under harsh conditions. This progressive structural engineering paradigm offers fresh insights into overcoming the intrinsic structural challenges of lithium‐rich cathode materials.
title_zh: 通过精确静电钉扎与梯度屏蔽打破富锂层状氧化物正极的降解多米诺效应
abstract_zh: 摘要 得益于阴离子氧化还原活性，富锂层状氧化物正极表现出高比容量，但过渡金属（TM）迁移会加剧空位团簇化，导致多米诺式的结构退化。为稳定结构，将静电钉扎效应精准引入Li层，通过强静电排斥缓解TM迁移。同时，该构型有效调控氧配体周围的电子分布，从而稳定氧氧化还原。此外，强大的静电相互作用赋予材料自适应调节层间距的能力，从而在（脱）锂过程中缓冲层状框架的结构演变。修饰后的正极在半电池中400次循环后容量保持率为89.1%，在全电池中1000次循环后容量保持率高达96.2%。为进一步解耦容量—稳定性权衡并同步提升体相和界面稳定性，我们设计了梯度屏蔽架构。该设计不仅在0.5C下达到219.8 mAh g⁻¹，400次循环后容量保持率为90.8%，还促进近表面区域形成致密CEI，显著提升苛刻条件下的界面稳定性。这种渐进式结构工程范式为克服富锂正极材料的本征结构难题提供了新见解。

title: Polar Wurtzite NbAlN: A Transition‐Metal Nitride Alloy for Polarization‐Engineered GaN Heterostructures
abstract: ABSTRACT The discovery of ferroelectric ScAlN sparked a search for new polar wurtzite alloys; however, incorporating transition metals remains a formidable challenge. Here, we demonstrate the synthesis of wurtzite‐phase NbAlN, a polar transition‐metal nitride alloy that is highly compatible with GaN‐based heterostructures. Despite the strong metallic character of elemental Nb, we achieved coherent epitaxial NbAlN films that preserve the wurtzite crystal structure and metal polarity of the underlying GaN, as directly visualized by annular bright‐field scanning transmission electron microscopy. Nb incorporation induces a monotonic lattice expansion and produces coherent Nb‐enriched nanoscale regions that are accommodated within the continuous wurtzite framework. Functionally, NbAlN barriers induce a substantial enhancement in the two‐dimensional electron gas density at the AlN/GaN heterointerface, consistent with polarization‐related carrier modulation by the metal‐polar NbAlN barrier. This study demonstrates that d ‐electron transition metals can be integrated into polar nitride systems without compromising their functional asymmetry, making NbAlN a promising building block for polar nitride heterostructures and carrier‐density‐engineered GaN electronics.
title_zh: 极性纤锌矿NbAlN：用于极化工程GaN异质结构的过渡金属氮化物合金
abstract_zh: 摘要 铁电 ScAlN 的发现引发了对新型极性纤锌矿合金的探索；然而，掺入过渡金属仍然是一项艰巨的挑战。在这里，我们演示了纤锌矿相 NbAlN 的合成，这是一种与 GaN 基异质结构高度兼容的极性过渡金属氮化物合金。尽管元素 Nb 具有很强的金属特性，我们还是获得了相干外延 NbAlN 薄膜，该薄膜保留了纤锌矿晶体结构和底层 GaN 的金属极性，如环形明场扫描透射电子显微镜直接观察到的那样。铌的掺入会引起单调晶格膨胀，并产生相干的富铌纳米级区域，这些区域容纳在连续的纤锌矿框架内。从功能上讲，NbAlN 势垒引起 AlN/GaN 异质界面处二维电子气密度的显着增强，这与金属极性 NbAlN 势垒的极化相关载流子调制一致。这项研究表明，d 电子过渡金属可以集成到极性氮化物系统中，而不会影响其功能不对称性，使 NbAlN 成为极性氮化物异质结构和载流子密度设计的 GaN 电子器件的有前途的构建模块。

title: Rising plant extinction rates on European mountain summits
abstract: Climate change increases plant species richness in alpine ecosystems. However, to what extent this diversity enrichment masks extinction dynamics of resident species remains elusive. In this study, we used floristic resurvey data from 896 permanent vegetation plots across 62 European mountain summits to show that local extinctions have increased over the past 21 years. Extinction rates rose with the magnitude of warming, and species were more likely to go extinct toward their low-elevation range margins and in communities undergoing stronger thermophilization. Moreover, local extinctions were significantly related to preceding abundance declines, which can serve as an early warning signal. These findings suggest that despite increasing plant species richness, plant assemblages above the treeline face an accelerating but so far neglected loss of their most characteristic species.
title_zh: 欧洲山顶植物灭绝速率上升
abstract_zh: 气候变化增加了高山生态系统中植物物种的丰富度。然而，这种多样性丰富在多大程度上掩盖了常驻物种的灭绝动态仍然难以捉摸。在这项研究中，我们使用了欧洲 62 个山峰 896 个永久植被地块的植物区系再调查数据，结果表明，过去 21 年来，局部物种灭绝有所增加。灭绝率随着变暖的程度而上升，物种更有可能在低海拔范围边缘和经历更强的嗜热作用的群落中灭绝。此外，局部灭绝与之前的丰度下降显着相关，这可以作为早期预警信号。这些发现表明，尽管植物物种丰富度不断增加，但林线以上的植物群落面临着其最具特征物种的加速但迄今为止被忽视的损失。

title: Psilocybin prevents chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy through mitochondrial trafficking preservation
abstract: Chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy (CIPN) is a disabling, often irreversible toxicity that affects millions of patients, limits life-saving cancer therapy, and lacks proven treatment. In this work, we show that as little as two doses of psilocybin before chemotherapy durably prevented the onset of CIPN across platinum- and taxane-based models, including repeated chemotherapy cycles, without impairing antitumor efficacy. Peripherally, psilocybin maintained tactile sensitivity and intraepidermal nerve fiber endings through axonal mitochondrial trafficking and distribution preservation, through the TrkB-Akt-PAK5-MAP2-KIF5B pathway and remobilization of syntaphilin-anchored mitochondria. Centrally, it normalized medial prefrontal cortical synaptic activity and cortical alpha and beta electroencephalography power. This stabilization of peripheral axonal energy balance establishes psilocybin as a first-in-class prophylactic agent for CIPN while also preserving central neural function. Given psilocybin’s established safety, these discoveries support clinical evaluation as a strategy to prevent CIPN.
title_zh: 赛洛西宾通过保护线粒体运输预防化疗诱导的周围神经病变
abstract_zh: 化疗引起的周围神经病变 (CIPN) 是一种致残且通常不可逆的毒性，影响数百万患者，限制挽救生命的癌症治疗，并且缺乏经过验证的治疗方法。在这项工作中，我们表明，在基于铂类和紫杉烷的模型中，化疗前只需服用两剂裸盖菇素即可持久预防 CIPN 的发作，包括重复化疗周期，而不会损害抗肿瘤功效。在外周，裸盖菇素通过轴突线粒体运输和分布保存、TrkB-Akt-PAK5-MAP2-KIF5B 通路和亲合蛋白锚定线粒体的再动员来维持触觉敏感性和表皮内神经纤维末梢。其核心是使内侧前额皮质突触活动以及皮质α和β脑电图能力正常化。这种外周轴突能量平衡的稳定使裸盖菇素成为 CIPN 的一流预防剂，同时还能保留中枢神经功能。鉴于裸盖菇素已确定的安全性，这些发现支持将临床评估作为预防 CIPN 的策略。

title: High-Efficiency, Self-Healing Elastomer via Dynamic Boronic Ester Bond Density Regulation for Joint Motion Monitoring
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Elastomer-based flexible and stretchable sensors have attracted considerable research interest for promising applications in areas, such as human–machine interfaces, physiological monitoring, and soft robotics. Despite the typical trade-off between transparency, mechanical strength, and self-healing in elastomers, which is rooted in conflicting requirements for molecular chain mobility, impeding this broad application prospects in wearable devices and the conformable electronics field. This work demonstrates a polyborosiloxane/polydimethylsiloxane interpenetrating network (PBS/PDMS IPN) that successfully reconciles these properties. The resulting multifunctional elastomer exhibits both effective self-healing (97.8% recovery of tensile strength in 15 min under 1 psi) and a transmittance up to 93%. The energy dissipation imparted by high-molecular-weight hydroxy-terminated PDMS (PDMS-OH) further enhances adhesion, granting the multifunctional elastomer superior bonding performance. The multifunctional elastomer is integrated with eutectic gallium–indium (EGaIn) to form a stress sensor, which enables high-accuracy human motion monitoring, showcasing its potential for advanced wearable medical sensors.
title_zh: 通过动态硼酸酯键密度调控的高效自修复弹性体用于关节运动监测
abstract_zh: 摘要：基于弹性体的柔性可拉伸传感器在人机界面、生理监测和软机器人等领域具有广阔的应用前景，引起了人们广泛的研究兴趣。尽管弹性体在透明度、机械强度和自修复性之间存在典型的权衡，但其根源在于分子链流动性的相互冲突的要求，阻碍了可穿戴设备和顺应电子领域的广泛应用前景。这项工作展示了聚硼硅氧烷/聚二甲基硅氧烷互穿网络 (PBS/PDMS IPN)，它成功地协调了这些特性。所得的多功能弹性体表现出有效的自修复性（1 psi 下 15 分钟内拉伸强度恢复 97.8%）和高达 93% 的透光率。高分子量羟基封端的PDMS (PDMS-OH) 带来的能量耗散进一步增强了粘合力，赋予多功能弹性体优异的粘合性能。这种多功能弹性体与共晶镓铟（EGaIn）集成形成应力传感器，可实现高精度人体运动监测，展示了其在先进可穿戴医疗传感器方面的潜力。

title: Distinct Active-Site Dynamics of Primitive Catalytic Amyloids Revealed by Two-Dimensional Infrared Spectroscopy
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Catalytic amyloids are proposed evolutionary precursors of modern enzymes, yet the active-site dynamics underlying their distinct catalytic properties remain unclear. Here, we combine azide infrared probes and two-dimensional infrared (2D-IR) spectroscopy to characterize the active-site dynamics of primitive catalytic amyloids and compare them with human carbonic anhydrase II (CAII), a representative modern enzyme. The Zn2+-bound azide in amyloids exhibits a ∼30 cm–1 blue shift and a 2-fold longer vibrational lifetime than free azide, establishing vibrational lifetime as a sensitive reporter of metal coordination. Center Line Slope (CLS) analysis reveals the absence of picosecond dynamics in bound azide, indicating that rigid amyloid scaffolds lack the rapid hydration and side-chain motions present in CAII. Furthermore, 2D-IR linewidth analysis shows that amyloids possess ∼2-fold greater inhomogeneous broadening. Such pronounced active-site heterogeneity correlates with reduced catalytic efficiency in amyloids, whereas CAII achieves high activity through a homogeneous and dynamically optimized active site. This contrast reveals two evolutionarily divergent catalytic strategies: conformational selection versus tuned dynamics.
title_zh: 二维红外光谱揭示原始催化淀粉样蛋白的独特活性位点动力学
abstract_zh: 摘要 催化淀粉样蛋白被认为是现代酶的进化前体，但其独特催化特性背后的活性位点动力学仍不清楚。在这里，我们结合叠氮化物红外探针和二维红外（2D-IR）光谱来表征原始催化淀粉样蛋白的活性位点动力学，并将其与具有代表性的现代酶人类碳酸酐酶II（CAII）进行比较。淀粉样蛋白中 Zn2+ 结合的叠氮化物表现出约 30 cm-1 的蓝移和比游离叠氮化物长 2 倍的振动寿命，确立了振动寿命作为金属配位的敏感报告分子。中心线斜率 (CLS) 分析揭示了结合叠氮化物中不存在皮秒动力学，这表明刚性淀粉样蛋白支架缺乏 CAII 中存在的快速水合和侧链运动。此外，2D-IR 线宽分析表明淀粉样蛋白具有约 2 倍的不均匀加宽。这种明显的活性位点异质性与淀粉样蛋白的催化效率降低相关，而 CAII 通过均匀且动态优化的活性位点实现了高活性。这种对比揭示了两种进化上不同的催化策略：构象选择与调谐动力学。

title: Monomer-biased manufacture of industrial-scale colloidal photonic films
abstract: Complex functions in nature arise from the ordered assembly of simple building blocks. Transformation of colloidal aggregates into industrial-scale photonic crystals under rapid ambient conditions remains challenging owing to high energy barriers and limited assembly control. In this study, common monomers act as mediators that lower these barriers and bias ambient shear-induced ordering within seconds. This enables in situ processing compatible with roll-to-roll manufacturing of colloidal photonic crystal films with tunable mechanical properties. Robust 15-micrometer-thick films, incorporating a supramolecular matrix, can be produced up to 4000 meters long and 1.3 meters wide at a rate of 25 meters per minute. These combine vivid structural color and high transparency (>90%) with mechanical robustness and rapid self-healing, demonstrating a scalable route to high-quality colloidal photonic materials.
title_zh: 偏向单体的工业规模胶体光子薄膜制备
abstract_zh: 自然界中的复杂功能是由简单构建块的有序组装产生的。由于高能垒和有限的组装控制，在快速环境条件下将胶体聚集体转化为工业规模的光子晶体仍然具有挑战性。在这项研究中，常见的单体充当介质，可以在几秒钟内降低这些障碍并偏置环境剪切诱导的排序。这使得原位加工与具有可调机械性能的胶体光子晶体薄膜的卷对卷制造兼容。坚固的 15 微米厚的薄膜包含超分子基质，可以以每分钟 25 米的速度生产长达 4000 米、宽 1.3 米的薄膜。它们将生动的结构色彩和高透明度（> 90％）与机械鲁棒性和快速自修复结合在一起，展示了高质量胶体光子材料的可扩展途径。

title: Longitudinal dynamics of gene expression and metabolomics in an aging population cohort
abstract: Multiomic profiling provides a comprehensive physiological overview at the molecular level, but understanding of its spatiotemporal dynamics remains limited in human populations. We profiled longitudinal whole-blood gene expression and metabolite levels in 335 females over 8 years. Levels of 5061 genes and 181 metabolites changed over time, with individual trajectories often diverging from population-level trends. Longitudinally variable genes showed cell type specificity and enrichment for aging-relevant pathways, including cardiometabolic and neurodegenerative disorders. Longitudinal trajectories were further shaped by genetics, circadian rhythm, seasonality, and environmental pollutant exposures. Integrative analyses revealed extensive static and time-variable cross-omic connectivity. Longitudinal profiling offers insight into the temporal evolution of age-related conditions at the molecular level, and understanding individual variation within these longitudinal patterns will be essential for future precision medicine approaches.
title_zh: 老龄化人群队列中基因表达与代谢组学的纵向动态
abstract_zh: 多组学分析提供了分子水平上的全面生理学概述，但对其时空动态的了解在人类群体中仍然有限。我们对 8 年来 335 名女性的纵向全血基因表达和代谢水平进行了分析。 5061 个基因和 181 种代谢物的水平随着时间的推移而发生变化，个体的轨迹往往与群体水平的趋势不同。纵向可变基因显示出细胞类型特异性和衰老相关途径的富集，包括心脏代谢和神经退行性疾病。纵向轨迹进一步受到遗传、昼夜节律、季节性和环境污染物暴露的影响。综合分析揭示了广泛的静态和时变的跨组学连接。纵向分析可以在分子水平上洞察与年龄相关的疾病的时间演变，并且了解这些纵向模式内的个体差异对于未来的精准医学方法至关重要。

title: Spontaneous polarization in chemical vapor–deposited polymer films creates large electric fields
abstract: Controlled surface potentials in permanently polarized polymer films are of increasing interest for electronics, sensing, and biomedical devices. Conventional polymer films require external electric fields or postdeposition treatments, limiting precision and scalability. Here, we report a spontaneous polarization in polymer thin films polymerized through initiated chemical vapor deposition (iCVD). Surface potentials emerge spontaneously during film growth, scale linearly with film thickness, and remain stable under ambient conditions. Their magnitude is tunable through deposition parameters, and polymerization initiator choice determines the polarity. The solvent-free, single-step iCVD process enables mechanically robust, uniform coatings on complex geometries and large areas. Our findings establish a simple, versatile route to intrinsically polarized polymer films without postprocessing, opening new opportunities for direct integration of electric fields into functional devices or surface-driven processes at the nanoscale.
title_zh: 化学气相沉积聚合物薄膜中的自发极化产生强大电场
abstract_zh: 永久极化聚合物薄膜中受控的表面电势越来越受到电子、传感和生物医学设备的关注。传统的聚合物薄膜需要外部电场或沉积后处理，限制了精度和可扩展性。在这里，我们报告了通过引发化学气相沉积（iCVD）聚合的聚合物薄膜的自发极化。表面电势在薄膜生长过程中自发出现，与薄膜厚度成线性比例，并在环境条件下保持稳定。它们的大小可通过沉积参数调节，聚合引发剂的选择决定极性。无溶剂、单步 iCVD 工艺可在复杂的几何形状和大面积上实现机械坚固、均匀的涂层。我们的研究结果建立了一种简单、通用的途径，无需后处理即可获得本质偏振聚合物薄膜，为将电场直接集成到纳米级功能器件或表面驱动过程中提供了新的机会。

title: Conformational asymmetry of replicated human chromosomes
abstract: DNA replication generates sister chromatids with identical sequence, yet its mechanism is fundamentally asymmetric: Chromatids inherit strands of opposite orientation, whereas forks synthesize new strands by distinct leading- and lagging-strand mechanisms. How this replication asymmetry affects chromosome organization is unknown. Using sister chromatid–sensitive conformation analysis, we found that human sister chromatids are consistently misaligned in the 5′→3′ direction of inherited DNA strands. This shift persisted without cohesin-mediated loop extrusion but was lost upon disruption of cohesion. Polymer modeling showed that modest directional misalignment of cohesive cohesins can explain the observed shift, and we propose two models for how such misalignment could originate from replication fork asymmetry. This register shift between sister chromatids has implications for homology search during DNA repair.
title_zh: 复制的人类染色体的构象不对称性
abstract_zh: DNA复制产生具有相同序列的姐妹染色单体，但其机制基本上是不对称的：染色单体继承相反方向的链，而分叉通过不同的前导链和滞后链机制合成新链。这种复制不对称如何影响染色体组织尚不清楚。通过姐妹染色单体敏感构象分析，我们发现人类姐妹染色单体在遗传 DNA 链的 5′→3′ 方向上始终错位。这种转变在没有粘连蛋白介导的环挤出的情况下持续存在，但在粘连破坏时消失。聚合物模型表明，粘性粘连蛋白的适度方向错位可以解释观察到的转变，并且我们提出了两种模型来解释这种错位如何源于复制叉不对称。姐妹染色单体之间的这种寄存器转移对于 DNA 修复期间的同源性搜索具有影响。
