title: Spatially resolved single-cell atlas reveals the macroevolutionary trajectory of animal hearts
abstract: Animal hearts display diverse anatomical structures during adaptive evolution. Here, we present a multiomics atlas of adult hearts from 27 species across chordates, arthropods, and mollusks. Joint analysis indicates that Bilateria hearts share a core gene repertoire, taking a stepwise “add-on” approach as a universal evolutionary strategy. The “proto-heart” is populated by key cell types, including cardiomyocytes, fibroblasts, endothelial cells, and neural cells, which maintained core signatures while evolving with shifts in living environments and corresponding adaptations in the cardiovascular system. Additionally, we reveal an evolutionarily conserved cardiomyocyte state dynamic potentially linked to cardiac development and stress responses. Finally, we identify a common molecular program underpinning chamber evolution from a ventricular foundation. This work establishes a resource for understanding the intrinsic mechanisms of heart evolution.
title_zh: 空间分辨单细胞图谱揭示动物心脏的宏观演化轨迹
abstract_zh: 动物心脏在适应性进化过程中表现出不同的解剖结构。在这里，我们展示了来自脊索动物、节肢动物和软体动物 27 个物种的成年心脏的多组学图谱。联合分析表明，双边对称动物心脏共享一个核心基因库，采用逐步“附加”方法作为通用进化策略。 “原心脏”由关键细胞类型组成，包括心肌细胞、成纤维细胞、内皮细胞和神经细胞，它们在随着生活环境的变化和心血管系统的相应适应而进化的同时保持核心特征。此外，我们揭示了进化上保守的心肌细胞状态动态可能与心脏发育和应激反应相关。最后，我们确定了一个共同的分子程序，支持心室从心室基础演化而来。这项工作为理解心脏进化的内在机制建立了资源。

title: Helium escaping from the atmosphere of a nearby rocky exoplanet orbiting in a habitable zone
abstract: Observations of highly irradiated gas giant exoplanets have shown helium escaping from their atmospheres. There is limited evidence for atmospheres on rocky exoplanets, perhaps because they have already escaped. We report near-infrared spectroscopic observations of LHS 1140b, a rocky exoplanet that orbits in the habitable zone of a nearby low-mass star. The transit spectra show absorption by helium escaping from the planet’s atmosphere. Helium absorption is detected in 2024 but not in 2025, indicating time-variable atmospheric escape. We interpret these results as indicating an upper atmosphere dominated by helium and depleted in hydrogen, with other volatile species trapped at lower altitudes, which is consistent with atmospheric fractionation models. No helium absorption is detected for LHS 1140c, a smaller and more strongly irradiated exoplanet in the same system.
title_zh: 附近一颗位于宜居带的岩质系外行星大气中逸出的氦
abstract_zh: 对高辐射气态巨行星的观测表明，氦气从其大气层中逸出。关于岩石系外行星上存在大气层的证据有限，也许是因为它们已经逃逸了。我们报告了 LHS 1140b 的近红外光谱观测，这是一颗在附近低质量恒星的宜居带内运行的岩石系外行星。传输光谱显示了从行星大气层逸出的氦气的吸收。 2024 年检测到氦吸收，但 2025 年未检测到，这表明大气逃逸随时间变化。我们将这些结果解释为表明高层大气以氦为主且氢贫乏，其他挥发性物质被困在较低海拔，这与大气分馏模型一致。 LHS 1140c 是同一系统中一颗更小、辐射更强烈的系外行星，没有检测到氦吸收。

title: Programmable design of synthetic plant immune receptors for pathogen protein recognition
abstract: The limited diversity and recognition scope of natural plant immune receptors impede resistance breeding against rapidly evolving pathogens. Here, we report the programmable design of synthetic plant immune receptors (SPIRs). De novo–designed binding modules targeting pathogen proteins were grafted into the integrated decoy domain of a plant immune receptor. SPIRs recognized proteins derived from viral, bacterial, fungal, and oomycete pathogens. Their performance was improved by combining artificial intelligence–guided protein design with in planta–directed evolution, enhancing immune activation while reducing autoactivation. The SPIRs exhibited high target specificity and could be stacked for multiplexed recognition of pathogen proteins. Viral-targeting SPIRs responded to infectious clones of plant viruses, and transgenic plants expressing SPIRs conferred disease resistance. This work establishes a versatile platform for the efficient engineering of plant immunity.
title_zh: 用于病原菌蛋白识别的合成植物免疫受体的可编程设计
abstract_zh: 天然植物免疫受体的多样性和识别范围有限，阻碍了针对快速进化的病原体的抗性育种。在这里，我们报告了合成植物免疫受体（SPIR）的可编程设计。从头设计的针对病原体蛋白的结合模块被移植到植物免疫受体的整合诱饵结构域中。 SPIR 可识别源自病毒、细菌、真菌和卵菌病原体的蛋白质。通过将人工智能引导的蛋白质设计与植物定向进化相结合，增强了免疫激活，同时减少了自身激活，从而提高了它们的性能。 SPIR 表现出高度的靶标特异性，并且可以堆叠用于病原体蛋白的多重识别。病毒靶向 SPIR 对植物病毒的感染性克隆做出反应，而表达 SPIR 的转基因植物则具有抗病性。这项工作为植物免疫的有效工程建立了一个多功能平台。

title: Autothermal methane pyrolysis: Scalable heat integration for hydrogen and graphite production
abstract: Methane pyrolysis (MP) offers a compelling opportunity to meet low-carbon hydrogen demand using existing energy infrastructure. A key limitation in scaling MP is the efficient delivery of high-temperature heat into the reactor. We show that hydrogen-fueled autothermal operation overcomes this limitation, enabling an increase of several orders of magnitude in the reactor throughput for commercially relevant bed diameters. It also yields a carbon coproduct of 96.0% degrees of graphitization, meeting graphite precursor specifications and enabling domestic graphite production from natural gas using low-cost iron oxide catalysts. We further demonstrate a strategy to suppress the direct emissions inherent to autothermal operation, reducing them to near zero. A process-level life cycle assessment estimates that carbon intensities for autothermal methane pyrolysis can be as low as 1.9 to 4.5 kilograms (kg) of CO 2,eq per kg H 2 .
title_zh: 自热甲烷热解：面向氢气和石墨生产的可规模化热集成
abstract_zh: 甲烷热解（MP）提供了利用现有能源基础设施满足低碳氢需求的绝佳机会。扩展 MP 的一个关键限制是将高温热量有效地输送到反应器中。我们表明，氢燃料自热操作克服了这一限制，使得商业相关床直径的反应器吞吐量增加了几个数量级。它还产生石墨化度为 96.0% 的碳副产品，满足石墨前体规格，并能够使用低成本氧化铁催化剂从天然气中生产国内石墨。我们进一步展示了一种抑制自热操作固有的直接排放的策略，将其减少到接近零。过程级生命周期评估估计，自热甲烷热解的碳强度可低至每千克 H 2 1.9 至 4.5 千克 (kg) CO 2,eq。

title: (Un)intended consequences of mass-prescribing GLP-1s
abstract: It is difficult to overstate how much glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) pharmacotherapies have inundated the public discourse on obesity. An avalanche of scientific papers, news articles, and social media posts debate the efficacy, affordability, and appropriateness of GLP-1 receptor agonists not just for obesity but also skin disease, erectile dysfunction, pregnancy, and addiction. Attempting to cut through the noise, the World Health Organization (WHO) recently published the first-ever global guidelines recommending GLP-1s for the treatment of obesity, while committing to develop a global framework ensuring “fair access” to these medicines for the 1 billion people affected worldwide. Going deeper, the guidelines also advocate for “robust populationlevel policies” to address the root causes of obesity in unhealthy food environments. However, to complicate these efforts, WHO’s recommendations unfold at a time rife with competitive pressures among pharmaceutical companies, food companies vying for the GLP-1 market segment, and wellness companies promoting supplements and telemedicine programs for what is being billed as a GLP-1 lifestyle. This commercial milieu is ripe for unintended consequences that conspire against fair access to these medicines.
title_zh: 大规模开GLP-1s（非）预期后果
abstract_zh: 胰高血糖素样肽-1 (GLP-1) 药物疗法已经淹没了有关肥胖的公众讨论，这一点都不为过。大量的科学论文、新闻文章和社交媒体帖子争论 GLP-1 受体激动剂的功效、可负担性和适当性，不仅可以治疗肥胖，还可以治疗皮肤病、勃起功能障碍、怀孕和成瘾。为了消除噪音，世界卫生组织 (WHO) 最近发布了首个全球指南，推荐 GLP-1 治疗肥胖，同时承诺制定一个全球框架，确保全球 10 亿受影响人群“公平获得”这些药物。更深入地说，该指南还倡导“强有力的人口政策”，以解决不健康食品环境中肥胖的根本原因。然而，使这些努力变得复杂的是，世卫组织的建议是在制药公司、争夺 GLP-1 细分市场的食品公司以及为所谓的 GLP-1 生活方式推广补充剂和远程医疗计划的健康公司之间充满竞争压力的时候提出的。这种商业环境很容易产生意想不到的后果，从而阻碍公平获得这些药物。

title: High-capacity associative memory in a quantum-optical spin glass
abstract: The Hopfield neural network stores memories using all-to-all-coupled spins and recalls those memories through equilibrium dynamics. Storing too many hampers recall because frustration causes an exponential number of spurious patterns to arise as the network becomes a spin glass. Despite this, memory recall can be restored, and even enhanced, under quantum-optical nonequilibrium dynamics because spurious patterns can now serve as reliable memories. We experimentally observe associative memory with high storage capacity in a driven-dissipative spin glass made of atoms and photons. The capacity surpasses that of the Hopfield model under Hebbian learning by up to seven-fold in a sixteen-spin network. Atomic motion boosts capacity by dynamically modifying connectivity akin to short-term synaptic plasticity in neural networks, realizing a precursor to learning in a quantum-optical system.
title_zh: 量子光学自旋玻璃中的高容量联想记忆
abstract_zh: Hopfield 神经网络使用全耦合自旋来存储记忆，并通过平衡动力学调用这些记忆。存储太多会妨碍回忆，因为当网络变成旋转玻璃时，挫折会导致指数数量的虚假模式出现。尽管如此，在量子光学非平衡动力学下，记忆回忆可以恢复，甚至增强，因为虚假模式现在可以充当可靠的记忆。我们通过实验观察了由原子和光子制成的驱动耗散自旋玻璃中具有高存储容量的联想存储器。在十六旋转网络中，其容量比 Hebbian 学习下的 Hopfield 模型高出七倍。原子运动通过动态修改类似于神经网络中短期突触可塑性的连接性来提高容量，从而实现了量子光学系统中学习的先驱。

title: Measurement of the Λ electric dipole moment with an entangled baryon-antibaryon system
abstract: The dominance of matter over antimatter in the Universe has consistently driven the pursuit of new physics beyond the Standard Model that violates charge-parity symmetry. Strange baryons (hyperons) remain a largely unexplored territory in which interactions between hyperons and particles from new physics could induce a nontrivial electric dipole moment (EDM). However, direct measurements of hyperon EDMs through spin precession are highly challenging owing to their short lifetimes. In this work, we introduce a method to extract the EDM of the lightest hyperon, Λ, using the entangled Λ Λ ¯ system. Our result is consistent with zero, achieving a three-orders-of-magnitude improvement over the previous upper limit established in the 1980s with comparable statistics, providing stringent constraints on potential new physics.
title_zh: 利用纠缠重子-反重子系统测量Λ粒子电偶极矩
abstract_zh: 宇宙中物质相对反物质的主导地位一直推动着对违反电荷宇称对称性的标准模型之外的新物理学的追求。奇异重子（超子）仍然是一个很大程度上未被探索的领域，其中超子和新物理学粒子之间的相互作用可能会产生不平凡的电偶极矩（EDM）。然而，由于超子 EDM 的寿命较短，通过自旋进动直接测量超子 EDM 非常具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们介绍了一种使用纠缠 Λ Λ ¯ 系统提取最轻超子 Λ 的 EDM 的方法。我们的结果与零一致，比 20 世纪 80 年代建立的可比统计数据上限提高了三个数量级，为潜在的新物理学提供了严格的约束。

title: Tumor-derived antioxidants suppress immunity by depriving T cells of reactive oxygen species
abstract: Reactive oxygen species (ROS) promote genomic instability and fuel oncogenic signaling in cancer, but antioxidant therapies have so far failed to improve, or worsen, cancer outcomes. Emerging data suggest that T cells depend on ROS for signal transduction. In this study, we show that tumors exploit this dependency, releasing antioxidant enzymes into the tumor environment to suppress T cell–mediated antitumor immunity. The interstitial fluid of tumors possesses potent antioxidant activity, associated with enrichment of the antioxidant enzyme peroxiredoxin 1 (PRDX1). Extracellular PRDX1 deprives T cells of ROS, preventing oxidative inactivation of phosphatases required for T cell receptor–driven kinase signaling and effector function. Prdx1 is up-regulated upon cancer immunoediting, and loss of PRDX1 within tumors enhances antitumor immunity and immunotherapy responses. These findings define a redox-dependent mechanism of tumor immunosuppression that is potentially amenable to therapeutic intervention.
title_zh: 肿瘤源性抗氧化物通过剥夺T细胞的活性氧抑制免疫
abstract_zh: 活性氧（ROS）会促进基因组不稳定性并促进癌症中的致癌信号传导，但抗氧化疗法迄今为止未能改善或恶化癌症结果。新数据表明，T 细胞依赖 ROS 进行信号转导。在这项研究中，我们证明肿瘤利用这种依赖性，将抗氧化酶释放到肿瘤环境中来抑制 T 细胞介导的抗肿瘤免疫。肿瘤间质液具有强大的抗氧化活性，与抗氧化酶过氧化还原蛋白 1 (PRDX1) 的富集有关。细胞外 PRDX1 剥夺 T 细胞的 ROS，防止 T 细胞受体驱动的激酶信号传导和效应器功能所需的磷酸酶氧化失活。 Prdx1 在癌症免疫编辑时上调，肿瘤内 PRDX1 的缺失可增强抗肿瘤免疫力和免疫治疗反应。这些发现定义了肿瘤免疫抑制的氧化还原依赖性机制，该机制可能适合治疗干预。

title: Early-life colonization with Clostridioides difficile remodels the developing gut
abstract: Clostridioides difficile causes severe disease in adults but commonly colonizes infants asymptomatically. The consequences of early-life colonization on host development remain unknown. In a neonatal mouse model, C. difficile colonization drove proinflammatory and tissue repair responses in the intestinal epithelium, enriching injury-associated intestinal stem cell populations and skewing differentiation toward secretory lineages. Despite transient colonization, exposure to C. difficile early in life led to persistent changes into adulthood. Epithelial responses were toxin dependent, as colonization with nontoxigenic strains or maternal vaccination with a C. difficile –targeted messenger RNA–lipid nanoparticle vaccine protected neonates. Human infant intestinal epithelial cells were sensitive to C. difficile toxins, and biopsies from colonized infants exhibited altered intestinal stem cell behavior. This study redefines C. difficile as an underappreciated early-life pathogen with lasting effects on host development.
title_zh: 生命早期艰难梭菌定植重塑发育中的肠道
abstract_zh: 艰难梭菌会在成人中引起严重疾病，但通常在无症状的情况下定植于婴儿。生命早期定植对宿主发育的影响仍然未知。在新生小鼠模型中，艰难梭菌定植促进了肠上皮的促炎和组织修复反应，丰富了损伤相关的肠干细胞群，并使分化偏向分泌谱系。尽管有短暂的定植，但生命早期接触艰难梭菌会导致成年后的持续变化。上皮反应是毒素依赖性的，因为非产毒菌株的定植或母体接种艰难梭菌靶向信使 RNA-脂质纳米颗粒疫苗可以保护新生儿。人类婴儿肠上皮细胞对艰难梭菌毒素敏感，定植婴儿的活检显示肠干细胞行为发生改变。这项研究将艰难梭菌重新定义为一种未被充分认识的早期病原体，对宿主发育具有持久影响。

title: Dual‐Site Spin State Modulation in Iron‐Based Prussian Blue Cathode Enabling Improved Sodium Storage
abstract: ABSTRACT Prussian blue (PB) and its analogues are promising cathode materials for sodium‐ion batteries (SIBs), yet their practical application is hindered by uncontrolled [Fe(CN) 6 ] vacancies and interstitial water, which lead to unsatisfactory cycling stability and capacity utilization. Herein, we report a ligand engineering strategy to simultaneously modulate the spin states of both low‐spin (LS) and high‐spin (HS) Fe sites in PB. By introducing ─CN vacancies and terminal ─NH 2 groups via a pentacyanide precursor, a modified PB (denoted as PPB) is achieved. Spectroscopic and computational analyses confirm a dual‐site spin transition in which both LS and HS Fe sites predominantly convert into an intermediate‐spin (IS) state. As a result, the PPB cathode exhibits impressive rate capability (129 and 92 mAh g −1 at 0.05 and 2 A g −1 , respectively) and cycling stability (70% retention after 4000 cycles at 2 A g −1 ), significantly outperforming the routine hexacyanide‐based PB. Density functional theory calculations reveal that the ─NH 2 groups serve as preferential adsorption sites for Na + , while ─CN vacancies lower the migration barrier, which collectively enhance the Na + storage kinetics. This work presents a prudent ligand engineering strategy for designing high‐performance cathode materials through deliberate spin state manipulation.
title_zh: 铁基普鲁士蓝正极中双位点自旋态调控实现更优的钠存储
abstract_zh: 摘要：普鲁士蓝（PB）及其类似物是有前景的钠离子电池（SIB）正极材料，但其实际应用受到不受控制的[Fe(CN) 6 ]空位和间隙水的阻碍，导致循环稳定性和容量利用率不理想。在此，我们报告了一种配体工程策略，可同时调节 PB 中低自旋（LS）和高自旋（HS）Fe 位点的自旋态。通过五氰化物前体引入─CN空位和末端─NH 2 基团，得到改性PB（记为PPB）。光谱和计算分析证实了双位点自旋跃迁，其中 LS 和 HS Fe 位点主要转化为中间自旋 (IS) 态。因此，PPB正极表现出令人印象深刻的倍率性能（在0.05和2 A g -1 下分别为129和92 mAh g -1 ）和循环稳定性（在2 A g -1 下4000次循环后70%的保留率），显着优于常规的基于六氰化物的PB。密度泛函理论计算表明，─NH 2 基团是Na + 的优先吸附位点，而─CN空位降低了迁移势垒，共同增强了Na + 的储存动力学。这项工作提出了一种审慎的配体工程策略，通过有意的自旋态操纵来设计高性能阴极材料。

title: Modifications of Lysine Residues 294 and 311 Within the Microtubule‐Binding Region Alter Tau Aggregation and Tubulin Binding Equilibria
abstract: ABSTRACT Dysfunction of the microtubule‐associated protein Tau is a central feature of Alzheimer's disease and related tauopathies, yet how site‐specific lysine modifications modulate the functional and pathological states of Tau remains poorly understood. Here, we combine protein semi‐synthesis with segmental isotope labelling and NMR spectroscopy of full‐length Tau, to dissect how lysine acetylation and carboxymethylation within the microtubule‐binding region of Tau regulate its interactions with tubulin, microtubules, and amyloid assembly. Site‐specific modification at lysine 294 delays Tau‐mediated tubulin polymerization and fibril formation, whereas acetylation at lysine 311 exerts more moderate effects, but alters fibril morphology. NMR spectroscopy of segmentally isotope‐labelled Tau variants indicates that single lysine acetylation does not measurably weaken Tau binding to pre‐formed microtubules; however, bivalent acetylation reduces microtubule binding, possibly by cumulative charge neutralization. Together, these results indicate that lysine acetylation redistributes Tau between functional states in a site‐ and valency‐dependent manner. Our study helps to establish a mechanistic framework linking combinatorial lysine modifications to Tau dysfunction and highlights the utility of region‐resolved structural approaches to decipher posttranslational modification–dependent equilibria in intrinsically disordered proteins.
title_zh: 微管结合区域内赖氨酸残基294和311的修饰改变Tau蛋白聚集与微管蛋白结合平衡
abstract_zh: 摘要 微管相关蛋白 Tau 的功能障碍是阿尔茨海默病和相关 tau 病的一个核心特征，但位点特异性赖氨酸修饰如何调节 Tau 的功能和病理状态仍知之甚少。在这里，我们将蛋白质半合成与全长 Tau 的片段同位素标记和核磁共振波谱相结合，剖析 Tau 微管结合区域内的赖氨酸乙酰化和羧甲基化如何调节其与微管蛋白、微管和淀粉样蛋白组装的相互作用。赖氨酸 294 的位点特异性修饰可延迟 Tau 介导的微管蛋白聚合和原纤维形成，而赖氨酸 311 的乙酰化则发挥更温和的作用，但会改变原纤维形态。片段同位素标记的 Tau 变体的核磁共振波谱表明，单个赖氨酸乙酰化不会明显削弱 Tau 与预先形成的微管的结合；然而，二价乙酰化可能通过累积电荷中和来减少微管结合。总之，这些结果表明赖氨酸乙酰化以位点和价态依赖的方式在功能状态之间重新分配 Tau。我们的研究有助于建立一个将组合赖氨酸修饰与 Tau 功能障碍联系起来的机制框架，并强调区域解析结构方法在破译本质无序蛋白质中翻译后修饰依赖性平衡的效用。

title: A Dual Locking Strategy Enables Highly Selective meta ‐Xylene Separation With an Aluminum‐Pyrrolic Framework
abstract: ABSTRACT Efficient separation of xylene isomers remains a significant challenge due to their nearly identical physicochemical properties. Here, we report a dual locking strategy in an aluminum–pyrrolic framework (Al‐PyDC) with V‐shaped ligand featured AlO 6 chains and pyrrole dual recognition sites that simultaneously stabilize the V‐shaped meta ‐xylene (mX). This dual‐locking effect promotes dense packing of mX within confined channels, resulting in a high adsorption capacity for mX (4.0 mmol g −1 ), which is much higher than that for ortho ‐xylene (oX, 2.5 mmol g −1 ) and para ‐xylene (pX, 2.0 mmol g −1 ). The simulations and solid‐state NMR spectroscopy further confirmed that mX experienced stronger locking interactions with the AlO 6 chains and pyrrolic ligands compared to pX. Notably, the dual locking effect was temperature‐dependent, and elevated temperature accelerated molecular diffusion, thereby weakening the effectiveness of the recognition. Hence, Al‐PyDC achieved an excellent mX/pX selectivity of 8.0 in vapor‐phase breakthrough measurements at ambient temperature (303 K), which outperformed most of the MOF counterparts. Additionally, the isomorphic CAU‐10‐H with V‐shaped AlO 6 –phenyl–AlO 6 dual locking sites was employed as a control material to elucidate the role of active‐site in molecular recognition. This dual locking strategy offered an effective approach for enhancing the adsorption capacity and selectivity for challenging isomer separations.
title_zh: 双重锁定策略实现铝-吡咯骨架对间二甲苯的高选择性分离
abstract_zh: 摘要 由于二甲苯异构体几乎相同的物理化学性质，有效分离二甲苯异构体仍然是一个重大挑战。在这里，我们报告了铝-吡咯框架（Al-PyDC）中的双重锁定策略，其V形配体具有AlO 6 链和吡咯双重识别位点，可同时稳定V形间二甲苯（mX）。这种双重锁定效应促进了mX在有限通道内的密集堆积，从而导致mX（4.0 mmol g -1 ）的高吸附容量，远高于邻二甲苯（oX，2.5 mmol g -1 ）和对二甲苯（pX，2.0 mmol g -1 ）。模拟和固态核磁共振波谱进一步证实，与 pX 相比，mX 与 AlO 6 链和吡咯配体具有更强的锁定相互作用。值得注意的是，双重锁定效应是温度依赖性的，升高的温度会加速分子扩散，从而削弱识别的有效性。因此，Al-PyDC 在环境温度（303 K）下的气相突破测量中实现了 8.0 的优异 mX/pX 选择性，优于大多数 MOF 同类产品。此外，采用具有V形AlO 6 -苯基-AlO 6 双锁定位点的同构CAU-10-H作为对照材料来阐明活性位点在分子识别中的作用。这种双重锁定策略为增强具有挑战性的异构体分离的吸附能力和选择性提供了有效的方法。

title: Broad‐Spectrum, Cell Envelope‐Active Marinocyclin Antibiotics From a Coral‐Derived Bacterium Are Effective Against Colistin‐Resistant Bacteria
abstract: ABSTRACT The marine bacterial genus Aquimarina comprises diverse members with numerous natural product biosynthetic gene clusters but few characterized compounds. Here we report a novel class of lipopeptides with exceptional antibiotic activity, named marinocyclins, isolated from Aquimarina megaterium EL43 associated with the octocoral Eunicella labiata . The major congener marinocyclin A exhibited potent and uniform activity against a broad panel of drug‐resistant gram‐negative and gram‐positive pathogens, including ESKAPE bacteria. The natural product efficiently compromised the outer and inner bacterial membranes, leading to rapid cell permeabilization and lysis. This activity profile was mediated by the ability to bind lipopolysaccharides, anionic phospholipids enriched in bacterial membranes, and peptidoglycan precursors. Eukaryotic cytotoxicity required higher doses than antibacterial activity. Genomic data suggest a nonribosomal biosynthetic origin for marinocyclins. These findings position marinocyclins as a promising new scaffold for antibiotic development and highlight the potential of Aquimarina spp. as a source of novel antibiotics. Further medicinal chemistry optimization of marinocyclins could enhance their prokaryotic selectivity to generate leads for treating infections caused by drug‐resistant pathogens.
title_zh: 来自珊瑚来源细菌的广谱细胞包膜活性Marinocyclin抗生素对多粘菌素耐药菌有效
abstract_zh: 摘要 海洋细菌属 Aquimarina 包含多种成员，具有大量天然产物生物合成基因簇，但特征化合物很少。在这里，我们报告了一类具有特殊抗生素活性的新型脂肽，称为 marinocyclins，从与八珊瑚 Eunicella labiata 相关的 Aquimarina megaterium EL43 中分离出来。主要同源物 marinocyclin A 对多种耐药革兰氏阴性和革兰氏阳性病原体（包括 ESKAPE 细菌）表现出有效且一致的活性。该天然产物有效地破坏了细菌的外膜和内膜，导致细胞快速透化和裂解。这种活性特征是由结合脂多糖、富含细菌膜的阴离子磷脂和肽聚糖前体的能力介导的。真核细胞毒性需要比抗菌活性更高的剂量。基因组数据表明马林环素的非核糖体生物合成起源。这些发现将 marinocyclins 定位为一种有前景的抗生素开发新支架，并凸显了 Aquimarina spp 的潜力。作为新型抗生素的来源。马林环素的进一步药物化学优化可以增强其原核选择性，以产生治疗耐药病原体引起的感染的先导化合物。

title: Crystallization Manipulation Through Buried Pyridinium‐Induced Tunable Interactions in Perovskite Solar Cells
abstract: ABSTRACT The interaction between the hybrid component of self‐assembled monolayers (SAMs) and the perovskite precursor could delay the crystallization process, resulting in high‐quality perovskite film and highly efficient perovskite solar cells (PSCs). However, the intensity of interaction affects more precise control of crystallization speed. Herein, we introduce two pyridinium cation species to compare the intensity of their interaction with iodide. Our systematic investigation reveals that the more electron deficient 1‐methyl‐4‐(trifluoromethyl)pyridinium (CF 3 Py + )‐based hybrid SAM enables a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 27.07% (certified 26.8%) for a 0.06‐cm 2 PSC, surpassing hybrid 1‐methylpyridinium (Py + )‐based device (26.42%) and pure 4PADCB‐based device (25.12%). The impressive PCE stems from fine‐tuning of crystallization speed through more intensive interaction between CF 3 Py + and I − . Moreover, the stronger interaction inhibits iodide migration, which improves the light and thermal stability of the optimized PSCs. Our work demonstrates an effective approach to strengthening the interaction between pyridinium cations and iodide by incorporating an electron‐withdrawing group into the aromatic core, providing crucial insights into the manipulation of perovskite film crystallization.
title_zh: 钙钛矿太阳能电池中通过埋底吡啶鎓诱导的可调相互作用实现结晶调控
abstract_zh: 摘要 自组装单层（SAM）的混合成分与钙钛矿前驱体之间的相互作用可以延迟结晶过程，从而产生高质量的钙钛矿薄膜和高效的钙钛矿太阳能电池（PSC）。然而，相互作用的强度会影响结晶速度的更精确控制。在这里，我们引入两种吡啶鎓阳离子物种来比较它们与碘化物相互作用的强度。我们的系统研究表明，更缺电子的基于 1-甲基-4-(三氟甲基)吡啶 (CF 3 Py + ) 的混合 SAM 使 0.06 cm 2 PSC 的冠军功率转换效率 (PCE) 达到 27.07%（认证为 26.8%），超过了基于混合 1-甲基吡啶 (Py + ) 的器件 (26.42%) 和纯器件。 4基于PADCB的设备（25.12%）。令人印象深刻的 PCE 源于通过 CF 3 Py + 和 I - 之间更强烈的相互作用来微调结晶速度。此外，更强的相互作用抑制了碘化物的迁移，从而提高了优化PSC的光稳定性和热稳定性。我们的工作展示了一种通过将吸电子基团纳入芳香核来增强吡啶鎓阳离子和碘化物之间相互作用的有效方法，为钙钛矿薄膜结晶的操纵提供了重要的见解。

title: Polypyridyl Coordination Motifs as Precursors for Ordered Carbonaceous Frameworks Toward High‐Density Ru Single‐Atom Catalysts
abstract: ABSTRACT Achieving high‐density single‐atom catalysts (SACs) remains a fundamental challenge, particularly for precious metals such as Ru that readily aggregate under synthetic and catalytic conditions. Here, we report a rational precursor design strategy for fabricating high‐density Ru SACs via direct carbonization, yielding ordered carbonaceous frameworks (Ru‐OCFs) with high Ru loadings of up to 11.0 wt%. By expanding the scope of precursors for OCF synthesis beyond conventional macrocyclic coordination motifs to coordinatively flexible polypyridyl ligands, we show that Ru‐terpyridine crystals with thermally polymerizable ethynyl units serve as effective precursors for immobilizing single‐atomic Ru species within three‐dimensional porous carbon frameworks, without metal aggregation or post‐synthetic treatments. The resulting Ru‐OCFs retain the ordered structure and coordination environment of the precursor crystals while simultaneously developing microporosity with high specific surface areas of up to 670 m 2 g −1 . As a proof of concept, the high‐density isolated Ru sites in Ru‐OCFs enable enhanced catalytic activity in liquid‐phase CO 2 hydrogenation, achieving a high formic acid productivity of up to 19 mmol g cat −1 h −1 , outperforming representative nanoparticle catalysts.
title_zh: 多吡啶配位基元作为有序碳质框架前驱体用于制备高密度Ru单原子催化剂
abstract_zh: 摘要 实现高密度单原子催化剂（SAC）仍然是一个基本挑战，特别是对于像钌这样在合成和催化条件下容易聚集的贵金属。在这里，我们报告了一种合理的前体设计策略，用于通过直接碳化制造高密度Ru SAC，产生高Ru负载量高达11.0 wt%的有序碳质骨架（Ru-OCF）。通过将OCF合成前体的范围从传统的大环配位基序扩展到配位柔性聚吡啶基配体，我们表明具有热聚合乙炔基单元的Ru-三联吡啶晶体可以作为将单原子Ru物质固定在三维多孔碳框架内的有效前体，无需金属聚集或合成后处理。所得的Ru-OCF保留了前体晶体的有序结构和配位环境，同时形成了具有高达670 m 2 g -1 的高比表面积的微孔性。作为概念证明，Ru-OCF 中的高密度孤立 Ru 位点能够增强液相 CO 2 加氢中的催化活性，实现高达 19 mmol g cat -1 h -1 的高甲酸生产率，优于代表性的纳米颗粒催化剂。

title: Dual d– p hybridization in Ternary PtGaGe Enables Concurrent Activity and Stability Enhancement for Alkaline Oxygen Reduction
abstract: ABSTRACT The activity–stability trade‐off in oxygen reduction reactions (ORR) fundamentally limits the practical development of Zinc–air batteries (ZABs) and fuel cells. Here, we address this long‐standing challenge through spatial electronic engineering that enables dual d–p orbital hybridization within a Pt‐based ternary alloy. The resulting PtGaGe catalyst exhibits exceptional alkaline ORR performance, achieving a mass activity of 1.79 A·mg Pt −1 and a half‐wave potential of 0.90 V (vs. RHE)—both surpassing commercial Pt/C and most previously reported Pt‐based catalysts. When integrated into a ZAB, it reaches a peak power density of 207.6 mW·cm −2 and maintains steady operation for over 200 h at 10 mA·cm −2 , highlighting outstanding durability under practical operating conditions. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal that dual d–p hybridization induces spatial electron redistribution between Pt and Ga/Ge sites, modulating the Pt d ‐band center and facilitating O─O bond activation while suppressing catalyst degradation. This synergistic electronic regulation simultaneously improves catalytic activity, stability, and Pt utilization efficiency. This work establishes a mechanistic paradigm for electronic‐structure engineering in high‐performance ORR electrocatalysts.
title_zh: 三元PtGaGe中的d–p双重杂化实现碱性氧还原反应活性与稳定性的同步提升
abstract_zh: 摘要：氧还原反应（ORR）中活性与稳定性的权衡从根本上限制了锌空气电池（ZAB）和燃料电池的实际发展。在这里，我们通过空间电子工程解决了这一长期存在的挑战，该工程实现了 Pt 基三元合金内的双 d-p 轨道杂化。所得的 PtGaGe 催化剂表现出优异的碱性 ORR 性能，实现了 1.79 A·mg Pt -1 的质量活性和 0.90 V 的半波电位（相对于 RHE）——均超过了商业 Pt/C 和大多数先前报道的 Pt 基催化剂。当集成到ZAB中时，其峰值功率密度达到207.6 mW·cm -2 ，并在10 mA·cm -2 下保持稳定运行超过200小时，突出了在实际操作条件下出色的耐用性。密度泛函理论（DFT）计算表明，双 d-p 杂化会诱导 Pt 和 Ga/Ge 位点之间的空间电子重新分布，调节 Pt d 带中心并促进 O─O 键活化，同时抑制催化剂降解。这种协同电子调节同时提高了催化活性、稳定性和铂利用效率。这项工作为高性能 ORR 电催化剂的电子结构工程建立了机械范式。

title: Noncanonical Peloruside A Biosynthesis by an Uncultivated Verrucomicrobiota Symbiont
abstract: ABSTRACT Peloruside A, a polyketide macrolide identified in the marine sponge Mycale hentscheli , is a promising anticancer drug candidate due to its ability to stabilize tubulin at a nontaxoid binding site. Substantial efforts were made to improve the supply of this scarce substance through chemical synthesis and mariculture, however, sustainable production has yet to be achieved. Recent microbiome sequencing suggested that bacterial producers are responsible for all M. hentscheli bioactive compounds, but the identity of the peloruside producer remained unknown. Furthermore, a candidate peloruside polyketide synthase (PKS) was identified in silico, but its highly aberrant architecture prevented a confident biosynthetic prediction for the pharmacologically important exocyclic double bond. Here, we reveal an unusually complex modular PKS pathway comprising nonelongating ketosynthases (KSs), two internal thioesterases (TEs), and an acetyl coenzyme A ligase that orchestrate O ‐acetylation/elimination, acetyl‐CoA recycling, and configurational proof‐reading to facilitate selective Z ‐double bond incorporation. The first internal TE falls into a previously characterized O ‐acylating TE family but contains key amino acid substitutions that facilitate bifunctional acylation/elimination activity. Furthermore, we identified the peloruside producer as ‘ Candidatus Pelorusia occulta’, a member of the biochemically underexplored Lentisphaeria class within the phylum Verrucomicrobiota. This work provides the biochemical and microbiological foundation for heterologous peloruside production.
title_zh: 未培养的疣微菌门共生体的非经典Peloruside A生物合成
abstract_zh: 摘要 Peloruside A 是一种在海洋海绵 Mycale hentscheli 中发现的聚酮化合物大环内酯，由于其能够稳定非紫杉烷结合位点的微管蛋白，因此是一种有前途的抗癌药物候选物。人们做出了大量努力，通过化学合成和海水养殖来改善这种稀缺物质的供应，但尚未实现可持续生产。最近的微生物组测序表明，细菌生产者负责所有 M. hentscheli 生物活性化合物的产生，但 Peloruside 生产者的身份仍然未知。此外，在计算机中鉴定了一种候选的盘苷聚酮合酶（PKS），但其高度异常的结构阻碍了对药理学上重要的环外双键的可靠生物合成预测。在这里，我们揭示了一个异常复杂的模块化 PKS 途径，包括非延长酮合酶 (KS)、两种内部硫酯酶 (TE) 和乙酰辅酶 A 连接酶，该连接酶协调 ​​O 乙酰化/消除、乙酰辅酶 A 回收和构型校对以促进选择性 Z 双键掺入。第一个内部 TE 属于先前表征的 O 酰化 TE 家族，但包含促进双功能酰化/消除活性的关键氨基酸取代。此外，我们确定了 Peloruside 的生产者为“Candidatus Pelorusia oculta”，它是疣微生物门中生化尚未充分探索的 Lentisphaeria 类的成员。本工作为异源海藻苷的生产提供了生化和微生物学基础。

title: The Creation of a Dual‐End Interface in Li─S Cathode by Anchoring Independent Metal Atoms on Graphdiyne
abstract: ABSTRACT Conventional strategies to address sluggish polysulfide conversion and the shuttle effect have primarily focused on interactions between sulfur anions and catalytic centers, while largely neglecting the enrichment and transport of lithium ions at the cathode. Herein, we report a niobium (Nb) atomic catalyst anchored on graphdiyne (Nb‐GDY) that enables a unique dual‐end binding mechanism for the simultaneous regulation of polysulfide conversion and lithium‐ion transport kinetics. Density functional theory calculations reveal pronounced electronic coupling between Nb─S and Li─C pairs, creating synergistic binding sites that immobilize LiPSs while lowering the energy barriers for their transformation. This mechanism is corroborated by x‐ray photoelectron spectroscopy and comprehensive in situ characterizations, which demonstrate significantly accelerated electrode kinetics and efficient Li + flux. Consequently, the Nb‐GDY‐based cathode exhibits exceptional high‐rate capability and long‐term durability, achieving a high capacity of 724 mAh g −1 at 10 C and maintaining stable operation over 1200 cycles at 5 C with a low‐capacity decay of 0.025% per cycle. Our research ingeniously combines dual ends binding, activating the synergistic interaction between atoms and the substrate, providing a new concept for the management of multi‐species transport for high energy density Li−S batteries.
title_zh: 通过在石墨炔上锚定独立金属原子在Li─S正极中构建双端界面
abstract_zh: 摘要 解决多硫化物转化缓慢和穿梭效应的传统策略主要集中在硫阴离子和催化中心之间的相互作用，而很大程度上忽视了锂离子在阴极的富集和传输。在此，我们报告了一种锚定在石墨二炔（Nb-GDY）上的铌（Nb）原子催化剂，它能够实现独特的双端结合机制，用于同时调节多硫化物转化和锂离子传输动力学。密度泛函理论计算揭示了 Nb─S 和 Li─C 对之间明显的电子耦合，产生了协同结合位点，固定 LiPS，同时降低其转化的能垒。这种机制得到了 X 射线光电子能谱和综合原位表征的证实，证明了电极动力学的显着加速和高效的 Li + 通量。因此，Nb-GDY基正极表现出优异的高倍率性能和长期耐久性，在10 C下实现了724 mAh g -1 的高容量，并在5 C下保持稳定运行超过1200个循环，每个循环的容量衰减为0.025%。我们的研究巧妙地结合了双端结合，激活了原子与基底之间的协同相互作用，为高能量密度Li−S电池的多物种传输管理提供了新概念。

title: Achieve the Full‐Wavelength Photoexcited Pyroelectricity in Perovskite Ferroelectric for Long‐Wave Infrared Detection
abstract: ABSTRACT Ferroelectric materials have emerged as a promising class of optoelectronic candidates, due to their strong light‐polarization couplings that lead to fascinating physical attributes. Especially, photoexcited pyroelectricity originating from light‐induced variation of spontaneous polarization ( P s ) holds potentials for ultra‐broadband photodetection even up to long‐wave infrared optical region. For the first time, we present the full‐wavelength switchable photoexcited pyroelectric effects in a two‐dimensional perovskite ferroelectric, (4‐ethylanilinium) 2 (ethylammonium) 2 Pb 3 Br 10 ( 1 ), covering ultraviolet to long‐wave infrared spectral range. It is a high‐temperature ferroelectric ( T c = 390 K) with superior pyroelectricity, including large pyroelectric coefficients and figure‐of‐merits. Strikingly, robust full‐wavelength photoexcited pyroelectric responses are obtained in 1 under irradiation from ultraviolet (266 nm) to long‐wave infrared (12.5 µm) region, far beyond its intrinsic optical bandgap. These P s ‐dependent photoactivities can be electrically switched and controlled by electric poling. Thus, crystal‐based device of 1 allows ultrabroadband photodetection, as verified by highly‐sensitive response to human radiation. As the first report on full‐wavelength photoexcited pyroelectricity in perovskite ferroelectrics, our study highlights a promising strategy for new‐generation broadband optoelectronic devices.
title_zh: 在钙钛矿铁电体中实现全波长光激发热电用于长波红外探测
abstract_zh: 摘要：铁电材料已成为一类有前途的光电候选材料，因为它们具有强光偏振耦合，可产生令人着迷的物理属性。特别是，源自光致自发偏振（ P s ）变化的光激发热释电具有超宽带光电探测甚至长波红外光学区域的潜力。我们首次在二维钙钛矿铁电体 (4-乙基苯胺) 2 (乙基铵) 2 Pb 3 Br 10 (1) 中呈现全波长可切换的光生热释电效应，覆盖紫外到长波红外光谱范围。它是一种高温铁电体（T c = 390 K），具有优异的热电性，包括大的热电系数和品质因数。引人注目的是，在从紫外线（266 nm）到长波红外（12.5 µm）区域的照射下，1 中获得了鲁棒的全波长光激发热释电响应，远远超出了其固有的光学带隙。这些 P s 依赖的光活性可以通过电极化进行电切换和控制。因此，基于晶体的器件 1 可以实现超宽带光电探测，这一点已通过对人体辐射的高灵敏响应得到验证。作为第一份关于钙钛矿铁电体全波长光激发热释电的报告，我们的研究强调了新一代宽带光电器件的一种有前景的策略。

title: Reversible Symmetry Switching, Giant Birefringence, and UV Second‐Harmonic Generation in Hybrid Niobium Oxyfluorides
abstract: ABSTRACT Birefringent crystals that simultaneously exhibit large optical anisotropy and wide band gaps are highly desirable for advanced photonic technologies, yet these properties are often mutually constrained because structural features that enhance birefringence often compromise optical transparency. Herein, we report four new hybrid niobium oxyfluoride phenanthroline compounds, [Hphen]NbOF 4 ∙H 2 O ( NP1 ), α‐[Hphen]NbOF 4 ( NP2 ), β‐[Hphen]NbOF 4 ( NP3 ), and [Hphen] 2 NbOF 5 ( NP4 ), obtained through systematic variation of synthetic conditions. Thermal dehydration of centrosymmetric hydrated phase NP1 yields noncentrosymmetric (NCS) dehydrated phase NP2 through reversible crystal‐to‐crystal transformation, with birefringence increasing from 0.354 to 0.419 at 546 nm. Further optimization affords NP3 , which exhibits an enhanced second‐harmonic generation (SHG) response of 1.2 × KDP, compared with 0.09 × KDP for NP2 . Strikingly, transformation from a one‐dimensional chain‐type niobium oxyfluoride framework ( NP1–NP3 ) to a zero‐dimensional structure of isolated NbOF 5 units ( NP4 ) removes geometric constraints on phenanthroline alignment, enabling near‐coplanar arrangement of π‐conjugated chromophores and a record‐high birefringence of 0.618 at 546 nm for a Nb‐based crystal. All four compounds retain wide optical band gaps of 3.2–3.3 eV, demonstrating that giant birefringence and UV transparency are simultaneously achievable within a single material family. These results establish framework dimensionality as a viable strategy for overcoming the trade‐off between optical anisotropy and transparency.
title_zh: 杂化铌氧化物氟化物中的可逆对称性切换、巨双折射与紫外二次谐波产生
abstract_zh: 摘要：同时表现出大光学各向异性和宽带隙的双折射晶体对于先进光子技术来说是非常理想的，但这些特性通常是相互制约的，因为增强双折射的结构特征通常会损害光学透明度。在此，我们报告了四种新的杂化铌氟氧化物菲咯啉化合物，[Hphen]NbOF 4 ∙H 2 O ( NP1 )、α-[Hphen]NbOF 4 ( NP2 )、β-[Hphen]NbOF 4 ( NP3 ) 和 [Hphen] 2 NbOF 5 ( NP4 )，这是通过合成条件的系统变化获得的。中心对称水合相 NP1 的热脱水通过可逆晶体间转变产生非中心对称（NCS）脱水相 NP2，双折射率在 546 nm 处从 0.354 增加到 0.419。进一步优化后的 NP3 表现出 1.2 × KDP 的增强二次谐波生成 (SHG) 响应，而 NP2 的二次谐波生成 (SHG) 响应为 0.09 × KDP。引人注目的是，从一维链型氟氧化铌骨架（NP1-NP3）到孤立NbOF 5 单元（NP4）的零维结构的转变消除了菲咯啉排列的几何限制，实现了π共轭发色团的近共面排列以及铌基晶体在546 nm处创纪录的高双折射率0.618。所有四种化合物都保留了 3.2-3.3 eV 的宽光学带隙，表明在单一材料系列中可以同时实现巨大的双折射和紫外线透明度。这些结果将框架维度确立为克服选择之间权衡的可行策略

title: Ligand‐Controlled Chemodivergent Telomerization and Hydrofunctionalization of Isoprene With Hydrazones Under Ni Catalysis
abstract: ABSTRACT Terpenoids represent one of the most structurally diverse and biologically relevant families of natural products, yet the development of controllable biomimetic synthetic strategies using bulk feedstocks remains a critical challenge. Isoprene, an abundant and atom‐economical building block, holds great promise for terpenoid synthesis, but its four electronically and sterically similar olefinic carbons generally lead to poor regioselectivity and uncontrollable chemoselectivity in catalytic transformations. In this study, we reported a nickel‐catalyzed chemodivergent telomerization and hydrofunctionalization reaction for constructing terpenoids, wherein precise ligand control enables selective reactivity tuning. Leveraging the in situ formation of benzyl group from hydrazone‐mediated carbonyl umpolung reaction, telomerization is promoted by triarylphosphine ligand featuring both large steric hindrance and electron‐donating characteristics, while hydrofunctionalization benefits from the combination of less bulky, electron‐withdrawing triarylphosphine ligand and BEt 3 . Mechanistic studies and density functional theory calculations validate the chemoselectivity governed by ligand sterics and electronics, as well as the role of BEt 3 in enhancing regioselectivity. Moreover, this protocol created a series of value‐added terpenoids, all of which are amenable to further structural derivatizations. This mild, operationally simple catalytic manifold enables facile access to unnatural terpenoids and broadens the accessible chemical space of terpene frameworks.
title_zh: Ni催化下配体控制的异戊二烯与腙的化学发散性调聚和氢官能化反应
abstract_zh: 摘要 萜类化合物是结构最多样化和生物学相关的天然产物家族之一，但使用散装原料开发可控仿生合成策略仍然是一个严峻的挑战。异戊二烯是一种丰富且原子经济的结构单元，对于萜类化合物的合成具有巨大的前景，但其四个电子和空间相似的烯属碳通常导致催化转化中的区域选择性差和不可控的化学选择性。在这项研究中，我们报道了一种用于构建萜类化合物的镍催化化学发散调聚和氢官能化反应，其中精确的配体控制能够选择性地调节反应性。利用腙介导的羰基反相反应中苄基的原位形成，具有大空间位阻和给电子特性的三芳基膦配体促进调聚，而氢官能化则受益于体积较小的吸电子三芳基膦配体和 BEt 3 的组合。机理研究和密度泛函理论计算验证了配体空间和电子控制的化学选择性，以及 BEt 3 在增强区域选择性中的作用。此外，该方案创造了一系列增值萜类化合物，所有这些都适合进一步的结构衍生化。这种温和、操作简单的催化歧管能够轻松获得非天然萜类化合物，并拓宽萜烯框架的可利用化学空间。

title: Oxygen Serves as an Electron Acceptor for Efficient Photocatalytic Acetylene Hydrochlorination in Seawater
abstract: ABSTRACT The photocatalytic acetylene hydrochlorination with H 2 O as hydrogen source and Cl – as chlorine source in seawater is a highly promising alternative to traditional thermocatalytic acetylene hydrochlorination, but seriously suffers from poor performance due to the rapid recombination of photogenerated electrons and holes as well as the sluggish redox kinetics caused by low H + and Cl – concentrations. Here, we report an O 2 ‐accelerated photocatalytic acetylene hydrochlorination in seawater, where the O 2 serves as an efficient electron acceptor for rapidly consuming photo‐generated electrons. Consequently, the as‐fabricated tubular carbon nitride photocatalyst (MTA‐C 3 N 4 ) delivers a substantially enhanced vinyl chloride monomer (VCM) production rate of 567.0 µmol g cat −1 h −1 under 420 nm light‐emitting diode (LED) irradiation in simulated seawater with O 2 , which is ∼66‐fold higher than that without O 2 . Even in natural seawater, the MTA‐C 3 N 4 maintains a stable VCM production rate of 433.3 µmol g cat −1 h −1 over 10 days. Mechanistic studies reveal that O 2 acts as an electron acceptor to suppress charge recombination and promote the formation of holes, thereby accelerating the hole‐driven chloride oxidation kinetics to generate *Cl for selective acetylene hydrochlorination. This work not only reveals the vital role of molecular oxygen in photoredox kinetics, but also provides an appealing strategy for enhancing photocatalytic performance.
title_zh: 氧作为电子受体实现海水中高效光催化乙炔氢氯化反应
abstract_zh: 摘要 以H 2 O为氢源、Cl - 为海水中氯源的光催化乙炔氢氯化反应是传统热催化乙炔氢氯化反应的一种非常有前景的替代方案，但由于光生电子和空穴的快速复合以及低H + 和Cl - 浓度导致的氧化还原动力学缓慢，其性能严重不佳。在这里，我们报道了海水中 O 2 加速的光催化乙炔氢氯化反应，其中 O 2 作为有效的电子受体，快速消耗光生电子。因此，在含有 O 2 的模拟海水中，在 420 nm 发光二极管（LED）照射下，所制成的管状氮化碳光催化剂（MTA-C 3 N 4 ）显着提高了氯乙烯单体（VCM）的产率，达到 567.0 µmol g cat -1 h -1 ，比不含 O 2 的海水高约 66 倍。即使在天然海水中，MTA-C 3 N 4 也能在 10 天内保持稳定的 VCM 生产率 433.3 µmol g cat -1 h -1 。机理研究表明，O 2 作为电子受体抑制电荷复合并促进空穴的形成，从而加速空穴驱动的氯化物氧化动力学，生成用于选择性乙炔氢氯化的*Cl。这项工作不仅揭示了分子氧在光氧化还原动力学中的重要作用，而且为增强光催化性能提供了一种有吸引力的策略。

title: Stabilizing Grain Boundaries by Flexible Bidirectional Multisite Hydrazide Cations toward High-Performance Inverted Perovskite Solar Cells
source: ACS Energy Letters: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The grain boundary instability induced by defects and tensible strain impedes the realization of high-performance inverted perovskite solar cells (PSCs). Here, we propose a flexible bidirectional multisite additive strategy to stabilize perovskite. (6-(2,5-Dioxo-2,5-dihydro-1H-pyrror-1-yl) hexanehydrazide hydrochloride (PHHCl) with a hydrazide cation, three carbonyl groups, and a flexible alkyl chain is leveraged to manipulate the GBs of perovskite. The multiple functional groups in PHH+ synergistically participate in passivating various charged defects via rich chemical bonding modes. The bidirectional distribution of functional groups and molecular flexibility can not only enhance the defect passivation capability of PHH+ but also realize chemical bridging between neighboring perovskite grains. The PHHCl-modulated 1.55 eV inverted PSC accomplishes a certified power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 27.0%, accompanied by exceptional operational stability with a T90 lifetime of 1084 h under continuous maximum power point tracking. Moreover, the PHHCl-modified 1.78 eV and 1.68 eV PSCs yield PCEs of 20.3% and 23.5%, respectively.
title_zh: 柔性双向多位点酰肼阳离子稳定晶界助力高性能倒置钙钛矿太阳能电池
abstract_zh: 摘要 缺陷和拉伸应变引起的晶界不稳定性阻碍了高性能倒置钙钛矿太阳能电池（PSC）的实现。在这里，我们提出了一种灵活的双向多位点添加剂策略来稳定钙钛矿。利用具有酰肼阳离子、三个羰基和柔性烷基链的6-(2,5-二氧代-2,5-二氢-1H-吡咯-1-基)己酰肼盐酸盐(PHHCl)来操纵钙钛矿的晶界。PHH+中的多个官能团通过丰富的化学键合模式协同参与钝化各种带电缺陷。官能团的双向分布和分子柔性不仅可以增强钙钛矿的晶界。 PHH+ 的缺陷钝化能力，同时还实现了相邻钙钛矿晶粒之间的化学桥接，PHHCl 调制的 1.55 eV 反向 PSC 实现了 27.0% 的认证功率转换效率 (PCE)，并且在连续最大功率点跟踪下具有 1084 小时的 T90 寿命。此外，PHHCl 调制的 1.78 eV 和 1.68 eV PSC 产量。 PCE 分别为 20.3% 和 23.5%。

title: The Achilles’ Heel of Lithium‐Ion Batteries: Protonic Species
abstract: ABSTRACT Lithium‐ion batteries (LIBs) are central to the global energy transition, dominating the markets for electric vehicles and grid‐scale renewable energy storage. However, as LIBs are pushed toward their theoretical energy density limits to meet ever‐escalating performance demands, they are confronted with challenges to their intrinsic operational safety and long‐term cycling stability. In recent years, protonic species within LIBs have been increasingly recognized as critical drivers of accelerated cell degradation and premature failure. In this contribution, we first recapitulate the diverse sources and generation pathways of protonic species, with a particular emphasis on the chemical and electrochemical oxidation of state‐of‐the‐art carbonate‐based electrolytes. Subsequently, we elucidate the proton‐mediated failure network and associated self‐amplifying proton‐regeneration cycle, including electrolyte degradation and proton‐driven parasitic interfacial side reactions at both the anode‐ and cathode‐electrolyte interphases. Furthermore, we highlight critical advancements in in situ/operando characterization techniques for elucidating the sources and degradation mechanisms of protonic species, and propose a mitigation framework centered on proton source suppression and proton scavenging strategies. Finally, we pinpoint unresolved challenges and outline prospective research directions in this field. This contribution establishes critical connections between fundamental proton chemistry and failure modes, which will provide key strategic guidelines toward durable and safe high‐energy‐density LIBs.
title_zh: 锂离子电池的阿喀琉斯之踵：质子物种
abstract_zh: 摘要 锂离子电池（LIB）是全球能源转型的核心，主导着电动汽车和电网规模可再生能源存储市场。然而，随着锂离子电池被推向理论能量密度极限以满足不断升级的性能需求，它们面临着本质操作安全性和长期循环稳定性的挑战。近年来，人们越来越认识到锂离子电池中的质子是加速电池退化和过早失效的关键驱动因素。在这篇文章中，我们首先概述了质子物质的不同来源和生成途径，特别强调了最先进的碳酸盐基电解质的化学和电化学氧化。随后，我们阐明了质子介导的失效网络和相关的自放大质子再生循环，包括阳极和阴极电解质界面处的电解质降解和质子驱动的寄生界面副反应。此外，我们强调了原位/操作表征技术的关键进展，用于阐明质子物质的来源和降解机制，并提出了一个以质子源抑制和质子清除策略为中心的缓解框架。最后，我们指出了尚未解决的挑战并概述了该领域的前瞻性研究方向。这一贡献在基本质子化学和失效模式之间建立了关键联系，这将为持久和可靠的关键战略指导提供依据。

title: Polymer Surfactants at the Mesoscale: Packaging Liquid Droplets with Ultrathin Sheets and Filaments
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract We describe the design of a polymer chemistry and materials platform to fabricate mesoscale polymer surfactant (MPS) structures, as ultrathin filaments and sheets, which exhibit tailored properties in fluids and at fluidic interfaces. By coupling functional polymers with light-triggered chemical transformations and photolithographic methods, these MPS structures were found to segregate to, and assemble at, the interface of oil-in-water droplets. Using cross-linkable, fluorescent polymers, our MPS preparation produced objects of predetermined shapes on Si/SiO2 substrates which, upon release from the substrate, adhered to droplet interfaces as extended appendages (for MPS filaments) or as ultrathin films that wrapped the entire droplet surface (for MPS sheets). With MPS structures, tailored droplet-based assemblies were realized by strategically varying both the volume ratios of the fluid phases and methods of release from the substrate. Overall, this study of static and dynamic mesoscale polymer surfactants produces a breadth of fluidic structures and interfacial configurations, including individually wrapped droplets, droplet-MPS networks, and droplets trapped in nonequilibrium shapes. These findings thus translate the fundamental science of polymer chemistry at interfaces to the mesoscale using functional, programmed structures.
title_zh: 介观尺度的聚合物表面活性剂:用超薄片和丝包装液滴
abstract_zh: 摘要：我们描述了聚合物化学和材料平台的设计，用于制造介观聚合物表面活性剂（MPS）结构，如超细丝和片材，它们在流体和流体界面处表现出定制的特性。通过将功能性聚合物与光触发化学转化和光刻方法相结合，发现这些 MPS 结构在水包油滴的界面上分离并组装。使用可交联的荧光聚合物，我们的 MPS 制剂在 Si/SiO2 基底上产生了预定形状的物体，这些物体在从基底释放后，作为延伸的附属物（对于 MPS 细丝）或作为包裹整个液滴表面的超薄膜（对于 MPS 片材）粘附到液滴界面。利用 MPS 结构，通过策略性地改变流体相的体积比和从基底释放的方法，实现了基于液滴的定制组件。总体而言，这项对静态和动态介观聚合物表面活性剂的研究产生了广泛的流体结构和界面配置，包括单独包裹的液滴、液滴-MPS网络和捕获在非平衡形状中的液滴。因此，这些发现利用功能性、程序化结构将界面上的聚合物化学基础科学转化为介观尺度。

title: Uneven TCR chain pairing constraints govern epitope recognition
abstract: Combinatorial pairing of independently recombined T cell receptor (TCR) α- and β-chains is central to diversifying the TCR repertoire. Although sequence motifs in one chain correlate with epitope recognition, the extent to which a single chain dictates specificity remains unclear. Here, we systematically tested TCR chain coupling constraints by enforcing the pairing of individual chains with hundreds of thousands of partners. Although most chains paired stably, the preservation of epitope specificity was rare and highly variable, with the frequency of compatible partners ranging from ~10 to 70,000 epitope-specific TCRs across 10 epitopes. Our work illuminates the distinct contributions of TCR chains, highlights the limitations of single-chain data, and provides an experimental and analytical framework for refining TCR-peptide-major histocompatibility complex specificity inference.
title_zh: 不均一的TCR链配对约束决定表位识别
abstract_zh: 独立重组 T 细胞受体 (TCR) α 链和 β 链的组合配对对于 TCR 库多样化至关重要。尽管一条链中的序列基序与表位识别相关，但单链在多大程度上决定特异性仍不清楚。在这里，我们通过强制将各个链与数十万个合作伙伴配对来系统地测试 TCR 链耦合约束。尽管大多数链稳定配对，但表位特异性的保留很少且高度可变，10 个表位中相容伴侣的频率范围为约 10 至 70,000 个表位特异性 TCR。我们的工作阐明了 TCR 链的独特贡献，强调了单链数据的局限性，并为完善 TCR 肽主要组织相容性复合体特异性推断提供了实验和分析框架。

title: Thalamic NRXN1-mediated input to human cortical progenitors drives excitatory neurogenesis
abstract: The human cerebral cortex develops through coordinated signals from within the cortex and from other brain regions, including the thalamus. However, how thalamic neuronal projections influence early human cortical development remains less well-understood. In this study, we fused cortical and thalamic organoids to investigate how thalamic input shapes the maturation of human cortical cells. Using single-nuclei RNA-sequencing and cellular imaging, we found that thalamic input increases the production of cortical excitatory neurons. We identify neurexin-1 (NRXN1) as a mediator of physical contact between thalamic axons and cortical outer radial glia. Genetic knockout of thalamic NRXN1 reduced these contacts and attenuated the production of upper-layer excitatory neurons. These findings reveal a mechanism by which thalamic input regulates human cortical progenitors and shapes excitatory neuron production during development.
title_zh: 丘脑NRXN1介导的向人类皮质祖细胞的输入驱动兴奋性神经发生
abstract_zh: 人类大脑皮层通过来自皮层内部和其他大脑区域（包括丘脑）的协调信号而发育。然而，丘脑神经元投射如何影响早期人类皮质发育仍然不太清楚。在这项研究中，我们融合了皮质和丘脑类器官，以研究丘脑输入如何影响人类皮质细胞的成熟。使用单核 RNA 测序和细胞成像，我们发现丘脑输入增加了皮质兴奋性神经元的产生。我们确定 neurexin-1 (NRXN1) 是丘脑轴突和皮质外放射状胶质细胞之间物理接触的介体。丘脑 NRXN1 的基因敲除减少了这些接触并减弱了上层兴奋性神经元的产生。这些发现揭示了丘脑输入调节人类皮质祖细胞并塑造发育过程中兴奋性神经元产生的机制。

title: Stabilizing Perovskite/Electrode Interface With Tailored 2D/1D Stacking Layer
abstract: ABSTRACT Metal halide perovskite (MHP) single crystals are promising for optoelectronic applications, yet their surfaces suffer from severe ion migration‐related degradation. Herein, a 2D/1D stacking layer is explored to stabilize the crystal/electrode interface. In addition to providing a dense barrier layer, the inserted 2D perovskites can modulate the microscopic morphology and coverage ratio of the overlying 1D perovskite layer. Through tailoring the 2D/1D stacking layer, interface iodide migration is suppressed markedly, extending the T 90 lifetime of single‐crystal perovskite solar cells (PSCs) from 450 h to 2500 h, which significantly exceeds previously reported values. Besides, the reverse‐bias‐induced performance decay can be recovered substantially, indicating effective hindrance of irreversible iodide ion migration across the perovskite/electrode interface. Finally, the surface iodide vacancies and nonradiative recombination loss are mitigated, increasing the power conversion efficiency (PCE) from 23.2% to 25.5%, which is among the highest value for single‐crystal PSCs. Since interface ion migration is a universal issue for both polycrystalline films and single crystals, our strategy is instructive for optimizing diverse perovskite optoelectronic devices.
title_zh: 利用定制的2D/1D堆叠层稳定钙钛矿/电极界面
abstract_zh: 摘要金属卤化物钙钛矿（MHP）单晶在光电应用方面很有前景，但其表面遭受严重的离子迁移相关退化。在此，探索了 2D/1D 堆叠层来稳定晶体/电极界面。除了提供致密的阻挡层之外，插入的二维钙钛矿还可以调节上面的一维钙钛矿层的微观形态和覆盖率。通过定制2D/1D堆叠层，界面碘化物迁移被显着抑制，将单晶钙钛矿太阳能电池（PSC）的T 90 寿命从450小时延长至2500小时，大大超过了之前报道的值。此外，反向偏压引起的性能衰减可以显着恢复，表明有效阻碍了不可逆碘离子在钙钛矿/电极界面上的迁移。最后，表面碘化物空位和非辐射复合损失得到缓解，功率转换效率（PCE）从23.2%提高到25.5%，这是单晶PSC的最高值之​​一。由于界面离子迁移是多晶薄膜和单晶的普遍问题，因此我们的策略对于优化各种钙钛矿光电器件具有指导意义。

title: Anionic Bottom-Up Flux Orchestrated via Hard Carbon Surface Chemistry for Stable Sodium-Ion Batteries
abstract: Hard carbon anodes for sodium-ion batteries suffer from unstable solid-electrolyte interphase formation, leading to low initial Coulombic efficiency and poor cycle stability. Herein, we demonstrate a molecular-level surface design that actively orchestrates an anionic bottom-up flux from the electrolyte bulk to the hard carbon interface. By engineering a synergistic pair of pyridinic-N and carbonyl groups on the carbon surface, we create a functional-differentiation microenvironment where pyridinic-N selectively anchors PF6− anions, while the cooperative carbonyl repels solvent molecules. This dual functionality establishes a sustained concentration gradient that drives a continuous reverse flux of anions toward the interface, fundamentally redirecting the electrolyte decomposition pathway from solvent-dominated to anion-preferential. The tailored surface lowers the PF6− decomposition barrier by over 70%, yielding a thin, inorganic-rich solid-electrolyte interphase dominated by NaF and Na2O. The optimized anode achieves 91.9% Coulombic efficiency with high reversible capacity of 368.2 mAh g−1, and 96.5% capacity retention after 5,000 cycles. A pouch cell assembled with NFPP cathode achieves an energy density of 239.1 Wh kg−1 and stable operation over 500 cycles, demonstrating strong practical potential. This work establishes active surface-guided anionic transport as a powerful strategy for interphase engineering in advanced sodium-ion batteries. Highlights:1 A cooperative pair of pyridinic-N and carbonyl groups creates a trap-and-repel microenvironment that actively programs interfacial reactions.2 The functional differentiation drives a sustained bottom-up anionic flux, steering decomposition toward an anion-derived pathway.3 The resulting inorganic-rich solid-electrolyte interphase enables 91.9% initial Coulombic efficiency and 96.5% capacity retention over 5,000 cycles.

title: Measurement of the Λ electric dipole moment with an entangled baryon-antibaryon system
abstract: The dominance of matter over antimatter in the Universe has consistently driven the pursuit of new physics beyond the Standard Model that violates charge-parity symmetry. Strange baryons (hyperons) remain a largely unexplored territory in which interactions between hyperons and particles from new physics could induce a nontrivial electric dipole moment (EDM). However, direct measurements of hyperon EDMs through spin precession are highly challenging owing to their short lifetimes. In this work, we introduce a method to extract the EDM of the lightest hyperon, Λ, using the entangled Λ Λ ¯ system. Our result is consistent with zero, achieving a three-orders-of-magnitude improvement over the previous upper limit established in the 1980s with comparable statistics, providing stringent constraints on potential new physics.
title_zh: 利用纠缠重子-反重子系统测量Λ粒子电偶极矩
abstract_zh: 宇宙中物质相对反物质的主导地位一直推动着对违反电荷宇称对称性的标准模型之外的新物理学的追求。奇异重子（超子）仍然是一个很大程度上未被探索的领域，其中超子和新物理学粒子之间的相互作用可能会产生不平凡的电偶极矩（EDM）。然而，由于超子 EDM 的寿命较短，通过自旋进动直接测量超子 EDM 非常具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们介绍了一种使用纠缠 Λ Λ ¯ 系统提取最轻超子 Λ 的 EDM 的方法。我们的结果与零一致，比 20 世纪 80 年代建立的可比统计数据上限提高了三个数量级，为潜在的新物理学提供了严格的约束。

title: Architectural Optimization of Multilayer Thermal Barrier Coatings
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Multilayer thermal barrier coatings provide greater flexibility for tailoring coating performance, but the large number of possible material combinations and layer configurations makes architectural optimization increasingly difficult through experimental trial and error alone. In this study, an experimentally generated dataset spanning single-layer, bilayer, multilayer, graded, variable-thickness, and physically mixed coating architectures containing conventional yttria stabilized zirconia (YSZ), nanostructured YSZ, and ceria yttria stabilized zirconia (CYSZ) was analyzed using machine learning to investigate the relationship between coating architecture and degradation-related performance. Surrogate models were developed for multiple degradation responses and combined with model interpretation, consistency assessment, and multiobjective optimization to examine the influence of composition, layer arrangement, and thickness distribution on coating behavior. The analysis showed that different degradation metrics provide distinct perspectives on coating performance and should not be treated equally during optimization. It also identified the architectural variables with the greatest influence on degradation resistance and durability, allowing practical architecture level design trends to be identified from the experimental data. Global performance–relative-cost screening of the investigated 450 μm architectures selected a YSZ/nanostructured YSZ bilayer as a practical candidate for balancing performance and cost while reducing final degradation and preserving high cyclic durability, making it technically viable for further development and engineering applications.
title_zh: 多层热障涂层的结构优化
abstract_zh: 摘要 多层热障涂层在调控涂层性能方面提供了更大的灵活性，但可能的材料组合和层构型数量庞大，仅通过实验试错进行结构优化变得越来越困难。在本研究中，我们对实验生成的数据集进行了分析，该数据集涵盖单层、双层、多层、梯度、变厚度以及物理混合涂层结构，其中包含常规氧化钇稳定氧化锆（YSZ）、纳米结构YSZ和氧化铈氧化钇稳定氧化锆（CYSZ），并利用机器学习研究涂层结构与降解相关性能之间的关系。我们针对多种降解响应建立了代理模型，并结合模型解释、一致性评估和多目标优化，考察了成分、层排列和厚度分布对涂层行为的影响。分析表明，不同的降解指标从不同角度反映涂层性能，在优化过程中不应等同对待。研究还识别了对抗降解性和耐久性影响最大的结构变量，从而能够从实验数据中确定实用的结构层面设计趋势。对所研究的450 μm结构进行的全局性能-相对成本筛选，选出了YSZ/纳米结构YSZ双层结构作为平衡性能与成本、同时降低最终降解并保持高循环性能的实用候选方案。

title: Biomimetic EUK-134 Synergy Strategy for Dynamic Cyclic Antioxidant Defense and Defect Passivation in Perovskite Solar Cells
abstract: Abstract Organic–inorganic hybrid perovskites are highly susceptible to oxidative degradation under illumination and oxygen exposure. The primary degradation mechanism involves photogenerated electrons reducing adsorbed oxygen to form highly reactive superoxide radicals (O2•–). These radicals not only initiate lattice iodide loss and organic cation volatilization but also produce hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) as a dismutation byproduct, which further accelerates material decomposition and severely compromises long-term stability. Here, we introduce the biomimetic enzyme mimetic EUK-134 into the perovskite precursor solution, which possesses dual superoxide dismutase (SOD) and catalase (CAT) activities. It effectively scavenges O2•– and decomposes H2O2, blocking the reactive oxygen species (ROS)-mediated degradation pathway. Concurrently, the Cl– ions from EUK-134 modulate perovskite crystallization and fill iodide vacancies, whereas the phenolic oxygen groups passivate undercoordinated Pb2+ sites. This synergistic effect achieves a champion power conversion efficiency of 24.48%. Notably, the unencapsulated device retains 90.39% of its initial efficiency after 2000 h of aging in nitrogen and maintains 75.45% after 1000 h under ambient conditions (25 °C, RH ≈ 40–60%, room light), significantly outperforming the control device. This work provides a reliable and powerful strategy for fabricating highly stable and long-lived photovoltaic devices.
title_zh: 仿生EUK-134协同策略用于钙钛矿太阳能电池的动态循环抗氧化防御与缺陷钝化
abstract_zh: 摘要 有机-无机杂化钙钛矿在光照和氧气暴露下极易氧化降解。主要降解机制涉及光生电子还原吸附的氧，形成高反应性超氧自由基 (O2•–)。这些自由基不仅引发晶格碘化物损失和有机阳离子挥发，而且还产生歧化副产物过氧化氢（H2O2），进一步加速材料分解并严重损害长期稳定性。在这里，我们将仿生酶模拟物EUK-134引入钙钛矿前体溶液中，其具有超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和过氧化氢酶（CAT）双重活性。它有效清除 O2•– 并分解 H2O2，阻断活性氧 (ROS) 介导的降解途径。同时，EUK-134 中的 Cl- 离子调节钙钛矿结晶并填充碘化物空位，而酚氧基团则钝化欠配位的 Pb2+ 位点。这种协同效应实现了 24.48% 的冠军功率转换效率。值得注意的是，未封装的器件在氮气中老化 2000 小时后仍保留了 90.39% 的初始效率，并在环境条件（25 °C，RH ≈ 40–60%，室内光线）下老化 1000 小时后仍保持 75.45%，显着优于对照器件。这项工作为制造高度稳定和长寿命的光伏器件提供了可靠而强大的策略。

title: High-Efficiency, Self-Healing Elastomer via Dynamic Boronic Ester Bond Density Regulation for Joint Motion Monitoring
abstract: Abstract Elastomer-based flexible and stretchable sensors have attracted considerable research interest for promising applications in areas, such as human–machine interfaces, physiological monitoring, and soft robotics. Despite the typical trade-off between transparency, mechanical strength, and self-healing in elastomers, which is rooted in conflicting requirements for molecular chain mobility, impeding this broad application prospects in wearable devices and the conformable electronics field. This work demonstrates a polyborosiloxane/polydimethylsiloxane interpenetrating network (PBS/PDMS IPN) that successfully reconciles these properties. The resulting multifunctional elastomer exhibits both effective self-healing (97.8% recovery of tensile strength in 15 min under 1 psi) and a transmittance up to 93%. The energy dissipation imparted by high-molecular-weight hydroxy-terminated PDMS (PDMS-OH) further enhances adhesion, granting the multifunctional elastomer superior bonding performance. The multifunctional elastomer is integrated with eutectic gallium–indium (EGaIn) to form a stress sensor, which enables high-accuracy human motion monitoring, showcasing its potential for advanced wearable medical sensors.
title_zh: 通过动态硼酸酯键密度调控制备高效自修复弹性体用于关节运动监测
abstract_zh: 摘要：基于弹性体的柔性可拉伸传感器在人机界面、生理监测和软机器人等领域具有广阔的应用前景，引起了人们广泛的研究兴趣。尽管弹性体在透明度、机械强度和自修复性之间存在典型的权衡，但其根源在于分子链流动性的相互冲突的要求，阻碍了可穿戴设备和顺应电子领域的广泛应用前景。这项工作展示了聚硼硅氧烷/聚二甲基硅氧烷互穿网络 (PBS/PDMS IPN)，它成功地协调了这些特性。所得的多功能弹性体表现出有效的自修复性（1 psi 下 15 分钟内拉伸强度恢复 97.8%）和高达 93% 的透光率。高分子量羟基封端的PDMS (PDMS-OH) 带来的能量耗散进一步增强了粘合力，赋予多功能弹性体优异的粘合性能。这种多功能弹性体与共晶镓铟（EGaIn）集成形成应力传感器，可实现高精度人体运动监测，展示了其在先进可穿戴医疗传感器方面的潜力。

title: Antifreezing and Highly Elastic Hydrogels Based on Hydrogen-Bond Regulation and Hydrophobic Crosslinking for Multifunctional Flexible Devices
abstract: Abstract Conventional hydrogels tend to freeze at low temperatures and exhibit significant mechanical hysteresis during cyclic deformation, which impairs their cycling stability and substantially restricts their applications in flexible devices employed in extremely cold environments. Herein, a synergistic strategy combining hydrophobic crosslinking and hydrogen-bond regulation is proposed to achieve antifreezing and highly elastic hydrogels. The hydrogels are one-step prepared by polymerization of acrylamide in zinc triflate solutions using hydrophobic 1,9-bis(acryloyloxy)nonane as a crosslinker. The hydrophobic crosslinker endows the hydrogel with an ultrahigh stretchability of 2266% and a toughness of 0.51 MJ m−3, while Zn(OTf)2 regulates the hydrogen-bonding interactions to reduce mechanical hysteresis and depress the freezing point. The as-prepared hydrogels show a hysteresis ratio of 6.61% during cyclic deformations and maintain mechanical flexibility even at ultralow temperatures of −70 °C. Owing to the antifreezing and highly elastic features, the resultant hydrogels demonstrate robust functionalities as electrolytes for zinc-ion pouch batteries and strain/temperature sensors at ultralow temperatures. This study provides an effective route to achieve high stretchability, low hysteresis, and superior antifreezing performance in one hydrogel for flexible energy storage and wearable sensing materials under extreme cold conditions.
title_zh: 基于氢键调控与疏水交联的抗冻高弹性水凝胶用于多功能柔性器件
abstract_zh: 摘要 传统的水凝胶在低温下容易冻结，并且在循环变形过程中表现出显着的机械滞后，这损害了它们的循环稳定性，并极大地限制了它们在极冷环境下柔性器件中的应用。在此，提出了一种结合疏水交联和氢键调节的协同策略来实现抗冻和高弹性水凝胶。该水凝胶是通过使用疏水性 1,9-双（丙烯酰氧基）壬烷作为交联剂，在三氟甲磺酸锌溶液中聚合丙烯酰胺一步制备的。疏水性交联剂赋予水凝胶2266%的超高拉伸性和0.51 MJ m−3的韧性，而Zn(OTf)2调节氢键相互作用以减少机械滞后并降低凝固点。所制备的水凝胶在循环变形过程中表现出6.61%的滞后比，即使在-70°C的超低温下也能保持机械柔韧性。由于具有防冻和高弹性的特性，所得水凝胶在超低温下表现出作为锌离子软包电池和应变/温度传感器电解质的强大功能。这项研究为在极冷条件下实现柔性储能和可穿戴传感材料的水凝胶高拉伸性、低滞后性和优异的防冻性能提供了一种有效途径。

title: Oxygen-Vacancy-Rich Na1.3Ti1.8Ni0.1Sb0.1(PO4)3@C Anode for High-Rate and Low-Temperature Sodium-Ion Storage
abstract: Abstract NASICON-type NaTi2(PO4)3 as an electrode material for sodium-ion batteries has attracted considerable attention due to its high structural stability and safety, yet its low intrinsic electronic conductivity limits high-rate and low-temperature performance. In this work, an oxygen-vacancy-rich Na1.3Ti1.8Ni0.1Sb0.1(PO4)3@C (N1.3T1.8N0.1S0.1P@C) nanopowder as a high-performance anode material is synthesized by a solvothermal method. The Ni2+/Sb5+ co-doping effectively modulates the local TiO6/PO4 lattice environment, introduces oxygen vacancies, and optimizes the lattice electronic structure, enhancing both electron and ion transport. A continuous carbon coating forms a stable conductive network, further improving kinetics and structural integrity. As a result, Na∥N1.3T1.8N0.1S0.1P@C half-cells retain 91% of their capacity after 5000 cycles at 20 C and maintain 86% capacity over 10,000 cycles at 10 C under 0 °C. The full cell paired with Na3V2(PO4)3 cathodes exhibits 87% capacity retention after 1000 cycles at 5 C and delivers excellent performance even at 50 C without pre-sodiation, highlighting their potential for low-temperature applications. This study provides a general doping-defect engineering strategy for NASICON-type anodes, enabling high-rate, low-temperature, and long-cycle performance for sodium-ion batteries.
title_zh: 富氧空位Na1.3Ti1.8Ni0.1Sb0.1(PO4)3@C负极用于高倍率低温钠离子存储
abstract_zh: 摘要 NASICON型NaTi2(PO4)3作为钠离子电池电极材料由于其结构稳定性和安全性高而受到广泛关注，但其较低的本征电导率限制了高倍率和低温性能。本工作采用溶剂热法合成了富含氧空位的Na1.3Ti1.8Ni0.1Sb0.1(PO4)3@C (N1.3T1.8N0.1S0.1P@C)纳米粉体作为高性能负极材料。 Ni2+/Sb5+共掺杂有效调节局部TiO6/PO4晶格环境，引入氧空位，优化晶格电子结构，增强电子和离子传输。连续的碳涂层形成稳定的导电网络，进一步提高动力学和结构完整性。结果，Na||N1.3T1.8N0.1S0.1P@C 半电池在 20 C 下循环 5000 次后仍保留 91% 的容量，在 0 °C 下于 10 C 循环 10,000 次后仍保持 86% 的容量。与 Na3V2(PO4)3 阴极配对的全电池在 5 C 下循环 1000 次后容量保持率为 87%，即使在 50 C 下无需预钠化也能提供出色的性能，凸显了其在低温应用中的潜力。这项研究为 NASICON 型阳极提供了一种通用的掺杂缺陷工程策略，使钠离子电池具有高倍率、低温和长循环性能。

title: Interface-Driven Evolution of Interlayer and Hybrid Excitons in CVD-Grown Large-Area MoS2/WS2 Vertical Heterostructures
abstract: Abstract Van der Waals heterostructures grown by chemical vapor deposition (CVD) offer a scalable platform for optoelectronic applications. However, understanding and accurately assigning their excitonic spectral features remain challenging. This is due to variable interfacial quality arising from interfacial disorder and interlayer coupling, as well as overlapping spectral signatures. Here, we synthesize continuous, large-area (up to 600 μm) MoS2/WS2 vertical heterostructures using two distinct single-step CVD processes. This approach enables a systematic comparison of excitonic behavior across varying interface qualities. Temperature-dependent photoluminescence, supported by ultra-low-frequency Raman spectroscopy, resolves the evolution of distinct interlayer exciton (ILE) spectral features. In heterobilayers, the ILE evolves from localized states in the presence of interfacial disorder to delocalized states stabilized by uniform interlayer coupling. Notably, we identify a hybrid exciton, arising from strong interlayer electronic hybridization, centered at ∼1.90 eV between the neutral A-excitons of MoS2 and WS2. Importantly, hybrid exciton formation correlates with a suppression of ILE radiative emission. By systematically disentangling disorder-trapped, delocalized, and hybrid excitonic regimes, this work provides clear experimental evidence of interface-driven excitonic transitions. These findings highlight the critical role of interfacial quality in governing excitonic behavior in scalable MoS2/WS2 heterostructures.
title_zh: CVD生长大面积MoS2/WS2垂直异质结中界面驱动的层间激子与杂化激子演化
abstract_zh: 摘要 通过化学气相沉积 (CVD) 生长的范德华异质结构为光电应用提供了一个可扩展的平台。然而，理解并准确分配它们的激子光谱特征仍然具有挑战性。这是由于界面无序和层间耦合以及重叠光谱特征引起的界面质量变化。在这里，我们使用两种不同的单步 CVD 工艺合成连续的大面积（高达 600 μm）MoS2/WS2 垂直异质结构。这种方法可以对不同界面质量的激子行为进行系统比较。由超低频拉曼光谱支持的温度依赖性光致发光解决了独特的层间激子 (ILE) 光谱特征的演变。在异双层中，ILE 从存在界面无序的局域态演化为通过均匀层间耦合稳定的离域态。值得注意的是，我们发现了一种由强层间电子杂化产生的混合激子，其中心位于 MoS2 和 WS2 的中性 A 激子之间~1.90 eV。重要的是，混合激子的形成与 ILE 辐射发射的抑制相关。通过系统地解开无序捕获、离域和混合激子状态，这项工作为界面驱动的激子跃迁提供了清晰的实验证据。这些发现强调了界面质量在控制可扩展的 MoS2/WS2 异质结构中激子行为中的关键作用。

title: Engineered Hierarchical Porosity in Three-Dimensional-Printed Hydrogel Scaffolds Enhances Mesenchymal Stem Cell Therapy for Chronic Diabetic Wounds

abstract_zh: 摘要 慢性糖尿病伤口不愈合是一项重大的临床挑战，因为它根源于复杂的病理微环境，包括神经病变、血管病变和慢性炎症。传统的治疗方法无法从根本上解决这些问题。受户外攀岩的启发，本研究开发了一种具有分级孔径的多功能生物活性水凝胶支架（CSP水凝胶），以重塑伤口微环境并促进再生修复。该水凝胶由甲基丙烯酰化壳聚糖（CSMA）和甲基丙烯酰化丝素蛋白（SiMA）通过3D打印和光聚合制成，具有可控的特性：多尺度多孔结构（大孔≥100μm，中孔1-50μm，微孔）

title: Ultrastable Lithium Metal Batteries Enabled by the Fluorinated Li/Electrolyte Interphase with High Mechanical Strength
abstract: Abstract A rationally designed solid-electrolyte interphase (SEI) is critical for enabling a high mechanical modulus, low mass transfer resistance, and uniform, rapid ion transport in lithium metal batteries. Herein, we report a promising artificial SEI layer fabricated by coating fluorinated hydroxyapatite on the commercially available polypropylene separator. Fluorination reaction for hydroxyapatite greatly improves its Young’s modulus, physically suppressing Li dendrite growth. More importantly, the uniformly coated nanoscale fluorinated hydroxyapatite with a solid−solid nanoporous network enables efficient Li-ion transport during Li plating/stripping and F− release, which not only endows the formed SEI with local outer regions of ordered laminar Li2O as revealed by cryo-transmission electron microscopy but also effectively promotes the formation of a stable LiF-rich inner layer. The obtained double-deck SEI, with high mechanical strength, suppresses SEI fracture during repeated cycles, promotes uniform Li-ion flux, and stabilizes the Li/electrolyte interface. As a result, Li anodes based on this fluorinated hydroxyapatite exhibit an ultrastable cycling life over 1200 h with a capacity of 3 mAh cm−2 at a current density of 3 mA cm−2. When coupled with a LiFePO4 cathode, the obtained full cell shows a high capacity retention of 96% after 600 cycles.
title_zh: 高机械强度氟化锂/电解质界面相实现的超稳定锂金属电池
abstract_zh: 摘要 合理设计的固体电解质界面（SEI）对于在锂金属电池中实现高机械模量、低传质阻力以及均匀、快速的离子传输至关重要。在此，我们报告了一种有前途的人造 SEI 层，通过在市售聚丙烯隔膜上涂覆氟化羟基磷灰石而制成。羟基磷灰石的氟化反应极大地提高了其杨氏模量，从物理上抑制了锂枝晶的生长。更重要的是，均匀涂覆的纳米级氟化羟基磷灰石具有固-固纳米多孔网络，能够在锂沉积/剥离和F-释放过程中实现高效的锂离子传输，这不仅使形成的SEI具有低温透射电子显微镜显示的有序层状Li2O的局部外部区域，而且还有效促进了稳定的富含LiF的内层的形成。所获得的双层SEI具有高机械强度，可抑制重复循环过程中SEI的断裂，促进均匀的锂离子通量，并稳定Li/电解质界面。因此，基于这种氟化羟基磷灰石的锂阳极表现出超过1200小时的超稳定循环寿命，在3 mA cm−2的电流密度下容量为3 mAh cm−2。当与 LiFePO4 阴极结合时，所获得的全电池在 600 次循环后显示出 96% 的高容量保持率。

title: High-Performance Microwave-Synthesized Graphene Supercapacitive Synapses for Reservoir Preprocessing in Neuromorphic Computing
abstract: Abstract Reservoir computing bridges the gap between artificial intelligence and the physical environment. The realization of such systems depends on artificial synapses that emulate neurobiological plasticity in response to external stimuli. Functioning as reservoirs, these synapses convert the input signals into reservoir states, which are then retrieved by the readout layer. However, energy is merely dissipated during the operation of existing artificial synapses. Herein, we propose an energy-storage-involved reservoir architecture based on graphene-based supercapacitors. Reduced graphene oxide electrode, fabricated via metal-assisted microwave reduction, exhibits a mesoporous structure and low defect density. The supercapacitor delivers a specific capacitance of 352 F g–1 at a current density of 1 A g–1. Under current stimuli, the energy-storage device replicates biological synaptic functions through voltage responses. Next, the voltage responses can be used to mimic human perceptual learning, in which sensory systems are enhanced through experience. Moreover, integrated with a diffractive deep neural network in simulation, supercapacitor-based reservoir preprocessing can accurately identify static and dynamic handwritten images, outperforming an artificial neural network and an unprocessed diffractive deep neural network. These results pave the way for neuromorphic computing that integrates energy-storage-involved information processing, offering promising applications for energy-efficient artificial intelligence hardware.
title_zh: 高性能微波合成石墨烯超级电容器突触用于神经形态计算中的储备池预处理
abstract_zh: 摘要 水库计算弥合了人工智能和物理环境之间的差距。这种系统的实现依赖于模拟神经生物学可塑性以响应外部刺激的人工突触。这些突触充当储存器，将输入信号转换为储存器状态，然后由读出层检索。然而，能量仅在现有人工突触的操作过程中耗散。在此，我们提出了一种基于石墨烯超级电容器的涉及储能的储层结构。通过金属辅助微波还原制备的还原氧化石墨烯电极具有介孔结构和低缺陷密度。超级电容器在 1 A g–1 的电流密度下提供 352 F g–1 的比电容。在电流刺激下，储能装置通过电压响应复制生物突触功能。接下来，电压响应可用于模仿人类感知学习，其中感觉系统通过经验得到增强。此外，在模拟中与衍射深度神经网络相结合，基于超级电容器的水库预处理可以准确识别静态和动态手写图像，其性能优于人工神经网络和未经处理的衍射深度神经网络。这些结果为集成能量存储相关信息处理的神经形态计算铺平了道路，为节能人工智能硬件提供了有前途的应用。

title: Dual Photo-Functional Au/TiO2/NiO Nanocone Arrays Empower Flexible Zn−Urea−Air Batteries
abstract: Abstract Photo-assisted Zn−air batteries provide an integrated route for solar energy conversion and storage, but their energy efficiency is still limited by sluggish bifunctional oxygen electrocatalysis at the air electrode. Herein, an Au nanoparticle-modified TiO2/NiO nanocone array air electrode (Au/n-TO/NiO) is developed for photo-assisted zinc−urea−air batteries. The nanocone TO architecture enhances broadband light harvesting, local electric-field intensity, and interfacial reactant enrichment, while the TO/NiO heterojunction promotes photogenerated charge separation. Under 365 nm irradiation, photogenerated holes preferentially migrate toward Ni-related active sites and accelerate urea oxidation, thereby reducing charging polarization. Meanwhile, Au nanoparticles serve as localized surface plasmon resonance centers, enabling efficient 808 nm photothermal conversion to regulate the oxygen reduction microenvironment during discharge. Benefiting from this functional partitioning of photoexcitation and photothermal regulation, the Au/n-TO/NiO-based battery exhibits a reduced charging plateau from 1.899 V in the dark to 1.585 V under combined illumination with urea, while the discharge plateau increases from 1.087 to 1.214 V. The apparent electrical round-trip efficiency consequently increases from 57.2% to 76.6% under the specified operating conditions. Furthermore, the flexible gel-state device achieves an apparent electrical round-trip efficiency of 81.5% under illumination with urea, demonstrating the potential of this strategy for flexible photo-assisted metal−air batteries.
title_zh: 双光功能Au/TiO2/NiO纳米锥阵列助力柔性Zn−尿素−空气电池
abstract_zh: 摘要 光辅助锌空气电池为太阳能转换和存储提供了一条综合途径，但其能量效率仍然受到空气电极缓慢的双功能氧电催化的限制。在此，开发了一种用于光辅助锌尿素空气电池的金纳米粒子修饰的TiO2/NiO纳米锥阵列空气电极（Au/n-TO/NiO）。纳米锥 TO 结构增强了宽带光捕获、局部电场强度和界面反应物富集，而 TO/NiO 异质结则促进光生电荷分离。在365 nm照射下，光生空穴优先向Ni相关活性位点迁移，加速尿素氧化，从而减少充电极化。同时，Au纳米粒子作为局部表面等离子体共振中心，实现高效的808 nm光热转换，以调节放电过程中的氧还原微环境。受益于光激发和光热调节的这种功能划分，Au/n-TO/NiO基电池的充电平台从黑暗中的1.899 V降低到尿素组合照明下的1.585 V，而放电平台从1.087增加到1.214 V。因此，在指定的工作条件下，表观电往返效率从57.2%增加到76.6%。此外，柔性凝胶态器件在尿素照明下实现了 81.5% 的表观电往返效率，证明了该策略在柔性光辅助金属空气电池中的潜力。

title: Decoupling the Dual Thermal Failure Pathways at the PDINN/Ag Cathode Interface in Conventional Organic Solar Cells
abstract: Abstract The conventional architecture of organic solar cells (OSCs) results in power conversion efficiency (PCE) but suffers from poor thermal stability, largely due to insufficiently understood interfacial degradation at the cathode side. Guided by this mechanistic understanding, we introduce a thermally evaporated C60/SnO2 bilayer between the active layer and PDINN as a diffusion-blocking interlayer.
