title: Programmable Recognition of Organyl 5′-Phosphates by Human Argonaute-2
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract To effectuate RNA interference (RNAi), Argonaute (AGO) proteins recognize and load RNA guide strands by their requisite 5′-phosphate (5′-P). However, the structural features that govern AGO2 tolerance for chemically modified 5′-P architectures remain poorly defined, despite their importance for small interfering RNA (siRNA) drug design. Moreover, degradative enzymes also recognize 5′-P, yet few stereoelectronic features are known to differentiate AGO2 recognition from competing degradation pathways. Here, we show that AGO2 accommodates a substantially broader range of 5′-P derivatives than previously recognized, and that select 5′-P mimics can exploit novel interactions with the protein to reinforce guide anchoring. Through systematic diversification of 35 organic substituents, we interrogated structural determinants of guide anchoring and enzymatic susceptibility. Our analysis identified previously uncharacterized 5′-P mimics, including methyl and phenylpropargyl 5′-phosphates (5′-PO-Me, 5′-PO-PhPrp), phenylpropargyl 5′-phosphorothioate (5′-PS-PhPrp), and 5′-mesylphosphoramidate (5′-MsPA), that preserve efficient AGO2 loading in cells while inhibiting phosphatase-mediated degradation. We further found that 5′-exonuclease susceptibility depends strongly on canonical 5′ phosphate chemistry rather than steric accessibility. Structural analysis of a 5′-PO-PhPrp guide:AGO2 complex shows that the phenylpropargyl substituent engages a π-stacking network within a cluster of aromatic side chains (Y529/F811/Y815), while extended 5′-P substituents are accommodated through rotation of the 5′-P and coordinated rearrangement of water molecules within the 5′-P binding pocket. Collectively, these findings reveal the structural basis for plasticity of guide anchoring in AGO2 and establish chemically programmable 5′-end interactions as a general strategy for modulating oligonucleotide stability and activity.
title_zh: 人Argonaute-2对有机基5′-磷酸酯的可编程识别
abstract_zh: 摘要 为了实现 RNA 干扰 (RNAi)，Argonaute (AGO) 蛋白通过必需的 5'-磷酸 (5'-P) 识别并加载 RNA 引导链。然而，尽管 AGO2 对小干扰 RNA (siRNA) 药物设计很重要，但控制 AGO2 对化学修饰 5'-P 结构耐受性的结构特征仍然不清楚。此外，降解酶也识别 5'-P，但很少有立体电子特征能够区分 AGO2 识别和竞争性降解途径。在这里，我们表明 AGO2 容纳的 5'-P 衍生物范围比之前认识的要广泛得多，并且选择的 5'-P 模拟物可以利用与蛋白质的新相互作用来增强引导锚定。通过 35 个有机取代基的系统多样化，我们探究了引导锚定和酶敏感性的结构决定因素。我们的分析发现了以前未表征的 5'-P 模拟物，包括甲基和苯基炔丙基 5'-磷酸酯 (5'-PO-Me、5'-PO-PhPrp)、苯基炔丙基 5'-硫代磷酸酯 (5'-PS-PhPrp) 和 5'-甲磺酰氨基磷酸酯 (5'-MsPA)，它们可保持细胞中 AGO2 的有效负载，同时抑制磷酸酶介导的降解。我们进一步发现 5'-核酸外切酶敏感性很大程度上取决于规范的 5' 磷酸化学而不是空间可及性。 5'-PO-PhPrp 引导物：AGO2 复合物的结构分析表明，苯基炔丙基取代基在芳香侧链簇 (Y529/F811/Y815) 内形成 π 堆积网络，而扩展的 5'-P 取代基则通过 ro 容纳。

title: Iridescent, Flexible, Hydrophobic Polymer Composite Films from Self-Assembled Cellulose Nanocrystals
abstract: Abstract Cellulose nanocrystals (CNCs) are known for their ability to form iridescent films with structural color via solidification of a chiral nematic liquid crystalline phase. However, the inherent brittleness and hydrophilicity of CNCs make them fragile and susceptible to moisture, limiting their versatility. To address these issues, an innovative strategy has been developed to overcome the incompatibility between hydrophilic CNCs and hydrophobic polycaprolactone (PCL), and a series of hydrophobic iridescent CNC-PCL composite films has been prepared. The soft PCL was homogenously entrapped in the chiral nematic CNC matrix through film swelling, solvent exchange, and ambient drying, while the photonic structure of the assembled CNCs was well retained. These composite materials are iridescent, flexible, and hydrophobic, making them promising candidates for waterproof photonic coatings. Furthermore, their structural color, flexibility, and hydrophobicity were readily adjusted by tuning the proportion of PCL in the CNC matrix. It is expected that this new strategy will open the door for future researchers to develop water-resistant and flexible photonic materials by blending photonic crystals and hydrophobic polymers, as well as expanding their application scenarios.
title_zh: 基于自组装纤维素纳米晶体的虹彩、柔性、疏水聚合物复合薄膜
abstract_zh: 摘要 纤维素纳米晶体（CNC）因其能够通过手性向列液晶相的凝固形成具有结构色的虹彩薄膜而闻名。然而，CNC 固有的脆性和亲水性使其易碎且容易受潮，从而限制了其多功能性。为了解决这些问题，我们开发了一种创新策略来克服亲水性CNC和疏水性聚己内酯（PCL）之间的不相容性，并制备了一系列疏水性虹彩CNC-PCL复合薄膜。通过薄膜溶胀、溶剂交换和环境干燥，软 PCL 被均匀地捕获在手性向列 CNC 矩阵中，同时组装好的 CNC 的光子结构得到了很好的保留。这些复合材料具有虹彩、柔性和疏水性，使其成为防水光子涂层的有希望的候选材料。此外，通过调整 CNC 矩阵中 PCL 的比例，可以轻松调整它们的结构颜色、柔韧性和疏水性。预计这一新策略将为未来研究人员通过混合光子晶体和疏水性聚合物来开发防水且柔性的光子材料并扩展其应用场景打开大门。

title: Temperature-Dependent Voltammetry Reveals the Potential-Dependent Formation of Reaction Species and Their Impact on Interfacial Excess Charge during the Ammonia Oxidation Reaction on Pt
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract The electrocatalytic ammonia oxidation reaction (AOR) has historically garnered significant interest, since ammonia could be used as a carbon-free fuel and convenient H2 carrier. Key challenges hindering its application are the high overpotentials and rapid catalyst poisoning, which remain poorly understood. Here, we study the overpotential-dependent formation of reaction species via temperature-dependent cyclic voltammetry and electrochemical Arrhenius analysis on polycrystalline Pt in conjunction with infrared spectroscopy. Further, we link the evolution of the kinetic parameters to the degree of polarization and excess charge via CO-displacement measurements. Strikingly, with increasing overpotential, we discover the parallel formation of a reaction species (not a direct intermediate) that modulates the electron chemical potential and, thus, the potential of zero charge. Due to this coupling, the parallel formation of this “poisoning” species appears to depolarize the surface with increasing overpotential. To recover the interfacial polarization, the overpotential needs to be increased further, before the activity can be restored and substantial Faradiac current can arise. What emerges is a new kinetic picture, where not only formation but also stabilization of interfacial excess charge are decisive for the catalyst activity. In general, the study demonstrates the utility of performing temperature-dependent cyclic voltammetry for revealing how transient changes in local chemicals modulate the overall inner-sphere kinetics.
title_zh: 温度依赖伏安法揭示Pt上氨氧化反应中反应物种的电位依赖性形成及其对界面过剩电荷的影响
abstract_zh: 摘要 电催化氨氧化反应（AOR）历来引起了人们的极大兴趣，因为氨可以用作无碳燃料和方便的氢气载体。阻碍其应用的主要挑战是高过电势和快速催化剂中毒，但人们对此仍知之甚少。在这里，我们通过温度依赖性循环伏安法和多晶 Pt 的电化学阿伦尼乌斯分析结合红外光谱研究了反应物种的过电势依赖性形成。此外，我们通过 CO 位移测量将动力学参数的演变与极化程度和过量电荷联系起来。引人注目的是，随着超电势的增加，我们发现了一种反应物质（不是直接中间体）的平行形成，它调节电子化学势，从而调节零电荷的电势。由于这种耦合，这种“中毒”物质的平行形成似乎随着过电势的增加而使表面去极化。为了恢复界面极化，需要进一步增加过电势，然后才能恢复活性并产生大量法拉第电流。出现的是一个新的动力学图，其中界面过量电荷的形成和稳定对于催化剂活性都具有决定性作用。总的来说，该研究证明了执行温度依赖性循环伏安法对于揭示局部化学物质的瞬态变化如何调节整体内球动力学的效用。

title: From Dehydrogenation to Derivatization: Functionalization of Alkanes and Alkyl Groups by Molecular Catalysis
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Alkane dehydrogenation has evolved from a fundamental organometallic challenge into a transformative technology for upgrading abundant hydrocarbon feedstocks and modifying complex molecules. This Perspective charts the evolution of modern alkane dehydrogenation, emphasizing the strategic divergence between well-established two-electron pathways and emerging radical-mediated reaction manifolds. For the dehydrogenation of structurally unbiased simple alkanes, research remains centered on noble-metal-based molecular catalysts, represented by pincer–transition-metal systems, where activity and regioselectivity are not only governed by catalysts’ first coordination sphere but also subtly affected by ligands’ scaffold. In contrast, for the dehydrogenation of hydrocarbons with electronically or thermodynamically differentiated C(sp3)–H bonds, a complementary paradigm has emerged in which reactivity is mainly dictated by the intrinsic properties of substrates. The interplay of bond dissociation energies (BDEs) and bond polarity can be harnessed by a diverse array of hydrogen atom transfer (HAT) reagents (or catalysts). We discuss how these two distinct mechanisms dictate the scope of both the dehydrogenation and dehydrogenation-triggered derivatization, which extends beyond small alkane functionalizations to controlled upcycling of macromolecular polyolefins. By analyzing the interplay between thermodynamic constraints, catalyst sustainability, and process integration, we outline a forward-looking roadmap for next-generation catalytic dehydrogenation systems.
title_zh: 从脱氢到衍生化：分子催化实现烷烃和烷基官能团化
abstract_zh: 摘要 烷烃脱氢已从一项基本的有机金属挑战发展成为一项用于升级丰富的碳氢化合物原料和改性复杂分子的革命性技术。本视角描绘了现代烷烃脱氢的演变，强调了成熟的双电子途径和新兴的自由基介导的反应流形之间的战略分歧。对于结构无偏的简单烷烃的脱氢，研究仍然集中在以钳过渡金属体系为代表的贵金属分子催化剂上，其中活性和区域选择性不仅受催化剂的第一配位球的控制，而且还受到配体支架的微妙影响。相比之下，对于具有电子或热力学差异的C(sp3)-H键的碳氢化合物的脱氢，出现了一种补充范式，其中反应性主要由底物的固有性质决定。键解离能 (BDE) 和键极性的相互作用可以通过多种氢原子转移 (HAT) 试剂（或催化剂）来利用。我们讨论这两种不同的机制如何决定脱氢和脱氢触发的衍生化的范围，其范围超出了小烷烃官能化，延伸到大分子聚烯烃的受控升级循环。通过分析热力学约束、催化剂可持续性和工艺集成之间的相互作用，我们概述了下一代催化脱氢系统的前瞻性路线图。

title: Biphasic Dip Coating for Versatile and Material-Efficient Nanoparticle Thin Films
abstract: Abstract Colloidal quantum dot (cQD) thin films are central to solution-processed optoelectronics, yet scalable deposition methods that preserve device performance while improving material utilization remain limited. Here, we adapt a biphasic meniscus dip coating strategy that enables controlled deposition of cQD films while substantially reducing the volume of active nanocrystal solution required. In this approach, a thin cQD layer is supported by an immiscible underlayer, such that film formation occurs exclusively at the liquid–air interface of the active phase. Using this geometry, we fabricate PbS quantum dot photodetectors with responsivities up to ∼1000 mA/W at 1200 nm, comparable to conventional spin-coated devices. Relative to spin coating, the biphasic configuration reduces active solution consumption by up to 20-fold while maintaining film quality and reproducible device performance. A mass-volume cost analysis shows that the reduced active reservoir shifts the economic viability of dip coating into thickness and throughput regimes more relevant to practical device fabrication. We further extend the method to CsPbBr3 nanocrystals and curved substrates, highlighting its generality across material systems and geometries. Together, these results establish biphasic dip coating as a material-efficient and device-compatible manufacturing strategy for solution-processed optoelectronics.
title_zh: 用于通用且节约材料的纳米粒子薄膜的双相浸渍涂膜法
abstract_zh: 摘要：胶体量子点 (cQD) 薄膜是溶液加工光电子学的核心，但在提高材料利用率的同时保持器件性能的可扩展沉积方法仍然有限。在这里，我们采用双相弯液面浸涂策略，能够控制 cQD 薄膜的沉积，同时大大减少所需的活性纳米晶体溶液的体积。在这种方法中，薄的 cQD 层由不混溶的底层支撑，这样薄膜的形成仅发生在活性相的液-气界面。利用这种几何结构，我们制造了 PbS 量子点光电探测器，其在 1200 nm 处的响应度高达 ∼1000 mA/W，与传统的旋涂器件相当。相对于旋涂，双相配置可将活性溶液消耗量减少多达 20 倍，同时保持薄膜质量和可重复的器件性能。质量体积成本分析表明，活性储层的减少将浸涂的经济可行性转变为与实际设备制造更相关的厚度和吞吐量状态。我们进一步将该方法扩展到 CsPbBr3 纳米晶体和弯曲基板，突出了其在材料系统和几何形状中的通用性。总之，这些结果将双相浸涂确立为溶液加工光电子产品的一种材料高效且设备兼容的制造策略。

title: Dynamic Actuatable Hydrogels for Integrated Environmental Sensing and Remediation Applications
abstract: Abstract Hydrogel-based adsorbents have emerged as versatile materials for environmental remediation and sensing owing to their tunable chemistries, hydrated networks, and compatibility with multifunctional nanomaterials. However, conventional static hydrogels remain constrained by diffusion-limited mass transport, slow adsorption kinetics, and limited integration of pollutant detection with remediation. This review highlights the emerging shift from passive adsorption toward dynamic and actuatable hydrogels as adaptive sense–respond–act material systems capable of accelerated pollutant capture, real-time monitoring, and autonomous regeneration. We first discuss static hydrogel design principles, including polymer composition, nanomaterial incorporation, and structural architectures that govern adsorption capacity, selectivity, kinetics, and reusability. We then examine dynamic hydrogel platforms, including intrinsically stimuli-responsive networks, extrinsically actuated composites, and shape-programmed architectures that actively enhance mass transport and interfacial exposure. Particular emphasis is placed on emerging systems that integrate sensing with decontamination, positioning actuatable hydrogels as adaptive environmental interfaces and soft robotic materials. A comparative discussion of static and dynamic systems evaluates their performance, practical limitations, and translational potential for water remediation, resource recovery, and integrated sensing technologies. Finally, challenges in scalability, stability, and system integration are critically assessed, and future directions are proposed toward autonomous, intelligent hydrogel platforms for next-generation environmental technologies.
title_zh: 用于集成环境传感与修复应用的动态驱动水凝胶
abstract_zh: 摘要：基于水凝胶的吸附剂由于其可调节的化学性质、水合网络以及与多功能纳米材料的兼容性，已成为环境修复和传感的多功能材料。然而，传统的静态水凝胶仍然受到扩散限制的质量传输、缓慢的吸附动力学以及污染物检测与修复的有限整合的限制。这篇综述强调了从被动吸附到动态可驱动水凝胶的转变，作为自适应感知-响应-行为材料系统，能够加速污染物捕获、实时监测和自主再生。我们首先讨论静态水凝胶设计原理，包括聚合物组成、纳米材料掺入以及控制吸附能力、选择性、动力学和可重复使用性的结构体系。然后，我们研究动态水凝胶平台，包括内在刺激响应网络、外在驱动复合材料和主动增强质量传输和界面暴露的形状编程结构。特别强调将传感与净化相结合的新兴系统，将可驱动水凝胶定位为自适应环境界面和软机器人材料。对静态和动态系统的比较讨论评估了它们的性能、实际局限性以及水修复、资源回收和集成传感技术的转化潜力。最后，对可扩展性、稳定性和系统集成方面的挑战进行了严格的评估，

title: Conformal Transfer Printing of PEDOT: PSS Patterns onto Structurally Complex Surfaces
abstract: Abstract Fabricating conductive circuits on complex curved surfaces remains a significant challenge for conformal electronics, particularly for soft and additively manufactured polymer substrates. We report a robust, conformal GOPS-assisted transfer-printing strategy for integrating inkjet-printed PEDOT:PSS patterns onto traditionally hard-to-print and non-planar surfaces. In this approach, conductive features are first defined on a planar polyimide donor substrate and subsequently transferred to the target substrate. The incorporation of (3-glycidyloxypropyl)trimethoxysilane (GOPS) into PEDOT:PSS facilitates strong covalent bonding, ensuring exceptional interfacial adhesion and structural integrity of transferred patterns. This transfer process is compatible with diverse non-planar substrates, including compliant PDMS, curved glass, and stereolithography (SLA)-printed resins. While direct printing on these substrates often suffers from poor wetting or non-planar surfaces, this transfer strategy yields continuous pathways that preserve the original morphology and electrical performance. Transferred films exhibited excellent stability, maintaining functionality through repetitive bending and aqueous immersion without delamination. As a demonstration, a functional organic electrochemical transistor (OECT) was fabricated on a curved 3D-printed substrate through a multi-step process, independently transferring electrodes and a semiconducting channel, and exhibited concentration-dependent responses to dopamine from 5 to 1000 nM. These results establish a versatile route for integrating printed conductive patterns and functional devices on complex polymer geometries.
title_zh: PEDOT: PSS图案向结构复杂表面的保形转印
abstract_zh: 摘要 在复杂的曲面上制造导电电路对于保形电子产品来说仍然是一个重大挑战，特别是对于软质和增材制造的聚合物基板。我们报告了一种强大的、保形的 GOPS 辅助转移印刷策略，用于将喷墨印刷的 PEDOT:PSS 图案集成到传统上难以印刷和非平面的表面上。在这种方法中，首先在平面聚酰亚胺供体基板上限定导电特征，然后将其转移到目标基板上。将(3-缩水甘油氧基丙基)三甲氧基硅烷 (GOPS) 纳入 PEDOT:PSS 中可促进牢固的共价键合，确保转印图案卓越的界面附着力和结构完整性。该转移工艺与多种非平面基材兼容，包括兼容的 PDMS、曲面玻璃和立体光刻 (SLA) 印刷树脂。虽然在这些基材上直接印刷通常会遇到润湿性差或非平面表面的问题，但这种转移策略产生的连续路径可以保留原始形态和电气性能。转移薄膜表现出优异的稳定性，通过重复弯曲和水浸保持功能而不会分层。作为演示，功能性有机电化学晶体管 (OECT) 通过多步工艺在弯曲 3D 打印基板上制造，独立转移电极和半导体通道，并对 5 至 1000 nM 的多巴胺表现出浓度依赖性响应。这些结果为国际化建立了一条通用途径

title: Manganese Carbonyl-Based Peroxidase-like Nanoenzyme Cascading with Glucose Oxidase, Combined with Porphyrin-COFs-Based Phototherapy and CO-Mediated Immunomodulation for Diabetic Wound Repair
abstract: Abstract Diabetic wounds remain a global health challenge due to vascular insufficiency, bacterial infection, and persistent inflammation. Herein, we designed and prepared a triple-synergistic nanoenzyme platform with antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and angiogenesis-promoting effects, which was formed by coloading a porphyrin covalent organic framework (Por-COF) with glucose oxidase (GOx) and manganese carbonyl (MnCO). Under near-infrared irradiation, Por-COFs produce a large number of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and localized hyperthermia. Simultaneously, GOx consumes the glucose in wounds to produce gluconic acid and H2O2, which trigger the decomposition of MnCO into immunomodulatory carbon monoxide (CO) and catalytically active Mn2+/3+ ions. The released Mn2+/3+ ions catalyze H2O2 to produce highly toxic •OH through peroxidase-like activity, enhancing bacterial elimination, while the produced CO improves M1-to-M2 macrophage polarization to resolve inflammation and suppresses heat-shock proteins to enhance PTT efficacy. This prepared nanoplatform (Por-COF@GOx/MnCO) achieved more than 99.99% antibacterial efficiency against Escherichia coli, Staphylococcus aureus, and methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus and accelerated wound healing by promoting angiogenesis, ROS scavenging, and immunomodulation. The designed triple-synergistic nanoplatform—integrating glucose oxidase cascading MnCO-based peroxidase-like activity, phototherapy, and CO immunomodulation—shows great potential as a therapeutic strategy for diabetic wound repair.
title_zh: 羰基锰类过氧化物酶纳米酶与葡萄糖氧化酶级联，结合基于卟啉-COFs的光疗和CO介导的免疫调节用于糖尿病伤口修复
abstract_zh: 摘要 由于血管功能不全、细菌感染和持续炎症，糖尿病伤口仍然是全球健康挑战。在此，我们设计并制备了具有抗菌、抗炎和促进血管生成作用的三重协同纳米酶平台，该平台由卟啉共价有机框架（Por-COF）与葡萄糖氧化酶（GOx）和羰基锰（MnCO）共负载而形成。在近红外照射下，Por-COFs产生大量活性氧（ROS）并产生局部高温。同时，GOx 消耗伤口中的葡萄糖产生葡萄糖酸和 H2O2，从而触发 MnCO 分解为免疫调节性一氧化碳 (CO) 和具有催化活性的 Mn2+/3+ 离子。释放的Mn2+/3+离子通过类过氧化物酶活性催化H2O2产生剧毒·OH，增强细菌消除，而产生的CO改善M1到M2巨噬细胞极化以解决炎症并抑制热休克蛋白以增强PTT功效。这种制备的纳米平台（Por-COF@GOx/MnCO）对大肠杆菌、金黄色葡萄球菌和耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌的抗菌效率达到99.99%以上，并通过促进血管生成、ROS清除和免疫调节来加速伤口愈合。设计的三重协同纳米平台——整合葡萄糖氧化酶级联基于MnCO的过氧化物酶样活性、光疗和CO免疫调节——显示出作为糖尿病伤口修复治疗策略的巨大潜力。

title: When Copper Falls: Overriding the Irving–Williams Stability Trend Through Outer-Sphere Hydrogen Bonding
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract The Irving–Williams series (Mn Zn) is a well-established thermodynamic stability trend among high-spin divalent first-row transition-metal complexes. However, complete isostructural Mn–Zn series are rare, and those that enable direct evaluation of a defined secondary coordination sphere are even rarer. As a result, whether outer-sphere noncovalent interactions can alter this periodic trend without changing the primary coordination environment has remained unresolved. Here, we present a complete isostructural octahedral series, (allLH)2MCl2 (M = Mn–Zn), supported by a flavin-derived bidentate ligand, allLH. An outer-sphere N–H···Cl hydrogen-bonding network provided by allLH locks all complexes into a single meridional isomer, enabling direct thermodynamic comparison across the row. In stark contrast to the classical Irving–Williams series, Cu(II) becomes the least stable species in the (allLH)2MCl2 series. Experimental and computational analyses show that this reversal arises from a finely balanced noncovalent constraint imposed by the rigid hydrogen-bonded scaffold. This scaffold retains the octahedral geometry of (allLH)2CuCl2 but only partially accommodates Jahn–Teller distortion, leaving the resulting stabilization insufficient to offset the accompanying attenuation of outer-sphere hydrogen-bond stabilization. This study demonstrates that a well-established metal-ion stability trend can be overcome by designing outer-sphere noncovalent interactions without altering the primary coordination environment.
title_zh: 当铜跌落时：通过外球氢键颠覆Irving–Williams稳定性趋势
abstract_zh: 摘要 欧文-威廉姆斯系列 (Mn Zn) 是高自旋二价第一排过渡金属配合物中公认的热力学稳定性趋势。然而，完整的同构 Mn-Zn 系列很少见，而那些能够直接评估确定的二级配位层的系列则更加罕见。因此，外层非共价相互作用是否可以在不改变主要配位环境的情况下改变这种周期性趋势仍然悬而未决。在这里，我们提出了一个完整的同构八面体系列，(allLH)2MCl2 (M = Mn-Zn)，由黄素衍生的二齿配体 allLH 支持。 allLH 提供的外球 N–H…Cl 氢键网络将所有配合物锁定为单一子午异构体，从而实现跨行的直接热力学比较。与经典的欧文-威廉姆斯系列形成鲜明对比，Cu(II) 成为 (allLH)2MCl2 系列中最不稳定的物质。实验和计算分析表明，这种逆转是由刚性氢键支架施加的精细平衡的非共价约束引起的。该支架保留了 (allLH)2CuCl2 的八面体几何形状，但仅部分适应 Jahn-Teller 畸变，导致所得的稳定性不足以抵消外球氢键稳定性的伴随衰减。这项研究表明，通过设计外层非共价相互作用，可以在不改变主要配位环境的情况下克服既定的金属离子稳定性趋势。

title: Sequence-defined Digital Bottlebrush Polymers for Programmable Oligonucleotide Delivery
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Oligonucleotide therapeutics hold transformative potential, yet their clinical translation is hindered by delivery barriers, including rapid renal/hepatic clearance and poor organ specificity. Bottlebrush polymer conjugates have emerged as a promising vector to address these limitations, but conventional architectures with uniform backbones can only achieve an unmodifiable, rigid biodistribution profile. Here, we report a library of sequence-defined “digital” bottlebrush polymers, precisely engineered with controlled placements of chemical motifs that modify physicochemical properties─including lipids, cholesterol, and cationic groups─along a polyphosphodiester backbone. Systematic evaluation of the digital bottlebrush polymer library reveals distinct structure–property relationships and enables organ-biased systemic delivery to several traditionally difficult-to-reach tissues, including muscle and skin. In a mouse model of rheumatoid arthritis, a single dose of a spleen-homing polymer-conjugated antisense oligonucleotide targeting TNF-α significantly reduced arthritis severity and preserved animal body weight. These findings establish a versatile design framework for tailoring bottlebrush polymers to specific therapeutic applications.
title_zh: 序列明确的数字瓶刷状聚合物用于可编程寡核苷酸递送
abstract_zh: 摘要 寡核苷酸疗法具有变革潜力，但其临床转化受到递送障碍的阻碍，包括快速的肾脏/肝脏清除和较差的器官特异性。 Bottlebrush 聚合物缀合物已成为解决这些限制的有前途的载体，但具有均匀主链的传统架构只能实现不可修改的、刚性的生物分布曲线。在这里，我们报告了一个序列定义的“数字”洗瓶刷聚合物库，通过精确设计化学基序的受控位置来改变理化性质（包括脂质、胆固醇和阳离子基团）沿着聚磷酸二酯主链。对数字洗瓶刷聚合物库的系统评估揭示了独特的结构-性能关系，并能够实现器官偏向的系统递送到几个传统上难以到达的组织，包括肌肉和皮肤。在类风湿性关节炎小鼠模型中，单剂靶向 TNF-α 的脾归巢聚合物缀合反义寡核苷酸可显着降低关节炎的严重程度并保持动物体重。这些发现建立了一个通用的设计框架，用于根据特定的治疗应用定制洗瓶刷聚合物。

title: Cobalt-Catalyzed, Aminoquinoline-Directed Functionalization of Nonactivated C(sp3)-H Bonds under Mild Conditions
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Second- and third-row transition metal catalysis in C(sp3)-H bond functionalization is well-established and is currently used in the synthesis of complex natural products, which can be considered the ultimate test of new synthetic methodologies. However, readily available and abundant first-row metals have been mostly employed in the functionalization of C(sp2)-H bonds. Their use in transformations of nonactivated (not benzylic or α to a heteroatom) C(sp3)-H bonds is rare and typically limited by the inability to functionalize secondary C–H bonds, high reaction temperatures, and the need to employ multiple equivalents of silver(I) oxidants. We report here a new approach to cobalt-catalyzed carbon–hydrogen bond functionalization by using a double-directing group strategy, enabling efficient activation of primary and secondary C(sp3)-H bonds under mild conditions to form β- or γ-lactams. Barium manganate is employed as an oxidant. Several Co(III) intermediates have been isolated and their reactivity is explored, supporting their involvement in the catalytic cycle. The reaction shows unusually high KIE kH/kD (>11) for C–H functionalization, allowing the use of deuterium as a blocking group, which enables amplified or switchable site selectivity. Mechanistic studies suggest a possible contribution of quantum tunneling in the C–H activation step.
title_zh: 温和条件下钴催化、氨基喹啉导向的非活化C(sp3)-H键官能化
abstract_zh: 摘要 C(sp3)-H键功能化中的第二列和第三列过渡金属催化已经成熟，目前用于复杂天然产物的合成，可以被认为是新合成方法的终极测试。然而，容易获得且丰富的第一行金属主要用于 C(sp2)-H 键的功能化。它们在非活化（不是苄基或α到杂原子）C(sp3)-H键的转化中的应用很少，并且通常受到无法功能化二级C-H键、高反应温度以及需要使用多当量银(I)氧化剂的限制。我们在这里报告了一种钴催化碳氢键功能化的新方法，通过使用双导向基团策略，能够在温和条件下有效激活伯和仲C(sp3)-H键以形成β-或γ-内酰胺。使用锰酸钡作为氧化剂。几种 Co(III) 中间体已被分离出来，并探索了它们的反应性，支持它们参与催化循环。该反应显示出异常高的 C–H 官能化 KIE kH/kD (>11)，允许使用氘作为封闭基团，从而实现放大或可切换的位点选择性。机理研究表明量子隧道效应可能在 C-H 激活步骤中发挥作用。

title: Maximizing the Magnetic Anisotropy of Dy Complexes by Fine-Tuning Organic Ligands: A Systematic Multireference High-Throughput Exploration of over 25k Molecules
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract The design of the coordination environment of magnetic ions is key to achieving properties such as large magnetic anisotropy and slow magnetic relaxation, but a systematic exploration of the relevant chemical space for these compounds is missing. Here, we automatically extract all entries of mononuclear Dy coordination complexes from crystallographic databases and use multireference ab initio methods to compute their magnetic anisotropy. In addition, we generate and simulate magnetic anisotropy for 25k new molecules with the general formula [Dy(H2O)5L2]n+ and pentagonal bipyramidal coordination geometry, a motif selected as very promising for its properties and for imparting synthetic realism to the generated compounds. While the screening of crystallography databases allows for correlations between electronic structure and coordination geometry to naturally emerge, molecules with crystal field splittings over 1600 cm–1 are identified by systematically exploring new organic ligands. This corresponds to a ∼100% increase of magnetic anisotropy over the reference compound with L = tBuPO(NHiPr)2, ∼40% over any known pentagonal bipyramidal Dy complex, and approaching the values of dysprosocenium. The systematic study presented in this work demonstrates the very large extent to which the fine-tuning of Dy’s second coordination sphere by organic ligands can affect magnetic anisotropy, and that automated high-throughput screening is capable of identifying chemical motifs statistically able to maximize such a property, therefore paving the way to the rational and automated design of magnetic molecules beyond established first coordination shell considerations.
title_zh: 通过精细调节有机配体最大化Dy配合物的磁各向异性：对超过2.5万个分子的系统性多参考高通量探索
abstract_zh: 摘要 磁性离子配位环境的设计是实现大磁各向异性和慢磁弛豫等性能的关键，但缺乏对这些化合物相关化学空间的系统探索。在这里，我们自动从晶体学数据库中提取单核 Dy 配位配合物的所有条目，并使用多参考从头计算方法来计算其磁各向异性。此外，我们还生成并模拟了 25k 个具有通式 [Dy(H2O)5L2]n+ 和五角双锥配位几何形状的新分子的磁各向异性，该图案因其特性和赋予生成的化合物赋予合成真实性而被选为非常有前途的图案。虽然晶体学数据库的筛选允许自然出现电子结构和配位几何之间的相关性，但通过系统地探索新的有机配体，可以识别晶体场分裂超过 1600 cm-1 的分子。这对应于磁各向异性比 L = tBuPO(NHiPr)2 的参考化合物增加约 100%，比任何已知的五角双锥 Dy 络合物增加约 40%，并接近镝的值。这项工作中提出的系统研究表明，有机配体对 Dy 的第二配位层的微调可以在很大程度上影响磁各向异性，并且自动化高通量筛选能够识别化学基序，统计上能够最大化这种特性，从而为合理和自动化的磁各向异性铺平了道路。

title: Deciphering Electrocatalytic Sulfur Reduction Reactions in Al–S Batteries via Single-Particle Electrodes
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract The kinetically sluggish sulfur reduction reaction (SRR) governs the performance of ultrahigh-capacity aluminum–sulfur batteries, while deciphering the SRR process is critical for rationally electrocatalyzing reaction kinetics to unlock their full energy output. To overcome this challenge, a single-particle electrochemical methodology has been developed to investigate the SRR process on a cobalt/nickel and nitrogen codoped graphene (CoNi-NG) electrocatalyst. The SRR process involves a major route of S8 → Al2S8 → Al2S4 → Al2S3 with a minor route of Al2S8 → Al2S6 → Al2S4, where Al2S4 conversion governs the overall SRR kinetics and Al2S4 contributes the most to the shuttle effect owing to its fastest generation and slowest consumption. The CoNi-NG raises the Co d-orbital energy level via Ni-to-Co electron transfer to accelerate cleavage of polysulfides, which doubles the exchange current density of rate-determining Al2S4 conversion. Consequently, the sulfur composite (S@CoNi-NG) electrode delivers a specific capacity of ∼1480 mAh gsulfur–1. Such a single-particle methodology for quantitatively deciphering electrocatalytic SRRs offers mechanistic guidance for rationally enhancing battery performance.
title_zh: 通过单颗粒电极解析Al–S电池中的电催化硫还原反应
abstract_zh: 摘要 动力学缓慢的硫还原反应（SRR）控制着超高容量铝硫电池的性能，而破译SRR过程对于合理地电催化反应动力学以释放其全部能量输出至关重要。为了克服这一挑战，开发了一种单颗粒电化学方法来研究钴/镍和氮共掺杂石墨烯（CoNi-NG）电催化剂上的 SRR 过程。 SRR过程涉及S8→Al2S8→Al2S4→Al2S3的主要路线和Al2S8→Al2S6→Al2S4的次要路线，其中Al2S4转化控制整个SRR动力学，而Al2S4由于其最快的生成和最慢的消耗而对穿梭效应贡献最大。 CoNi-NG 通过 Ni-to-Co 电子转移提高 Co d 轨道能级，以加速多硫化物的裂解，从而使决定速率的 Al2S4 转化的交换电流密度加倍。因此，硫复合材料（S@CoNi-NG）电极的比容量为~1480 mAh gsulfur-1。这种用于定量解读电催化 SRR 的单粒子方法为合理增强电池性能提供了机械指导。

title: Beyond Funnel-Style High-Throughput Screening: An Expert-Guided Multi-Scale Nexus for Polynary Perovskite Electrocatalyst Exploration
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society

title_zh: 超越漏斗式高通量筛选：面向多元钙钛矿电催化剂探索的专家引导多尺度关联平台
abstract_zh: 摘要：传统上，探索多元氧化物电催化剂的广阔组成景观受到漏斗式筛选范例的限制，该范例将高保真数据视为二元门而不是信息丰富的训练信号。在这里，我们提出了一个专家指导的 Pr-Sr-Co-Fe 钙钛矿多尺度框架。通过集成原子描述符、实验结构特征和机制通知的电子特征，该框架解决了描述符可访问的多元钙钛矿空间中的这些限制。通过实施“最近网格插值”策略，高保真密度泛函理论计算的计算成本在搜索空间内降低了近2个数量级。两轮主动学习大幅提高了高性能候选者的发现效率（η@10 mA cm–2

title: Oxoisoaporphine Half-Sandwich Osmium(II) Derivative: A Catalytic Trigger for Innate Tumor Chemoimmunotherapy
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Chemoimmunotherapy, particularly strategies that induce a tumor specific antitumor immune response, has emerged as a promising approach to improved cancer treatment. Nonetheless, only a limited number of drugs can successfully stimulate an antitumor immune response in vivo. Recent studies have highlighted the potential of metal-based anticancer agents in chemoimmunotherapy. Herein, we report a half-sandwich osmium(II) complex, Os-1, which acts as a catalyst for H2O2 generation through autocatalytic hydride transfer from coenzyme NADH to oxygen. Sustained H2O2 self-supply generation disrupts tumor redox homeostasis and induces DNA damage, leading to the activation of the cGAS-STING signaling pathway. Os-1 demonstrates potent cytotoxicity in vitro and elicits a robust antitumor immune response in vivo. Furthermore, Os-1 exhibits a synergistic antitumor growth effect when combined with a PD-1 inhibitor. To the best of our knowledge, this study is the first to describe the rational design of a small-molecule metal catalyst that provides for the in situ generation of H2O2 in cancer cells, thus overcoming the exogenous-additive bottleneck of oxidative therapy. This self-sufficient system not only promotes oxidative damage but also activates the cGAS-STING pathway, thereby integrating synergistically oxidative and immunotherapeutic actions.
title_zh: 氧代异阿扑菲因半夹心锇(II)衍生物：内在肿瘤化学免疫治疗的催化触发器
abstract_zh: 摘要化学免疫疗法，特别是诱导肿瘤特异性抗肿瘤免疫反应的策略，已成为改善癌症治疗的一种有前景的方法。尽管如此，只有有限数量的药物可以成功地刺激体内抗肿瘤免疫反应。最近的研究强调了金属抗癌剂在化学免疫疗法中的潜力。在此，我们报道了一种半夹心锇(II)络合物Os-1，它通过自催化氢化物从辅酶NADH转移到氧气来充当H2O2生成的催化剂。持续的 H2O2 自给生成会破坏肿瘤氧化还原稳态并诱导 DNA 损伤，从而激活 cGAS-STING 信号通路。 Os-1 在体外表现出强大的细胞毒性，并在体内引发强大的抗肿瘤免疫反应。此外，Os-1 与 PD-1 抑制剂联合使用时表现出协同抗肿瘤生长作用。据我们所知，这项研究首次描述了小分子金属催化剂的合理设计，该催化剂可在癌细胞中原位产生H2O2，从而克服氧化疗法的外源添加剂瓶颈。这种自给自足的系统不仅促进氧化损伤，还激活 cGAS-STING 通路，从而整合协同氧化和免疫治疗作用。

title: Modular Platform for Directing-Group-Free Radical Dicarbofunctionalization of Unactivated Alkenes via Dual Nickel/Energy-Transfer Catalysis
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Multicomponent cross-coupling reactions of alkenes offer a powerful strategy for constructing three-dimensional, sp3 -rich molecular architectures, a key objective in modern medicinal chemistry. However, the regioselective dicarbofunctionalization of unactivated alkenes without the use of directing groups remains a significant challenge. Herein, we report a visible-light-induced, Ni-catalyzed platform that enables the radical 1,2-dicarbofunctionalization of unactivated alkenes using diverse alkyl radical precursors and aryl, vinyl, acyl, alkynyl, and alkyl coupling partners. Mechanistic studies support a catalytic cycle in which multiple electron donor–acceptor (EDA) complexes mediate radical generation, atom-transfer radical addition (ATRA), and cross-electrophile coupling (XEC) or bimolecular homolytic substitution (SH2) processes. Additionally, preferential formation of a complex between the Ni catalyst and the radical precursor suppresses undesired homocoupling of the electrophilic partner. Notably, delivery of gaseous radical precursors such as trifluoromethyl iodide (TFMI) from the robust metal–organic framework (MOF) Al(OH)fum (fum– = fumarate) or Al–fum offers advantages in terms of both operational safety and reaction efficiency, and the MOF further boosts the yields of reactions by decreasing the concentration of free amine (employed for radical generation) in solution. Collectively, this flexible, directing-group-free approach establishes a general platform for the rapid construction of structurally complex and pharmaceutically relevant molecules from readily available precursors.
title_zh: 通过双镍/能量转移催化实现未活化烯烃无导向基自由基双碳官能化的模块化平台
abstract_zh: 摘要 烯烃的多组分交叉偶联反应为构建三维、富含 sp3 的分子结构提供了强大的策略，这是现代药物化学的一个关键目标。然而，在不使用导向基团的情况下对未活化的烯烃进行区域选择性二碳官能化仍然是一个重大挑战。在此，我们报告了一种可见光诱导的镍催化平台，该平台能够使用不同的烷基自由基前体和芳基、乙烯基、酰基、炔基和烷基偶联伙伴对未活化的烯烃进行自由基 1,2-二碳官能化。机理研究支持催化循环，其中多个电子供体-受体（EDA）复合物介导自由基生成、原子转移自由基加成（ATRA）和交叉亲电子偶联（XEC）或双分子均裂取代（SH2）过程。此外，Ni催化剂和自由基前体之间优先形成络合物抑制了不期望的亲电子配偶体的自偶联。值得注意的是，从坚固的金属有机骨架（MOF）Al(OH)fum（fum–=富马酸盐）或Al-fum输送气态自由基前体，例如三氟甲基碘（TFMI），在操作安全性和反应效率方面具有优势，并且MOF通过降低溶液中游离胺（用于自由基生成）的浓度进一步提高反应产率。总的来说，这种灵活的、无导向基团的方法为快速构建结构复杂且药物相关的分子建立了一个通用平台。

title: Dual-Site Engineering Unlocks Spin Modulation and Local Field-Controlled Charge Switching in Triangulenes
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Open-shell nanographenes, featuring highly tunable and correlated magnetic states, constitute a promising platform for engineering graphene nanomagnets towards molecular-scale spintronics and quantum information technologies. However, their magnetic states are largely dictated by topological constraints and strong electronic correlations, limiting independent control of spin and charge degrees of freedom. Here, we introduce a structural dual-site engineering strategy that integrates intrinsic spin modulation with adsorption- and field-controlled charge state tuning in a single magnetic nanographene, enabling a level of multifunctional control not previously demonstrated. We design and synthesize nitrogen, sulfur-co-engineered [3]triangulene (N,S-Tri), incorporating a central nitrogen dopant and an edge sulfur substitution with complementary functions. The central nitrogen modifies the occupation of the frontier π states and thereby tunes the molecular spin configuration, while the edge sulfur site weakly participates in the low-energy π-state and simultaneously acts as a tunable chemical anchor that regulates molecule–substrate coupling and charge transfer. Using low-temperature scanning probe microscopy, we directly visualize switching from neutral to cationic states, driven by adsorption-site variation on Au(111), or reversible switching by local electrostatic gating. This dual-functional design moves beyond static doping or interface charge transfer in graphene nanomagnets, enabling field-controlled dynamic modulation of spin and charge states, and opening new opportunities for device-oriented applications where molecule–electrode interactions and electrostatic field control play central roles.
title_zh: 双位点工程解锁三角烯的自旋调制与局域场调控的电荷开关
abstract_zh: 摘要 开壳纳米石墨烯具有高度可调和相关的磁态，为将石墨烯纳米磁体工程化以实现分子级自旋电子学和量子信息技术提供了一个有前途的平台。然而，它们的磁态很大程度上取决于拓扑约束和强电子相关性，限制了对自旋和电荷自由度的独立控制。在这里，我们引入了一种结构双位点工程策略，该策略将本征自旋调制与单个磁性纳米石墨烯中的吸附和场控电荷状态调谐集成在一起，从而实现了先前未证实的多功能控制水平。我们设计并合成了氮、硫协同设计的[3]三角烯（N,S-Tri），其中包含具有互补功能的中心氮掺杂剂和边缘硫取代。中心氮改变了前沿π态的占据，从而调节分子自旋构型，而边缘硫位点微弱地参与低能π态，同时充当调节分子-底物耦合和电荷转移的可调节化学锚。使用低温扫描探针显微镜，我们直接可视化由 Au(111) 吸附位点变化驱动的中性态到阳离子态的切换，或通过局部静电门控的可逆切换。这种双功能设计超越了石墨烯纳米磁体中的静态掺杂或界面电荷转移，实现了自旋和电荷状态的场控动态调制，并开辟了新的领域。

title: A Host–Guest Strategy to Achieve Selective and Robust CO2-to-CO Electrocatalysis in Aqueous Media
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Heterogeneous materials incorporating molecular catalysts hold strong promise for efficient electrocatalytic CO2 reduction to value-added products. While activity and selectivity are traditionally tuned through ligand design, increasing attention is being paid to the second-coordination sphere, which modulates reactivity beyond the metal center. Inspired by enzymatic systems, this outer-sphere environment enhances catalysis through spatial confinement and noncovalent interactions. Here, we report a host–guest strategy to control CO2 reduction using the [bpyMn(CO)3MeCN]+ catalyst encapsulated in an anionic cage. When immobilized on an electrode surface, the assembly selectively produces CO. Mechanistic studies indicate that the cage promotes proton-coupled CO2 binding while preventing catalyst deactivation. This demonstrates that supramolecular second-sphere engineering is a powerful strategy for enhancing electrocatalytic performance and provides a basis for future developments in molecular electrocatalysts.
title_zh: 主客体策略实现水相介质中高选择性且稳健的CO2到CO电催化
abstract_zh: 摘要 结合分子催化剂的异质材料对于高效电催化二氧化碳还原为增值产品具有广阔的前景。虽然活性和选择性传统上是通过配体设计来调节的，但人们越来越关注第二配位球，它调节金属中心以外的反应性。受酶系统的启发，这种外球环境通过空间限制和非共价相互作用增强催化作用。在这里，我们报告了一种主客体策略，使用封装在阴离子笼中的 [bpyMn(CO)3MeCN]+ 催化剂来控制 CO2 还原。当固定在电极表面上时，该组件选择性地产生 CO。机理研究表明，笼子促进质子耦合 CO2 结合，同时防止催化剂失活。这表明超分子第二球体工程是增强电催化性能的有力策略，并为分子电催化剂的未来发展奠定了基础。

title: Atomically Precise Pt19: The Largest All-Organic Ligand–Protected Platinum Nanocluster with Enhanced Stability and Electrocatalytic Activity
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Versatile organic ligands can notably enhance the stability and tunability of metal nanoclusters (NCs), and, consequently, all-organic ligand–protected metal nanoclusters have recently attracted widespread attention. Platinum (Pt) remains an indispensable metal in various fields, particularly in catalysis and cancer therapeutics. However, all-organic ligand–protected Pt nanoclusters are rarely reported due to substantial synthesis challenges, which have hindered progress in Pt nanocluster research and their practical applications. Herein, we report the successful synthesis of the largest all-organic ligand–protected Pt nanocluster to date, [Pt19(NapNC)27][PF6]2 (abbreviated as Pt19; NapNC: isocyanonaphthalene), achieved through the development of a ligand-exchange method. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction (SC-XRD) revealed a face-centered cubic (FCC), nonequivalent structure that has not been previously documented for all-organic ligand–protected Pt nanoclusters. Compared with its partially organic parent nanoclusters, this novel nanocluster exhibits considerably enhanced stability in both the ground and excited states. Furthermore, the Pt19 nanocluster demonstrates superior activity in the electrocatalytic methanol oxidation reaction (MOR) relative to its parent nanoclusters and commercial Pt/C. Based on its well-defined structure, we gained deep insights into the exceptional MOR activity of Pt19 and revealed, for the first time, the steric and electronic preferences of the active sites for electrocatalytic MOR.
title_zh: 原子级精确的Pt19：具有增强稳定性与电催化活性的最大全有机配体保护铂纳米团簇
abstract_zh: 摘要 多功能有机配体可以显着提高金属纳米团簇（NC）的稳定性和可调性，因此，全有机配体保护的金属纳米团簇最近引起了广泛的关注。铂（Pt）仍然是各个领域不可或缺的金属，特别是在催化和癌症治疗领域。然而，由于合成上的巨大挑战，全有机配体保护的Pt纳米团簇很少被报道，这阻碍了Pt纳米团簇研究及其实际应用的进展。在此，我们报告了通过配体交换方法的开发，成功合成了迄今为止最大的全有机配体保护的Pt纳米团簇[Pt19(NapNC)27][PF6]2（缩写为Pt19；NapNC：异氰萘）。单晶 X 射线衍射 (SC-XRD) 揭示了面心立方 (FCC) 的非等效结构，这种结构以前从未有过全有机配体保护的 Pt 纳米团簇的记录。与其部分有机母体纳米团簇相比，这种新型纳米团簇在基态和激发态下均表现出显着增强的稳定性。此外，相对于其母体纳米团簇和商业 Pt/C，Pt19 纳米团簇在电催化甲醇氧化反应 (MOR) 中表现出优异的活性。基于其明确的结构，我们深入了解了 Pt19 卓越的 MOR 活性，并首次揭示了电催化 MOR 活性位点的空间和电子偏好。

title: Homogeneous Iron Porphyrin as a Molecular CO Shuttle Enables Electrochemical Multicarbon Product Formation from CO2
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Abstract Homogeneous molecular catalysts for electrochemical CO2 reduction are generally limited to two-electron-reduced C1 products, primarily CO. Here we propose and demonstrate a fundamentally distinct role for molecular catalysts: as reversible CO shuttles that enhance the local CO activity at the electrical double layer. Using a water-soluble iron porphyrin as a CO shuttle, we observe the formation of isotopically verified C1–C4 hydrocarbons from CO2 in aqueous electrolyte. These products are not observed even in CO-saturated electrolyte in the absence of the iron porphyrin, indicating that the shuttle enhances local CO activity at the electrode surface beyond what bulk saturation can provide. Electrochemical and spectroscopic data support the formation of a stable FeII–CO species outside the compact layer, which releases CO upon further reduction at the electrode surface, consistent with an electrochemically gated shuttle mechanism. These findings suggest a potential design principle in which homogeneous catalysts function as molecular intermediate shuttles at the electrode surface and provide an alternative framework for interpreting beyond-CO products observed in heterogenized molecular catalyst systems.
title_zh: 均相铁卟啉作为分子CO穿梭载体实现CO2电化学多碳产物生成
abstract_zh: 摘要 用于电化学 CO2 还原的均相分子催化剂通常仅限于双电子还原的 C1 产物，主要是 CO。在这里，我们提出并证明了分子催化剂的一个根本不同的作用：作为可逆的 CO 穿梭，增强双电层的局部 CO 活性。使用水溶性铁卟啉作为 CO 穿梭，我们观察到在水性电解质中由 CO2 形成经过同位素验证的 C1-C4 碳氢化合物。即使在不存在铁卟啉的 CO 饱和电解质中也观察不到这些产物，这表明穿梭增强了电极表面的局部 CO 活性，超出了本体饱和所能提供的范围。电化学和光谱数据支持在致密层外形成稳定的 FeII-CO 物质，其在电极表面进一步还原时释放 CO，这与电化学门控穿梭机制一致。这些发现提出了一种潜在的设计原理，即均相催化剂在电极表面充当分子中间体穿梭机，并为解释在多相分子催化剂系统中观察到的超越CO产物提供了替代框架。

title: Oxygen Serves as an Electron Acceptor for Efficient Photocatalytic Acetylene Hydrochlorination in Seawater
abstract: ABSTRACT The photocatalytic acetylene hydrochlorination with H 2 O as hydrogen source and Cl – as chlorine source in seawater is a highly promising alternative to traditional thermocatalytic acetylene hydrochlorination, but seriously suffers from poor performance due to the rapid recombination of photogenerated electrons and holes as well as the sluggish redox kinetics caused by low H + and Cl – concentrations. Here, we report an O 2 ‐accelerated photocatalytic acetylene hydrochlorination in seawater, where the O 2 serves as an efficient electron acceptor for rapidly consuming photo‐generated electrons. Consequently, the as‐fabricated tubular carbon nitride photocatalyst (MTA‐C 3 N 4 ) delivers a substantially enhanced vinyl chloride monomer (VCM) production rate of 567.0 µmol g cat −1 h −1 under 420 nm light‐emitting diode (LED) irradiation in simulated seawater with O 2 , which is ∼66‐fold higher than that without O 2 . Even in natural seawater, the MTA‐C 3 N 4 maintains a stable VCM production rate of 433.3 µmol g cat −1 h −1 over 10 days. Mechanistic studies reveal that O 2 acts as an electron acceptor to suppress charge recombination and promote the formation of holes, thereby accelerating the hole‐driven chloride oxidation kinetics to generate *Cl for selective acetylene hydrochlorination. This work not only reveals the vital role of molecular oxygen in photoredox kinetics, but also provides an appealing strategy for enhancing photocatalytic performance.
title_zh: 氧气作为电子受体实现海水中高效光催化乙炔氢氯化反应
abstract_zh: 摘要 以H 2 O为氢源、Cl - 为海水中氯源的光催化乙炔氢氯化反应是传统热催化乙炔氢氯化反应的一种非常有前景的替代方案，但由于光生电子和空穴的快速复合以及低H + 和Cl - 浓度导致的氧化还原动力学缓慢，其性能严重不佳。在这里，我们报道了海水中 O 2 加速的光催化乙炔氢氯化反应，其中 O 2 作为有效的电子受体，快速消耗光生电子。因此，在含有 O 2 的模拟海水中，在 420 nm 发光二极管（LED）照射下，所制成的管状氮化碳光催化剂（MTA-C 3 N 4 ）显着提高了氯乙烯单体（VCM）的产率，达到 567.0 µmol g cat -1 h -1 ，比不含 O 2 的海水高约 66 倍。即使在天然海水中，MTA-C 3 N 4 也能在 10 天内保持稳定的 VCM 生产率 433.3 µmol g cat -1 h -1 。机理研究表明，O 2 作为电子受体抑制电荷复合并促进空穴的形成，从而加速空穴驱动的氯化物氧化动力学，生成用于选择性乙炔氢氯化的*Cl。这项工作不仅揭示了分子氧在光氧化还原动力学中的重要作用，而且为增强光催化性能提供了一种有吸引力的策略。

title: Two-Step Access to High-Energy Materials via Intrinsic Fuel–Oxidizer Design
abstract: Abstract The development of advanced energetic materials that balance high performance with synthetic accessibility remains a formidable challenge in aerospace and defense applications. Here, we report a simple two-step synthetic strategy to access two distinct yet complementary energetic platforms, a solvent-free sodium-based energetic framework (3) and a hydrazinium-based hypergolic salt (4), from a common precursor. This design leverages an intrinsic fuel–oxidizer motif, integrating gem-dinitro oxidizing units with hydrazine-based fuel fragments to achieve internal redox balance and enhanced energetic output. Compound 3 exhibits a high density of 1.83 g cm–3 and good thermal stability (182 °C), while compound 4 delivers good detonation performance (VOD = 8831 m s–1, DP = 31.8 GPa) together with remarkable hypergolic activity toward white fuming nitric acid, achieving an ignition delay of only 18 ms. Hirshfeld surface analysis further reveals that the solid-state architecture of 4 is stabilized by an extensive hydrogen-bonding network, with O–H interactions contributing 70% of the surface contacts, highlighting the role of directed intermolecular packing in its energetic behavior. This work establishes a cost-effective design paradigm that reconciles synthetic simplicity with high-performance energetic metrics, providing a versatile platform for next-generation ignition-responsive energetic materials.
title_zh: 通过内在燃料-氧化剂设计两步法制备高能材料
abstract_zh: 摘要 平衡高性能与合成可及性的先进含能材料的开发仍然是航空航天和国防应用中的巨大挑战。在这里，我们报告了一种简单的两步合成策略，可以从共同的前体获得两个不同但互补的能量平台，即无溶剂的钠基能量框架（3）和肼基自燃盐（4）。该设计利用固有的燃料-氧化剂主题，将偕二硝基氧化单元与肼基燃料碎片相结合，以实现内部氧化还原平衡并增强能量输出。化合物 3 具有 1.83 g cm–3 的高密度和良好的热稳定性 (182 °C)，而化合物 4 具有良好的爆轰性能（VOD = 8831 m s–1，DP = 31.8 GPa）以及对白发烟硝酸的显着自燃活性，实现了仅 18 ms 的点火延迟。 Hirshfeld 表面分析进一步揭示了 4 的固态结构通过广泛的氢键网络稳定，其中 O-H 相互作用贡献了 70% 的表面接触，突出了定向分子间堆积在其能量行为中的作用。这项工作建立了一种具有成本效益的设计范例，将合成简单性与高性能能量指标相协调，为下一代点火响应能量材料提供了一个多功能平台。

title: Stabilizing Perovskite/Electrode Interface With Tailored 2D/1D Stacking Layer
abstract: ABSTRACT Metal halide perovskite (MHP) single crystals are promising for optoelectronic applications, yet their surfaces suffer from severe ion migration‐related degradation. Herein, a 2D/1D stacking layer is explored to stabilize the crystal/electrode interface. In addition to providing a dense barrier layer, the inserted 2D perovskites can modulate the microscopic morphology and coverage ratio of the overlying 1D perovskite layer. Through tailoring the 2D/1D stacking layer, interface iodide migration is suppressed markedly, extending the T 90 lifetime of single‐crystal perovskite solar cells (PSCs) from 450 h to 2500 h, which significantly exceeds previously reported values. Besides, the reverse‐bias‐induced performance decay can be recovered substantially, indicating effective hindrance of irreversible iodide ion migration across the perovskite/electrode interface. Finally, the surface iodide vacancies and nonradiative recombination loss are mitigated, increasing the power conversion efficiency (PCE) from 23.2% to 25.5%, which is among the highest value for single‐crystal PSCs. Since interface ion migration is a universal issue for both polycrystalline films and single crystals, our strategy is instructive for optimizing diverse perovskite optoelectronic devices.
title_zh: 利用定制化的2D/1D堆叠层稳定钙钛矿/电极界面
abstract_zh: 摘要金属卤化物钙钛矿（MHP）单晶在光电应用方面很有前景，但其表面遭受严重的离子迁移相关退化。在此，探索了 2D/1D 堆叠层来稳定晶体/电极界面。除了提供致密的阻挡层之外，插入的二维钙钛矿还可以调节上面的一维钙钛矿层的微观形态和覆盖率。通过定制2D/1D堆叠层，界面碘化物迁移被显着抑制，将单晶钙钛矿太阳能电池（PSC）的T 90 寿命从450小时延长至2500小时，大大超过了之前报道的值。此外，反向偏压引起的性能衰减可以显着恢复，表明有效阻碍了不可逆碘离子在钙钛矿/电极界面上的迁移。最后，表面碘化物空位和非辐射复合损失得到缓解，功率转换效率（PCE）从23.2%提高到25.5%，这是单晶PSC的最高值之​​一。由于界面离子迁移是多晶薄膜和单晶的普遍问题，因此我们的策略对于优化各种钙钛矿光电器件具有指导意义。

title: Psilocybin prevents chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy through mitochondrial trafficking preservation
abstract: Chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy (CIPN) is a disabling, often irreversible toxicity that affects millions of patients, limits life-saving cancer therapy, and lacks proven treatment. In this work, we show that as little as two doses of psilocybin before chemotherapy durably prevented the onset of CIPN across platinum- and taxane-based models, including repeated chemotherapy cycles, without impairing antitumor efficacy. Peripherally, psilocybin maintained tactile sensitivity and intraepidermal nerve fiber endings through axonal mitochondrial trafficking and distribution preservation, through the TrkB-Akt-PAK5-MAP2-KIF5B pathway and remobilization of syntaphilin-anchored mitochondria. Centrally, it normalized medial prefrontal cortical synaptic activity and cortical alpha and beta electroencephalography power. This stabilization of peripheral axonal energy balance establishes psilocybin as a first-in-class prophylactic agent for CIPN while also preserving central neural function. Given psilocybin’s established safety, these discoveries support clinical evaluation as a strategy to prevent CIPN.
title_zh: 赛洛西宾通过保护线粒体运输防止化疗引起的周围神经病变
abstract_zh: 化疗引起的周围神经病变 (CIPN) 是一种致残且通常不可逆的毒性，影响数百万患者，限制挽救生命的癌症治疗，并且缺乏经过验证的治疗方法。在这项工作中，我们表明，在基于铂类和紫杉烷的模型中，化疗前只需服用两剂裸盖菇素即可持久预防 CIPN 的发作，包括重复化疗周期，而不会损害抗肿瘤功效。在外周，裸盖菇素通过轴突线粒体运输和分布保存、TrkB-Akt-PAK5-MAP2-KIF5B 通路和亲合蛋白锚定线粒体的再动员来维持触觉敏感性和表皮内神经纤维末梢。其核心是使内侧前额皮质突触活动以及皮质α和β脑电图能力正常化。这种外周轴突能量平衡的稳定使裸盖菇素成为 CIPN 的一流预防剂，同时还能保留中枢神经功能。鉴于裸盖菇素已确定的安全性，这些发现支持将临床评估作为预防 CIPN 的策略。

title: Early-life colonization with Clostridioides difficile remodels the developing gut
abstract: Clostridioides difficile causes severe disease in adults but commonly colonizes infants asymptomatically. The consequences of early-life colonization on host development remain unknown. In a neonatal mouse model, C. difficile colonization drove proinflammatory and tissue repair responses in the intestinal epithelium, enriching injury-associated intestinal stem cell populations and skewing differentiation toward secretory lineages. Despite transient colonization, exposure to C. difficile early in life led to persistent changes into adulthood. Epithelial responses were toxin dependent, as colonization with nontoxigenic strains or maternal vaccination with a C. difficile –targeted messenger RNA–lipid nanoparticle vaccine protected neonates. Human infant intestinal epithelial cells were sensitive to C. difficile toxins, and biopsies from colonized infants exhibited altered intestinal stem cell behavior. This study redefines C. difficile as an underappreciated early-life pathogen with lasting effects on host development.
title_zh: 生命早期艰难梭菌定植重塑发育中的肠道
abstract_zh: 艰难梭菌会在成人中引起严重疾病，但通常在无症状的情况下定植于婴儿。生命早期定植对宿主发育的影响仍然未知。在新生小鼠模型中，艰难梭菌定植促进了肠上皮的促炎和组织修复反应，丰富了损伤相关的肠干细胞群，并使分化偏向分泌谱系。尽管有短暂的定植，但生命早期接触艰难梭菌会导致成年后的持续变化。上皮反应是毒素依赖性的，因为非产毒菌株的定植或母体接种艰难梭菌靶向信使 RNA-脂质纳米颗粒疫苗可以保护新生儿。人类婴儿肠上皮细胞对艰难梭菌毒素敏感，定植婴儿的活检显示肠干细胞行为发生改变。这项研究将艰难梭菌重新定义为一种未被充分认识的早期病原体，对宿主发育具有持久影响。

title: Thalamic NRXN1-mediated input to human cortical progenitors drives excitatory neurogenesis
abstract: The human cerebral cortex develops through coordinated signals from within the cortex and from other brain regions, including the thalamus. However, how thalamic neuronal projections influence early human cortical development remains less well-understood. In this study, we fused cortical and thalamic organoids to investigate how thalamic input shapes the maturation of human cortical cells. Using single-nuclei RNA-sequencing and cellular imaging, we found that thalamic input increases the production of cortical excitatory neurons. We identify neurexin-1 (NRXN1) as a mediator of physical contact between thalamic axons and cortical outer radial glia. Genetic knockout of thalamic NRXN1 reduced these contacts and attenuated the production of upper-layer excitatory neurons. These findings reveal a mechanism by which thalamic input regulates human cortical progenitors and shapes excitatory neuron production during development.
title_zh: 丘脑NRXN1介导的向人皮层祖细胞的输入驱动兴奋性神经发生
abstract_zh: 人类大脑皮层通过来自皮层内部和其他大脑区域（包括丘脑）的协调信号而发育。然而，丘脑神经元投射如何影响早期人类皮质发育仍然不太清楚。在这项研究中，我们融合了皮质和丘脑类器官，以研究丘脑输入如何影响人类皮质细胞的成熟。使用单核 RNA 测序和细胞成像，我们发现丘脑输入增加了皮质兴奋性神经元的产生。我们确定 neurexin-1 (NRXN1) 是丘脑轴突和皮质外放射状胶质细胞之间物理接触的介体。丘脑 NRXN1 的基因敲除减少了这些接触并减弱了上层兴奋性神经元的产生。这些发现揭示了丘脑输入调节人类皮质祖细胞并塑造发育过程中兴奋性神经元产生的机制。

title: Ligand‐Controlled Chemodivergent Telomerization and Hydrofunctionalization of Isoprene With Hydrazones Under Ni Catalysis
abstract: ABSTRACT Terpenoids represent one of the most structurally diverse and biologically relevant families of natural products, yet the development of controllable biomimetic synthetic strategies using bulk feedstocks remains a critical challenge. Isoprene, an abundant and atom‐economical building block, holds great promise for terpenoid synthesis, but its four electronically and sterically similar olefinic carbons generally lead to poor regioselectivity and uncontrollable chemoselectivity in catalytic transformations. In this study, we reported a nickel‐catalyzed chemodivergent telomerization and hydrofunctionalization reaction for constructing terpenoids, wherein precise ligand control enables selective reactivity tuning. Leveraging the in situ formation of benzyl group from hydrazone‐mediated carbonyl umpolung reaction, telomerization is promoted by triarylphosphine ligand featuring both large steric hindrance and electron‐donating characteristics, while hydrofunctionalization benefits from the combination of less bulky, electron‐withdrawing triarylphosphine ligand and BEt 3 . Mechanistic studies and density functional theory calculations validate the chemoselectivity governed by ligand sterics and electronics, as well as the role of BEt 3 in enhancing regioselectivity. Moreover, this protocol created a series of value‐added terpenoids, all of which are amenable to further structural derivatizations. This mild, operationally simple catalytic manifold enables facile access to unnatural terpenoids and broadens the accessible chemical space of terpene frameworks.
title_zh: Ni催化下腙参与的异戊二烯配体调控发散性调聚反应与氢官能化反应
abstract_zh: 摘要 萜类化合物是结构最多样化和生物学相关的天然产物家族之一，但使用散装原料开发可控仿生合成策略仍然是一个严峻的挑战。异戊二烯是一种丰富且原子经济的结构单元，对于萜类化合物的合成具有巨大的前景，但其四个电子和空间相似的烯属碳通常导致催化转化中的区域选择性差和不可控的化学选择性。在这项研究中，我们报道了一种用于构建萜类化合物的镍催化化学发散调聚和氢官能化反应，其中精确的配体控制能够选择性地调节反应性。利用腙介导的羰基反相反应中苄基的原位形成，具有大空间位阻和给电子特性的三芳基膦配体促进调聚，而氢官能化则受益于体积较小的吸电子三芳基膦配体和 BEt 3 的组合。机理研究和密度泛函理论计算验证了配体空间和电子控制的化学选择性，以及 BEt 3 在增强区域选择性中的作用。此外，该方案创造了一系列增值萜类化合物，所有这些都适合进一步的结构衍生化。这种温和、操作简单的催化歧管能够轻松获得非天然萜类化合物，并拓宽萜烯框架的可利用化学空间。

title: Longitudinal dynamics of gene expression and metabolomics in an aging population cohort
abstract: Multiomic profiling provides a comprehensive physiological overview at the molecular level, but understanding of its spatiotemporal dynamics remains limited in human populations. We profiled longitudinal whole-blood gene expression and metabolite levels in 335 females over 8 years. Levels of 5061 genes and 181 metabolites changed over time, with individual trajectories often diverging from population-level trends. Longitudinally variable genes showed cell type specificity and enrichment for aging-relevant pathways, including cardiometabolic and neurodegenerative disorders. Longitudinal trajectories were further shaped by genetics, circadian rhythm, seasonality, and environmental pollutant exposures. Integrative analyses revealed extensive static and time-variable cross-omic connectivity. Longitudinal profiling offers insight into the temporal evolution of age-related conditions at the molecular level, and understanding individual variation within these longitudinal patterns will be essential for future precision medicine approaches.
title_zh: 老年人群队列中基因表达与代谢组学的纵向动态
abstract_zh: 多组学分析提供了分子水平上的全面生理学概述，但对其时空动态的了解在人类群体中仍然有限。我们对 8 年来 335 名女性的纵向全血基因表达和代谢水平进行了分析。 5061 个基因和 181 种代谢物的水平随着时间的推移而发生变化，个体的轨迹往往与群体水平的趋势不同。纵向可变基因显示出细胞类型特异性和衰老相关途径的富集，包括心脏代谢和神经退行性疾病。纵向轨迹进一步受到遗传、昼夜节律、季节性和环境污染物暴露的影响。综合分析揭示了广泛的静态和时变的跨组学连接。纵向分析可以在分子水平上洞察与年龄相关的疾病的时间演变，并且了解这些纵向模式内的个体差异对于未来的精准医学方法至关重要。

title: An embryo-derived peptide signal directs endosperm polarity in Arabidopsis
abstract: Angiosperm seed formation requires the coordinated development of the products of double fertilization—the embryo and the endosperm. The endosperm mediates efficient nutrient transfer from surrounding maternal tissues to the developing embryo. This function requires a polarized tissue organization, which manifests as early polar gene expression and polar cellularization dynamics. We show that the receptor kinase HAIKU2 (IKU2) acts in coordination with the transcription factor WRKY10/MINISEED3 (MINI3) to ensure robust endosperm polarity establishment through the activity of the homeodomain transcription factors WUSCHEL-RELATED HOMEOBOX 8 (WOX8) and WOX9. This process depends on egg cell fertilization and is mediated through the peptide PATHOGEN-INDUCED PEPTIDE–LIKE 7 (PIPL7), which acts as a potential IKU2 ligand. Our results reveal how a molecular paracrine dialog between the embryo and endosperm ensures optimal seed developmental coordination.
title_zh: 胚胎来源的肽信号指导拟南芥胚乳的极性建立
abstract_zh: 被子植物种子的形成需要双重受精的产物——胚胎和胚乳的协调发育。胚乳介导从周围母体组织到发育中胚胎的有效营养转移。该功能需要极化的组织组织，表现为早期的极性基因表达和极性细胞化动力学。我们发现受体激酶 HAIKU2 (IKU2) 与转录因子 WRKY10/MINISEED3 (MINI3) 协同作用，通过同源结构域转录因子 WUSCHEL 相关同源盒 8 (WOX8) 和 WOX9 的活性确保稳健的胚乳极性建立。该过程取决于卵细胞受精，并通过肽类病原体诱导肽 7 (PIPL7) 介导，PIPL7 可作为潜在的 IKU2 配体。我们的结果揭示了胚胎和胚乳之间的分子旁分泌对话如何确保最佳的种子发育协调。

title: Strain-Engineered Intramolecular Junctions in Chirality-Enriched Carbon Nanotubes with Gate-Tunable Photoresponse
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Strain engineering serves as a pivotal method for modulating the electronic and optical properties of semiconductors, thereby realizing energy band engineering in low-dimensional materials. In this work, we report a strain-engineered photodetection architecture based on chirality-enriched single-walled carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) that enables chirality-sensitive energy-band structure modulation, intramolecular junction (IMJ) formation, and gate-tunable spectral photoresponse. Height-tunable step structures are designed to introduce well-controlled uniaxial strain in SWCNT IMJ devices, allowing systematic correlation between mechanical deformation and optoelectronic behavior. Unlike conventional bulk materials or two-dimensional semiconductors, for which external strain typically induces a monotonic shift of their bandgaps, we find that devices based on SWCNT IMJs exhibit pronounced, chirality-dependent changes in photoresponse spectra under increasing uniaxial strain. The energy bandgaps extracted from spectra quantitatively follow the theoretically predicted strain–bandgap relationships with various trends for different chiral indices. Furthermore, electrostatic gating provides continuous tunability of both photocurrent amplitude and spectral response profile, showing active modulation of device photoresponse. These results demonstrate that strain-engineered IMJs in chirality-enriched SWCNT films can serve as a general method for energy band engineering and gate-tunable photoresponse, offering a practical route toward multifunctional and reconfigurable low-dimensional optoelectronic devices.
title_zh: 手性富集碳纳米管中具有栅极可调光响应的应变工程分子内结
abstract_zh: 摘要 应变工程是调控半导体电子和光学性质的关键方法，从而在低维材料中实现能带工程。在这项工作中，我们报道了一种基于手性富集单壁碳纳米管（SWCNTs）的应变工程光电探测结构，可实现手性敏感的能带结构调制、分子内结（IMJ）形成以及栅极可调的光谱光响应。我们设计了高度可调的台阶结构，以在SWCNT IMJ器件中引入良好控制的单轴应变，从而系统地建立机械形变与光电子行为之间的关联。与外部应变通常引起带隙单调变化的传统块体材料或二维半导体不同，我们发现基于SWCNT IMJs的器件在单轴应变增加时表现出显著的、依赖于手性的光响应光谱变化。从光谱中提取的能带带隙在定量上遵循理论预测的应变-带隙关系，且不同手性指数呈现不同趋势。此外，静电栅极可对光电流幅度和光谱响应轮廓进行连续调控，显示器件光响应的主动调制。这些结果表明，手性富集SWCNT薄膜中的应变工程IMJs可作为能带工程和栅极可调光响应的通用方法，为多功能、可重构的低维器件提供了实用途径。

title: Evaluating the Impact of Surface Treatments on a Fluorinated Silicon Phthalocyanine Organic Mixed Ionic-Electronic Conductor
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Small-molecule organic mixed ionic-electronic conductors (OMIECs) offer an interesting alternative to polymers for the fabrication of reliable organic electrochemical transistors (OECTs) thanks to their minimal batch-to-batch variability. The environmental and operational stability of the devices remains a significant issue, particularly in n-type OMIECs, prompting the molecular design of materials with lower LUMO levels and tighter intermolecular forces. In this work, we apply a common strategy that achieves these goals, fluorination, to our previously developed silicon phthalocyanine OMIEC and use silane-based surface treatments as a case study for the effect of surface treatment on the performance of small-molecule OECTs. When compared to the non-fluorinated material, bis(2-[2-(2-methoxyethoxy)ethoxy]acetate) silicon tetrafluoro phthalocyanine (MEEA-F4SiPc) OECTs fabricated on SiO2 demonstrate a lower threshold voltage (VT) at 0.406 ± 0.056 V and better cycling stability. Using surface treatments resulted in faster uptake of ions when swelling as evidenced by EIS and Raman spectroscopy. Though this also resulted in slight improvements in the transient characteristics of the OECTs through faster τon values, the steady-state characteristics of the OECTs were unchanged. This study suggests surface treatment as a strategy for improved small-molecule OECT performance.
title_zh: 表面处理对氟化硅酞菁有机混合离子-电子导体影响的评估
abstract_zh: 摘要 小分子有机混合离子-电子导体（OMIECs）因其批次间差异极小，为制备可靠的有机电化学晶体管（OECTs）提供了一种有趣的聚合物替代方案。器件的环境稳定性和操作稳定性仍然是一个重要问题，尤其是在n型OMIECs中，这促使人们在分子设计上开发具有更低LUMO能级和更强分子间作用力的材料。在这项工作中，我们将一种可实现这些目标的常见策略——氟化——应用于我们先前开发的硅酞菁OMIEC，并以硅烷基表面处理为案例，研究表面处理对小分子OECTs性能的影响。与非氟化材料相比，在SiO2上制备的双(2-[2-(2-甲氧基乙氧基)乙氧基]乙酸酯)四氟硅酞菁（MEEA-F4SiPc）OECTs表现出更低的阈值电压（VT）0.406 ± 0.056 V以及更好的循环稳定性。表面处理使离子在溶胀过程中的吸收更快，这一点由EIS和拉曼光谱证实。尽管这通过更快的τon值使OECTs的瞬态特性略有改善，但其稳态特性并未改变。本研究表明表面处理是提升小分子OECTs性能的一种策略。

title: Non-Annealing Treatment Mechanism of Electron Transport Layers for High-Performance Inverted Perovskite Solar Cells
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Inverted perovskite solar cells (IPSCs) have presented great potential in the photovoltaic field due to their outstanding optoelectronic properties. However, the widely used electron transport layer of [6,6]-phenyl-C61-butyric acid methyl ester (PCBM) in IPSCs presents some issues such as poor passivation effect, insufficient film coverage, and suboptimal energy-level alignment, and the influence of annealing treatment of PCBM on device performance has rarely been investigated. Therefore, in this work, we systematically study the influence of PCBM with or without the thermal annealing process (e.g., annealed PCBM or non-annealed PCBM) on the device performance of IPSCs. Surprisingly, it is found that the annealing treatment of PCBM potentially leads to collapse of the perovskite lattice and generation of PbI2, whereas the non-annealed PCBM exhibits uniform surface morphology and higher coverage integrity at the perovskite surface. Moreover, the device with non-annealed PCBM presents higher electron mobility and lower trap state density. Ultimately, IPSCs based on non-annealed PCBM achieve the highest power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 25.37%, accompanied by prolonged air stability, retaining 88.4% of the initial efficiency after being stored for 1360 h under ambient air.
title_zh: 高性能倒钙钛矿太阳能电池电子传输层的非退火处理机制
abstract_zh: 摘要 倒置钙钛矿太阳能电池（IPSC）因其优异的光电性能在光伏领域展现出巨大的潜力。然而，IPSC中广泛使用的[6,6]-苯基-C61-丁酸甲酯（PCBM）电子传输层存在钝化效果差、薄膜覆盖不足和能级排列不理想等问题，并且PCBM退火处理对器件性能的影响很少被研究。因此，在这项工作中，我们系统地研究了有或没有热退火工艺的PCBM（例如退火PCBM或非退火PCBM）对IPSC器件性能的影响。令人惊讶的是，我们发现PCBM的退火处理可能导致钙钛矿晶格的塌陷并产生PbI2，而未退火的PCBM在钙钛矿表面表现出均匀的表面形貌和更高的覆盖完整性。此外，采用非退火PCBM的器件具有更高的电子迁移率和更低的陷阱态密度。最终，基于非退火PCBM的IPSC实现了25.37%的最高功率转换效率（PCE），并具有较长的空气稳定性，在环境空气中储存1360小时后仍保留了88.4%的初始效率。

title: High-Throughput Screening of Single-Atom Catalyst Coordination Environment Regulation for CO2 Reduction Reactions
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Recent studies have demonstrated that precise modulation of the coordination environment around metal centers can significantly influence the catalytic activity, inspiring interest in the rational design of efficient CO2 reduction reaction (CO2RR) catalysts through coordination engineering. In this work, a series of single-atom catalysts (SACs) with asymmetric coordination environments were systematically constructed based on heteroatom-doped graphene frameworks, aiming to elucidate the structure−activity relationships governing CO2RR performance. By integrating density functional theory (DFT) calculations with machine learning (ML) approaches, the limiting potential (UL) was employed as the target descriptor. EXtreme Gradient Boosting Regression (XGBR) and Sure Independence Screening and Sparsifying Operator (SISSO) algorithms were adopted to construct a black-box predictive model. An interpretable descriptor model, achieving coefficients of determination of R2 = 0.96 and R2 = 0.95, respectively, validated the reliability and generalizability of the established models. The results revealed that, compared to conventional M-N4 SACs with symmetric coordination environments, the introduction of asymmetric coordination could further enhance the CO2RR catalytic activity of Co-, Fe-, and Mn-based SACs, with notable performance variations across different metal centers. Four SACs with superior catalytic potential, namely, Co-N3O, Co-N3S, Fe-N4O2, and Mn-N4N3, were identified. Electronic structure analysis indicated that coordination environment modulation drove an upshift of the metal center d band toward the Fermi level, strengthening interactions with key reaction intermediates and optimizing adsorption energies to enhance catalytic activity. The DFT−ML strategy established herein provides a systematic framework for the rational design of SACs toward efficient CO2RR and offers generalizable principles for coordination engineering in electrocatalysis.
title_zh: 用于CO2还原反应的单原子催化剂配位环境调控的高通量筛选
abstract_zh: 摘要 最近的研究表明，精确调节金属中心周围的配位环境可以显着影响催化活性，激发了人们对通过配位工程合理设计高效二氧化碳还原反应（CO2RR）催化剂的兴趣。在这项工作中，基于杂原子掺杂石墨烯框架，系统地构建了一系列具有不对称配位环境的单原子催化剂（SAC），旨在阐明控制CO2RR性能的构效关系。通过将密度泛函理论（DFT）计算与机器学习（ML）方法相结合，极限电势（UL）被用作目标描述符。采用EXTreme Gradient Boosting Regression（XGBR）和Sure Independence Screening and Sparsifying Operator（SISSO）算法构建黑盒预测模型。可解释的描述符模型的确定系数分别为 R2 = 0.96 和 R2 = 0.95，验证了所建立模型的可靠性和普遍性。结果表明，与具有对称配位环境的传统M-N4 SAC相比，引入不对称配位可以进一步增强Co、Fe和Mn基SAC的CO2RR催化活性，并且不同金属中心的性能差异显着。确定了四种具有优异催化潜力的 SAC，即 Co-N3O、Co-N3S、Fe-N4O2 和 Mn-N4N3。电子结构分析表明配位环境调制驱动升档

title: Self-Activated Direct Bonding with a Highly Polar Atomic-Layer-Deposited Film for 3D Integration
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract We report a previously unknown bonding regime: “self-activated, plasma-free” direct wafer bonding, enabled by atomic-layer-deposited (ALD) Al2O3 on 300-mm wafers. Direct bonding underpins all advanced three-dimensional (3D) complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) and heterogeneous chiplet architectures, yet dielectric surfaces have been assumed to require aggressive plasma activation or chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) to achieve sufficient reactivity. Our results overturn this assumption. ALD-Al2O3 spontaneously forms strong, void-free bonds without any pre-treatment, delivering practical bonding performance sufficient for subsequent wafer processing. Using a comprehensive suite of interfacial probes (double-cantilever-beam measurements, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, X-ray reflectivity, thermal desorption spectroscopy, water-contact-angle dynamics, ultra-sensitive sum-frequency generation spectroscopy, and transmission electron microscopy), we uncover dense, highly polar Al–OH networks, stabilized by the Lewis acidity of Al3+ and the amorphous low-temperature ALD structure, as the intrinsic driver of bond formation. These networks and their rearrangement persist irrespective of queue time, creating a robust, activation-free pathway from hydrogen-bond attachment to covalent bonding. Process-level engineering, including post-deposition annealing (PDA) and oxide-buffer insertion, further boosts strength and reliability. This discovery demonstrates the potential of self-activated, plasma-free bonding using low-temperature ALD-Al2O3 as a new route toward simplified and damage-mitigated 3D integration and advanced semiconductor packaging.
title_zh: 利用高极性原子层沉积薄膜实现3D集成的自激活直接键合
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们报告了一种以前未知的键合方式：“自激活、无等离子体”直接晶圆键合，通过 300 毫米晶圆上的原子层沉积 (ALD) Al2O3 实现。直接键合是所有先进三维 (3D) 互补金属氧化物半导体 (CMOS) 和异质小芯片架构的基础，但电介质表面被认为需要强力等离子体激活或化学机械抛光 (CMP) 才能实现足够的反应性。我们的结果推翻了这个假设。 ALD-Al2O3 无需任何预处理即可自发形成牢固、无空隙的键合，为后续晶圆加工提供足够的实用键合性能。使用一整套界面探针（双悬臂梁测量、X射线光电子能谱、X射线反射率、热解吸光谱、水接触角动力学、超灵敏和频发生光谱和透射电子显微镜），我们发现了致密、高极性的Al-OH网络，该网络由Al3+的路易斯酸性和非晶低温ALD结构稳定，作为键形成的内在驱动力。无论排队时间如何，这些网络及其重新排列都会持续存在，从而创建从氢键连接到共价键合的稳健、无激活的途径。工艺级工程，包括沉积后退火 (PDA) 和氧化物缓冲插入，进一步提高了强度和可靠性。这一发现证明了使用低温 ALD-Al2O3 进行自激活、无等离子体键合的潜力，作为一种新途径

title: Two-Step Access to High-Energy Materials via Intrinsic Fuel–Oxidizer Design
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The development of advanced energetic materials that balance high performance with synthetic accessibility remains a formidable challenge in aerospace and defense applications. Here, we report a simple two-step synthetic strategy to access two distinct yet complementary energetic platforms, a solvent-free sodium-based energetic framework (3) and a hydrazinium-based hypergolic salt (4), from a common precursor. This design leverages an intrinsic fuel–oxidizer motif, integrating gem-dinitro oxidizing units with hydrazine-based fuel fragments to achieve internal redox balance and enhanced energetic output. Compound 3 exhibits a high density of 1.83 g cm–3 and good thermal stability (182 °C), while compound 4 delivers good detonation performance (VOD = 8831 m s–1, DP = 31.8 GPa) together with remarkable hypergolic activity toward white fuming nitric acid, achieving an ignition delay of only 18 ms. Hirshfeld surface analysis further reveals that the solid-state architecture of 4 is stabilized by an extensive hydrogen-bonding network, with O–H interactions contributing 70% of the surface contacts, highlighting the role of directed intermolecular packing in its energetic behavior. This work establishes a cost-effective design paradigm that reconciles synthetic simplicity with high-performance energetic metrics, providing a versatile platform for next-generation ignition-responsive energetic materials.
title_zh: 通过内在燃料–氧化剂设计两步合成高能材料
abstract_zh: 摘要 平衡高性能与合成可及性的先进含能材料的开发仍然是航空航天和国防应用中的巨大挑战。在这里，我们报告了一种简单的两步合成策略，可以从共同的前体获得两个不同但互补的能量平台，即无溶剂的钠基能量框架（3）和肼基自燃盐（4）。该设计利用固有的燃料-氧化剂主题，将偕二硝基氧化单元与肼基燃料碎片相结合，以实现内部氧化还原平衡并增强能量输出。化合物 3 具有 1.83 g cm–3 的高密度和良好的热稳定性 (182 °C)，而化合物 4 具有良好的爆轰性能（VOD = 8831 m s–1，DP = 31.8 GPa）以及对白发烟硝酸的显着自燃活性，实现了仅 18 ms 的点火延迟。 Hirshfeld 表面分析进一步揭示了 4 的固态结构通过广泛的氢键网络稳定，其中 O-H 相互作用贡献了 70% 的表面接触，突出了定向分子间堆积在其能量行为中的作用。这项工作建立了一种具有成本效益的设计范例，将合成简单性与高性能能量指标相协调，为下一代点火响应能量材料提供了一个多功能平台。

title: Chirality-Driven Left-Handed Helical Nanofibers with Amplified CPL Emission via Helicoidal Aggregation of Bulky Naphthalimide AIEgens
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract We report the preparation of left-handed helical fibers, imaged by scanning electron microscopy, with enhanced circularly polarized luminescence (CPL) signals, by the self-assembly of chiral naphthalimide derivatives bearing chiral urea moieties, which exhibit aggregation-induced emission luminescence (AIE) in mixtures of organic solvents with high water content. The helical fibers are driven by specific molecular interactions, the particular geometry of the core dye, and the inherent chirality of the substituents. Notably, enantiomeric pairs (R,R and S,S) of the NMI derivatives displayed mirror-image circular dichroism (CD) signals but both emitted circularly polarized luminescence (CPL) of the same handedness, attributed to the supramolecular interactions at the aggregated state. Furthermore, these organic left-handed fibers served as chiral templates for the growth of silver nanoparticles. The metallization process was confirmed by elemental analysis using energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (FESEM-EDX). This work highlights a strategy for the rational design of chiral aggregation-induced emission luminogens and their use as scaffolds for the synthesis of metal coverings.
title_zh: 通过大体积萘酰亚胺AIEgens的螺旋聚集实现手性驱动的左手螺旋纳米纤维及其放大CPL发射
abstract_zh: 摘要：我们报道了通过带有手性尿素部分的手性萘酰亚胺衍生物的自组装制备了左手螺旋纤维，通过扫描电子显微镜成像，具有增强的圆偏振发光（CPL）信号，其在高含水量的有机溶剂混合物中表现出聚集诱导发射发光（AIE）。螺旋纤维由特定的分子相互作用、核心染料的特定几何形状以及取代基的固有手性驱动。值得注意的是，NMI衍生物的对映体对（R，R和S，S）显示出镜像圆二色性（CD）信号，但两者都发出相同旋向的圆偏振发光（CPL），这归因于聚集状态下的超分子相互作用。此外，这些有机左手纤维充当银纳米颗粒生长的手性模板。使用能量色散 X 射线光谱 (FESEM-EDX) 进行元素分析证实了金属化过程。这项工作强调了合理设计手性聚集诱导发射发光体及其作为合成金属覆盖物的支架的策略。

title: 300-Period Si/SiGe Superlattices on 12-inch Wafers: Growth, Structural Integrity, and Challenges Relevant to 3D DRAM Application
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract To overcome the scaling limits of conventional dynamic random-access memory (DRAM), three-dimensional DRAM (3D DRAM) has been proposed for next-generation high-density memory. Multi-period Si/SiGe superlattices (SLs) are key candidates for vertically stacked channel structures, but their high-period stacking capability is limited by degradation of structural integrity and crystalline quality. In this work, 300-period Si/SiGe SLs with different Ge contents (∼ 25 and ∼ 15%) were grown on 12-inch Si wafers using reduced-pressure chemical vapor deposition (RPCVD), achieving total film thicknesses exceeding ∼ 14 μm. A Si/Si0.75Ge0.25 SL was first fabricated and systematically characterized, revealing partial strain relaxation, degradation of vertical periodicity, and within-wafer non-uniformity. Subsequently, a 300-period Si/Si0.85Ge0.15 SL with reduced effective Ge content was grown under optimized process conditions. Compared with the Si/Si0.75Ge0.25 structure, the Si/Si0.85Ge0.15 SL exhibits improved layer-to-layer thickness control, more stable composition profiles, and enhanced within-wafer uniformity. However, partial strain relaxation and threading dislocations are still observed. Overall, this work provides experimental insights into the degradation evolution, optimization potential, and remaining limitations of 300-period Si/SiGe SLs on 12-inch wafers, offering guidance for further scaling of Si/SiGe epitaxy toward future 3D DRAM applications.
title_zh: 12英寸晶圆上300周期Si/SiGe超晶格:生长、结构完整性及与3D DRAM应用相关的挑战
abstract_zh: 摘要 为了克服传统动态随机存取存储器（DRAM）的缩放限制，三维DRAM（3D DRAM）被提出作为下一代高密度存储器。多周期Si/SiGe超晶格（SL）是垂直堆叠沟道结构的关键候选材料，但其高周期堆叠能力受到结构完整性和晶体质量退化的限制。在这项工作中，使用减压化学气相沉积 (RPCVD) 在 12 英寸硅片上生长了具有不同 Ge 含量（~ 25 和~ 15%）的 300 周期 Si/SiGe SL，总膜厚度超过~ 14 μm。首先制造了 Si/Si0.75Ge0.25 SL 并进行了系统表征，揭示了部分应变弛豫、垂直周期性退化和晶圆内不均匀性。随后，在优化的工艺条件下生长了有效Ge含量降低的300周期Si/Si0.85Ge0.15 SL。与Si/Si0.75Ge0.25结构相比，Si/Si0.85Ge0.15 SL表现出改进的层间厚度控制、更稳定的成分分布以及增强的晶圆内均匀性。然而，仍然观察到部分应变松弛和螺纹位错。总体而言，这项工作为 12 英寸晶圆上 300 周期 Si/SiGe SL 的退化演变、优化潜力和剩余局限性提供了实验见解，为未来 3D DRAM 应用进一步扩展 Si/SiGe 外延提供了指导。

title: Building VS&Si-CuInS2/SiC Heterojunctions Mimicking Thylakoid for Artificial Photosynthesis—Dual-Vacancy-Assisted Mechanism
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Converting CO2 and water into value-added chemicals by mimicking plant photosynthesis is a promising strategy to mitigate CO2 concentration in the atmosphere. Herein, a series of hierarchical hollow VS&Si-CuInS2/SiC-X heterojunctions with abundant S and Si vacancies were designed, synthesized, and utilized for photoelectrocatalytic CO2 reduction in an aqueous KHCO3 solution. Our results reveal that the unique hierarchical hollow architecture, S and Si vacancies, and n−n heterojunction property synergistically contribute to CO2 reduction performance and selectivity to C2 products. In particular, the optimal heterojunction VS&Si-CuInS2/SiC-2 achieves a generation rate of 79.38 μM h−1 cm−2 for carbon-based products and a C2 selectivity of 83.63% for liquid products. Moreover, its total electron transfer rate (263.19 μM h−1 cm−2) is 3.60 times higher than that of VSi-SiC and 3.96 times higher than that of VS-CuInS2, respectively. DFT calculations indicate that the S and Si vacancies can evidently reduce the reaction barriers in the CO2 reduction, promoting the generation of crucial intermediates and facilitating the C−C coupling reaction on the catalyst surface. Based on the key intermediates *═C═O, *CHO, *COCHO, and *COCH3 detected through in situ FTIR spectroscopy and confirmed by DFT calculations, a dual-vacancy-assisted mechanism is proposed for photoelectrocatalytic CO2 reduction.
title_zh: 构建模拟类囊体的VS&Si-CuInS2/SiC异质结用于人工光合作用——双空位辅助机制
abstract_zh: 摘要 通过模拟植物光合作用将CO2和水转化为高附加值化学品，是缓解大气中CO2浓度的一种有前景的策略。本文设计、合成了一系列具有丰富S和Si空位的分级空心VS&Si-CuInS2/SiC-X异质结，并将其用于水性KHCO3溶液中的光电催化CO2还原。我们的结果表明，独特的分级空心结构、S和Si空位以及n−n异质结特性协同促进了CO2还原性能及对C2产物的选择性。特别是，最优异质结VS&Si-CuInS2/SiC-2对碳基产物的生成速率为79.38 μM h−1 cm−2，对液态产物的C2选择性为83.63%。此外，其总电子转移速率（263.19 μM h−1 cm−2）分别是VSi-SiC的3.60倍和VS-CuInS2的3.96倍。DFT计算表明，S和Si空位能显著降低CO2还原中的反应能垒，促进关键中间体的生成，并有利于催化剂表面的C−C偶联反应。基于原位FTIR光谱检测到并经DFT计算确认的关键中间体*═C═O、*CHO、*COCHO和*COCH3，提出了光电催化CO2还原的双空位辅助机理。

title: Effect of Substrate Miscut on the Epitaxial Growth of MoS2 on Sapphire
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The combined effects of substrate miscut angle and growth temperature on the epitaxial growth and properties of MoS2 monolayers synthesized by metalorganic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD) on c-plane sapphire substrates were investigated. Increasing the miscut angle toward the M-axis produces faceted step–terrace surfaces with higher step density and reduced terrace width on the sapphire surface, while promoting pronounced step bunching during growth. These miscut-induced surface reconstructions strongly modulate MoS2 growth, leading to systematic changes in bilayer domain density, size, morphology, and epitaxial alignment without significantly altering the growth rate. Comprehensive structural, optical, and electronic characterizations reveal that growth at 1000 °C on the lowest miscut (0.2°) sapphire yields the highest quality monolayer MoS2, as evidenced by the low full width at half-maximum of the in-plane X-ray diffraction φ-scan peaks, minimized defect-bound exciton emission in photoluminescence spectra at cryogenic temperatures, and superior field-effect transistor performance. In contrast, 1° miscut substrates promote increased bilayer domain density, likely due to increased step bunching of the sapphire, making them suitable for controlled bilayer MoS2 growth. However, further increasing the miscut to 4° or lowering the growth temperature to 950 °C results in significantly degraded structural, optical, and electrical properties. These results highlight the importance of substrate miscut and its role in governing the epitaxial growth of MoS2, offering valuable guidance for the scalable synthesis of high-quality two-dimensional MoS2 films.
title_zh: 衬底偏切角对蓝宝石上MoS2外延生长的影响
