title: Complementary Asymmetric Fluorinated Viologen and Conjugated Phenyl Viologen for Black Electrochromic Devices with High Cycling Stability
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Black electrochromic devices (ECDs) that offer broadband visible-light absorption and a visually neutral dark state are highly attractive for smart windows, displays, and adaptive light-management systems. However, achieving high-quality black electrochromism with high optical contrast, fast switching, and long-term cycling stability remains challenging, primarily owing to the unbalanced spectral absorption and radical-cation dimerization issues inherent in conventional viologen-based systems. Herein, we address the limitations of conventional viologen-based electrochromic devices via a strategy integrating molecular design and spectral superposition engineering. A fluorinated benzyl viologen derivative, 1-(4-fluorobenzyl)–1′-(3,5-bis(trifluoromethyl)benzyl)–4,4′-bipyridinium di(tetrafluoroborate) (TFBV), is designed to suppress radical-cation aggregation and improve redox stability. To compensate for the weak absorption of TFBV in the 450–550 nm region, a cyanophenyl-substituted viologen (1,1′-bis(4-cyanophenyl)–4,4′-bipyridinium bis(tetrafluoroborate) (CPV)) with extended π-conjugation is introduced as a complementary chromophore, enabling red-shifted and balanced visible-light absorption. Benefiting from the synergistic absorption of TFBV and CPV, the optimized ECD exhibits a high bleached-state transmittance of 81.1%, a low colored-state transmittance of 5.2%, and a large optical contrast of 75.9% across the visible region. The device also shows rapid switching with coloration and bleaching times of 4.4 and 4.1 s, respectively, a high coloration efficiency of 218.65 cm2 C–1, and excellent cycling stability with 99.8% contrast retention after 10,000 cycles. Furthermore, a prototype smart window based on TFBV/CPV exhibits effective light and heat regulation. This work presents an effective molecular design strategy for stable, fast-response black ECDs and expands the potential of viologen-based materials for energy-saving smart windows.

title: Defect Passivation of Mesoporous Al2O3-Based Buried Interface for Efficient Inverted Perovskite Solar Cells
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Buried interface engineering between the hole transport layer and perovskite remains a critical challenge for inverted perovskite solar cells (IPSCs). Al2O3-based interface modification provides excellent interfacial stability and ion-blocking capability; however, its insulating nature and chemical inertness limit effective carrier transport modulation and defect regulation at the buried interface. Here, a synergistic interface engineering strategy is developed by incorporating phenethylammonium bromide (PEABr) into an ultrathin Al2O3 matrix to construct a multifunctional composite interlayer at the NiOX/perovskite buried interface. The introduced PEABr chemically reconstructs the buried interface through the formation of an interfacial quasi-2D/3D perovskite heterostructure. Bromide species derived from PEABr interact with undercoordinated Pb2+ sites and compensate iodine-vacancy-related defects, while phenethylammonium (PEA+) cations participate in constructing the quasi-2D interfacial phase, which optimizes energy-level alignment and promotes efficient hole extraction across the NiOX/perovskite heterojunction. Moreover, the PEABr-induced quasi-2D/3D interfacial structure improves carrier selectivity and suppresses interfacial recombination, thereby enhancing carrier collection. Electronic characterizations demonstrate that the composite interlayer reduces the charge-transfer resistance from 462.81 to 279.65 kΩ, increases the built-in potential from 0.617 to 0.703 V, and decreases the ideality factor from 2.44 to 1.63, enabling a champion power conversion efficiency of 21.34% for IPSCs. This work provides a feasible strategy for constructing multifunctional oxide-based buried interfaces through simultaneous defect regulation, energy-level optimization, and efficient carrier extraction.

title: Strain-Regulated Plasmonic Excitation and Raman Scattering for Tunable Surface-Enhanced Raman Scattering in a Stretchable Ag Grating
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Flexible plasmonic substrates are attractive for conformal and in situ surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) detection; however, gap-free metallic nanostructures have received limited attention for strain-tunable SERS despite their facile fabrication and spectral tunability. This paper reports a stretchable Ag grating on a sinusoidal polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) substrate that enables strain-regulated modulation of plasmonic response and Raman scattering. Strain applied perpendicular (εx) and parallel (εy) to the grating lines induces distinct morphological changes, leading to opposite spectral shifts relative to the 532 nm excitation wavelength. Under longitudinal stretching, the local-field enhancement exhibits a nonmonotonic dependence on strain and reaches its maximum at εy = 10%, although the plasmon resonance further blueshifts toward the excitation wavelength at larger strains. Electromagnetic simulations and Purcell-factor analysis reveal that stretching simultaneously regulates excitation-field enhancement and plasmon-mediated Raman scattering. This excitation−scattering modulation produces the strongest SERS response for crystal violet at εy = 10%, enabling a detection limit of 10−11 mol/L. Moreover, the substrate maintains high reproducibility, with an RSD = 4.5% over 60 stretching cycles, highlighting its potential for mechanically tunable and flexible molecular sensing.
title_zh: 可拉伸Ag光栅中应变调控的等离激元激发与拉曼散射实现可调谐表面增强拉曼散射
abstract_zh: 摘要 柔性等离激元基底在共形和原位表面增强拉曼散射（SERS）检测中具有吸引力；然而，无间隙金属纳米结构尽管制备简便且具有光谱可调性，在应变可调SERS方面受到的关注有限。本文报道了一种基于正弦形聚二甲基硅氧烷（PDMS）基底的可拉伸Ag光栅，可实现等离激元响应和拉曼散射的应变调控调制。垂直于（εx）和平行于（εy）光栅线施加应变会引起不同的形貌变化，导致相对于532 nm激发波长出现相反的光谱位移。在纵向拉伸下，局域场增强对应变呈现非单调依赖关系，并在εy = 10%时达到最大值，尽管在更大应变下等离激元共振进一步蓝移至接近激发波长。电磁模拟和Purcell因子分析表明，拉伸同时调节激发场增强和等离激元介导的拉曼散射。这种激发-散射调制使结晶紫在εy = 10%时产生最强的SERS响应，检测限可达10−11 mol/L。此外，该基底在60次拉伸循环后仍保持高重现性，RSD = 4.5%，凸显了其在机械可调柔性分子传感方面的潜力。

title: Perovskite Oxide Interfaces Tailored by Cation Ordering Periodicities: Experimentally Resolved Atomic Structure and Predicted Magnetic Coupling
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Magnetically coupled interfaces formed from perovskite oxides with different B-site ordering periodicities have not been studied extensively due to challenges in synthesis and a lack of adequate parent phases. Here, we use aberration-corrected analytical scanning transmission electron microscopy to identify the atomic structure and chemistry of a perovskite oxide interface that exhibits different B-site ordering periodicity on the atomic scale. The interface is formed from the 1:1 B-site-ordered double-perovskite Sr2Fe1+xRe1–xO6 and the 1:2 B-site-ordered triple-perovskite Sr3Fe2ReO9. First-principles calculations on the superlattice model with the same modulation of B-site ordering periodicity observed experimentally show that magnetic coupling between Fe and Re atoms at the interface results in characteristics of ferromagnetism, in contrast to the antiferromagnetic nature of the parent phases. The results suggest that tailoring of B-site ordering periodicity for tuning interfacial magnetism at perovskite oxide interfaces can be potentially applied in epitaxial growth of superlattice thin films with magnetically engineered interfaces.
title_zh: 通过阳离子有序周期性调控钙钛矿氧化物界面：实验解析的原子结构与预测的磁耦合
abstract_zh: 摘要 由具有不同B位有序周期的钙钛矿氧化物形成的磁性耦合界面，由于合成上的挑战以及缺乏合适的母相，尚未得到广泛研究。在此，我们利用像差校正分析型扫描透射电子显微镜，鉴定了一种在原子尺度上表现出不同B位有序周期的钙钛矿氧化物界面的原子结构和化学性质。该界面由1:1 B位有序的双钙钛矿Sr2Fe1+xRe1–xO6和1:2 B位有序的三重钙钛矿Sr3Fe2ReO9形成。对具有与实验观察到的相同B位有序周期调制的超晶格模型进行的第一性原理计算表明，界面处Fe和Re原子之间的磁耦合产生了铁磁特征，这与母相的反铁磁性质形成对比。结果表明，通过调控B位有序周期来调节钙钛矿氧化物界面的界面磁性，有望应用于具有磁性工程界面的超晶格薄膜的外延生长。

title: Delivery of CAR T Cells in a Magnesium-Functionated Hydrogel Boosts Peritoneal Metastasis Treatment
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cells show limited efficacy in solid tumors due to suppressive factors in the tumor microenvironment. In this study, we identified extracellular magnesium (Mg2+) as a pharmacologically modulable regulator of CAR T activity. Mg2+ supplementation increased early activation and augmented cytotoxic readouts, including IFN-γ secretion and target-cell lysis. To localize this cue, we engineered a phosphorylated hyaluronic-acid hydrogel ionically cross-linked by Mg2+ (HA-Mg Gel), which forms an in situ Mg2+-rich niche. In this niche, CAR T cells exhibit reinforced actin polymerization at the tumor-T-cell interface and show enhanced activation and effector function in vitro. In a Capan-2 peritoneal metastasis model, intraperitoneal administration of CAR T@HA-Mg Gel produced durable tumor control and significantly prolonged survival compared with controls. These findings position extracellular Mg2+ as a modulator of CAR T activity and present a biomaterial-guided, nongenetic strategy to improve CAR T-cell therapy for solid tumors.
title_zh: 镁功能化水凝胶递送CAR T细胞增强腹膜转移治疗
abstract_zh: 摘要 嵌合抗原受体（CAR）T细胞由于肿瘤微环境中的抑制性因子，在实体瘤中疗效有限。在本研究中，我们发现细胞外镁离子（Mg2+）是CAR T活性的一种可药理学调控的调节因子。补充Mg2+可增强早期激活并增强细胞毒性读出指标，包括IFN-γ分泌和靶细胞裂解。为了定位这一信号，我们构建了一种由Mg2+离子交联的磷酸化透明质酸水凝胶（HA-Mg Gel），可形成原位Mg2+富集的微环境。在该微环境中，CAR T细胞在肿瘤-T细胞界面表现出增强的肌动蛋白聚合，并在体外显示出更强的激活和效应功能。在Capan-2腹膜转移模型中，与对照相比，腹腔注射CAR T@HA-Mg Gel实现了持久的肿瘤控制并显著延长了生存期。这些发现确立了细胞外Mg2+作为CAR T活性的调节因子，并提出了一种生物材料引导的非基因策略，以改进针对实体瘤的CAR T细胞疗法。

title: Stress-Induced Electronic/Atomic Interfacial Evolution of MXene/MoS2-Ionic Liquid Heterostructures Enables Adaptive Lubrication in Epoxy Coatings
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The tribological performance of MXene/MoS2 heterostructure-based polymer coatings is limited by an incomplete understanding of electronic/atomic interfacial evolution, as well as an insufficient adaptive response to dynamic contact stress under friction conditions, which restricts the realization of load-bearing capacity, lubrication efficiency, and long-term durability. Herein, a multiscale hierarchical hybrid filler (MSIC) is rationally designed by integrating a chitosan-encapsulated MXene/MoS2-[APMIM]Br ionic liquid (IL) heterostructure, and then incorporated into epoxy (EP) to fabricate the self-lubricating composite coatings (MSICP). Nanotribological tests demonstrate that the MSIC exhibits lower and more uniform friction than individual MXene and MoS2, while MSICP significantly reduces wear depth, wear volume, and interfacial adhesion. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations reveal that the sequential interfacial interaction evolution drives enhanced tribological performance. Specifically, sliding initiates IL-mediated boundary lubrication, and further transitions to van der Waals-assisted MXene/MoS2 heterostructure shearing, eventually concluding with strong polar adhesion at exposed MXene surfaces. This evolution suppresses direct solid-solid contact and minimizes electron-cloud overlap, thus reducing interfacial shear and adhesion. At the macroscale, the coating containing 2 wt % MSIC achieves a 70.4% reduction in wear rate (3.7 × 10–4 mm3/N m) compared with EP, confirming the effective translation of nanoscale interfacial regulation into bulk mechanical reinforcement. Machine learning (ML) identifies filler content as the dominant friction-governing factor. Notably, increased filler concentration maintains continuous low-shear channels and buffers plastic deformation, which triggers chitosan microcracking to facilitate on-demand IL release. This work provides a guided strategy for designing high-performance MXene/MoS2 heterostructure-based polymer coatings for wear protection of moving parts in precision machinery systems.
title_zh: MXene/MoS2-离子液体异质结构的应力诱导电子/原子界面演化实现环氧涂层自适应润滑
abstract_zh: 摘要 MXene/MoS2异质结构聚合物涂层的摩擦学性能受到对电子/原子界面演化的不完全理解以及对摩擦条件下动态接触应力的自适应响应不足的限制，限制了承载能力、润滑效率和长期耐久性的实现。在此，通过集成壳聚糖封装的MXene/MoS2-[APMIM]Br离子液体（IL）异质结构，合理设计了多尺度分级混合填料（MSIC），然后将其掺入环氧树脂（EP）中以制备自润滑复合涂层（MSICP）。纳米摩擦学测试表明，MSIC 比单独的 MXene 和 MoS2 表现出更低且更均匀的摩擦，而 MSICP 显着降低了磨损深度、磨损体积和界面粘附力。密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算和分子动力学 (MD) 模拟表明，连续的界面相互作用演化可提高摩擦学性能。具体来说，滑动引发 IL 介导的边界润滑，并进一步过渡到范德华辅助的 MXene/MoS2 异质结构剪切，最终在暴露的 MXene 表面产生强极性粘附。这种演变抑制了直接的固-固接触，并最大限度地减少了电子-云重叠，从而减少了界面剪切和粘附。在宏观尺度上，与 EP 相比，含有 2 wt% MSIC 的涂层的磨损率 (3.7 × 10–4 mm3/N m) 降低了 70.4%，证实了纳米尺度的有效转化

title: Monomer-biased manufacture of industrial-scale colloidal photonic films
abstract: Complex functions in nature arise from the ordered assembly of simple building blocks. Transformation of colloidal aggregates into industrial-scale photonic crystals under rapid ambient conditions remains challenging owing to high energy barriers and limited assembly control. In this study, common monomers act as mediators that lower these barriers and bias ambient shear-induced ordering within seconds. This enables in situ processing compatible with roll-to-roll manufacturing of colloidal photonic crystal films with tunable mechanical properties. Robust 15-micrometer-thick films, incorporating a supramolecular matrix, can be produced up to 4000 meters long and 1.3 meters wide at a rate of 25 meters per minute. These combine vivid structural color and high transparency (>90%) with mechanical robustness and rapid self-healing, demonstrating a scalable route to high-quality colloidal photonic materials.
title_zh: 单体偏向型工业规模胶体光子薄膜的制备
abstract_zh: 自然界中的复杂功能是由简单构建块的有序组装产生的。由于高能垒和有限的组装控制，在快速环境条件下将胶体聚集体转化为工业规模的光子晶体仍然具有挑战性。在这项研究中，常见的单体充当介质，可以在几秒钟内降低这些障碍并偏置环境剪切诱导的排序。这使得原位加工与具有可调机械性能的胶体光子晶体薄膜的卷对卷制造兼容。坚固的 15 微米厚的薄膜包含超分子基质，可以以每分钟 25 米的速度生产长达 4000 米、宽 1.3 米的薄膜。它们将生动的结构色彩和高透明度（> 90％）与机械鲁棒性和快速自修复结合在一起，展示了高质量胶体光子材料的可扩展途径。

title: Uneven TCR chain pairing constraints govern epitope recognition
abstract: Combinatorial pairing of independently recombined T cell receptor (TCR) α- and β-chains is central to diversifying the TCR repertoire. Although sequence motifs in one chain correlate with epitope recognition, the extent to which a single chain dictates specificity remains unclear. Here, we systematically tested TCR chain coupling constraints by enforcing the pairing of individual chains with hundreds of thousands of partners. Although most chains paired stably, the preservation of epitope specificity was rare and highly variable, with the frequency of compatible partners ranging from ~10 to 70,000 epitope-specific TCRs across 10 epitopes. Our work illuminates the distinct contributions of TCR chains, highlights the limitations of single-chain data, and provides an experimental and analytical framework for refining TCR-peptide-major histocompatibility complex specificity inference.
title_zh: 不均一的TCR链配对限制决定表位识别
abstract_zh: 独立重组 T 细胞受体 (TCR) α 链和 β 链的组合配对对于 TCR 库多样化至关重要。尽管一条链中的序列基序与表位识别相关，但单链在多大程度上决定特异性仍不清楚。在这里，我们通过强制将各个链与数十万个合作伙伴配对来系统地测试 TCR 链耦合约束。尽管大多数链稳定配对，但表位特异性的保留很少且高度可变，10 个表位中相容伴侣的频率范围为约 10 至 70,000 个表位特异性 TCR。我们的工作阐明了 TCR 链的独特贡献，强调了单链数据的局限性，并为完善 TCR 肽主要组织相容性复合体特异性推断提供了实验和分析框架。

title: Dual‐Site Spin State Modulation in Iron‐Based Prussian Blue Cathode Enabling Improved Sodium Storage
abstract: ABSTRACT Prussian blue (PB) and its analogues are promising cathode materials for sodium‐ion batteries (SIBs), yet their practical application is hindered by uncontrolled [Fe(CN) 6 ] vacancies and interstitial water, which lead to unsatisfactory cycling stability and capacity utilization. Herein, we report a ligand engineering strategy to simultaneously modulate the spin states of both low‐spin (LS) and high‐spin (HS) Fe sites in PB. By introducing ─CN vacancies and terminal ─NH 2 groups via a pentacyanide precursor, a modified PB (denoted as PPB) is achieved. Spectroscopic and computational analyses confirm a dual‐site spin transition in which both LS and HS Fe sites predominantly convert into an intermediate‐spin (IS) state. As a result, the PPB cathode exhibits impressive rate capability (129 and 92 mAh g −1 at 0.05 and 2 A g −1 , respectively) and cycling stability (70% retention after 4000 cycles at 2 A g −1 ), significantly outperforming the routine hexacyanide‐based PB. Density functional theory calculations reveal that the ─NH 2 groups serve as preferential adsorption sites for Na + , while ─CN vacancies lower the migration barrier, which collectively enhance the Na + storage kinetics. This work presents a prudent ligand engineering strategy for designing high‐performance cathode materials through deliberate spin state manipulation.
title_zh: 铁基普鲁士蓝正极中的双位点自旋态调制助力钠存储性能提升
abstract_zh: 摘要：普鲁士蓝（PB）及其类似物是有前景的钠离子电池（SIB）正极材料，但其实际应用受到不受控制的[Fe(CN) 6 ]空位和间隙水的阻碍，导致循环稳定性和容量利用率不理想。在此，我们报告了一种配体工程策略，可同时调节 PB 中低自旋（LS）和高自旋（HS）Fe 位点的自旋态。通过五氰化物前体引入─CN空位和末端─NH 2 基团，得到改性PB（记为PPB）。光谱和计算分析证实了双位点自旋跃迁，其中 LS 和 HS Fe 位点主要转化为中间自旋 (IS) 态。因此，PPB正极表现出令人印象深刻的倍率性能（在0.05和2 A g -1 下分别为129和92 mAh g -1 ）和循环稳定性（在2 A g -1 下4000次循环后70%的保留率），显着优于常规的基于六氰化物的PB。密度泛函理论计算表明，─NH 2 基团是Na + 的优先吸附位点，而─CN空位降低了迁移势垒，共同增强了Na + 的储存动力学。这项工作提出了一种审慎的配体工程策略，通过有意的自旋态操纵来设计高性能阴极材料。

title: Elucidating the Suppression of High‐Voltage Degradation in O3‐type NaNi 1/3 Fe 1/3 Mn 1/3 O 2 : A Voltage‐Switching Strategy for Na‐ion Batteries
abstract: ABSTRACT Elevating depth‐of‐charge (DoC) enhances the energy density of layered oxide cathodes for sodium‐ion batteries; however, such high‐DoC cycling inevitably triggers severe structural and interfacial degradation. In practice, battery management systems commonly adapt voltage‐derating strategies dynamically according to battery state of health, achieving a favorable trade‐off between energy density and cycle life. Nevertheless, a critical yet overlooked question remains: how high‐DoC‐induced damaged regions evolve when reverted to moderate‐DoC cycling. Here, using NaNi 1/3 Fe 1/3 Mn 1/3 O 2 (NFM111) as a prototype, a voltage‐switching strategy is employed to elucidate the dynamic and long‐term behavior of these damaged regions. During high‐DoC cycling (charging to 4.3 V), the rapid capacity fading is driven by pronounced formation of bulk defects and interfacial disordered spinel phases. However, upon switching these cells to moderate‐DoC cycling (charging to 4.0 V), these pre‐existing damaged regions become stabilized: their rapid propagation is suppressed, and they no longer accelerate degradation in surrounding intact regions. This enables degraded NFM111 to deliver capacity retention comparable to that of cells cycled solely under moderate‐DoC conditions. This work presents a dynamic and evolving picture of high‐DoC degradation and subsequent moderate‐DoC stabilization in NFM111 cathodes, providing mechanistic insights into voltage‐derating process and the lifetime prolongation of compromised cells.
title_zh: 阐明O3型NaNi 1/3 Fe 1/3 Mn 1/3 O 2中高压降解的抑制机制：一种钠离子电池的电压切换策略
abstract_zh: 摘要：提高充电深度（DoC）可提高钠离子电池层状氧化物阴极的能量密度；然而，如此高的 DoC 循环不可避免地会引发严重的结构和界面退化。在实践中，电池管理系统通常根据电池的健康状况动态调整电压降额策略，从而在能量密度和循环寿命之间实现有利的权衡。然而，一个关键但被忽视的问题仍然存在：当恢复到中等 DoC 循环时，高 DoC 诱导的受损区域如何演变。在这里，使用 NaNi 1/3 Fe 1/3 Mn 1/3 O 2 (NFM111) 作为原型，采用电压切换策略来阐明这些受损区域的动态和长期行为。在高 DoC 循环（充电至 4.3 V）期间，容量快速衰减是由大量缺陷和界面无序尖晶石相的明显形成驱动的。然而，将这些细胞切换到中等 DoC 循环（充电至 4.0 V）后，这些预先存在的受损区域变得稳定：它们的快速增殖受到抑制，并且它们不再加速周围完整区域的降解。这使得降解的 NFM111 能够提供与仅在中等 DoC 条件下循环的电池相当的容量保留率。这项工作展示了 NFM111 阴极中高 DoC 退化和随后的中等 DoC 稳定的动态和演变图景，为电压降额过程和受损电池的寿命延长提供了机制见解。

title: Modifications of Lysine Residues 294 and 311 Within the Microtubule‐Binding Region Alter Tau Aggregation and Tubulin Binding Equilibria
abstract: ABSTRACT Dysfunction of the microtubule‐associated protein Tau is a central feature of Alzheimer's disease and related tauopathies, yet how site‐specific lysine modifications modulate the functional and pathological states of Tau remains poorly understood. Here, we combine protein semi‐synthesis with segmental isotope labelling and NMR spectroscopy of full‐length Tau, to dissect how lysine acetylation and carboxymethylation within the microtubule‐binding region of Tau regulate its interactions with tubulin, microtubules, and amyloid assembly. Site‐specific modification at lysine 294 delays Tau‐mediated tubulin polymerization and fibril formation, whereas acetylation at lysine 311 exerts more moderate effects, but alters fibril morphology. NMR spectroscopy of segmentally isotope‐labelled Tau variants indicates that single lysine acetylation does not measurably weaken Tau binding to pre‐formed microtubules; however, bivalent acetylation reduces microtubule binding, possibly by cumulative charge neutralization. Together, these results indicate that lysine acetylation redistributes Tau between functional states in a site‐ and valency‐dependent manner. Our study helps to establish a mechanistic framework linking combinatorial lysine modifications to Tau dysfunction and highlights the utility of region‐resolved structural approaches to decipher posttranslational modification–dependent equilibria in intrinsically disordered proteins.
title_zh: 微管结合区中赖氨酸残基294和311的修饰改变Tau聚集与微管蛋白结合平衡
abstract_zh: 摘要 微管相关蛋白 Tau 的功能障碍是阿尔茨海默病和相关 tau 病的一个核心特征，但位点特异性赖氨酸修饰如何调节 Tau 的功能和病理状态仍知之甚少。在这里，我们将蛋白质半合成与全长 Tau 的片段同位素标记和核磁共振波谱相结合，剖析 Tau 微管结合区域内的赖氨酸乙酰化和羧甲基化如何调节其与微管蛋白、微管和淀粉样蛋白组装的相互作用。赖氨酸 294 的位点特异性修饰可延迟 Tau 介导的微管蛋白聚合和原纤维形成，而赖氨酸 311 的乙酰化则发挥更温和的作用，但会改变原纤维形态。片段同位素标记的 Tau 变体的核磁共振波谱表明，单个赖氨酸乙酰化不会明显削弱 Tau 与预先形成的微管的结合；然而，二价乙酰化可能通过累积电荷中和来减少微管结合。总之，这些结果表明赖氨酸乙酰化以位点和价态依赖的方式在功能状态之间重新分配 Tau。我们的研究有助于建立一个将组合赖氨酸修饰与 Tau 功能障碍联系起来的机制框架，并强调区域解析结构方法在破译本质无序蛋白质中翻译后修饰依赖性平衡的效用。

title: A Dual Locking Strategy Enables Highly Selective meta ‐Xylene Separation With an Aluminum‐Pyrrolic Framework
abstract: ABSTRACT Efficient separation of xylene isomers remains a significant challenge due to their nearly identical physicochemical properties. Here, we report a dual locking strategy in an aluminum–pyrrolic framework (Al‐PyDC) with V‐shaped ligand featured AlO 6 chains and pyrrole dual recognition sites that simultaneously stabilize the V‐shaped meta ‐xylene (mX). This dual‐locking effect promotes dense packing of mX within confined channels, resulting in a high adsorption capacity for mX (4.0 mmol g −1 ), which is much higher than that for ortho ‐xylene (oX, 2.5 mmol g −1 ) and para ‐xylene (pX, 2.0 mmol g −1 ). The simulations and solid‐state NMR spectroscopy further confirmed that mX experienced stronger locking interactions with the AlO 6 chains and pyrrolic ligands compared to pX. Notably, the dual locking effect was temperature‐dependent, and elevated temperature accelerated molecular diffusion, thereby weakening the effectiveness of the recognition. Hence, Al‐PyDC achieved an excellent mX/pX selectivity of 8.0 in vapor‐phase breakthrough measurements at ambient temperature (303 K), which outperformed most of the MOF counterparts. Additionally, the isomorphic CAU‐10‐H with V‐shaped AlO 6 –phenyl–AlO 6 dual locking sites was employed as a control material to elucidate the role of active‐site in molecular recognition. This dual locking strategy offered an effective approach for enhancing the adsorption capacity and selectivity for challenging isomer separations.
title_zh: 双锁定策略通过铝-吡咯框架实现高选择性的间二甲苯分离
abstract_zh: 摘要 由于二甲苯异构体几乎相同的物理化学性质，有效分离二甲苯异构体仍然是一个重大挑战。在这里，我们报告了铝-吡咯框架（Al-PyDC）中的双重锁定策略，其V形配体具有AlO 6 链和吡咯双重识别位点，可同时稳定V形间二甲苯（mX）。这种双重锁定效应促进了mX在有限通道内的密集堆积，从而导致mX（4.0 mmol g -1 ）的高吸附容量，远高于邻二甲苯（oX，2.5 mmol g -1 ）和对二甲苯（pX，2.0 mmol g -1 ）。模拟和固态核磁共振波谱进一步证实，与 pX 相比，mX 与 AlO 6 链和吡咯配体具有更强的锁定相互作用。值得注意的是，双重锁定效应是温度依赖性的，升高的温度会加速分子扩散，从而削弱识别的有效性。因此，Al-PyDC 在环境温度（303 K）下的气相突破测量中实现了 8.0 的优异 mX/pX 选择性，优于大多数 MOF 同类产品。此外，采用具有V形AlO 6 -苯基-AlO 6 双锁定位点的同构CAU-10-H作为对照材料来阐明活性位点在分子识别中的作用。这种双重锁定策略为增强具有挑战性的异构体分离的吸附能力和选择性提供了有效的方法。

title: Broad‐Spectrum, Cell Envelope‐Active Marinocyclin Antibiotics From a Coral‐Derived Bacterium Are Effective Against Colistin‐Resistant Bacteria
abstract: ABSTRACT The marine bacterial genus Aquimarina comprises diverse members with numerous natural product biosynthetic gene clusters but few characterized compounds. Here we report a novel class of lipopeptides with exceptional antibiotic activity, named marinocyclins, isolated from Aquimarina megaterium EL43 associated with the octocoral Eunicella labiata . The major congener marinocyclin A exhibited potent and uniform activity against a broad panel of drug‐resistant gram‐negative and gram‐positive pathogens, including ESKAPE bacteria. The natural product efficiently compromised the outer and inner bacterial membranes, leading to rapid cell permeabilization and lysis. This activity profile was mediated by the ability to bind lipopolysaccharides, anionic phospholipids enriched in bacterial membranes, and peptidoglycan precursors. Eukaryotic cytotoxicity required higher doses than antibacterial activity. Genomic data suggest a nonribosomal biosynthetic origin for marinocyclins. These findings position marinocyclins as a promising new scaffold for antibiotic development and highlight the potential of Aquimarina spp. as a source of novel antibiotics. Further medicinal chemistry optimization of marinocyclins could enhance their prokaryotic selectivity to generate leads for treating infections caused by drug‐resistant pathogens.
title_zh: 来自珊瑚来源细菌的广谱、作用于细胞被膜的Marinocyclin抗生素对粘菌素耐药细菌有效
abstract_zh: 摘要 海洋细菌属 Aquimarina 包含多种成员，具有大量天然产物生物合成基因簇，但特征化合物很少。在这里，我们报告了一类具有特殊抗生素活性的新型脂肽，称为 marinocyclins，从与八珊瑚 Eunicella labiata 相关的 Aquimarina megaterium EL43 中分离出来。主要同源物 marinocyclin A 对多种耐药革兰氏阴性和革兰氏阳性病原体（包括 ESKAPE 细菌）表现出有效且一致的活性。该天然产物有效地破坏了细菌的外膜和内膜，导致细胞快速透化和裂解。这种活性特征是由结合脂多糖、富含细菌膜的阴离子磷脂和肽聚糖前体的能力介导的。真核细胞毒性需要比抗菌活性更高的剂量。基因组数据表明马林环素的非核糖体生物合成起源。这些发现将 marinocyclins 定位为一种有前景的抗生素开发新支架，并凸显了 Aquimarina spp 的潜力。作为新型抗生素的来源。马林环素的进一步药物化学优化可以增强其原核选择性，以产生治疗耐药病原体引起的感染的先导化合物。

title: Crystallization Manipulation Through Buried Pyridinium‐Induced Tunable Interactions in Perovskite Solar Cells
abstract: ABSTRACT The interaction between the hybrid component of self‐assembled monolayers (SAMs) and the perovskite precursor could delay the crystallization process, resulting in high‐quality perovskite film and highly efficient perovskite solar cells (PSCs). However, the intensity of interaction affects more precise control of crystallization speed. Herein, we introduce two pyridinium cation species to compare the intensity of their interaction with iodide. Our systematic investigation reveals that the more electron deficient 1‐methyl‐4‐(trifluoromethyl)pyridinium (CF 3 Py + )‐based hybrid SAM enables a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 27.07% (certified 26.8%) for a 0.06‐cm 2 PSC, surpassing hybrid 1‐methylpyridinium (Py + )‐based device (26.42%) and pure 4PADCB‐based device (25.12%). The impressive PCE stems from fine‐tuning of crystallization speed through more intensive interaction between CF 3 Py + and I − . Moreover, the stronger interaction inhibits iodide migration, which improves the light and thermal stability of the optimized PSCs. Our work demonstrates an effective approach to strengthening the interaction between pyridinium cations and iodide by incorporating an electron‐withdrawing group into the aromatic core, providing crucial insights into the manipulation of perovskite film crystallization.
title_zh: 钙钛矿太阳能电池中通过埋藏吡啶鎓诱导的可调相互作用实现结晶调控
abstract_zh: 摘要 自组装单层（SAM）的混合成分与钙钛矿前驱体之间的相互作用可以延迟结晶过程，从而产生高质量的钙钛矿薄膜和高效的钙钛矿太阳能电池（PSC）。然而，相互作用的强度会影响结晶速度的更精确控制。在这里，我们引入两种吡啶鎓阳离子物种来比较它们与碘化物相互作用的强度。我们的系统研究表明，更缺电子的基于 1-甲基-4-(三氟甲基)吡啶 (CF 3 Py + ) 的混合 SAM 使 0.06 cm 2 PSC 的冠军功率转换效率 (PCE) 达到 27.07%（认证为 26.8%），超过了基于混合 1-甲基吡啶 (Py + ) 的器件 (26.42%) 和纯器件。 4基于PADCB的设备（25.12%）。令人印象深刻的 PCE 源于通过 CF 3 Py + 和 I - 之间更强烈的相互作用来微调结晶速度。此外，更强的相互作用抑制了碘化物的迁移，从而提高了优化PSC的光稳定性和热稳定性。我们的工作展示了一种通过将吸电子基团纳入芳香核来增强吡啶鎓阳离子和碘化物之间相互作用的有效方法，为钙钛矿薄膜结晶的操纵提供了重要的见解。

title: Polypyridyl Coordination Motifs as Precursors for Ordered Carbonaceous Frameworks Toward High‐Density Ru Single‐Atom Catalysts
abstract: ABSTRACT Achieving high‐density single‐atom catalysts (SACs) remains a fundamental challenge, particularly for precious metals such as Ru that readily aggregate under synthetic and catalytic conditions. Here, we report a rational precursor design strategy for fabricating high‐density Ru SACs via direct carbonization, yielding ordered carbonaceous frameworks (Ru‐OCFs) with high Ru loadings of up to 11.0 wt%. By expanding the scope of precursors for OCF synthesis beyond conventional macrocyclic coordination motifs to coordinatively flexible polypyridyl ligands, we show that Ru‐terpyridine crystals with thermally polymerizable ethynyl units serve as effective precursors for immobilizing single‐atomic Ru species within three‐dimensional porous carbon frameworks, without metal aggregation or post‐synthetic treatments. The resulting Ru‐OCFs retain the ordered structure and coordination environment of the precursor crystals while simultaneously developing microporosity with high specific surface areas of up to 670 m 2 g −1 . As a proof of concept, the high‐density isolated Ru sites in Ru‐OCFs enable enhanced catalytic activity in liquid‐phase CO 2 hydrogenation, achieving a high formic acid productivity of up to 19 mmol g cat −1 h −1 , outperforming representative nanoparticle catalysts.
title_zh: 多吡啶配位基序作为有序碳质框架的前体用于高密度Ru单原子催化剂
abstract_zh: 摘要 实现高密度单原子催化剂（SAC）仍然是一个基本挑战，特别是对于像钌这样在合成和催化条件下容易聚集的贵金属。在这里，我们报告了一种合理的前体设计策略，用于通过直接碳化制造高密度Ru SAC，产生高Ru负载量高达11.0 wt%的有序碳质骨架（Ru-OCF）。通过将OCF合成前体的范围从传统的大环配位基序扩展到配位柔性聚吡啶基配体，我们表明具有热聚合乙炔基单元的Ru-三联吡啶晶体可以作为将单原子Ru物质固定在三维多孔碳框架内的有效前体，无需金属聚集或合成后处理。所得的Ru-OCF保留了前体晶体的有序结构和配位环境，同时形成了具有高达670 m 2 g -1 的高比表面积的微孔性。作为概念证明，Ru-OCF 中的高密度孤立 Ru 位点能够增强液相 CO 2 加氢中的催化活性，实现高达 19 mmol g cat -1 h -1 的高甲酸生产率，优于代表性的纳米颗粒催化剂。

title: Dual d– p hybridization in Ternary PtGaGe Enables Concurrent Activity and Stability Enhancement for Alkaline Oxygen Reduction
abstract: ABSTRACT The activity–stability trade‐off in oxygen reduction reactions (ORR) fundamentally limits the practical development of Zinc–air batteries (ZABs) and fuel cells. Here, we address this long‐standing challenge through spatial electronic engineering that enables dual d–p orbital hybridization within a Pt‐based ternary alloy. The resulting PtGaGe catalyst exhibits exceptional alkaline ORR performance, achieving a mass activity of 1.79 A·mg Pt −1 and a half‐wave potential of 0.90 V (vs. RHE)—both surpassing commercial Pt/C and most previously reported Pt‐based catalysts. When integrated into a ZAB, it reaches a peak power density of 207.6 mW·cm −2 and maintains steady operation for over 200 h at 10 mA·cm −2 , highlighting outstanding durability under practical operating conditions. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal that dual d–p hybridization induces spatial electron redistribution between Pt and Ga/Ge sites, modulating the Pt d ‐band center and facilitating O─O bond activation while suppressing catalyst degradation. This synergistic electronic regulation simultaneously improves catalytic activity, stability, and Pt utilization efficiency. This work establishes a mechanistic paradigm for electronic‐structure engineering in high‐performance ORR electrocatalysts.
title_zh: 三元PtGaGe中的d–p双重杂化实现碱性氧还原活性与稳定性的同步提升
abstract_zh: 摘要：氧还原反应（ORR）中活性与稳定性的权衡从根本上限制了锌空气电池（ZAB）和燃料电池的实际发展。在这里，我们通过空间电子工程解决了这一长期存在的挑战，该工程实现了 Pt 基三元合金内的双 d-p 轨道杂化。所得的 PtGaGe 催化剂表现出优异的碱性 ORR 性能，实现了 1.79 A·mg Pt -1 的质量活性和 0.90 V 的半波电位（相对于 RHE）——均超过了商业 Pt/C 和大多数先前报道的 Pt 基催化剂。当集成到ZAB中时，其峰值功率密度达到207.6 mW·cm -2 ，并在10 mA·cm -2 下保持稳定运行超过200小时，突出了在实际操作条件下出色的耐用性。密度泛函理论（DFT）计算表明，双 d-p 杂化会诱导 Pt 和 Ga/Ge 位点之间的空间电子重新分布，调节 Pt d 带中心并促进 O─O 键活化，同时抑制催化剂降解。这种协同电子调节同时提高了催化活性、稳定性和铂利用效率。这项工作为高性能 ORR 电催化剂的电子结构工程建立了机械范式。

title: Noncanonical Peloruside A Biosynthesis by an Uncultivated Verrucomicrobiota Symbiont
abstract: ABSTRACT Peloruside A, a polyketide macrolide identified in the marine sponge Mycale hentscheli , is a promising anticancer drug candidate due to its ability to stabilize tubulin at a nontaxoid binding site. Substantial efforts were made to improve the supply of this scarce substance through chemical synthesis and mariculture, however, sustainable production has yet to be achieved. Recent microbiome sequencing suggested that bacterial producers are responsible for all M. hentscheli bioactive compounds, but the identity of the peloruside producer remained unknown. Furthermore, a candidate peloruside polyketide synthase (PKS) was identified in silico, but its highly aberrant architecture prevented a confident biosynthetic prediction for the pharmacologically important exocyclic double bond. Here, we reveal an unusually complex modular PKS pathway comprising nonelongating ketosynthases (KSs), two internal thioesterases (TEs), and an acetyl coenzyme A ligase that orchestrate O ‐acetylation/elimination, acetyl‐CoA recycling, and configurational proof‐reading to facilitate selective Z ‐double bond incorporation. The first internal TE falls into a previously characterized O ‐acylating TE family but contains key amino acid substitutions that facilitate bifunctional acylation/elimination activity. Furthermore, we identified the peloruside producer as ‘ Candidatus Pelorusia occulta’, a member of the biochemically underexplored Lentisphaeria class within the phylum Verrucomicrobiota. This work provides the biochemical and microbiological foundation for heterologous peloruside production.
title_zh: 未培养疣微菌门共生体的非经典Peloruside A生物合成
abstract_zh: 摘要 Peloruside A 是一种在海洋海绵 Mycale hentscheli 中发现的聚酮化合物大环内酯，由于其能够稳定非紫杉烷结合位点的微管蛋白，因此是一种有前途的抗癌药物候选物。人们做出了大量努力，通过化学合成和海水养殖来改善这种稀缺物质的供应，但尚未实现可持续生产。最近的微生物组测序表明，细菌生产者负责所有 M. hentscheli 生物活性化合物的产生，但 Peloruside 生产者的身份仍然未知。此外，在计算机中鉴定了一种候选的盘苷聚酮合酶（PKS），但其高度异常的结构阻碍了对药理学上重要的环外双键的可靠生物合成预测。在这里，我们揭示了一个异常复杂的模块化 PKS 途径，包括非延长酮合酶 (KS)、两种内部硫酯酶 (TE) 和乙酰辅酶 A 连接酶，该连接酶协调 ​​O 乙酰化/消除、乙酰辅酶 A 回收和构型校对以促进选择性 Z 双键掺入。第一个内部 TE 属于先前表征的 O 酰化 TE 家族，但包含促进双功能酰化/消除活性的关键氨基酸取代。此外，我们确定了 Peloruside 的生产者为“Candidatus Pelorusia oculta”，它是疣微生物门中生化尚未充分探索的 Lentisphaeria 类的成员。本工作为异源海藻苷的生产提供了生化和微生物学基础。

title: The Creation of a Dual‐End Interface in Li─S Cathode by Anchoring Independent Metal Atoms on Graphdiyne
abstract: ABSTRACT Conventional strategies to address sluggish polysulfide conversion and the shuttle effect have primarily focused on interactions between sulfur anions and catalytic centers, while largely neglecting the enrichment and transport of lithium ions at the cathode. Herein, we report a niobium (Nb) atomic catalyst anchored on graphdiyne (Nb‐GDY) that enables a unique dual‐end binding mechanism for the simultaneous regulation of polysulfide conversion and lithium‐ion transport kinetics. Density functional theory calculations reveal pronounced electronic coupling between Nb─S and Li─C pairs, creating synergistic binding sites that immobilize LiPSs while lowering the energy barriers for their transformation. This mechanism is corroborated by x‐ray photoelectron spectroscopy and comprehensive in situ characterizations, which demonstrate significantly accelerated electrode kinetics and efficient Li + flux. Consequently, the Nb‐GDY‐based cathode exhibits exceptional high‐rate capability and long‐term durability, achieving a high capacity of 724 mAh g −1 at 10 C and maintaining stable operation over 1200 cycles at 5 C with a low‐capacity decay of 0.025% per cycle. Our research ingeniously combines dual ends binding, activating the synergistic interaction between atoms and the substrate, providing a new concept for the management of multi‐species transport for high energy density Li−S batteries.
title_zh: 通过在石墨炔上锚定独立金属原子在Li─S正极中构建双端界面
abstract_zh: 摘要 解决多硫化物转化缓慢和穿梭效应的传统策略主要集中在硫阴离子和催化中心之间的相互作用，而很大程度上忽视了锂离子在阴极的富集和传输。在此，我们报告了一种锚定在石墨二炔（Nb-GDY）上的铌（Nb）原子催化剂，它能够实现独特的双端结合机制，用于同时调节多硫化物转化和锂离子传输动力学。密度泛函理论计算揭示了 Nb─S 和 Li─C 对之间明显的电子耦合，产生了协同结合位点，固定 LiPS，同时降低其转化的能垒。这种机制得到了 X 射线光电子能谱和综合原位表征的证实，证明了电极动力学的显着加速和高效的 Li + 通量。因此，Nb-GDY基正极表现出优异的高倍率性能和长期耐久性，在10 C下实现了724 mAh g -1 的高容量，并在5 C下保持稳定运行超过1200个循环，每个循环的容量衰减为0.025%。我们的研究巧妙地结合了双端结合，激活了原子与基底之间的协同相互作用，为高能量密度Li−S电池的多物种传输管理提供了新概念。

title: Achieve the Full‐Wavelength Photoexcited Pyroelectricity in Perovskite Ferroelectric for Long‐Wave Infrared Detection
abstract: ABSTRACT Ferroelectric materials have emerged as a promising class of optoelectronic candidates, due to their strong light‐polarization couplings that lead to fascinating physical attributes. Especially, photoexcited pyroelectricity originating from light‐induced variation of spontaneous polarization ( P s ) holds potentials for ultra‐broadband photodetection even up to long‐wave infrared optical region. For the first time, we present the full‐wavelength switchable photoexcited pyroelectric effects in a two‐dimensional perovskite ferroelectric, (4‐ethylanilinium) 2 (ethylammonium) 2 Pb 3 Br 10 ( 1 ), covering ultraviolet to long‐wave infrared spectral range. It is a high‐temperature ferroelectric ( T c = 390 K) with superior pyroelectricity, including large pyroelectric coefficients and figure‐of‐merits. Strikingly, robust full‐wavelength photoexcited pyroelectric responses are obtained in 1 under irradiation from ultraviolet (266 nm) to long‐wave infrared (12.5 µm) region, far beyond its intrinsic optical bandgap. These P s ‐dependent photoactivities can be electrically switched and controlled by electric poling. Thus, crystal‐based device of 1 allows ultrabroadband photodetection, as verified by highly‐sensitive response to human radiation. As the first report on full‐wavelength photoexcited pyroelectricity in perovskite ferroelectrics, our study highlights a promising strategy for new‐generation broadband optoelectronic devices.
title_zh: 在钙钛矿铁电体中实现全波长光激发热电用于长波红外探测
abstract_zh: 摘要：铁电材料已成为一类有前途的光电候选材料，因为它们具有强光偏振耦合，可产生令人着迷的物理属性。特别是，源自光致自发偏振（ P s ）变化的光激发热释电具有超宽带光电探测甚至长波红外光学区域的潜力。我们首次在二维钙钛矿铁电体 (4-乙基苯胺) 2 (乙基铵) 2 Pb 3 Br 10 (1) 中呈现全波长可切换的光生热释电效应，覆盖紫外到长波红外光谱范围。它是一种高温铁电体（T c = 390 K），具有优异的热电性，包括大的热电系数和品质因数。引人注目的是，在从紫外线（266 nm）到长波红外（12.5 µm）区域的照射下，1 中获得了鲁棒的全波长光激发热释电响应，远远超出了其固有的光学带隙。这些 P s 依赖的光活性可以通过电极化进行电切换和控制。因此，基于晶体的器件 1 可以实现超宽带光电探测，这一点已通过对人体辐射的高灵敏响应得到验证。作为第一份关于钙钛矿铁电体全波长光激发热释电的报告，我们的研究强调了新一代宽带光电器件的一种有前景的策略。

title: Reversible Symmetry Switching, Giant Birefringence, and UV Second‐Harmonic Generation in Hybrid Niobium Oxyfluorides
abstract: ABSTRACT Birefringent crystals that simultaneously exhibit large optical anisotropy and wide band gaps are highly desirable for advanced photonic technologies, yet these properties are often mutually constrained because structural features that enhance birefringence often compromise optical transparency. Herein, we report four new hybrid niobium oxyfluoride phenanthroline compounds, [Hphen]NbOF 4 ∙H 2 O ( NP1 ), α‐[Hphen]NbOF 4 ( NP2 ), β‐[Hphen]NbOF 4 ( NP3 ), and [Hphen] 2 NbOF 5 ( NP4 ), obtained through systematic variation of synthetic conditions. Thermal dehydration of centrosymmetric hydrated phase NP1 yields noncentrosymmetric (NCS) dehydrated phase NP2 through reversible crystal‐to‐crystal transformation, with birefringence increasing from 0.354 to 0.419 at 546 nm. Further optimization affords NP3 , which exhibits an enhanced second‐harmonic generation (SHG) response of 1.2 × KDP, compared with 0.09 × KDP for NP2 . Strikingly, transformation from a one‐dimensional chain‐type niobium oxyfluoride framework ( NP1–NP3 ) to a zero‐dimensional structure of isolated NbOF 5 units ( NP4 ) removes geometric constraints on phenanthroline alignment, enabling near‐coplanar arrangement of π‐conjugated chromophores and a record‐high birefringence of 0.618 at 546 nm for a Nb‐based crystal. All four compounds retain wide optical band gaps of 3.2–3.3 eV, demonstrating that giant birefringence and UV transparency are simultaneously achievable within a single material family. These results establish framework dimensionality as a viable strategy for overcoming the trade‐off between optical anisotropy and transparency.
title_zh: 混合铌氧化物氟化物中的可逆对称性切换、巨双折射与紫外二次谐波产生
abstract_zh: 摘要：同时表现出大光学各向异性和宽带隙的双折射晶体对于先进光子技术来说是非常理想的，但这些特性通常是相互制约的，因为增强双折射的结构特征通常会损害光学透明度。在此，我们报告了四种新的杂化铌氟氧化物菲咯啉化合物，[Hphen]NbOF 4 ∙H 2 O ( NP1 )、α-[Hphen]NbOF 4 ( NP2 )、β-[Hphen]NbOF 4 ( NP3 ) 和 [Hphen] 2 NbOF 5 ( NP4 )，这是通过合成条件的系统变化获得的。中心对称水合相 NP1 的热脱水通过可逆晶体间转变产生非中心对称（NCS）脱水相 NP2，双折射率在 546 nm 处从 0.354 增加到 0.419。进一步优化后的 NP3 表现出 1.2 × KDP 的增强二次谐波生成 (SHG) 响应，而 NP2 的二次谐波生成 (SHG) 响应为 0.09 × KDP。引人注目的是，从一维链型氟氧化铌骨架（NP1-NP3）到孤立NbOF 5 单元（NP4）的零维结构的转变消除了菲咯啉排列的几何限制，实现了π共轭发色团的近共面排列以及铌基晶体在546 nm处创纪录的高双折射率0.618。所有四种化合物都保留了 3.2-3.3 eV 的宽光学带隙，表明在单一材料系列中可以同时实现巨大的双折射和紫外线透明度。这些结果将框架维度确立为克服选择之间权衡的可行策略

title: The Achilles’ Heel of Lithium‐Ion Batteries: Protonic Species
abstract: ABSTRACT Lithium‐ion batteries (LIBs) are central to the global energy transition, dominating the markets for electric vehicles and grid‐scale renewable energy storage. However, as LIBs are pushed toward their theoretical energy density limits to meet ever‐escalating performance demands, they are confronted with challenges to their intrinsic operational safety and long‐term cycling stability. In recent years, protonic species within LIBs have been increasingly recognized as critical drivers of accelerated cell degradation and premature failure. In this contribution, we first recapitulate the diverse sources and generation pathways of protonic species, with a particular emphasis on the chemical and electrochemical oxidation of state‐of‐the‐art carbonate‐based electrolytes. Subsequently, we elucidate the proton‐mediated failure network and associated self‐amplifying proton‐regeneration cycle, including electrolyte degradation and proton‐driven parasitic interfacial side reactions at both the anode‐ and cathode‐electrolyte interphases. Furthermore, we highlight critical advancements in in situ/operando characterization techniques for elucidating the sources and degradation mechanisms of protonic species, and propose a mitigation framework centered on proton source suppression and proton scavenging strategies. Finally, we pinpoint unresolved challenges and outline prospective research directions in this field. This contribution establishes critical connections between fundamental proton chemistry and failure modes, which will provide key strategic guidelines toward durable and safe high‐energy‐density LIBs.
title_zh: 锂离子电池的阿喀琉斯之踵:质子物种
abstract_zh: 摘要 锂离子电池（LIB）是全球能源转型的核心，主导着电动汽车和电网规模可再生能源存储市场。然而，随着锂离子电池被推向理论能量密度极限以满足不断升级的性能需求，它们面临着本质操作安全性和长期循环稳定性的挑战。近年来，人们越来越认识到锂离子电池中的质子是加速电池退化和过早失效的关键驱动因素。在这篇文章中，我们首先概述了质子物质的不同来源和生成途径，特别强调了最先进的碳酸盐基电解质的化学和电化学氧化。随后，我们阐明了质子介导的失效网络和相关的自放大质子再生循环，包括阳极和阴极电解质界面处的电解质降解和质子驱动的寄生界面副反应。此外，我们强调了原位/操作表征技术的关键进展，用于阐明质子物质的来源和降解机制，并提出了一个以质子源抑制和质子清除策略为中心的缓解框架。最后，我们指出了尚未解决的挑战并概述了该领域的前瞻性研究方向。这一贡献在基本质子化学和失效模式之间建立了关键联系，这将为持久和可靠的关键战略指导提供依据。

title: Interaction Between Three‐Dimensional Topological Spin Textures With Layer‐Dependent Sign Change Tunes Lattice Symmetry
abstract: ABSTRACT Three‐dimensional (3D) topological spin textures host rich internal structures in thickness dimensions and enable emergent topological phenomena. However, whether their layer‐resolved textures and internal singularities fundamentally modify intralayer interactions lies beyond rigid‐tube interaction models and remains unexplored. Here we show that, in 3D hybrid skyrmion‐antiskyrmion strings, the layer‐dependent topology gives rise to interactions with a sign change across the film thickness, producing a switch between attraction and repulsion both among different layers within each texture and between neighboring 3D strings. This vertically asymmetric attractive‐repulsive interaction drives a tunable transition between square and triangular string lattices, in agreement with our experiment. Computational simulations identify quadrupolar Bloch points as internal topological junctions whose vertical migration mediates the intralayer competition between repulsive skyrmion segments near the surfaces and attractive antiskyrmion segments in the interior. We further show that the averaged topological charge quantifies the relative thickness fractions of the two competing topological segments and robustly captures the lattice phase boundary over a broad range of magnetic parameters. These findings highlight the importance of the surface‐bulk difference in topological materials and establish vertically asymmetric interactions as an intrinsic mechanism for topological phase control in 3D magnetic systems.
title_zh: 具有层依赖符号变化的三维拓扑自旋织构之间的相互作用调控晶格对称性
abstract_zh: 摘要：三维（3D）拓扑自旋纹理在厚度维度上拥有丰富的内部结构，并能够实现新兴的拓扑现象。然而，它们的层解析纹理和内部奇点是否从根本上改变了层内相互作用超出了刚性管相互作用模型的范围，仍未得到探索。在这里，我们表明，在 3D 混合斯格明子-反斯格明子弦中，依赖于层的拓扑会引起整个薄膜厚度上符号变化的相互作用，从而在每个纹理内的不同层之间以及相邻 3D 弦之间产生吸引力和排斥力之间的切换。这种垂直不对称的吸引-排斥相互作用驱动方形和三角形弦晶格之间的可调过渡，与我们的实验一致。计算模拟将四极布洛赫点识别为内部拓扑连接点，其垂直迁移介导表面附近的排斥斯格明子片段与内部有吸引力的反斯格明子片段之间的层内竞争。我们进一步表明，平均拓扑电荷量化了两个竞争拓扑段的相对厚度分数，并在广泛的磁参数范围内稳健地捕获晶格相界。这些发现强调了拓扑材料中表面体积差异的重要性，并将垂直不对称相互作用确立为 3D 磁系统中拓扑相位控制的内在机制。

title: Polar Wurtzite NbAlN: A Transition‐Metal Nitride Alloy for Polarization‐Engineered GaN Heterostructures
abstract: ABSTRACT The discovery of ferroelectric ScAlN sparked a search for new polar wurtzite alloys; however, incorporating transition metals remains a formidable challenge. Here, we demonstrate the synthesis of wurtzite‐phase NbAlN, a polar transition‐metal nitride alloy that is highly compatible with GaN‐based heterostructures. Despite the strong metallic character of elemental Nb, we achieved coherent epitaxial NbAlN films that preserve the wurtzite crystal structure and metal polarity of the underlying GaN, as directly visualized by annular bright‐field scanning transmission electron microscopy. Nb incorporation induces a monotonic lattice expansion and produces coherent Nb‐enriched nanoscale regions that are accommodated within the continuous wurtzite framework. Functionally, NbAlN barriers induce a substantial enhancement in the two‐dimensional electron gas density at the AlN/GaN heterointerface, consistent with polarization‐related carrier modulation by the metal‐polar NbAlN barrier. This study demonstrates that d ‐electron transition metals can be integrated into polar nitride systems without compromising their functional asymmetry, making NbAlN a promising building block for polar nitride heterostructures and carrier‐density‐engineered GaN electronics.
title_zh: 极性纤锌矿NbAlN:用于极化工程GaN异质结构的过渡金属氮化物合金
abstract_zh: 摘要 铁电 ScAlN 的发现引发了对新型极性纤锌矿合金的探索；然而，掺入过渡金属仍然是一项艰巨的挑战。在这里，我们演示了纤锌矿相 NbAlN 的合成，这是一种与 GaN 基异质结构高度兼容的极性过渡金属氮化物合金。尽管元素 Nb 具有很强的金属特性，我们还是获得了相干外延 NbAlN 薄膜，该薄膜保留了纤锌矿晶体结构和底层 GaN 的金属极性，如环形明场扫描透射电子显微镜直接观察到的那样。铌的掺入会引起单调晶格膨胀，并产生相干的富铌纳米级区域，这些区域容纳在连续的纤锌矿框架内。从功能上讲，NbAlN 势垒引起 AlN/GaN 异质界面处二维电子气密度的显着增强，这与金属极性 NbAlN 势垒的极化相关载流子调制一致。这项研究表明，d 电子过渡金属可以集成到极性氮化物系统中，而不会影响其功能不对称性，使 NbAlN 成为极性氮化物异质结构和载流子密度设计的 GaN 电子器件的有前途的构建模块。

title: Spontaneous polarization in chemical vapor–deposited polymer films creates large electric fields
abstract: Controlled surface potentials in permanently polarized polymer films are of increasing interest for electronics, sensing, and biomedical devices. Conventional polymer films require external electric fields or postdeposition treatments, limiting precision and scalability. Here, we report a spontaneous polarization in polymer thin films polymerized through initiated chemical vapor deposition (iCVD). Surface potentials emerge spontaneously during film growth, scale linearly with film thickness, and remain stable under ambient conditions. Their magnitude is tunable through deposition parameters, and polymerization initiator choice determines the polarity. The solvent-free, single-step iCVD process enables mechanically robust, uniform coatings on complex geometries and large areas. Our findings establish a simple, versatile route to intrinsically polarized polymer films without postprocessing, opening new opportunities for direct integration of electric fields into functional devices or surface-driven processes at the nanoscale.
title_zh: 化学气相沉积聚合物薄膜中的自发极化产生强大电场
abstract_zh: 永久极化聚合物薄膜中受控的表面电势越来越受到电子、传感和生物医学设备的关注。传统的聚合物薄膜需要外部电场或沉积后处理，限制了精度和可扩展性。在这里，我们报告了通过引发化学气相沉积（iCVD）聚合的聚合物薄膜的自发极化。表面电势在薄膜生长过程中自发出现，与薄膜厚度成线性比例，并在环境条件下保持稳定。它们的大小可通过沉积参数调节，聚合引发剂的选择决定极性。无溶剂、单步 iCVD 工艺可在复杂的几何形状和大面积上实现机械坚固、均匀的涂层。我们的研究结果建立了一种简单、通用的途径，无需后处理即可获得本质偏振聚合物薄膜，为将电场直接集成到纳米级功能器件或表面驱动过程中提供了新的机会。

title: Conformational asymmetry of replicated human chromosomes
abstract: DNA replication generates sister chromatids with identical sequence, yet its mechanism is fundamentally asymmetric: Chromatids inherit strands of opposite orientation, whereas forks synthesize new strands by distinct leading- and lagging-strand mechanisms. How this replication asymmetry affects chromosome organization is unknown. Using sister chromatid–sensitive conformation analysis, we found that human sister chromatids are consistently misaligned in the 5′→3′ direction of inherited DNA strands. This shift persisted without cohesin-mediated loop extrusion but was lost upon disruption of cohesion. Polymer modeling showed that modest directional misalignment of cohesive cohesins can explain the observed shift, and we propose two models for how such misalignment could originate from replication fork asymmetry. This register shift between sister chromatids has implications for homology search during DNA repair.
title_zh: 复制后人类染色体的构象不对称性
abstract_zh: DNA复制产生具有相同序列的姐妹染色单体，但其机制基本上是不对称的：染色单体继承相反方向的链，而分叉通过不同的前导链和滞后链机制合成新链。这种复制不对称如何影响染色体组织尚不清楚。通过姐妹染色单体敏感构象分析，我们发现人类姐妹染色单体在遗传 DNA 链的 5′→3′ 方向上始终错位。这种转变在没有粘连蛋白介导的环挤出的情况下持续存在，但在粘连破坏时消失。聚合物模型表明，粘性粘连蛋白的适度方向错位可以解释观察到的转变，并且我们提出了两种模型来解释这种错位如何源于复制叉不对称。姐妹染色单体之间的这种寄存器转移对于 DNA 修复期间的同源性搜索具有影响。

title: Tumor-derived antioxidants suppress immunity by depriving T cells of reactive oxygen species
abstract: Reactive oxygen species (ROS) promote genomic instability and fuel oncogenic signaling in cancer, but antioxidant therapies have so far failed to improve, or worsen, cancer outcomes. Emerging data suggest that T cells depend on ROS for signal transduction. In this study, we show that tumors exploit this dependency, releasing antioxidant enzymes into the tumor environment to suppress T cell–mediated antitumor immunity. The interstitial fluid of tumors possesses potent antioxidant activity, associated with enrichment of the antioxidant enzyme peroxiredoxin 1 (PRDX1). Extracellular PRDX1 deprives T cells of ROS, preventing oxidative inactivation of phosphatases required for T cell receptor–driven kinase signaling and effector function. Prdx1 is up-regulated upon cancer immunoediting, and loss of PRDX1 within tumors enhances antitumor immunity and immunotherapy responses. These findings define a redox-dependent mechanism of tumor immunosuppression that is potentially amenable to therapeutic intervention.
title_zh: 肿瘤来源的抗氧化剂通过剥夺T细胞的活性氧抑制免疫
abstract_zh: 活性氧（ROS）会促进基因组不稳定性并促进癌症中的致癌信号传导，但抗氧化疗法迄今为止未能改善或恶化癌症结果。新数据表明，T 细胞依赖 ROS 进行信号转导。在这项研究中，我们证明肿瘤利用这种依赖性，将抗氧化酶释放到肿瘤环境中来抑制 T 细胞介导的抗肿瘤免疫。肿瘤间质液具有强大的抗氧化活性，与抗氧化酶过氧化还原蛋白 1 (PRDX1) 的富集有关。细胞外 PRDX1 剥夺 T 细胞的 ROS，防止 T 细胞受体驱动的激酶信号传导和效应器功能所需的磷酸酶氧化失活。 Prdx1 在癌症免疫编辑时上调，肿瘤内 PRDX1 的缺失可增强抗肿瘤免疫力和免疫治疗反应。这些发现定义了肿瘤免疫抑制的氧化还原依赖性机制，该机制可能适合治疗干预。

title: Spatially resolved single-cell atlas reveals the macroevolutionary trajectory of animal hearts
abstract: Animal hearts display diverse anatomical structures during adaptive evolution. Here, we present a multiomics atlas of adult hearts from 27 species across chordates, arthropods, and mollusks. Joint analysis indicates that Bilateria hearts share a core gene repertoire, taking a stepwise “add-on” approach as a universal evolutionary strategy. The “proto-heart” is populated by key cell types, including cardiomyocytes, fibroblasts, endothelial cells, and neural cells, which maintained core signatures while evolving with shifts in living environments and corresponding adaptations in the cardiovascular system. Additionally, we reveal an evolutionarily conserved cardiomyocyte state dynamic potentially linked to cardiac development and stress responses. Finally, we identify a common molecular program underpinning chamber evolution from a ventricular foundation. This work establishes a resource for understanding the intrinsic mechanisms of heart evolution.
title_zh: 空间分辨的单细胞图谱揭示动物心脏的宏观演化轨迹
abstract_zh: 动物心脏在适应性进化过程中表现出不同的解剖结构。在这里，我们展示了来自脊索动物、节肢动物和软体动物 27 个物种的成年心脏的多组学图谱。联合分析表明，双边对称动物心脏共享一个核心基因库，采用逐步“附加”方法作为通用进化策略。 “原心脏”由关键细胞类型组成，包括心肌细胞、成纤维细胞、内皮细胞和神经细胞，它们在随着生活环境的变化和心血管系统的相应适应而进化的同时保持核心特征。此外，我们揭示了进化上保守的心肌细胞状态动态可能与心脏发育和应激反应相关。最后，我们确定了一个共同的分子程序，支持心室从心室基础演化而来。这项工作为理解心脏进化的内在机制建立了资源。

title: Helium escaping from the atmosphere of a nearby rocky exoplanet orbiting in a habitable zone
abstract: Observations of highly irradiated gas giant exoplanets have shown helium escaping from their atmospheres. There is limited evidence for atmospheres on rocky exoplanets, perhaps because they have already escaped. We report near-infrared spectroscopic observations of LHS 1140b, a rocky exoplanet that orbits in the habitable zone of a nearby low-mass star. The transit spectra show absorption by helium escaping from the planet’s atmosphere. Helium absorption is detected in 2024 but not in 2025, indicating time-variable atmospheric escape. We interpret these results as indicating an upper atmosphere dominated by helium and depleted in hydrogen, with other volatile species trapped at lower altitudes, which is consistent with atmospheric fractionation models. No helium absorption is detected for LHS 1140c, a smaller and more strongly irradiated exoplanet in the same system.
title_zh: 氦气从附近一颗位于宜居带的岩石系外行星大气中逃逸
abstract_zh: 对高辐射气态巨行星的观测表明，氦气从其大气层中逸出。关于岩石系外行星上存在大气层的证据有限，也许是因为它们已经逃逸了。我们报告了 LHS 1140b 的近红外光谱观测，这是一颗在附近低质量恒星的宜居带内运行的岩石系外行星。传输光谱显示了从行星大气层逸出的氦气的吸收。 2024 年检测到氦吸收，但 2025 年未检测到，这表明大气逃逸随时间变化。我们将这些结果解释为表明高层大气以氦为主且氢贫乏，其他挥发性物质被困在较低海拔，这与大气分馏模型一致。 LHS 1140c 是同一系统中一颗更小、辐射更强烈的系外行星，没有检测到氦吸收。

title: Programmable design of synthetic plant immune receptors for pathogen protein recognition
abstract: The limited diversity and recognition scope of natural plant immune receptors impede resistance breeding against rapidly evolving pathogens. Here, we report the programmable design of synthetic plant immune receptors (SPIRs). De novo–designed binding modules targeting pathogen proteins were grafted into the integrated decoy domain of a plant immune receptor. SPIRs recognized proteins derived from viral, bacterial, fungal, and oomycete pathogens. Their performance was improved by combining artificial intelligence–guided protein design with in planta–directed evolution, enhancing immune activation while reducing autoactivation. The SPIRs exhibited high target specificity and could be stacked for multiplexed recognition of pathogen proteins. Viral-targeting SPIRs responded to infectious clones of plant viruses, and transgenic plants expressing SPIRs conferred disease resistance. This work establishes a versatile platform for the efficient engineering of plant immunity.
title_zh: 用于病原菌蛋白识别的合成植物免疫受体的可编程设计
abstract_zh: 天然植物免疫受体的多样性和识别范围有限，阻碍了针对快速进化的病原体的抗性育种。在这里，我们报告了合成植物免疫受体（SPIR）的可编程设计。从头设计的针对病原体蛋白的结合模块被移植到植物免疫受体的整合诱饵结构域中。 SPIR 可识别源自病毒、细菌、真菌和卵菌病原体的蛋白质。通过将人工智能引导的蛋白质设计与植物定向进化相结合，增强了免疫激活，同时减少了自身激活，从而提高了它们的性能。 SPIR 表现出高度的靶标特异性，并且可以堆叠用于病原体蛋白的多重识别。病毒靶向 SPIR 对植物病毒的感染性克隆做出反应，而表达 SPIR 的转基因植物则具有抗病性。这项工作为植物免疫的有效工程建立了一个多功能平台。

title: Autothermal methane pyrolysis: Scalable heat integration for hydrogen and graphite production
abstract: Methane pyrolysis (MP) offers a compelling opportunity to meet low-carbon hydrogen demand using existing energy infrastructure. A key limitation in scaling MP is the efficient delivery of high-temperature heat into the reactor. We show that hydrogen-fueled autothermal operation overcomes this limitation, enabling an increase of several orders of magnitude in the reactor throughput for commercially relevant bed diameters. It also yields a carbon coproduct of 96.0% degrees of graphitization, meeting graphite precursor specifications and enabling domestic graphite production from natural gas using low-cost iron oxide catalysts. We further demonstrate a strategy to suppress the direct emissions inherent to autothermal operation, reducing them to near zero. A process-level life cycle assessment estimates that carbon intensities for autothermal methane pyrolysis can be as low as 1.9 to 4.5 kilograms (kg) of CO 2,eq per kg H 2 .
title_zh: 自热甲烷热解：面向氢气和石墨生产的规模化热集成
abstract_zh: 甲烷热解（MP）提供了利用现有能源基础设施满足低碳氢需求的绝佳机会。扩展 MP 的一个关键限制是将高温热量有效地输送到反应器中。我们表明，氢燃料自热操作克服了这一限制，使得商业相关床直径的反应器吞吐量增加了几个数量级。它还产生石墨化度为 96.0% 的碳副产品，满足石墨前体规格，并能够使用低成本氧化铁催化剂从天然气中生产国内石墨。我们进一步展示了一种抑制自热操作固有的直接排放的策略，将其减少到接近零。过程级生命周期评估估计，自热甲烷热解的碳强度可低至每千克 H 2 1.9 至 4.5 千克 (kg) CO 2,eq。

title: (Un)intended consequences of mass-prescribing GLP-1s
abstract: It is difficult to overstate how much glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) pharmacotherapies have inundated the public discourse on obesity. An avalanche of scientific papers, news articles, and social media posts debate the efficacy, affordability, and appropriateness of GLP-1 receptor agonists not just for obesity but also skin disease, erectile dysfunction, pregnancy, and addiction. Attempting to cut through the noise, the World Health Organization (WHO) recently published the first-ever global guidelines recommending GLP-1s for the treatment of obesity, while committing to develop a global framework ensuring “fair access” to these medicines for the 1 billion people affected worldwide. Going deeper, the guidelines also advocate for “robust populationlevel policies” to address the root causes of obesity in unhealthy food environments. However, to complicate these efforts, WHO’s recommendations unfold at a time rife with competitive pressures among pharmaceutical companies, food companies vying for the GLP-1 market segment, and wellness companies promoting supplements and telemedicine programs for what is being billed as a GLP-1 lifestyle. This commercial milieu is ripe for unintended consequences that conspire against fair access to these medicines.
title_zh: 大规模开具GLP-1s处方的（非）预期后果
abstract_zh: 胰高血糖素样肽-1 (GLP-1) 药物疗法已经淹没了有关肥胖的公众讨论，这一点都不为过。大量的科学论文、新闻文章和社交媒体帖子争论 GLP-1 受体激动剂的功效、可负担性和适当性，不仅可以治疗肥胖，还可以治疗皮肤病、勃起功能障碍、怀孕和成瘾。为了消除噪音，世界卫生组织 (WHO) 最近发布了首个全球指南，推荐 GLP-1 治疗肥胖，同时承诺制定一个全球框架，确保全球 10 亿受影响人群“公平获得”这些药物。更深入地说，该指南还倡导“强有力的人口政策”，以解决不健康食品环境中肥胖的根本原因。然而，使这些努力变得复杂的是，世卫组织的建议是在制药公司、争夺 GLP-1 细分市场的食品公司以及为所谓的 GLP-1 生活方式推广补充剂和远程医疗计划的健康公司之间充满竞争压力的时候提出的。这种商业环境很容易产生意想不到的后果，从而阻碍公平获得这些药物。

title: High-capacity associative memory in a quantum-optical spin glass
abstract: The Hopfield neural network stores memories using all-to-all-coupled spins and recalls those memories through equilibrium dynamics. Storing too many hampers recall because frustration causes an exponential number of spurious patterns to arise as the network becomes a spin glass. Despite this, memory recall can be restored, and even enhanced, under quantum-optical nonequilibrium dynamics because spurious patterns can now serve as reliable memories. We experimentally observe associative memory with high storage capacity in a driven-dissipative spin glass made of atoms and photons. The capacity surpasses that of the Hopfield model under Hebbian learning by up to seven-fold in a sixteen-spin network. Atomic motion boosts capacity by dynamically modifying connectivity akin to short-term synaptic plasticity in neural networks, realizing a precursor to learning in a quantum-optical system.
title_zh: 量子光学自旋玻璃中的高容量联想记忆
abstract_zh: Hopfield 神经网络使用全耦合自旋来存储记忆，并通过平衡动力学调用这些记忆。存储太多会妨碍回忆，因为当网络变成旋转玻璃时，挫折会导致指数数量的虚假模式出现。尽管如此，在量子光学非平衡动力学下，记忆回忆可以恢复，甚至增强，因为虚假模式现在可以充当可靠的记忆。我们通过实验观察了由原子和光子制成的驱动耗散自旋玻璃中具有高存储容量的联想存储器。在十六旋转网络中，其容量比 Hebbian 学习下的 Hopfield 模型高出七倍。原子运动通过动态修改类似于神经网络中短期突触可塑性的连接性来提高容量，从而实现了量子光学系统中学习的先驱。

title: Rising plant extinction rates on European mountain summits
abstract: Climate change increases plant species richness in alpine ecosystems. However, to what extent this diversity enrichment masks extinction dynamics of resident species remains elusive. In this study, we used floristic resurvey data from 896 permanent vegetation plots across 62 European mountain summits to show that local extinctions have increased over the past 21 years. Extinction rates rose with the magnitude of warming, and species were more likely to go extinct toward their low-elevation range margins and in communities undergoing stronger thermophilization. Moreover, local extinctions were significantly related to preceding abundance declines, which can serve as an early warning signal. These findings suggest that despite increasing plant species richness, plant assemblages above the treeline face an accelerating but so far neglected loss of their most characteristic species.
title_zh: 欧洲山顶植物灭绝速率上升
abstract_zh: 气候变化增加了高山生态系统中植物物种的丰富度。然而，这种多样性丰富在多大程度上掩盖了常驻物种的灭绝动态仍然难以捉摸。在这项研究中，我们使用了欧洲 62 个山峰 896 个永久植被地块的植物区系再调查数据，结果表明，过去 21 年来，局部物种灭绝有所增加。灭绝率随着变暖的程度而上升，物种更有可能在低海拔范围边缘和经历更强的嗜热作用的群落中灭绝。此外，局部灭绝与之前的丰度下降显着相关，这可以作为早期预警信号。这些发现表明，尽管植物物种丰富度不断增加，但林线以上的植物群落面临着其最具特征物种的加速但迄今为止被忽视的损失。

title: Lenacapavir binding to immature Gag induces giant virions and causes protease-dependent inhibition of viral release
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Lenacapavir (LEN), a potent capsid inhibitor, suppresses reverse transcription and nuclear import by disrupting capsid core formation in HIV type 1 (HIV-1). However, its effects on late-stage viral assembly remain unclear. Although p24 ELISA suggested that LEN substantially inhibited HIV-1, both RT-dPCR and Vpr-HiBiT assays indicated that suppression of viral release required relatively high LEN concentrations. This discrepancy was attributed to LEN-induced reduction in p24 solubility, leading to an overestimation of its inhibitory effect on viral release. In addition, excessive intracellular Gag processing by the viral protease was observed in the presence of LEN, which contributed to impaired viral release. Furthermore, LEN induced numerous abnormal, discrete clusters of Gag at the plasma membrane. Using mass photometry, which was applied to analyze HIV-1 particle sizes, and transmission electron microscopy, we identified heterogeneous LEN-induced viral-like particles (LENiVLPs; diameter >200 nm) containing both Gag and Env proteins. Although LENiVLPs retained membrane fusion capability, they were noninfectious owing to postentry defects that prevented viral replication. Thus, LEN binds to the precursor Gag and promotes aberrant particle formation, offering insights that could guide the development of next-generation LEN-based therapeutics targeting the late stages of the viral life cycle.
title_zh: Lenacapavir结合未成熟Gag诱导巨型病毒颗粒并引起蛋白酶依赖的病毒释放抑制
abstract_zh: Lenacapavir（LEN）是一种强效衣壳抑制剂，通过破坏HIV 1型（HIV-1）衣壳核心的形成来抑制逆转录和核输入。然而，其对晚期病毒组装的影响仍不清楚。尽管p24 ELISA显示LEN显著抑制HIV-1，但RT-dPCR和Vpr-HiBiT检测均表明抑制病毒释放需要相对较高的LEN浓度。这种差异归因于LEN诱导的p24溶解性降低，导致对其病毒释放抑制效应的高估。此外，在LEN存在下观察到病毒蛋白酶对胞内Gag的过度加工，这也损害了病毒释放。同时，LEN在质膜上诱导Gag形成大量异常的离散簇。利用分析HIV-1颗粒尺寸的质量光度法和透射电子显微镜，我们鉴定出同时含Gag和Env蛋白的异质性LEN诱导病毒样颗粒（LENiVLPs；直径>200 nm）。尽管LENiVLPs保留膜融合能力，但由于阻止病毒复制的进入后缺陷而丧失感染性。因此，LEN结合前体Gag并促进异常颗粒形成，为指导针对病毒生命周期晚期的下一代LEN类药物的开发提供了见解。

title: Viscous remanent magnetization authentication method for archaeological artifacts
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
Museums and public collections often contain archaeological clay artifacts of unknown origin. Such artifacts, if proven to be authentic, may contribute significantly to our understanding of ancient societies. However, the authenticity of these artifacts is usually highly debated, resulting in their being disregarded in historical interpretations. Several laboratory methods have been developed in order to authenticate such objects but none have been proven infallible. Here we present a method for distinguishing between authentic and fake clay artifacts by considering the Viscous Remanent Magnetization (VRM) acquired by the artifacts. Clay objects tend to acquire a strong magnetic signal termed Thermal Remanent Magnetization (TRM) upon heating and cooling in kilns during their manufacturing process. After being removed from the orientation in which their TRM was acquired, these objects were exposed to an ambient geomagnetic field in a different direction. Over archaeological time scales, this results in the acquisition of a significant VRM. We propose a laboratory protocol for identifying this ancient VRM. We validated the protocol using micromagnetic modeling of single domain particles and by laboratory experiments carried out on 19 ancient and 26 modern objects, made from different types of clay and fired using different firing techniques. Both the experiments and the simulations indicate that the existence of a significant VRM component removed at temperatures higher than a cutoff temperature of

                            °
                          
                        
                      
                    
                    C is indicative of ancient objects while its removal at lower temperatures is indicative of modern objects. We successfully applied this method to objects of debated authenticity.

title: Leveraging generative AI for causal inference with unstructured data
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: We introduce GenAI-Powered Inference (GPI), a statistical framework for causal inference using unstructured data, including text and images. GPI leverages open-source pretrained Generative AI (GenAI) models—such as large language models and diffusion models—not only to generate unstructured data at scale but also to extract low-dimensional representations that are guaranteed to capture their underlying structure. Applying machine learning to these representations, GPI enables estimation of causal effects while quantifying estimation uncertainty. Unlike existing approaches to representation learning, GPI does not require fine-tuning of GenAI models, making it computationally efficient and broadly accessible. We illustrate the versatility of the GPI framework through three applications: 1) estimating the effects of Chinese social media censorship while adjusting for textual confounders, 2) isolating the impact of specific image features from that of other correlated features in the same image, and 3) assessing the persuasiveness of political rhetoric. An open-source software package is available for implementing GPI.
title_zh: 利用生成式AI基于非结构化数据进行因果推断
abstract_zh: 我们介绍了生成式人工智能驱动推断（GenAI-Powered Inference，GPI），这是一种利用非结构化数据（包括文本和图像）进行因果推断的统计框架。GPI 利用开源的预训练生成式人工智能（GenAI）模型——例如大语言模型和扩散模型——不仅能够大规模生成非结构化数据，还能提取能够保证捕捉其底层结构的低维表示。通过对这些表示应用机器学习，GPI 能够在量化估计不确定性的同时估计因果效应。与现有的表示学习方法不同，GPI 不需要对 GenAI 模型进行微调，因而计算高效且广泛可用。我们通过三个应用展示了 GPI 框架的多样性：1) 在调整文本混杂因素的情况下估计中国社交媒体审查的影响；2) 将特定图像特征的影响与同一图像中其他相关特征的影响分离开来；以及 3) 评估政治言论的说服力。我们提供了一个用于实现 GPI 的开源软件包。

title: Hex-MASP for mapping the whole-tissue spatial proteome and the intrabrain distribution of monoclonal antibodies
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
Whole-tissue level spatial proteomics provides critical insights into region-specific biological regulations but remains challenging. Previously, we introduced the micro-scaffold assisted spatial proteomics (MASP) concept for whole-tissue mapping. However, this prototype required substantial development in spatial resolution, practicality, and throughput for practical application. Here we present a next-generation MASP technique (
                    hex-
                    MASP) featuring i) a new design of hexagonal-micro-wells fabricated with optimized projection micro-stereolithography 3D-printing, achieving high spatial resolution, sampling robustness, and mechanical strength for reproducibly compartmentalizing even tough tissues; ii) enhanced throughput/effectiveness in sample preparation and LC–MS analysis with high quantitative quality. Applied to mouse brain,
                    hex-
                    MASP achieved in-depth, whole-tissue mapping for >6,000 proteins in mouse brains, with high spatial accuracy and excellent data quality. The substantially improved resolution revealed critical regional details across the entire brain, that were not previously captured, enabling precise depiction of protein distribution heterogeneity. This technique enabled the identification of many unreported regionally enriched proteins across brain structures. We further applied
                    hex-
                    MASP to investigate the intrabrain distribution of intracerebroventricularly dosed antibody therapeutics and related proteins, which enabled whole-tissue mapping of protein drugs revealed insights into antibody brain penetration and distribution.
                    Hex
                    -MASP represents a robust, scalable platform for whole-tissue spatial proteomics.

title: Extreme climatic events drive consistent and predictable shifts in soil antibiotic resistance genes
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a growing One Health challenge, and as climate warming intensifies extreme events, it remains unclear how these disturbances affect soil antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs). Here we analyzed the data from a controlled experiment using soils from 30 grassland sites across ten European countries, which simulated drought, flooding, freeze–thaw, and heatwaves to explore ARG dynamics. Overall, ARGs exhibited relatively small but highly consistent shifts across treatments. Heatwaves caused the strongest reductions in ARG abundance and in their linkages with mobile genetic elements (MGEs), a pattern that may reflect a hypothesized metabolic–genetic trade–off, in which microbial investment may shift from core metabolism toward stress signaling and structural maintenance. ARG dynamics during and after disturbance were governed by distinct soil physicochemical properties, with temperature and nutrient status determining acute responses, whereas soil moisture and seasonal variability in temperature and precipitation shaped longer–term legacy effects. Cross–validated random–forest models showed positive predictive performance for Bray–Curtis–based compositional responses within the environmental range represented by the 30 grassland sites. Our findings enhance the understanding of how soil ARGs respond to extreme climatic events and provide a step toward predicting extreme–event impacts on soil resistomes with relevance to One Health.
title_zh: 极端气候事件驱动土壤抗生素抗性基因的一致且可预测的变化
abstract_zh: 抗菌素耐药性（AMR）是一个日益严峻的“同一健康”（One Health）挑战，随着气候变暖加剧极端事件，这些扰动如何影响土壤抗生素抗性基因（ARGs）仍不清楚。在此，我们分析了来自欧洲十个国家 30 个草地地点土壤的受控实验数据，该实验模拟了干旱、洪水、冻融和热浪，以探究 ARG 的动态变化。总体而言，ARG 在各处理间表现出相对较小但高度一致的变化。热浪导致 ARG 丰度及其与移动遗传元件（MGEs）的关联性出现最强程度的降低，这一模式可能反映了一种假设的代谢–遗传权衡，即微生物的投资可能从核心代谢转向胁迫信号传导和结构维持。扰动期间和之后的 ARG 动态受不同土壤理化性质的调控，温度和养分状况决定急性响应，而土壤湿度以及温度和降水的季节性变异性则塑造了较长期的遗留效应。经交叉验证的随机森林模型在 30 个草地地点所代表的环境范围内，对基于 Bray–Curtis 的组成响应显示出正向预测性能。我们的发现加深了对土壤 ARG 如何响应极端气候事件的理解，并为预测极端事件对与“同一健康”相关的土壤耐药组的影响迈出了一步。

title: Fish navigate a hydrodynamic maze via yaw-mediated lateral migration
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: In aquatic environments, gradients in flow velocity and turbulence define a constantly shifting landscape that sets the physical constraints on propulsion and energy expenditure in fish. Successfully navigating these complex flows depends on the ability to sense and respond to subtle hydrodynamic cues in an energy-efficient manner. Revealing these mechanisms is central to understanding how fish identify and exploit favorable flow conditions. To this end, we designed a hydrodynamic maze with spatially varying mean flow and turbulence, creating a controlled heterogeneous flow landscape for understanding fish movement strategies. We found that fish escape energetically unfavorable regions by yawing their bodies relative to the flow. These yawed orientations appear to facilitate lateral migration through lift forces and may improve sensitivity to local flow variations. Notably, fish maintain body orientations near, but below, predicted stall conditions to exploit lift without a significant increase in drag. These findings provide insight into how fish navigate heterogeneous hydrodynamic environments, with potential relevance for both natural and engineered flow systems.
title_zh: 鱼类通过偏航介导的侧向迁移在水动力迷宫中导航
abstract_zh: 在水生环境中，流速和湍流的梯度定义了一个不断变化的景观，为鱼类的推进和能量消耗设定了物理约束。成功在这些复杂的水流中航行，取决于以节能方式感知和响应细微流体动力学线索的能力。揭示这些机制对于理解鱼类如何识别并利用有利的流动条件至关重要。为此，我们设计了一个具有空间变化平均流速和湍流的水动力迷宫，为理解鱼类的运动策略创造了受控的异质流动景观。我们发现鱼类通过使身体相对于水流偏航来逃离能量不利的区域。这些偏航姿态似乎通过升力促进侧向迁移，并可能提高对局部水流变化的敏感性。值得注意的是，鱼类将身体姿态维持在接近但低于预测失速条件的状态，以利用升力而不会显著增加阻力。这些发现为鱼类如何在异质流体动力学环境中航行提供了见解，对自然和工程流动系统均具有潜在意义。

title: Impact of the small Dirac component on the valence electron density of actinides at their nuclei in solids
source: Recent Articles in Phys. Rev. C
abstract: Author(s): A. V. Nikolaev, U. N. Kurelchuk, and E. V. TkalyaAn enhanced Full-Potential Linear Augmented Plane Wave (FLAPW) method is introduced which incorporates the small Dirac components of valence states—specifically the 6p1/2 semicore states—in actinide solids such as Ac, Th, ThO2, and UO2. By accounting for these small components, it is demonstrated that the valence electron density at the nucleus increases by a factor of 2.4 to 4.3, correcting standard approximations in computational physics that omit significant valence electron density near the atomic nucleus. These refined relativistic Dirac calculations offer improved theoretical precision for nuclear phenomena such as internal conversion, Mossbauer spectroscopy, and electron bridge effects, providing foundational electronic structure insights relevant to technologies like 229Th-based solid-state nuclear clocks.[Phys. Rev. C 114, 034601] Published Thu Sep 03, 2026
title_zh: 小Dirac分量对固体中锕系元素原子核处价电子密度的影响
abstract_zh: 作者：A. V. Nikolaev、U. N. Kurelchuk 和 E. V. Tkalya 介绍了一种增强的全势线性增强平面波 (FLAPW) 方法，该方法结合了锕系固体（例如 Ac、Th、ThO2 和 UO2）中价态（特别是 6p1/2 半核态）的小狄拉克分量。通过考虑这些小成分，证明原子核处的价电子密度增加了 2.4 至 4.3 倍，修正了计算物理学中忽略原子核附近显着价电子密度的标准近似。这些精炼的相对论狄拉克计算提高了内转换、穆斯堡尔光谱和电子桥效应等核现象的理论精度，提供了与基于 229Th 的固态核钟等技术相关的基础电子结构见解。修订版 C 114, 034601] 于 2026 年 9 月 3 日星期四发布
